text: 预检分诊 triage 患者到院后由护士快速判断病情轻重并确定就诊优先顺序的环节 The process of sorting arriving patients by clinical urgency so that treatment is given in the order of need. 预检分诊 分诊台
分诊台 triage desk 急诊入口处供护士接待患者、询问情况并完成登记的工作台 The staffed desk at the emergency entrance where nurses receive patients, obtain basic information, and register them. 预检分诊 分诊台
分诊护士 triage nurse 在急诊入口负责首轮评估与分级判断的注册护士 A registered nurse who performs the initial assessment and assigns acuity levels at the emergency entrance. 预检分诊 分诊台
分诊标准 triage criteria 判断患者病情紧急程度所依据的统一条目与判定规则 The standardized criteria and decision rules used to judge how urgent a patient's condition is. 预检分诊 分诊台
分诊记录 triage record 记载患者到院时间、分级结果与去向的护理文书 A nursing document that records arrival time, assigned acuity, and the patient's destination. 预检分诊 分诊台
快速分诊 rapid triage 在极短时间内仅凭外观与关键问题完成分级的简化流程 A streamlined process that assigns acuity within a very short time using appearance and a few key questions. 预检分诊 分诊区
批量分诊 mass casualty triage 大量伤员同时到达时按救治优先级分配资源的分诊方式 Triage used when many casualties arrive at once, assigning treatment priority and resources among them. 预检分诊 急诊大厅
二次分诊 secondary triage 患者进入诊区后由接诊医生再次评估并调整优先级的环节 A second assessment performed after the patient enters the treatment area to confirm or revise priority. 预检分诊 接诊区
再评估 periodic reassessment 候诊或治疗过程中按固定间隔重新判断病情变化的过程 The repeated evaluation of a patient at set intervals to detect any change in condition. 预检分诊 候诊区
症状分诊 symptom-based triage 以患者主要症状为线索选择对应流程与分区的方法 A method that uses the patient's main symptom to select the appropriate pathway and treatment area. 预检分诊 分诊台
传染病预检 screening for infectious diseases 对到院患者筛查传染性疾病风险并采取隔离措施的环节 The step of screening arriving patients for infectious disease risk and applying isolation when needed. 预检分诊 预检区
发热预检 fever screening 在急诊入口测量体温并登记发热情况的初筛措施 An initial screening measure at the emergency entrance that measures and records fever. 预检分诊 急诊门口
流行病学史筛查 epidemiological screening 询问旅行史、接触史与聚集史以判断传染病风险的步骤 The step of asking about travel, contact, and cluster history to assess infectious disease risk. 预检分诊 分诊台
分诊准确性 triage accuracy 分诊结果与患者真实病情紧急程度的一致程度 The degree to which the assigned triage level agrees with the patient's true clinical urgency. 预检分诊 分诊台
分诊不足 undertriage 把危重患者的分级定得过低，导致其等待时间延长的错误 An error in which a critically ill patient is assigned too low an acuity level, delaying care. 预检分诊 分诊台 与「过度分诊」相对，易译成 missed triage
过度分诊 overtriage 把病情较轻的患者分级定得过高，占用抢救资源的现象 Assigning a higher acuity than warranted to a less sick patient, which uses up critical care resources. 预检分诊 分诊台
等待时间 waiting time 患者完成分诊到实际接受医生诊治之间的时长 The time between completion of triage and the patient actually being seen by a doctor. 预检分诊 候诊区
分诊等级 triage level 分诊后标定的紧急程度档次，通常用数字或颜色表示 The urgency category assigned at triage, usually expressed as a number or a color. 预检分诊 分诊台
预检评估 preliminary assessment 正式诊疗前对患者外观、呼吸与反应做出的快速判断 A quick judgement of appearance, breathing, and responsiveness made before formal assessment. 预检分诊 分诊台
接诊台 reception desk 急诊大厅内负责登记、答疑与初步引导的服务台 The service counter in the emergency hall that handles registration, inquiries, and initial guidance. 预检分诊 急诊大厅
急诊入口 emergency entrance 供患者与救护车进入急诊区域的通道口 The entry point through which patients and ambulances reach the emergency area. 预检分诊 急诊入口
步行入院 walk-in 患者自行步入急诊而非由救护车送来的到院方式 Arrival at the emergency department on foot rather than by ambulance. 预检分诊 急诊入口
目测评估 visual assessment 不接触患者、仅凭观察外观与姿态判断紧急程度的方法 Judging urgency by observing appearance and posture without touching the patient. 预检分诊 分诊台
分诊访谈 triage interview 分诊护士用简短提问了解患者症状与经过的对话过程 The short structured conversation in which the triage nurse learns the patient's symptoms and course. 预检分诊 分诊台
分诊分区 triage zone 按病情轻重把急诊划分为不同救治区域的做法 The practice of dividing the emergency department into zones according to patient acuity. 预检分诊 分诊区
分诊决策 triage decision 分诊护士据以确定分级与去向的判断结果 The judgement reached by the triage nurse that sets the acuity level and destination. 预检分诊 分诊台
分诊指南 triage guideline 规范分诊操作与分级判定的行业性指导文件 A professional document that standardizes triage practice and acuity assignment. 预检分诊 分诊台
分诊差错 triage error 分诊过程中分级或去向判断出现偏差的事件 An incident in which the assigned acuity or destination during triage is incorrect. 预检分诊 分诊台
儿童分诊 pediatric triage 针对儿童患者采用年龄相关指标进行分级的专门流程 A dedicated triage process for children that uses age-specific indicators. 预检分诊 分诊区
电话分诊 telephone triage 通过电话询问情况并给出就诊建议的分诊形式 Triage conducted over the telephone, in which advice is given based on the reported symptoms. 预检分诊 分诊台
分诊分级 acuity level 预检后为患者确定的紧急等级，决定其就诊与处置的先后顺序 The urgency category assigned after triage that determines the order of assessment and treatment. 分诊分级 分诊台 与「分诊等级」近义，后者更强调档次编号
分级标准 triage scale 把病情由轻到重划分为若干档次的统一度量工具 A standardized instrument that ranks conditions into ordered levels from least to most urgent. 分诊分级 分诊台
五级分诊 five-level triage 将患者病情划分为五个紧急档次的国际常用分诊体系 An internationally used triage system that sorts patients into five levels of urgency. 分诊分级 分诊台
病情分级 severity classification 按疾病严重程度对患者进行层级划分的过程 The process of classifying patients into levels according to how severe their condition is. 分诊分级 分诊台
危急级别 resuscitation category 最高紧急档次，表示患者需要立即复苏或抢救 The highest urgency category, indicating that the patient needs immediate resuscitation. 分诊分级 抢救室
危重患者 critically ill patient 病情随时可能恶化、需要连续监护与优先处置的患者 A patient whose condition may deteriorate at any moment and who needs continuous monitoring and priority care. 分诊分级 抢救室
急症患者 urgent patient 病情较重但暂时稳定、需在较短时间内处理的患者 A patient who is seriously unwell but currently stable and needs care within a short time. 分诊分级 接诊区
非紧急患者 non-urgent patient 病情稳定、可延后处理且不影响预后的患者 A patient whose condition is stable and who can safely wait without affecting the outcome. 分诊分级 候诊区
分级颜色 color code 用不同颜色标示病情紧急档次的做法 The practice of marking acuity levels with different colors for quick recognition. 分诊分级 分诊台
红色分级 red category 表示病情最危急、需立即抢救的颜色档次 The color category that marks the most critical condition and requires immediate resuscitation. 分诊分级 抢救室
黄色分级 yellow category 表示病情较重、需在短时间内处置的颜色档次 The color category for seriously ill patients who need treatment within a short period. 分诊分级 接诊区
绿色分级 green category 表示病情较轻、可耐受较长等待时间的颜色档次 The color category for milder conditions that can tolerate a longer wait. 分诊分级 候诊区
分级升级 acuity upgrade 因病情加重而把紧急档次调高的处理 Raising a patient's urgency level because the condition has worsened. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级降级 acuity downgrade 因病情好转而把紧急档次调低的处理 Lowering a patient's urgency level because the condition has improved. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级复核 level review 由高年资人员对分诊结果进行的再次核查 A second check of the triage result carried out by a more experienced staff member. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级争议 acuity dispute 患者或家属对分诊等级或等候顺序提出不同意见的情形 A situation in which a patient or family member disagrees with the assigned acuity level. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级阈值 acuity threshold 判定患者进入某一紧急档次所依据的边界条件 The boundary condition that determines whether a patient meets a given urgency level. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级判定 acuity determination 护士综合各项指标确定患者最终紧急档次的判断过程 The judgement process in which the nurse combines several indicators to set the patient's final acuity level. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级登记 acuity registration 把患者的分级结果录入信息系统并生成记录的操作 The operation of entering the assigned acuity into the information system and generating a record. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级腕带 acuity wristband 印有分级颜色与患者信息的识别腕带 An identification band printed with the acuity color and the patient's details. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级优先顺序 priority order 按紧急程度排列的患者接诊先后次序 The sequence in which patients are seen, arranged according to how urgent their condition is. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级一致性 triage reliability 不同护士对同一患者给出相同分级结果的程度 The degree to which different nurses assign the same acuity level to the same patient. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级质控 acuity quality control 对分诊分级过程与结果进行持续监督与改进的活动 Ongoing monitoring and improvement of the triage process and the resulting acuity assignments. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级培训 triage training 针对分诊标准与分级操作开展的岗位培训 Job training on the triage criteria and the practical assignment of acuity levels. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级告知 acuity notification 向患者说明其分诊等级与预计等候时长的沟通 The communication in which the patient is told their acuity level and expected wait. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级标识 acuity marker 贴在病历或床头用于快速识别分级的颜色标记 A colored marker attached to the chart or bedside to show the acuity level at a glance. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级信息系统 triage information system 用于记录分诊数据并自动计算时限的计算机系统 A computer system that records triage data and automatically calculates target times. 分诊分级 分诊台
分级响应时限 response time target 各分级对应的最长应诊等待时间要求 The maximum waiting time allowed for each acuity level before the patient must be seen. 分诊分级 分诊台
急诊挂号 emergency registration 患者在急诊窗口办理就诊登记并获取就诊序号的手续 The procedure by which a patient registers at the emergency counter and receives a visit number. 急诊挂号 挂号处
挂号处 registration desk 医院内办理挂号与缴费手续的服务窗口 The service counter in the hospital where registration and payment are handled. 急诊挂号 挂号处
挂号窗口 registration window 挂号处内按编号分别办理登记与收费业务的服务窗口 One of the numbered service windows at the registration desk. 急诊挂号 挂号处
挂号单 registration slip 记录患者科室、序号与就诊信息的纸质凭据 A paper slip that records the patient's department, queue number, and visit details. 急诊挂号 挂号处
挂号费 registration fee 患者办理挂号手续时支付的固定服务费用 A fixed service charge paid when the patient completes registration. 急诊挂号 挂号处
现场挂号 on-site registration 患者到院后在窗口即时办理的挂号方式 Registration completed at the counter after the patient arrives at the hospital. 急诊挂号 挂号处
自助挂号 self-service registration 患者通过自助机或手机自行完成挂号的方式 Registration that patients complete themselves through a kiosk or a mobile application. 急诊挂号 挂号处
补挂号 re-registration 因欠费或信息缺失而重新办理挂号的手续 The procedure of registering again because of missing payment or incomplete information. 急诊挂号 挂号处
退号 registration cancellation 取消已办理的挂号并按规定退还费用的操作 The operation of cancelling a completed registration and refunding the fee as required. 急诊挂号 挂号处
建卡 patient card creation 为首次就诊者建立院内身份账户的步骤 The step of creating a hospital identity account for a first-time patient. 急诊挂号 挂号处
就诊卡 hospital card 记录患者院内标识与就诊信息的卡片 A card that carries the patient's hospital identifier and visit information. 急诊挂号 挂号处
电子健康卡 electronic health card 以二维码形式使用的跨机构就医身份凭证 A QR-code based credential used to identify patients across medical institutions. 急诊挂号 挂号处
急诊号 emergency ticket 急诊挂号后获得的就诊序号与排队凭证 The numbered ticket issued after emergency registration that determines the order of consultation. 急诊挂号 分诊台
加号 extra slot 在号源已满时为患者临时增加的接诊名额 An additional appointment slot created when the regular slots are full. 急诊挂号 挂号处
挂号员 registration clerk 在挂号窗口办理登记与收费的工作人员 The staff member who handles registration and payment at the registration window. 急诊挂号 挂号处
号源 appointment slot 可供患者预约或现场分配的接诊名额 A unit of appointment capacity that can be booked or allocated on site. 急诊挂号 挂号处
实名挂号 real-name registration 要求使用真实身份信息办理挂号的制度 A system that requires registration under the patient's true identity. 急诊挂号 挂号处
挂号信息 registration information 挂号时采集的患者身份、科室与序号等数据 The data collected at registration, including identity, department, and queue number. 急诊挂号 挂号处
信息录入 data entry 把患者资料输入医院信息系统的操作 The operation of entering patient details into the hospital information system. 急诊挂号 挂号处
录入错误 entry error 输入患者资料时出现的文字或数字差错 A textual or numerical mistake made while entering patient details. 急诊挂号 挂号处
代办挂号 proxy registration 由家属或他人代替患者办理挂号的方式 Registration completed by a family member or another person on the patient's behalf. 急诊挂号 挂号处
无卡挂号 registration without a card 患者未持就诊卡时凭身份信息临时办理挂号的方式 Registration completed with identity information alone when the patient has no hospital card. 急诊挂号 挂号处
首诊登记 first-visit registration 患者在本院第一次就诊时建立的登记记录 The registration record created when a patient visits the hospital for the first time. 急诊挂号 挂号处
复诊登记 return-visit registration 患者再次就诊时调取原有档案并登记的步骤 The step of retrieving the existing record and registering a patient who returns for another visit. 急诊挂号 挂号处
挂号类型 registration type 区分普通、专家、急诊等挂号类别的标识 A label that distinguishes general, specialist, and emergency registration categories. 急诊挂号 挂号处
收费项目 charge item 医院向患者收取费用的具体诊疗或服务条目 A specific service or procedure item for which the hospital charges the patient. 急诊挂号 收费处
挂号凭条 registration receipt 挂号成功后打印的含序号与费用的凭据 The printed document showing the queue number and fee after successful registration. 急诊挂号 挂号处
身份核验 identity verification 核对患者所持证件与本人信息是否一致的过程 The process of checking that the document presented matches the patient's own identity. 身份核验 挂号处
身份证 identity card 用于证明中国公民身份的法定身份证件 The official document that certifies the identity of a Chinese citizen. 身份核验 挂号处
护照 passport 证明外国公民身份与国籍的旅行证件 A travel document that certifies a foreign national's identity and nationality. 身份核验 挂号处

en: Exit-Entry Permit for Travelling to and from Hong Kong and Macau
text: 港澳通行证 Exit-Entry Permit for Travelling to and from Hong Kong and Macau 内地居民往来香港与澳门使用的旅行证件 The travel document used by mainland residents to visit Hong Kong and Macau. 身份核验 挂号处 英文全称较长，句中常用 Exit-Entry Permit 简称
台胞证 Taiwan Compatriot Permit 台湾居民来往大陆时使用的身份证件 The identity document used by Taiwan residents travelling to the mainland. 身份核验 挂号处
护照号码 passport number 护照上用于唯一识别持照人身份的编号 The number on a passport that uniquely identifies its holder. 身份核验 挂号处
证件类型 document type 用于标识患者所持身份证件种类的字段 The field that records which kind of identity document the patient presents. 身份核验 挂号处
证件号码 document number 证件上标示的唯一识别号码，用于系统查询 The unique identification number printed on an identity document and used for system lookup. 身份核验 挂号处
姓名核对 name check 比对患者自述姓名与证件姓名的步骤 The step of comparing the name the patient gives with the name on the document. 身份核验 挂号处
姓名拼写 name spelling 按证件逐字给出姓名写法以避免系统检索错误 Giving the name character by character as printed on the document to avoid record lookup errors. 身份核验 挂号处
出生日期 date of birth 患者出生的年月日，是身份核对的关键项目 The year, month, and day a patient was born, used as a key identity check. 身份核验 挂号处
国籍 nationality 患者所属的国家，决定证件类型与结算方式 The country to which a patient belongs, which determines document type and billing arrangements. 身份核验 挂号处
人证合一 identity matching 通过现场比对确认持证人与证件为同一人的核验要求 The requirement to confirm on the spot that the person presenting a document is its rightful holder. 身份核验 挂号处
人脸识别 facial recognition 用摄像头采集面部特征并与证件照片比对的技术 Technology that captures facial features by camera and compares them with the document photograph. 身份核验 挂号处
指纹核验 fingerprint verification 采集指纹并与证件或系统记录比对的身份确认方式 A method of confirming identity by capturing a fingerprint and comparing it with a document or system record. 身份核验 挂号处
无证件患者 patient without identification 到院时未能提供任何有效身份证件的患者 A patient who arrives at the emergency department without any valid identity document. 身份核验 挂号处
身份不明 unidentified person 无法确认姓名与身份的到院患者或伤员 A patient or casualty whose name and identity cannot be established. 身份核验 抢救室
无名氏 unnamed patient 医院为身份不明患者临时使用的统一代称 A temporary standardized name used by the hospital for patients whose identity is unknown. 身份核验 挂号处
临时身份 temporary identity 在正式身份确认前为患者建立的过渡性标识 A provisional identifier created for a patient before the formal identity is confirmed. 身份核验 挂号处
监护人确认 guardian confirmation 未成年患者由监护人核对身份并签署确认的步骤 The step in which the guardian of a minor patient verifies identity and signs confirmation. 身份核验 挂号处
代办人 authorized agent 受患者委托代为办理挂号与手续的人员 A person entrusted by the patient to handle registration and paperwork on their behalf. 身份核验 挂号处
就诊人 patient registrant 挂号信息中实际接受诊疗的自然人 The natural person who will actually receive care according to the registration record. 身份核验 挂号处
关系证明 proof of relationship 证明代办人与患者亲属关系的材料 Documentation that proves the family relationship between the agent and the patient. 身份核验 挂号处
签证有效期 visa validity 外国患者所持签证允许停留的起止时间 The period during which a foreign patient's visa permits them to stay. 身份核验 挂号处
同名患者 same-name patient 姓名完全相同、需靠其他信息区分的患者 Patients who share exactly the same name and must be distinguished by other details. 身份核验 挂号处
身份信息采集 identity data collection 按规范获取并保存患者身份相关信息的过程 The process of obtaining and storing a patient's identity-related information in a standard way. 身份核验 挂号处
医保结算 medical insurance settlement 由医保基金与医院直接结算患者合规医疗费用的方式 The arrangement in which the insurance fund settles covered medical costs directly with the hospital. 医保与支付 收费处
医保目录 medical insurance formulary 纳入医保支付范围的药品与诊疗项目清单 The list of drugs and services covered by medical insurance payments. 医保与支付 收费处
异地医保 out-of-town medical insurance 参保地与就诊地不同的医保结算情形 A situation in which the insurance is registered in one place but care is received in another. 医保与支付 收费处
缴费 payment 患者向医院支付已发生医疗费用的行为 The act of a patient paying the hospital for medical services already received. 医保与支付 收费处
缴费窗口 cashier window 医院内办理现金或刷卡缴费的窗口 The hospital counter where payment is made in cash or by card. 医保与支付 收费处
移动支付 mobile payment 通过手机应用完成医疗费用支付的方式 The act of paying medical costs through a mobile phone application. 医保与支付 收费处
扫码支付 QR code payment 扫描二维码在线完成医疗费用支付的方式 A payment method in which a QR code is scanned to complete the transaction. 医保与支付 收费处
现金支付 cash payment 以纸币或硬币当场结清费用的方式 Settling a charge on the spot using banknotes or coins. 医保与支付 收费处
刷卡支付 card payment 通过银行卡刷卡机完成费用支付的方式 Paying a charge by swiping a bank card at a card reader. 医保与支付 收费处
收据 receipt 缴费后由医院财务出具的收款证明 A proof of payment issued by the hospital finance office after a charge is settled. 医保与支付 收费处
费用查询 charge inquiry 患者查询已发生医疗费用明细的服务 A service that lets patients look up the details of charges already incurred. 医保与支付 收费处
费用不足 insufficient funds 预交金或账户余额不足以支付当前费用的情况 A situation in which the deposit or account balance cannot cover the current charges. 医保与支付 收费处
应急救助 emergency assistance 对无力支付费用的急危患者先行救治的保障措施 A safeguard that ensures urgent care is given first to patients who cannot pay. 医保与支付 收费处
应急救助基金 emergency assistance fund 用于垫付无力支付患者急救费用的专项资金 A dedicated fund that advances the cost of emergency care for patients who cannot pay. 医保与支付 收费处
退费 refund 因项目取消或重复收费而退还已交费用的操作 The operation of returning money already paid because a service was cancelled or charged twice. 医保与支付 收费处
支付方式 payment method 患者选择用于结清医疗费用的具体途径 The specific channel a patient chooses to settle medical charges. 医保与支付 收费处
结算单 settlement statement 列明医保支付与个人负担金额的结算凭证 A settlement document that shows the amounts paid by insurance and by the patient. 医保与支付 收费处
就诊流程 patient flow 患者从到院到离开急诊所经历的各环节顺序 The sequence of steps a patient goes through from arrival to leaving the emergency department. 就诊流程 急诊大厅
急诊接诊 emergency reception 急诊医护人员接收患者并开始初次诊治的环节 The stage in which emergency staff receive a patient and begin the first assessment and treatment. 就诊流程 接诊区
医生接诊 doctor consultation 由医生面对面询问病情并作出初步判断的过程 The process in which a doctor interviews the patient face to face and makes an initial judgement. 就诊流程 诊室
首诊 first consultation 患者本次疾病第一次由医生诊查并记录的过程 The first occasion on which a doctor examines and documents the patient for the current illness. 就诊流程 诊室
就诊序号 visit number 患者挂号后获得的院内就诊排队编号 The queue number assigned to a patient within the hospital after registration. 就诊流程 急诊大厅
转科 interdepartmental transfer 患者因病情需要从一个科室转到另一个科室继续诊治 Moving a patient from one department to another for continued assessment and treatment. 就诊流程 急诊大厅
会诊 consultation 邀请其他专科医生共同讨论患者病情的诊疗形式 A clinical arrangement in which doctors from other specialties are invited to discuss the patient's condition. 就诊流程 诊室
住院办理 admission processing 为需要住院的患者办理床位与手续的流程 The process of arranging a bed and completing paperwork for a patient who needs admission. 就诊流程 住院处
入院手续 admission procedure 患者正式进入病房前须完成的各项登记与检查 The registrations and checks that must be completed before a patient formally enters the ward. 就诊流程 住院处
出院办理 discharge processing 为病情稳定患者办理离院与费用结算的流程 The process of arranging departure and settling costs for a patient whose condition is stable. 就诊流程 住院处
检查预约 examination scheduling 为患者安排影像或功能检查具体时间的操作 The operation of booking a specific time for imaging or functional examinations. 就诊流程 检查室
检查陪同 examination escort 由工作人员或家属陪同患者前往检查科室 Accompanying a patient to the examination department, either by staff or by family. 就诊流程 检查室
检查转运 examination transport 用平车或轮椅把患者送到检查科室的过程 Moving a patient to the examination department by stretcher or wheelchair. 就诊流程 检查室
门诊转急诊 outpatient-to-emergency transfer 门诊患者病情变化时转入急诊继续诊治的过程 The process of moving an outpatient whose condition has changed into the emergency department. 就诊流程 急诊大厅
急诊转住院 emergency admission 急诊患者经评估后收住病房继续治疗的过程 The process of admitting an emergency patient to a ward for continued treatment after assessment. 就诊流程 住院处
就诊环节 visit step 就诊过程中相对独立的一个操作或处理阶段 One relatively self-contained action or stage within the visit process. 就诊流程 急诊大厅
就诊时长 visit duration 患者从挂号到离开急诊所用的总时间 The total time from registration to leaving the emergency department. 就诊流程 急诊大厅
流程优化 process improvement 通过调整环节与资源缩短患者等待的做法 The practice of shortening patient waits by adjusting steps and resources. 就诊流程 急诊大厅
二次就诊 repeat visit 同一疾病在短期内再次到急诊就诊的情形 A situation in which the patient returns to the emergency department for the same illness within a short period. 就诊流程 急诊大厅
就诊高峰期 peak hours 急诊患者集中到达、资源最紧张的时段 The period when emergency patients arrive in large numbers and resources are most stretched. 就诊流程 候诊区
就诊状态 visit status 患者在系统中所处的就诊阶段标识 The label in the system showing which stage of the visit the patient has reached. 就诊流程 诊室
就诊完成 visit completion 患者结束本次急诊诊疗并离院的节点 The point at which the patient finishes the current emergency visit and leaves. 就诊流程 急诊大厅
就诊确认 visit confirmation 患者或家属对本次诊疗安排表示同意的签认 The patient's or family's signed acknowledgement agreeing to the current care arrangements. 就诊流程 诊室
就诊秩序 department order 急诊区域内患者排队与就诊的正常次序 The proper order of queueing and consultation within the emergency area. 就诊流程 急诊大厅
流程公示 process disclosure 把就诊步骤与时限向患者公开告知的做法 The practice of publicly informing patients about visit steps and time limits. 就诊流程 急诊大厅
分诊后就诊 consultation after triage 完成预检分级后进入医生诊查的阶段 The stage of being seen by a doctor after triage and acuity assignment are complete. 就诊流程 接诊区
复诊预约 follow-up appointment 为患者安排下次就诊时间与科室的操作 The operation of arranging the time and department for the patient's next visit. 就诊流程 诊室
候诊 waiting for consultation 患者完成挂号后等待医生接诊的过程 The period during which a patient waits to be seen after registration. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊区 waiting area 急诊内供患者等候就诊的指定区域 The designated area in the emergency department where patients wait to be seen. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊时长 wait duration 患者从挂号到被叫号之间的时间长度 The length of time between registration and being called to be seen. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊叫号 queue calling 按顺序呼叫候诊患者进入诊室的做法 The practice of calling waiting patients into the consulting room in order. 候诊管理 候诊区
叫号系统 queuing system 自动排序并呼叫就诊号码的电子系统 An electronic system that automatically orders and calls visit numbers. 候诊管理 候诊区
排队 queueing 患者按先后顺序在窗口或诊室外等候 Waiting in order at a counter or outside a consulting room. 候诊管理 候诊区
插队 queue jumping 不按顺序插入队列、提前就诊的行为 The act of entering the queue out of turn to be seen earlier. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊序号 queue number 候诊时用于标识叫号先后顺序的编号 The number used to identify a patient's place in the calling order. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊屏 display screen 显示叫号信息与等候时长的电子屏幕 The electronic screen that shows calling information and waiting times. 候诊管理 候诊区
过号 missed number 患者未在叫号时到场导致号码被跳过 A situation in which a patient's number is skipped because they were not present when called. 候诊管理 候诊区
重新排队 requeue 因过号或病情变化而再次加入候诊队列 The act of joining the waiting queue again after a missed call or a change in condition. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊巡视 waiting-area rounds 护士定时巡查候诊区观察患者情况的制度 A system in which nurses periodically patrol the waiting area to observe patients. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊观察 waiting-area observation 对候诊患者持续关注病情变化的做法 The practice of continuously watching waiting patients for changes in their condition. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊病情变化 deterioration while waiting 患者在候诊期间症状加重或出现新情况 A worsening of symptoms or the appearance of new problems while a patient is waiting. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊安全 waiting-area safety 保障候诊患者不发生跌倒、走失等意外的管理 Management aimed at preventing falls, wandering, and other incidents among waiting patients. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊秩序 waiting order 候诊区内患者排队与就座的良好状态 The proper state of queueing and seating among patients in the waiting area. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊患者 waiting patient 已完成挂号、正在等待接诊的患者 A patient who has registered and is waiting to be seen. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊告知 waiting information 向候诊患者说明预计等待时间与注意事项 Informing waiting patients about the expected wait and points to note. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊宣教 waiting-area education 在候诊区向患者普及急救与健康知识的活动 Activities that teach patients first aid and health knowledge in the waiting area. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊环境 waiting environment 候诊区的温度、照明、噪音与卫生状况 The temperature, lighting, noise, and cleanliness of the waiting area. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊拥挤 overcrowding 候诊区人数超过设计容纳能力的状态 A state in which the number of people in the waiting area exceeds its capacity. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊分流 waiting-area diversion 把候诊患者引导到其他区域以缓解拥挤的措施 A measure that directs waiting patients to other areas to relieve crowding. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊优先级 waiting priority 候诊患者在叫号队列中的先后次序依据 The basis on which waiting patients are ordered in the calling queue. 候诊管理 候诊区
候诊流程 waiting process 从挂号到叫号之间患者需遵守的步骤与规则 The steps and rules a patient follows between registration and being called. 候诊管理 候诊区
座位管理 seat management 对候诊区座椅分配与优先让座的管理措施 Measures for allocating seats in the waiting area and giving priority to those in need. 候诊管理 候诊区
广播叫号 loudspeaker calling 通过广播系统播报就诊号码的方式 Announcing visit numbers to patients through the hospital public address system. 候诊管理 候诊区
绿色通道 fast-track pathway 为危重或特殊患者设置的优先接诊与检查通道 A priority pathway for critically ill or special-needs patients that speeds up assessment and testing. 绿色通道 急诊大厅
先检查后付费 examination first, payment later 绿色通道患者先完成检查、后补办缴费手续的安排 An arrangement in which fast-track patients complete examinations first and settle payment afterwards. 绿色通道 收费处
批量伤员通道 mass casualty pathway 突发事件中为成批伤员开设的集中接诊与分流通道 A dedicated route opened during an incident to receive and sort large numbers of casualties. 绿色通道 急诊入口
直达手术室 direct transfer to operating room 严重创伤或大出血患者不经病房直接送入手术间的安排 An arrangement that sends patients with severe trauma or major bleeding straight to the operating room. 绿色通道 手术室
危重孕产妇中心 maternal critical care center 专门救治病情危重的孕产妇的救治单元 A unit dedicated to the care of pregnant and postpartum women in critical condition. 绿色通道 抢救室
新生儿救治中心 neonatal care center 集中救治危重新生儿与早产儿的专病单元 A specialized unit that concentrates care for critically ill and premature newborns. 绿色通道 抢救室
先救治后付费 treat first and pay later 对急危患者先实施救治、后补办缴费手续的原则 The principle of giving emergency treatment first and completing payment procedures afterwards. 绿色通道 收费处
优先接诊 priority reception 对特定患者提前安排医生接诊的措施 A measure that arranges for certain patients to be seen by a doctor ahead of others. 绿色通道 接诊区
优先检查 priority examination 让绿色通道患者先于普通患者接受检查的安排 An arrangement that lets fast-track patients undergo examinations before routine patients. 绿色通道 检查室
通道启动 pathway activation 确认患者符合条件后开启绿色通道的动作 The action of opening the fast-track pathway once a patient is confirmed to qualify. 绿色通道 急诊大厅
通道时限 pathway time target 绿色通道各环节须完成的最长时间要求 The maximum time allowed for each step of the fast-track pathway. 绿色通道 急诊大厅
门球时间 door-to-balloon time 急性心梗患者从到院到球囊扩张的时间 The time from a heart attack patient's arrival to balloon inflation during angioplasty. 绿色通道 导管室
门针时间 door-to-needle time 缺血性卒中患者从到院到溶栓给药的时间 The time from arrival of a patient with ischaemic stroke to delivery of thrombolytic treatment. 绿色通道 抢救室
通道标识 pathway signage 标出绿色通道患者行走路线的地面与墙面标记 Floor and wall markings that guide fast-track patients along the correct route. 绿色通道 急诊大厅
通道管理 pathway management 对绿色通道运行质量与流程进行协调的活动 Activities that coordinate the operation and quality of the fast-track pathway. 绿色通道 急诊大厅
通道质控 pathway quality control 对绿色通道时限与结局指标进行统计分析的工作 The work of statistically analysing time and outcome indicators of the fast-track pathway. 绿色通道 急诊大厅
通道协调员 pathway coordinator 负责联络绿色通道各环节人员的专职岗位 A dedicated role responsible for liaising among all staff involved in the fast-track pathway. 绿色通道 急诊大厅
多学科团队 multidisciplinary care team 由多个专科人员组成、共同参与救治的团队 A team made up of staff from several specialties who take part in care together. 绿色通道 抢救室
一键启动 one-call activation 通过一个电话或按钮同时通知多个科室的机制 A mechanism that notifies several departments at once through a single call or button press. 绿色通道 急诊大厅
院前预警 prehospital alert 救护车在途中提前通知医院做好准备的信息 Information sent from the ambulance on the way so that the hospital can prepare in advance. 绿色通道 抢救室
绕行急诊 emergency department bypass 危重患者不经急诊直接送往介入或手术单元 Taking critically ill patients straight to the interventional or surgical unit without passing through the emergency department. 绿色通道 导管室

en: direct transfer to the catheterization laboratory
text: 直达导管室 direct transfer to the catheterization laboratory 把患者从入口直接送到介入手术间的安排 An arrangement that sends the patient from the entrance directly to the interventional suite. 绿色通道 导管室
优先权 priority access 绿色通道患者享有的优先使用资源资格 The right of fast-track patients to use resources ahead of others. 绿色通道 急诊大厅
通道响应时间 response time 从通道启动到患者接受关键处置的间隔 The interval from pathway activation to the patient receiving the key intervention. 绿色通道 急诊大厅
时间窗 time window 某种治疗仍能获得最佳效果的时限范围 The period within which a treatment can still achieve its best effect. 绿色通道 抢救室
应急通道 emergency access route 突发事件时供救援车辆与人员通行的专用路线 A dedicated route for rescue vehicles and personnel during an emergency incident. 绿色通道 急诊入口
通道延误 pathway delay 绿色通道某一环节超出规定时限的情况 A situation in which one step of the fast-track pathway exceeds its time limit. 绿色通道 急诊大厅
转诊 referral 因诊治需要把患者转到另一家医疗机构的过程 The process of sending a patient to another medical institution for diagnosis and treatment. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊单 referral form 记录转诊原因、病情与去向的医疗文书 A medical document that records the reason for referral, the condition, and the destination. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊申请 referral request 向接收医院提出的接收患者正式请求 A formal request to a receiving hospital to accept a patient. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊指征 referral indication 判断患者需要转往上级或其他机构的条件 The conditions that indicate a patient needs to be sent to a higher-level or other facility. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊评估 transfer assessment 对患者能否耐受转诊作出的医学判断 The medical judgement of whether a patient can tolerate being transferred. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊登记 referral registration 在信息系统中记录转诊信息的操作 The operation of recording referral information in the information system. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊审批 transfer approval 由科室负责人确认同意转诊的流程 The process by which the department head confirms agreement to the transfer. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊接收 referral acceptance 接收医院同意接收转诊患者的行为 The act of a receiving hospital agreeing to take a referred patient. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
接收确认 acceptance confirmation 接收医院以书面或电话形式作出的同意答复 The agreement given by the receiving hospital in writing or by telephone. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
接诊准备 reception preparation 接收医院在患者到达前做的床位与人员准备 The bed and staffing preparations made by the receiving hospital before the patient arrives. 转诊接收 抢救室
床位预留 bed reservation 为即将转来的患者提前保留床位的安排 An arrangement that holds a bed in advance for a patient who is about to be transferred. 转诊接收 住院处
转诊反馈 referral feedback 接收医院向转出医院说明患者后续情况的信息 Information sent by the receiving hospital to the referring hospital about the patient's progress. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
双向转诊 two-way referral 上下级医院之间按病情需要相互转送患者的机制 A mechanism in which hospitals at different levels send patients to each other according to need. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
上转 upward referral 把患者从基层机构转到上级医院的过程 The process of sending a patient from a primary facility to a higher-level hospital. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
下转 downward referral 把病情稳定的患者转到下级机构继续康复 Sending a patient whose condition is stable to a lower-level facility for continued recovery. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
跨院转诊 inter-hospital transfer 在不同医院之间转移患者接受进一步诊治 Moving a patient between hospitals for further diagnosis and treatment. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
跨省转诊 interprovincial transfer 把患者转到其他省份医疗机构救治的情形 A situation in which a patient is sent to a medical institution in another province. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
国际转诊 international referral 把患者转到境外医疗机构继续诊治的过程 The process of sending a patient to a medical institution in another country. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊沟通 referral communication 转出与接收双方就患者病情进行的交流 The exchange between the referring and receiving sides about the patient's condition. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊电话 referral call 为协调转诊事宜而拨打的专线电话 The dedicated telephone call made to coordinate the arrangements for a referral. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊风险 transfer risk 患者在转诊途中可能出现的病情恶化等风险 The risk that a patient's condition may worsen during the transfer. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊延误 referral delay 因协调不畅导致转诊未能按时完成的情况 A situation in which a referral is not completed on time because coordination has broken down. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊绿色通道 referral fast track 为转诊患者预留的优先接收与接诊安排 A priority arrangement for receiving and assessing patients who arrive by referral. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
对口医院 partner hospital 与本院建立长期协作关系的指定医院 A designated hospital that has a long-term collaborative relationship with this hospital. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
医联体 medical consortium 由不同层级医疗机构组成的协作联合体 A collaborative alliance formed by medical institutions at different levels. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊标准 referral criteria 规定何种情况应当转诊的判定依据 The criteria that state in which situations a patient should be referred. 转诊接收 急诊大厅
转诊档案 referral file 汇集转诊相关文书与记录的完整资料 The complete set of documents and records related to a referral. 转诊接收 急诊大厅

口温 oral temperature 体温计置于舌下热袋测得的温度，测温前需静候并且不能饮水 The temperature taken with a thermometer placed in the sublingual heat pocket. 体温 分诊台
肛温 rectal temperature 体温计插入直肠测得的温度，接近核心体温，多用于婴幼儿与意识障碍者 The temperature measured with a thermometer inserted into the rectum, close to core temperature. 体温 抢救室
耳温 tympanic temperature 红外线耳温计探测鼓膜温度所得读数，数秒出结果，适合快速筛查 The reading obtained by an infrared thermometer aimed at the tympanic membrane, available within seconds. 体温 分诊台

额温 temporal artery temperature 用红外测温仪在额部或颞动脉处测得的面部温度，常用于入口筛查 The facial temperature measured over the forehead or temporal artery with an infrared device, widely used for screening. 体温 发热门诊 户外低温或刚下车时额温偏低，筛查异常需复测
发热 fever 体温超过正常范围上限的状态，常伴畏寒、心率增快与代谢升高 A body temperature above the normal range, often with chills, tachycardia and raised metabolism. 体温 分诊台
高热 hyperpyrexia 体温升高至 41 摄氏度以上的状态，易引起惊厥、脱水与意识改变 A very high body temperature above 41 degrees Celsius, which may cause seizures, dehydration and altered consciousness. 体温 抢救室
低体温 hypothermia 核心体温低于 35 摄氏度的状态，可引起心律失常、凝血障碍与意识抑制 A core temperature below 35 degrees Celsius, which can cause arrhythmia, coagulopathy and depressed consciousness. 体温 抢救室

体温不升 subnormal temperature 机体体温低于正常且对常规保暖反应差的状态，常见于重症感染与休克 A body temperature below normal that responds poorly to routine warming, often seen in severe infection and shock. 体温 留观区 老年人感染时可不发热甚至体温不升，易漏诊

体温曲线 temperature curve 把多次体温读数按时点连接绘成的图形，用于判断热型与治疗效果 A graph plotting successive temperature readings against time to show the fever pattern and treatment response. 体温 病房
体温单 temperature chart 病历中专门记录体温、脉搏、呼吸与出入量的表格文书 The part of the medical record that charts temperature, pulse, respiration and fluid balance. 体温 护士站
物理降温 physical cooling 用冰袋、温水擦浴或降温毯等方式带走体热，不依赖药物 Removal of body heat by ice packs, tepid sponging or cooling blankets without drugs. 体温 抢救室
药物降温 antipyretic therapy 使用退热药物降低体温的处理，需注意剂量与肝肾功能 Treatment with antipyretic drugs to lower body temperature, with attention to dose and organ function. 体温 病房
体温探头 temperature probe 置于体腔或皮肤表面连续测温的传感器部件，常与监护仪连接使用 A sensor placed in a body cavity or on the skin for continuous temperature measurement, usually linked to a monitor. 体温 监护室

降温毯 cooling blanket 铺于患者身下、通过循环冷水带走热量的控温装置 A device placed under the patient that circulates cold water to remove body heat. 体温 监护室
