体温调节 thermoregulation 机体通过产热与散热维持体温相对恒定的生理调节过程 The physiological control of heat production and loss that keeps body temperature nearly constant. 体温 分诊台
体温计 thermometer 测量人体温度的器具，有玻璃水银式与电子式等多种类型 An instrument for measuring body temperature, available in glass, electronic and infrared types. 体温 分诊台
脉搏 pulse 心脏搏动沿动脉传导引起的血管节律性扩张，可在浅表动脉触及 The rhythmic expansion of arteries transmitted from each heartbeat and felt over superficial vessels. 脉搏 分诊台
脉率 pulse rate 每分钟触及的脉搏搏动次数，是基本生命体征记录项目之一 The number of palpable arterial pulsations per minute, one of the recorded vital signs. 脉搏 护士站
脉律 pulse rhythm 脉搏搏动间隔的规律性，可反映心脏节律是否规整 The regularity of the intervals between pulse beats, reflecting whether cardiac rhythm is regular. 脉搏 抢救室
脉搏短绌 pulse deficit 心率快于脉率的现象，因部分心搏射血量少未能形成可触及脉搏 A condition in which the heart rate exceeds the pulse rate because some beats produce no palpable pulse. 脉搏 抢救室
洪脉 bounding pulse 脉搏搏动强而有力、容易触及的状态，常见于高热与高排血量循环 A strong, easily felt pulse, often seen in fever and high-output circulatory states. 脉搏 抢救室
细脉 thready pulse 脉搏弱而细、难以触及的状态，提示每搏输出量下降与末梢灌注不足 A weak, thin pulse that is hard to feel, indicating reduced stroke volume and poor peripheral perfusion. 脉搏 抢救室
交替脉 pulsus alternans 脉搏强弱交替出现的体征，提示左心收缩功能严重减退 A pulse in which strong and weak beats alternate, indicating severely reduced left ventricular function. 脉搏 监护室
奇脉 pulsus paradoxus 吸气时收缩压明显下降、脉搏减弱的现象，见于心包填塞与重症哮喘 An exaggerated fall in systolic pressure and pulse amplitude during inspiration, seen in tamponade and severe asthma. 脉搏 抢救室
水冲脉 water-hammer pulse 脉搏骤起骤落、冲击感强的体征，常见于脉压显著增宽的情况 A pulse with a rapid rise and sudden collapse, typical of a markedly widened pulse pressure. 脉搏 抢救室
无脉 pulselessness 在主要动脉处触不到搏动的状态，是循环停止的直接征象 The absence of palpable pulsation over major arteries, a direct sign of circulatory arrest. 脉搏 抢救室
桡动脉搏动 radial pulse 在腕部桡侧触及的动脉搏动，是最常用的脉搏检查部位 The arterial pulsation felt on the radial side of the wrist, the most common site for pulse checks. 脉搏 抢救室
颈动脉搏动 carotid pulse 在颈部甲状软骨旁触及的动脉搏动，用于判断循环是否停止 The arterial pulsation felt beside the thyroid cartilage, used to judge whether circulation has stopped. 脉搏 抢救室
股动脉搏动 femoral pulse 在腹股沟韧带下方触及的动脉搏动，用于中心循环评估与动脉穿刺定位 The arterial pulsation felt below the inguinal ligament, used to assess central circulation and guide arterial puncture. 脉搏 抢救室
足背动脉搏动 dorsalis pedis pulse 在足背第一二跖骨间触及的动脉搏动，用于评估下肢末梢灌注 The arterial pulsation felt between the first and second metatarsals, used to assess distal leg perfusion. 脉搏 监护室
脉搏触诊 pulse palpation 用手指按压浅表动脉感知搏动次数、节律与强弱的检查方法 The technique of pressing a superficial artery to assess the rate, rhythm and strength of the pulse. 脉搏 分诊台
摸脉 feel for a pulse 用手触摸动脉以判断有无心跳和循环的快速动作 The quick act of touching an artery to check whether a heartbeat and circulation are present. 脉搏 抢救室
脉搏强度 pulse strength 脉搏搏动幅度的大小，与每搏输出量和外周血管阻力有关 The amplitude of the pulse beat, related to stroke volume and peripheral vascular resistance. 脉搏 监护室
周围脉搏 peripheral pulse 四肢浅表动脉的搏动，其减弱提示末梢循环灌注下降 Pulsation of superficial limb arteries, whose reduction suggests falling peripheral perfusion. 脉搏 监护室
中心脉搏 central pulse 颈动脉或股动脉等近心大血管的搏动，用于判断有效循环是否存在 Pulsation of a large vessel close to the heart, such as the carotid or femoral artery, used to confirm effective circulation. 脉搏 抢救室
脉搏监测 pulse monitoring 定时或连续观察脉搏的频率、节律与强弱并记录的过程 Repeated or continuous observation and recording of pulse rate, rhythm and strength. 脉搏 护士站
静息脉率 resting pulse rate 安静休息状态下测得的每分钟脉搏次数，用于判断基础心率水平 The pulse rate per minute measured at rest, used to judge the baseline heart rate. 脉搏 分诊台
脉搏加快 rapid pulse 脉率高于同龄正常范围的状态，常见于发热、失血与疼痛应激 A pulse rate above the normal range for age, common in fever, blood loss and painful stress. 脉搏 抢救室
脉搏减慢 slow pulse 脉率低于同龄正常范围的状态，可见于颅内压增高与传导阻滞 A pulse rate below the normal range for age, seen in raised intracranial pressure and conduction block. 脉搏 留观区
脉搏细速 rapid thready pulse 脉搏又快又弱的体征，是低血容量性休克的典型表现之一 A pulse that is both fast and weak, a classic finding in hypovolemic shock. 脉搏 抢救室
脉搏测量 pulse measurement 通过触诊或监护设备获取脉率与节律数值的操作 The procedure of obtaining pulse rate and rhythm by palpation or a monitoring device. 脉搏 护士站
呼吸 respiration 机体与外界进行气体交换的过程，频率与深度是基本生命体征 The exchange of gases between the body and the environment, whose rate and depth are basic vital signs. 呼吸 分诊台
呼吸频率 respiratory rate 每分钟呼吸的次数，是识别危重患者最敏感的指标之一 The number of breaths per minute, one of the most sensitive indicators of critical illness. 呼吸 分诊台
呼吸节律 respiratory rhythm 呼吸周期在时间上的规律性，异常提示中枢或代谢紊乱 The regularity of breathing cycles over time, whose abnormality suggests central or metabolic disturbance. 呼吸 监护室
呼吸深度 depth of breathing 每次呼吸时胸廓扩张与气体进出的幅度，反映通气量大小 The extent of chest expansion and gas movement with each breath, reflecting tidal volume. 呼吸 监护室
呼吸急促 tachypnea 成人呼吸频率超过 24 次每分的状态，常见于缺氧与代谢性酸中毒 A respiratory rate above 24 per minute in adults, common in hypoxia and metabolic acidosis. 呼吸 分诊台
呼吸缓慢 bradypnea 成人呼吸频率低于 10 次每分的状态，常提示中枢抑制或药物过量 A respiratory rate below 10 per minute in adults, often indicating central depression or drug overdose. 呼吸 留观区
呼吸暂停 apnea 呼吸动作暂时停止的现象，超过二十秒或伴心率下降即有临床意义 A temporary cessation of breathing, clinically significant when longer than twenty seconds or with bradycardia. 呼吸 抢救室
潮式呼吸 Cheyne-Stokes respiration 呼吸由浅慢逐渐加深加快再转为浅慢并出现暂停的周期性呼吸形态 A cyclic breathing pattern of gradually deepening then shallowing breaths followed by apnea. 呼吸 监护室
深大呼吸 Kussmaul breathing 深而规则且频率增快的呼吸，是代谢性酸中毒的代偿表现 Deep, regular and often rapid breathing that compensates for metabolic acidosis. 呼吸 抢救室
叹息样呼吸 sighing respiration 呼吸中夹有深大叹气样动作的形态，常见于濒死或严重脑损伤患者 A breathing pattern interrupted by deep sighing breaths, seen in dying patients and severe brain injury. 呼吸 抢救室
呼吸做功 work of breathing 呼吸肌为完成通气所消耗的能量，增加时提示呼吸负荷过重 The energy spent by respiratory muscles to achieve ventilation, increased when the load is excessive. 呼吸 监护室
自主呼吸 spontaneous breathing 患者依靠自身呼吸肌完成的呼吸，不含呼吸机送气 Breathing produced by the patient's own respiratory muscles without ventilator-delivered breaths. 呼吸 监护室
呼吸监护 respiratory monitoring 对呼吸频率、节律、深度与血氧进行连续观察并记录的过程 Continuous observation and recording of respiratory rate, rhythm, depth and oxygen saturation. 呼吸 护士站
呼吸形态 respiratory pattern 呼吸在频率、深度与节律上整体呈现的样子，用于快速判断病因 The overall appearance of breathing in rate, depth and rhythm, used to judge the cause quickly. 呼吸 抢救室
呼吸费力 labored breathing 呼吸时需额外动用辅助肌、显得吃力的状态，常伴三凹征 Breathing that visibly requires extra effort and accessory muscles, often with retractions. 呼吸 抢救室
呼吸节律不齐 irregular respiratory rhythm 呼吸周期长短不一、缺乏规律的状态，需警惕中枢病变 Breathing cycles of varying length without regular pattern, requiring vigilance for central lesions. 呼吸 监护室
呼吸过深 hyperpnea 单次呼吸幅度明显超过正常的状态，可因缺氧或代谢性酸中毒引起 Breathing with a depth clearly greater than normal, caused by hypoxia or metabolic acidosis. 呼吸 抢救室
张口呼吸 mouth breathing 以口代替鼻腔进行呼吸的状态，常见于鼻道阻塞或意识障碍 Breathing through the mouth instead of the nose, common with nasal obstruction or impaired consciousness. 呼吸 分诊台
呼吸抑制 respiratory depression 呼吸中枢兴奋性下降导致通气不足的状态，常见于镇静药过量 Reduced ventilatory drive from depressed respiratory centres, common with sedative overdose. 呼吸 抢救室
肺泡通气 alveolar ventilation 单位时间内到达肺泡参与气体交换的通气量，受潮气量与无效腔大小影响 The volume of fresh gas reaching the alveoli per unit time, set by tidal volume and dead space. 呼吸 抢救室
呼吸监测仪 respiratory monitor 连续显示呼吸频率与呼吸波形的床旁设备，可设置报警限 A bedside device that continuously displays respiratory rate and waveform with adjustable alarms. 呼吸 监护室
呼吸努力 respiratory effort 患者为完成吸气所付出的肌肉用力程度，用于判断呼吸肌储备 The muscular effort a patient makes to achieve inspiration, used to judge respiratory muscle reserve. 呼吸 监护室
呼吸浅快 shallow rapid breathing 呼吸幅度小且频率快的形态，常见于胸痛、肺顺应性下降与休克 A pattern of small-volume, rapid breaths, common in chest pain, reduced compliance and shock. 呼吸 监护室
呼吸波形 respiratory waveform 监护仪上显示的呼吸周期曲线，用于观察呼吸暂停与节律变化 The respiratory cycle curve displayed on a monitor, used to detect apnea and rhythm changes. 呼吸 监护室
呼吸频率监测 respiratory rate monitoring 对单位时间内呼吸次数进行定时或连续测定的过程 The timed or continuous measurement of the number of breaths per unit time. 呼吸 护士站
血压 blood pressure 血液对血管壁的侧压力，由心输出量与外周阻力共同决定 The lateral pressure exerted by blood on vessel walls, determined by cardiac output and peripheral resistance. 血压 分诊台
收缩压 systolic blood pressure 心脏收缩射血时动脉压达到的最高值，是循环评估的核心指标 The peak arterial pressure during ventricular contraction, a core index of circulatory assessment. 血压 监护室
舒张压 diastolic blood pressure 心脏舒张末期动脉压的最低值，主要反映外周血管阻力 The lowest arterial pressure at the end of diastole, reflecting mainly peripheral vascular resistance. 血压 监护室
平均动脉压 mean arterial pressure 一个心动周期内动脉压的平均值，反映器官灌注的驱动压力 The average arterial pressure across the cardiac cycle, the driving pressure for organ perfusion. 血压 监护室
脉压 pulse pressure 收缩压与舒张压之差，反映每搏输出量与动脉弹性 The difference between systolic and diastolic pressure, reflecting stroke volume and arterial stiffness. 血压 分诊台
血压升高 elevated blood pressure 测得的血压高于正常参考范围的状态，需复测并评估靶器官 A measured blood pressure above the normal reference range, requiring recheck and organ assessment. 血压 分诊台
低血压 hypotension 血压低于维持器官灌注所需的水平，成人常以收缩压 90 为界 Blood pressure below the level needed for organ perfusion, often defined as systolic under 90 in adults. 血压 抢救室
有创血压 invasive blood pressure 经动脉置管直接测得的血压，数值连续且准确，便于反复采血 Blood pressure measured directly through an arterial catheter, continuous and accurate. 血压 抢救室
无创血压 non-invasive blood pressure 用袖带充气间接测得的血压，操作简便但受心律与袖带影响 Blood pressure measured indirectly with an inflating cuff, convenient but affected by rhythm and cuff fit. 血压 监护室
动脉血压 arterial blood pressure 动脉内的实际压力，由收缩压、舒张压与平均压共同描述 The actual pressure within arteries, described by systolic, diastolic and mean values. 血压 监护室
血压测量 blood pressure measurement 用血压计或监护设备获取血压数值的操作，需注意体位与袖带规格 The procedure of obtaining blood pressure values with a cuff or monitor, with attention to posture and cuff size. 血压 护士站
血压监测 blood pressure monitoring 对血压进行定时或连续测定并记录，用于发现循环波动 Timed or continuous measurement and recording of blood pressure to detect circulatory changes. 血压 监护室
动态血压 ambulatory blood pressure 在日常生活状态下多次或连续记录的血压，用于排除白大衣效应 Blood pressure recorded repeatedly during daily activity, used to exclude white-coat effects. 血压 分诊台
血压计 sphygmomanometer 测量血压的器具，有水银式、气压表式与电子式三类 An instrument for measuring blood pressure, available in mercury, aneroid and electronic types. 血压 分诊台
血压袖带 blood pressure cuff 缠绕上臂充气以阻断血流、间接测压的带状装置 An inflatable band wrapped round the upper arm to occlude flow for indirect pressure measurement. 血压 护士站
袖带尺寸 cuff size 血压袖带的宽度与长度规格，需与患者上臂周径相匹配 The width and length specification of a blood pressure cuff, which must match upper-arm circumference. 血压 护士站
测血压 take a blood pressure 给患者测量血压的日常说法，含摆位、绑袖带与读数 The everyday expression for measuring a patient's blood pressure, including positioning and reading. 血压 护士站
血压下降 blood pressure drop 血压较基础值明显降低的状态，需立即寻找失血、感染或心源因素 A marked fall in blood pressure from baseline, requiring urgent search for bleeding, infection or cardiac causes. 血压 抢救室
血压波动 blood pressure variability 血压在短时间内反复升降的幅度，波动过大提示循环不稳定 The extent to which blood pressure swings up and down over a short period. 血压 监护室
体位性低血压 orthostatic hypotension 由卧位或坐位站起时血压明显下降并伴头晕的现象，常见于容量不足与老年患者 A fall in blood pressure on standing from lying or sitting, with dizziness, common with volume depletion. 血压 分诊台 起身过快易跌倒，测站立位血压要有人扶
双侧血压 blood pressure in both arms 同时测量左右上臂血压并比较差值，差值过大提示主动脉或锁骨下动脉病变 Blood pressure measured in both upper arms for comparison, a large difference suggesting aortic or subclavian disease. 血压 抢救室
目标血压 target blood pressure 根据病情为患者设定的血压控制范围，用于指导补液与用药 The blood pressure range set for a patient according to the condition, guiding fluids and drugs. 血压 监护室
血压读数 blood pressure reading 血压计或监护仪显示的具体数值，记录时需注明测量方式与部位 The specific value shown by a cuff or monitor, recorded together with the method and site. 血压 护士站
血压波形 blood pressure waveform 有创监测时动脉压力随时间变化的曲线，可判断容量状态与管路问题 The arterial pressure curve over time during invasive monitoring, used to judge volume status and line problems. 血压 抢救室
血压不稳 labile blood pressure 血压在短时间内大幅升降且难以维持在目标范围的状态 Blood pressure that swings widely in a short time and is hard to keep within target. 血压 监护室
血氧饱和度 oxygen saturation 血液中氧合血红蛋白占总血红蛋白的比例，反映机体氧合状态 The proportion of haemoglobin that is bound to oxygen, reflecting the adequacy of oxygenation. 血氧饱和度 分诊台 缩写 SpO2 与 SaO2 不同，前者为脉搏血氧测得，后者来自血气
动脉血氧饱和度 arterial oxygen saturation 动脉血中氧合血红蛋白所占比例，由血气分析直接测得 The percentage of arterial haemoglobin bound to oxygen, measured directly by blood gas analysis. 血氧饱和度 监护室
脉搏血氧饱和度 pulse oxygen saturation 脉搏血氧仪经皮肤测得的功能性血氧饱和度，可连续无创监测 The functional oxygen saturation measured non-invasively and continuously by pulse oximetry. 血氧饱和度 监护室
血氧监测 oxygen saturation monitoring 对血氧饱和度进行连续或定时测定并记录，用于发现低氧 Continuous or timed measurement and recording of oxygen saturation to detect hypoxaemia. 血氧饱和度 护士站
指脉氧 finger pulse oximetry 把血氧探头夹在指端测得血氧饱和度的快速检查方法 A rapid check of oxygen saturation using a probe clipped to the fingertip. 血氧饱和度 分诊台 指甲油、末梢冷或低灌注时指脉氧会偏低
血氧探头 pulse oximeter probe 夹在指端或耳垂、发射与接收红光以计算血氧饱和度的部件 The clip placed on a finger or earlobe that emits and detects light to calculate oxygen saturation. 血氧饱和度 监护室
氧饱和度下降 oxygen desaturation 血氧饱和度较基线明显降低的状态，需立即查找气道与肺部原因 A marked fall in oxygen saturation from baseline, requiring prompt assessment of airway and lungs. 血氧饱和度 抢救室
血氧仪 pulse oximeter 通过光电容积描记原理无创测定血氧饱和度的小型设备 A small device that measures oxygen saturation non-invasively by photoplethysmography. 血氧饱和度 护士站
血氧波形 plethysmographic waveform 监护仪上由血氧探头生成的光电容积脉搏波，可反映末梢灌注 The photoplethysmographic pulse wave generated by the oximeter probe, reflecting peripheral perfusion. 血氧饱和度 监护室
目标血氧饱和度 target oxygen saturation 为患者设定的血氧饱和度范围，用于调节氧疗强度并避免过度给氧 The oxygen saturation range set for a patient, used to titrate oxygen and avoid over-oxygenation. 血氧饱和度 监护室 慢阻肺患者过高给氧可加重二氧化碳潴留
氧合 oxygenation 氧由肺泡进入血液并与血红蛋白结合的过程，反映肺换气功能 The process by which oxygen enters the blood and binds haemoglobin, reflecting pulmonary gas exchange. 血氧饱和度 监护室
氧合指数 oxygenation index 动脉氧分压与吸氧浓度的比值，用于评估低氧血症严重程度 The ratio of arterial oxygen partial pressure to inspired oxygen fraction, grading hypoxaemia severity. 血氧饱和度 监护室 计算时吸氧浓度以小数表示，如 0.6
组织氧合 tissue oxygenation 氧输送到外周组织并被细胞利用的状态，受循环与血红蛋白影响 The delivery and cellular use of oxygen in peripheral tissues, affected by circulation and haemoglobin. 血氧饱和度 监护室
中心静脉血氧饱和度 central venous oxygen saturation 上腔静脉或右心房血样的氧饱和度，反映全身氧供需平衡 The oxygen saturation of blood from the superior vena cava or right atrium, reflecting global oxygen balance. 血氧饱和度 监护室
混合静脉血氧饱和度 mixed venous oxygen saturation 肺动脉血样的氧饱和度，是全身氧供需平衡的可靠指标 The oxygen saturation of pulmonary artery blood, a reliable index of global oxygen supply and demand. 血氧饱和度 监护室
缺氧 hypoxia 组织氧供应不足或利用障碍导致细胞代谢异常的状态 A state in which tissue oxygen supply or use is inadequate, impairing cellular metabolism. 血氧饱和度 抢救室
血氧波动 oxygen saturation fluctuation 血氧饱和度在短时间内反复升降的现象，常见于活动、吸痰与体位改变 Repeated rises and falls in oxygen saturation over a short period, common with activity and suctioning. 血氧饱和度 监护室
血氧读数 oxygen saturation reading 血氧仪或监护仪显示的血氧饱和度具体数值，需结合波形判断可靠性 The specific saturation value displayed by an oximeter or monitor, interpreted together with the waveform. 血氧饱和度 护士站
血氧报警 oxygen saturation alarm 血氧低于设定下限时监护设备发出的声光提示，需立即查看患者 An audible and visual alert from the monitor when saturation falls below the set limit. 血氧饱和度 监护室
血氧趋势 oxygen saturation trend 一段时间内血氧饱和度变化的走势，用于判断病情是否改善 The direction of oxygen saturation over time, used to judge whether the condition is improving. 血氧饱和度 监护室

血氧正常范围 normal oxygen saturation range 健康成人在海平面呼吸空气时的血氧饱和度参考区间，一般为 95 至 98 百分比 The reference range of oxygen saturation in healthy adults breathing air at sea level, usually 95 to 98 percent. 血氧饱和度 分诊台
低氧饱和度 low oxygen saturation 血氧饱和度低于正常下限的状态，提示肺换气或氧输送障碍 A saturation below the normal lower limit, indicating impaired gas exchange or oxygen delivery. 血氧饱和度 抢救室
氧解离曲线 oxygen dissociation curve 描述氧分压与血红蛋白氧饱和度关系的曲线，可因温度与酸碱而偏移 The curve relating oxygen partial pressure to haemoglobin saturation, shifted by temperature and acid-base status. 血氧饱和度 监护室
脉搏血氧监测 pulse oximetry monitoring 用脉搏血氧仪对血氧饱和度与脉率进行连续监测的方法 Continuous monitoring of oxygen saturation and pulse rate with a pulse oximeter. 血氧饱和度 监护室
吸空气血氧 oxygen saturation on room air 患者在未吸氧状态下测得的血氧饱和度，用于判断真实氧合水平 The oxygen saturation measured without supplemental oxygen, used to judge true oxygenation. 血氧饱和度 分诊台
意识 consciousness 个体对自身与周围环境的感知与反应能力，是神经功能评估的核心 The capacity to perceive oneself and the surroundings and to respond, central to neurological assessment. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 分诊台
意识水平 level of consciousness 意识清晰程度的等级描述，从清醒到昏迷连续变化 The degree of wakefulness and awareness, ranging from alert to comatose. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
意识障碍 disorder of consciousness 意识清晰度或意识内容受损的一类状态，含嗜睡、昏睡与昏迷 Impaired clarity or content of consciousness, including somnolence, stupor and coma. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
意识模糊 confusion 注意力与思维清晰度下降、对答不切题的状态，常伴定向力障碍 Reduced attention and clarity of thinking with inappropriate answers, often with disorientation. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 分诊台
嗜睡 somnolence 睡眠倾向明显增强、可被唤醒但很快又入睡的意识状态 A state of increased sleepiness in which the patient can be aroused but soon drifts off again. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
昏睡 stupor 需强烈刺激才能唤醒、醒后反应迟钝且很快再入睡的意识状态 A state in which only strong stimulation arouses the patient, with slow responses before sleep returns. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
昏迷 coma 不能被唤醒、无有意识反应的最严重意识障碍状态 The most severe disorder of consciousness, in which the patient cannot be aroused or respond purposefully. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
浅昏迷 light coma 对疼痛有躲避反应、部分反射存在的昏迷状态 A coma in which painful stimuli still produce withdrawal and some reflexes remain. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 监护室
深昏迷 deep coma 对任何刺激均无反应、生理反射消失的昏迷状态 A coma with no response to any stimulus and absent physiological reflexes. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 监护室
格拉斯哥昏迷评分 Glasgow Coma Scale 由睁眼、语言与运动三项反应计分的昏迷程度评估工具，总分 3 至 15 分 A coma scale scoring eye opening, verbal and motor responses, with totals from 3 to 15. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室 记录需分项写 E、V、M 分值，不能只写总分
睁眼反应 eye opening 格拉斯哥评分中按自发、呼唤、疼痛与无反应计 4 至 1 分的项目 The Glasgow item scoring eye opening from spontaneous to none, worth four to one points. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
语言反应 verbal response 格拉斯哥评分中按对答切题到无反应计 5 至 1 分的项目 The Glasgow item scoring verbal response from orientated to none, worth five to one points. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室 气管插管患者语言反应记为 T，不按 1 分计算
运动反应 motor response 格拉斯哥评分中按遵嘱动作到无反应计 6 至 1 分的项目 The Glasgow item scoring motor response from obeying commands to none, worth six to one points. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
格拉斯哥评分分数 Glasgow Coma Scale score 睁眼、语言与运动三项分值相加所得的总分，用于动态比较病情 The total of the eye, verbal and motor scores, used to track the condition over time. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 护士站
意识评估 consciousness assessment 通过呼唤、疼痛刺激与反射检查判断意识水平的过程，需定时重复 The process of judging consciousness by voice, pain and reflex testing, repeated at intervals. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 护士站
定向力 orientation 对时间、地点与人物的正确辨识能力，是意识内容完整的表现 The ability to identify time, place and person correctly, indicating intact awareness. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
定向力障碍 disorientation 对时间、地点或人物辨识错误的状态，常见于谵妄与中毒 Incorrect identification of time, place or person, common in delirium and poisoning. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
意识内容 content of consciousness 意识清晰状态下思维、记忆与情感等心理活动的总体，受损时出现谵妄 The overall mental activity of thought, memory and affect in a wakeful state, impaired in delirium. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 监护室
唤醒 arousal 通过声音或疼痛刺激使患者从睡眠或昏迷中产生反应的动作 The act of producing a response from sleep or coma by voice or painful stimulation. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
疼痛刺激 painful stimulus 评估意识与反应时施加的标准有害刺激，如压眶上神经或捏斜方肌 A standard noxious stimulus applied when assessing consciousness, such as supraorbital pressure. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
最佳运动反应 best motor response 格拉斯哥评分中取四肢中最强的一项运动反应计分 The strongest motor response among the limbs, used for the Glasgow motor score. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
意识恢复 recovery of consciousness 昏迷或意识障碍患者重新出现觉醒与有目的反应的过程 The return of wakefulness and purposeful response in a patient who was comatose or obtunded. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 监护室
意识丧失 loss of consciousness 对外界刺激完全无反应、不能唤醒的状态，需立即评估气道与循环 A state of complete unresponsiveness that cannot be aroused, requiring immediate airway and circulation checks. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
意识水平下降 decreased level of consciousness 意识清晰程度较前降低的状态，是病情恶化的早期信号 A reduction in the degree of wakefulness compared with before, an early sign of deterioration. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 监护室
昏迷程度 depth of coma 昏迷由浅到深的轻重分级，常以格拉斯哥评分与脑干反射判断 The severity grading of coma from light to deep, judged by the Glasgow score and brainstem reflexes. 意识与格拉斯哥评分 抢救室
休克 shock 有效循环血量不足导致组织灌注与氧供严重下降的临床综合征 A clinical syndrome in which inadequate effective circulating volume causes critical falls in tissue perfusion. 休克识别 抢救室 不写感染性休克、心源性休克等具体类型，那些按病因归入相应领域
休克指数 shock index 心率除以收缩压所得的比值，超过 0.9 提示存在隐性休克风险 Heart rate divided by systolic pressure, a ratio above 0.9 suggesting occult shock. 休克识别 抢救室
休克代偿期 compensated shock 血压尚能维持而组织灌注已不足的休克早期阶段，易被漏诊 The early stage of shock in which blood pressure is maintained despite inadequate tissue perfusion. 休克识别 抢救室
休克失代偿期 decompensated shock 代偿机制耗竭、血压开始明显下降的休克阶段，器官损伤迅速进展 The stage of shock in which compensatory mechanisms fail and blood pressure falls overtly. 休克识别 抢救室
冷休克 cold shock 心输出量低、外周阻力高、皮肤湿冷的休克类型，常见于失血与心源因素 A shock pattern with low output, high resistance and cold clammy skin, typical of blood loss. 休克识别 抢救室
暖休克 warm shock 外周阻力降低、皮肤温暖干燥而血压低的休克类型，常见于分布性休克早期 A shock pattern with low resistance and warm dry skin despite hypotension, typical of early distributive shock. 休克识别 抢救室
隐匿性休克 occult shock 血压与心率尚在正常范围而组织灌注已异常的状态，需靠乳酸等指标识别 A state with normal-looking blood pressure and heart rate but abnormal tissue perfusion, detected by lactate. 休克识别 监护室
难治性休克 refractory shock 充分补液并应用大剂量血管活性药后血压仍不能维持的休克状态 Shock in which blood pressure cannot be maintained despite adequate fluids and high-dose vasopressors. 休克识别 监护室
休克体位 shock position 抬高下肢约三十度以增加回心血流量的体位摆放方法 A posture with the legs raised about thirty degrees to increase venous return. 休克识别 抢救室 不再常规采用头低足高位，以免影响通气
休克早期 early shock 组织灌注刚开始不足、代偿机制活跃的休克阶段，及时干预可逆转 The stage of shock when hypoperfusion has just begun and compensation is active, reversible with prompt care. 休克识别 抢救室
休克晚期 late shock 微循环严重障碍、多器官功能开始衰竭的休克阶段，病死率高 The stage of shock with severe microcirculatory failure and incipient multi-organ dysfunction. 休克识别 监护室
组织灌注不足 inadequate tissue perfusion 组织血流不能满足代谢需要的状态，表现为乳酸升高、尿少与末梢湿冷 A state in which tissue blood flow fails to meet metabolic demand, shown by rising lactate and oliguria. 休克识别 抢救室
微循环障碍 microcirculatory disturbance 微动脉与毛细血管血流异常导致细胞缺氧的状态，是休克的核心环节 Abnormal flow in arterioles and capillaries causing cellular hypoxia, central to shock. 休克识别 监护室
末梢湿冷 cold clammy extremities 四肢皮肤温度低且出汗发湿的体征，提示外周血管收缩与灌注下降 Cool, sweaty skin on the limbs, indicating peripheral vasoconstriction and reduced perfusion. 休克识别 抢救室
花斑样皮肤 mottled skin 皮肤出现紫红色网纹状斑驳的体征，提示皮肤微循环灌注严重不足 Skin showing a purple-red net-like mottling, indicating severely reduced cutaneous perfusion. 休克识别 抢救室

毛细血管再充盈时间 capillary refill time 按压指端后颜色恢复所需的时间，超过三秒提示末梢灌注不良 The time taken for colour to return after pressing the fingertip, over three seconds indicating poor perfusion. 休克识别 抢救室 检查时需保持环境温暖，避免低温干扰结果
脉压变窄 narrowed pulse pressure 收缩压与舒张压差值减小的现象，是每搏输出量下降的早期信号 A reduced difference between systolic and diastolic pressure, an early sign of falling stroke volume. 休克识别 抢救室
休克识别 shock recognition 通过生命体征、灌注体征与乳酸等早期发现休克的过程，强调不等血压下降 The process of detecting shock early through vital signs, perfusion signs and lactate, without waiting for hypotension. 休克识别 抢救室
休克评估 shock assessment 对休克患者的类型、程度与复苏反应进行的系统判断 The systematic judgement of shock type, severity and response to resuscitation. 休克识别 监护室
休克复苏 shock resuscitation 针对休克采取的补液、血管活性药与病因处理等综合救治措施 The combined measures for shock, including fluids, vasoactive drugs and treatment of the cause. 休克识别 抢救室
血流动力学不稳定 hemodynamic instability 血压、心率与灌注指标剧烈波动、难以维持的状态，需持续监护 A state of marked fluctuation in blood pressure, heart rate and perfusion that is hard to stabilise. 休克识别 监护室
血流动力学监测 hemodynamic monitoring 对血压、心输出量与容量状态等循环指标的连续测定，指导复苏 Continuous measurement of circulatory indices such as pressure, output and volume to guide resuscitation. 休克识别 监护室
循环衰竭 circulatory failure 心脏泵血或血管张力严重障碍导致器官灌注不能维持的状态 A state in which cardiac pumping or vascular tone fails so severely that organ perfusion cannot be maintained. 休克识别 监护室
周围循环灌注 peripheral perfusion 血液流向四肢与皮肤等外周组织的状况，可通过温度与毛细血管再充盈判断 Blood flow to the limbs and skin, judged by temperature and capillary refill. 休克识别 抢救室
低血容量性休克 hypovolemic shock 大量失血或失液使有效循环血量骤减所致的休克类型 Shock caused by a rapid loss of blood or fluid that sharply reduces effective circulating volume. 休克识别 抢救室
液体复苏 fluid resuscitation 通过静脉输注液体恢复有效循环血量与组织灌注的治疗措施 Treatment by intravenous fluid administration to restore effective circulating volume and perfusion. 液体复苏 抢救室
静脉液体 intravenous fluids 经静脉通路输入的液体，包括晶体液、胶体液与含药液体 Fluids given through an intravenous line, including crystalloids, colloids and drug-containing solutions. 液体复苏 输液室
晶体液 crystalloid 含小分子电解质、可自由通过毛细血管壁的静脉液体，如生理盐水 An intravenous solution of small electrolytes that crosses capillary walls freely, such as saline. 液体复苏 抢救室
胶体液 colloid 含大分子物质、在血管内停留较久的静脉液体，如白蛋白溶液 An intravenous solution containing large molecules that stay in the vessels longer, such as albumin. 液体复苏 抢救室
等渗晶体液 isotonic crystalloid 渗透压与血浆相近的晶体液，是休克液体复苏的首选 A crystalloid with osmolality close to plasma, the first choice for fluid resuscitation in shock. 液体复苏 抢救室
平衡盐溶液 balanced salt solution 电解质成分接近血浆的晶体液，大量输注时酸碱干扰较小 A crystalloid whose electrolyte composition resembles plasma, causing less acid-base disturbance in large volumes. 液体复苏 抢救室
生理盐水 normal saline 含 0.9 百分比氯化钠的等渗溶液，是最常用的晶体液 A 0.9 percent sodium chloride solution, the most commonly used crystalloid. 液体复苏 抢救室 大量输注生理盐水可引起高氯性代谢性酸中毒
乳酸林格液 lactated Ringer's solution 含钠钾钙与乳酸根的等渗晶体液，常用于创伤与烧伤补液 An isotonic crystalloid containing sodium, potassium, calcium and lactate, used in trauma and burns. 液体复苏 抢救室 乳酸林格液含钙，不能与同一通路输注血液
液体负荷试验 fluid challenge 短时间内输入定量液体并观察血压与灌注反应，以判断是否需要继续补液 Rapid administration of a set volume of fluid with observation of pressure and perfusion to decide further fluids. 液体复苏 抢救室
液体反应性 fluid responsiveness 给予液体后每搏输出量或心输出量明显增加的特性，提示还需补液 The property by which stroke volume or cardiac output rises appreciably after fluids, indicating further volume is needed. 液体复苏 监护室
被动抬腿试验 passive leg raise 将患者双下肢被动抬高以暂时增加回心血量，用于判断液体反应性 Passive lifting of both legs to transiently increase venous return, used to test fluid responsiveness. 液体复苏 监护室 操作时需同步监测每搏量，抬腿前后测量
补液量 fluid volume 在一定时间内输入患者体内的液体总量，需根据体重与反应调整 The total volume of fluid given over a period, adjusted for body weight and response. 液体复苏 抢救室
补液速度 infusion rate 单位时间内输入液体的量，复苏时常需快速滴注后再调整 The volume of fluid infused per unit time, often fast during resuscitation and then adjusted. 液体复苏 护士站
快速补液 rapid fluid bolus 在数分钟内快速输入数百毫升液体的方式，用于紧急纠正循环血量不足 Rapid administration of several hundred millilitres of fluid within minutes to correct volume deficit urgently. 液体复苏 抢救室 心功能不全者需小量分次，避免诱发肺水肿
限制性补液 restrictive fluid strategy 有意控制补液总量、避免液体过多的复苏策略，常用于急性肺损伤与心功能不全 A resuscitation strategy that deliberately limits total fluid volume to avoid overload. 液体复苏 抢救室
开放性补液 liberal fluid strategy 早期给予较大剂量液体的复苏策略，适用于低血容量与烧伤早期 A resuscitation strategy giving larger fluid volumes early, used in hypovolaemia and early burns. 液体复苏 抢救室
复苏目标 resuscitation target 复苏时需要达到的血压、心率、尿量与乳酸等指标要求 The blood pressure, heart rate, urine output and lactate goals to be reached during resuscitation. 液体复苏 抢救室
复苏终点 endpoint of resuscitation 判断复苏可以停止或减弱的综合指标，如乳酸清除与中心静脉血氧饱和度 The combined indices indicating that resuscitation can be reduced or stopped, such as lactate clearance. 液体复苏 监护室
液体平衡 fluid balance 一定时间内输入量与排出量的差值，用于评估容量状态与复苏效果 The difference between intake and output over a period, used to assess volume status and response. 液体复苏 护士站
扩容 volume expansion 通过输注液体增加血管内容量的处理，是休克复苏的核心手段 Increasing intravascular volume by infusing fluid, a central measure in shock resuscitation. 液体复苏 抢救室 扩容前应评估容量反应性，避免盲目大量输注

动脉血气分析 arterial blood gas analysis 经动脉采血测定氧分压、二氧化碳分压与酸碱度的床旁检查，用于判断氧合与通气 A bedside arterial blood test measuring oxygen and carbon dioxide pressures with acid-base status, used to assess oxygenation and ventilation. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 抢救室
氧疗指征 indication for oxygen therapy 根据血氧、症状与基础病情决定是否给予氧疗的临床依据，常以血氧饱和度 94 为界 The clinical grounds for starting oxygen, based on saturation, symptoms and the underlying condition. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 抢救室

十二导联心电图 twelve-lead ECG 在标准电极位置记录十二个导联心电变化的检查，用于判断心律与心肌缺血 A recording of twelve ECG leads from standard electrode positions, used to assess rhythm and myocardial ischaemia. 心电监护 抢救室 不可只用心电监护代替，缺血判断须看十二导联
加温输液 warmed intravenous fluid 将输入液体加温至接近体温的措施，用于大量补液与低体温患者 Heating intravenous fluid close to body temperature, used in massive transfusion and hypothermia. 液体复苏 抢救室
目标导向液体治疗 goal-directed fluid therapy 依据每搏量、脉压变异等动态指标指导补液的策略，避免盲目扩容 A strategy guiding fluid therapy by dynamic indices such as stroke volume and pulse pressure variation. 液体复苏 监护室
心电监护 electrocardiographic monitoring 通过体表电极连续记录心脏电活动并显示波形的监护方法 Continuous recording and display of cardiac electrical activity through surface electrodes. 心电监护 监护室
心电监护仪 cardiac monitor 显示心电波形、心率与报警信息的床旁设备，常兼有血压与血氧模块 A bedside device displaying ECG waveform, heart rate and alarms, often with pressure and oximetry modules. 心电监护 监护室
心电波形 ECG waveform 监护仪上呈现的心电活动曲线，可判断心律与缺血改变 The curve of cardiac electrical activity shown on the monitor, used to judge rhythm and ischaemia. 心电监护 监护室
监护导联 monitoring lead 固定在胸壁特定位置用于持续观察心律的电极连接方式 An electrode configuration fixed at a set chest position for continuous rhythm observation. 心电监护 监护室
三导联监护 three-lead monitoring 使用三个电极连续观察心电的监护方式，操作简便但导联有限 Monitoring of the heart rhythm with three electrodes, simple but limited in leads. 心电监护 监护室
心率 heart rate 每分钟心搏的次数，由心电监护或脉搏测得，是核心生命体征 The number of heartbeats per minute, from the monitor or pulse, a core vital sign. 心电监护 监护室
心律 cardiac rhythm 心脏跳动的节律与起源，正常为窦性，异常时需判断类型 The rhythm and origin of cardiac beats, normally sinus, classified when abnormal. 心电监护 监护室
窦性心律 sinus rhythm 由窦房结发出冲动、P 波形态正常的心律，属正常心律 A rhythm originating from the sinus node with normal P waves, the normal cardiac rhythm. 心电监护 监护室
心动过速 tachycardia 成人心率超过 100 次每分的状态，可为窦性、室上性或室性 A heart rate above 100 per minute in adults, which may be sinus, supraventricular or ventricular. 心电监护 抢救室
心动过缓 bradycardia 成人心率低于 60 次每分的状态，严重时可致低血压与晕厥 A heart rate below 60 per minute in adults, which may cause hypotension and syncope. 心电监护 抢救室
心律失常 arrhythmia 心脏冲动起源或传导异常导致的心律改变，可表现为过快、过慢或不齐 Abnormal cardiac rhythm from disordered impulse formation or conduction, fast, slow or irregular. 心电监护 监护室
期前收缩 premature beat 提前出现的心搏，按起源分为房性与室性，偶发者多无临床意义 A beat occurring earlier than expected, atrial or ventricular in origin, often insignificant when occasional. 心电监护 监护室 偶发期前收缩不等于心脏病，避免对患者过度解释
心室率 ventricular rate 心房颤动等心律失常时心室实际搏动的频率，决定血流动力学影响 The actual rate of ventricular beating in arrhythmias such as atrial fibrillation, which drives the haemodynamic effect. 心电监护 监护室
PR 间期 PR interval 自 P 波起点至 QRS 波起点的时限，正常 0.12 至 0.20 秒 The interval from the start of the P wave to the start of the QRS complex, normally 0.12 to 0.20 seconds. 心电监护 监护室
QRS 波群 QRS complex 代表心室除极的心电波群，时限增宽提示室内传导异常 The ECG complex representing ventricular depolarisation, widening indicating abnormal intraventricular conduction. 心电监护 监护室 宽 QRS 心动过速在排除前按室性处理更安全
ST 段 ST segment QRS 波群终点至 T 波起点的线段，抬高或压低提示心肌缺血 The segment between the end of the QRS complex and the start of the T wave, altered in myocardial ischaemia. 心电监护 监护室
T 波 T wave 代表心室复极的心电波，高尖或倒置可提示缺血与电解质紊乱 The ECG wave representing ventricular repolarisation, peaked or inverted in ischaemia and electrolyte disturbance. 心电监护 监护室
心电报警 ECG alarm 心电监护仪在心率或心律超出设定范围时发出的提示 An alert from the cardiac monitor when the rate or rhythm goes outside the set limits. 心电监护 监护室
导联脱落 lead disconnection 电极与皮肤接触不良或导线松脱导致波形消失的情况 Loss of waveform caused by poor electrode contact or a detached lead wire. 心电监护 监护室
心率变异性 heart rate variability 逐次心搏间期长短的变化程度，降低提示自主神经调节受损 The variation in beat-to-beat intervals, reduced when autonomic regulation is impaired. 心电监护 监护室
心率监测 heart rate monitoring 对心率进行连续或定时观察并记录，注意与脉率对比 Continuous or timed observation and recording of heart rate, compared with the pulse rate. 心电监护 护士站
目标心率 target heart rate 根据病情为患者设定的心率控制范围，用于指导用药与活动 The heart rate range set for a patient, guiding drug therapy and activity. 心电监护 监护室
电极片 electrode pad 贴于皮肤表面传导心电信号的导电贴片，需定期更换以防接触不良 A conductive pad on the skin that transmits the ECG signal, changed regularly to avoid poor contact. 心电监护 监护室
监护报警设置 alarm settings 对心率上下限、血氧下限等报警阈值与音量的配置，需按病情个体化 The configuration of alarm limits and volume, such as heart rate bounds and saturation floor. 心电监护 监护室
心律监测 rhythm monitoring 对心律类型与变化进行持续观察，识别新发心律失常 Continuous observation of rhythm type and change to detect new arrhythmias. 心电监护 护士站
危急值 critical value 提示患者可能立即危及生命的检验或检查结果，需限时报告并处置 A laboratory or imaging result indicating immediate life-threatening risk, requiring prompt reporting and action. 危急值 护士站 危急值不等同于异常值，只有达到设定阈值才算
危急值报告 critical value reporting 检验科发现危急值后按流程通知临床并记录的过程 The process by which the laboratory notifies clinicians of a critical value and documents it. 危急值 护士站
危急值登记 critical value log 专门记录危急值内容、报告与处理经过的登记本或电子记录 A register or electronic record documenting critical values, their reporting and the response. 危急值 护士站
危急值通知 critical value notification 把危急值结果及时告知主管医生的动作，需复述确认避免听错 The act of promptly informing the responsible doctor of a critical value, read back to avoid error. 危急值 护士站
危急值预警 critical value alert 信息系统在结果达到危急阈值时自动发出的提示，用于缩短报告延迟 An automatic prompt from the information system when a result reaches the critical threshold. 危急值 监护室
危急值闭环管理 closed-loop critical value management 从结果识别、通知、处置到复核的全流程可追溯管理方式 A traceable management approach covering detection, notification, treatment and review of critical values. 危急值 护士站
危急值范围 critical value range 各检验项目被设定为危急值的数值区间，由医疗机构统一制定 The numeric range set as critical for each test, defined by the institution. 危急值 护士站
危急值报告制度 critical value reporting policy 规定危急值识别、报告时限与责任人的管理制度 An institutional policy defining critical value identification, reporting deadlines and responsibilities. 危急值 护士站
报告时限 reporting time limit 从确认危急值到通知临床的最长允许时间，通常为数分钟 The maximum permitted time from confirming a critical value to notifying the clinician, usually minutes. 危急值 护士站
血糖危急值 critical blood glucose 血糖低至或高至设定阈值的结果，可迅速引起意识障碍与抽搐 A glucose result at or beyond the set low or high threshold, rapidly causing confusion and seizures. 危急值 护士站
血钾危急值 critical serum potassium 血钾超出安全范围的结果，过高可致心律失常甚至心搏骤停 A potassium result outside the safe range, high values causing arrhythmia and cardiac arrest. 危急值 护士站
血钠危急值 critical serum sodium 血钠低于 120 或高于 160 毫摩尔每升的结果，可致抽搐与意识改变 A sodium result below 120 or above 160 millimoles per litre, which may cause seizures and confusion. 危急值 护士站 纠正过快可致渗透性脱髓鞘，必须限速
血红蛋白危急值 critical hemoglobin 血红蛋白低至设定阈值的结果，提示严重贫血或活动性出血 A haemoglobin result at or below the set threshold, indicating severe anaemia or active bleeding. 危急值 护士站
血小板危急值 critical platelet count 血小板计数极低的结果，提示自发出血风险显著升高 A very low platelet count, indicating a markedly increased risk of spontaneous bleeding. 危急值 护士站
国际标准化比值 international normalized ratio 用于监测华法林抗凝强度的标准化凝血指标，过高提示出血风险 A standardized coagulation index for monitoring warfarin intensity, high values indicating bleeding risk. 危急值 护士站
动脉氧分压 partial pressure of arterial oxygen 动脉血中溶解氧产生的压力，是判断氧合与通气的重要血气指标 The pressure exerted by dissolved oxygen in arterial blood, a key blood gas index of oxygenation. 危急值 抢救室 吸氧会抬高氧分压，判读时须结合吸氧浓度

en: partial pressure of arterial carbon dioxide
text: 动脉二氧化碳分压 partial pressure of arterial carbon dioxide 动脉血中二氧化碳产生的压力，反映肺泡通气是否充分 The pressure exerted by carbon dioxide in arterial blood, reflecting the adequacy of alveolar ventilation. 危急值 抢救室
乳酸 lactate 无氧代谢产物，血中浓度升高提示组织灌注不足或氧利用障碍 A product of anaerobic metabolism whose rise indicates inadequate perfusion or impaired oxygen use. 危急值 护士站 采血时避免止血带长时间结扎，以免假性升高
高乳酸血症 hyperlactatemia 血乳酸超过正常上限的状态，持续升高提示预后不良 A blood lactate above the upper limit of normal, persistent elevation indicating a poor prognosis. 危急值 监护室
肌钙蛋白危急值 critical troponin level 心肌肌钙蛋白升高至设定阈值的结果，提示心肌损伤需紧急评估 A troponin result above the set threshold, indicating myocardial injury requiring urgent assessment. 危急值 护士站 肾功能不全时肌钙蛋白可非特异性升高
凝血危急值 critical coagulation value 凝血酶原时间或活化部分凝血活酶时间显著延长的结果，提示出血风险 A markedly prolonged prothrombin or activated partial thromboplastin time, indicating bleeding risk. 危急值 护士站
血培养阳性报警 positive blood culture alert 血培养仪器检出细菌生长时发出的紧急提示，需立即报告并评估感染源 An urgent alert when the blood culture analyser detects bacterial growth, requiring prompt reporting. 危急值 护士站
复测 repeat testing 对可疑结果再次采样或重新检测以确认，危急值须复测后报告 Sampling or testing again to confirm a doubtful result, required before reporting a critical value. 危急值 护士站
危急值记录 critical value documentation 对危急值内容、通知与处理过程的书面或电子记录 The written or electronic record of a critical value, its notification and the response. 危急值 护士站
危急值漏报 missed critical value 危急值未被识别、通知或记录的情况，属严重医疗安全事件 A critical value that was not identified, reported or documented, a serious patient safety event. 危急值 护士站
氧疗 oxygen therapy 通过给氧提高吸入氧浓度以纠正低氧血症的治疗措施 Treatment that raises the inspired oxygen concentration to correct hypoxaemia. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 抢救室
吸氧 oxygen inhalation 患者经鼻导管或面罩吸入氧气的具体动作与过程 The act of breathing in supplemental oxygen through a nasal cannula or mask. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 抢救室
氧流量 oxygen flow rate 每分钟供给的氧气体积，以升每分表示，需按病情调节 The volume of oxygen delivered per minute, expressed in litres per minute and adjusted to the condition. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 护士站 鼻导管流量一般不超过每分钟 6 升，再高需改面罩
吸氧浓度 fraction of inspired oxygen 吸入气体中氧气所占的比例，以小数或百分比表示，是呼吸机核心参数 The proportion of oxygen in inspired gas, expressed as a fraction, a core ventilator setting. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室 长期高吸氧浓度可致氧中毒与吸收性肺不张
鼻导管吸氧 nasal cannula oxygen 将双孔导管置于鼻前庭供氧的方式，舒适但氧浓度有限且不恒定 Oxygen delivered through a two-pronged cannula in the nostrils, comfortable but with a low variable concentration. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 抢救室
面罩吸氧 oxygen therapy via face mask 用面罩罩住口鼻供氧的方式，可提供较高且较稳定的氧浓度 Oxygen delivered through a mask covering the nose and mouth, giving a higher and steadier concentration. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 抢救室
高流量鼻导管氧疗 high-flow nasal cannula therapy 经鼻导管提供加温湿化、高流量且氧浓度可调氧气的治疗方式 Delivery of warmed, humidified oxygen at high flow with adjustable concentration through nasal cannulae. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室
起搏心律 paced rhythm 起搏器发放电冲动控制心室除极时的心电表现，可见起搏信号 The ECG pattern produced when a pacemaker drives ventricular depolarisation, showing pacing spikes. 心电监护 监护室 起搏心律时 ST 段与心肌缺血的判读需谨慎
有创机械通气 invasive mechanical ventilation 经气管插管或气管切开连接呼吸机进行通气的支持方式 Ventilation through an endotracheal tube or tracheostomy connected to a ventilator. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室
呼吸机参数 ventilator settings 呼吸机的潮气量、频率、吸氧浓度与呼气末正压等设定值 The set values on a ventilator, such as tidal volume, rate, oxygen concentration and end-expiratory pressure. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室
潮气量 tidal volume 每次平静呼吸进出肺的气体量，机械通气时常按体重设定 The volume of gas moving in or out of the lungs with each breath, set by predicted body weight. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室 按预测体重而非实际体重计算，肥胖患者尤需注意
呼吸频率设置 set respiratory rate 呼吸机上为患者设定的每分钟通气次数，需与自主呼吸协调 The breaths per minute programmed on the ventilator, coordinated with the patient's own breathing. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室
气道峰压 peak airway pressure 机械通气吸气时气道内出现的最高压力，过高提示气道阻力增加或顺应性下降 The highest airway pressure during inspiration on mechanical ventilation, raised by resistance or stiffness. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室
平台压 plateau pressure 吸气末屏气时气道内的压力，反映肺泡内压，超过 30 厘米水柱易致肺损伤 The airway pressure during an end-inspiratory hold, reflecting alveolar pressure and lung injury risk above 30. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室
呼气末正压 positive end-expiratory pressure 机械通气呼气末维持的正压，可防止肺泡塌陷并改善氧合 Positive pressure maintained at end-expiration during ventilation, preventing alveolar collapse. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室
压力支持 pressure support 患者触发吸气时呼吸机给予的辅助压力，用于部分通气支持与撤机 Assist pressure delivered by the ventilator with each patient-triggered breath, used for partial support. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室
氧合目标 oxygenation target 氧疗或通气时为患者设定的血氧或氧分压目标范围 The target saturation or oxygen partial pressure set for a patient during oxygen therapy or ventilation. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室
氧输送 oxygen delivery 单位时间内血液输送到组织的氧量，由心输出量与动脉血氧含量决定 The amount of oxygen transported to the tissues per unit time, set by cardiac output and arterial oxygen content. 休克识别 监护室
气道阻力 airway resistance 气体流经气道时遇到的阻力，升高时需更高压力才能送入同等气量 The resistance to gas flow through the airways, requiring higher pressure for the same volume. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室
肺顺应性 lung compliance 肺在单位压力变化下容积改变的程度，降低提示肺水肿或纤维化 The change in lung volume per unit change in pressure, reduced in oedema and fibrosis. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室
每搏量指数 stroke volume index 每搏输出量除以体表面积所得的值，用于不同体型患者间比较前负荷反应 Stroke volume divided by body surface area, used to compare preload response between patients of different size. 容量评估 监护室
撤机参数 weaning parameters 判断能否脱离呼吸机的一组指标，如浅快呼吸指数与最大吸气压 A set of indices used to judge whether ventilator support can be withdrawn, such as the rapid shallow index. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室
氧中毒 oxygen toxicity 长时间吸入高浓度氧导致肺损伤与吸收性肺不张的状态 Lung injury and absorption atelectasis caused by prolonged inhalation of high oxygen concentrations. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 抢救室
呼吸支持 respiratory support 为维持通气与氧合所采用的各种手段的总称，含氧疗与机械通气 The collective measures maintaining ventilation and oxygenation, including oxygen therapy and ventilation. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 监护室

zh: 急性生理与慢性健康评分
en: Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation
text: 急性生理与慢性健康评分 Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation 由急性生理、年龄与慢性健康三部分计分的危重程度评估系统，分值越高预后越差 A severity score combining acute physiology, age and chronic health, with higher scores predicting worse outcome. 危重症评分 抢救室 取入住监护室最初二十四小时的最差值计算

序贯器官衰竭评分 Sequential Organ Failure Assessment 按呼吸、凝血、肝、循环、神经与肾脏六系统计分的器官功能评估工具 An organ dysfunction score covering respiratory, coagulation, liver, circulatory, neurological and renal systems. 危重症评分 监护室

zh: 快速序贯器官衰竭评分
text: 快速序贯器官衰竭评分 quick Sequential Organ Failure Assessment 由呼吸频率、意识状态与收缩压三项组成的床旁快速筛查工具 A bedside screening tool using respiratory rate, mental status and systolic pressure. 危重症评分 分诊台 仅用于床旁筛查提示预后，不能替代完整评分
国家早期预警评分 National Early Warning Score 根据呼吸、血氧、体温、血压、心率与意识计分的病情恶化预警工具 A deterioration warning score based on respiration, saturation, temperature, pressure, heart rate and consciousness. 危重症评分 分诊台
改良早期预警评分 Modified Early Warning Score 在早期预警评分基础上调整参数的简化版评分，用于病房识别病情恶化 A simplified early warning score with adjusted parameters, used on wards to detect deterioration. 危重症评分 分诊台
早期预警评分 early warning score 依据常规生命体征计分以早期发现病情恶化的通用评分体系 A scoring system based on routine vital signs to detect clinical deterioration early. 危重症评分 护士站
危重症评分 critical illness score 用于量化病情严重程度与死亡风险的一类评分工具的统称 A general term for scores that quantify illness severity and mortality risk. 危重症评分 监护室
简化急性生理评分 Simplified Acute Physiology Score 由十二项生理指标、年龄与住院类型计分的危重程度评估工具，用于预估病死率 A severity score using twelve physiological variables, age and admission type to estimate mortality. 危重症评分 抢救室
器官衰竭评分 organ failure score 按器官系统功能障碍程度计分的评估工具，用于量化多器官功能不全 A score grading dysfunction in each organ system to quantify multi-organ failure. 危重症评分 监护室
格拉斯哥预后评分 Glasgow Outcome Scale 用于评价颅脑损伤后功能恢复程度的分级工具，分五级从死亡到恢复良好 A five-level scale grading functional recovery after brain injury, from death to good recovery. 危重症评分 监护室 与格拉斯哥昏迷评分不是同一工具，勿混用
镇静评分 sedation score 量化镇静深度的评分工具，用于避免镇静不足或过度镇静 A tool quantifying depth of sedation to avoid under- or over-sedation. 危重症评分 监护室
镇静躁动评分 Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale 从 +4 极度躁动到 -5 不可唤醒共十级的镇静与躁动评估量表 A ten-level scale from plus four combative to minus five unarousable, grading sedation and agitation. 危重症评分 监护室
谵妄评估 delirium assessment 用标准化工具在监护室筛查患者是否处于急性脑功能紊乱状态 Use of a standardized tool to screen for acute brain dysfunction in intensive care. 危重症评分 监护室 评估前需确认患者能对声音或疼痛有反应
肌力评分 muscle strength score 对上肢、下肢与呼吸肌等多组肌力分级计分，用于发现监护室获得性衰弱 A score grading strength in limb and respiratory muscles to detect intensive care acquired weakness. 危重症评分 监护室
误吸风险评估 aspiration risk assessment 对吞咽、意识与胃管等危险因素进行评分以判断误吸风险的过程 Grading swallowing, consciousness and tube-related risk factors to judge aspiration risk. 危重症评分 监护室
营养风险筛查 nutritional risk screening 通过进食量下降、体重减轻与疾病严重度评定营养风险的工具 A tool rating nutritional risk from reduced intake, weight loss and disease severity. 危重症评分 监护室
静脉血栓风险评估 venous thromboembolism risk assessment 依据制动、手术与基础疾病等评估血栓风险，决定是否药物预防 Assessment of thrombosis risk from immobility, surgery and comorbidity, deciding pharmacological prophylaxis. 危重症评分 监护室
死亡风险预测 mortality risk prediction 用评分模型计算患者住院或一定期限内死亡概率的过程 Calculating the probability of death during admission or within a set period with a scoring model. 危重症评分 监护室 不能把模型数值直接当预后结论告诉家属
预后评分 prognostic score 用于预判功能恢复或生存结局的评分工具，常在出院或随访时使用 A score used to predict functional recovery or survival, often applied at discharge or follow-up. 危重症评分 监护室
评分量表 scoring scale 由若干条目与分值构成、按总分判断病情或风险的标准化工具 A standardized instrument of scored items whose total indicates severity or risk. 危重症评分 护士站
评分阈值 score threshold 评分达到某一数值即触发相应临床行动的界限值 The cut-off value of a score that triggers a defined clinical action. 危重症评分 护士站
重复评分 repeated scoring 按固定间隔再次进行同一评分并比较变化，用于发现病情演变 Repeating the same score at set intervals and comparing change to detect deterioration. 危重症评分 护士站
危重程度分级 severity grading 按病情轻重把患者分为不同等级，决定监护与救治资源分配 Classifying patients into severity grades to allocate monitoring and treatment resources. 危重症评分 抢救室
急性生理评分 acute physiology score 由多项急性生理指标最差值合成的分值，是多种危重评分的基础部分 A score built from the worst values of several acute physiological variables, used in several severity scores. 危重症评分 监护室
慢性健康评分 chronic health evaluation 对既往器官功能不全或免疫抑制状态计分的部分，反映基础储备 The component scoring prior organ insufficiency or immunosuppression, reflecting baseline reserve. 危重症评分 监护室
肺超声 lung ultrasound 用超声探查肺表面以评估肺水与胸腔积液的床旁检查方法 Bedside ultrasound of the lung surface used to assess extravascular lung water and pleural effusion. 容量评估 监护室
转运监护仪 transport monitor 内置电池、体积小便于随患者移动的监护设备，可显示心电、血压与血氧 A small battery-powered monitor that moves with the patient, showing ECG, pressure and saturation. 转运监护 转运车
转运途中监测 monitoring during transport 在移动过程中对心率、血压、血氧与意识等指标的连续观察 Continuous observation of heart rate, pressure, saturation and consciousness while moving the patient. 转运监护 转运车
转运前评估 pre-transport assessment 出发前对气道、呼吸、循环与设备准备情况的系统检查 A systematic check of airway, breathing, circulation and equipment before departure. 转运监护 护士站
转运风险评估 transport risk assessment 对转运途中可能发生的心搏骤停、管路脱落等风险进行分级判断 Grading the risk of cardiac arrest, tube dislodgement and other events during transfer. 转运监护 护士站
转运禁忌证 contraindication to transport 因病情极不稳定而不宜离开抢救单元的情形，如需持续按压者 A condition so unstable that leaving the resuscitation area is unsafe, such as ongoing chest compressions. 转运监护 护士站
便携式监护仪 portable monitor 重量轻、可由一人携带的小型监护设备，用于院前与转运场景 A lightweight monitor one person can carry, used in prehospital care and transfer. 转运监护 转运车
尿渗透压 urine osmolality 单位重量尿液中溶质颗粒的总数，反映肾小管浓缩与稀释功能 The number of solute particles per unit weight of urine, reflecting tubular concentrating and diluting ability. 尿量监测 监护室
转运氧气瓶 portable oxygen cylinder 随患者移动的压缩氧气钢瓶，需核对容量与剩余压力 A compressed oxygen cylinder carried with the patient, checked for capacity and residual pressure. 转运监护 转运车
转运中生命体征 vital signs during transport 患者在移动过程中测得的体温、脉搏、呼吸与血压等指标 The temperature, pulse, respiration and blood pressure measured while the patient is being moved. 转运监护 转运车
转运报警 transport alarm 转运设备在参数超出范围或电源异常时发出的提示，需立即查看 An alert from transport equipment when parameters go out of range or power fails. 转运监护 转运车
转运供氧 oxygen supply during transport 在移动过程中持续供给氧气的方式，需保证流量与续航 Continuous oxygen delivery while moving the patient, with attention to flow and duration. 转运监护 转运车
转运监测参数 monitored parameters during transport 转运过程中需要持续观察的具体指标，如心电、血氧、血压与呼气末二氧化碳 The specific values watched during transfer, such as ECG, saturation, pressure and end-tidal carbon dioxide. 转运监护 转运车

血乳酸清除率 lactate clearance 复苏前后血乳酸下降的百分比，用于评价组织灌注改善与复苏效果 The percentage fall in blood lactate after resuscitation, used to judge improved perfusion and response to treatment. 休克识别 监护室 乳酸清除率比单次乳酸值更能反映复苏效果
转运团队 transport team 负责转运的医护与辅助人员组合，需明确分工与指挥者 The clinical and support staff who carry out the transfer, with defined roles and a leader. 转运监护 护士站
转运设备检查 equipment check before transport 出发前对监护仪、呼吸机、氧气与吸引装置的完好性逐项确认 Confirming the monitor, ventilator, oxygen and suction are all functioning before departure. 转运监护 护士站
转运不良事件 transport adverse event 转运途中发生的管路脱落、血压骤降或设备故障等意外情况 An unexpected event during transfer such as tube dislodgement, a pressure drop or equipment failure. 转运监护 转运车
转运记录 transport record 记录转运时间、路线、监护参数与途中处理的文书 Documentation of transfer time, route, monitored values and any intervention on the way. 转运监护 护士站
转运安全 transport safety 保障患者在移动过程中不发生跌落、脱管与设备失效的综合措施 Measures preventing falls, tube dislodgement and equipment failure while moving a patient. 转运监护 转运车
转运后交接 post-transport handover 到达目的地后向接收方交代病情、用药与监护情况的程序 The procedure of handing over the condition, drugs and monitoring to the receiving team on arrival. 转运监护 护士站
转运中输液 infusion during transport 移动过程中维持静脉通路通畅与输注速度稳定的管理 Keeping the intravenous line patent and the infusion rate steady while the patient is moved. 转运监护 转运车
转运中心率监测 heart rate monitoring during transport 在移动过程中持续观察心率与心律变化的监护内容 Continuous observation of heart rate and rhythm while the patient is being moved. 转运监护 转运车
转运中血氧监测 oxygen saturation monitoring during transport 在移动过程中持续观察血氧饱和度与波形，防止途中低氧 Continuous observation of saturation and waveform while moving, to prevent hypoxaemia en route. 转运监护 转运车
转运中血压监测 blood pressure monitoring during transport 在移动过程中定时测量血压以发现循环波动 Timed blood pressure measurement while moving to detect circulatory change. 转运监护 转运车
转运设备电池 battery for transport equipment 转运监护仪与呼吸机所用电池，需保证续航覆盖往返时间 The battery powering transport monitors and ventilators, whose runtime must cover the round trip. 转运监护 转运车
容量评估 volume assessment 对患者体内有效循环血量的多少及其分布进行判断的过程 Judging the amount and distribution of effective circulating volume in a patient. 容量评估 监护室
容量状态 volume status 机体血管内容量与组织间液量的总体情况，分为不足、正常与过多 The overall state of intravascular and interstitial volume, described as low, normal or high. 容量评估 监护室
容量负荷 volume load 血管内所承受的液体量，补液时需关注其累积效应 The fluid volume within the vascular space, whose cumulative effect matters during fluid therapy. 容量评估 监护室
容量过负荷 fluid overload 输入液体超过机体排出能力导致体重增加与组织水肿的状态 A state in which fluid intake exceeds the ability to excrete it, causing weight gain and oedema. 容量评估 监护室
容量不足 volume depletion 血管内容量减少的状态，可由失血、呕吐、腹泻或过度利尿引起 A reduction in intravascular volume caused by bleeding, vomiting, diarrhoea or over-diuresis. 容量评估 监护室
中心静脉压 central venous pressure 上腔静脉或右心房的压力，反映右心前负荷与容量状态 The pressure in the superior vena cava or right atrium, reflecting right heart preload and volume. 容量评估 监护室 单次数值受胸腔内压与体位影响，不能单独作为补液依据
中心静脉压监测 central venous pressure monitoring 经中心静脉导管连续测定右心前负荷压力的监护方法 Continuous measurement of right heart preload pressure through a central venous catheter. 容量评估 监护室

每搏量变异度 stroke volume variation 机械通气时每搏量随呼吸周期的变化幅度，超过 13 百分比提示有容量反应性 The respiratory variation in stroke volume during ventilation, above 13 percent indicating fluid responsiveness. 容量评估 监护室 自主呼吸、心律失常或低潮气量时结果不可靠
脉压变异度 pulse pressure variation 动脉脉压随呼吸变化的比例，用于判断机械通气患者的液体反应性 The respiratory change in arterial pulse pressure, used to judge fluid responsiveness during ventilation. 容量评估 监护室
下腔静脉变异度 inferior vena cava variability 超声观察下腔静脉随呼吸塌陷或扩张的比例，用于估计容量状态 The respiratory collapse or distension of the inferior vena cava on ultrasound, used to estimate volume. 容量评估 监护室
下腔静脉直径 inferior vena cava diameter 超声测得的下腔静脉内径，结合塌陷率可判断右心房压力 The ultrasound-measured calibre of the inferior vena cava, which with collapsibility indicates right atrial pressure. 容量评估 监护室
每搏输出量 stroke volume 心脏每次收缩射出的血量，是评价心泵功能与容量反应的核心指标 The volume ejected by the ventricle with each beat, central to pump function and fluid responsiveness. 容量评估 监护室
心输出量 cardiac output 心脏每分钟射出的血量，等于每搏输出量乘以心率 The volume ejected by the heart per minute, equal to stroke volume multiplied by heart rate. 容量评估 监护室
心指数 cardiac index 心输出量除以体表面积所得的值，用于不同体型患者间比较 Cardiac output divided by body surface area, allowing comparison between patients of different sizes. 容量评估 监护室
床旁超声 point-of-care ultrasound 由临床医生在床旁即时完成的操作性超声检查，用于快速评估容量与心功能 Ultrasound performed at the bedside by the treating clinician to assess volume and cardiac function rapidly. 容量评估 监护室 结果依赖操作者经验，需结合临床判断
液体潴留 fluid retention 体内液体排出减少而蓄积的状态，表现为体重增加与凹陷性水肿 Accumulation of fluid because excretion is reduced, shown by weight gain and pitting oedema. 容量评估 监护室
第三间隙 third space 液体异常积聚在组织间隙与体腔、不参与循环的部分，如腹水与肠壁水肿 Fluid sequestered in tissues and body cavities, outside the circulating volume, such as ascites. 容量评估 监护室
组织水肿 tissue edema 液体在组织间隙积聚引起的肿胀，常见于补液过多与低蛋白血症 Swelling from fluid accumulating in the interstitium, common with over-infusion and hypoalbuminaemia. 容量评估 监护室
出入量 intake and output 患者摄入与排出液体的总量记录，是判断容量平衡的基础数据 The recorded totals of fluid taken in and put out, the basis for judging fluid balance. 容量评估 护士站
