吸入给药 inhaled administration 经口鼻吸入气溶胶或气体药物的给药方式 Delivering a drug as an aerosol or gas that the patient breathes in. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
滴鼻给药 intranasal administration 把药液滴入鼻腔经黏膜吸收的给药方式 Placing a drug drop in the nose for absorption through the nasal mucosa. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
直肠给药 rectal administration 经肛门把药物送入直肠、由黏膜吸收的给药方式 Introducing a drug into the rectum for absorption through the rectal mucosa. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
气管内给药 endotracheal drug administration 经气管导管把药物注入气道、由肺泡吸收的给药方式 Instilling a drug into the airway through a tracheal tube for absorption. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
雾化吸入 nebulized inhalation 把药液雾化后随呼吸吸入气道的给药方式 Inhaling a drug after it has been turned into a fine mist. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
微量注射泵 syringe pump 以极小流速精确推注药液的电动装置 An electric pump that pushes very small volumes of drug at a precise rate. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
静脉滴注 intravenous drip 药液经输液器缓慢持续滴入静脉的方式 Giving a drug slowly and continuously into a vein through an infusion set. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
静脉推注 intravenous bolus 用注射器在短时间内把药液直接推入静脉 Pushing a drug straight into a vein with a syringe over a short time. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
负荷剂量 loading dose 为迅速达到有效血药浓度而先给的较大剂量 A larger initial dose given to reach a therapeutic drug level quickly. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
维持剂量 maintenance dose 达到疗效后为保持血药浓度而规律给予的剂量 The regular dose that keeps a therapeutic level once the target has been reached. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
单次剂量 single dose 一次给药所使用的药量，常与总量区分记录 The amount of drug given on one occasion, recorded separately from the total. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
最大剂量 maximum dose 单位时间内允许使用的药量上限，须与累积量核对 The upper limit of drug that may be given within a set period. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
剂量调整 dose adjustment 根据疗效、体重或肝肾功能改变给药量 Changing the dose according to response, body weight, or kidney and liver function. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
药物浓度 drug concentration 单位体积液体内所含药物的质量，配制后须标注 The mass of drug in a given volume of fluid, which must be labelled after preparation. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
药物稀释 drug dilution 用溶媒降低药液浓度以便静脉给药的处理 Adding a solvent to lower the drug concentration before intravenous use. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
配伍禁忌 drug incompatibility 两种药物混合后发生沉淀、失效或毒性增加 A reaction between two mixed drugs that causes precipitation, loss of effect or toxicity. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
给药间隔 dosing interval 两次给药之间相隔的时间，按药代动力学设定 The time between two doses, set according to the drug's pharmacokinetics. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
剂量计算 dose calculation 按体重或体表面积推算应给药量的过程 Working out the dose to give from body weight or body surface area. 给药途径与剂量 床旁
药物不良反应 adverse drug reaction 使用正常剂量药物时出现的有害反应 A harmful effect that appears at normal therapeutic doses of a drug. 给药途径与剂量 抢救室
复苏团队 resuscitation team 由医生与护士组成、按分工实施抢救的小组 The group of doctors and nurses who carry out resuscitation with divided roles. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
抢救组长 team leader 现场统一指挥抢救、决定处置顺序的负责人 The person who directs the resuscitation scene and sets the order of actions. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
按压者 compressor 负责实施胸外按压的施救人员，需定时轮换 The rescuer who performs chest compressions and must be rotated regularly. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
球囊操作者 bag-mask operator 负责挤压球囊、配合面罩通气的人员 The rescuer who squeezes the bag and assists with mask ventilation. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
气道管理者 airway manager 负责开放气道、置入高级气道的人员 The team member responsible for opening the airway and placing an advanced airway. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
给药护士 medication nurse 负责按医嘱准备与推注抢救药物的护士 The nurse who prepares and gives the resuscitation drugs on instruction. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
记录者 recorder 负责记录抢救时间、操作与用药的人员 The team member who records the timing, procedures and drugs during resuscitation. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
计时员 timekeeper 负责提示两分钟轮换与给药间隔的人员 The person who calls the two-minute cycle and the drug intervals. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
除颤操作者 defibrillator operator 负责操作除颤器、执行电击的人员 The team member who works the defibrillator and delivers the shocks. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
角色分工 role assignment 抢救开始前按岗位把任务分派给具体人员 Assigning each task to a named person before resuscitation begins. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
闭环沟通 closed-loop communication 下达指令后由接收者复述、执行者确认完成的沟通方式 A communication loop in which every order is repeated back and confirmed. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
复苏复盘 resuscitation debriefing 抢救结束后团队回顾流程与问题的讨论 A team discussion that reviews the resuscitation and identifies what to improve. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
团队站位 team positioning 抢救时各成员在床旁的相对位置安排 How team members are arranged around the bed during a resuscitation. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
呼叫支援 call for help 抢救人手不足时请求其他人员到场协助 Calling additional staff to come and help when the team is too small. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
交叉核对 cross-check 两人分别核对同一信息、以发现差错的核查方式 Having two people check the same information independently to catch errors. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
团队协作 teamwork 成员之间配合与信息共享以保证抢救顺畅 Team members working together and sharing information so resuscitation runs smoothly. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
院内急救小组 rapid response team 院内发生病情恶化时快速到场的急救团队 A hospital team that rushes to deteriorating patients anywhere in the building. 复苏团队分工 病房
口头医嘱 verbal order 抢救时由医生口述、护士复述执行的医嘱 An order spoken by the doctor during resuscitation and repeated back by the nurse. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
复述确认 read-back 接收者把指令重复一遍、以确认理解无误的做法 Repeating an instruction back so that the giver can confirm it was heard correctly. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
团队资源管理 team resource management 系统调配人力、设备与信息以提升团队效能的训练 Training that organises people, equipment and information to improve team performance. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
复苏团队启动 team activation 识别骤停后按流程召集复苏团队的行动 Activating the resuscitation team according to protocol once arrest is recognised. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
多学科协作 multidisciplinary team 多个专科共同参与同一患者救治的工作方式 Several specialties working together on the care of one patient. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
复苏演练 resuscitation drill 模拟真实骤停场景、用于训练团队配合的演练 A simulated arrest scenario used to train the team to work together. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
上级医师到场 senior physician arrival 抢救中请求上级医师到达现场主持处置 A senior doctor coming to the bedside to take over the resuscitation. 复苏团队分工 抢救室
复苏后处理 post-resuscitation care 自主循环恢复后针对脑、心、肺等器官的综合治疗 Comprehensive care of the brain, heart, lungs and other organs after circulation returns. 复苏后处理 监护室
复苏后监护 post-resuscitation monitoring 复苏后对生命体征、意识与心律的持续监测 Continuous observation of vital signs, consciousness and rhythm after resuscitation. 复苏后处理 监护室
目标温度管理 targeted temperature management 把体温控制在三十二至三十六度以保护脑功能的治疗 Controlling body temperature between thirty-two and thirty-six degrees to protect the brain. 复苏后处理 监护室
治疗性低温 therapeutic hypothermia 用物理方法把核心体温降至目标范围的脑保护措施 Lowering core temperature with physical methods as a brain-protective measure. 复苏后处理 监护室
复温 rewarming 低温治疗结束后缓慢恢复至正常体温的过程 Slowly returning the body to normal temperature once cooling treatment ends. 复苏后处理 监护室
寒战 shivering 低温治疗时出现的骨骼肌不自主收缩、增加产热 Involuntary muscle contraction during cooling that generates extra body heat. 复苏后处理 监护室
神经预后评估 neurological prognostication 综合临床与电生理指标判断脑功能恢复可能性的过程 Judging the likely recovery of brain function from clinical and electrophysiological findings. 复苏后处理 监护室
复苏后低血压 post-arrest hypotension 复苏成功后血压仍低于目标、影响器官灌注的状态 Blood pressure that stays below target after resuscitation and limits organ perfusion. 复苏后处理 监护室
复苏后心电图 post-resuscitation electrocardiogram 复苏成功后立即记录、用于寻找骤停原因的心电图 The tracing recorded immediately after resuscitation to look for the cause of the arrest. 复苏后处理 抢救室
复苏后血糖控制 glucose control after resuscitation 把复苏后血糖维持在目标范围以减少脑损伤 Keeping blood glucose within target after resuscitation to limit brain injury. 复苏后处理 监护室
复苏后癫痫发作 post-arrest seizure 复苏后出现的抽搐发作，提示脑损伤较重 A seizure after resuscitation that suggests more severe brain injury. 复苏后处理 监护室
肌阵挛 myoclonus 复苏后出现的短暂肌肉抽动，常提示神经预后不良 Brief muscle jerks after resuscitation that often indicate a poor neurological outlook. 复苏后处理 监护室
脑电图 electroencephalogram 记录大脑皮层电活动、用于评估癫痫与脑功能的检查 A recording of cortical electrical activity used to assess seizures and brain function. 复苏后处理 床旁
体感诱发电位 somatosensory evoked potential 刺激外周神经后记录皮层反应、用于判断预后的神经电生理检查 A test that records cortical responses after stimulating a peripheral nerve to help judge prognosis. 复苏后处理 床旁
神经功能结局 neurological outcome 复苏后患者神经功能恢复的程度分级 The grade of neurological recovery reached by a patient after resuscitation. 复苏后处理 监护室
肺保护性通气 lung-protective ventilation 用小潮气量与限制气道压减少肺损伤的通气策略 A ventilation strategy using small tidal volumes and limited airway pressure to reduce lung injury. 复苏后处理 监护室
复苏后镇静 post-arrest sedation 复苏后为降低脑代谢与配合治疗给予的镇静 Sedation given after resuscitation to lower brain metabolism and allow treatment. 复苏后处理 监护室
复苏后发热 post-arrest fever 复苏后出现体温升高，可能加重脑损伤 A raised temperature after resuscitation that can worsen the existing brain injury. 复苏后处理 监护室
复苏后护理 post-resuscitation nursing 复苏后针对气道、管路、皮肤与体温的护理措施 Nursing measures for the airway, lines, skin and temperature after resuscitation. 复苏后处理 监护室
复苏后随访 post-arrest follow-up 出院后对存活患者的门诊复查与功能评估 Outpatient review and functional assessment of survivors after they leave hospital. 复苏后处理 门诊
复苏后康复 post-arrest rehabilitation 针对认知与运动功能障碍开展的康复训练 Rehabilitation training aimed at cognitive and movement problems after the arrest. 复苏后处理 监护室

en: quality of life after cardiac arrest
text: 复苏后生活质量 quality of life after cardiac arrest 存活者日常生活、认知与情绪状态的综合评估 An overall assessment of daily living, cognition and mood in survivors. 复苏后处理 门诊
复苏后营养支持 post-arrest nutrition support 复苏后经肠内或肠外途径提供营养的措施 Nutrition given by the enteral or parenteral route after resuscitation. 复苏后处理 监护室
复苏后呼吸支持 post-arrest respiratory support 复苏后维持氧合与通气的呼吸治疗措施 Respiratory treatment that keeps oxygenation and ventilation adequate after resuscitation. 复苏后处理 监护室
院前急救 prehospital emergency care 在到达医院前对急危重伤病员实施的救治 Emergency treatment given to seriously ill or injured patients before they reach hospital. 院前转运与交接 救护车
院前转运 prehospital transport 用救护车等工具把患者从现场送往医院的过程 Moving a patient from the scene to hospital by ambulance or another vehicle. 院前转运与交接 救护车
救护车 ambulance 配备急救设备、用于院前转运的专用车辆 A vehicle fitted with emergency equipment and used for prehospital transport. 院前转运与交接 救护车
急救员 emergency medical technician 接受专业训练、从事院前急救的技术人员 A trained technician who provides emergency care before hospital arrival. 院前转运与交接 现场
院前急救团队 prehospital team 由急救员与随车医护组成的院前救治小组 The group of technicians and clinicians who provide care before hospital arrival. 院前转运与交接 救护车
急救调度 emergency dispatch 受理呼救并派出救护车与人员的指挥环节 The control step that takes the call and sends the ambulance and crew. 院前转运与交接 救护车
现场评估 scene assessment 急救人员到达现场后对安全、患者与环境的快速判断 A rapid judgement of safety, patients and surroundings on arrival at the scene. 院前转运与交接 现场
现场安全 scene safety 确认现场无持续危险、保障施救者与患者安全 Confirming that the scene holds no ongoing danger to rescuers or patients. 院前转运与交接 现场
担架转运 stretcher transport 用担架把患者从现场移至救护车或病床 Moving the patient on a stretcher from the scene to the vehicle or bed. 院前转运与交接 现场
铲式担架 scoop stretcher 可拆开从两侧插入、减少患者翻动的担架 A stretcher that splits and slides under the patient with minimal turning. 院前转运与交接 现场
转运监护 transport monitoring 转运途中对心电、血氧与血压的持续监测 Continuous monitoring of rhythm, saturation and pressure while moving the patient. 院前转运与交接 救护车
转运呼吸机 transport ventilator 体积小、可由电池供电、用于转运途中通气的呼吸机 A small battery-powered ventilator used to ventilate patients during transfer. 院前转运与交接 救护车
院前通知 prehospital notification 救护车在到达前向接收医院通报病情与预计到院时间 A call from the crew to the receiving hospital with the condition and arrival time. 院前转运与交接 救护车
院前交接 prehospital handover 急救人员向院内医护交代病情与处置的过程 The handover from ambulance staff to hospital staff about the patient. 院前转运与交接 急诊入口
交接报告 handover report 交接时按固定结构叙述病情、处置与风险的报告 A structured report of the history, treatment and risks handed over at transfer. 院前转运与交接 急诊入口
转运风险 transport risk 转运过程中病情恶化或设备故障的可能性 The chance of deterioration or equipment failure while the patient is moved. 院前转运与交接 救护车
途中病情变化 deterioration during transport 患者在转运途中出现的意识、呼吸或循环恶化 Worsening of consciousness, breathing or circulation while the patient is in transit. 院前转运与交接 救护车
转运时间 transport time 从现场出发到抵达接收医院的时长 The time from leaving the scene to arriving at the receiving hospital. 院前转运与交接 救护车
院前延迟 prehospital delay 从发病到获得院前救治之间的时间延误 The time lost between onset and the start of prehospital care. 院前转运与交接 救护车
直升机转运 helicopter transport 用医疗直升机实施远程或复杂地形转运 Moving a patient by medical helicopter, used for remote or difficult terrain. 院前转运与交接 转运途中
转运决策 transport decision 根据病情与资源决定是否转、转到哪里与怎么转 Deciding whether to transfer, where to and by what means. 院前转运与交接 现场
就近送医 transport to nearest hospital 把患者送往最近的具备救治能力的医疗机构 Taking the patient to the closest hospital able to provide the needed care. 院前转运与交接 现场
转院 interhospital transfer 因诊疗需要把患者从一家医院转到另一家医院 Moving a patient from one hospital to another for further care. 院前转运与交接 急诊入口
接收医院 receiving hospital 同意接收并继续救治转运患者的医疗机构 The hospital that agrees to accept and continue treating the transferred patient. 院前转运与交接 急诊入口
院前记录 prehospital record 记录现场情况、处置与转运过程的文书 A document recording the scene findings, the treatment given and the transport. 院前转运与交接 急诊入口
初级评估 primary survey 创伤患者到院后按气道、呼吸、循环、意识和暴露顺序进行的首次快速评估 The first rapid trauma assessment following the airway, breathing, circulation, disability and exposure sequence. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
创伤团队启动 trauma team activation 接到严重创伤预警后呼叫创伤团队到抢救室集结的启动流程 The process of calling the trauma team to the resuscitation area after a severe trauma alert. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
创伤机制 mechanism of injury 造成损伤的外力类型与方式，是判断伤情和选择检查的重要依据 The type and manner of force that caused the injury, which guides assessment and imaging. 创伤初级评估 分诊台
高能量损伤 high-energy injury 由高速碰撞、高处坠落等巨大外力造成的严重损伤，常为多发伤 Severe injury caused by major force such as a high-speed collision or a fall from height. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
多发伤 polytrauma 同一外力造成两个以上解剖部位或脏器严重损伤，常伴生理功能紊乱 Severe injury to two or more body regions or organs from the same event, often with physiological instability. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
损伤严重度评分 injury severity score 按三个最重损伤部位编码计算总分的创伤严重程度量化工具 A trauma score derived from the three most severely injured body regions. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
创伤评分 trauma score 用生理指标快速量化创伤严重程度、指导分流与转运的评分方法 A scoring method using physiological variables to quantify trauma severity and guide triage. 创伤初级评估 分诊台
黄金一小时 golden hour 严重创伤后最关键的早期救治时间窗，强调尽快完成止血与手术 The critical early period after severe trauma in which rapid hemorrhage control and surgery most improve survival. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
致命三联征 lethal triad 严重创伤后低体温、酸中毒与凝血功能障碍相互加重的致死性组合 The deadly combination of hypothermia, acidosis and coagulopathy that reinforce each other after severe trauma. 创伤初级评估 抢救室

损伤控制复苏 damage control resuscitation 以控制出血、限制晶体液、纠正凝血病为核心的严重创伤复苏策略 A resuscitation strategy for severe trauma focused on hemorrhage control, limited crystalloid and correction of coagulopathy. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
损伤控制手术 damage control surgery 对危重创伤患者先止血和临时关闭体腔、待生理稳定后再确定性手术的策略 A staged strategy that controls bleeding and contamination first and defers definitive repair until physiology recovers. 创伤初级评估 手术室
创伤中心 trauma center 具备创伤团队、手术与重症监护能力并承担严重创伤救治的定点医院 A designated hospital with trauma teams, surgery and intensive care that treats severe injuries. 创伤初级评估 分诊台
院前创伤评估 prehospital trauma assessment 急救人员在现场和转运途中对创伤患者完成的初步伤情判断 The initial injury assessment performed by emergency staff at the scene and during transport. 创伤初级评估 救护车
气道通畅性评估 airway patency assessment 检查气道是否通畅、有无梗阻与误吸风险的快速判断过程 A rapid check of whether the airway is open and whether obstruction or aspiration risk is present. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
创伤预警 trauma alert 急救人员提前通知医院即将到达的严重创伤，以便团队提前准备 Advance notification to the hospital that a severely injured patient is arriving so the team can prepare. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
创伤救治流程 trauma protocol 医院内部规定的严重创伤接诊、评估与处置标准步骤 The standard hospital steps for receiving, assessing and treating severe trauma. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
骨盆骨折评估 pelvic fracture assessment 通过病史、挤压试验与影像判断骨盆环是否损伤的评估过程 The assessment of whether the pelvic ring is injured, using history, compression tests and imaging. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
暴露与保温 exposure and warming 充分暴露全身以发现隐匿损伤，同时采取保温措施防止体温下降 Exposing the whole body to find hidden injuries while actively preventing heat loss. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
出血源控制 source control of bleeding 通过压迫、填塞或手术直接处理出血部位以停止失血 Directly treating the bleeding site by pressure, packing or surgery to stop blood loss. 创伤初级评估 手术室

en: focused assessment with sonography for trauma
text: 创伤超声评估 focused assessment with sonography for trauma 用床旁超声快速检查心包、胸腔和腹腔有无游离液体的评估方法 A bedside ultrasound examination of the pericardium, chest and abdomen for free fluid after trauma. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
骨盆挤压试验 pelvic compression test 双手向中线挤压骨盆两侧，出现疼痛提示骨盆环损伤的检查 A test in which both sides of the pelvis are gently compressed, with pain suggesting a pelvic ring injury. 创伤初级评估 抢救室
快速评估 rapid assessment 用很短时间判断有无立即威胁生命的伤情的初步评估 A very brief initial evaluation to identify immediately life-threatening injuries. 创伤初级评估 现场
现场安全评估 scene safety assessment 救援人员到达现场后先判断环境危险、再接触伤者的步骤 The step in which rescuers judge environmental hazards before approaching a casualty. 创伤初级评估 现场
可预防性死亡 preventable death 通过及时规范的救治本可避免的创伤死亡，常用于质量改进分析 A trauma death that timely and appropriate care could have prevented, often reviewed for quality improvement. 创伤初级评估 会议室
创伤救治体系 trauma system 涵盖院前急救、创伤中心与康复的区域内一体化救治网络 An integrated regional network covering prehospital care, trauma centers and rehabilitation. 创伤初级评估 会议室
次级评估 secondary survey 初级评估与初步稳定后，对创伤患者从头到脚的系统性详细检查 A systematic head-to-toe examination performed after the primary survey and initial stabilization. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
从头到脚查体 head-to-toe examination 按头颈、胸腹、骨盆、四肢顺序完成的全身体格检查 A complete physical examination carried out in order from head and neck to chest, abdomen, pelvis and limbs. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
创伤病史 trauma history 围绕受伤经过、既往疾病与用药情况采集的创伤相关病史 The injury-related history covering how the trauma happened, past illness and current medication. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
受伤时间 time of injury 外力作用于人体的具体时刻，关系清创时限与病情演变判断 The exact moment the force was applied, which affects the debridement window and clinical course. 创伤次级评估 分诊台
受伤部位 injury site 外力直接作用或症状最明显的身体区域，是查体与影像检查的重点 The body region directly struck or most symptomatic, the focus of examination and imaging. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
伤口检查 wound inspection 观察伤口大小、深度、污染与活动性出血的现场检查步骤 The step of observing a wound for size, depth, contamination and active bleeding. 创伤次级评估 清创室
骨盆稳定性检查 pelvic stability examination 双手轻压骨盆两侧判断骨盆环是否完整、有无异常活动的检查 A physical check of whether the pelvic ring is intact by gently pressing both sides of the pelvis. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
神经血管检查 neurovascular examination 检查损伤肢体远端感觉、运动与脉搏的评估方法 Assessment of sensation, movement and pulses distal to an injured limb. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
活动性出血 active bleeding 伤口或体腔内正在持续流出的血液，需立即压迫或手术止血 Blood that is actively flowing from a wound or body cavity and needs immediate control. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
隐性出血 occult bleeding 体表无明显伤口但体腔内持续失血的情况，易被漏诊 Ongoing blood loss inside a body cavity without an obvious external wound, easily missed. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
腹膜后出血 retroperitoneal hemorrhage 腹膜后间隙血管或脏器损伤引起的出血，早期体征不明显 Bleeding from vessels or organs in the retroperitoneal space, with subtle early signs. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
诊断性腹腔灌洗 diagnostic peritoneal lavage 向腹腔置管灌注液体并回抽，判断腹腔内有无积血的操作 A procedure that instills fluid into the peritoneal cavity and inspects the return for blood. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
创伤系列X线 trauma radiograph series 针对严重创伤拍摄的胸片、骨盆片与颈椎侧位片的组合 A set of chest, pelvic and lateral cervical spine radiographs taken in severe trauma. 创伤次级评估 影像科
全身CT扫描 whole-body computed tomography 一次扫描覆盖头颈、胸腹与骨盆的影像检查，用于快速排查多发伤 An imaging study covering head and neck, chest, abdomen and pelvis in one pass to screen polytrauma. 创伤次级评估 影像科
重复评估 reassessment 在处置和转运过程中反复检查伤情变化，及时发现恶化 Repeated checks of the patient during treatment and transfer to detect deterioration early. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
漏诊 missed injury 在初次评估中未被发现、后续才明确的损伤，是多发伤常见问题 An injury not found during the initial assessment and identified only later, a common issue in polytrauma. 创伤次级评估 病房
创伤性凝血病 trauma-induced coagulopathy 严重创伤后凝血功能异常、易发生难以控制出血的病理状态 A clotting disorder after severe trauma that makes bleeding hard to control. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
出血量估计 estimated blood loss 根据伤口、影像与临床表现估算失血量的方法，指导输血决策 An estimate of blood lost based on wounds, imaging and clinical signs that guides transfusion. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
长骨骨折 long bone fracture 股骨、肱骨等长管状骨的断裂，常伴明显失血与脂肪栓塞风险 A break in a long tubular bone such as the femur or humerus, often with blood loss and fat embolism risk. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
开放性创伤 open trauma 皮肤或黏膜破损、伤口与外界相通的创伤类型 Trauma in which the skin or mucosa is broken and the wound communicates with the outside. 创伤次级评估 清创室
闭合性创伤 closed trauma 皮肤完整、外力造成的深部组织或脏器损伤 Injury from external force in which the skin remains intact but deeper tissue or organs are damaged. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
穿透伤 penetrating trauma 锐器或投射物穿入体腔造成的创伤，常需手术探查 Trauma caused by a sharp object or projectile entering a body cavity, often needing surgical exploration. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
挤压伤 crush injury 重物长时间压迫肢体造成的肌肉损伤，可致横纹肌溶解 Muscle damage from prolonged compression of a limb, which can cause rhabdomyolysis. 创伤次级评估 抢救室
撕脱伤 avulsion injury 皮肤及皮下组织被外力撕扯脱离深部结构的损伤 Injury in which skin and underlying tissue are torn away from the deeper structures. 创伤次级评估 清创室
止血 hemostasis 通过压迫、填塞或手术等方式使出血停止的处理 The stopping of bleeding by pressure, packing, surgery or other means. 止血 抢救室
直接压迫 direct pressure 用手或纱布持续压住出血点使血流减慢并形成血凝块的方法 A method of pressing steadily on a bleeding point with a hand or gauze to slow flow and allow clotting. 止血 现场
指压止血 digital pressure hemostasis 用手指按压出血动脉近心端以暂时控制出血的急救手法 A first-aid technique of pressing the artery proximal to the wound with the fingers to slow bleeding. 止血 现场
止血带 tourniquet 缠绕肢体近端并加压以阻断动脉血流的止血器械 A device wrapped around a limb above the wound and tightened to block arterial flow. 止血 现场
止血带时间 tourniquet time 止血带开始使用至松解之间的时长，需记录在醒目位置 The period between application and release of a tourniquet, which must be recorded prominently. 止血 救护车
止血带松解 tourniquet release 在具备手术止血条件时逐步放松止血带的操作，需警惕再出血 The step of loosening a tourniquet once surgical hemostasis is available, watching for renewed bleeding. 止血 手术室
填塞止血 wound packing 把纱布或止血敷料紧塞入伤口深部以压迫出血血管的方法 A method of tightly packing gauze or hemostatic dressing deep into a wound to compress bleeding vessels. 止血 抢救室
止血敷料 hemostatic dressing 含促凝成分、用于难以压迫部位出血的专用敷料 A special dressing containing clotting agents for bleeding sites that are hard to compress. 止血 抢救室
电凝止血 electrocautery 用高频电流烧灼出血点使蛋白凝固而止血的手术操作 A surgical technique that uses high-frequency current to coagulate tissue and stop bleeding. 止血 手术室
血管结扎 vessel ligation 用缝线结扎出血血管两端以彻底控制出血的手术操作 A surgical procedure in which sutures are tied around a bleeding vessel to stop the flow. 止血 手术室
出血点 bleeding point 正在出血的具体血管或组织部位，是止血操作的目标 The specific vessel or tissue site that is bleeding and where hemostasis is directed. 止血 现场
喷射性出血 spurting bleeding 血液随心跳呈喷射状涌出，提示动脉损伤的出血表现 Bleeding that spurts with each heartbeat, suggesting an arterial injury. 止血 抢救室
渗血 oozing 血液从创面缓慢持续渗出，多见于毛细血管或小静脉损伤 Slow continuous seepage of blood from a wound, typical of capillary or small vein injury. 止血 换药室
静脉出血 venous bleeding 静脉破裂后血液持续暗红流出，压力较低但量大时同样危险 Steady dark red flow from a torn vein, at lower pressure but still dangerous when heavy. 止血 抢救室
动脉出血 arterial bleeding 动脉破裂后鲜红血液快速喷出，短时间可危及生命 Rapid bright red flow from a torn artery that can become life-threatening within minutes. 止血 抢救室
毛细血管出血 capillary bleeding 毛细血管损伤引起的少量渗血，多在数分钟内自行停止 Minor oozing from damaged capillaries that usually stops by itself within minutes. 止血 换药室
血肿 hematoma 血液在组织间隙积聚形成的局限性包块，可压迫周围结构 A localized collection of blood in the tissues that may compress surrounding structures. 止血 抢救室
大出血 major hemorrhage 短时间内大量失血、可迅速危及生命的出血情况 Heavy blood loss over a short period that can rapidly threaten life. 止血 抢救室
止血钳 hemostatic forceps 用于夹闭出血血管的带锁扣手术器械 A locking surgical instrument used to clamp a bleeding vessel. 止血 手术室
止血海绵 hemostatic sponge 可吸收的促凝海绵状材料，填压创面起局部止血作用 An absorbable spongy material that promotes clotting when packed against a bleeding surface. 止血 手术室
明胶海绵 gelatin sponge 由明胶制成的可吸收止血材料，常用于创面渗血与手术野 An absorbable hemostatic material made of gelatin, often used for oozing surfaces and surgical fields. 止血 手术室
氨甲环酸 tranexamic acid 抑制纤维蛋白溶解的抗纤溶药物，用于创伤早期减少失血 An antifibrinolytic drug that inhibits clot breakdown and reduces blood loss in early trauma. 止血 抢救室
止血失败 hemostasis failure 压迫或手术处理后仍无法控制出血，需要升级止血手段 Inability to control bleeding despite pressure or surgery, requiring escalation of hemostatic measures. 止血 手术室
再出血 rebleeding 出血已停止后再次发生的出血，常见于血压回升或血凝块脱落 Bleeding that restarts after it had stopped, often when blood pressure rises or a clot dislodges. 止血 病房
创伤性出血 traumatic hemorrhage 由外力损伤血管引起的出血，是创伤早期可预防死亡的主因 Bleeding caused by external force damaging blood vessels, a leading cause of preventable early trauma death. 止血 抢救室
加压包扎 pressure dressing 在伤口覆盖敷料后施加压力包扎以压迫止血的方法 A dressing applied with firm pressure over a wound to control bleeding. 加压包扎 抢救室
包扎 bandaging 用绷带或三角巾覆盖并固定伤口的操作 The act of covering and securing a wound with a bandage or triangular cloth. 加压包扎 换药室
绷带 bandage 用于缠绕固定敷料或加压的带状材料 A strip of material used to wrap, secure a dressing or apply pressure. 加压包扎 换药室
弹性绷带 elastic bandage 具有伸展性的绷带，用于加压、固定与减轻肿胀 A stretchable bandage used for compression, securing dressings and reducing swelling. 加压包扎 换药室
加压绷带 compression bandage 可施加持续压力的绷带，用于控制渗血与防止水肿 A bandage that maintains steady pressure to control oozing and prevent swelling. 加压包扎 换药室
纱布 gauze 由棉纤维织成的网状敷料，用于覆盖伤口与吸收渗液 A cotton mesh dressing used to cover wounds and absorb exudate. 加压包扎 换药室
纱布卷 gauze roll 卷状的纱布，用于填塞伤口或缠绕固定 Gauze in roll form, used for packing wounds or wrapping dressings. 加压包扎 抢救室
无菌敷料 sterile dressing 经灭菌处理、可直接覆盖开放伤口的敷料 A dressing that has been sterilized and can be applied directly to an open wound. 加压包扎 换药室
封闭敷料 occlusive dressing 能阻止空气与水分通过的敷料，用于开放性气胸等伤口 A dressing that blocks air and moisture, used for wounds such as open pneumothorax. 加压包扎 抢救室
吸收敷料 absorbent dressing 能大量吸收伤口渗液的敷料，适用于渗液多的创面 A dressing that absorbs large amounts of wound fluid, suitable for heavily exuding wounds. 加压包扎 换药室
敷料更换 dressing change 按规定时间取下旧敷料、清洁创面并覆盖新敷料的操作 The procedure of removing the old dressing, cleaning the wound and applying a new one. 加压包扎 换药室
敷料固定 dressing fixation 用胶带或绷带把敷料固定在伤口上的步骤 The step of securing a dressing over a wound with tape or a bandage. 加压包扎 换药室
敷料浸透 soaked dressing 敷料被血液或渗液完全浸湿，提示出血或渗液增多 A dressing fully saturated with blood or wound fluid, suggesting bleeding or heavy exudate. 加压包扎 病房
环形包扎 circular bandage 绷带在同一部位反复绕圈重叠的包扎方法，多用于起始固定 A bandaging method in which the bandage circles the same area repeatedly, often to start a wrap. 加压包扎 换药室
螺旋包扎 spiral bandage 绷带螺旋向上、每圈覆盖前一圈三分之一的包扎方法 A bandaging method in which each turn spirals upward and covers one third of the previous turn. 加压包扎 换药室
八字包扎 figure-of-eight bandage 绷带交叉成八字形的包扎方法，常用于关节部位固定 A bandaging method in which the bandage crosses in a figure of eight, often used around joints. 加压包扎 换药室
三角巾 triangular bandage 三角形布巾，可折叠成宽带用于悬吊或包扎 A triangular cloth that can be folded into a broad band for slings and bandaging. 加压包扎 现场
三角巾悬吊 triangular sling 用三角巾托住前臂并悬挂于颈部的临时固定方法 A temporary support made by suspending the forearm in a triangular bandage around the neck. 加压包扎 抢救室
创可贴 adhesive bandage 带粘性背衬的小型敷料，用于覆盖细小表浅伤口 A small dressing with an adhesive backing used to cover minor superficial wounds. 加压包扎 急诊诊室
医用胶带 medical tape 带粘性的胶带，用于固定敷料与引流管 Adhesive tape used to secure dressings and drainage tubes to the skin. 加压包扎 换药室
腹带 abdominal binder 缠绕腹部提供支撑与压迫的宽带，用于腹部术后或肋骨骨折 A wide band wrapped around the abdomen for support and compression after surgery or rib fracture. 加压包扎 病房
伤口渗液 wound exudate 从伤口渗出的组织液或炎性液体，量与性状反映创面情况 Fluid that seeps from a wound, whose volume and character reflect the wound bed. 加压包扎 换药室
伤口覆盖 wound coverage 用敷料遮盖并保护创面的处理步骤 The step of covering and protecting a wound with a dressing. 加压包扎 换药室
敷料 dressing 覆盖在伤口表面、起保护与吸收作用的医用材料 A medical material placed over a wound to protect it and absorb exudate. 加压包扎 换药室
骨折固定 fracture immobilization 用夹板、石膏或支具限制骨折端活动以减轻疼痛和继发损伤的处理 The use of splints, casts or braces to limit movement of fracture fragments and reduce pain and further injury. 骨折固定 抢救室
夹板 splint 置于肢体外侧、用于临时固定骨折的硬质支撑物 A rigid support placed along a limb to immobilize a fracture temporarily. 骨折固定 抢救室
石膏 cast 由石膏绷带塑形硬化后包绕肢体、提供牢固固定的外固定物 A rigid shell made from plaster bandages that hardens around a limb to hold it still. 骨折固定 石膏室
石膏固定 plaster immobilization 用石膏绷带包绕肢体使复位后的骨折保持位置的固定方法 The method of wrapping plaster bandages around a limb to hold a reduced fracture in position. 骨折固定 石膏室
石膏托 plaster splint 只在肢体一侧铺石膏形成的半管状固定物，便于观察肿胀 A half-shell plaster support applied to one side of a limb so that swelling can be observed. 骨折固定 石膏室
牵引 traction 沿肢体纵轴施加持续拉力，用于复位或维持骨折对位 A steady pull along the long axis of a limb used to reduce or hold a fracture. 骨折固定 骨科诊室
骨牵引 skeletal traction 通过穿入骨内的钢针施加牵引力，用于股骨等大骨骨折 Traction applied through a pin inserted into bone, used for fractures such as the femur. 骨折固定 骨科诊室
皮肤牵引 skin traction 用胶布或套带固定皮肤后施加牵引，力量较小且时间有限 Traction applied through tape or straps on the skin, with limited force and duration. 骨折固定 骨科诊室
骨盆固定带 pelvic binder 环绕骨盆施加环向压力、用于稳定骨盆骨折并减少出血的宽带 A wide band that encircles the pelvis to stabilize a fracture and reduce bleeding. 骨折固定 抢救室
