伤口清洗 wound irrigation 用生理盐水或清水冲洗伤口以去除细菌与异物的步骤 Washing a wound with saline or clean water to remove bacteria and debris. 清创缝合 清创室
伤口探查 wound exploration 用手指或器械检查伤口深度、走行与有无异物和肌腱损伤 Examining a wound by finger or instrument for depth, track, foreign bodies and tendon injury. 清创缝合 清创室
缝合 suturing 用缝针与缝线把伤口边缘对合连接的操作 The act of bringing wound edges together with a needle and suture. 清创缝合 清创室
单纯缝合 simple suture 直接对合皮肤伤口边缘、不涉及深部组织的缝合方式 Closure that brings the skin edges together directly without involving deeper layers. 清创缝合 清创室
间断缝合 interrupted suture 每针单独打结剪断、针间留有间隔的缝合方法 A suturing method in which each stitch is tied and cut separately with gaps between them. 清创缝合 清创室
连续缝合 continuous suture 用一根缝线连续进针、最后统一打结的缝合方法 A method in which one thread is run continuously through the wound and tied at the end. 清创缝合 清创室
褥式缝合 mattress suture 缝线两次穿过组织形成褥垫状对合的缝合方法，张力较强 A suture that passes through the tissue twice to give a mattress-like apposition with good strength. 清创缝合 清创室
皮内缝合 subcuticular suture 缝线在真皮层内走行、表面不留针眼的缝合方法，瘢痕小 A suture run within the dermis that leaves no visible skin marks and produces a small scar. 清创缝合 手术室
可吸收缝线 absorbable suture 在体内一定时间后可被降解吸收、无需拆线的缝线 A suture that is broken down and absorbed in the body and does not need removal. 清创缝合 手术室
不可吸收缝线 non-absorbable suture 在体内不被降解、需按期拆除的缝线，如丝线与尼龙线 A suture that is not broken down in the body and must be removed later, such as silk or nylon. 清创缝合 换药室
拆线 suture removal 伤口愈合到一定程度后剪断并抽出缝线的操作 The procedure of cutting and pulling out sutures once the wound has healed sufficiently. 清创缝合 换药室
局部麻醉 local anesthesia 用局麻药暂时阻断局部神经传导以消除疼痛的方法 The use of anesthetic drugs to block nerve conduction in a limited area and remove pain. 清创缝合 清创室
浸润麻醉 infiltration anesthesia 将局麻药分层注射到手术区域的麻醉方式 Anesthesia produced by injecting local anesthetic in layers into the operative area. 清创缝合 清创室
伤口感染 wound infection 细菌侵入伤口繁殖引起的红肿、渗液、化脓与疼痛加重 Bacterial invasion of a wound causing redness, discharge, pus and worsening pain. 清创缝合 换药室
伤口裂开 wound dehiscence 缝合后的伤口边缘重新分开、常与感染或张力过大有关 Separation of the edges of a sutured wound, often related to infection or excessive tension. 清创缝合 换药室
伤口愈合 wound healing 伤口经炎症、增生与塑形阶段逐步修复的过程 The process by which a wound repairs itself through inflammation, proliferation and remodeling. 清创缝合 换药室
一期缝合 primary closure 伤口清创后立即对合缝合、不留开放创面的处理 Immediate closure of a cleaned wound without leaving it open. 清创缝合 清创室
延期缝合 delayed primary closure 伤口先开放引流数日、待无感染后再行缝合的处理 Closure of a wound after several days of open drainage once infection has been excluded. 清创缝合 清创室
伤口引流 wound drainage 在伤口内放置引流物使渗液与积血排出体外的处理 Placement of a drain in a wound so that fluid and blood can escape. 清创缝合 换药室
引流条 drainage strip 置入伤口内引流渗液的条状材料，多为纱布条或硅胶条 A strip of gauze or silicone placed in a wound to drain fluid. 清创缝合 换药室
污染伤口 contaminated wound 含有细菌、泥土或异物等污染物的伤口，感染风险较高 A wound containing bacteria, dirt or foreign material with a higher risk of infection. 清创缝合 清创室
撕裂伤 laceration 钝性外力造成皮肤与软组织裂开的伤口，边缘多不整齐 A wound in which blunt force splits skin and soft tissue, often with irregular edges. 清创缝合 清创室
缝线 suture 用于缝合组织的线状材料，分可吸收与不可吸收两类 Thread material used to sew tissue, available as absorbable or non-absorbable types. 清创缝合 手术室
缝合针 suture needle 与缝线相连、用于穿刺组织的弯针或直针 A curved or straight needle attached to a suture for passing through tissue. 清创缝合 手术室
持针器 needle holder 用于夹持缝合针完成缝合的手术器械 A surgical instrument that grips the suture needle during suturing. 清创缝合 手术室
破伤风 tetanus 破伤风梭菌毒素引起的中枢神经系统疾病，表现为肌肉强直与痉挛 A disease of the nervous system caused by tetanus toxin, with muscle rigidity and spasms. 破伤风预防 急诊诊室
破伤风梭菌 Clostridium tetani 厌氧的芽孢杆菌，其毒素是破伤风发病的原因 An anaerobic spore-forming bacterium found in soil whose toxin causes tetanus. 破伤风预防 清创室
破伤风抗毒素 tetanus antitoxin 含破伤风抗体的马血清制剂，用于中和游离毒素的被动免疫 Equine antibody preparation that neutralizes free tetanus toxin as passive immunization. 破伤风预防 注射室
破伤风免疫球蛋白 tetanus immunoglobulin 由人血浆制备的破伤风抗体，用于伤口污染重的被动免疫 Human-derived tetanus antibody used for passive immunization in heavily contaminated wounds. 破伤风预防 注射室
破伤风类毒素 tetanus toxoid 经处理失去毒性但保留免疫原性的毒素，用于主动免疫 A toxin that has lost its toxicity but retains immunogenicity, used for active immunization. 破伤风预防 注射室
破伤风疫苗 tetanus vaccine 含破伤风类毒素、用于预防破伤风的疫苗 A vaccine containing tetanus toxoid that protects against tetanus infection. 破伤风预防 注射室
破伤风预防 tetanus prophylaxis 根据伤口情况与免疫史采取的疫苗与抗毒素预防措施 Preventive measures with vaccine and antitoxin based on wound type and immunization history. 破伤风预防 急诊诊室
主动免疫 active immunization 接种疫苗使机体自身产生抗体的免疫方式，保护持久 Immunization by vaccination that makes the body produce its own antibodies with long-lasting protection. 破伤风预防 注射室
被动免疫 passive immunization 直接输入抗体使机体立即获得短期保护力的免疫方式 Immunization by giving antibodies directly for immediate but temporary protection. 破伤风预防 注射室
基础免疫 primary immunization 首次按程序完成全程疫苗接种以建立基础保护力的过程 The initial full course of vaccination that builds basic protective immunity. 破伤风预防 注射室
加强免疫 booster immunization 基础免疫后再次接种以维持或提高抗体水平的免疫措施 An additional dose after primary immunization that maintains or raises antibody levels. 破伤风预防 注射室
疫苗接种史 vaccination history 患者既往接种疫苗的种类、次数与时间记录，决定是否需补种 A record of which vaccines, how many doses and when, which determines the need for further doses. 破伤风预防 急诊诊室
免疫接种记录 immunization record 记载疫苗接种时间、种类与批号的书面或电子凭证 A written or electronic record of vaccine dates, types and batch numbers. 破伤风预防 急诊诊室
伤口污染程度 wound contamination level 伤口被泥土、粪便或细菌污染的程度，决定清创与预防方案 The degree to which a wound is contaminated by dirt, feces or bacteria, guiding cleaning and prevention. 破伤风预防 清创室
清洁伤口 clean wound 无明显污染、感染风险低的伤口，可一期缝合 A wound without obvious contamination and with low infection risk that can be closed primarily. 破伤风预防 清创室
破伤风皮试 tetanus skin test 注射破伤风抗毒素前用少量药液皮内注射观察过敏反应 An intradermal test with a small dose of tetanus antitoxin to detect allergy before injection. 破伤风预防 注射室
牙关紧闭 trismus 破伤风等疾病引起咀嚼肌痉挛、张口受限的表现 Spasm of the jaw muscles that limits mouth opening, seen in tetanus and other conditions. 破伤风预防 抢救室
角弓反张 opisthotonos 破伤风发作时躯干与颈部过度后伸、身体呈弓形的痉挛表现 Severe backward arching of the trunk and neck during tetanus spasms. 破伤风预防 抢救室
苦笑面容 risus sardonicus 破伤风患者面部肌肉痉挛形成的固定苦笑表情 A fixed grin-like facial expression caused by facial muscle spasm in tetanus. 破伤风预防 抢救室
肌肉强直 muscle rigidity 肌肉持续紧张僵硬、被动活动阻力增大的表现，见于破伤风 Persistent stiffness of muscles with increased resistance to passive movement, seen in tetanus. 破伤风预防 抢救室
肌痉挛 muscle spasm 肌肉突然不自主收缩引起的疼痛与抽动，可由破伤风毒素诱发 Sudden involuntary muscle contraction causing pain and twitching, which tetanus toxin can trigger. 破伤风预防 抢救室
接种禁忌证 contraindication to vaccination 发热、严重过敏史等不宜立即接种疫苗的情况 Conditions such as fever or a history of severe allergy in which vaccination should be deferred. 破伤风预防 注射室
免疫状态评估 immune status assessment 根据接种史、年龄与基础病判断患者免疫保护水平的过程 The process of judging a patient's immune protection from vaccination history, age and comorbidity. 破伤风预防 急诊诊室
破伤风发作 tetanus onset 破伤风从潜伏期进入出现肌肉痉挛与强直的临床阶段 The stage at which tetanus moves from incubation to clinical muscle spasm and rigidity. 破伤风预防 监护室
破伤风抗体 tetanus antibody 体内针对破伤风毒素的保护性抗体，水平反映免疫保护力 Protective antibody against tetanus toxin whose level reflects immune protection. 破伤风预防 注射室
手术知情同意 informed consent for surgery 医生说明手术方案与风险后患者自愿签署同意的过程 The process in which the doctor explains the operation and its risks and the patient voluntarily agrees. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
手术同意书 surgical consent form 载明手术名称、风险与替代方案并由患者签署的书面文书 A written form listing the operation, its risks and alternatives, signed by the patient. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
术前谈话 preoperative discussion 术前医生与患者家属就病情、术式与风险进行的正式沟通 A formal preoperative conversation between the doctor and patient or family about the condition, procedure and risks. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
手术风险告知 disclosure of surgical risks 向患者说明手术可能出现的并发症与不良后果的告知义务 The duty to inform the patient of possible complications and adverse outcomes of surgery. 手术知情沟通 告知谈话
手术指征 surgical indication 根据病情判断需要手术治疗的理由与依据 The reason and evidence from the clinical picture that surgery is required. 手术知情沟通 手术室
手术禁忌证 contraindication to surgery 存在严重心肺疾病或感染等不宜立即手术的情况 A condition such as severe cardiopulmonary disease or infection in which surgery should not proceed now. 手术知情沟通 手术室
手术方案 surgical plan 术前确定的术式、入路、麻醉与围术期处理的整体安排 The overall preoperative plan covering procedure, approach, anesthesia and perioperative care. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
术式选择 choice of surgical procedure 根据病变特点与患者条件决定采用何种手术方式的决策 The decision on which operative technique to use, based on the lesion and the patient's condition. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
麻醉方式 anesthesia type 全身麻醉、椎管内麻醉或局部麻醉等麻醉方法的选择 The choice among general, regional or local anesthesia for an operation. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
全身麻醉 general anesthesia 通过药物使患者意识消失、全身无痛并控制呼吸的麻醉方式 Anesthesia that renders the patient unconscious and pain-free while breathing is supported. 手术知情沟通 手术室
区域麻醉 regional anesthesia 通过阻断某一区域神经传导使该部位无痛的麻醉方式 Anesthesia that blocks nerve conduction to a region so that area is pain-free. 手术知情沟通 手术室
麻醉风险 anesthesia risk 麻醉过程中可能出现过敏、呼吸循环抑制等不良事件的风险 The risk of adverse events during anesthesia such as allergy or cardiorespiratory depression. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
术前禁食 preoperative fasting 手术前按规定时间停止进食饮水以降低误吸风险的措施 Stopping food and drink for a set time before surgery to reduce aspiration risk. 手术知情沟通 术前等候区
术前准备 preoperative preparation 手术前完成的检查、备血、皮肤准备与文书签署等工作 The work done before surgery, including tests, blood crossmatch, skin preparation and paperwork. 手术知情沟通 术前等候区
术后护理 postoperative care 手术后对伤口、引流、疼痛与活动的观察与护理措施 The observation and nursing care of wound, drains, pain and activity after surgery. 手术知情沟通 病房
术后并发症 postoperative complication 手术后发生的出血、感染、血栓等不良事件 An adverse event after surgery such as bleeding, infection or thrombosis. 手术知情沟通 病房
手术并发症 surgical complication 手术操作直接或间接引起的不良后果 An adverse outcome caused directly or indirectly by a surgical procedure. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
二次手术 reoperation 因首次手术效果不佳或出现并发症而再次进行的手术 A further operation because the first was ineffective or a complication developed. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
急诊手术 emergency surgery 因病情危急需立即实施、不做长时间术前准备的手术 An operation performed immediately because of a critical condition, without lengthy preparation. 手术知情沟通 手术室
择期手术 elective surgery 病情允许、可安排在预定时间进行的手术 An operation that can be scheduled at a planned time because the condition allows delay. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
替代治疗方案 alternative treatment option 除拟行手术外可选择的保守或其他治疗方式 A conservative or other treatment that can be chosen instead of the proposed operation. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
手术获益 surgical benefit 手术预期带来的症状缓解、功能恢复或生存改善 The expected relief of symptoms, recovery of function or survival gain from surgery. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
手术成功率 surgical success rate 同类手术达到预期治疗目标的比例，用于术前沟通 The proportion of similar operations that achieve the expected goal, used in preoperative discussion. 手术知情沟通 谈话室
术前评估 preoperative assessment 手术前对心肺功能、化验与麻醉耐受性的综合评估 A comprehensive preoperative evaluation of cardiopulmonary function, laboratory results and anesthetic tolerance. 手术知情沟通 术前等候区
术前核查 surgical safety checklist 手术开始前对患者身份、术式与器械进行的核对流程 The checking process for patient identity, procedure and instruments before an operation starts. 手术知情沟通 手术室
胸痛 chest pain 胸部出现的疼痛或不适感，可由心脏、肺、胸壁或食管等多种原因引起 Pain or discomfort in the chest that may arise from the heart, lungs, chest wall, or esophagus. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 分诊台
心绞痛 angina pectoris 冠状动脉供血不足引起的发作性胸骨后压榨样疼痛，常由劳累或情绪激动诱发 Paroxysmal crushing retrosternal pain caused by inadequate coronary blood flow, usually triggered by exertion or emotion. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 心电室

急性心肌梗死 acute myocardial infarction 冠状动脉急性闭塞造成心肌持续缺血坏死，伴剧烈胸痛和心肌标志物升高 Acute coronary occlusion causing sustained myocardial ischemia and necrosis, with severe chest pain and raised cardiac markers. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 抢救室

ST段抬高型心肌梗死 ST-elevation myocardial infarction 心电图相邻导联ST段抬高的心肌梗死类型，需尽快开通闭塞的血管 A myocardial infarction type with ST-segment elevation in contiguous leads that needs urgent reopening of the blocked vessel. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 抢救室

非ST段抬高型心肌梗死 non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction 心电图无ST段抬高但肌钙蛋白升高的心肌梗死，按风险分层决定干预时机 Myocardial infarction without ST elevation but with raised troponin, in which risk stratification guides the timing of intervention. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 观察室

急性冠脉综合征 acute coronary syndrome 冠状动脉斑块破裂或侵蚀引起的一组急性心肌缺血综合征，含不稳定型心绞痛和心肌梗死 A group of acute myocardial ischemia syndromes caused by plaque rupture or erosion, including unstable angina and myocardial infarction. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 抢救室
心电图 electrocardiogram 记录心脏电活动的无创检查，用于诊断心律失常和心肌缺血 A non-invasive test that records the electrical activity of the heart to diagnose arrhythmia and myocardial ischemia. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 心电室
肌钙蛋白 troponin 心肌损伤后释放入血的特异性蛋白，是判断心肌梗死的核心指标 A protein released into the blood after myocardial injury and the key marker for diagnosing myocardial infarction. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 检验科

冠状动脉造影 coronary angiography 经导管注入对比剂显示冠状动脉狭窄或闭塞部位的检查，也可同期治疗 A catheter-based contrast study that shows where coronary arteries are narrowed or blocked and allows treatment in the same session. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 导管室

zh: 经皮冠状动脉介入治疗
text: 经皮冠状动脉介入治疗 percutaneous coronary intervention 经导管开通狭窄或闭塞冠状动脉的治疗方法，包括球囊扩张和支架植入 A catheter-based treatment that reopens narrowed or blocked coronary arteries using balloon dilation and stenting. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 导管室
溶栓治疗 thrombolytic therapy 用药物溶解冠状动脉内新鲜血栓、恢复血流的急救方法，须严格掌握时间窗 An emergency treatment that dissolves fresh coronary thrombus with drugs to restore blood flow within a strict time window. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 抢救室
阿司匹林 aspirin 抗血小板药物，疑诊急性冠脉综合征时尽早嚼服以抑制血栓形成 An antiplatelet drug chewed early in suspected acute coronary syndrome to limit thrombus formation. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 抢救室
硝酸甘油 nitroglycerin 舌下含服的血管扩张药，用于缓解心绞痛，低血压患者禁用 A sublingual vasodilator used to relieve angina and avoided in patients with low blood pressure. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 抢救室
主动脉夹层 aortic dissection 主动脉内膜撕裂使血液进入血管壁中层，表现为突发撕裂样胸背痛 A tear in the aortic intima that lets blood enter the media, causing sudden tearing chest and back pain. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 CT室
肺栓塞 pulmonary embolism 血栓阻塞肺动脉引起的急症，常见突发呼吸困难、胸痛和低氧 A blockage of pulmonary arteries by thrombus causing sudden dyspnea, chest pain, and low oxygen. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 CT室
心包炎 pericarditis 心包膜的炎症，典型表现为胸痛随呼吸加重、坐位前倾减轻 Inflammation of the pericardium that typically causes chest pain worse on breathing and eased by sitting forward. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 心电室
心包积液 pericardial effusion 心包腔内液体异常积聚，可由炎症、肿瘤或尿毒症引起 Abnormal accumulation of fluid in the pericardial sac caused by inflammation, tumor, or uremia. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 超声室
急性胸痛 acute chest pain 新近发生的胸部疼痛，需在十分钟内评估以排除致命性病因 Recent-onset chest pain that must be assessed within ten minutes to exclude lethal causes. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 分诊台
放射痛 radiating pain 疼痛从原发部位沿神经向其他部位扩散的现象，如心绞痛放射至左肩 Pain that spreads from its origin along a nerve to another area, as angina radiates to the left shoulder. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 分诊台
压榨性胸痛 crushing chest pain 被患者描述为胸部被重物压住的疼痛性质，高度提示心肌缺血 Chest pain described as a heavy weight pressing on the chest, which strongly suggests myocardial ischemia. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 分诊台
心肌缺血 myocardial ischemia 心肌供血不足导致氧供需失衡的状态，可引起胸痛和心电图改变 A state in which blood supply to the heart muscle cannot meet oxygen demand, causing chest pain and ECG changes. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 心电室
冠状动脉痉挛 coronary artery spasm 冠状动脉平滑肌一过性收缩使管腔狭窄，引起静息性胸痛的机制 Transient contraction of coronary smooth muscle that narrows the artery and causes resting chest pain. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 心电室
心源性休克 cardiogenic shock 心脏泵功能严重衰竭导致组织灌注不足的休克类型，多继发于大面积心梗 Shock from severe pump failure of the heart that leaves tissues underperfused, usually after a large myocardial infarction. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 抢救室
不稳定型心绞痛 unstable angina 介于稳定心绞痛与心肌梗死之间的急性冠脉综合征，静息时也可发作 An acute coronary syndrome between stable angina and myocardial infarction that may occur at rest. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 观察室
心前区不适 precordial discomfort 患者对胸前区闷、紧、压迫等难以描述感觉的统称，需警惕心肌缺血 A vague sense of tightness or pressure over the front of the chest that may still reflect myocardial ischemia. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 分诊台
危险分层 risk stratification 按年龄、心电图、标志物等把患者分成不同风险等级以决定处置 Sorting patients into risk levels by age, ECG, and biomarkers to decide the intensity of care. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 观察室
双联抗血小板治疗 dual antiplatelet therapy 同时使用两种抗血小板药物预防支架内血栓，常用于介入术后 Use of two antiplatelet drugs together to prevent stent thrombosis, common after coronary intervention. 胸痛与急性冠脉综合征 心内科

zh: 房室结折返性心动过速
text: 房室结折返性心动过速 atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia 房室结内双径路形成折返导致的规则窄QRS波心动过速 A regular narrow-complex tachycardia caused by reentry through dual pathways within the atrioventricular node. 心律失常 心电室
心房颤动 atrial fibrillation 心房无序快速颤动、心室率不规则的常见心律失常，易形成血栓 A common arrhythmia with chaotic atrial activity and an irregular ventricular rate that predisposes to thrombus. 心律失常 心电室
心房扑动 atrial flutter 心房内大折返导致规则锯齿状心房波的快速心律失常 A rapid arrhythmia caused by a large reentrant circuit in the atrium that produces regular sawtooth atrial waves. 心律失常 心电室
室性心动过速 ventricular tachycardia 起源于心室、心率快且QRS波宽大的心律失常，可演变为室颤 A rapid wide-complex arrhythmia arising in the ventricles that can degenerate into ventricular fibrillation. 心律失常 抢救室
尖端扭转型室速 torsades de pointes QRS波尖端围绕基线扭转的多形性室速，常与QT间期延长相关 A polymorphic ventricular tachycardia whose QRS complexes twist around the baseline, often linked to QT prolongation. 心律失常 抢救室
室上性心动过速 supraventricular tachycardia 起源于心室以上的快速规则心律失常，常见突发突止的心悸 A rapid regular arrhythmia originating above the ventricles that often starts and stops abruptly with palpitations. 心律失常 抢救室
窦性心动过缓 sinus bradycardia 窦房结发放冲动过慢使心率低于每分钟六十次的心律 A rhythm in which the sinus node fires too slowly and the heart rate falls below sixty beats per minute. 心律失常 心电室
窦性心动过速 sinus tachycardia 窦房结发放冲动过快使心率超过每分钟一百次的心律，常继发于发热或失血 A sinus rhythm faster than one hundred beats per minute, often secondary to fever or blood loss. 心律失常 心电室
室性期前收缩 premature ventricular contraction 心室异位起搏点提前发放冲动形成的心搏，偶发者多无临床意义 A beat from an ectopic ventricular focus that fires early and is usually harmless when infrequent. 心律失常 心电室
房性期前收缩 premature atrial contraction 心房异位起搏点提前发放冲动形成的心搏，常见于疲劳和咖啡因摄入 An early beat from an ectopic atrial focus, often linked to fatigue and caffeine intake. 心律失常 心电室
房室传导阻滞 atrioventricular block 心房冲动向心室传导延迟或中断的心律失常，分三度 An arrhythmia in which atrial impulses are delayed or blocked on the way to the ventricles, graded in three degrees. 心律失常 心电室
病态窦房结综合征 sick sinus syndrome 窦房结功能减退导致严重心动过缓或长间歇，常伴晕厥 A decline in sinus node function that causes severe bradycardia or long pauses, often with syncope. 心律失常 心电室
预激综合征 pre-excitation syndrome 存在异常房室旁路使心室提前激动的先天心律异常，可诱发快速心律失常 A congenital accessory pathway that pre-excites the ventricle and can trigger rapid arrhythmias. 心律失常 心电室
电复律 electrical cardioversion 用同步电击使快速心律失常恢复窦性心律的治疗方法 A treatment that delivers a synchronized shock to restore sinus rhythm in a rapid arrhythmia. 心律失常 抢救室
抗心律失常药物 antiarrhythmic drug 用于终止或预防异常心律的药物，按电生理机制分为四类 A drug used to stop or prevent abnormal heart rhythms, grouped into four classes by electrophysiological action. 心律失常 抢救室
动态心电图 Holter monitoring 连续记录二十四小时心电活动的检查，用于捕捉发作性心律失常 A test that records the heart rhythm continuously for twenty four hours to capture intermittent arrhythmias. 心律失常 心电室
射频消融 radiofrequency ablation 用高频电流毁损异常传导通路或病灶以根治某些心律失常的介入治疗 A catheter procedure that destroys abnormal conduction pathways or foci with high-frequency current to cure some arrhythmias. 心律失常 导管室
人工心脏起搏器 pacemaker 植入体内发放电脉冲维持合适心率的装置，用于严重心动过缓 A device implanted to deliver electrical impulses and keep an adequate heart rate in severe bradycardia. 心律失常 导管室

zh: 植入式心律转复除颤器
text: 植入式心律转复除颤器 implantable cardioverter-defibrillator 能自动识别并电击终止致命性室性心律失常的植入装置 An implanted device that detects and shocks lethal ventricular arrhythmias automatically. 心律失常 导管室
QT间期 QT interval 心电图从QRS波起点到T波终点的时限，延长易致恶性心律失常 The time from the start of the QRS complex to the end of the T wave, whose prolongation predisposes to malignant arrhythmia. 心律失常 心电室
左束支传导阻滞 left bundle branch block 左束支传导中断使心室除极延迟，QRS波增宽呈特定形态 Interruption of left bundle conduction that delays ventricular depolarization and widens the QRS in a characteristic pattern. 心律失常 心电室
心悸 palpitation 患者自觉心跳过快、过重或不规则的主观感受，需区分有无器质性病因 The subjective awareness of a fast, forceful, or irregular heartbeat, which must be assessed for an organic cause. 心律失常 分诊台
长QT综合征 long QT syndrome 心电图QT间期延长、易发生尖端扭转型室速的遗传性心律失常 An inherited arrhythmia with a prolonged QT interval on the ECG and a risk of torsades de pointes. 心律失常 心电室
阿斯综合征 Adams-Stokes syndrome 严重心动过缓或长间歇导致脑供血骤减而突发晕厥的临床综合征 A clinical syndrome of sudden syncope from a brief drop in cerebral blood flow due to severe bradycardia or pauses. 心律失常 抢救室
心脏再同步治疗 cardiac resynchronization therapy 对心衰伴束支阻滞者植入起搏装置使双心室同步收缩的治疗 Implanting a pacing device so that both ventricles contract together in heart failure with bundle branch block. 心律失常 导管室
迷走神经刺激 vagal maneuver 通过屏气用力或按压颈动脉窦等动作增强迷走张力以终止室上速的方法 A method that boosts vagal tone by breath holding and straining or carotid pressure to stop supraventricular tachycardia. 心律失常 抢救室
室性心律失常 ventricular arrhythmia 起源于心室的各类异常心律，包括室早、室速和室颤 Any abnormal rhythm arising in the ventricles, including premature beats, tachycardia, and fibrillation. 心律失常 抢救室
脑卒中 stroke 脑血管突然阻塞或破裂造成脑组织损伤的急症，表现为偏瘫、失语等 A sudden cerebrovascular blockage or rupture that damages brain tissue and causes hemiplegia, aphasia, and other deficits. 脑卒中 抢救室
缺血性脑卒中 ischemic stroke 脑血管被血栓阻塞导致局部脑组织缺血坏死的卒中类型，占多数 A stroke type in which thrombus blocks a cerebral vessel and causes ischemic necrosis of brain tissue, the majority of cases. 脑卒中 抢救室
出血性脑卒中 hemorrhagic stroke 脑血管破裂出血进入脑实质或蛛网膜下腔的卒中类型，禁用溶栓 A stroke type in which a ruptured vessel bleeds into brain tissue or the subarachnoid space, in which thrombolysis is contraindicated. 脑卒中 CT室
短暂性脑缺血发作 transient ischemic attack 脑局部缺血引起的短暂神经功能缺失，多在二十四小时内完全恢复 A brief focal neurological deficit from temporary cerebral ischemia that usually resolves fully within twenty four hours. 脑卒中 观察室
脑出血 intracerebral hemorrhage 脑实质内血管破裂出血形成血肿，常由高血压引起 Bleeding from a vessel within the brain parenchyma that forms a hematoma, often caused by hypertension. 脑卒中 CT室
脑静脉窦血栓形成 cerebral venous sinus thrombosis 颅内静脉窦血栓形成导致静脉回流受阻和脑水肿的疾病 Thrombosis of the intracranial venous sinuses that obstructs venous drainage and causes brain edema. 脑卒中 CT室
脑梗死 cerebral infarction 脑组织因缺血发生坏死的病理结果，影像上呈低密度灶 Necrosis of brain tissue caused by ischemia and seen as a low-density lesion on imaging. 脑卒中 CT室
溶栓时间窗 thrombolytic time window 从发病到可以安全实施静脉溶栓的最长时间限制，通常为四点五小时 The maximum interval from symptom onset within which intravenous thrombolysis can be given safely, usually four and a half hours. 脑卒中 抢救室
静脉溶栓 intravenous thrombolysis 经静脉给予溶栓药物开通闭塞脑血管的治疗，须在时间窗内完成 Treatment that gives clot-dissolving drug by vein to reopen a blocked cerebral artery within the time window. 脑卒中 抢救室
机械取栓 mechanical thrombectomy 用导管器械从脑血管内取出栓子开通血管的介入治疗，适用于大血管闭塞 A catheter procedure that removes a clot from a cerebral artery and is used for large-vessel occlusion. 脑卒中 导管室
脑栓塞 cerebral embolism 心脏或大血管的栓子脱落堵塞脑血管导致的脑梗死 Brain infarction caused by an embolus from the heart or great vessels lodging in a cerebral artery. 脑卒中 抢救室
卒中单元 stroke unit 专门收治卒中患者并配有多学科团队的病房单元，可降低死亡和残疾 A ward dedicated to stroke patients with a multidisciplinary team that lowers death and disability. 脑卒中 病房
面瘫 facial palsy 面神经受损造成一侧面部肌肉瘫痪，表现为口角歪斜和闭眼不全 Paralysis of muscles on one side of the face from facial nerve damage, with a drooping mouth and incomplete eye closure. 脑卒中 抢救室
偏瘫 hemiplegia 一侧上下肢及面部肌肉的瘫痪，多由对侧大脑运动区损伤引起 Paralysis of the upper and lower limbs and face on one side, usually from damage to the opposite motor cortex. 脑卒中 抢救室
失语症 aphasia 大脑语言中枢受损导致理解和表达语言能力障碍，意识多清醒 Impaired ability to understand or produce language from damage to language areas, usually with preserved consciousness. 脑卒中 抢救室
构音障碍 dysarthria 发音器官肌肉控制异常导致说话含糊不清，语言内容本身正常 Unclear speech caused by poor muscular control of the articulators, with language content itself intact. 脑卒中 抢救室
吞咽困难 dysphagia 吞咽过程受阻或肌肉协调不良，卒中后易导致误吸和肺炎 Difficulty moving food through the swallowing process and, after stroke, a common cause of aspiration and pneumonia. 脑卒中 病房
雷击样头痛 thunderclap headache 数秒内达到顶峰的剧烈头痛，需警惕蛛网膜下腔出血 A severe headache that peaks within seconds and should raise concern for subarachnoid hemorrhage. 脑卒中 分诊台
缺血半暗带 ischemic penumbra 梗死核心周围血流减少但尚未坏死的脑组织，及时再灌注可挽救 Brain tissue around the infarct core that is underperfused but not yet dead and can be saved by timely reperfusion. 脑卒中 CT室
颈动脉狭窄 carotid stenosis 颈动脉内膜斑块使管腔变窄，是缺血性卒中的重要原因 Narrowing of the carotid artery by plaque and an important cause of ischemic stroke. 脑卒中 超声室
卒中后癫痫 post-stroke epilepsy 卒中后脑血管病变继发的反复癫痫发作 Recurrent seizures secondary to the brain lesion caused by stroke. 脑卒中 病房
阿替普酶 alteplase 重组组织型纤溶酶原激活剂，用于急性缺血性卒中和心梗的溶栓治疗 A recombinant tissue plasminogen activator used for thrombolysis in acute ischemic stroke and myocardial infarction. 脑卒中 抢救室
出血转化 hemorrhagic transformation 缺血性梗死的脑组织内继发渗血或血肿，是溶栓后的重要并发症 Bleeding into infarcted brain tissue that is an important complication after thrombolysis. 脑卒中 CT室
血管内治疗 endovascular therapy 经血管内导管完成的介入治疗，包括取栓、栓塞和支架置入 Catheter-based treatment performed inside blood vessels, including thrombectomy, embolization, and stenting. 脑卒中 导管室
抗血小板治疗 antiplatelet therapy 用药物抑制血小板聚集以预防血栓形成，用于缺血性卒中二级预防 Drug treatment that inhibits platelet aggregation to prevent thrombus, used in secondary prevention of ischemic stroke. 脑卒中 病房
脑血流灌注 cerebral perfusion 单位时间内流经脑组织的血流量，决定脑细胞能否获得足够氧和营养 Blood flow through brain tissue per unit time, which determines whether brain cells receive enough oxygen and nutrients. 脑卒中 抢救室
改良Rankin量表 modified Rankin Scale 评估卒中后神经功能残疾程度的七级量表，分数越高残疾越重 A seven-point scale that grades disability after stroke, with higher scores meaning worse disability. 脑卒中 病房
呼吸困难 dyspnea 患者自觉呼吸费力或气不够用的不适感，是急诊最常见的呼吸系统主诉 The uncomfortable awareness of difficult or insufficient breathing, the most common respiratory complaint in the emergency department. 呼吸困难与哮喘 分诊台
支气管哮喘 bronchial asthma 气道慢性炎症导致可逆性气流受限的疾病，发作时喘息和胸闷 A disease of chronic airway inflammation causing reversible airflow limitation with wheezing and chest tightness during attacks. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
哮喘急性发作 acute asthma attack 哮喘症状在短时间内迅速加重、常规药物难以缓解的状态 Rapid worsening of asthma symptoms over a short time that does not respond to usual reliever medication. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
喘息 wheezing 气流通过狭窄气道产生的连续性高调呼吸音，呼气相明显 A continuous high-pitched breath sound produced by airflow through narrowed airways, most obvious on expiration. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
端坐呼吸 orthopnea 平卧时呼吸困难加重、必须坐起才能缓解的表现，提示心衰或肺水肿 Breathlessness that worsens when lying flat and forces the patient to sit up, suggesting heart failure or pulmonary edema. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
夜间阵发性呼吸困难 paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea 入睡后突然憋醒、需坐起才缓解的呼吸困难，是左心衰的典型表现 Sudden breathlessness that wakes the patient from sleep and eases on sitting up, typical of left heart failure. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
慢性阻塞性肺疾病 chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 以持续气流受限为特征的常见慢性呼吸病，多与吸烟相关 A common chronic lung disease marked by persistent airflow limitation and usually linked to smoking. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室

zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重
text: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重 acute exacerbation of COPD 慢阻肺患者在短期内症状加重超出日常波动的状态，需升级治疗 A short-term worsening of symptoms beyond normal day-to-day variation in COPD that requires intensified treatment. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
呼吸衰竭 respiratory failure 肺通气或换气功能严重障碍导致低氧或伴高碳酸血症的状态 Severe impairment of ventilation or gas exchange that causes hypoxemia, with or without hypercapnia. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
急性呼吸窘迫综合征 acute respiratory distress syndrome 各种病因引起肺毛细血管通透性增加、顽固低氧的急性弥漫性肺损伤 Acute diffuse lung injury with leaky pulmonary capillaries and refractory hypoxemia caused by various insults. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
低氧血症 hypoxemia 动脉血氧分压低于正常水平的病理状态，可由通气或换气障碍引起 An arterial oxygen partial pressure below the normal range that can result from ventilatory or gas exchange problems. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
高碳酸血症 hypercapnia 动脉血二氧化碳分压高于正常范围的状态，常见于通气不足 An arterial carbon dioxide partial pressure above the normal range, usually from inadequate ventilation. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
支气管扩张剂 bronchodilator 松弛气道平滑肌、缓解支气管痉挛的药物，包括β受体激动剂和抗胆碱药 A drug that relaxes airway smooth muscle and relieves bronchospasm, including beta agonists and anticholinergics. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
沙丁胺醇 salbutamol 短效β2受体激动剂，雾化吸入可迅速缓解哮喘和支气管痉挛 A short-acting beta-2 agonist that rapidly relieves asthma and bronchospasm when nebulized. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
糖皮质激素 glucocorticoid 具有强大抗炎和免疫抑制作用的激素，用于重症哮喘和过敏反应 A hormone with strong anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressive effects used in severe asthma and allergic reactions. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
吸入性糖皮质激素 inhaled corticosteroid 经口吸入作用于气道局部的糖皮质激素，用于哮喘长期控制 A corticosteroid inhaled to act locally in the airways and used for long-term asthma control. 呼吸困难与哮喘 门诊
峰流速 peak expiratory flow 用力呼气时的最大流速，反映气道通畅程度和哮喘控制水平 The maximum speed of a forced expiration, reflecting airway patency and the level of asthma control. 呼吸困难与哮喘 观察室
血气分析 arterial blood gas 测定动脉血氧、二氧化碳和酸碱指标的检查，评估通气与氧合 A test of arterial oxygen, carbon dioxide, and acid-base values that assesses ventilation and oxygenation. 呼吸困难与哮喘 检验科
二氧化碳潴留 carbon dioxide retention 通气不足使体内二氧化碳排出受阻而蓄积，可抑制意识 Accumulation of carbon dioxide because inadequate ventilation prevents its clearance, which can depress consciousness. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
三凹征 suprasternal retraction 吸气时胸骨上窝、锁骨上窝和肋间隙凹陷，提示上气道梗阻 Inward pulling of the suprasternal, supraclavicular, and intercostal spaces on inspiration, indicating upper airway obstruction. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
肺水肿 pulmonary edema 液体渗入肺泡和肺间质导致氧合障碍，常见于急性左心衰 Fluid leaking into the alveoli and lung interstitium that impairs oxygenation, common in acute left heart failure. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
肺性脑病 pulmonary encephalopathy 严重呼吸衰竭导致二氧化碳潴留和缺氧引起的中枢神经障碍 Central nervous dysfunction caused by carbon dioxide retention and hypoxia in severe respiratory failure. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
呼吸肌疲劳 respiratory muscle fatigue 长时间呼吸做功增加使呼吸肌力量下降、通气不足的状态 A state in which prolonged increased work of breathing weakens the respiratory muscles and leads to hypoventilation. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
呼吸窘迫 respiratory distress 患者主观感到呼吸极度费力并伴有相应体征的临床状态 A clinical state of extreme subjective breathing effort accompanied by corresponding physical signs. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
支气管舒张试验 bronchodilator reversibility test 吸入支气管扩张剂后复查肺功能，看气流受限是否可逆 A lung function test repeated after a bronchodilator to see whether airflow limitation is reversible. 呼吸困难与哮喘 肺功能室
咯血 hemoptysis 喉以下呼吸道出血经口咳出，需与呕血仔细区分 Bleeding from the respiratory tract below the larynx that is coughed out and must be distinguished from hematemesis. 呼吸困难与哮喘 分诊台
茶碱 theophylline 支气管扩张药，治疗窗窄，过量易引起心律失常和抽搐 A bronchodilator with a narrow therapeutic window that can cause arrhythmia and seizures when excessive. 呼吸困难与哮喘 抢救室
腹痛 abdominal pain 腹部任何部位出现的疼痛，是急诊最常见的主诉之一，需按部位和性质分析 Pain anywhere in the abdomen, one of the most common emergency complaints, analysed by site and character. 腹痛与急腹症 分诊台
急腹症 acute abdomen 需要紧急外科评估的腹部急症统称，常表现为剧烈腹痛和腹膜刺激征 An umbrella term for abdominal emergencies needing urgent surgical assessment, often with severe pain and peritoneal signs. 腹痛与急腹症 抢救室
急性阑尾炎 acute appendicitis 阑尾腔阻塞继发感染引起的急性炎症，典型为转移性右下腹痛 Acute inflammation of the appendix after luminal obstruction, classically with migratory right lower quadrant pain. 腹痛与急腹症 CT室
急性胰腺炎 acute pancreatitis 胰酶异常激活导致胰腺自身消化的急性炎症，典型为上腹剧痛向背部放射 Acute inflammation from premature activation of pancreatic enzymes, classically severe epigastric pain radiating to the back. 腹痛与急腹症 抢救室
急性胆囊炎 acute cholecystitis 胆囊管阻塞合并感染引起的急性炎症，表现为右上腹痛和发热 Acute inflammation from cystic duct obstruction with infection, causing right upper quadrant pain and fever. 腹痛与急腹症 CT室
胆石症 cholelithiasis 胆囊或胆管内形成结石的疾病，可无症状或引起胆绞痛 Stones in the gallbladder or bile ducts that may be silent or cause biliary colic. 腹痛与急腹症 超声室
肠梗阻 intestinal obstruction 肠内容物通过障碍，表现为腹痛、呕吐、腹胀和停止排便排气 Blockage of the passage of intestinal contents, with pain, vomiting, distension, and no flatus or stool. 腹痛与急腹症 抢救室
胃肠穿孔 gastrointestinal perforation 胃肠道壁全层破裂使内容物进入腹腔，引起急性腹膜炎 A full-thickness rupture of the gut wall that spills contents into the abdomen and causes acute peritonitis. 腹痛与急腹症 CT室
结肠憩室炎 acute diverticulitis 结肠憩室继发感染引起的局部炎症，表现为左下腹痛和发热 Local inflammation from infection of a colonic diverticulum, with left lower quadrant pain and fever. 腹痛与急腹症 CT室
肠系膜缺血 mesenteric ischemia 肠系膜血管闭塞或低灌注导致肠管缺血，疼痛剧烈而体征轻微 Ischemia of the bowel from blocked or underperfused mesenteric vessels, with severe pain but few physical signs. 腹痛与急腹症 CT室
肾绞痛 renal colic 结石阻塞输尿管引起剧烈腰部绞痛并向会阴放射，常伴血尿 Severe flank colic radiating to the groin from a stone obstructing the ureter, often with blood in the urine. 腹痛与急腹症 抢救室
输尿管结石 ureteral calculus 位于输尿管的结石，可引起肾绞痛、血尿和梗阻性肾积水 A stone lodged in the ureter that can cause renal colic, blood in the urine, and obstructive hydronephrosis. 腹痛与急腹症 CT室
消化性溃疡 peptic ulcer 胃或十二指肠黏膜被胃酸和胃蛋白酶侵蚀形成的溃疡，可并发出血 An ulcer of gastric or duodenal mucosa eroded by acid and pepsin that may bleed. 腹痛与急腹症 内镜室

胃食管反流病 gastroesophageal reflux disease 胃内容物反流入食管引起烧心等症状的疾病，可误为胸痛 A disease in which stomach contents reflux into the esophagus and cause heartburn and chest pain that may mimic cardiac pain. 腹痛与急腹症 门诊
腹腔积液 ascites 腹腔内异常积聚的液体，可由肝病、肿瘤或感染引起 Abnormal fluid accumulation in the abdominal cavity caused by liver disease, tumor, or infection. 腹痛与急腹症 超声室
腹部超声 abdominal ultrasonography 用超声检查腹腔脏器形态和积液的床旁影像手段，无辐射 Bedside imaging of abdominal organs and fluid using ultrasound, with no radiation exposure. 腹痛与急腹症 超声室
抑酸治疗 acid suppression 用药物减少胃酸分泌以促进黏膜愈合和止血的治疗 Treatment that reduces gastric acid secretion to help mucosal healing and stop bleeding. 腹痛与急腹症 病房
急性胃扩张 acute gastric dilatation 胃内大量内容物潴留使胃壁过度扩张的急症 An emergency in which retained gastric contents overdistend the stomach. 腹痛与急腹症 抢救室
生长抑素 somatostatin 抑制多种胃肠激素分泌的药物，用于急性胰腺炎和食管静脉出血 A drug that inhibits secretion of several gut hormones, used in acute pancreatitis and variceal bleeding. 腹痛与急腹症 抢救室
质子泵抑制剂 proton pump inhibitor 抑制胃壁细胞分泌胃酸最强的药物类别，用于溃疡和消化道出血 The most potent class of drugs suppressing acid secretion by gastric parietal cells, used in ulcers and gastrointestinal bleeding. 腹痛与急腹症 抢救室
胆管炎 cholangitis 胆道梗阻合并细菌感染引起的炎症，典型为腹痛、发热和黄疸 Inflammation from biliary obstruction with bacterial infection, classically with pain, fever, and jaundice. 腹痛与急腹症 CT室
胰腺假性囊肿 pancreatic pseudocyst 急性胰腺炎后胰液积聚被纤维组织包裹形成的囊性结构 A fluid collection after acute pancreatitis enclosed by fibrous tissue. 腹痛与急腹症 CT室
功能性消化不良 functional dyspepsia 无器质性病变但有餐后饱胀、早饱或上腹痛的消化不良综合征 A dyspepsia syndrome with postprandial fullness, early satiety, or epigastric pain but no organic disease. 腹痛与急腹症 门诊
慢性腹痛 chronic abdominal pain 持续时间超过数周、病因多样的腹部疼痛，需系统排查 Abdominal pain lasting more than several weeks with varied causes that requires systematic evaluation. 腹痛与急腹症 门诊
急性胃黏膜病变 acute gastric mucosal lesion 应激或药物引起的胃黏膜急性糜烂出血，常表现为呕血黑便 Acute erosion and bleeding of the gastric mucosa caused by stress or drugs, often with hematemesis or melena. 腹痛与急腹症 内镜室
幽门螺杆菌 Helicobacter pylori 定植于胃黏膜的螺旋形细菌，是消化性溃疡和胃炎的重要病因 A spiral bacterium colonizing the gastric mucosa and a major cause of peptic ulcer and gastritis. 腹痛与急腹症 门诊
麻痹性肠梗阻 paralytic ileus 肠管蠕动功能丧失导致内容物停滞，腹胀明显而腹痛较轻 Loss of bowel motility that halts the passage of contents, with marked distension but milder pain. 腹痛与急腹症 病房
消化道出血 gastrointestinal bleeding 从食管到肛门的消化道任何部位出血，表现为呕血、黑便或便血 Bleeding anywhere from the esophagus to the anus, presenting as hematemesis, melena, or hematochezia. 消化道出血 抢救室
上消化道出血 upper gastrointestinal bleeding 屈氏韧带以上部位出血，常见呕血和黑便 Bleeding above the ligament of Treitz that usually causes hematemesis and melena. 消化道出血 抢救室
下消化道出血 lower gastrointestinal bleeding 屈氏韧带以下部位出血，多表现为便血 Bleeding below the ligament of Treitz that usually presents as hematochezia. 消化道出血 抢救室
呕血 hematemesis 上消化道出血经口呕出，可呈鲜红色或咖啡样 Vomiting of blood from upper gastrointestinal bleeding, either fresh red or coffee-ground. 消化道出血 抢救室
黑便 melena 上消化道出血后血液经肠道消化形成的黑色柏油样便 Black tarry stool formed when blood from upper gastrointestinal bleeding is digested in the bowel. 消化道出血 分诊台
便血 hematochezia 经肛门排出鲜红色或暗红色血液，多来自下消化道 Passage of bright or dark red blood from the anus, usually from the lower gastrointestinal tract. 消化道出血 分诊台
隐血试验 fecal occult blood test 检测粪便中肉眼不可见血液的筛查方法 A screening test that detects blood in stool that is invisible to the eye. 消化道出血 检验科
食管胃底静脉曲张 esophageal varices 门静脉高压使食管和胃底静脉扩张迂曲，破裂可大出血 Dilated tortuous veins in the esophagus and gastric fundus from portal hypertension that can bleed massively if they rupture. 消化道出血 内镜室
消化性溃疡出血 bleeding peptic ulcer 消化性溃疡侵蚀血管造成的出血，是上消化道出血最常见原因 Bleeding from a peptic ulcer that erodes a vessel and the most common cause of upper gastrointestinal bleeding. 消化道出血 内镜室

zh: 食管静脉曲张破裂出血
text: 食管静脉曲张破裂出血 variceal bleeding 曲张静脉破裂引起的大出血，病死率高，需药物加内镜治疗 Massive bleeding from ruptured varices with high mortality that needs drugs plus endoscopic treatment. 消化道出血 抢救室
内镜检查 endoscopy 经口腔或肛门插入内镜观察消化道内部并可行治疗的检查 Examination of the inside of the digestive tract with an inserted scope, which also allows treatment. 消化道出血 内镜室
急诊内镜 emergency endoscopy 在出血后二十四小时内尽快实施的胃镜检查与治疗 Gastroscopy performed and treatment given within twenty four hours of bleeding. 消化道出血 内镜室
内镜下止血 endoscopic hemostasis 经内镜用钛夹、注射或热凝等方法止住消化道出血 Stopping gastrointestinal bleeding through the scope with clips, injection, or thermal coagulation. 消化道出血 内镜室
输血 blood transfusion 把全血或成分血输入患者体内以纠正贫血和血容量不足 Giving whole blood or blood components to correct anemia and low circulating volume. 消化道出血 抢救室
贫血 anemia 血红蛋白低于正常范围的状态，急性失血时早期可能不明显 A hemoglobin level below the normal range, which may be misleading early in acute blood loss. 消化道出血 检验科
门静脉高压 portal hypertension 门静脉系统压力升高，常由肝硬化引起，可致静脉曲张和腹水 Raised pressure in the portal venous system, usually from cirrhosis, causing varices and ascites. 消化道出血 超声室
肝硬化 liver cirrhosis 慢性肝损伤导致纤维化和假小叶形成的终末期肝病 End-stage liver disease with fibrosis and regenerative nodules from chronic injury. 消化道出血 病房
门脉高压性胃病 portal hypertensive gastropathy 门静脉高压使胃黏膜血管扩张充血，可引起慢性渗血 Dilated engorged gastric mucosal vessels from portal hypertension that can ooze blood chronically. 消化道出血 内镜室
奥曲肽 octreotide 生长抑素类似物，用于控制食管静脉曲张出血 A somatostatin analogue used to control bleeding from esophageal varices. 消化道出血 抢救室
套扎治疗 band ligation 用橡皮圈结扎曲张静脉使其坏死脱落的内镜治疗方法 An endoscopic method that ties rubber bands around varices so they necrose and slough. 消化道出血 内镜室
硬化治疗 sclerotherapy 向曲张静脉内注射硬化剂使其血栓化闭塞的内镜治疗 Endoscopic treatment that injects a sclerosing agent into varices to thrombose and obliterate them. 消化道出血 内镜室
三腔二囊管 Sengstaken-Blakemore tube 带胃囊和食管囊的导管，压迫止血用于难控的食管胃底静脉出血 A tube with gastric and esophageal balloons used to tamponade uncontrolled variceal bleeding. 消化道出血 抢救室
缺铁性贫血 iron deficiency anemia 长期慢性失血或铁摄入不足导致的小细胞低色素性贫血 A microcytic hypochromic anemia caused by chronic blood loss or inadequate iron intake. 消化道出血 门诊
肠道血管畸形 angiodysplasia 肠道黏膜下异常扩张的血管团，是老年人下消化道出血的常见原因 Abnormally dilated vessels in the bowel mucosa and a common cause of lower gastrointestinal bleeding in the elderly. 消化道出血 内镜室
结肠镜 colonoscopy 经肛门插入内镜观察结肠并可止血和取活检的检查 Insertion of a scope through the anus to examine the colon and allow hemostasis and biopsy. 消化道出血 内镜室
止血药物 hemostatic agent 通过促进凝血或收缩血管减少出血的药物，作为辅助治疗 A drug that reduces bleeding by promoting clotting or constricting vessels, used as supportive treatment. 消化道出血 抢救室
咖啡样呕吐物 coffee-ground vomitus 胃内血液被胃酸作用后呈咖啡渣样的呕吐物 Vomited material that looks like coffee grounds after blood has been acted on by gastric acid. 消化道出血 抢救室
脓毒症 sepsis 感染引起宿主反应失调导致危及生命的器官功能障碍 Life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated host response to infection. 感染与脓毒症 抢救室
脓毒性休克 septic shock 脓毒症合并持续低血压、需要升压药维持的循环衰竭状态 Sepsis with persistent hypotension that requires vasopressors to maintain circulation. 感染与脓毒症 抢救室
菌血症 bacteremia 细菌进入血液循环的状态，可无临床症状也可引起脓毒症 The presence of bacteria in the bloodstream, which may be silent or lead to sepsis. 感染与脓毒症 检验科

全身炎症反应综合征 systemic inflammatory response syndrome 由感染或非感染因素引起的全身炎症反应，表现为体温、心率、呼吸和白细胞异常 A whole-body inflammatory response to infectious or non-infectious causes, marked by abnormal temperature, heart rate, respiration, and white cells. 感染与脓毒症 抢救室

zh: 多器官功能障碍综合征
text: 多器官功能障碍综合征 multiple organ dysfunction syndrome 严重损伤或感染后两个以上器官功能相继或同时衰竭的临床综合征 A syndrome in which two or more organs fail sequentially or together after severe injury or infection. 感染与脓毒症 ICU
抗生素 antibiotic 用于杀灭或抑制细菌生长的药物，需按感染部位和病原选择 A drug that kills or inhibits bacteria, chosen by infection site and pathogen. 感染与脓毒症 抢救室
经验性抗生素治疗 empiric antibiotic therapy 在病原结果出来前根据经验选择抗生素的治疗策略 A strategy of choosing antibiotics from clinical experience before pathogen results are available. 感染与脓毒症 抢救室
血培养 blood culture 采集血液培养病原菌以指导抗感染治疗的检查，应在用药前留取 A test that cultures blood to identify pathogens and guide antibiotics, ideally taken before drugs. 感染与脓毒症 检验科
降钙素原 procalcitonin 细菌感染时升高的指标，可帮助判断感染和指导停药 A marker that rises in bacterial infection and helps judge infection and guide stopping antibiotics. 感染与脓毒症 检验科
C反应蛋白 C-reactive protein 炎症时升高的急性期蛋白，敏感性高但特异性低 An acute-phase protein that rises with inflammation and is sensitive but not specific. 感染与脓毒症 检验科
脓毒症集束化治疗 sepsis bundle 在一小时内完成血培养、抗生素和液体复苏的标准化处置组合 A standardized set of actions completed within one hour, including cultures, antibiotics, and fluid resuscitation. 感染与脓毒症 抢救室
社区获得性肺炎 community-acquired pneumonia 在医院外获得的肺实质感染，常见发热、咳嗽和呼吸困难 Infection of the lung tissue acquired outside hospital, usually with fever, cough, and dyspnea. 感染与脓毒症 病房
医院获得性肺炎 hospital-acquired pneumonia 入院四十八小时后新发生的肺炎，病原多为耐药菌 Pneumonia developing more than forty eight hours after admission, often caused by resistant organisms. 感染与脓毒症 病房
吸入性肺炎 aspiration pneumonia 口咽或胃内容物误吸入下呼吸道引起的肺部感染 Lung infection caused by aspirating oropharyngeal or gastric contents into the lower airway. 感染与脓毒症 病房
泌尿系统感染 urinary tract infection 细菌侵入尿路引起的感染，表现为尿频尿急尿痛和发热 Bacterial infection of the urinary tract with frequency, urgency, dysuria, and fever. 感染与脓毒症 门诊
急性肾盂肾炎 acute pyelonephritis 上尿路细菌感染累及肾盂和肾实质，常伴高热和腰痛 Bacterial infection of the upper urinary tract involving the renal pelvis and parenchyma, with high fever and flank pain. 感染与脓毒症 病房
胆道感染 biliary tract infection 细菌侵入胆道引起的感染，多在胆道梗阻基础上发生 Bacterial infection of the biliary tract that usually follows obstruction. 感染与脓毒症 病房
感染源控制 source control 通过引流、清创或拔管等措施去除感染源头，是抗感染成功的关键 Removal of the source of infection by drainage, debridement, or line removal, which is key to successful treatment. 感染与脓毒症 抢救室
化脓性脑膜炎 purulent meningitis 细菌感染脑膜引起的化脓性炎症，表现为发热、头痛和颈抵抗 Bacterial infection of the meninges causing purulent inflammation, with fever, headache, and neck stiffness. 感染与脓毒症 抢救室
皮肤软组织感染 skin and soft tissue infection 累及皮肤及皮下组织的细菌感染，包括蜂窝织炎和脓肿 Bacterial infection of the skin and underlying tissue, including cellulitis and abscess. 感染与脓毒症 门诊
坏死性筋膜炎 necrotizing fasciitis 筋膜和皮下组织快速坏死的严重感染，需紧急清创 A severe rapidly spreading infection that destroys fascia and subcutaneous tissue and needs urgent debridement. 感染与脓毒症 抢救室
脓毒症筛查 sepsis screening 用简单指标在急诊早期识别可能脓毒症患者的流程 A process that uses simple indicators to identify possible sepsis early in the emergency department. 感染与脓毒症 分诊台
导管相关血流感染 catheter-related bloodstream infection 留置血管导管引起的菌血症，拔管是治疗关键 Bloodstream infection caused by an indwelling vascular catheter in which removing the line is key. 感染与脓毒症 病房
抗菌药物降阶梯 de-escalation of antibiotics 根据病原和药敏结果把广谱抗生素换为窄谱的治疗策略 A strategy of narrowing broad-spectrum antibiotics according to pathogen and susceptibility results. 感染与脓毒症 病房
多重耐药菌 multidrug-resistant organism 对三类以上抗菌药物同时耐药的细菌，增加治疗难度 Bacteria resistant to three or more antibiotic classes, which makes treatment harder. 感染与脓毒症 病房
感染性心内膜炎 infective endocarditis 病原体侵犯心内膜或心脏瓣膜引起的感染，可致赘生物和栓塞 Infection of the endocardium or heart valves that can form vegetations and cause embolism. 感染与脓毒症 病房
脓毒症心肌病 sepsis-induced cardiomyopathy 脓毒症引起的心肌收缩功能抑制，可逆但加重循环衰竭 Reversible depression of myocardial contraction caused by sepsis that worsens circulatory failure. 感染与脓毒症 ICU
糖尿病酮症酸中毒 diabetic ketoacidosis 胰岛素严重缺乏引起酮体堆积和代谢性酸中毒的糖尿病急性并发症 A diabetic emergency in which severe insulin deficiency causes ketone accumulation and metabolic acidosis. 内分泌急症 抢救室
高渗高血糖状态 hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state 以极高血糖和严重脱水为特征、酮症不明显的糖尿病危象 A diabetic crisis marked by very high glucose and severe dehydration with little ketosis. 内分泌急症 抢救室
低血糖 hypoglycemia 血糖低于正常水平引起交感兴奋和脑功能障碍的临床状态 A clinical state in which blood glucose falls below normal and causes sympathetic activation and brain dysfunction. 内分泌急症 抢救室
低血糖昏迷 hypoglycemic coma 严重低血糖导致意识完全丧失，需立即静脉补糖 Complete loss of consciousness from severe hypoglycemia that requires immediate intravenous glucose. 内分泌急症 抢救室
甲状腺危象 thyroid storm 甲亢患者在诱因下出现高热、心动过速和意识改变的危重状态 A critical state in hyperthyroid patients with high fever, tachycardia, and altered consciousness triggered by stress or infection. 内分泌急症 抢救室
黏液性水肿昏迷 myxedema coma 严重甲减失代偿出现低体温、意识障碍和呼吸抑制的危象 Decompensated severe hypothyroidism with low body temperature, impaired consciousness, and depressed breathing. 内分泌急症 抢救室
肾上腺危象 adrenal crisis 肾上腺皮质激素严重不足导致低血压、低血钠和高钾的急症 An emergency from severe deficiency of adrenal steroids causing hypotension, low sodium, and high potassium. 内分泌急症 抢救室
高钙危象 hypercalcemic crisis 血钙显著升高引起意识改变、脱水和心律失常的危重状态 A critical state of markedly raised serum calcium with altered consciousness, dehydration, and arrhythmia. 内分泌急症 抢救室
糖尿病 diabetes mellitus 因胰岛素分泌或作用缺陷导致慢性高血糖的代谢性疾病 A metabolic disease of chronic hyperglycemia caused by defective insulin secretion or action. 内分泌急症 门诊
胰岛素 insulin 调节血糖的激素类药物，是控制高血糖和酮症酸中毒的关键 A hormone drug that regulates blood glucose and is central to treating hyperglycemia and ketoacidosis. 内分泌急症 抢救室
胰岛素治疗 insulin therapy 用外源胰岛素控制血糖的治疗方式，分皮下和静脉给药 Treatment with exogenous insulin to control blood glucose, given subcutaneously or intravenously. 内分泌急症 病房
糖尿病足 diabetic foot 糖尿病神经病变和血管病变导致的足部溃疡和感染 Foot ulcers and infection caused by diabetic neuropathy and vascular disease. 内分泌急症 门诊
尿崩症 diabetes insipidus 抗利尿激素缺乏或作用障碍导致大量低渗尿和烦渴的疾病 A disorder of absent or ineffective antidiuretic hormone that causes large volumes of dilute urine and thirst. 内分泌急症 病房

zh: 抗利尿激素分泌不当综合征
text: 抗利尿激素分泌不当综合征 syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone 抗利尿激素异常分泌导致稀释性低钠和尿钠增高的综合征 A syndrome of excessive antidiuretic hormone causing dilutional hyponatremia and high urine sodium. 内分泌急症 病房
库欣综合征 Cushing syndrome 长期糖皮质激素过多引起向心性肥胖、紫纹和高血压的综合征 A syndrome of prolonged excess glucocorticoid causing central obesity, purple striae, and hypertension. 内分泌急症 门诊
嗜铬细胞瘤 pheochromocytoma 肾上腺髓质肿瘤阵发释放儿茶酚胺，引起阵发性高血压和心悸 A tumor of the adrenal medulla that releases catecholamines in bursts, causing paroxysmal hypertension and palpitations. 内分泌急症 病房
甲状腺功能亢进 hyperthyroidism 甲状腺激素分泌过多引起的高代谢综合征，表现为心慌、消瘦和怕热 A high-metabolism syndrome from excess thyroid hormone, with palpitations, weight loss, and heat intolerance. 内分泌急症 门诊
甲状腺功能减退 hypothyroidism 甲状腺激素分泌不足引起的低代谢状态，表现为乏力、怕冷和水肿 A low-metabolism state from insufficient thyroid hormone, with fatigue, cold intolerance, and edema. 内分泌急症 门诊
酮体 ketone body 脂肪分解产生的酸性代谢产物，血或尿中升高提示酮症 Acidic products of fat breakdown whose rise in blood or urine indicates ketosis. 内分泌急症 检验科
糖化血红蛋白 glycated hemoglobin 反映近两三个月平均血糖水平的指标，用于评估长期控制 A marker of average blood glucose over the past two to three months used to assess long-term control. 内分泌急症 检验科
糖尿病肾病 diabetic nephropathy 糖尿病引起的肾小球病变，表现为蛋白尿和肾功能下降 Kidney damage from diabetes that causes proteinuria and declining renal function. 内分泌急症 门诊
垂体危象 pituitary crisis 垂体功能严重减退急性失代偿，出现低血压、低血糖和低体温 Acute decompensation of severe hypopituitarism with hypotension, hypoglycemia, and low body temperature. 内分泌急症 抢救室
葡萄糖注射液 dextrose injection 含葡萄糖的静脉制剂，用于纠正低血糖和补充能量 An intravenous glucose preparation used to correct hypoglycemia and supply energy. 内分泌急症 抢救室
静脉胰岛素泵 continuous insulin infusion 用输液泵持续静脉输入胰岛素以平稳控制血糖的方法 A method of giving insulin continuously by infusion pump to control glucose smoothly. 内分泌急症 抢救室

zh: 原发性肾上腺皮质功能减退
text: 原发性肾上腺皮质功能减退 primary adrenal insufficiency 肾上腺本身病变导致皮质醇和醛固酮分泌不足的慢性病 A chronic disorder in which disease of the adrenal gland reduces cortisol and aldosterone secretion. 内分泌急症 门诊
胰岛素抵抗 insulin resistance 组织对胰岛素反应减弱导致代偿性高胰岛素血症的状态 A state in which tissues respond poorly to insulin and compensatory hyperinsulinemia develops. 内分泌急症 门诊
内分泌急症 endocrine emergency 由内分泌腺功能异常急性失代偿引起的危重情况统称 An umbrella term for critical conditions from acute decompensation of endocrine gland function. 内分泌急症 抢救室
急性中毒 acute poisoning 短时间内接触毒物引起机体功能或器质性损害的急症 An emergency in which short-term exposure to a poison causes functional or structural damage. 急性中毒 抢救室
药物过量 drug overdose 有意或无意服用超过治疗剂量的药物，可危及生命 Taking more than the therapeutic dose of a drug, deliberately or by accident, which can be life-threatening. 急性中毒 抢救室
有机磷农药中毒 organophosphate poisoning 有机磷抑制胆碱酯酶引起毒蕈碱样和烟碱样症状的中毒 Poisoning in which organophosphates inhibit cholinesterase and cause muscarinic and nicotinic effects. 急性中毒 抢救室
一氧化碳中毒 carbon monoxide poisoning 吸入一氧化碳形成碳氧血红蛋白导致组织缺氧的中毒 Poisoning from inhaling carbon monoxide, which forms carboxyhemoglobin and starves tissues of oxygen. 急性中毒 抢救室
百草枯中毒 paraquat poisoning 误服或接触百草枯引起以肺纤维化为特征的剧毒农药中毒 Poisoning by the highly toxic herbicide paraquat, characterized by progressive lung fibrosis. 急性中毒 抢救室
敌敌畏中毒 dichlorvos poisoning 误服或吸入敌敌畏这种有机磷杀虫剂引起的中毒 Poisoning from swallowing or inhaling dichlorvos, an organophosphate insecticide used in households. 急性中毒 抢救室
镇静催眠药中毒 sedative-hypnotic poisoning 过量服用苯二氮卓类或巴比妥类等药物抑制中枢的中毒 Poisoning from overdosing benzodiazepines or barbiturates, which depress the central nervous system. 急性中毒 抢救室
阿片类中毒 opioid poisoning 过量使用阿片类药物导致呼吸抑制、瞳孔缩小和昏迷的中毒 Poisoning from excess opioid causing respiratory depression, pinpoint pupils, and coma. 急性中毒 抢救室
酒精中毒 alcohol intoxication 短时间内摄入大量乙醇引起中枢抑制和代谢紊乱的状态 Central nervous system depression and metabolic disturbance from heavy short-term ethanol intake. 急性中毒 抢救室
甲醇中毒 methanol poisoning 摄入工业酒精后甲醇代谢产生甲酸，导致代谢性酸中毒和失明 Poisoning in which methanol in industrial alcohol is metabolized to formic acid, causing acidosis and blindness. 急性中毒 抢救室
氰化物中毒 cyanide poisoning 氰化物抑制细胞色素氧化酶使细胞不能利用氧的速死性中毒 Rapidly fatal poisoning in which cyanide blocks cytochrome oxidase so cells cannot use oxygen. 急性中毒 抢救室
重金属中毒 heavy metal poisoning 铅、汞、砷等金属进入体内蓄积造成多系统损害的中毒 Poisoning from accumulation of metals such as lead, mercury, or arsenic that damages multiple systems. 急性中毒 抢救室
毒蕈中毒 mushroom poisoning 误食有毒蘑菇引起胃肠、神经或肝肾损害的中毒 Poisoning from eating toxic mushrooms that damages the gut, nerves, liver, or kidneys. 急性中毒 抢救室
河豚中毒 pufferfish poisoning 食用河豚后河豚毒素阻断钠通道引起口唇麻木和呼吸麻痹 Poisoning after eating pufferfish, in which tetrodotoxin blocks sodium channels and causes numb lips and respiratory paralysis. 急性中毒 抢救室
中毒性肝损伤 toxic liver injury 毒物直接或经代谢产物损伤肝细胞引起的肝功能异常 Liver dysfunction caused by a poison or its metabolite damaging hepatocytes. 急性中毒 病房
解毒剂 antidote 能中和毒物或对抗其毒性的特异性药物 A specific drug that neutralizes a poison or opposes its toxic effects. 急性中毒 抢救室
氟马西尼 flumazenil 苯二氮卓受体拮抗剂，用于逆转苯二氮卓类药物的中枢抑制 A benzodiazepine receptor antagonist used to reverse central depression from benzodiazepines. 急性中毒 抢救室
活性炭 activated charcoal 口服后吸附胃肠道内毒物减少吸收的急救用药 An oral agent that adsorbs poisons in the gut and reduces absorption. 急性中毒 抢救室
洗胃 gastric lavage 经胃管注入并抽出液体以清除胃内毒物的方法，须掌握时机 A method of flushing and aspirating the stomach through a tube to remove poison, used at the right time. 急性中毒 抢救室
血液灌流 hemoperfusion 把血液引出经活性炭或树脂吸附柱清除毒物的治疗 A treatment that passes blood through charcoal or resin columns to remove poisons. 急性中毒 血液净化室
血液透析 hemodialysis 利用半透膜清除血中小分子毒物和代谢废物的治疗 A treatment that clears small-molecule poisons and waste products through a semipermeable membrane. 急性中毒 血液净化室
胆碱酯酶 cholinesterase 分解乙酰胆碱的酶，有机磷中毒时活性下降可辅助诊断 An enzyme that breaks down acetylcholine and whose activity falls in organophosphate poisoning. 急性中毒 检验科
解磷定 pralidoxime 胆碱酯酶复能剂，用于有机磷中毒时恢复酶活性 A cholinesterase reactivator that restores enzyme activity in organophosphate poisoning. 急性中毒 抢救室
毒物筛查 toxicology screening 检测血或尿中常见毒物及其代谢物的检查，帮助明确中毒种类 A test that detects common poisons and their metabolites in blood or urine to identify the agent. 急性中毒 检验科
亚硝酸盐中毒 nitrite poisoning 摄入亚硝酸盐使血红蛋白氧化为高铁血红蛋白，导致发绀和缺氧 Poisoning in which nitrite oxidizes hemoglobin to methemoglobin, causing cyanosis and hypoxia. 急性中毒 抢救室
中毒性脑病 toxic encephalopathy 毒物直接或间接损害中枢神经引起意识障碍和抽搐的病变 Brain dysfunction from direct or indirect poison damage that causes impaired consciousness and seizures. 急性中毒 抢救室
迟发性脑病 delayed encephalopathy 急性一氧化碳中毒清醒数天或数周后再出现神经精神症状 Neuropsychiatric symptoms appearing days or weeks after apparent recovery from acute carbon monoxide poisoning. 急性中毒 病房
中暑 heat illness 高温环境下体温调节失衡引起的一组疾病，含热痉挛到热射病 A group of disorders from failed thermoregulation in heat, ranging from cramps to heat stroke. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
热射病 heat stroke 核心体温超四十度伴意识障碍和器官损害的最严重中暑类型 The most severe form of heat illness, with core temperature above forty, impaired consciousness, and organ damage. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
热痉挛 heat cramps 大量出汗后只补水不补盐引起的肌肉痛性痉挛 Painful muscle cramps from replacing sweat with water but not salt. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
热衰竭 heat exhaustion 高温下大量出汗导致脱水和血容量不足，出现头晕乏力和心动过速 Dehydration and low circulating volume from heavy sweating in heat, with dizziness, weakness, and tachycardia. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
日射病 sunstroke 长时间强烈日晒使头部受热引起头痛、头晕和体温升高的中暑类型 A heat illness from prolonged strong sun exposure to the head, causing headache, dizziness, and rising temperature. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
降温治疗 cooling therapy 用物理或药物方法快速降低核心体温的救治措施 Measures that rapidly lower core temperature by physical or pharmacological means. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
劳力型热射病 exertional heat stroke 高强度运动产热过多导致的热射病，多见于年轻人 Heat stroke from excessive heat production during strenuous exercise, most common in young people. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
体温调节中枢 thermoregulatory center 下丘脑调节产热与散热的神经中枢，其功能障碍可致体温失控 The hypothalamic center that balances heat production and loss and whose failure causes uncontrolled temperature. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
横纹肌溶解 rhabdomyolysis 骨骼肌大量破坏释放肌红蛋白，可致急性肾损伤 Massive breakdown of skeletal muscle that releases myoglobin and can cause acute kidney injury. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
急性肾损伤 acute kidney injury 肾功能在短期内急剧下降，表现为少尿和肌酐升高 A rapid decline in kidney function with oliguria and rising creatinine. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
冻伤 frostbite 寒冷使组织冻结造成的损伤，常见于手指脚趾和耳鼻 Tissue injury from freezing in cold, most often affecting fingers, toes, ears, and nose. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
冻僵 severe hypothermia 长时间寒冷暴露使核心体温显著下降、意识和循环受抑的状态 A state of markedly low core temperature from prolonged cold exposure that depresses consciousness and circulation. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
冷暴露 cold exposure 身体长时间处于低温环境而散热超过产热的情况 A situation in which the body loses heat faster than it produces it during prolonged cold. 中暑与冻伤 院前急救
复温休克 rewarming shock 严重低体温快速复温时外周血管扩张引起血压骤降的现象 A sudden fall in blood pressure from peripheral vasodilation during rapid rewarming of severe hypothermia. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
冻疮 chilblain 寒冷潮湿引起的非冻结性局部皮肤损伤，表现为红肿和瘙痒 Non-freezing localized skin injury from cold and damp, with redness, swelling, and itching. 中暑与冻伤 门诊
热适应 heat acclimatization 反复热暴露后机体耐热能力逐渐提高的生理过程 The physiological process by which repeated heat exposure gradually improves heat tolerance. 中暑与冻伤 门诊
蒸发降温 evaporative cooling 通过喷水并扇风促进水分蒸发带走热量的降温方法 A cooling method that sprays water and fans the skin so evaporation carries heat away. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
冷水浸泡 cold water immersion 把患者浸入冷水中以最快速度降低核心体温的方法 Immersing the patient in cold water to lower core temperature as fast as possible. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
电解质补充 electrolyte replacement 补充因出汗、呕吐或腹泻丢失的钠钾等电解质的措施 Replacing sodium, potassium, and other electrolytes lost through sweating, vomiting, or diarrhea. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
冻伤分级 frostbite staging 按组织损伤深度把冻伤分为四度以指导治疗 Classifying frostbite into four degrees by depth of tissue injury to guide treatment. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
奥斯本波 Osborn wave 低体温患者心电图上J点抬高的特征性改变 A characteristic J-point elevation on the electrocardiogram of a hypothermic patient. 中暑与冻伤 心电室
热暴露 heat exposure 人体处于高温环境或剧烈产热状态的暴露情况 Being in a hot environment or generating excessive heat internally. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
经典型热射病 classic heat stroke 老年人或慢性病患者在高温环境中被动暴露导致的热射病 Heat stroke in elderly or chronically ill people passively exposed to hot environments. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
冰袋 ice pack 装有冰块用于局部冷敷降温的用品 A pack of ice applied to the skin or over large vessels to lower body temperature. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
温水复温 warm water immersion 把冻伤部位浸入三十七到四十度温水中复温的方法 Immersing frostbitten parts in water at thirty seven to forty degrees to rewarm them. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
非冻结性冷伤 non-freezing cold injury 长时间处于零到十度潮湿环境造成的组织损伤，不发生冻结 Tissue injury from prolonged exposure to damp cold between zero and ten degrees without freezing. 中暑与冻伤 抢救室
热指数 heat index 把气温和湿度结合表示体感炎热程度的指标 An index combining air temperature and humidity to express how hot it feels. 中暑与冻伤 分诊台
过敏反应 allergic reaction 机体对过敏原产生的异常免疫反应，可轻可重 An abnormal immune response to an allergen that ranges from mild to severe. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 抢救室
过敏性休克 anaphylactic shock 严重过敏反应导致血管扩张和气道水肿的分布性休克 Distributive shock from severe allergic reaction with vasodilation and airway edema. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 抢救室
严重过敏反应 anaphylaxis 迅速进展、可危及生命的多系统过敏反应，需立即用肾上腺素 A rapidly progressive, life-threatening multisystem allergic reaction that requires immediate epinephrine. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 抢救室
荨麻疹 urticaria 皮肤黏膜小血管扩张渗出形成的风团，伴剧痒 Raised itchy welts from dilation and leakage of small vessels in skin and mucosa. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
血管性水肿 angioedema 皮下或黏膜深层血管扩张渗出引起的局限性肿胀 Localized deep swelling of subcutaneous or mucosal tissue from vessel dilation and leakage. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 抢救室
气道水肿 airway edema 喉、会厌或支气管黏膜肿胀使气道变窄，可见于过敏和感染 Swelling of the laryngeal, epiglottic, or bronchial mucosa that narrows the airway in allergy and infection. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 抢救室
类胰蛋白酶 tryptase 肥大细胞释放的蛋白酶，血中升高提示近期发生过敏反应 A protease released by mast cells whose rise in blood indicates a recent allergic reaction. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 检验科
抗组胺药 antihistamine 阻断组胺受体以减轻瘙痒和风团的药物，不能替代肾上腺素 A drug that blocks histamine receptors to reduce itching and welts and cannot replace epinephrine. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
过敏原 allergen 能诱发过敏反应的物质，如食物、药物、花粉和昆虫毒液 A substance such as food, drug, pollen, or insect venom that can trigger an allergic reaction. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
过敏原检测 allergy testing 通过皮肤试验或血清IgE检测确定过敏原的方法 A method of identifying allergens by skin tests or serum IgE measurement. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
皮肤点刺试验 skin prick test 把少量过敏原刺入表皮观察风团反应的检测方法 A test that introduces tiny amounts of allergen into the skin and looks for a wheal response. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
特异性IgE specific IgE 针对某种过敏原的免疫球蛋白E，血检可辅助确定致敏原 Immunoglobulin E directed at a particular allergen, measured in blood to help identify sensitization. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 检验科
组胺 histamine 过敏反应中由肥大细胞释放的介质，引起血管扩张和瘙痒 A mediator released by mast cells in allergic reactions that dilates vessels and causes itching. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 抢救室
免疫球蛋白E immunoglobulin E 介导速发型过敏反应的抗体，总水平升高提示过敏体质 The antibody that mediates immediate allergic reactions and whose total level rises in atopic individuals. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 检验科
皮疹 rash 皮肤出现的颜色或形态改变，是药物过敏最常见的表现 A change in skin color or texture and the most common sign of drug allergy. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
瘙痒 pruritus 引起搔抓欲望的皮肤不适感，过敏和胆汁淤积都可引起 An unpleasant skin sensation that provokes scratching and occurs in allergy and cholestasis. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
食物过敏 food allergy 进食某种食物后由免疫机制介导的不良反应 An adverse reaction to a food mediated by immune mechanisms. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
过敏原回避 allergen avoidance 明确过敏原后通过环境控制和饮食管理减少接触的措施 Measures of environmental control and dietary management that reduce exposure once an allergen is identified. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
青霉素过敏 penicillin allergy 对青霉素类抗生素的免疫反应，用前必须做皮试并询问史 An immune reaction to penicillin antibiotics that requires a skin test and history before use. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
碘对比剂预处理 contrast premedication 对有造影剂反应史者提前给糖皮质激素和抗组胺药的方案 A regimen of steroids and antihistamines given in advance to patients with a history of contrast reactions. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 CT室
昆虫蜇伤 insect sting 蜂类等昆虫蜇伤后毒液引起的局部反应或全身过敏 Local reaction or systemic allergy from venom after a sting by bees or similar insects. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 抢救室
双相反应 biphasic reaction 严重过敏反应初步缓解后数小时再次出现的症状 Recurrence of symptoms hours after anaphylaxis has apparently responded to treatment. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 抢救室
迟发型过敏反应 delayed hypersensitivity 接触过敏原后数小时至数天才出现的T细胞介导反应 A T-cell mediated reaction appearing hours to days after allergen exposure. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
肥大细胞 mast cell 储存组胺等介质的免疫细胞，是过敏反应的核心效应细胞 An immune cell storing histamine and other mediators and the central effector cell of allergy. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 抢救室
肾上腺素自动注射器 epinephrine auto-injector 预充肾上腺素、供患者自行肌注的装置，用于严重过敏自救 A prefilled device that lets patients inject epinephrine into the muscle themselves during severe allergy. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
脱敏治疗 desensitization 反复给予少量过敏原使机体逐渐耐受的免疫治疗方法 An immunotherapy that gives small repeated doses of allergen to build tolerance. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
血清病 serum sickness 注射异种血清或某些药物后出现的免疫复合物病，表现为发热皮疹关节痛 An immune complex disorder after foreign serum or certain drugs, with fever, rash, and joint pain. 过敏反应与过敏性休克 门诊
电解质紊乱 electrolyte imbalance 血中钠钾钙等电解质浓度异常，可引起心律失常和意识改变 Abnormal blood levels of sodium, potassium, calcium, or other electrolytes that can cause arrhythmia and altered consciousness. 电解质紊乱 检验科
低钠血症 hyponatremia 血钠低于正常范围导致细胞水肿，可出现乏力和意识改变 A serum sodium level below normal that causes cellular swelling, with weakness and altered consciousness. 电解质紊乱 病房
高钠血症 hypernatremia 血钠高于正常范围，多因失水或钠摄入过多引起 A serum sodium level above normal, usually from water loss or excess sodium intake. 电解质紊乱 病房
低钾血症 hypokalemia 血钾低于正常范围，可引起乏力和严重心律失常 A serum potassium level below normal that can cause weakness and serious arrhythmia. 电解质紊乱 抢救室
高钾血症 hyperkalemia 血钾高于正常范围，可致致命性心律失常，需紧急处理 A serum potassium level above normal that can cause fatal arrhythmia and needs urgent treatment. 电解质紊乱 抢救室
低钙血症 hypocalcemia 血钙低于正常范围，引起手足搐搦和口周麻木 A serum calcium level below normal that causes carpopedal spasm and numbness around the mouth. 电解质紊乱 抢救室
高钙血症 hypercalcemia 血钙高于正常范围，可引起多尿、便秘和意识障碍 A serum calcium level above normal that can cause polyuria, constipation, and impaired consciousness. 电解质紊乱 病房
低镁血症 hypomagnesemia 血镁低于正常范围，常伴低钾和低钙，可诱发心律失常 A serum magnesium level below normal, often with low potassium and calcium, that can provoke arrhythmia. 电解质紊乱 抢救室
代谢性酸中毒 metabolic acidosis 体内酸性代谢产物蓄积或碳酸氢根丢失导致的血pH下降 A fall in blood pH from accumulation of acid metabolites or loss of bicarbonate. 电解质紊乱 抢救室
代谢性碱中毒 metabolic alkalosis 胃液丢失或碱摄入过多使碳酸氢根升高导致的pH上升 A rise in blood pH from bicarbonate excess due to gastric fluid loss or alkali intake. 电解质紊乱 病房
呼吸性酸中毒 respiratory acidosis 通气不足使二氧化碳蓄积导致的血pH下降 A fall in blood pH from carbon dioxide retention due to inadequate ventilation. 电解质紊乱 抢救室
呼吸性碱中毒 respiratory alkalosis 过度通气使二氧化碳排出过多导致的血pH上升 A rise in blood pH from excessive carbon dioxide washout due to hyperventilation. 电解质紊乱 抢救室
阴离子间隙 anion gap 血中未测定阴离子与未测定阳离子之差，帮助判断酸中毒类型 The difference between unmeasured anions and cations that helps classify acidosis. 电解质紊乱 检验科
补钾治疗 potassium replacement 通过口服或静脉补充钾离子纠正低钾的措施 Correcting low potassium by giving potassium chloride orally or intravenously. 电解质紊乱 病房
静脉补钙 intravenous calcium 经静脉给予葡萄糖酸钙或氯化钙以纠正低钙或高钾 Giving calcium gluconate or chloride by vein to correct low calcium or high potassium. 电解质紊乱 抢救室
氯化钾 potassium chloride 最常用的补钾制剂，口服或稀释后静脉滴注纠正低钾 The most commonly used potassium preparation, given orally or diluted intravenously to correct low potassium. 电解质紊乱 病房
渗透压 osmolality 溶液中溶质微粒的浓度，反映体液的水分与溶质平衡 The concentration of solute particles in a solution, reflecting the balance of water and solute. 电解质紊乱 检验科
水电解质平衡 fluid and electrolyte balance 体内水分和电解质摄入与排出保持相对稳定的状态 A state in which water and electrolyte intake and output remain in relative balance. 电解质紊乱 病房
低氯血症 hypochloremia 血氯低于正常范围，常继发于呕吐或利尿剂使用 A serum chloride level below normal, often after vomiting or diuretic use. 电解质紊乱 病房
低磷血症 hypophosphatemia 血磷低于正常范围，可引起肌无力和呼吸肌疲劳 A serum phosphate level below normal that can cause muscle weakness and respiratory fatigue. 电解质紊乱 病房
高磷血症 hyperphosphatemia 血磷高于正常范围，多见于肾功能不全 A serum phosphate level above normal, most often in renal impairment. 电解质紊乱 病房
酸碱平衡 acid-base balance 体内酸性和碱性物质产生与排出保持稳定的状态 The steady state between production and elimination of acids and bases in the body. 电解质紊乱 检验科
低钾性周期性麻痹 hypokalemic periodic paralysis 反复发作的弛缓性肢体瘫痪，发作时血钾降低 Recurrent episodes of flaccid limb weakness during which serum potassium is low. 电解质紊乱 抢救室
碱剩余 base excess 血气分析中反映代谢性酸碱失衡程度的指标 A blood gas value that reflects the degree of metabolic acid-base disturbance. 电解质紊乱 检验科
低钠性脑病 hyponatremic encephalopathy 严重低钠导致脑细胞水肿，出现头痛、抽搐和意识障碍 Brain cell swelling from severe hyponatremia that causes headache, seizures, and impaired consciousness. 电解质紊乱 抢救室
高镁血症 hypermagnesemia 血镁高于正常范围，多见于肾功能衰竭，可抑制神经肌肉 A serum magnesium level above normal, mostly in renal failure, that depresses neuromuscular function. 电解质紊乱 病房
渗透性利尿 osmotic diuresis 尿中溶质过多使水分排出增加的现象，见于高血糖 Increased water loss in urine caused by excess solute in the tubular fluid, as in hyperglycemia. 电解质紊乱 抢救室
晕厥 syncope 短暂全脑低灌注引起的快速发生又自行恢复的意识丧失 A sudden, brief loss of consciousness from transient global cerebral hypoperfusion that resolves on its own. 晕厥 分诊台
血管迷走性晕厥 vasovagal syncope 迷走张力突然增高引起血压下降和心率减慢导致的晕厥 Syncope from a sudden rise in vagal tone that drops blood pressure and slows the heart rate. 晕厥 观察室

zh: 直立性心动过速综合征
text: 直立性心动过速综合征 postural tachycardia syndrome 直立时心率异常增快伴头晕心悸，平卧后缓解的综合征 A syndrome of excessive heart rate rise on standing with dizziness and palpitations that eases when lying down. 晕厥 门诊
心源性晕厥 cardiac syncope 心律失常或心脏结构病变导致心输出量骤降引起的晕厥 Syncope from a sudden fall in cardiac output due to arrhythmia or structural heart disease. 晕厥 抢救室
情境性晕厥 situational syncope 排尿、咳嗽或吞咽等特定动作诱发的反射性晕厥 Reflex syncope triggered by specific acts such as urination, coughing, or swallowing. 晕厥 观察室
颈动脉窦综合征 carotid sinus syndrome 颈动脉窦过敏导致心率减慢和血压下降引起的晕厥 Syncope from an overactive carotid sinus that slows the heart and lowers blood pressure. 晕厥 观察室
晕厥前兆 presyncope 即将失去意识但尚未完全晕倒的状态，常伴眼前发黑和出汗 The sensation of impending loss of consciousness without actually fainting, often with dim vision and sweating. 晕厥 分诊台
直立倾斜试验 tilt table test 让患者被动直立并监测血压心率以诱发晕厥的检查 A test that tilts the patient upright while monitoring blood pressure and heart rate to provoke syncope. 晕厥 检查室
反射性晕厥 reflex syncope 神经反射导致血管扩张和心率减慢引起的晕厥统称 Syncope caused by a neural reflex that dilates vessels and slows the heart. 晕厥 观察室
直立不耐受 orthostatic intolerance 直立位时出现头晕心悸等不适而平卧可缓解的状态 Symptoms such as dizziness and palpitations on standing that ease when lying down. 晕厥 门诊
短暂意识丧失 transient loss of consciousness 突然发生又自行恢复的意识丧失，晕厥是其中最常见的一种 A sudden loss of consciousness that resolves spontaneously, of which syncope is the most common form. 晕厥 分诊台
惊厥性晕厥 convulsive syncope 晕厥时脑缺血引起短暂肢体抽动，易被误认为癫痫 Brief limb jerking during syncope from cerebral hypoperfusion that is often mistaken for epilepsy. 晕厥 抢救室
心内电生理检查 electrophysiological study 经导管记录心内电活动以明确心律失常机制的检查 A catheter study that records electrical activity inside the heart to define the mechanism of an arrhythmia. 晕厥 导管室
动态心电监测 ambulatory ECG monitoring 长时间连续记录心电活动以捕捉阵发性心律失常 Continuous ECG recording over a long period to capture intermittent arrhythmias. 晕厥 心电室
心律失常性晕厥 arrhythmogenic syncope 快速或缓慢心律失常导致心输出量不足引起的晕厥 Syncope from inadequate cardiac output due to a fast or slow arrhythmia. 晕厥 抢救室
结构性心脏病 structural heart disease 心脏瓣膜、心肌或大血管存在解剖异常的疾病统称 An umbrella term for anatomical abnormalities of heart valves, muscle, or great vessels. 晕厥 门诊
复发性晕厥 recurrent syncope 在一定时间内多次发生的晕厥，需系统评估病因 Syncope occurring repeatedly over time and requiring systematic evaluation of the cause. 晕厥 观察室
晕厥评估 syncope assessment 按病史、查体、心电图和危险分层判断晕厥病因的流程 A process using history, examination, ECG, and risk stratification to determine the cause of syncope. 晕厥 分诊台
血容量不足 hypovolemia 循环血容量减少导致血压下降和组织灌注不足的状态 A reduction in circulating volume that lowers blood pressure and tissue perfusion. 晕厥 抢救室
咳嗽性晕厥 cough syncope 剧烈咳嗽时胸腔压力升高影响静脉回流引起的晕厥 Syncope during severe coughing when raised intrathoracic pressure reduces venous return. 晕厥 观察室
排尿性晕厥 micturition syncope 排尿时或排尿后因迷走反射和腹压骤降引起的晕厥 Syncope during or after urination from vagal reflex and a sudden fall in abdominal pressure. 晕厥 观察室
颈动脉窦按摩 carotid sinus massage 按压颈动脉窦以诱发或终止某些心律失常和晕厥的床旁手法 A bedside maneuver that presses the carotid sinus to provoke or terminate certain arrhythmias and syncope. 晕厥 检查室
运动性晕厥 exertional syncope 运动中或刚运动后发生的晕厥，高度提示心脏病因 Syncope during or immediately after exertion, which strongly suggests a cardiac cause. 晕厥 抢救室
晕厥发作 syncopal episode 一次具体的晕厥事件，记录持续时间、诱因和伴随表现 A single episode of fainting, recorded with duration, triggers, and accompanying features. 晕厥 分诊台
脑灌注不足 cerebral hypoperfusion 脑血流减少导致头晕、黑矇和意识丧失的状态 Reduced blood flow to the brain that causes dizziness, dim vision, and loss of consciousness. 晕厥 抢救室
跌倒发作 drop attack 突发下肢无力而跌倒但意识保留的现象，需与晕厥鉴别 Sudden leg weakness causing a fall while consciousness is preserved, which must be distinguished from syncope. 晕厥 观察室
发热待查 fever of unknown origin 不明原因发热持续三周以上、经检查仍未明确病因的临床诊断 Fever persisting for more than three weeks without an identified cause after investigation. 发热待查 病房
铁蛋白 ferritin 反映体内铁储备的蛋白，显著升高可见于成人斯蒂尔病和噬血细胞综合征 A protein reflecting body iron stores that rises markedly in adult Still disease and hemophagocytic syndrome. 发热待查 检验科
药物热 drug fever 由药物本身引起的发热，停药后多可自行消退 Fever caused by a drug itself that usually resolves after the drug is stopped. 发热待查 病房
低热 low-grade fever 体温在三十七点三到三十八度之间的轻度升高 A mildly raised temperature between thirty seven point three and thirty eight degrees. 发热待查 门诊
稽留热 continued fever 体温持续在三十九度以上且日波动不超过一度的热型 A fever pattern with temperature persistently above thirty nine and daily variation under one degree. 发热待查 病房
弛张热 remittent fever 体温三十九度以上且日波动超过两度但不降至正常的热型 A fever pattern above thirty nine with daily swings over two degrees that never reach normal. 发热待查 病房
间歇热 intermittent fever 高热与正常体温交替出现的热型，常见于疟疾 A fever pattern alternating between high temperature and normal, typical of malaria. 发热待查 病房
不规则热 irregular fever 体温高低无规律、热型不典型的状态 A fever that shows no regular pattern or typical temperature curve. 发热待查 病房
畏寒 chills 自觉怕冷甚至寒战的感觉，常出现在体温上升期 A feeling of coldness, sometimes with shaking, that often accompanies a rising temperature. 发热待查 分诊台
盗汗 night sweats 夜间睡眠中出汗、醒后汗止的现象，常见于结核和淋巴瘤 Sweating during sleep that stops on waking, common in tuberculosis and lymphoma. 发热待查 门诊
中枢性发热 central fever 脑损伤后体温调节中枢失常引起的发热，抗感染无效 Fever caused by disturbed central thermoregulation after brain injury that does not respond to antibiotics. 发热待查 病房
周期热 periodic fever 按一定周期反复发作的发热，见于家族性地中海热等疾病 Fever that recurs at regular intervals, as in familial Mediterranean fever. 发热待查 门诊
回归热 relapsing fever 螺旋体感染引起的发热数天后缓解、再反复发作的传染病 A spirochetal infection with fever that subsides after a few days and then returns. 发热待查 病房
结核菌素试验 tuberculin skin test 皮内注射结核菌素观察局部反应以判断结核感染的试验 A test that injects tuberculin into the skin and reads the local reaction to detect tuberculosis infection. 发热待查 门诊
γ干扰素释放试验 interferon-gamma release assay 用结核特异性抗原刺激T细胞检测其释放γ干扰素的结核感染检测 A tuberculosis test that stimulates T cells with specific antigens and measures interferon-gamma release. 发热待查 检验科
隐匿性感染 occult infection 缺乏典型局部症状和体征、不易发现的感染灶 An infection focus without typical local symptoms or signs that is easily overlooked. 发热待查 病房
结核 tuberculosis 结核分枝杆菌引起的慢性传染病，以肺结核最常见 A chronic infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, most often affecting the lungs. 发热待查 门诊
布鲁菌病 brucellosis 接触牛羊或生乳后感染布鲁菌引起的人畜共患病，表现为波状热和关节痛 A zoonosis from contact with sheep, cattle, or raw milk that causes undulant fever and joint pain. 发热待查 门诊
疟疾 malaria 疟原虫经蚊虫传播引起的传染病，典型为周期性发冷发热 A mosquito-borne infection by Plasmodium with periodic chills and fever. 发热待查 病房
登革热 dengue fever 登革病毒经蚊虫传播引起的急性传染病，表现为高热和肌肉痛 An acute mosquito-borne viral infection with high fever and muscle pain. 发热待查 病房
伤寒 typhoid fever 伤寒沙门菌经消化道传播引起，典型为稽留热和玫瑰疹 Infection by Salmonella typhi spread by the fecal-oral route, with continued fever and rose spots. 发热待查 病房
感染灶 infectious focus 病原微生物繁殖并引起局部病变的具体部位，是寻找发热原因的关键 The specific site where a pathogen multiplies and causes local damage, key to finding the cause of fever. 发热待查 病房
骨髓穿刺 bone marrow aspiration 用穿刺针取骨髓液检查以诊断血液病和不明原因发热的方法 A needle sampling of marrow to diagnose blood diseases and unexplained fever. 发热待查 检查室
抗核抗体 antinuclear antibody 针对自身细胞核成分的抗体，是筛查风湿免疫病的指标 Antibodies against components of the cell nucleus, used to screen for rheumatic autoimmune disease. 发热待查 检验科
肿瘤热 tumor fever 恶性肿瘤本身引起的发热，抗感染治疗无效 Fever caused by the malignancy itself and unresponsive to antibiotics. 发热待查 病房
产后出血 postpartum hemorrhage 胎儿娩出后二十四小时内失血量超过五百毫升或剖宫产超过一千毫升 Blood loss exceeding 500 mL after vaginal birth or 1000 mL after cesarean delivery within 24 hours. 产科出血 产房
子宫收缩乏力 uterine atony 分娩后子宫肌层不能有效收缩，是产后出血首要原因的病理状态 Failure of the uterus to contract effectively after delivery, the leading cause of postpartum hemorrhage. 产科出血 产房
胎盘滞留 retained placenta 胎儿娩出后三十分钟胎盘仍未排出，或胎盘小叶残留于宫腔 Failure of the placenta to deliver within 30 minutes after birth, or retention of placental fragments. 产科出血 产房
胎盘植入 placenta accreta 胎盘绒毛异常侵入子宫肌层，分娩时胎盘无法自行剥离并易大出血 Abnormal invasion of placental villi into the myometrium that prevents placental separation and causes severe bleeding. 产科出血 手术室
前置胎盘 placenta previa 妊娠二十八周后胎盘附着于子宫下段并覆盖宫颈内口的状态 A condition in which the placenta lies in the lower uterus and covers the internal cervical os after 28 weeks. 产科出血 产科病房
胎盘早剥 placental abruption 正常位置的胎盘在胎儿娩出前部分或全部从子宫壁剥离 Partial or complete separation of a normally implanted placenta from the uterine wall before delivery. 产科出血 产房
