人工流产 induced abortion 用手术或药物人为终止早期妊娠的医疗措施 A medical procedure that intentionally ends an early pregnancy by surgery or medication. 妇科急症 妇科门诊
药物流产 medical abortion 用米非司酮联合米索前列醇终止早期妊娠的方法 Ending an early pregnancy with mifepristone followed by misoprostol. 妇科急症 妇科门诊
葡萄胎 hydatidiform mole 胎盘绒毛水肿增生形成的异常妊娠，需清宫并随访HCG An abnormal pregnancy with swollen placental villi that requires evacuation and hCG follow-up. 妇科急症 妇科门诊
绒毛膜癌 choriocarcinoma 滋养细胞来源的恶性肿瘤，可继发于葡萄胎或正常妊娠 A malignant tumor of trophoblastic tissue that can follow a molar or normal pregnancy. 妇科急症 妇科门诊
急性盆腔痛 acute pelvic pain 突发的下腹部疼痛，需排除异位妊娠与卵巢扭转 Sudden lower abdominal pain that requires exclusion of ectopic pregnancy and ovarian torsion. 妇科急症 急诊科
性传播感染 sexually transmitted infection 通过性接触传播的一组感染，可致盆腔炎与不孕 A group of infections spread by sexual contact that can cause pelvic inflammatory disease and infertility. 妇科急症 妇科门诊
淋病 gonorrhea 淋病奈瑟菌引起的性传播感染，常表现为脓性分泌物 A sexually transmitted infection caused by Neisseria gonorrhoeae, often with purulent discharge. 妇科急症 妇科门诊
衣原体感染 chlamydial infection 沙眼衣原体引起的性传播感染，常无明显症状 A sexually transmitted infection caused by Chlamydia trachomatis that is often asymptomatic. 妇科急症 妇科门诊
细菌性阴道病 bacterial vaginosis 阴道菌群失调导致厌氧菌过度生长的常见感染 A common infection in which the vaginal flora shift allows anaerobic bacteria to overgrow. 妇科急症 妇科门诊

zh: 外阴阴道假丝酵母菌病
text: 外阴阴道假丝酵母菌病 vulvovaginal candidiasis 假丝酵母菌过度生长引起的外阴瘙痒与豆渣样分泌物 Overgrowth of Candida causing vulvar itching and thick white discharge. 妇科急症 妇科门诊
紧急避孕 emergency contraception 无保护性行为后短时间内防止妊娠的补救措施 A backup method used soon after unprotected intercourse to prevent pregnancy. 妇科急症 妇科门诊
子宫穿孔 uterine perforation 宫腔操作时器械穿破子宫壁的并发症 A complication in which an instrument passes through the uterine wall during an intrauterine procedure. 妇科急症 手术室
儿科评估三角 pediatric assessment triangle 通过外观、呼吸功与循环灌注三项快速判断患儿危重程度的方法 A rapid visual tool assessing appearance, work of breathing, and circulation to judge how sick a child is. 儿童急诊评估 抢救室
儿童早期预警评分 pediatric early warning score 根据生命体征与意识等参数给住院患儿打分以预警病情恶化 A score based on vital signs and consciousness that warns of deterioration in hospitalized children. 儿童急诊评估 儿科病房
儿童体重估算 weight estimation 无法称重时用身长或年龄公式估算患儿体重以计算药量 Estimating a child's weight from length or age when weighing is impossible, in order to calculate drug doses. 儿童急诊评估 抢救室
生长发育评估 growth and development assessment 通过身高体重与发育里程碑判断儿童生长是否正常的评估 Assessment of height, weight, and developmental milestones to judge whether a child is growing normally. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
头围测量 head circumference measurement 用软尺绕枕骨与眉间测量婴幼儿头围的操作 Measuring an infant's head around the occiput and above the eyebrows with a tape. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
前囟 anterior fontanelle 婴儿颅骨尚未闭合的菱形膜性区域，约一岁半闭合 The diamond-shaped membranous gap between infant skull bones that closes at about eighteen months. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
囟门膨隆 bulging fontanelle 前囟张力增高向外凸出，提示颅内压升高 A tense, outward-bulging anterior fontanelle that suggests raised intracranial pressure. 儿童急诊评估 抢救室
婴儿肌张力 infant muscle tone 婴儿安静与活动时肌肉的紧张程度，是神经系统评估指标 The degree of muscle tension in an infant at rest and during movement, used in neurologic assessment. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
儿童疼痛评估 pediatric pain assessment 用适龄量表评估儿童疼痛部位与程度的规范方法 A structured method using age-appropriate scales to assess the site and severity of pain in children. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
疼痛面部表情量表 Wong-Baker FACES pain scale 用一组逐渐痛苦的面部表情图让儿童指出自己疼痛程度 A scale with a series of increasingly distressed faces that a child points to in order to rate pain. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
家长陈述 parental report 由照护者提供的患儿症状与病史信息，是儿科评估的重要来源 Information about a child's symptoms and history given by the caregiver, a key source in pediatric assessment. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
儿童体格检查 pediatric physical examination 按儿童特点调整顺序与手法的全身查体 A full physical examination adapted in order and technique to the needs of a child. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
营养状况评估 nutritional status assessment 通过体重身高与饮食史判断儿童营养是否充足 Assessment of weight, height, and diet history to judge whether a child is adequately nourished. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
年龄别体重 weight-for-age 按年龄比较体重的生长指标，用于筛查低体重与消瘦 A growth index comparing weight with age, used to screen for underweight and wasting. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
身高别体重 weight-for-height 按身高比较体重的指标，用于判断急性营养不良 A growth index comparing weight with height, used to detect acute malnutrition. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
反应性评估 responsiveness assessment 通过呼唤、触觉与疼痛刺激判断患儿意识反应水平 Judging a child's level of consciousness by voice, touch, and painful stimulation. 儿童急诊评估 抢救室
微弱哭声 weak cry 婴儿哭声低弱无力，常提示全身状态差或呼吸费力 A feeble, low-volume infant cry that often signals poor general condition or breathing effort. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
喂养史 feeding history 记录患儿近期进食种类、量与方式的病史内容 A history of what, how much, and how a child has been fed recently. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
儿童疫苗接种史 pediatric immunization history 记录患儿既往接种疫苗种类与时间的病史内容 A record of which vaccines a child has received and when. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
出生史 birth history 记录出生方式、胎龄、体重与窒息抢救情况的病史 A record of delivery mode, gestational age, birth weight, and any resuscitation at birth. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
早产儿 preterm infant 胎龄不足三十七周出生的婴儿，各系统发育不成熟 An infant born before 37 weeks of gestation with immature organ systems. 儿童急诊评估 儿科病房
低出生体重儿 low birth weight infant 出生体重不足两千五百克的婴儿，易出现低血糖与低体温 An infant weighing under 2,500 g at birth, prone to hypoglycemia and hypothermia. 儿童急诊评估 儿科病房
巨大儿 macrosomia 出生体重超过四千克的新生儿，易发生肩难产与低血糖 A newborn weighing more than 4 kg, at higher risk of shoulder dystocia and hypoglycemia. 儿童急诊评估 产科病房
儿童转运 pediatric transport 把危重患儿安全转送至上级医院的过程与保障措施 The process and safety measures for moving a critically ill child to a higher-level hospital. 儿童急诊评估 急诊科
家长陪同 parental presence 在评估与操作时允许照护者留在患儿身边的做法 Allowing a caregiver to stay with the child during assessment and procedures. 儿童急诊评估 急诊科
儿童生长发育曲线 growth chart 按年龄绘制身高体重与头围百分位的参考图 A reference chart plotting height, weight, and head circumference percentiles against age. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
体格生长指标 anthropometric measurement 身高体重与头围等反映儿童体格生长的测量数据 Measurements such as height, weight, and head circumference that reflect a child's physical growth. 儿童急诊评估 儿科门诊
儿童发热 pediatric fever 儿童肛温超过三十八摄氏度或腋温超过三十七点五摄氏度的发热状态 A body temperature above 38 degrees Celsius rectally or 37.5 degrees Celsius axillary in a child. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
儿童高热 pediatric high fever 体温超过三十九摄氏度的发热，儿童常伴精神反应改变 A temperature above 39 degrees Celsius, often accompanied by a change in a child's general condition. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
小儿超高热 pediatric hyperpyrexia 体温超过四十一摄氏度的极重度发热，可致惊厥与器官损害 An extreme elevation of body temperature above 41 degrees Celsius that can cause seizures and organ damage. 儿童发热 抢救室
热峰 peak temperature 一次发热过程中达到的最高体温，用于评估病情趋势 The highest temperature reached during a febrile episode, used to judge the trend of illness. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
热性惊厥 febrile seizure 六个月至五岁儿童发热时出现的惊厥，无颅内感染证据 A convulsion during fever in a child aged six months to five years without evidence of intracranial infection. 儿童发热 急诊科
复杂性热性惊厥 complex febrile seizure 持续超过十五分钟、局灶性或二十四小时内反复的热性惊厥 A febrile seizure that lasts over fifteen minutes, is focal, or recurs within twenty-four hours. 儿童发热 儿科病房
热性惊厥持续状态 febrile status epilepticus 热性惊厥持续超过三十分钟或反复发作未恢复意识 A febrile seizure lasting over thirty minutes, or repeated seizures without regaining consciousness. 儿童发热 抢救室
退热药 antipyretic 通过调节体温中枢降低发热患儿体温的药物 A drug that lowers body temperature in a febrile child by acting on the temperature center. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
布洛芬 ibuprofen 非甾体抗炎类儿童退热药，脱水患儿慎用 A nonsteroidal antipyretic for children that should be used cautiously in dehydrated children. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
儿童物理降温 pediatric physical cooling 用温水擦浴、减少衣物或冰袋等物理方法降低体温 Lowering body temperature by tepid sponging, removing clothing, or applying ice packs. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
退热处理 antipyretic treatment 针对发热采取的退热药或物理降温等处理措施 Measures such as antipyretic drugs or physical cooling used to treat fever. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
发热护理 fever care 对发热患儿进行补水、监测体温与观察精神的护理措施 Nursing measures for a febrile child, including fluids, temperature monitoring, and observing behavior. 儿童发热 儿科病房
发热伴皮疹 fever with rash 发热同时出现皮疹的表现，需鉴别麻疹、猩红热与药疹 Fever accompanied by a rash, requiring distinction among measles, scarlet fever, and drug eruption. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
幼儿急疹 roseola infantum 婴幼儿病毒感染，高热三天后热退疹出 A viral infection of infants marked by three days of high fever followed by a rash as the fever resolves. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
麻疹 measles 麻疹病毒引起的急性呼吸道传染病，有卡他症状与口腔黏膜斑 An acute respiratory infection caused by the measles virus, with catarrhal symptoms and oral mucosal spots. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
疱疹性咽峡炎 herpangina 柯萨奇病毒引起，咽峡部疱疹伴高热与咽痛 An enteroviral illness with vesicles in the oropharynx, high fever, and sore throat. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
猩红热 scarlet fever A组链球菌引起的感染，表现为草莓舌与全身弥漫皮疹 An infection caused by group A streptococcus with a strawberry tongue and a diffuse body rash. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
川崎病 Kawasaki disease 儿童急性血管炎，表现为持续发热、结膜充血与手足硬肿 An acute vasculitis of childhood with persistent fever, conjunctival injection, and swollen hands and feet. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
疫苗接种后发热 post-vaccination fever 接种疫苗后一到两天出现的低中度发热，多自行缓解 Low to moderate fever appearing one to two days after vaccination that usually resolves on its own. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
出牙期发热 teething fever 婴儿出牙期间出现的轻度发热，通常不超过三十八度 Mild fever during infant teething that usually does not exceed 38 degrees Celsius. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
发热患儿观察 observation of febrile child 对发热儿童持续观察精神、进食与尿量的过程 Continued monitoring of a febrile child's alertness, feeding, and urine output. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
小儿感染性发热 pediatric infectious fever 由细菌、病毒等病原体感染引起的发热 Fever caused by infection with bacteria, viruses, or other pathogens. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
小儿非感染性发热 pediatric non-infectious fever 由免疫、肿瘤或中枢原因引起的非感染性发热 Fever caused by immune, neoplastic, or central nervous system conditions rather than infection. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
婴儿体温测量 infant temperature measurement 用腋温、肛温或耳温测量婴儿体温的操作 Taking an infant's temperature by the axillary, rectal, or tympanic route. 儿童发热 儿科门诊
发热家庭护理 home fever care 家长在家中护理发热儿童的方法，包括补水与观察 Care of a febrile child at home, including fluids and monitoring the child's condition. 儿童发热 儿科病房
婴幼儿脱水 infant dehydration 体内水分与电解质丢失超过摄入，导致细胞外液减少的状态 A state in which water and electrolyte losses exceed intake, reducing extracellular fluid volume. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科门诊
轻度脱水 mild dehydration 失水量约占体重百分之五以内的脱水 Dehydration with a fluid loss of up to about five percent of body weight. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科门诊
中度脱水 moderate dehydration 失水量约占体重百分之五到十的脱水 Dehydration with a fluid loss of about five to ten percent of body weight. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科门诊
重度脱水 severe dehydration 失水量超过体重百分之十，伴循环不良的脱水 Dehydration with a fluid loss over ten percent of body weight and impaired circulation. 儿童脱水与补液 抢救室
脱水程度评估 dehydration assessment 根据前囟、皮肤弹性、眼窝与尿量判断脱水轻重 Judging the severity of dehydration from the fontanelle, skin turgor, eyes, and urine output. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科门诊
等渗性脱水 isotonic dehydration 水与钠按比例丢失，血钠处于正常范围的脱水 Dehydration in which water and sodium are lost proportionally and serum sodium remains normal. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
低渗性脱水 hypotonic dehydration 失钠多于失水，血钠低于正常范围的脱水 Dehydration in which sodium loss exceeds water loss and serum sodium falls below normal. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
高渗性脱水 hypernatremic dehydration 失水多于失钠，血钠高于正常范围的脱水 Dehydration in which water loss exceeds sodium loss and serum sodium rises above normal. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
口服补液盐 oral rehydration salts 含葡萄糖与电解质的粉剂，按比例冲服纠正脱水 A powder of glucose and electrolytes dissolved in water to correct dehydration. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科门诊
口服补液 oral rehydration therapy 通过少量多次口服补液盐纠正轻中度脱水 Correcting mild to moderate dehydration with frequent small volumes of oral rehydration solution. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科门诊
静脉补液 intravenous rehydration 经静脉输注液体纠正脱水与电解质紊乱 Infusion of fluids through a vein to correct dehydration and electrolyte disturbance. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
小儿补液速度 pediatric fluid infusion rate 单位时间内输入液体的量，按体重与病情调整 The volume of fluid given per unit time, adjusted for weight and clinical condition. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
累积损失量 fluid deficit 发病后已丢失的液体总量，按体重下降估算 The total fluid lost since the illness began, estimated from weight loss. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
继续损失量 ongoing losses 补液期间继续丢失的液体，如呕吐与腹泻量 Fluid continuing to be lost during treatment, such as vomit and stool. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
生理需要量 maintenance fluid requirement 维持正常生理所需的水与电解质摄入量 The water and electrolyte intake needed to maintain normal body functions. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
前囟凹陷 sunken fontanelle 前囟向下凹陷，是婴幼儿脱水的体征 An inward depression of the anterior fontanelle, a sign of dehydration in infants. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科门诊
皮肤弹性评估 skin turgor assessment 捏起皮肤后回缩的速度，用于判断脱水程度 The speed at which pinched skin returns to normal, used to judge dehydration. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科门诊
眼窝凹陷 sunken eyes 眼球周围组织下陷，是脱水的常见体征 Inward sinking of the tissue around the eyes, a common sign of dehydration. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科门诊
黏膜干燥 dry mucous membranes 口腔黏膜失去湿润光泽，提示体液不足 Loss of the normal moist sheen of the oral mucosa, suggesting inadequate body fluid. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科门诊
哭时无泪 absent tears 婴儿哭泣时没有眼泪，提示明显脱水 Absence of tears when an infant cries, suggesting significant dehydration. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科门诊
尿量减少 decreased urine output 单位时间内尿量低于正常，是脱水的早期表现 Urine volume below normal for the time period, an early sign of dehydration. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
补液方案 rehydration plan 规定补液种类、速度与总量的个体化计划 An individualized plan specifying the type, rate, and total volume of fluid to be given. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
快速扩容 rapid volume expansion 短时间内快速输入等张液以纠正休克或重度脱水 Rapid infusion of isotonic fluid over a short period to correct shock or severe dehydration. 儿童脱水与补液 抢救室
鼻胃管补液 nasogastric rehydration 经鼻胃管分次注入补液盐纠正脱水 Giving rehydration solution in divided doses through a nasogastric tube to correct dehydration. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
口服补液失败 oral rehydration failure 口服补液后仍持续脱水或呕吐不止 Persistent dehydration or uncontrolled vomiting despite oral rehydration. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
补液后评估 post-rehydration assessment 补液后重新评估脱水体征与尿量的过程 Reassessment of dehydration signs and urine output after fluid replacement. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房
维持补液 maintenance fluid therapy 补充每日生理需要量与继续损失量的持续补液治疗 Continuous fluid therapy that supplies daily maintenance needs and replaces ongoing losses. 儿童脱水与补液 儿科病房

新生儿复苏 neonatal resuscitation 对出生时无呼吸或心跳微弱的新生儿进行的保暖、通气与胸外按压等抢救 Resuscitation of a newborn who does not breathe or has a poor heartbeat at birth, including warmth, ventilation, and chest compressions. 新生儿复苏 产房
新生儿窒息 neonatal asphyxia 出生时因缺氧导致呼吸循环受抑制的状态 Impaired breathing and circulation at birth caused by a lack of oxygen. 新生儿复苏 产房
Apgar评分 Apgar score 出生后一分钟与五分钟评估心率、呼吸、肌张力、反射与肤色的评分 A score of heart rate, breathing, muscle tone, reflexes, and color assessed at one and five minutes after birth. 新生儿复苏 产房 专有名词，A 大写，不得改为 APGAR
胎粪吸入 meconium aspiration 胎儿吸入污染羊水中的胎粪导致气道阻塞与肺炎 Inhalation of meconium-stained amniotic fluid that obstructs the airway and causes pneumonia. 新生儿复苏 产房
羊水胎粪污染 meconium-stained amniotic fluid 羊水混有胎粪，提示胎儿可能发生过缺氧 Amniotic fluid mixed with meconium, which may indicate that the fetus was hypoxic. 新生儿复苏 产房

zh: 新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征
text: 新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征 neonatal respiratory distress syndrome 肺表面活性物质不足导致的进行性呼吸困难 Progressive breathing difficulty in a newborn caused by a lack of pulmonary surfactant. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
新生儿呼吸暂停 neonatal apnea 新生儿呼吸停止超过二十秒或伴心率下降 Cessation of breathing for more than twenty seconds, or shorter pauses with bradycardia, in a newborn. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
正压通气 positive pressure ventilation 用面罩或气管导管给予正压帮助通气 Delivering breaths under positive pressure through a mask or endotracheal tube to support ventilation. 新生儿复苏 抢救室
儿童面罩通气 pediatric mask ventilation 用面罩密闭患者面部以提供辅助通气的操作 Assisted ventilation delivered through a mask sealed over the face. 新生儿复苏 抢救室
新生儿低体温 neonatal hypothermia 新生儿体温低于三十六点五度的状态 A newborn body temperature below 36.5 degrees Celsius. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
新生儿体温管理 neonatal thermal management 通过保暖设备与措施维持新生儿正常体温 Using warming devices and measures to keep a newborn at a normal body temperature. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
辐射保暖台 radiant warmer 用红外辐射给新生儿保温的开放式设备 An open bed that warms a newborn with infrared radiation. 新生儿复苏 产房
延迟脐带结扎 delayed cord clamping 出生后三十秒至一分钟后再结扎脐带的做法 Waiting thirty to sixty seconds after birth before clamping the umbilical cord. 新生儿复苏 产房
脐带结扎 cord clamping 胎儿娩出后夹闭并剪断脐带的标准处理步骤 Clamping and cutting the umbilical cord after birth. 新生儿复苏 产房
新生儿黄疸 neonatal jaundice 新生儿期胆红素升高导致皮肤与巩膜黄染 Yellowing of the skin and eyes in a newborn caused by raised bilirubin. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
新生儿溶血病 hemolytic disease of the newborn 母婴血型不合导致胎儿红细胞破坏的疾病 Destruction of fetal red blood cells caused by maternal-fetal blood group incompatibility. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
新生儿败血症 neonatal sepsis 新生儿期细菌侵入血循环引起的全身感染 A systemic bacterial infection in a newborn in which organisms enter the bloodstream. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
新生儿肺炎 neonatal pneumonia 新生儿期发生的肺部感染，常与羊水吸入或母体感染相关 Lung infection in a newborn, often related to aspiration of amniotic fluid or maternal infection. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
新生儿低血糖 neonatal hypoglycemia 新生儿血糖低于正常范围，可致嗜睡与惊厥 Blood glucose below the normal range in a newborn, which can cause lethargy and seizures. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
新生儿惊厥 neonatal seizure 新生儿期出现的抽搐，表现常不典型 A seizure in a newborn, often with subtle and atypical features. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
缺氧缺血性脑病 hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy 围产期缺氧缺血导致的新生儿脑损伤 Brain injury in a newborn caused by lack of oxygen and blood flow around the time of birth. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
亚低温治疗 neonatal therapeutic hypothermia 将体温降至三十三到三十四度以保护缺氧脑组织的治疗 Cooling the body to 33 to 34 degrees Celsius to protect the brain after hypoxia. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
新生儿转运 neonatal transport 把危重新生儿转至有重症监护条件医院的过程 Moving a critically ill newborn to a hospital with a neonatal intensive care unit. 新生儿复苏 急诊科
新生儿复苏流程 neonatal resuscitation algorithm 按评估、通气与按压顺序执行的新生儿复苏步骤 The stepwise sequence of assessment, ventilation, and compressions used in newborn resuscitation. 新生儿复苏 产房
新生儿评估 newborn assessment 出生后对呼吸、心率、肌张力与反应的整体检查 A structured check of breathing, heart rate, tone, and responsiveness after birth. 新生儿复苏 产房
新生儿重症监护 neonatal intensive care 对危重新生儿进行连续监护与治疗的病房 A unit that provides continuous monitoring and treatment for critically ill newborns. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
新生儿原始反射 primitive reflexes 新生儿期存在、随月龄增长逐渐消失的反射 Reflexes present in early infancy that disappear as the nervous system matures. 新生儿复苏 新生儿病房
儿童气道 pediatric airway 儿童特有的气道解剖与生理结构，头大舌大且气道狭窄 The airway of a child, characterized by a large head and tongue and a narrow, compliant airway. 儿童气道 抢救室
儿童气道评估 pediatric airway assessment 通过外观、声音与呼吸功判断儿童气道是否通畅 Judging whether a child's airway is patent from appearance, voice, and work of breathing. 儿童气道 抢救室
儿童气道梗阻 pediatric airway obstruction 气道部分或完全阻塞导致通气障碍 Partial or complete blockage of the airway that impairs ventilation. 儿童气道 抢救室
儿童气道异物 pediatric airway foreign body 误吸入气道的异物，儿童多见于坚果与玩具零件 A foreign object inhaled into the airway, often nuts or toy parts in children. 儿童气道 抢救室
完全性气道梗阻 complete airway obstruction 气道完全阻塞，患者不能说话与咳嗽 Total blockage of the airway in which the patient cannot speak or cough. 儿童气道 抢救室
不完全性气道梗阻 partial airway obstruction 气道部分阻塞，患者仍可咳嗽并常伴喘鸣 Partial blockage of the airway that may produce stridor or coughing. 儿童气道 抢救室
儿童海姆立克急救法 pediatric Heimlich maneuver 通过腹部冲击排出气道异物的急救手法 Abdominal thrusts used to clear a foreign body from the airway. 儿童气道 抢救室 专有名词 H 大写
儿童背部拍击 pediatric back blows 让患儿前倾并拍击肩胛之间以排出异物 Striking between the shoulder blades of a forward-leaning child to clear a foreign body. 儿童气道 抢救室
胸部冲击 chest thrusts 对婴儿用两指按压胸骨以排出气道异物 Two-finger compressions on the infant chest used to expel a foreign body. 儿童气道 抢救室
小儿喉痉挛 pediatric laryngospasm 喉部肌肉反射性痉挛导致声门关闭 Reflex spasm of the laryngeal muscles that closes the vocal cords. 儿童气道 抢救室
小儿喉水肿 pediatric laryngeal edema 喉黏膜水肿导致气道狭窄与声音嘶哑 Swelling of the laryngeal mucosa that narrows the airway and causes hoarseness. 儿童气道 抢救室
急性会厌炎 acute epiglottitis 会厌急性感染肿胀，可迅速导致气道梗阻 Acute infection and swelling of the epiglottis that can rapidly obstruct the airway. 儿童气道 急诊科
哮吼 croup 病毒引起的喉气管炎，表现为犬吠样咳嗽与喘鸣 Viral laryngotracheitis with a barking cough and inspiratory stridor. 儿童气道 儿科门诊
小儿支气管痉挛 pediatric bronchospasm 支气管平滑肌收缩导致气道狭窄与喘息 Contraction of bronchial smooth muscle that narrows the airway and causes wheezing. 儿童气道 抢救室
儿童气管插管 pediatric endotracheal intubation 将气管导管经声门置入气管以建立人工气道 Placing a tube through the vocal cords into the trachea to secure an artificial airway. 儿童气道 抢救室
新生儿气管插管 neonatal intubation 对新生儿经口置入气管导管以建立人工气道 Passing an endotracheal tube through the mouth of a newborn to secure the airway. 儿童气道 产房
儿童气管导管 pediatric endotracheal tube 置入气管内用于通气与吸引的导管 A tube placed in the trachea for ventilation and suction. 儿童气道 抢救室
儿童声门上气道 pediatric supraglottic airway 不进入气管、置于声门上方的通气装置 A ventilation device placed above the vocal cords without entering the trachea. 儿童气道 抢救室
儿童喉罩 pediatric laryngeal mask airway 置于喉部形成密封的声门上通气装置 A supraglottic device seated over the larynx to provide a seal for ventilation. 儿童气道 抢救室
儿童球囊面罩通气 pediatric bag-mask ventilation 用自膨球囊连接面罩挤压送气的辅助通气方法 Assisted ventilation using a self-inflating bag attached to a face mask. 儿童气道 抢救室
气管内吸引 endotracheal suctioning 经气管导管吸引分泌物以保持气道通畅 Clearing secretions through an endotracheal tube to keep the airway patent. 儿童气道 抢救室
儿童困难气道 pediatric difficult airway 儿童因解剖或病变导致插管困难的临床情况 A clinical situation in which intubation is difficult in a child because of anatomy or disease. 儿童气道 抢救室
喘鸣 stridor 上气道狭窄产生的高调吸气性呼吸音 A high-pitched inspiratory sound produced by narrowing of the upper airway. 儿童气道 儿科门诊
呻吟 grunting 呼气末声门部分关闭产生的短促声音，提示呼吸窘迫 A short sound at the end of expiration caused by partial closure of the glottis, indicating respiratory distress. 儿童气道 儿科门诊
鼻翼扇动 nasal flaring 呼吸费力时鼻翼随吸气张开的体征 Widening of the nostrils during inspiration, a sign of increased breathing effort. 儿童气道 儿科门诊
儿童气道管理 pediatric airway management 对儿童气道进行评估、开放、通气与保护的整套措施 The set of measures used to assess, open, ventilate, and protect a child's airway. 儿童气道 抢救室
气管软化 tracheomalacia 气管软骨发育不良导致呼气时气管塌陷 Weak tracheal cartilage that allows the airway to collapse during expiration. 儿童气道 儿科门诊
自杀风险 suicide risk 个体在未来一段时间内实施自杀的可能性 The likelihood that a person will attempt suicide within a given period. 自杀风险评估 急诊科
自伤 self-harm 故意伤害自己身体的行为，动机可含非自杀目的 Deliberate injury to one's own body, which may or may not be intended to end life. 自杀风险评估 急诊科
自杀意图 suicidal intent 个体希望结束自己生命的程度与决心 The degree of determination a person has to end their own life. 自杀风险评估 急诊科
绝望感 hopelessness 对未来失去希望的主观体验，是自杀的重要预测因素 A subjective sense that the future holds no hope, a strong predictor of suicide. 自杀风险评估 精神科门诊
无价值感 worthlessness 认为自己没有价值或是他人负担的感受 The feeling of being worthless or a burden to others. 自杀风险评估 精神科门诊
情绪低落 depressed mood 持续感到悲伤或兴趣减退的情绪状态 A persistent state of sadness or loss of interest. 自杀风险评估 精神科门诊
自杀危险因素 suicide risk factor 使个体实施自杀的可能性升高的相关因素 A factor that increases the likelihood that a person will attempt suicide. 自杀风险评估 急诊科
致命性评估 lethality assessment 评估自杀手段的致死性与实施可能性 Evaluating how lethal the chosen method is and how likely it is to be used. 自杀风险评估 急诊科
手段限制 means restriction 减少高危者获得自杀工具机会的预防措施 Reducing a high-risk person's access to the means of suicide. 自杀风险评估 精神科门诊
强制住院 involuntary admission 患者不同意时依据法律规定收治入院的做法 Admission to hospital without the patient's consent, as permitted by law. 自杀风险评估 精神科门诊
观察期 observation period 在精神科留观病房接受连续监护的时段 A period of continuous supervision in a psychiatric observation unit. 自杀风险评估 精神科病房
心理评估 psychological assessment 用访谈与量表评估心理状态与风险的过程 Assessing mental state and risk through interview and standardized scales. 自杀风险评估 精神科门诊
自杀筛查 suicide screening 用简短问题快速识别需要进一步评估的人 Using brief questions to identify people who need a fuller suicide risk evaluation. 自杀风险评估 急诊科
精神科急症 psychiatric emergency 需要立即处理的精神或行为异常状态 A mental or behavioral condition that requires immediate assessment and management. 精神科急症 急诊科
急性精神病性障碍 acute psychotic disorder 急性起病的精神病性症状群，现实检验能力受损 A sudden onset of psychotic symptoms with impaired reality testing. 精神科急症 急诊科
躁狂发作 manic episode 以情绪高涨、活动增多与睡眠需求减少为特征的发作 An episode of elevated mood, increased activity, and reduced need for sleep. 精神科急症 急诊科
紧张性木僵 catatonic stupor 对外界刺激反应显著减弱、少动少语的状态 A state of markedly reduced responsiveness, movement, and speech. 精神科急症 急诊科
紧张症 catatonia 以木僵、违拗与刻板动作为特征的精神运动综合征 A psychomotor syndrome with stupor, negativism, and stereotyped movements. 精神科急症 急诊科
惊恐发作 panic attack 突然出现的强烈恐惧，伴心悸、气短与濒死感 A sudden episode of intense fear with palpitations, shortness of breath, and a sense of impending death. 精神科急症 急诊科
惊恐障碍 panic disorder 反复出现不可预期的惊恐发作并担心再次发作 Recurrent unexpected panic attacks with persistent worry about further attacks. 精神科急症 精神科门诊
广泛性焦虑障碍 generalized anxiety disorder 长期过度担忧伴紧张不安与睡眠障碍 Persistent excessive worry with tension and sleep disturbance. 精神科急症 精神科门诊
精神科评估 psychiatric assessment 对精神症状、风险与功能状态的系统评估 A structured evaluation of psychiatric symptoms, risk, and level of functioning. 精神科急症 精神科门诊
精神状态检查 mental status examination 通过观察与问答评估外观、言语、情绪与认知 Assessing appearance, speech, mood, and cognition through observation and questioning. 精神科急症 精神科门诊
拒食 food refusal 拒绝进食的行为，可见于抑郁与紧张症 Refusal to eat, which may occur in depression or catatonia. 精神科急症 精神科病房
逃跑风险 elopement risk 患者擅自离院的可能性，需评估与防范 The likelihood that a patient will leave the ward without permission, requiring assessment and prevention. 精神科急症 精神科病房
身体约束 physical restraint 用软带等器具限制患者身体活动的措施 Using a device to limit a patient's physical movement. 约束与保护 精神科病房
约束用具 restraint device 用于限制活动的软带、手套或固定带 A soft strap, mitt, or belt used to limit movement. 约束与保护 精神科病房
约束评估 restraint assessment 使用约束前评估必要性与替代方案的过程 Evaluating the need for restraint and alternatives before it is used. 约束与保护 精神科病房
约束并发症 restraint complication 约束引起的压疮、神经损伤或窒息等问题 Problems caused by restraint, such as pressure sores, nerve injury, or asphyxia. 约束与保护 精神科病房
约束解除 restraint discontinuation 达到条件后停止约束并观察患者反应 Ending restraint once criteria are met and observing the patient's response. 约束与保护 精神科病房
约束监测 restraint monitoring 约束期间定时观察生命体征与约束部位 Regular checks of vital signs and the restrained area during restraint. 约束与保护 精神科病房
约束替代方案 restraint alternative 用以避免身体约束的沟通、环境或药物措施 Communication, environmental, or drug measures used to avoid physical restraint. 约束与保护 精神科病房
隔离室 seclusion room 将患者单独安置以减少刺激与冲突的房间 A room where a patient is placed alone to reduce stimulation and conflict. 约束与保护 精神科病房
保护性约束 protective restraint 以防止自伤或坠床为目的实施的约束 Restraint used to prevent self-injury or falling out of bed. 约束与保护 精神科病房
约束巡查 restraint rounds 按固定间隔巡视约束患者的护理流程 Scheduled nursing checks on patients who are restrained. 约束与保护 精神科病房
约束相关伤害 restraint-related injury 约束过程中发生的皮肤、神经或骨骼损伤 Skin, nerve, or bone injury occurring during restraint. 约束与保护 精神科病房
暴力降级 de-escalation 用语言与环境保护降低暴力风险的技术 Verbal and environmental techniques that reduce the risk of violence. 约束与保护 精神科病房
药物约束 chemical restraint 用药物快速控制危险行为的精神科措施 Using medication to rapidly control dangerous behavior. 约束与保护 精神科病房
约束医嘱 restraint order 医生开具的约束使用方式与时限医嘱 A doctor's order specifying restraint use and its time limit. 约束与保护 精神科病房
约束告知 restraint notification 向患者与家属说明约束原因与权利 Explaining the reason for restraint and the patient's rights to patient and family. 约束与保护 精神科病房
精神科病房安全 psychiatric ward safety 病房内防自杀、防外逃与防暴力的管理措施 Ward measures to prevent suicide, elopement, and violence. 约束与保护 精神科病房
危险物品排查 contraband search 检查并收走可能用于自伤或伤人的物品 Checking for and removing items that could be used for self-harm or assault. 约束与保护 精神科病房
患者尊严 patient dignity 在约束与照护中尊重患者人格与隐私 Respecting a patient's personhood and privacy during restraint and care. 约束与保护 精神科病房
权利告知 rights notification 向患者说明其就医、申诉与拒绝治疗的权利 Telling a patient about the rights to care, complaint, and refusal of treatment. 约束与保护 精神科病房
约束后复盘 post-restraint review 约束结束后团队回顾原因与改进措施 A team review of the cause and improvement measures after restraint ends. 约束与保护 精神科病房
约束事件报告 restraint incident report 记录约束过程与不良事件经过的书面报告 A report documenting the restraint episode and any adverse events. 约束与保护 精神科病房
家庭暴力 domestic violence 家庭成员之间发生的身体、精神或性方面的伤害行为 Harmful physical, psychological, or sexual behavior between family members. 家庭暴力识别 急诊科
亲密伴侣暴力 intimate partner violence 伴侣之间发生的身体、性或情感伤害行为 Physical, sexual, or emotional harm between intimate partners. 家庭暴力识别 急诊科
儿童虐待 child abuse 对儿童实施的身体、情感或性伤害以及忽视 Physical, emotional, or sexual harm to a child, including neglect. 家庭暴力识别 急诊科
忽视 neglect 照护者未满足儿童或老人基本需要的行为 Failure of a caregiver to meet a dependent person's basic needs. 家庭暴力识别 急诊科
身体虐待 physical abuse 造成可见损伤的殴打、约束或烫伤等行为 Beating, restraint, or burning that causes visible injury. 家庭暴力识别 急诊科
情感虐待 emotional abuse 威胁、羞辱或长期贬低造成心理伤害的行为 Threats, humiliation, or persistent belittling that cause psychological harm. 家庭暴力识别 急诊科
性虐待 sexual abuse 未经同意的性接触、性剥削或性胁迫行为 Non-consensual sexual contact, sexual exploitation, or sexual coercion. 家庭暴力识别 急诊科
经济控制 economic abuse 控制对方钱财以维持支配地位的行为 Controlling a partner's money in order to maintain power. 家庭暴力识别 急诊科
暴力筛查 violence screening 对就诊者常规询问是否遭受暴力的流程 Routinely asking patients whether they have experienced violence. 家庭暴力识别 急诊科

收费处 cashier 办理缴费、结算与发票打印的窗口或部门 The desk or department that handles payment, settlement, and invoices. 费用与保险 收费处
发票 invoice 记载实际收费金额、可用于报销与理赔的正式票据 A formal receipt showing the amount charged, used for reimbursement and claims. 费用与保险 收费处
医保卡 insurance card 用于医保身份识别与费用结算的卡片或电子凭证 A card or electronic credential used to identify insurance status and settle costs. 费用与保险 收费处
境外保险 overseas insurance 由患者本国或国际保险公司承保、覆盖境外就医的保险 Insurance from the patient's home country or an international insurer covering care abroad. 费用与保险 保险窗口
旅行保险 travel insurance 为旅行期间突发疾病或意外提供医疗费用保障的短期保险 Short-term insurance covering medical costs for illness or injury during travel. 费用与保险 保险窗口
保险直付 direct billing 医院与保险公司直接结算、患者无需先垫付的付费方式 An arrangement where the hospital bills the insurer directly and the patient pays nothing upfront. 费用与保险 保险窗口
保险公司 insurer 承保医疗风险并按合同承担赔付责任的机构 The organization that underwrites medical risk and pays claims under contract. 费用与保险 保险窗口
保单 insurance policy 载明保险责任、保额与免责条款的保险合同文件 The contract document stating coverage, limits, and exclusions. 费用与保险 保险窗口
理赔 claim 投保人向保险公司申请赔付医疗费用的程序 The procedure by which the insured applies to the insurer for reimbursement. 费用与保险 保险窗口
理赔材料 claim documents 申请保险赔付所需的诊断证明、发票、费用清单与病历等文件 Documents such as diagnosis certificate, invoice, itemized bill, and records required for a claim. 费用与保险 保险窗口
费用预估 cost estimate 治疗前对可能发生的总费用给出的初步测算 A preliminary calculation of likely total costs before treatment. 费用与保险 谈话室
欠费 outstanding balance 患者尚未结清、仍挂在医院账上的医疗费用金额 The amount of medical charges the patient has not yet paid. 费用与保险 收费处
催缴通知 payment reminder 提醒患者或家属尽快结清欠费的书面通知 A written notice asking the patient or family to settle unpaid charges promptly. 费用与保险 收费处
费用减免 fee waiver 对经济困难患者按规定减收或免收部分医疗费用的安排 An arrangement to reduce or waive charges for patients in financial hardship. 费用与保险 医务处
医疗救助 medical assistance 政府对无力支付医疗费用的困难群众提供的兜底性补助 Government support for people unable to pay for necessary medical care. 费用与保险 医务处
慈善援助 charitable assistance 由慈善组织或基金为困难患者提供的资金或物资支持 Funds or supplies provided to needy patients by charities or foundations. 费用与保险 医务处
费用告知 cost disclosure 在诊疗前向患者说明预计费用与自费项目的义务 The duty to explain expected costs and self-pay items before treatment. 费用与保险 谈话室
价格公示 price transparency 医疗机构公开主要服务与药品价格、接受社会监督的做法 The practice of publishing prices of main services and drugs for public scrutiny. 费用与保险 收费处
领事馆 consulate 一国派驻他国城市、办理签证与领事事务的机构 An office set up in a foreign city to handle visas and consular affairs. 领事协助与通知 领事馆
大使馆 embassy 一国派驻他国的最高外交代表机构 The highest diplomatic mission of one state in another. 领事协助与通知 领事馆
通知家属 notifying family 在患者病情变化或身份确认后及时联系其家属的过程 The process of promptly contacting relatives after a change in condition or identification. 领事协助与通知 护士站
紧急联系人 emergency contact 在紧急情况下可代为联络与决策的指定联系人 A designated person to be contacted and to make decisions in an emergency. 领事协助与通知 分诊台
外交部 ministry of foreign affairs 主管国家对外事务、负责海外公民保护的中央政府机关 The central government body in charge of foreign affairs and protection of citizens abroad. 领事协助与通知 领事馆
外事部门 foreign affairs office 医院或地方政府中负责涉外事务协调的职能部门 The department in a hospital or local government that coordinates foreign-related affairs. 领事协助与通知 医务处
外籍患者 foreign patient 不具有本国国籍、在本国境内接受诊疗的人员 A person without local nationality receiving care within the country. 领事协助与通知 分诊台
监护人通知 guardian notification 对未成年或无行为能力患者，向其监护人告知情况的程序 The procedure of informing the guardian of a minor or an incapacitated patient. 领事协助与通知 护士站
学校通知 school notification 对在校学生患者，按需要通知其学校或辅导员的程序 The procedure of informing a student patient's school or counselor when needed. 领事协助与通知 护士站
旅行团 tour group 由旅行社组织、统一行程的境外游客团体 A group of travelers organized by an agency on a fixed itinerary. 领事协助与通知 分诊台
陪同人员 accompanying person 陪伴患者就诊、可协助沟通与照护的人员 A person who accompanies the patient and helps with communication and care. 领事协助与通知 分诊台
联络官 liaison officer 负责在机构之间传递信息、协调事务的人员 A person responsible for passing information and coordinating between organizations. 领事协助与通知 医务处
报案 report to police 就盗窃、伤害或死亡等事件向公安机关正式报告 To formally report theft, assault, death, or similar events to the police. 领事协助与通知 警务室
警方通报 police notification 医疗机构依法向公安机关报告特定事件的行为 A medical institution's lawful report of defined events to the police. 领事协助与通知 医务处
家属联络 family liaison 指定专人负责与患者家属保持信息沟通的安排 An arrangement assigning a staff member to keep the family informed. 领事协助与通知 家属谈话
华侨 overseas Chinese 长期居住在国外但保留中国国籍的公民 A Chinese citizen who lives abroad while retaining Chinese nationality. 领事协助与通知 分诊台
联络渠道 contact channel 与家属、使领馆或警方保持联系的指定电话或邮箱 A designated phone or email used to stay in touch with family, consulates, or police. 领事协助与通知 医务处
死亡判定 determination of death 依据心跳呼吸停止或脑功能丧失等标准确认个体死亡的过程 The process of confirming death by criteria such as cessation of circulation or brain function. 死亡判定与遗体处理 ICU 死亡判定须由具备资质的医师完成。
临床死亡 clinical death 心跳与呼吸停止但组织细胞尚未发生不可逆死亡的阶段 The stage when heartbeat and breathing stop but cells have not yet died irreversibly. 死亡判定与遗体处理 抢救室 临床死亡后仍有抢救时间窗。
生物学死亡 biological death 组织细胞发生不可逆死亡、复苏不再可能的阶段 The stage when cells have died irreversibly and resuscitation is no longer possible. 死亡判定与遗体处理 ICU 生物学死亡是停止复苏的依据之一。
心死亡 cardiac death 以心跳不可逆停止为判定依据的死亡类型 Death determined by irreversible cessation of heartbeat. 死亡判定与遗体处理 抢救室 心死亡与脑死亡的判定路径不同。
遗体保存 preservation of remains 通过冷藏或防腐措施延缓遗体腐败的处理 Treatment such as refrigeration or embalming that slows decomposition. 死亡判定与遗体处理 太平间 遗体保存温度须有记录。
遗体转运 transport of remains 在院内外或跨境转移遗体的合规流程 The regulated process of moving remains within or between facilities, including across borders. 死亡判定与遗体处理 太平间 跨境遗体转运需检疫与领事文件。
尸斑 livor mortis 死后血液下沉在低垂部位形成的紫红色斑块 Purplish patches formed as blood settles in dependent areas after death. 死亡判定与遗体处理 太平间 尸斑分布可提示遗体是否被移动。
尸体腐败 decomposition 死后组织被自身酶与细菌分解的过程 The breakdown of tissues by endogenous enzymes and bacteria after death. 死亡判定与遗体处理 太平间 高温环境会加快尸体腐败。
家属认领 family identification 由近亲属确认遗体身份并办理接收手续的过程 The process by which close relatives confirm the identity of remains and take custody. 死亡判定与遗体处理 太平间 家属认领须核验身份与关系证明。
死亡病例讨论 mortality review 对死亡病例的诊疗过程进行集体回顾与质量分析的制度 A structured team review of the care provided in a death to assess quality. 死亡判定与遗体处理 医务处 死亡病例讨论应在一周内完成。
法医鉴定 forensic examination 由法医对死因、损伤与死亡方式作出的专业判断 Professional determination by a forensic expert of cause, injuries, and manner of death. 死亡判定与遗体处理 医务处 法医鉴定结论是后续处理的重要依据。
到院死亡 dead on arrival 患者送达医院时已无生命体征、经确认死亡的情形 The situation in which a patient arrives without vital signs and is confirmed dead. 死亡判定与遗体处理 抢救室 到院死亡仍需记录抢救过程。
濒死期 agonal stage 死亡前呼吸循环逐渐衰竭、意识丧失的短暂阶段 The brief period before death when breathing and circulation fail and consciousness fades. 死亡判定与遗体处理 ICU 濒死期可能出现濒死呼吸。
户籍注销 household registration cancellation 家属凭死亡证明到公安机关注销死者户口的手续 The procedure by which the family cancels the deceased's household registration with a death certificate. 死亡判定与遗体处理 户籍窗口 户籍注销需在火化前办理。
器官移植 organ transplantation 将供者器官植入受者体内以替代衰竭器官的手术 Surgery that places a donor organ into a recipient to replace a failing organ. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 器官移植须在具备资质的中心开展。
捐献意愿 donation intent 本人生前或家属表达的同意捐献器官的意思 The expressed wish, by the person or family, to donate organs. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 捐献意愿应以书面形式记录。
潜在捐献者 potential donor 符合捐献医学条件、尚未完成评估的危重患者 A critically ill patient who meets initial medical criteria but has not yet been fully assessed. 器官捐献沟通 ICU 潜在捐献者须先完成脑死亡判定。
脑死亡捐献 donation after brain death 在脑死亡判定成立后实施的器官捐献 Organ donation carried out after brain death has been determined. 器官捐献沟通 ICU 脑死亡捐献是国内主要捐献类型。
循环死亡捐献 donation after circulatory death 在心肺功能不可逆停止后实施的器官捐献 Organ donation carried out after irreversible cessation of circulation. 器官捐献沟通 ICU 循环死亡捐献对热缺血时间要求严格。
活体捐献 living donation 健康成年人为亲属捐出一个肾脏或部分肝脏等的行为 A healthy adult donating a kidney or part of the liver, usually to a relative. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 活体捐献须经伦理委员会审批。
捐献同意书 donation consent form 由捐献者本人或家属签署、载明捐献范围的书面文件 A document signed by the donor or family stating the scope of donation. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 捐献同意书须与知情同意分开签署。
等待名单 waiting list 登记等待器官移植、按规则排序的患者名单 A registry of patients ranked by rules while awaiting transplantation. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 进入等待名单需完成全面评估。
组织配型 tissue typing 检测供受者人类白细胞抗原等相容性的实验室检查 Laboratory testing of donor-recipient compatibility such as human leukocyte antigens. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 组织配型结果影响排斥风险。
排斥反应 rejection 受者免疫系统攻击移植器官导致的损伤反应 Immune attack by the recipient on the transplanted organ. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 排斥反应分超急性、急性与慢性。
捐献协调员 donation coordinator 负责发现潜在捐献者、与家属沟通并协调流程的专业人员 A professional who identifies potential donors, talks with families, and coordinates the process. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 捐献协调员不得参与临床救治决策。
捐献伦理 donation ethics 围绕自愿、无偿、公正分配与知情同意的伦理原则 Ethical principles covering voluntariness, non-payment, fair allocation, and informed consent. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 捐献伦理要求避免任何形式的诱导。
无偿捐献 unpaid donation 捐献者及其家属不因捐献获得任何金钱或等价补偿的安排 An arrangement in which the donor or family receives no money or equivalent for donating. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 无偿捐献是器官来源合法的基本前提。
捐献拒绝 donation refusal 患者家属明确表示不同意捐献的决定 A clear decision by the patient's family not to donate. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 捐献拒绝不影响后续医疗照护。
角膜捐献 corneal donation 捐献眼角膜用于角膜移植、帮助患者复明的行为 Donating the cornea for transplantation to restore a recipient's sight. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 角膜捐献可在心死亡后进行。
遗体捐献 body donation 将遗体捐给医学院校用于教学与科研的行为 Donating a body to a medical school for teaching and research. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 遗体捐献须由本人或家属签署同意。
器官保存 organ preservation 用低温或灌注液维持离体器官活力的处理 Maintaining the viability of a removed organ by cooling or perfusion solutions. 器官捐献沟通 手术室 器官保存时间决定移植成功率。
器官获取手术 procurement surgery 在捐献者手术室内取出可移植器官的外科操作 The surgical procedure to remove transplantable organs from a donor. 器官捐献沟通 手术室 器官获取手术须在独立手术间进行。
移植中心 transplant center 具备器官移植资质与团队的定点医疗机构 An accredited institution with the qualifications and team to perform transplants. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 移植中心名单由卫生行政部门公布。
受者 recipient 接受他人捐献器官并接受移植手术的患者，其身份对捐献方保密 The patient who receives a transplanted organ. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 受者信息对捐献方严格保密。
供者 donor 提供器官、组织或血液用于移植或输注的人 A person who provides organs, tissues, or blood for transplantation or transfusion. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 供者与受者信息实行双盲。
免疫抑制 immunosuppression 用药物抑制受者免疫反应以减少排斥的治疗 Treatment with drugs that suppress the recipient's immune response to reduce rejection. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 免疫抑制治疗需终身监测药物浓度。
器官获取组织 organ procurement organization 负责器官捐献发现、评估与获取的专门机构 A specialized organization responsible for donor identification, assessment, and procurement. 器官捐献沟通 医务处 器官获取组织须具备国家认定资质。
移植评估 transplant assessment 对候选受者身体状况与手术风险的系统评价 A systematic evaluation of a candidate recipient's condition and surgical risk. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 移植评估包括心、肺、肝肾功能。
捐献登记 donation registration 本人生前在官方系统登记器官捐献意愿的行为 Registering one's wish to donate organs in an official system while alive. 器官捐献沟通 捐献谈话 捐献登记可在官方平台在线完成。
宗教信仰 religious belief 个人对超自然力量与宗教教义的信奉与践行 A person's faith in and practice of a religion's teachings. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 宗教信仰应记录在护理评估中。
宗教禁忌 religious taboo 宗教规范禁止的行为或物品，医疗操作须予避让 Acts or objects forbidden by a religion that medical care should avoid. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 宗教禁忌涉及输血、饮食与遗体处理。
饮食禁忌 dietary restriction 因宗教、文化或健康原因不能摄入的食物 Foods a person avoids for religious, cultural, or health reasons. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 饮食禁忌须在入院评估时确认。
清真饮食 halal diet 符合伊斯兰教规、不含猪肉与酒精的饮食 Food that complies with Islamic rules and excludes pork and alcohol. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 清真饮食须使用专用餐具与操作台。
素食 vegetarian diet 不摄入肉类或以植物性食物为主的饮食方式 A diet that excludes meat or is based mainly on plant foods. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 长期素食者需关注蛋白与维生素摄入。
斋月 Ramadan 伊斯兰教历九月，成年穆斯林白天禁食的月份 The ninth Islamic month, when adult Muslims fast during daylight. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 斋月期间用药时间需与患者商量。
斋戒 fasting 按宗教规定在一定时段内禁食禁饮的行为 Abstaining from food and drink for a set period as a religious practice. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 斋戒期间须评估低血糖与脱水风险。
礼拜 prayer 穆斯林每日定时面向麦加进行的宗教功课 The ritual prayer Muslims perform at set times facing Mecca. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 礼拜时间应尽量不安排治疗。
朝觐方向 qibla direction 穆斯林礼拜时面向麦加克尔白的方向 The direction of the Kaaba in Mecca that Muslims face during prayer. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 病床朝向可与朝觐方向协调。
安息日 Sabbath 犹太教与部分基督教派规定停止工作的圣日 The holy day of rest observed in Judaism and some Christian traditions. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 安息日期间非紧急操作可与患者商量。
割礼 circumcision 按宗教或文化习俗切除部分或全部包皮的行为 Partial or complete removal of the foreskin for religious or cultural reasons. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 已行割礼者导尿与查体时需注意。
输血拒绝 transfusion refusal 因宗教信念明确拒绝接受血液制品的态度 A firm refusal of blood products because of religious conviction. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 输血拒绝须签署知情拒绝文书。
耶和华见证人 Jehovah's Witness 因教义拒绝输血、需特别告知的基督教派别 A Christian denomination that refuses transfusion and requires specific disclosure. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 耶和华见证人常拒绝全血与部分成分血。
伊斯兰教 Islam 以古兰经与圣训为经典的宗教，信徒称穆斯林 The religion based on the Quran and Hadith, whose followers are Muslims. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 伊斯兰教患者饮食、礼拜与性别照护有要求。
基督教 Christianity 以耶稣基督为核心的宗教，含天主教与新教等派别 The religion centered on Jesus Christ, including Catholicism and Protestantism. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房 基督教患者临终常需牧师祷告。

导诊单 guidance slip 写明患者下一步去哪个科室、做哪项检查的纸质指引单 A printed slip stating the patient's next department and the test to be done. 导医与投诉 导医台
满意度回访 satisfaction follow-up 患者离院后由医院电话或短信征询就医体验与意见的环节 A post-visit call or message asking patients about their experience and suggestions. 导医与投诉 电话
陪护告知 caregiver briefing 向陪护人员交代患者病情、护理要点与注意事项的沟通过程 The briefing given to a caregiver on the patient's condition, care points and precautions. 陪护与探视 病房
探视预约 visiting appointment 为控制病房人数而要求家属提前登记预约探视时段的做法 Advance booking of visiting time slots to limit the number of people in the ward. 陪护与探视 病房
转诊对接 referral liaison 接收医院与转出医院之间就床位、病情与转运安排进行的对接协调 Coordination between receiving and referring hospitals on beds, condition and transport. 转诊接收 医生办公室
急救响应时间 emergency response time 从接到呼救电话到急救人员到达现场所用的时间 The time from receiving the emergency call to the arrival of responders on scene. 急救呼叫与出车 调度中心
复苏体位 recovery position 将恢复自主呼吸的患者置于侧卧、头后仰的体位以保持气道通畅 A side-lying position with the head tilted back to keep the airway open in a breathing patient. 复苏后处理 抢救室
按压分数 chest compression fraction 心肺复苏全程中实际进行胸外按压的时间所占比例 The proportion of resuscitation time during which chest compressions are actually delivered. 心肺复苏 抢救室
抢救车 crash cart 集中存放急救药品、气道器材与除颤设备的可移动推车 A mobile cart stocked with resuscitation drugs, airway equipment and defibrillation devices. 急救药物 抢救室

zh: 急救优先分级调度系统
text: 急救优先分级调度系统 medical priority dispatch system 按呼救者主诉与回答逐级提问、判定调度优先级的标准化电话调度系统 A standardized telephone triage system that sets dispatch priority through scripted questions. 院前转运与交接 调度中心
急救志愿者 emergency volunteer 经基础急救培训、在专业人员到达前提供现场协助的志愿人员 Trained volunteers who assist at the scene before professional responders arrive. 院前转运与交接 现场
第一响应者 first responder 最先到达现场、具备基础急救能力的处置人员 The first trained person to reach the scene and provide basic emergency care. 院前转运与交接 现场
院前镇痛 prehospital analgesia 急救人员在转运途中对剧痛患者实施的镇痛处理 Pain relief given by emergency crews during transport for patients in severe pain. 急救药物 救护车
费用担保函 letter of guarantee 由保险公司或机构出具、承诺承担患者医疗费用的书面担保文件 A written undertaking by an insurer or organization to pay for a patient's treatment. 费用与保险 收费处
口译伦理 interpreting ethics 口译员在医疗场景中应遵守的保密、中立、准确与不越界行事的职业准则 Professional standards of confidentiality, neutrality, accuracy and role boundaries for medical interpreters. 翻译与口译服务 诊室
语言权 language rights 患者在就医过程中获得其能理解的语言服务、不因语言障碍被剥夺诊疗的权利 The right of patients to language services they understand so care is not denied by language barriers. 翻译与口译服务 诊室
文化能力 cultural competence 医护人员识别并尊重患者文化背景、据此调整沟通与照护的能力 The ability of clinicians to recognize and respect cultural background and adapt communication and care. 宗教与文化禁忌 病房
预立照护计划 advance care planning 患者在具备决定能力时与医护及家属共同讨论未来照护意愿的过程 A process in which a capable patient discusses future care preferences with clinicians and family. 知情同意 病房
不良事件上报 adverse event reporting 医务人员将诊疗中发生的非预期伤害事件按流程上报的制度性动作 The formal reporting of unintended harm occurring during care, following institutional procedure. 医疗免责与投诉 医务处
产后抑郁筛查 postpartum depression screening 用标准化量表在产后对产妇进行抑郁风险筛查的流程 Screening for depression risk after childbirth using a validated scale. 心理危机干预 病房
急救包 first aid kit 装有止血敷料、绷带与基础器械、供现场初步处置的便携包 A portable kit with dressing materials, bandages and basic instruments for initial on-scene care. 急救药物 救护车
口译预约 interpreting request 患者或科室提前登记所需语种、时间与场景以安排口译员的服务流程 A booking process in which patients or departments register language, time and setting to arrange an interpreter. 翻译与口译服务 导医台
输液港 implantable venous access port 完全植入皮下、可长期反复使用的中心静脉输液装置 A fully implanted central venous device that allows repeated long-term access. 静脉通路 病房
直升机停机坪 helipad 医院内供救援直升机起降、配有标识与安全区的场地 A marked landing area at a hospital with clearance and safety zones for rescue helicopters. 院前转运与交接 停机坪
气管切开 tracheostomy 在颈前气管壁切开并置入套管、建立长期人工气道的操作 Creation of an opening in the anterior trachea with tube placement to establish a long-term airway. 外科气道 抢救室
高压氧治疗 hyperbaric oxygen therapy 在高于一个大气压的舱内吸入纯氧、以提高血氧分压的治疗方法 Breathing pure oxygen inside a chamber at greater than atmospheric pressure to raise arterial oxygen tension. 氧疗与呼吸支持参数 高压氧舱
片剂 tablet 药物与辅料压制成的扁平固体制剂，供口服使用 A flat solid dosage form made by compressing drug with excipients for oral use. 剂型与规格 用药交代
胶囊剂 capsule 药物装入空心胶囊壳中制成的口服固体制剂 An oral solid dosage form in which the drug is enclosed in a hollow capsule shell. 剂型与规格 用药交代 缓释或肠溶胶囊不可打开，否则失去控释作用
缓释片 extended-release tablet 在体内缓慢释放药物、减少服药次数并平稳血药浓度的片剂 A tablet that releases the drug slowly to reduce dosing frequency and smooth plasma levels. 剂型与规格 用药交代 掰开、碾碎或咀嚼会造成剂量突释，可能中毒
控释片 controlled-release tablet 以恒定速度释放药物、使血药浓度长期稳定的片剂 A tablet that releases the drug at a controlled rate to keep plasma levels stable over time. 剂型与规格 用药交代
肠溶片 enteric-coated tablet 外包肠溶衣、在胃内不崩解而到肠道才释放的片剂 A tablet coated to resist gastric acid and release the drug in the intestine. 剂型与规格 用药交代 与质子泵抑制剂同服可能破坏肠溶衣
分散片 dispersible tablet 可在水中迅速分散后服用的片剂，便于吞咽困难者使用 A tablet that disperses rapidly in water before use, which helps patients who have difficulty swallowing. 剂型与规格 用药交代
口崩片 orally disintegrating tablet 放在舌面数秒内即崩解、无需饮水即可服用的片剂 A tablet that disintegrates on the tongue within seconds and can be taken without water. 剂型与规格 用药交代 取出后应立即服用，避免吸潮
颗粒剂 granules 药物与辅料制成的干燥颗粒，冲水后口服的剂型 A dry granule formulation of drug and excipients that is dissolved in water before oral use. 剂型与规格 用药交代
口服溶液 oral solution 药物溶解于适宜溶剂中、供口服的液体制剂 A liquid preparation in which the drug is dissolved in a suitable solvent for oral use. 剂型与规格 用药交代
混悬液 suspension 难溶药物以微粒分散在液体中、需摇匀后服用的制剂 A preparation in which insoluble drug particles are dispersed in a liquid and must be shaken before use. 剂型与规格 用药交代
注射剂 injection 供注射进入体内使用的无菌药物制剂 A sterile drug preparation that is intended for administration by injection. 剂型与规格 抢救用药
粉针剂 powder for injection 药物以无菌粉末形式封装、临用前溶解后注射的制剂 A sterile powder that must be dissolved before it can be given by injection. 剂型与规格 配液中心
雾化液 nebulizer solution 专供雾化吸入使用、经雾化器变成气溶胶的药液 A liquid formulated for nebulization, converted into an aerosol by a nebulizer for inhalation. 剂型与规格 雾化室
栓剂 suppository 塞入直肠或阴道后在体温下融化或溶解的固体制剂 A solid dosage form that melts or dissolves at body temperature after insertion into the rectum or vagina. 剂型与规格 用药交代
贴剂 transdermal patch 贴于皮肤上经皮持续吸收药物的制剂 A preparation applied to the skin that delivers drug continuously through the skin. 剂型与规格 用药交代 旧贴剂仍含药物，须对折后丢弃
滴眼液 eye drops 滴入眼内用于局部治疗的无菌液体制剂 A sterile liquid preparation instilled into the eye for local treatment. 剂型与规格 用药交代
软膏剂 ointment 药物与油脂性或水溶性基质混合、供外用的半固体制剂 A semisolid preparation of drug in an oily or water-soluble base for topical use. 剂型与规格 用药交代
药品规格 drug strength 单位制剂中所含有效成分的量，如每片多少毫克 The amount of active ingredient in a unit dosage form, such as milligrams per tablet. 剂型与规格 门诊诊室
复方制剂 fixed-dose combination 含两种或以上有效成分的单一制剂 A single preparation that contains two or more active ingredients in a fixed ratio. 剂型与规格 用药交代 复方制剂易造成重复用药，须核对成分
剂量 dose 一次或单位时间内给予患者的药量 The amount of drug given to a patient at one time or over a defined period. 剂量与频次 用药交代
每日一次 once daily 每二十四小时给药一次，通常在固定时间服用 Administration of a drug once every twenty-four hours, usually at a fixed time. 剂量与频次 用药交代 qd 易与 qid 混淆，手写医嘱须写全
每日两次 twice daily 每十二小时给药一次，通常早晚各一次 Administration of a drug twice every twenty-four hours, usually in the morning and evening. 剂量与频次 用药交代
每日三次 three times daily 每二十四小时给药三次，通常随三餐安排 Administration of a drug three times every twenty-four hours, usually with meals. 剂量与频次 用药交代
每八小时一次 every 8 hours 严格每隔八小时给药一次，需昼夜连续执行 Administration at strict eight-hour intervals, continuing through both day and night. 剂量与频次 护理记录
必要时 as needed 根据症状需要临时给药，不设固定时间 Administration given only when symptoms require it, without a fixed schedule. 剂量与频次 用药交代 须写明二十四小时上限，避免过量
立即一次 stat dose 医嘱下达后须立即给予的单次剂量 A single dose to be given immediately after the order is written. 剂量与频次 抢救用药
睡前一次 at bedtime 每晚临睡前给药一次，常用于镇静催眠药 A single dose given at bedtime, often used for sedatives and hypnotics. 剂量与频次 用药交代
日剂量 daily dose 二十四小时内给予患者的总用药量 The total amount of drug given to a patient within twenty-four hours. 剂量与频次 用药交代
剂量单位 dosage unit 表示药量的计量单位，如毫克、毫升、单位 The unit in which a dose is expressed, such as milligrams, millilitres, or units. 剂量与频次 用药交代 mg 与 μg 混淆是常见用药错误
微克 microgram 一百万分之一克的药量单位，常用于强效药物 A unit of mass equal to one millionth of a gram, often used for potent drugs. 剂量与频次 用药交代 计量单位用符号 μg 表示，不是缩写，勿与 mg 混淆
国际单位 international unit 按生物效价标定的药量单位，用于维生素与激素类药 A unit based on biological activity, used for vitamins and hormones. 剂量与频次 用药交代
皮内注射 intradermal injection 将少量药液注入表皮与真皮之间的给药方式，多用于皮试 Administration of a small volume into the dermis, mainly used for skin testing. 给药途径 急诊药房
外用局部给药 topical administration 将药物涂敷于皮肤或黏膜表面、起局部作用的给药方式 Administration of a drug to the skin or a mucosal surface for a local effect. 给药途径 用药交代
鼻饲给药 nasogastric administration 经鼻胃管将药物送入胃内的给药方式 Administration of a drug into the stomach through a nasogastric tube. 给药途径 用药交代 缓释片与肠溶片不可碾碎鼻饲
经皮给药 transdermal administration 药物经皮肤吸收进入血液循环的给药方式 Administration in which a drug is absorbed through the skin into the systemic circulation. 给药途径 用药交代
用法用量 dosage and administration 药品说明书中关于如何使用与给多少的规定 The instructions in a product label on how and in what amount to use a drug. 用法与服用时间 用药交代
餐前服用 before meals 在进食前一定时间服药的用法，通常提前三十分钟 Taking a drug a set time before eating, usually about thirty minutes beforehand. 用法与服用时间 用药交代
餐后服用 after meals 在进食后一定时间服药的用法，通常为餐后半小时 Taking a drug a set time after eating, usually half an hour after the meal. 用法与服用时间 用药交代
空腹服用 on an empty stomach 在胃内无食物时服药，通常指餐前一小时或餐后两小时 Taking a drug when the stomach is empty, usually one hour before or two hours after eating. 用法与服用时间 用药交代
随餐服用 with meals 与食物同时服用的用法，多用于脂溶性药物或降糖药 Taking a drug together with food, common for fat-soluble drugs and glucose-lowering agents. 用法与服用时间 用药交代
晨服 in the morning 在早晨固定时间服药的用法，多用于激素与降压药 Taking a drug at a fixed time in the morning, often used for steroids and antihypertensives. 用法与服用时间 用药交代
整片吞服 swallow the tablet whole 不掰开、不咀嚼、整片用水送服的用法 Taking a tablet without splitting or chewing, and swallowing it whole with water. 用法与服用时间 用药交代
嚼服 chew 将药片嚼碎后咽下的用法，常用于抗酸药与咀嚼片 Taking a tablet by chewing it before swallowing, common for antacids and chewable tablets. 用法与服用时间 用药交代
顿服 take all at once 将一日总量集中在一次服完的用法 Taking the whole daily amount of a drug in a single administration. 用法与服用时间 用药交代
分服 divided doses 将一日总量分成若干次服用的用法 Dividing the total daily amount of a drug into several separate administrations. 用法与服用时间 用药交代
冲服 take dissolved in water 将药物用温水冲开后口服的服用方法 Dissolving a preparation in warm water before the patient drinks it. 用法与服用时间 用药交代
疗程 course of treatment 按规定连续用药的时间长度，到时须评估是否继续 The defined period of continuous treatment, after which continuation must be reassessed. 用法与服用时间 用药交代
不良反应 adverse reaction 合格药品在正常用法用量下出现的与用药目的无关的有害反应 A harmful reaction to a properly used drug at normal doses that is unrelated to the therapeutic aim. 不良反应 用药交代
副作用 side effect 药物在治疗剂量下出现的与治疗目的无关的作用 An effect of a drug at therapeutic doses that is unrelated to the intended treatment. 不良反应 用药交代
毒性反应 toxic reaction 药物剂量过大或蓄积引起的有害机体反应 A harmful bodily reaction caused by an excessive dose or accumulation of a drug. 不良反应 用药交代
药疹 drug rash 药物引起的皮肤与黏膜发疹性反应 An eruption of the skin and mucous membranes caused by a drug. 不良反应 用药交代
胃肠道反应 gastrointestinal reaction 药物引起的恶心、呕吐、腹痛或腹泻等消化道症状 Digestive symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, or diarrhoea caused by a drug. 不良反应 用药交代
肝损伤 liver injury 药物引起的肝细胞损害或肝功能异常 Damage to liver cells or abnormal liver function caused by a drug. 不良反应 用药交代
骨髓抑制 bone marrow suppression 药物抑制骨髓造血功能、导致血细胞减少的反应 Drug-induced suppression of bone marrow haematopoiesis that lowers blood cell counts. 不良反应 用药交代
QT间期延长 QT prolongation 心电图 QT 间期延长的药物不良反应，可诱发恶性心律失常 Drug-induced lengthening of the QT interval, which can trigger dangerous arrhythmias. 不良反应 用药交代
注射部位反应 injection site reaction 注射后局部出现的红肿、疼痛或硬结 Local redness, pain, or induration at the site of an injection. 不良反应 用药交代
双硫仑样反应 disulfiram-like reaction 用药期间饮酒引起的面部潮红、心悸与血压下降 Facial flushing, palpitations, and hypotension caused by drinking alcohol during treatment. 不良反应 用药交代
撤药反应 withdrawal reaction 突然停用某些药物后出现的症状反跳或不适 Rebound symptoms or discomfort after a drug is stopped abruptly. 不良反应 用药交代
禁忌证 contraindication 禁止使用某药或某疗法的具体情况 A condition in which a drug or treatment must not be used. 禁忌与慎用 用药交代
慎用 use with caution 特定情况下须权衡利弊、加强监测后使用的提示 A warning to weigh benefits and risks and monitor closely before using a drug in certain conditions. 禁忌与慎用 用药交代
禁用 do not use 明确禁止使用某种药物的具体情形 A situation in which a drug is explicitly not to be used. 禁忌与慎用 用药交代
绝对禁忌 absolute contraindication 任何情况下都不得使用该药的情形，无例外可循 A situation in which a drug must never be used under any circumstances. 禁忌与慎用 用药交代
相对禁忌 relative contraindication 通常避免使用、但在特定情况下可权衡使用的情形 A situation in which a drug is usually avoided but may be used after weighing the risks. 禁忌与慎用 用药交代
孕妇禁用 contraindicated in pregnancy 妊娠期禁止使用、可能致畸或损害胎儿的药物提示 A warning that a drug must not be used in pregnancy because it may harm the fetus. 禁忌与慎用 用药交代
儿童禁用 contraindicated in children 特定年龄段儿童禁止使用、可能造成严重损害的药 A drug that must not be given to children of a certain age because of serious harm. 禁忌与慎用 用药交代
哺乳期禁用 contraindicated during breastfeeding 哺乳期禁止使用、可经乳汁影响婴儿的药物提示 A warning that a drug must not be used while breastfeeding because it may reach the infant. 禁忌与慎用 用药交代

en: caution in hepatic and renal impairment
text: 肝肾功能不全慎用 caution in hepatic and renal impairment 肝功能或肾功能受损时须减量并加强监测的提示 A warning to reduce the dose and monitor closely when liver or kidney function is impaired. 禁忌与慎用 用药交代
过敏禁用 contraindicated in case of allergy 对药物或其成分过敏者禁止使用的提示 A warning that the drug must not be given to anyone allergic to it or its components. 禁忌与慎用 用药交代
黑框警告 boxed warning 药品说明书中以黑框标出的最严重风险警示 The most serious safety warning in a drug label, printed inside a black border. 禁忌与慎用 用药交代
协同作用 synergistic effect 两药合用产生的效应大于各自单独使用之和 An effect of two drugs together that is greater than the sum of their separate effects. 药物相互作用 用药交代
拮抗作用 antagonistic effect 两药合用后疗效相互抵消或减弱的效应 An effect in which two drugs used together cancel or weaken each other's action. 药物相互作用 用药交代
酶诱导 enzyme induction 药物使肝药酶活性增强、加速其他药物代谢的现象 A drug increasing hepatic enzyme activity and thereby speeding up the metabolism of other drugs. 药物相互作用 处方审核
酶抑制 enzyme inhibition 药物抑制肝药酶活性、使其他药物蓄积的现象 A drug inhibiting hepatic enzyme activity so that other drugs accumulate in the body. 药物相互作用 处方审核
肝药酶 hepatic drug-metabolizing enzyme 肝脏中代谢药物的酶系统，决定多种药物的清除速度 The enzyme system in the liver that metabolises drugs and determines their clearance. 药物相互作用 处方审核
蛋白结合率 protein binding rate 药物与血浆蛋白结合的比例，影响游离药物浓度 The proportion of drug bound to plasma protein, which affects the free drug concentration. 药物相互作用 处方审核
血药浓度监测 therapeutic drug monitoring 通过测定血液中药物浓度调整剂量的方法 The method of adjusting doses by measuring drug concentrations in the blood. 药物相互作用 用药交代
