丙氨酸氨基转移酶 alanine aminotransferase 主要存在于肝细胞胞质的转氨酶，升高提示肝损伤 A transaminase found mainly in liver cells; a rise suggests liver injury. 生化 检验科
天冬氨酸氨基转移酶 aspartate aminotransferase 分布于肝、心肌与骨骼肌的转氨酶 A transaminase found in the liver, heart, and skeletal muscle. 生化 检验科
总胆红素 total bilirubin 血清中直接与间接胆红素的总量，用于判断黄疸类型 The combined amount of conjugated and unconjugated bilirubin in serum. 生化 检验科
白蛋白 albumin 由肝脏合成、维持血浆胶体渗透压的蛋白 A protein made by the liver that maintains plasma oncotic pressure. 生化 检验科
血肌酐 serum creatinine 反映肾小球滤过功能的常用指标，升高提示肾功能受损 A commonly measured marker of glomerular filtration function in clinical practice. 生化 检验科
血尿素氮 blood urea nitrogen 蛋白质代谢产物，升高提示肾功能下降或脱水 A protein metabolite that rises with renal impairment or dehydration. 生化 检验科
估算肾小球滤过率 estimated glomerular filtration rate 由肌酐与年龄等推算的肾小球滤过能力 A calculated estimate of glomerular filtration from creatinine, age, and sex. 生化 检验科
电解质 electrolyte 血液中钾、钠、氯等离子的总称，紊乱可致心律失常 The dissolved ions in blood, such as potassium, sodium, and chloride. 生化 检验科
血钾 serum potassium 血清中钾离子浓度，影响心肌与神经肌肉功能 The serum potassium concentration, which affects cardiac and neuromuscular function. 生化 检验科
血糖 blood glucose 血液中葡萄糖的浓度，用于筛查与监测糖代谢 The blood glucose concentration, used to screen and monitor glucose metabolism. 生化 检验科
乳酸脱氢酶 lactate dehydrogenase 存在于多种组织的酶，升高提示组织损伤 An enzyme in many tissues whose rise indicates tissue damage. 生化 检验科
凝血功能 coagulation profile 评估内源与外源凝血途径的一组项目 A laboratory panel that assesses the intrinsic and extrinsic coagulation pathways. 凝血 检验科
凝血酶原时间 prothrombin time 反映外源性凝血途径的凝固时间，用于监测华法林 The clotting time that reflects activity of the extrinsic coagulation pathway. 凝血 检验科

zh: 活化部分凝血活酶时间
text: 活化部分凝血活酶时间 activated partial thromboplastin time 反映内源性凝血途径的凝固时间，用于监测普通肝素 The clotting time that reflects activity of the intrinsic coagulation pathway. 凝血 检验科
纤维蛋白原 fibrinogen 凝血过程中被转化为纤维蛋白的底物蛋白 The substrate protein that is converted into fibrin during blood clotting. 凝血 检验科
D二聚体 D-dimer 纤维蛋白降解产物，升高提示血栓形成或纤溶 A fibrin degradation product; a rise suggests thrombosis or fibrinolysis. 凝血 检验科 中文常写D-二聚体，报告单字段多不带连字符
凝血酶时间 thrombin time 加入凝血酶后血浆凝固所需的时间 The time for plasma to clot after thrombin is added. 凝血 检验科
纤维蛋白降解产物 fibrin degradation product 纤溶系统激活后纤维蛋白被分解的产物 Degradation products released when plasmin breaks down fibrin in the circulation. 凝血 检验科
抗凝血酶 antithrombin 抑制凝血酶活性的天然抗凝蛋白，降低时肝素效果变差 A natural plasma protein that inhibits the activity of thrombin. 凝血 检验科
血小板聚集试验 platelet aggregation test 检测血小板在诱导剂作用下聚集能力的试验 A test of how well platelets clump in response to an agonist. 凝血 检验科
出血时间 bleeding time 标准化皮肤切口后出血停止所需时间 The time for bleeding to stop after a standard skin incision. 凝血 检验科
凝血因子 coagulation factor 参与凝血级联反应的血浆蛋白，缺乏时易出血 A plasma protein that takes part in the coagulation cascade. 凝血 检验科
血栓弹力图 thromboelastography 实时反映全血凝血与纤溶全过程的功能检测 A whole-blood test that shows clotting and fibrinolysis in real time. 凝血 检验科
抗凝治疗监测 anticoagulation monitoring 通过化验指标跟踪抗凝药物效果与出血风险 Using laboratory indices to track anticoagulant effect and bleeding risk. 凝血 检验科
动脉血氧分压 arterial partial pressure of oxygen 动脉血中物理溶解氧产生的分压，评估氧合状态 The partial pressure exerted by oxygen dissolved in arterial blood. 血气 抢救室

en: arterial partial pressure of carbon dioxide
text: 动脉血二氧化碳分压 arterial partial pressure of carbon dioxide 动脉血中二氧化碳产生的分压，反映通气水平 The partial pressure of carbon dioxide in arterial blood, reflecting ventilation. 血气 抢救室
酸碱度 pH 血液酸碱平衡状态的对数值，低于正常为酸血症 The logarithmic measure of the acidity or alkalinity of blood. 血气 抢救室
碳酸氢根 bicarbonate 血浆中主要的缓冲碱，反映代谢性酸碱状态 The main buffer base in plasma, reflecting metabolic acid-base status. 血气 抢救室
心肌标志物 cardiac marker 心肌损伤时释放入血、用于诊断的一组蛋白 Proteins released into the blood when heart muscle cells are injured. 心肌标志物 抢救室
高敏肌钙蛋白 high-sensitivity troponin 灵敏度更高的肌钙蛋白检测，可早期发现微小损伤 A more sensitive troponin assay that detects minor injury earlier. 心肌标志物 抢救室
肌酸激酶 creatine kinase 存在于肌肉的酶，剧烈运动或肌损伤时升高 An enzyme in muscle that rises with strenuous exercise or muscle injury. 心肌标志物 抢救室
肌酸激酶同工酶 creatine kinase MB 主要来自心肌的肌酸激酶同工酶，升高提示心肌损伤 The creatine kinase isoenzyme that comes mainly from heart muscle. 心肌标志物 抢救室
肌红蛋白 myoglobin 肌肉损伤后最早释放的氧结合蛋白 An oxygen-binding protein that is released earliest after muscle injury. 心肌标志物 抢救室
B型钠尿肽 B-type natriuretic peptide 心室壁张力增高时释放的激素，用于评估心衰 A hormone released with ventricular wall stress, used to assess heart failure. 心肌标志物 抢救室
N末端前脑钠肽 N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide B型钠尿肽前体的 N 端片段，稳定性更好 The N-terminal fragment of the natriuretic peptide precursor, more stable. 心肌标志物 抢救室
心型脂肪酸结合蛋白 heart-type fatty acid-binding protein 心肌损伤后两小时内升高的早期标志物 An early marker that rises within two hours of myocardial injury. 心肌标志物 抢救室
心肌损伤 myocardial injury 心肌细胞受损导致标志物释放的状态 Damage to heart muscle cells with release of cardiac markers. 心肌标志物 抢救室
诊断窗口期 diagnostic window 标志物在血液中可被检出并用于诊断的时间范围 The period after injury during which a marker can be detected and used for diagnosis. 心肌标志物 抢救室
肌钙蛋白动态变化 troponin kinetics 连续检测肌钙蛋白水平随时间升降的过程 The rise and fall of troponin levels seen on serial testing. 心肌标志物 抢救室
心肌酶谱 myocardial enzyme panel 同时检测多种心肌来源酶的组合项目 A panel that measures several enzymes released from heart muscle. 心肌标志物 抢救室
快速肌钙蛋白检测 rapid troponin assay 在床旁数分钟至二十分钟内出结果的检测 A bedside test that gives a troponin result within minutes. 心肌标志物 抢救室
感染标志物 infection marker 血液中提示感染存在与严重程度的指标 Laboratory indices that indicate the presence and severity of infection. 感染标志物 检验科
超敏C反应蛋白 high-sensitivity C-reactive protein 灵敏度更高的C反应蛋白检测，用于低度炎症评估 A more sensitive C-reactive protein assay used to detect low-grade inflammation. 感染标志物 检验科
红细胞沉降率 erythrocyte sedimentation rate 红细胞在血沉管中下沉速度的指标，反映炎症 The rate at which red cells settle, an indirect measure of inflammation. 感染标志物 检验科
白细胞介素6 interleukin-6 促炎细胞因子，感染与炎症时迅速升高 A pro-inflammatory cytokine that rises quickly in infection and inflammation. 感染标志物 检验科
血清淀粉样蛋白A serum amyloid A 急性期反应蛋白，病毒感染时也可明显升高 An acute-phase protein that also rises markedly in viral infection. 感染标志物 检验科
内毒素 endotoxin 革兰阴性菌细胞壁成分，血中升高提示内毒素血症 A component of Gram-negative bacterial walls; a rise indicates endotoxaemia. 感染标志物 检验科
G试验 1,3-beta-D-glucan test 检测血中真菌细胞壁成分的筛查试验 A screening test for a fungal cell wall component in blood. 感染标志物 检验科
半乳甘露聚糖试验 galactomannan test 检测血中曲霉抗原的血清学试验，用于侵袭性曲霉病 A serological test that detects Aspergillus antigen in the blood of at-risk patients. 感染标志物 检验科
病毒载量 viral load 单位体积血液或体液中病毒核酸的数量 The amount of viral nucleic acid present in a volume of blood. 感染标志物 检验科
抗体滴度 antibody titer 血清中特异性抗体浓度的相对水平 The relative concentration of a specific antibody measured in serum samples. 感染标志物 检验科
培养阳性 culture positive 标本培养出明确病原体的结果状态 The state in which a culture grows a definite pathogen. 感染标志物 检验科
炎症指标 inflammatory marker 反映体内炎症活动程度的实验室指标 A laboratory index reflecting the activity of inflammation in the body. 感染标志物 检验科
尿常规 urinalysis 对尿液理化性质与沉渣的常规检查 A routine examination of the chemistry and sediment of urine. 尿液与粪便 检验科
尿蛋白 urine protein 尿液中蛋白质含量，升高提示肾小球损伤 The protein content in urine; a rise suggests glomerular damage. 尿液与粪便 检验科
尿潜血 occult blood in urine 尿液中检出红细胞或其分解产物的结果 Blood or its breakdown products detectable in the urine sample. 尿液与粪便 检验科
尿沉渣 urine sediment 离心后尿液中的细胞、管型与结晶等成分 Cells, casts, and crystals seen in urine after it has been centrifuged. 尿液与粪便 检验科
尿酮体 urine ketone 尿液中酮体含量，阳性提示脂肪分解增加 Ketone content in urine; a positive result indicates increased fat breakdown. 尿液与粪便 检验科
尿培养 urine culture 接种尿液标本以确定病原菌与药敏的检查 Inoculating urine on media to identify the pathogen and its susceptibility. 尿液与粪便 检验科
粪便隐血 fecal occult blood 检测粪便中肉眼不可见血液的试验 A test for blood in stool that is not visible to the eye. 尿液与粪便 检验科
粪便常规 stool routine 观察粪便性状并镜检细胞与寄生虫的检查 Inspection of stool together with microscopy for cells and parasites. 尿液与粪便 检验科
粪便培养 stool culture 接种粪便标本分离致病菌并做药敏的检查 Culturing stool on selective media to isolate pathogens and test susceptibility. 尿液与粪便 检验科
白细胞酯酶 leukocyte esterase 尿试纸中提示中性粒细胞存在的酶学指标 A urine dipstick index that indicates the presence of neutrophils. 尿液与粪便 检验科
亚硝酸盐 nitrite 尿试纸中提示革兰阴性菌存在的指标 A dipstick index that suggests the presence of Gram-negative bacteria. 尿液与粪便 检验科
24小时尿蛋白 24-hour urine protein 收集二十四小时全部尿液测定的蛋白质总量 The total protein excreted in urine collected over twenty-four hours. 尿液与粪便 检验科
细菌培养 bacterial culture 在培养基上分离并鉴定细菌的检查 Growing and identifying bacteria on appropriate culture media in the laboratory. 微生物 微生物室
药敏试验 antimicrobial susceptibility test 测定病原菌对不同抗菌药物敏感性的试验 A test of how susceptible a pathogen is to different antimicrobials. 微生物 微生物室
革兰染色 Gram stain 用结晶紫等染料区分细菌类型的染色方法 A staining method using crystal violet to classify bacteria by cell wall type. 微生物 微生物室
革兰阳性菌 Gram-positive bacterium 革兰染色呈紫色的细菌，多为球菌与部分杆菌 Bacteria that stain purple with Gram stain, often cocci or some rods. 微生物 微生物室
革兰阴性菌 Gram-negative bacterium 革兰染色呈红色的细菌，多与院内感染相关 Bacteria that stain red with Gram stain, often involved in hospital infection. 微生物 微生物室
真菌培养 fungal culture 在真菌培养基上分离鉴定真菌的检查 Culture on selective fungal media to isolate and identify fungal organisms. 微生物 微生物室
厌氧培养 anaerobic culture 在无氧条件下分离培养厌氧菌的方法 Culture carried out under oxygen-free conditions to isolate anaerobic bacteria. 微生物 微生物室
菌落计数 colony count 培养基上形成的菌落数量，用于判断感染程度 The number of colonies grown, used to judge the degree of infection. 微生物 微生物室
最低抑菌浓度 minimum inhibitory concentration 抑制细菌生长所需的最低药物浓度 The lowest concentration of a drug that inhibits visible growth of bacteria. 微生物 微生物室
多重耐药菌株 multidrug-resistant strain 对三类以上抗菌药物同时耐药的菌株 A strain that is resistant to three or more classes of antimicrobial drugs. 微生物 微生物室

zh: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌
text: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌 methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus 对甲氧西林耐药的金黄色葡萄球菌，常见于院内感染 A Staphylococcus aureus strain resistant to methicillin, common in hospitals. 微生物 微生物室
痰培养 sputum culture 接种痰标本分离下呼吸道病原菌的检查 Culture of sputum to isolate pathogens of the lower respiratory tract. 微生物 微生物室
定植菌 colonizer 在体表或腔道生长但未引起感染的微生物 A micro-organism growing on a surface or cavity without causing infection. 微生物 微生物室
免疫学检查 immunological test 检测抗原抗体与免疫细胞功能的一组试验 Laboratory tests that detect antigens, antibodies, and aspects of immune cell function. 免疫与血清学 检验科
乙肝表面抗原 hepatitis B surface antigen 乙肝病毒表面蛋白，阳性提示现症感染 A hepatitis B viral surface protein; positivity indicates current infection. 免疫与血清学 检验科
丙肝抗体 hepatitis C antibody 针对丙肝病毒的抗体，阳性需查核酸确认 Antibody to hepatitis C virus; a positive result needs nucleic acid testing. 免疫与血清学 检验科

zh: 人类免疫缺陷病毒抗体
text: 人类免疫缺陷病毒抗体 human immunodeficiency virus antibody 针对艾滋病病毒的抗体，用于初筛 Antibody to the human immunodeficiency virus, used for initial screening. 免疫与血清学 检验科
梅毒螺旋体抗体 Treponema pallidum antibody 针对梅毒螺旋体的特异性抗体试验 A specific antibody test used to detect Treponema pallidum infection. 免疫与血清学 检验科
类风湿因子 rheumatoid factor 针对自身抗体的抗体，多见于类风湿关节炎 An antibody directed against antibodies, often found in rheumatoid arthritis. 免疫与血清学 检验科
抗链球菌溶血素O antistreptolysin O 链球菌感染后升高的抗体，用于回顾性判断 An antibody that rises after streptococcal infection and is useful retrospectively. 免疫与血清学 检验科
补体C3 complement C3 补体系统中含量最高的成分，降低提示免疫消耗 The most abundant complement component; a fall indicates complement consumption. 免疫与血清学 检验科
交叉配血 crossmatching 输血前将供受者血液配合以确认相容的试验 A pre-transfusion test confirming compatibility between donor and recipient blood. 免疫与血清学 输血科
血型鉴定 blood typing 测定红细胞表面抗原以确定 ABO 与 Rh 血型 Testing red cell surface antigens to determine ABO and Rh group. 免疫与血清学 输血科
自身抗体 autoantibody 针对自身组织成分产生的抗体，是自身免疫病标志 An antibody produced by the immune system against the body's own tissues. 免疫与血清学 检验科
参考区间 reference interval 健康人群检测结果所处的统计学范围 The statistical range of test results in a healthy reference population. 参考区间与危急值 检验科
医学决定水平 medical decision level 结果超过该水平时需采取特定临床措施的界值 A threshold above or below which a specific clinical action is required. 参考区间与危急值 检验科
检测限 detection limit 方法能够可靠测出的最低物质浓度 The lowest concentration of an analyte that a method can reliably measure. 参考区间与危急值 检验科
线性范围 linear range 检测结果与真实浓度成正比的浓度区间 The concentration range over which the measured signal is proportional to the analyte. 参考区间与危急值 检验科
室内质控 internal quality control 实验室每日用质控品核查检测稳定性的措施 Daily checks with control materials to confirm the assay is stable. 参考区间与危急值 检验科
室间质评 external quality assessment 由外部机构比对实验室检测能力的评价活动 An external programme comparing a laboratory's results with other laboratories. 参考区间与危急值 检验科
结果异常 abnormal result 检测值超出参考区间或出现危急提示的检验结果 A test result that falls outside the stated reference interval. 参考区间与危急值 检验科
假阳性 false positive 实际无该情况却报告为阳性的结果 A positive report when the condition is in fact absent. 参考区间与危急值 检验科
假阴性 false negative 实际存在该情况却报告为阴性的结果 A negative report when the condition is in fact present. 参考区间与危急值 检验科
检验结果互认 mutual recognition of test results 不同医疗机构之间承认彼此检验结果的做法 The practice of accepting test results performed at another institution. 参考区间与危急值 检验科
参考方法 reference method 被公认为准确性最高、用于校准的检测方法 A measurement procedure accepted as the most accurate for an analyte. 参考区间与危急值 检验科
检验报告 laboratory report 记录检验项目、结果与解释的正式文件 A formal document that lists test items, results, and their interpretation. 报告术语 检验科
阴性 negative 未检出目标病原、抗体或标志物的结果 A result in which the target organism or marker is not detected. 报告术语 检验科
阳性 positive 检出目标病原、抗体或标志物的结果 A result in which the target organism or marker is detected. 报告术语 检验科
弱阳性 weakly positive 信号强度低于明确阳性但高于阴性的结果 A result with signal above negative but below a definite positive. 报告术语 检验科
未见异常 no abnormality detected 检查未发现明确病理改变的报告用语 Report wording meaning that no definite pathological change was found. 报告术语 检验科
待排 to be excluded 报告中提示需进一步检查以排除某病的用语 Report wording indicating that a diagnosis still needs to be excluded. 报告术语 检验科
待查 pending investigation 原因尚未明确、需继续检查的报告用语 Wording used when the cause is unclear and further tests are needed. 报告术语 检验科
检验报告时限 laboratory turnaround time 从标本接收到发出检验报告所需的时间 The time taken from specimen receipt to release of the report. 报告术语 检验科
报告审核 report verification 由上级检验人员核对数据与报告内容的流程 The process in which a senior laboratory staff member checks data and report content. 报告术语 检验科
解释性备注 interpretive comment 报告中说明结果意义与后续建议的附加文字 Added text in a report explaining what a result means and what to do next. 报告术语 检验科
结果复核 result review 对已发报告重新核对数据与判断的过程 Re-checking the data and conclusions of a report that has already been issued. 报告术语 检验科
检验结论 laboratory impression 检验报告末尾对结果所作的概括性判断 The summary judgement placed at the end of a laboratory report. 报告术语 检验科
报告用语 reporting wording 检验报告书写中统一使用的规范表达 Standardised expressions used when writing laboratory reports in clinical practice. 报告术语 检验科
电子报告 electronic report 经信息系统生成并可在终端查阅的检验报告 A laboratory report generated by an information system and viewed online. 报告术语 检验科
X线摄影 radiography 利用X线穿透人体成像的常规检查方法 A routine imaging method that uses X-rays passing through the body. X线与CT 影像科
计算机断层扫描 computed tomography 用X线束环绕扫描并重建断面的影像检查 An imaging examination that reconstructs cross-sections from rotating X-ray data. X线与CT CT室
平扫 non-contrast scan 不使用任何对比剂的断层扫描检查方式 A tomographic scan performed without giving any contrast agent to the patient. X线与CT CT室
增强扫描 contrast-enhanced scan 静脉注射对比剂后进行的断层扫描 A tomographic scan performed after intravenous contrast has been given. X线与CT CT室
肺窗 lung window 用于观察肺实质的窗宽与窗位设置 A window width and level setting used to display lung parenchyma. X线与CT CT室
纵隔窗 mediastinal window 用于观察纵隔软组织与血管的窗设置 A window setting used to display mediastinal soft tissue and vessels. X线与CT CT室
骨窗 bone window 用于观察骨皮质与骨小梁的窗设置 A window setting used to display bone cortex and trabeculae. X线与CT CT室
层厚 slice thickness 断层图像每一层所对应的实际组织厚度 The actual tissue thickness represented by each reconstructed tomographic slice. X线与CT CT室
图像重建 image reconstruction 由原始扫描数据生成断层图像的处理过程 The processing that turns raw scan data into displayed images. X线与CT CT室
腹部平片 abdominal radiograph 腹部X线摄影，用于观察肠气与结石 An X-ray of the abdomen used to assess bowel gas and calculi. X线与CT 影像科
辐射剂量 radiation dose 一次检查中患者接受的电离辐射量 The amount of ionizing radiation a patient receives in one examination. X线与CT CT室
三维重建 three-dimensional reconstruction 将断层数据重建为立体图像的技术 A technique that rebuilds tomographic data into a three-dimensional image. X线与CT CT室
磁共振成像 magnetic resonance imaging 利用磁场与射频波成像、无电离辐射的检查 An imaging method using magnetic fields and radio waves, with no ionizing radiation. MRI与超声 MRI室
T1加权成像 T1-weighted imaging 突出组织T1弛豫差异的磁共振序列 A magnetic resonance sequence that emphasises differences in T1 relaxation. MRI与超声 MRI室
T2加权成像 T2-weighted imaging 突出组织T2弛豫差异的磁共振序列 A magnetic resonance sequence that emphasises differences in T2 relaxation. MRI与超声 MRI室
弥散加权成像 diffusion-weighted imaging 反映水分子扩散受限程度的磁共振序列 A magnetic resonance sequence reflecting restriction of water molecule diffusion. MRI与超声 MRI室

zh: 液体衰减反转恢复序列
text: 液体衰减反转恢复序列 fluid-attenuated inversion recovery 抑制脑脊液信号、突出病灶的磁共振序列 A magnetic resonance sequence that suppresses cerebrospinal fluid to show lesions. MRI与超声 MRI室
磁共振血管成像 magnetic resonance angiography 无需插管即可显示血管的磁共振技术 A magnetic resonance technique that shows blood vessels without the need for catheterisation. MRI与超声 MRI室
超声检查 ultrasonography 利用超声波回声进行成像的检查方法 An imaging method that uses echoes of ultrasound waves to build images. MRI与超声 超声室
彩色多普勒超声 color Doppler ultrasonography 在超声图像上叠加血流信号的检查 Ultrasonography with superimposed colour signals that display blood flow in real time. MRI与超声 超声室
超声心动图 echocardiography 用超声评估心脏结构与功能的检查 An ultrasound examination that assesses cardiac structure and valvular function. MRI与超声 超声室
弹性成像 elastography 通过组织硬度评估病变性质的超声技术 An ultrasound technique that assesses tissue stiffness to characterise lesions. MRI与超声 超声室
超声造影 contrast-enhanced ultrasound 静脉注射微泡对比剂后进行的超声检查 An ultrasound examination performed after microbubble contrast has been injected intravenously. MRI与超声 超声室
磁共振禁忌证 contraindication to MRI 因体内金属或幽闭恐惧等不宜做磁共振的情况 A condition such as implanted metal that makes magnetic resonance imaging unsafe. MRI与超声 MRI室
造影检查 contrast examination 引入对比剂以显示管腔或血流的影像检查 An imaging examination in which contrast is used to show lumens or blood flow. 造影与对比剂 影像科
对比剂 contrast medium 用于增强影像对比度的药物或制剂 A pharmaceutical agent given to increase the contrast of medical images. 造影与对比剂 影像科
碘对比剂 iodinated contrast medium 含碘、用于CT与血管造影的对比剂 An iodine-containing contrast agent used for CT scanning and angiography. 造影与对比剂 影像科
钆对比剂 gadolinium-based contrast agent 含钆元素、主要用于磁共振增强的对比剂 A gadolinium-containing contrast agent used mainly for contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging. 造影与对比剂 影像科
对比剂过敏 contrast medium allergy 使用对比剂后出现的过敏反应病史 A documented history of allergic reaction after receiving contrast medium. 造影与对比剂 影像科
过敏样反应 anaphylactoid reaction 非IgE介导、表现类似过敏的急性反应 An acute reaction resembling allergy that is not mediated by IgE. 造影与对比剂 影像科
造影前准备 pre-contrast preparation 造影前完成的过敏史询问、禁食与肾功能评估 The allergy check, fasting, and renal assessment done before contrast is given. 造影与对比剂 影像科
水化 hydration 造影前后补液以减轻肾损伤的措施 Fluid given before and after contrast to reduce kidney injury. 造影与对比剂 影像科
造影后观察 post-contrast observation 造影结束后对患者反应与迟发过敏的监测 Monitoring for reactions and delayed allergy after the contrast examination. 造影与对比剂 影像科
对比剂肾病 contrast-induced nephropathy 使用对比剂后短期内出现的肾功能损害 Kidney injury that appears shortly after contrast medium is administered. 造影与对比剂 影像科
血管造影 angiography 将对比剂注入血管以显示管腔的检查 Imaging in which contrast is injected into vessels to show their lumen. 造影与对比剂 导管室
数字减影血管造影 digital subtraction angiography 通过减影技术去除骨骼背景的血管造影 Angiography in which subtraction removes background bone to show vessels. 造影与对比剂 导管室
注射速率 injection rate 对比剂单位时间内注入静脉的速度 The speed at which contrast medium is injected into the vein per unit time. 造影与对比剂 影像科
影像诊断 imaging diagnosis 依据影像表现作出的疾病判断结论 A diagnosis reached by interpreting the appearances seen on imaging. 影像结论 影像科
影像表现 imaging finding 影像检查中观察到的具体异常所见 The specific abnormalities that are observed on a particular imaging study. 影像结论 影像科
影像征象 imaging sign 具有诊断提示意义的特征性影像表现 A characteristic imaging appearance that points towards a particular diagnosis. 影像结论 影像科
占位性病变 space-occupying lesion 占据一定空间并推移周围组织的异常病灶，影像报告的规范用语 An abnormal lesion that occupies space and displaces surrounding tissue. 影像结论 影像科 影像报告规范用语；英文用 space-occupying lesion，不可直译为 occupying lesion
高密度影 hyperdense shadow 在CT图像上比周围组织更亮的区域 An area that appears brighter than surrounding tissue on CT. 影像结论 影像科
低密度影 hypodense shadow 在CT图像上比周围组织更暗的区域 An area that appears darker than surrounding tissue on CT. 影像结论 影像科
强化程度 degree of enhancement 病灶在增强后信号或密度升高的幅度 How much a lesion becomes brighter after contrast is given. 影像结论 影像科
边界清楚 well-defined 病灶边缘与周围组织分界清晰的表现 A lesion whose edge is clearly separated from surrounding tissue. 影像结论 影像科
随访复查 follow-up imaging 按计划再次进行影像检查以观察病灶变化 Repeat imaging at planned intervals in order to observe any changes. 影像结论 影像科
建议进一步检查 recommend further imaging 影像报告中提示需追加检查的用语 Report wording advising that additional imaging is required for clarification. 影像结论 影像科
影像与临床不符 imaging-clinical discrepancy 影像所见与患者症状体征不一致的情况 A mismatch between what imaging shows and the clinical picture. 影像结论 影像科
会诊读片 imaging consultation 由多名医师共同审阅影像并形成意见的过程 A session in which several clinicians review the images and agree an opinion. 影像结论 影像科
影像结论 imaging conclusion 影像报告末尾给出的最终判断与建议 The final judgement and advice given at the end of an imaging report. 影像结论 影像科
门诊病历 outpatient medical record 患者门诊就诊时形成的病历，记录主诉、查体、诊断与处理意见 The record created during an outpatient visit, documenting the complaint, examination, diagnosis and plan. 病历类型 门诊

急诊病历 emergency department medical record 患者急诊就诊时书写的病历，须记录到院时间、分诊级别与抢救经过 The record completed during an emergency visit, including arrival time, triage level and resuscitation. 病历类型 急诊 急诊病历往往是纠纷中的核心证据，时间点必须写清
留观病历 observation unit record 患者在急诊留观期间形成的病历，记录病情变化与留观处置 The record kept while a patient stays in the observation unit, documenting changes and treatment. 病历类型 急诊
入院记录 admission note 患者住院时由医师书写的首次完整病历，含主诉、现病史与查体 The first complete record written by a physician on admission, covering complaint, history and examination. 病历类型 住院部
住院病历 inpatient medical record 患者住院期间形成的全部病历文书，出院后统一归档保存 The complete set of records created during admission, archived after discharge. 病历类型 住院部
病案 medical record 患者出院后归档保存的病历文件，由病案室统一管理 The archived case file kept after discharge and managed centrally by the medical record room. 病历类型 病案室
病案首页 medical record front sheet 汇总患者基本信息、诊断、手术与费用等关键数据的首页表单 The summary sheet at the front of the case file covering demographics, diagnoses, procedures and costs. 病历类型 病案室 首页数据直接进入医院统计与医保结算，改错成本很高
就诊记录 visit record 一次就诊形成的记录，含时间、科室、接诊医师与处理 The record of a single visit, including time, department, attending physician and management. 病历类型 门诊
复诊记录 follow-up visit record 患者按计划再次就诊时书写的记录，重点比较前后变化 The record written at a scheduled return visit, focusing on changes since the last visit. 病历类型 门诊
门诊日志 outpatient register 门诊按日登记的接诊流水，记录患者姓名、诊断与去向 The daily outpatient log listing each patient's name, diagnosis and disposition. 病历类型 门诊
住院登记 inpatient registration 患者办理住院时录入的登记信息，含床位、诊断与费用类别 The registration data entered when a patient is admitted, including bed, diagnosis and payment type. 病历类型 住院部
纸质病历 paper medical record 以纸张形式保存的病历，与电子病历并行使用时须保持内容一致 A record kept on paper that must stay consistent with the electronic record when both are used. 病历类型 病案室
病历摘要 medical record summary 抽取病历关键信息形成的简要材料，多用于转诊、复印与保险 A condensed extract of key record information, often used for referral, copying and insurance. 病历类型 门诊
就诊前处理 pre-visit management 患者来院前自行或在他处采取的处理措施与效果 Measures taken by the patient or elsewhere before arrival, and their effect. 主诉与现病史 急诊
疫区接触史 epidemic area contact history 患者近期到访疫区或接触传染源的流行病学记录 The epidemiological record of recent travel to epidemic areas or contact with sources of infection. 既往史与个人史 住院部
旅居史 travel and residence history 患者近期居住与出行地点，用于判断地方病与传染病风险 Where the patient has recently lived and travelled, used to assess endemic disease risk. 既往史与个人史 住院部
浅表淋巴结 superficial lymph nodes 对颈部、腋下与腹股沟等部位淋巴结大小与压痛的检查 Examination of lymph node size and tenderness in the neck, axillae and groins. 体格检查 急诊
肺部听诊 pulmonary auscultation 用听诊器听取呼吸音与附加音的检查方法 Listening with a stethoscope for breath sounds and added sounds. 体格检查 住院部
脊柱四肢 spine and limbs 对脊柱生理弯曲、四肢活动与畸形的检查描述 Examination of spinal curvature, limb movement, deformity and any focal tenderness. 体格检查 急诊
专科检查 specialized examination 按专科要求进行的针对性检查，如眼科或骨科专科查体 A focused examination performed according to the requirements of a particular specialty. 体格检查 住院部
初步诊断 preliminary diagnosis 接诊时依据现有资料作出的阶段性诊断，可随检查修正 The working diagnosis based on available information at first contact, subject to revision. 诊断与鉴别 急诊
入院诊断 admission diagnosis 患者入院时确定的诊断，是后续诊疗与统计的依据 The diagnosis established at admission, the basis for treatment and statistics. 诊断与鉴别 住院部
出院诊断 discharge diagnosis 患者出院时确定的最终诊断，写入出院小结与病案首页 The final diagnosis at discharge, entered in the discharge summary and front sheet. 诊断与鉴别 住院部
修正诊断 revised diagnosis 住院期间因新证据而更改的诊断，须注明修正依据 A diagnosis changed during admission because of new evidence, with the basis stated. 诊断与鉴别 住院部
补充诊断 supplementary diagnosis 在原诊断之外新增的诊断，多为住院期间发现的合并症 An additional diagnosis found during admission beyond the original ones. 诊断与鉴别 住院部
鉴别诊断 differential diagnosis 与现有表现相似、需要逐一排除的其他疾病列表 The list of other conditions resembling the presentation that must be excluded. 诊断与鉴别 急诊
疑似诊断 suspected diagnosis 证据尚不足以确诊、需进一步检查支持的诊断表述 A diagnosis stated when evidence is insufficient and further testing is needed. 诊断与鉴别 急诊
确诊 confirmed diagnosis 经病理、影像或实验室检查证实的最终诊断 A final diagnosis confirmed by pathology, imaging or laboratory testing. 诊断与鉴别 住院部
临床诊断 clinical diagnosis 依据病史、查体与常规检查作出的诊断，未必有病理证据 A diagnosis based on history, examination and routine tests, not necessarily pathological proof. 诊断与鉴别 住院部
病理诊断 pathological diagnosis 依据组织或细胞学检查作出的诊断，是肿瘤确诊的金标准 A diagnosis based on tissue or cytology, the gold standard for tumours. 诊断与鉴别 住院部
并发症 complication 在原发病基础上新发生、由疾病或诊疗引起的病症 A new condition arising from the original disease or its treatment. 诊断与鉴别 住院部
误诊 misdiagnosis 将疾病诊断为其他疾病的情形，属病历质控与纠纷重点 Diagnosing a condition as a different disease, a focus of record review and disputes. 诊断与鉴别 病案室
医嘱 medical order 医师对患者诊疗下达的书面指令，是护士执行与给药的依据 A written instruction by a physician for care, the basis for nursing execution and drug administration. 医嘱 住院部
长期医嘱 standing order 有效时间超过二十四小时、需按频次持续执行的医嘱 An order effective for more than twenty-four hours and carried out repeatedly. 医嘱 住院部
临时医嘱 temporary order 一次执行即失效的医嘱，如一次性用药或当日检查 An order that expires after one execution, such as a single dose or a same-day test. 医嘱 住院部
备用医嘱 as-needed order 写明适用条件的医嘱，患者出现相应情况时才执行 An order stating a condition under which it is carried out. 医嘱 住院部
停止医嘱 discontinue order 医师决定终止某项正在执行的医嘱所下的指令 An instruction by a physician to terminate an active order. 医嘱 住院部
医嘱执行 order implementation 护士按医嘱内容实施并记录的过程 The process by which nurses carry out and document an order. 医嘱 护士站
医嘱核对 order verification 对医嘱内容、剂量与患者信息进行复核的环节 The step of double-checking order content, dose and patient identity. 医嘱 护士站
医嘱转抄 order transcription 将医师医嘱誊录到执行单或系统中的过程，须双人核对 Copying a physician order onto the execution sheet or system, checked by two staff. 医嘱 护士站
出院医嘱 discharge order 患者出院时下达的用药、复诊与注意事项指令 Instructions on medication, follow-up appointments and precautions issued when the patient leaves hospital. 医嘱 出院处
医嘱变更 order modification 对已下达医嘱的内容进行调整并留下修改记录 Adjusting an issued order while leaving a record of the change. 医嘱 住院部
医嘱审核 order review 药师对医嘱的剂量、相互作用与配伍进行审核的环节 The pharmacist's check of an order for dose, interactions and compatibility. 医嘱 药剂科
医嘱补录 late order entry 因抢救或系统故障未及时录入，事后补录并注明原因的医嘱 An order entered after the event because of resuscitation or system failure, with the reason noted. 医嘱 住院部
医嘱签名 order signature 医师在下达医嘱后签署姓名与工号，确认其有效性 The name and staff number a physician signs after issuing an order to confirm its validity. 医嘱 住院部
病程记录 progress note 住院期间按时间顺序记录病情变化与诊疗措施的病历文书 The record documenting changes in condition and treatment in time order during admission. 病程记录 住院部
首次病程记录 initial progress note 患者入院当日由经治医师书写的第一次病程记录 The first progress note written by the treating physician on the day of admission. 病程记录 住院部
日常病程记录 daily progress note 住院期间按日记录的病情、检查结果与处理意见 The day-to-day record of condition, test results and management during admission. 病程记录 住院部
上级医师查房记录 senior physician rounds note 记录上级医师查房时对病情的分析与诊疗意见的文书 A record of the senior physician's analysis and plan during ward rounds. 病程记录 住院部
主治医师查房记录 attending physician rounds note 记录主治医师查房意见与诊疗调整的病历内容 The record of the attending physician's rounds findings and treatment adjustments. 病程记录 住院部
主任医师查房记录 chief physician rounds note 记录主任医师查房时对疑难问题的判断与指示 The record of the chief physician's judgement and instructions on difficult problems. 病程记录 住院部
疑难病例讨论记录 difficult case discussion record 对诊断治疗困难的病例组织讨论后形成的记录 The record produced after a formal discussion of a case that is difficult to diagnose or treat. 病程记录 住院部
术前小结 preoperative summary 手术前对病情、手术指征与风险要点的简要总结 A brief summary before surgery of the condition, indications and key risks. 病程记录 手术室
术后首次病程记录 first postoperative progress note 手术结束后由术者书写的第一次术后记录 The first note written by the surgeon after the operation is completed. 病程记录 手术室
阶段小结 interval summary 住院时间较长时按阶段对病情与诊疗的归纳 A periodic summary of the condition and management during a long admission. 病程记录 住院部
交接班记录 handover record 交接班时对重点患者病情与注意事项的记录 The record of key patients' conditions and precautions at shift handover. 病程记录 护士站
病情变化记录 record of condition change 患者病情出现明显变化时随时书写的记录 A note written whenever there is a significant change in the patient's condition. 病程记录 住院部
诊疗计划 treatment plan 针对患者当前问题制定的检查与治疗安排 The planned investigations and treatment for the patient's current problems. 病程记录 住院部
护理记录 nursing record 护士对患者病情观察、护理措施与效果的记录 The nurse's record of observations, nursing measures and their effects. 病程记录 护士站
科内会诊 intradepartmental consultation 同一科室内部医师之间进行的病例讨论与诊治意见交流 Discussion of a case among physicians within the same department. 会诊与转科 会诊室

全脊麻 total spinal anesthesia 硬膜外或腰麻时局麻药大量进入蛛网膜下腔导致的全脊髓阻滞 Extensive spinal block caused by a large dose of local anesthetic entering the subarachnoid space. 麻醉风险 手术室
穿刺后头痛 post-dural puncture headache 硬膜穿破后脑脊液外漏引起的体位性头痛 A postural headache caused by cerebrospinal fluid leak after dural puncture. 麻醉风险 手术室 缩写 PDPH，正式文书首次出现应写全称
麻醉后神经损伤 nerve injury after anesthesia 麻醉穿刺或体位压迫造成的周围神经感觉或运动障碍 Sensory or motor impairment of a peripheral nerve caused by needle trauma or positioning pressure. 麻醉风险 手术室
支气管痉挛 bronchospasm 气道平滑肌强烈收缩导致呼气困难与气道压升高的麻醉并发症 Severe airway smooth muscle contraction causing expiratory difficulty and rising airway pressure. 麻醉风险 手术室
术中知晓 intraoperative awareness 全身麻醉中患者恢复意识并能回忆手术过程的现象 A phenomenon in which a patient regains consciousness during general anesthesia and recalls the surgery. 麻醉风险 手术室
术后恶心呕吐 postoperative nausea and vomiting 麻醉与手术后出现的恶心和呕吐，是常见的不适并发症 Nausea and vomiting after anesthesia and surgery, a common and distressing complication. 麻醉风险 恢复室
麻醉药物过敏 anesthetic allergy 对麻醉药物产生的免疫介导反应，轻者皮疹重者过敏性休克 An immune-mediated reaction to anesthetic drugs, from rash to anaphylactic shock. 麻醉风险 手术室
麻醉期间低血压 intraoperative hypotension 麻醉与手术期间血压低于维持器官灌注所需水平的状态 Blood pressure during anesthesia and surgery that falls below the level needed for organ perfusion. 麻醉风险 手术室
麻醉后呼吸抑制 respiratory depression after anesthesia 麻醉药物残余作用导致呼吸频率或潮气量不足的状态 Insufficient respiratory rate or tidal volume from residual anesthetic drug effect. 麻醉风险 恢复室
阻滞失败 block failure 神经阻滞或椎管内麻醉未能达到预期麻醉效果的情形 A regional or neuraxial block that fails to produce the intended anesthetic effect. 麻醉风险 手术室
麻醉并发症 anesthesia complication 麻醉实施过程中出现的各类不良事件总称 Any adverse event that arises during the delivery of anesthesia and must be documented. 麻醉风险 手术室
苏醒期躁动 emergence agitation 麻醉苏醒阶段出现的烦躁、挣扎与不配合状态 Restlessness, thrashing and non-cooperation during emergence from general anesthesia after surgery. 麻醉风险 恢复室
手术风险 surgical risk 手术过程中与术后可能出现的并发症、伤残与死亡风险 The risk of complications, disability or death during and after an operation. 手术风险 术前谈话
术中出血 intraoperative bleeding 手术过程中组织或血管损伤导致的失血 Blood loss from tissue or vessel injury during an operation. 手术风险 手术室
术后出血 postoperative bleeding 手术结束后切口或创面再次出血的并发症 Renewed bleeding from the wound or operative bed after surgery has finished. 手术风险 病房
手术部位感染 surgical site infection 发生于切口或手术深部组织的感染，多在术后数日至数周出现 Infection of the incision or deeper operative tissues, appearing days to weeks after surgery. 手术风险 病房
深静脉血栓 deep vein thrombosis 下肢深静脉内形成的血栓，术后活动减少时风险升高 A clot forming in a deep leg vein, with higher risk when mobility is reduced after surgery. 手术风险 病房
血管损伤 vascular injury 手术操作造成的动脉或静脉破裂、狭窄或血栓形成 Rupture, narrowing or thrombosis of an artery or vein caused during surgery. 手术风险 术前谈话
脏器损伤 organ injury 手术中邻近器官被误伤造成的穿孔、破裂或功能障碍 Accidental damage to adjacent organs during surgery, causing perforation, rupture or dysfunction. 手术风险 术前谈话
术后粘连 postoperative adhesion 手术后组织修复过程中形成的异常纤维连接，可致肠梗阻 Abnormal fibrous bands formed during healing after surgery, which can cause bowel obstruction. 手术风险 病房
愈合不良 poor wound healing 切口愈合缓慢或愈合质量差、延迟拆线的状态 Slow or inadequate healing of an incision that delays suture removal. 手术风险 病房
围术期死亡 perioperative death 手术前至术后三十天内发生的死亡 Death occurring between the preoperative period and thirty days after surgery. 手术风险 术前谈话
术中大出血 massive intraoperative hemorrhage 短时间内失血量超过循环代偿能力的大出血 Rapid blood loss during surgery that exceeds the circulation's ability to compensate. 手术风险 手术室
手术失败 surgical failure 手术未能达到预期治疗目标或未能解除病变 An operation that fails to achieve the intended goal or to remove the pathology. 手术风险 术前谈话
疾病复发 recurrence of disease 手术后原病变在同一部位或器官再次出现 Return of the original disease at the same site or organ after surgery. 手术风险 术前谈话
器官功能衰竭 organ failure 术后一个或多个器官功能严重受损、需支持治疗的状态 Severe impairment of one or more organs after surgery that requires organ support. 手术风险 病房
住院时间延长 prolonged hospital stay 因并发症或恢复缓慢导致住院天数超过预期 A hospital stay longer than expected because of complications or slow recovery. 手术风险 病房
替代方案 alternative treatment 除拟行手术外可供选择的保守、药物或介入等治疗方式 A conservative, medical or interventional option other than the proposed operation. 替代方案 术前谈话
知情同意 informed consent 医务人员说明病情、风险与替代方案后患者作出的明确同意 The patient's clear agreement after being told the condition, risks and alternatives. 替代方案 术前谈话 《民法典》第1219条：手术须向患者说明风险与替代方案并取得明确同意
手术知情同意书 surgical informed consent form 记录手术名称、风险、替代方案与患者签字的法律文书 The legal document recording the procedure, its risks, alternatives and the patient's signature. 替代方案 术前谈话
麻醉知情同意书 anesthesia informed consent form 记录麻醉方式、风险与替代选择并由患者签署的文书 The document recording the anesthetic plan, its risks and alternatives, signed by the patient. 替代方案 术前谈话
保守治疗 conservative treatment 不做手术、以药物、休息与观察为主的治疗方式 Treatment without surgery that relies on drugs, rest and careful observation. 替代方案 术前谈话
药物治疗 medical therapy 以药物控制病情、暂不手术的治疗选择 Controlling the condition with drugs instead of operating for now. 替代方案 术前谈话
介入治疗 interventional therapy 在影像引导下经导管或穿刺完成治疗、创伤小于开放手术的方式 Image-guided treatment through catheters or needles, less invasive than open surgery. 替代方案 术前谈话
内镜治疗 endoscopic therapy 经内镜在腔道内完成切除、止血或引流等治疗的方式 Treatment such as resection, haemostasis or drainage performed through an endoscope. 替代方案 术前谈话
第二诊疗意见 second opinion 就同一病情向另一位医师或机构征询的独立诊疗意见 An independent opinion on the same condition from another doctor or institution. 替代方案 术前谈话
拒绝手术 refusal of surgery 患者在知情后明确不接受手术治疗的决定 A patient's decision, after being informed, not to undergo the operation. 替代方案 术前谈话
撤回同意 withdrawal of consent 患者在手术实施前取消先前作出的同意决定 The patient cancelling a previously given consent before the operation starts. 替代方案 术前谈话
授权委托书 authorization letter 患者书面授权他人代为行使知情同意与签字权利的文书 A written document by which the patient authorises another person to give consent and sign on their behalf. 替代方案 术前谈话

en: person without capacity for civil conduct
text: 无民事行为能力人 person without capacity for civil conduct 不能辨认自己行为、须由法定代理人代为实施民事法律行为的成年人 An adult unable to recognise their own conduct, whose legal representative acts for them in civil matters. 替代方案 术前谈话 《民法典》第21条：不能辨认自己行为的成年人为无民事行为能力人
医疗损害责任 medical damage liability 医疗机构及其医务人员因过错造成患者损害应承担的民事责任 Civil liability of a medical institution and its staff for harm caused by fault. 替代方案 医患沟通
风险告知 risk disclosure 向患者说明诊疗风险、发生概率与应对措施的过程 Explaining to the patient the risks of treatment, how likely they are and how they would be managed. 替代方案 术前谈话
备血 blood reservation 术前或治疗前完成血型鉴定与交叉配血并预留血液的措施 Blood typing and crossmatching done in advance so units are reserved for possible use. 输血与备血 输血科
输血知情同意书 transfusion informed consent form 记录输血必要性、风险与替代方案并由患者签署的文书 The document recording the need for transfusion, its risks and alternatives, signed by the patient. 输血与备血 术前谈话
自体输血 autologous transfusion 采集患者自身血液在术中或术后回输的输血方式 Collecting and returning the patient's own blood during or after surgery. 输血与备血 手术室
术中血液回收 intraoperative cell salvage 把术中失血回收、洗涤后回输给患者的血液保护技术 Collecting shed blood during surgery, washing it and returning it to the patient. 输血与备血 手术室
成分输血 component transfusion 按需分别输注红细胞、血浆或血小板的输血方式 Transfusing red cells, plasma or platelets separately according to need. 输血与备血 输血科
新鲜冰冻血浆 fresh frozen plasma 采血后六小时内冰冻保存、含全部凝血因子的血浆制品 Plasma frozen within six hours of collection and containing all clotting factors. 输血与备血 输血科
红细胞悬液 packed red blood cells 去除大部分血浆后的红细胞制品，用于纠正贫血与失血 Red cells with most plasma removed, used to correct anaemia and blood loss. 输血与备血 输血科
血小板输注 platelet transfusion 输注血小板制品以纠正血小板减少或功能障碍的治疗 Transfusion of platelet concentrates to correct thrombocytopenia or platelet dysfunction. 输血与备血 输血科
输血反应 transfusion reaction 输血过程中或输血后出现发热、过敏、溶血等不良反应 An adverse response such as fever, allergy or haemolysis during or after transfusion. 输血与备血 输血科
输血传播感染 transfusion-transmitted infection 经血液制品传播的病毒、细菌或寄生虫感染 Infection with viruses, bacteria or parasites transmitted through blood products. 输血与备血 输血科
大量输血 massive transfusion 短时间内输入大量血液制品以抢救大出血的方案 A protocol delivering large volumes of blood products quickly to treat major haemorrhage. 输血与备血 手术室
输血指征 transfusion indication 根据血红蛋白、出血速度与临床症状判断需要输血的标准 The criteria, based on haemoglobin, bleeding rate and symptoms, that justify transfusion. 输血与备血 输血科
限制性输血 restrictive transfusion 采用较低血红蛋白阈值、减少不必要输血的策略 A strategy using a lower haemoglobin threshold to reduce unnecessary transfusion. 输血与备血 输血科
术后镇痛 postoperative analgesia 手术后为控制切口与内脏疼痛而采取的药物与非药物措施 Drug and non-drug measures used to control wound and visceral pain after surgery. 术后镇痛 术后病房
术后疼痛评估 postoperative pain assessment 用评分工具定期评估术后疼痛强度与缓解情况 Regular measurement of pain intensity and relief after surgery using a scoring tool. 术后镇痛 术后病房
镇痛方案 analgesia plan 按疼痛程度与手术类型制定的给药种类、途径与时间安排 The choice of drugs, route and timing set according to pain level and operation type. 术后镇痛 术后病房
多模式镇痛 multimodal analgesia 联合使用不同作用机制的镇痛药与技术以提高效果并减少副作用 Combining analgesics and techniques with different mechanisms to improve relief and reduce side effects. 术后镇痛 术后病房
患者自控镇痛 patient-controlled analgesia 由患者按需自行按压给药泵、实现个体化镇痛的装置与方法 A pump system that lets the patient self-administer set doses of analgesic on demand. 术后镇痛 术后病房
硬膜外镇痛 epidural analgesia 经硬膜外导管持续或间断注入局麻药与阿片类药物的镇痛方式 Analgesia delivered through an epidural catheter using local anesthetic with or without an opioid. 术后镇痛 术后病房
连续神经阻滞 continuous nerve block 经留置导管持续输注局麻药以延长区域镇痛时间的技术 Continuous infusion of local anesthetic through a placed catheter to extend regional analgesia. 术后镇痛 术后病房
阿片类药物 opioid 作用于阿片受体、用于中重度疼痛的镇痛药物总称 A class of analgesics acting on opioid receptors, used for moderate to severe pain. 术后镇痛 术后病房
非甾体抗炎药 nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug 通过抑制环氧化酶发挥解热镇痛抗炎作用的药物，可减少阿片用量 A drug that inhibits cyclooxygenase to relieve pain and inflammation and spare opioid use. 术后镇痛 术后病房
对乙酰氨基酚 paracetamol 常用解热镇痛药，是术后多模式镇痛的基础药物之一 A common analgesic and antipyretic, one of the foundation drugs in multimodal postoperative analgesia. 术后镇痛 术后病房
镇痛不足 inadequate analgesia 疼痛评分持续偏高、现有镇痛方案未能有效缓解的状态 Persistently high pain scores or distress despite the analgesia plan currently in use. 术后镇痛 术后病房
过度镇静 oversedation 镇痛镇静药物过量导致嗜睡、唤不醒或呼吸变慢的状态 Excessive drowsiness, difficulty rousing or slow breathing from too much sedative or opioid. 术后镇痛 术后病房
镇痛泵 analgesia pump 按设定速度或患者按需给药的便携式镇痛输注装置 A portable infusion device delivering analgesia at a set rate or on patient demand. 术后镇痛 术后病房
麻醉恢复室 postanesthesia care unit 手术后患者苏醒与早期监护的专门区域 A dedicated area where patients recover from anesthesia and are monitored in the early postoperative period. 术后监护 恢复室
麻醉苏醒 emergence from anesthesia 麻醉药物作用消退、患者逐步恢复意识与保护性反射的过程 The process in which anesthetic effects wane and consciousness and protective reflexes return. 术后监护 恢复室
术后监护 postoperative monitoring 手术后对生命体征、意识、引流量与切口的持续观察 Continuous observation of vital signs, consciousness, drain output and the wound after surgery. 术后监护 恢复室
术后拔管 postoperative extubation 手术结束、麻醉减浅后撤除气管导管的操作 Removal of the tracheal tube once surgery is finished and anesthesia is lightened. 术后监护 恢复室
术后低体温 postoperative hypothermia 术后核心体温低于三十六度、影响凝血与苏醒的状态 A core temperature below thirty-six degrees after surgery, impairing coagulation and recovery. 术后监护 恢复室
术后寒战 postoperative shivering 麻醉后出现的骨骼肌不自主收缩，增加耗氧与疼痛 Involuntary muscle contraction after anesthesia that increases oxygen consumption and pain. 术后监护 恢复室
尿潴留 urinary retention 手术后膀胱不能自行排空、残余尿量增多的状态 Failure of the bladder to empty after surgery, with a raised residual volume. 术后监护 病房
术后谵妄 postoperative delirium 手术后出现的急性注意力与认知障碍，多见于老年患者 Acute disturbance of attention and cognition after surgery, most common in older patients. 术后监护 病房
早期活动 early mobilisation 术后尽早下床或床上活动以预防血栓与肺部并发症的措施 Getting the patient moving, in or out of bed, soon after surgery to prevent clots and chest complications. 术后监护 病房
术后进食 resumption of oral intake 手术后根据胃肠功能恢复情况重新开始经口进食 Restarting food by mouth after surgery once gastrointestinal function returns. 术后监护 病房
引流管管理 drain management 术后对引流管位置、通畅度与引流液的观察与维护 Observing and maintaining drain position, patency and output after surgery. 术后监护 病房
术后随访 postoperative follow-up 出院后按计划复诊、评估伤口与功能恢复的过程 Scheduled review after discharge to assess the wound and functional recovery. 术后监护 门诊
日间手术 ambulatory surgery 患者当日入院、手术并在二十四小时内出院的择期手术模式 Elective surgery in which the patient is admitted, operated and discharged within twenty-four hours. 日间与急诊手术 日间病房
日间手术病房 day surgery unit 专门收治日间手术患者、承担术前准备与术后观察的单元 A unit that admits day-surgery patients and handles preparation and short postoperative observation. 日间与急诊手术 日间病房
门诊手术 outpatient surgery 在门诊手术室完成、不需住院的小型手术 Minor surgery performed in an outpatient theatre without admission to hospital. 日间与急诊手术 门诊
当日出院 same-day discharge 手术当天完成观察与评估后办理出院 Discharge on the same day after observation and assessment following surgery. 日间与急诊手术 日间病房
限期手术 urgent surgery 需在一定时限内完成、不宜长期等待的手术 Surgery that must be done within a defined time window and should not be deferred for long. 日间与急诊手术 病房
手术审批 surgical approval 按分级管理要求由科室与医务部门审核同意实施手术的流程 The process of obtaining departmental and medical affairs approval before surgery under grading rules. 日间与急诊手术 手术室

紧急救治 emergency rescue 抢救生命垂危患者等紧急情况下无法取得患方意见时经批准立即实施的医疗措施 Immediate treatment given in a life-threatening emergency when the patient's views cannot be obtained, after approval. 日间与急诊手术 急诊科 《民法典》第1220条：紧急救治须经医疗机构负责人或授权的负责人批准
术前等待时间 time to surgery 从决定手术到实际切皮之间的时间间隔 The interval between the decision to operate and the actual start of surgery. 日间与急诊手术 急诊科
手术取消 cancellation of surgery 已排定的手术因病情、资源或患者原因临时停止 A scheduled operation stopped at short notice because of the condition, resources or the patient. 日间与急诊手术 病房
急诊加台 emergency add-on case 在已排满的手术表中临时插入的急诊手术 An emergency operation inserted into an already full theatre list. 日间与急诊手术 手术室
手术排程 operating room scheduling 按手术分级、资源与紧急程度安排手术间与时间的管理工作 Managing theatre rooms and times according to grade, resources and urgency. 日间与急诊手术 手术室
计划二次手术 planned reoperation 在首次手术时即已拟定、按计划择期实施的再次手术 A second operation decided at the first surgery and performed electively as planned. 二次手术与中转 术前谈话
二次探查术 second-look laparotomy 首次手术后按计划或疑有并发症时再次开腹探查 Returning to the abdomen after a first operation, either as planned or for suspected complications. 二次手术与中转 手术室
中转开腹 conversion to laparotomy 腹腔镜手术中因出血、粘连或暴露困难改为开腹完成手术 Changing from laparoscopic to open surgery because of bleeding, adhesions or poor exposure. 二次手术与中转 手术室
中转全身麻醉 conversion to general anesthesia 区域麻醉效果不足或患者不能配合时改为全身麻醉 Changing from regional to general anesthesia when the block fails or the patient cannot cooperate. 二次手术与中转 手术室
非计划再次手术 unplanned reoperation 首次手术后因出血、感染或吻合口瘘等并发症而再次手术 A second operation after the first, caused by complications such as bleeding, infection or anastomotic leak. 二次手术与中转 病房
再手术指征 indication for reoperation 根据病情判断必须再次手术的临床依据 The clinical grounds showing that a further operation is necessary. 二次手术与中转 术前谈话
再次入院 readmission 出院后因同一疾病或并发症再次住院 Admission again after discharge for the same condition or a complication. 二次手术与中转 病房

text: 霍乱 cholera 由霍乱弧菌引起的甲类肠道传染病，可致严重水样腹泻 A Class A intestinal infectious disease caused by Vibrio cholerae with profuse watery diarrhoea. 重点传染病 肠道门诊

domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

text: 诺如病毒感染 norovirus infection 由诺如病毒引起、以呕吐腹泻为主的急性胃肠炎 Acute gastroenteritis with vomiting and diarrhoea caused by norovirus infection. 重点传染病 肠道门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 精神障碍 mental disorder 各种原因引起的感知、情感和思维等精神活动紊乱或异常，导致明显心理痛苦或社会功能损害 A disturbance or abnormality in perception, emotion, or thinking caused by various factors, leading to marked distress or impaired social functioning. 精神障碍分类 分诊台 精神卫生法统一用"精神障碍"，不宜在病历中写成"精神病"

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 严重精神障碍 severe mental disorder 症状严重、社会功能明显受损并需要长期治疗管理的精神障碍类别 A category of mental disorder with severe symptoms, marked social dysfunction, and a need for long-term treatment and management. 精神障碍分类 入院评估 精神卫生法第三十条的非自愿住院条件以"严重精神障碍"为前提

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 精神分裂症 schizophrenia 以幻觉、妄想和思维紊乱为核心症状且病程多迁延的严重精神障碍 A severe mental disorder with hallucinations, delusions, and disorganized thinking and a usually prolonged course. 精神障碍分类 精神科门诊 不要简写为"精神分裂"，口语中该说法常带贬义

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 抑郁障碍 depressive disorder 以持续心境低落、兴趣减退和精力下降为主要表现的一组精神障碍 A group of disorders marked by persistent low mood, loss of interest, and reduced energy. 精神障碍分类 精神科门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 双相障碍 bipolar disorder 抑郁发作与躁狂或轻躁狂发作交替出现的心境障碍 A mood disorder in which depressive episodes alternate with manic or hypomanic episodes. 精神障碍分类 精神科门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 焦虑障碍 anxiety disorder 以过度担忧、紧张不安和躯体不适为主要表现的一组精神障碍 A group of disorders characterized by excessive worry, tension, and physical symptoms. 精神障碍分类 精神科门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 谵妄 delirium 急性起病、注意与意识水平波动并伴认知障碍的急性脑功能障碍 An acute brain dysfunction with fluctuating attention and awareness together with disturbed cognition. 精神障碍分类 急诊抢救室 谵妄属急性脑病状态，不能只按"精神症状"处理，先查病因

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 器质性精神障碍 organic mental disorder 由脑部疾病或躯体疾病直接引起的精神障碍 A mental disorder directly caused by a brain disorder or a physical illness. 精神障碍分类 精神科门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 物质所致精神障碍 substance-induced mental disorder 使用精神活性物质后出现的精神障碍，症状随物质作用出现或消退 A mental disorder caused by psychoactive substance use whose symptoms track the substance effect. 精神障碍分类 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 强迫障碍 obsessive-compulsive disorder 以反复出现的强迫观念和强迫行为为特征的精神障碍 A disorder marked by recurrent intrusive obsessions and repetitive compulsive behaviours. 精神障碍分类 精神科门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 创伤后应激障碍 post-traumatic stress disorder 经历重大创伤后出现侵入性回忆、回避和警觉性增高的精神障碍 A disorder after major trauma with intrusive memories, avoidance, and increased arousal. 精神障碍分类 精神科门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 人格障碍 personality disorder 人格特征长期明显偏离常态并导致适应不良的持久状态 An enduring pattern of inner experience and behaviour that deviates markedly from expectations and causes impairment. 精神障碍分类 精神科门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 进食障碍 eating disorder 以进食行为异常和对体重体型的过度关注为核心的精神障碍 A disorder characterised by abnormal eating behaviour and excessive concern about weight and shape. 精神障碍分类 精神科门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 睡眠障碍 sleep disorder 入睡困难、睡眠维持困难或睡眠质量异常并影响日间功能的状态 A condition of difficulty falling or staying asleep, or poor sleep quality, that impairs daytime functioning. 精神障碍分类 精神科门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 躯体形式障碍 somatic symptom disorder 以反复躯体不适主诉为主而检查无相应器质性改变的精神障碍 A disorder with persistent physical complaints that are not explained by organic disease. 精神障碍分类 精神科门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 孤独症谱系障碍 autism spectrum disorder 以社交沟通障碍和重复刻板行为为核心表现的神经发育障碍 A neurodevelopmental disorder with impaired social communication and restricted repetitive behaviours. 精神障碍分类 儿科门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 幻觉 hallucination 没有相应客观刺激时出现的知觉体验，常见于精神分裂症和谵妄 A perceptual experience without a corresponding external stimulus, seen in schizophrenia and delirium. 症状学 精神检查 幻觉与错觉不同，前者无客观刺激，后者是对真实刺激的错误知觉

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 听幻觉 auditory hallucination 以听到说话声为主要形式的幻觉，是精神分裂症最常见的症状 A hallucination in the form of hearing voices and the most common symptom of schizophrenia. 症状学 精神检查 命令性听幻觉提示自伤与伤人风险，必须写入风险评估记录

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 妄想 delusion 与事实不符且不能被说服纠正的坚定错误信念 A fixed false belief held with conviction that is not corrected by evidence or persuasion. 症状学 精神检查

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 被害妄想 persecutory delusion 坚信自己被跟踪、下毒或谋害的妄想，常伴冲动行为 A delusion that one is being followed, poisoned, or plotted against, often with impulsive behaviour. 症状学 精神检查

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 关系妄想 delusion of reference 把周围与自己无关的事件和言语都认为针对自己的妄想 A delusion that neutral events and remarks refer to oneself. 症状学 精神检查

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 思维散漫 loosening of associations 言语内容缺乏逻辑联系、主题跳跃且难以理解的形式思维障碍 A formal thought disorder in which speech lacks logical connections and jumps between topics. 症状学 精神检查

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 思维奔逸 flight of ideas 思维联想加快、话题随境转移的躁狂期典型表现 Rapidly racing thoughts with constantly shifting topics, a typical feature of mania. 症状学 精神检查

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 思维贫乏 poverty of thought 思维内容空虚、言语量明显减少的阴性症状 A negative symptom with an empty content of thought and markedly reduced speech. 症状学 精神检查

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 情感淡漠 apathy 对周围事物缺乏情感反应和兴趣的阴性症状 A negative symptom of blunted emotional response and loss of interest in surroundings. 症状学 精神检查 情感淡漠与情感迟钝不同，前者是动力与兴趣丧失，后者是表情减少

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 情感高涨 elation 心境异常愉快、自我感觉过分良好的躁狂核心表现 An abnormally elevated mood with exaggerated well-being, a core feature of mania. 症状学 精神检查

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 情感倒错 inappropriate affect 情感表现与所处情境或言语内容明显不协调的症状 An emotional expression that is clearly incongruent with the situation or the content of speech. 症状学 精神检查

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 自知力 insight 患者对自身疾病的认识和求治态度，是判断治疗依从性的关键 A patient's awareness of being ill and attitude to treatment, key to predicting adherence. 症状学 精神检查 自知力是精神检查必写项，与自愿住院和依从性判断直接相关

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 蜡样屈曲 waxy flexibility 肢体被摆成某一姿势后可长时间保持不变而不觉疲劳的紧张症体征 A catatonic sign in which a limb remains in the position in which it is placed. 症状学 精神检查

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 缄默 mutism 无器质性构音障碍却持续不说话的状态，可见于紧张症与抑郁 A persistent absence of speech without organic impairment, seen in catatonia and depression. 症状学 精神检查

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 风险评估 risk assessment 系统评估患者自伤、自杀和伤害他人风险及保护因素的过程 A structured process of assessing the risk of self-harm, suicide, and harm to others alongside protective factors. 风险评估 入院评估 风险评估结果决定观察级别与是否采用保护性医疗措施

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 自杀风险评估 suicide risk assessment 对自杀意念、计划、手段和既往未遂史进行的分级评估 A graded assessment of suicidal ideation, plan, access to means, and previous attempts. 风险评估 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 暴力风险评估 violence risk assessment 评估患者攻击他人风险及其触发因素，用于安排处置与人力 Assessment of the risk of aggression toward others and its triggers, used to plan management and staffing. 风险评估 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 危险性评估 dangerousness assessment 对严重精神障碍患者伤害自身或他人危险性分级评定的管理工具 A grading tool for assessing the danger a patient with severe mental disorder poses to self or others. 风险评估 社区随访 危险性评估分0至5级，是严重精神障碍患者管理的固定用语

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 危险因素 risk factor 与自杀或暴力风险升高相关的既往史、症状与社会环境因素 Historical, symptom, and social factors associated with higher suicide or violence risk. 风险评估 入院评估

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 保护性因素 protective factor 降低自杀或暴力风险的社会支持、治疗依从和应对能力等因素 Factors such as social support, treatment adherence, and coping ability that lower suicide or violence risk. 风险评估 入院评估

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 既往自杀未遂史 history of suicide attempt 患者过去曾有自杀行为的历史，是再次自杀最强的预测因素 A history of previous suicidal behaviour and the strongest predictor of further attempts. 风险评估 入院评估

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 自杀意念 suicidal ideation 反复出现想结束自己生命的想法，可伴或不伴具体计划 Recurrent thoughts of ending one's life, with or without a specific plan. 风险评估 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 自杀计划 suicide plan 对自杀方式、时间和地点的具体设想，提示风险级别更高 A specific idea about the method, time, and place of suicide that indicates higher risk. 风险评估 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 冲动控制 impulse control 抑制冲动性行为的能力，受损时自伤和攻击风险升高 The capacity to inhibit impulsive behaviour, whose impairment raises self-harm and aggression risk. 风险评估 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 激越 agitation 伴明显运动性不安和情绪紧张的兴奋状态，易升级为冲动行为 A state of marked motor restlessness and emotional tension that can escalate to impulsive behaviour. 风险评估 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 敌意 hostility 对他人持明显对抗和敌视态度并伴言语攻击的情绪状态 An attitude of antagonism and verbal aggression directed at other people. 风险评估 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 评估量表 rating scale 用标准化条目和分值量化精神症状或风险程度的工具 A standardised tool that quantifies psychiatric symptoms or risk with defined items and scores. 风险评估 入院评估

zh: 哥伦比亚自杀严重程度评定量表
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 哥伦比亚自杀严重程度评定量表 Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale 国际通用的自杀意念与行为严重程度半结构化评估工具 An internationally used semi-structured tool for grading the severity of suicidal ideation and behaviour. 风险评估 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 攻击行为 aggressive behaviour 对他人或物品实施的言语或肢体侵害行为，需要登记与处置 Verbal or physical behaviour that harms others or property and requires documentation and management. 风险评估 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 自杀手段 lethal means 患者可获得并可实施自杀的具体方式与工具 The specific methods and instruments a patient can access to attempt suicide. 风险评估 急诊 限制手段可及性是自杀预防中证据最强的措施之一

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 自杀干预 suicide intervention 为降低自杀风险而采取的评估、观察、环境管理与转介等综合措施 Combined measures such as assessment, observation, environmental safety, and referral to lower suicide risk. 自杀干预 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 自杀未遂 suicide attempt 以结束生命为目的但未导致死亡的自伤行为 Self-harming behaviour intended to end one's life that does not result in death. 自杀干预 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 自杀既遂 completed suicide 以结束生命为目的并已导致死亡的行为结果 A self-harming act intended to end life that results in death. 自杀干预 死亡告知

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 自杀企图 suicidal attempt 患者有结束自己生命的意图并已实施或尝试实施的行为 An act or attempt to end one's own life with evidence of intent. 自杀干预 急诊 与自杀意念（suicidal ideation）区分：意念只有想法，企图已付诸行动

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 安全计划 safety plan 与患者共同制定的应对自杀念头、求助对象和危险物品管理的书面计划 A written plan agreed with the patient for coping with suicidal thoughts and reaching help. 自杀干预 出院交代

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 自杀风险筛查 suicide risk screening 用简短问题在就诊初期识别自杀风险的程序 A brief procedure to identify suicide risk early in the encounter. 自杀干预 分诊台

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 密切观察 close observation 对高风险患者增加巡视频次和视线覆盖的护理级别 A level of nursing care with increased checks and line-of-sight coverage for high-risk patients. 自杀干预 病房

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 专人看护 one-to-one observation 由专人持续在视线内陪护高风险患者的措施 Continuous line-of-sight accompaniment of a high-risk patient by a designated staff member. 自杀干预 病房

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 危险物品清理 removal of dangerous items 清除病房内可用于自伤或伤人的物品的护理措施 Removing items in the ward that could be used for self-harm or assault. 自杀干预 病房

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 不自杀承诺 no-suicide contract 由患者口头或书面承诺一段时间内不自杀的做法，现多被安全计划替代 A patient's verbal or written promise not to attempt suicide, now largely replaced by safety planning. 自杀干预 出院交代 不自杀承诺缺乏证据支持，不应作为降低观察级别的唯一依据

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 精神科转介 psychiatric referral 将存在精神症状或风险的患者转给精神专科进一步评估处理 Referring a patient with psychiatric symptoms or risk to specialist mental health services. 自杀干预 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 精神科会诊 psychiatric consultation 由精神科医师对急诊或住院患者进行的专科评估与建议 Specialist assessment and advice by a psychiatrist for emergency or inpatient care. 自杀干预 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 非自杀性自伤 non-suicidal self-injury 不以结束生命为目的的自我伤害行为，多见于青少年 Self-harm carried out without intent to die, seen most often in adolescents. 自杀干预 精神科门诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 遗书 suicide note 自杀前留下的表达意愿或交代后事的文字，是判断动机与风险的重要线索 Written material left before a suicide attempt that reveals intent and motives. 自杀干预 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 高危自杀风险 high suicide risk 评估为短期内自杀可能性很高的风险等级，需要立即干预 A risk level indicating a high likelihood of suicide in the near term that requires immediate intervention. 自杀干预 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 自杀预防 suicide prevention 通过限制手段、筛查、培训与随访等措施降低人群自杀率的系统工作 Systematic work such as means restriction, screening, training, and follow-up to reduce suicide rates. 自杀干预 公卫管理

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 约束 restraint 在没有其他可替代措施时限制患者身体活动的保护性医疗措施 A protective medical measure that limits a patient's physical movement when no alternative exists. 约束与保护 抢救室 精神卫生法要求约束须为保护性医疗措施、无其他可替代措施并在病历记录

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 保护性医疗措施 protective medical measures 为防止患者伤害自身或他人而采取的约束、隔离等措施的总称 The collective term for restraint, seclusion, and similar measures taken to prevent harm to self or others. 约束与保护 抢救室 这是精神卫生法的法定表述，不要写成"强制措施"

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 约束带 restraint belt 用于固定肢体、限制活动的医用约束器具，须规范使用 A medical device used to secure a limb and limit movement, which must be applied correctly. 约束与保护 抢救室

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 约束适应证 indication for restraint 可以实施约束的临床情形，如伤害自身、危害他人或扰乱医疗秩序 Clinical situations in which restraint may be used, such as self-harm, danger to others, or disrupting care. 约束与保护 抢救室

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 约束禁忌证 contraindication for restraint 不宜实施约束的情形，如约束部位皮肤损伤或严重心肺功能不全 Situations in which restraint should be avoided, such as skin injury at the site or severe cardiopulmonary disease. 约束与保护 抢救室

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 最小限制原则 least restrictive principle 在达到保护目的的前提下选择限制最小措施的原则 The principle of choosing the least restrictive measure that still achieves protection. 约束与保护 病房

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 定期巡视 regular rounds 按固定间隔查看患者状况并记录的护理要求 Checking and documenting the patient's condition at fixed, pre-set intervals. 约束与保护 病房

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 解除约束 discontinuation of restraint 患者风险缓解后及时终止约束并记录的操作 Ending restraint as soon as the risk subsides, with documentation. 约束与保护 病房

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 约束记录 restraint documentation 记录约束原因、起止时间、观察内容和告知情况的病历文书 A record of the reason, start and end times, observations, and notification for restraint. 约束与保护 病房

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 替代措施 alternative measures 在约束之前应优先尝试的陪护、环境调整和药物治疗等方式 Options such as accompaniment, environmental change, and medication that should be tried before restraint. 约束与保护 病房

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 告知义务 duty to inform 向患者或监护人说明病情、所采取措施和风险的法定义务 The legal duty to explain the condition, the measures used, and the risks to the patient or guardian. 约束与保护 知情谈话

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 人格尊严 personal dignity 患者作为人的基本尊严，不因精神障碍或约束措施而减损 The basic dignity of a person, which is not diminished by mental disorder or restraint. 约束与保护 病房

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 约束时长 duration of restraint 单次约束允许持续的时间上限，超时须重新评估 The maximum duration of a single restraint episode, beyond which reassessment is required. 约束与保护 病房

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 体位性窒息 positional asphyxia 身体被固定于影响呼吸的体位导致缺氧死亡的急症风险 A fatal risk of hypoxia when a restrained body position impairs breathing. 约束与保护 抢救室 约束相关死亡多与俯卧位和胸腹受压有关，须全程监测呼吸

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 自愿住院 voluntary admission 患者本人同意并主动要求住院治疗的方式，是精神障碍住院的基本原则 Admission with the patient's own consent and request, the basic principle for psychiatric admission. 非自愿住院 入院办理 精神卫生法规定住院治疗实行自愿原则，非自愿只是法定例外

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 非自愿住院治疗 involuntary inpatient treatment 患者不符合自愿条件时依法定情形和程序实施的住院治疗 Inpatient treatment given under statutory conditions and procedures when voluntary admission criteria are not met. 非自愿住院 入院办理 法定情形为伤害自身或有危险、危害他人安全或有危险两类

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 住院治疗 inpatient treatment 在医疗机构内接受系统观察、药物治疗和心理干预的治疗形式 Treatment delivered in a hospital with systematic observation, medication, and psychological intervention. 非自愿住院 入院办理

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 伤害自身 self-injury 患者已经发生或可能发生的针对自己身体的伤害行为，是非自愿住院的法定情形之一 Behaviour that has harmed or may harm the patient's own body, a statutory ground for involuntary admission. 非自愿住院 风险评估 法条表述为"已经发生伤害自身的行为，或者有伤害自身的危险"

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 危害他人安全 endangering the safety of others 患者已经发生或可能发生的危及他人人身安全的行为，是非自愿住院的法定情形之一 Behaviour that has endangered or may endanger the safety of others, a statutory ground for involuntary admission. 非自愿住院 风险评估

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 诊断结论 diagnostic conclusion 精神科执业医师对患者作出的疾病诊断意见，是非自愿住院的前提 The diagnostic opinion made by a licensed psychiatrist, a precondition for involuntary admission. 非自愿住院 入院办理

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 病情评估 condition assessment 对患者精神症状严重程度、风险水平和功能状态的综合判断 A comprehensive judgment of symptom severity, risk level, and functional status. 非自愿住院 入院办理

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 再次诊断 re-diagnosis 患者或监护人对住院诊断有异议时，由其他机构再次作出的诊断 A repeat diagnostic assessment by another institution when the patient or guardian disputes the admission diagnosis. 非自愿住院 入院办理 精神卫生法规定对诊断结论有异议可以要求再次诊断和鉴定

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 精神障碍鉴定 medical appraisal of mental disorder 由具备资质的鉴定机构对精神障碍诊断争议作出的技术性鉴定 A technical appraisal of a disputed mental disorder diagnosis made by a qualified institution. 非自愿住院 入院办理

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 异议 objection 患者或监护人对诊断或住院决定提出的不同意见，须依法处理和记录 A disagreement raised by the patient or guardian about diagnosis or admission that must be handled and documented. 非自愿住院 知情谈话

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 书面告知 written notification 以书面形式向患者或监护人说明诊断、治疗和权利义务的做法 Explaining the diagnosis, treatment, and rights in writing to the patient or guardian. 非自愿住院 知情谈话

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 近亲属 close relatives 配偶、父母、子女、兄弟姐妹等依法确定的亲属范围 The legally defined circle of relatives including spouse, parents, children, and siblings. 非自愿住院 知情谈话

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 公安机关 public security organ 对危害他人安全的精神障碍患者依法采取制止和送医措施的机关 The authority that may lawfully restrain and transport a patient who endangers others. 非自愿住院 急诊

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 非自愿住院标准 criteria for involuntary admission 判断是否应实施非自愿住院治疗的法定条件，包括诊断与危险性两方面 The statutory conditions for involuntary admission covering both diagnosis and dangerousness. 非自愿住院 入院办理 标准由诊断结论、病情评估和危险性三部分共同构成

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 住院治疗必要性 necessity of inpatient treatment 判断患者是否必须住院而非门诊或社区治疗的专业意见 A professional judgment on whether hospital care is required rather than outpatient or community care. 非自愿住院 入院办理

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 非自愿医疗 involuntary medical treatment 未经患者本人同意、依法定条件和程序实施的医疗措施 Medical treatment given without the patient's own consent under statutory conditions and procedures. 非自愿医疗 知情谈话

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 治疗措施 treatment measures 为控制症状和降低风险而采取的药物、心理和物理治疗手段 Drug, psychological, and physical interventions used to control symptoms and reduce risk. 非自愿医疗 病房

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 拒绝治疗 treatment refusal 患者明确表示不接受某项诊疗措施的意思表示 An explicit expression by the patient of not accepting a proposed intervention. 非自愿医疗 病房

domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
