en: management of patients with severe mental disorder
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗
text: 严重精神障碍患者管理 management of patients with severe mental disorder 对严重精神障碍患者建立档案、随访和应急处置的管理制度 A system of records, follow-up, and emergency response for patients with severe mental disorder. 特殊人群 社区管理
医疗损害 medical injury 患者在接受诊疗过程中受到的、依法可请求赔偿的人身损害 Harm to a patient arising from medical care for which compensation may be claimed 医疗损害与事故 医务处 与医疗事故不同，医疗损害不以构成事故为前提
医疗事故 medical malpractice 经医学会组织鉴定确认因过失造成患者人身损害的医疗事件 A medical event confirmed by appraisal as causing harm through negligence 医疗损害与事故 医务处 医疗事故是行政处理概念，与民事医疗损害责任不等同
医疗事故技术鉴定 technical appraisal of medical malpractice 由医学会组织专家对医疗事故争议进行的技术鉴定程序 A technical appraisal organized by the medical association on a malpractice dispute 医疗损害与事故 医务处 与医疗损害鉴定并列的两类鉴定之一，程序与主体不同
医疗意外 medical mishap 诊疗中发生的难以预见和防范、不必然构成过错的意外后果 An unforeseen and unavoidable adverse outcome that does not necessarily imply fault 医疗损害与事故 医务处 与医疗事故法律性质不同，不可混用
医疗产品责任 liability for medical products 因药品、消毒产品、医疗器械缺陷造成患者损害应承担的侵权责任 Liability for harm caused by defects in drugs, disinfectants, or medical devices 医疗损害与事故 医务处 无过错责任，与医疗损害责任的过错责任不同
院内感染损害 hospital-acquired infection injury 住院期间新发感染造成的人身损害 Harm caused by an infection newly acquired during hospitalization 医疗损害与事故 医务处 需与入院时已存在的感染区分
损害后果 damage 患者因诊疗行为受到的实际人身损害结果 The actual personal harm suffered by a patient as a result of care 医疗损害与事故 医务处 侵权构成要件之一，须有证据支持
因果关系 causation 诊疗行为与患者损害之间引起与被引起的关系 The link by which the medical act caused the patient's harm 医疗损害与事故 医务处 鉴定核心争点，常需因果关系鉴定
过错 fault 医务人员未尽到与当时医疗水平相应的诊疗义务 Failure by clinicians to meet the standard of care expected at the time 医疗损害与事故 医务处 医疗损害责任以过错为归责基础
推定过错 presumed fault 因隐匿或拒绝提供病历等情形依法直接认定医疗机构有过错 Fault imputed by law when records are concealed or refused 医疗损害与事故 医务处 病历管理失当会直接导致推定过错
医疗差错 medical error 诊疗过程中发生的可预防的执行或判断偏差 A preventable lapse in execution or judgment during care 医疗差错与过失 医务处 不等于医疗事故，也不必然构成侵权
医疗过失 medical negligence 医务人员违反注意义务造成患者损害的过错 Fault in which clinicians breach the duty of care and harm the patient 医疗差错与过失 医务处 须结合诊疗规范判断，不凭结果反推

en: duty to provide diagnosis and treatment
text: 诊疗义务 duty to provide diagnosis and treatment 医务人员依执业规范应尽到的诊断与治疗义务 The diagnostic and treatment duties clinicians owe under professional standards 医疗差错与过失 医务处 与注意义务 duty of care 区分：诊疗义务指向具体诊疗行为，注意义务指向诊疗过程中的谨慎标准
注意义务 duty of care 医务人员在诊疗中应保持的谨慎与合理注意程度 The degree of care and caution clinicians must exercise in treatment 医疗差错与过失 医务处 以合理医师标准衡量，不以结果论
违反告知义务 breach of duty to inform 未充分说明或未经同意实施诊疗的过错形态 Fault in the form of inadequate disclosure or treatment without consent 医疗差错与过失 医务处 可单独构成医疗损害责任
合理诊疗义务 duty of reasonable care 依照当时医疗水平提供合理诊疗的要求 The requirement to provide care consistent with the prevailing medical standard 医疗差错与过失 医务处 与当时医疗水平挂钩，非绝对结果义务
临床路径 clinical pathway 针对特定病种制定的标准化诊疗流程 A standardized care process for a defined condition 医疗差错与过失 医务处 偏离路径需说明理由并记录
违反诊疗规范 deviation from clinical guidelines 诊疗行为不符合国家规范或行业指南的要求 Care that fails to comply with national standards or professional guidelines 医疗差错与过失 医务处 是认定过错的主要依据
延误治疗 delay in treatment 未在合理时间内实施必要诊疗导致病情加重 Failure to provide necessary care within a reasonable time worsening the condition 医疗差错与过失 抢救室 须结合分级与病情判断合理性
过度医疗 excessive treatment 超出病情需要实施检查或治疗的行为 Tests or treatment beyond what the condition requires 医疗差错与过失 医务处 常与费用争议一并出现
医疗损害鉴定 medical injury appraisal 对医疗行为有无过错及因果关系的专门性鉴定 Expert appraisal of whether care was faulty and caused harm 鉴定与举证 医务处 由鉴定机构进行，与医疗事故技术鉴定不同
司法鉴定 forensic appraisal 司法鉴定机构依法对专门性问题出具意见的活动 Activities in which forensic institutions issue opinions on specialized issues 鉴定与举证 医务处 医疗损害常走司法鉴定路径
举证责任 burden of proof 当事人对自己主张提供证据加以证明的责任 The duty of a party to prove its own claims with evidence 鉴定与举证 医务处 医疗损害一般由患者举证

举证责任倒置 reversal of burden of proof 民法典第 1222 条规定情形下推定医疗机构有过错，由其证明无过错 Where Article 1222 of the Civil Code applies, the hospital is presumed at fault and must prove otherwise. 鉴定与举证 医务处 民法典施行后医疗损害以过错责任为原则，此为过错推定，不宜称完整的举证责任倒置
证据保全 evidence preservation 对可能灭失或难以取得的证据先行固定的措施 Preserving evidence that may be lost or hard to obtain later 鉴定与举证 医务处 可申请法院或公证机构办理
专家辅助人 expert assistant 经申请出庭就鉴定意见或专业问题提出意见的专家 An expert who appears in court to comment on appraisal opinions or technical issues 鉴定与举证 医务处 可弥补院方专业质证能力
因果关系鉴定 causation appraisal 专门判断诊疗行为与损害之间是否存在因果关系的鉴定 Appraisal determining whether care caused the harm 鉴定与举证 医务处 常与过错鉴定一并委托
伤残等级 disability grade 按国家标准对人身损害致残程度划分的等级 The grade of disability caused by personal injury under national standards 鉴定与举证 医务处 直接影响残疾赔偿金计算
医疗费 medical expenses 因损害实际发生的诊疗、药品与检查费用 Actual costs of treatment, drugs, and tests caused by the harm 赔偿与保险 医务处 以票据为准，需与损害相关
误工费 lost income 受害人因损害无法工作而减少的收入损失 Income lost because the injured person cannot work 赔偿与保险 医务处 需收入证明与误工时间
护理费 nursing expenses 因损害需要他人护理而产生的费用 Costs of nursing care required because of the harm 赔偿与保险 医务处 按护理依赖程度与期限计算
营养费 nutrition expenses 根据伤情需要补充营养所支出的费用 Costs of nutritional supplementation required by the injury 赔偿与保险 医务处 一般参照医嘱与鉴定意见
残疾赔偿金 disability compensation 因人身损害致残按伤残等级给付的赔偿 Compensation for disability paid according to the disability grade 赔偿与保险 医务处 按年龄与伤残等级计算年限
死亡赔偿金 death compensation 因人身损害死亡给付近亲属的赔偿 Compensation paid to close relatives for a fatal injury 赔偿与保险 医务处 与丧葬费、被扶养人生活费并列
精神损害抚慰金 compensation for emotional distress 因人身权益受损给予受害人或近亲属的精神损害赔偿 Compensation for mental suffering caused by harm to personal rights 赔偿与保险 医务处 数额由法院酌定，非固定标准
被扶养人生活费 dependent's living expenses 受害人依法应扶养的人因损害失去生活来源的费用 Living costs of persons the victim was legally obliged to support 赔偿与保险 医务处 已并入残疾赔偿金计算口径
后续治疗费 follow-up treatment costs 损害发生后确需继续进行的治疗费用 Costs of treatment still needed after the harm occurred 赔偿与保险 医务处 可待实际发生后另诉
医疗责任保险 medical liability insurance 承保医疗机构及其医务人员执业责任的保险 Insurance covering the professional liability of hospitals and clinicians 赔偿与保险 医务处 可分担赔付，但不免除责任认定
医疗意外保险 medical mishap insurance 针对无过错医疗意外给予补偿的保险 Insurance that compensates medical mishaps not caused by fault 赔偿与保险 医务处 与医疗责任保险的赔付前提不同
赔偿限额 compensation limit 保险合同约定的单次或累计最高赔付金额 The maximum single or aggregate payout agreed in an insurance contract 赔偿与保险 医务处 超出部分由医院自担
保险理赔 insurance claim settlement 向保险公司申请并按合同获得赔付的过程 Applying to an insurer and receiving payment under the contract 赔偿与保险 医务处 需责任认定与损失材料支撑
医疗纠纷 medical dispute 医患双方因诊疗活动产生的争议事项 A dispute between hospital and patient arising from care 调解与诉讼 医务处 处理途径包括协商、调解与诉讼
协商解决 negotiated settlement 医患双方自行协商达成一致的处理方式 Resolution reached directly through negotiation between the two sides 调解与诉讼 医务处 协商不影响患方另行起诉
人民调解 people's mediation 由人民调解委员会主持的纠纷调解 Dispute mediation led by a people's mediation committee 调解与诉讼 医务处 医疗纠纷人民调解不收费

zh: 医疗纠纷人民调解委员会
en: people's mediation committee for medical disputes
text: 医疗纠纷人民调解委员会 people's mediation committee for medical disputes 专门调解医疗纠纷的行业性人民调解组织 A specialized people's mediation body for medical disputes 调解与诉讼 医务处 调解协议可申请司法确认
调解协议 mediation agreement 经调解达成的书面协议，可申请司法确认 A written agreement reached in mediation, which may be judicially confirmed 调解与诉讼 医务处 经司法确认后具强制执行力
司法确认 judicial confirmation 法院对调解协议效力予以确认的程序 The procedure by which a court confirms the validity of a mediation agreement 调解与诉讼 医务处 确认后一方不履行可直接执行
民事诉讼 civil litigation 通过法院审理解决民事争议的程序 Court proceedings to resolve a civil dispute 调解与诉讼 医务处 医疗损害多为民诉
起诉 filing a lawsuit 向法院提交起诉状以启动诉讼的行为 Submitting a complaint to court to start proceedings 调解与诉讼 医务处 注意诉讼时效
举证期限 time limit for adducing evidence 法院指定当事人提交证据的法定期间 The period set by the court for parties to submit evidence 调解与诉讼 医务处 逾期举证可能不被采纳
一审 first instance 案件在基层或中级法院的首次审理程序 The first hearing of a case in a basic or intermediate court 调解与诉讼 医务处 不服可上诉进入二审
二审 second instance 当事人不服一审裁判提起上诉后的审理程序 The proceeding after a party appeals against a first-instance decision 调解与诉讼 医务处 二审可维持、改判或发回
判决 judgment 法院对案件实体问题作出的裁判结果 The court's ruling on the substance of a case 调解与诉讼 医务处 生效后可申请强制执行
死因鉴定 cause-of-death appraisal 对死亡原因作出的法医学专门判断 A forensic determination of the cause of death 尸检 医务处 与临床死亡诊断不同
法医病理 forensic pathology 运用病理学方法解决法律相关死亡问题的学科 The discipline applying pathology to legally relevant deaths 尸检 太平间 尸检常由法医病理医师实施
病理解剖 clinical autopsy 为明确疾病诊断与治疗效果的医学解剖 Medical autopsy to clarify diagnosis and treatment effect 尸检 太平间 与法医解剖目的不同
法医解剖 forensic autopsy 依刑事诉讼法等规定对遗体进行的强制或委托解剖 Autopsy ordered or commissioned under criminal procedure law 尸检 太平间 非正常死亡常需法医解剖
尸检报告 autopsy report 记录解剖所见与死因结论的书面报告 A written report of autopsy findings and the cause of death 尸检 太平间 是死因认定与诉讼的重要证据
死亡时间推断 estimation of time of death 依据尸体现象等推断死亡发生时刻的方法 Estimating when death occurred from postmortem findings 尸检 太平间 属法医病理判断，存在误差区间
组织病理 histopathology 对组织切片进行显微镜检查的病理方法 Microscopic examination of tissue sections 尸检 太平间 尸检常配合组织病理确诊
毒物分析 toxicological analysis 检测体内药物、毒物及其代谢物的检验 Testing for drugs, poisons, and their metabolites in the body 尸检 太平间 怀疑中毒或用药过量时必做
尸体保存 preservation of the body 以冷藏或防腐方式延缓遗体腐败的处理 Keeping a body refrigerated or embalmed to slow decomposition 尸检 太平间 保存条件须记录
尸僵 rigor mortis 死后肌肉僵硬、关节固定的尸体现象 Postmortem stiffening of muscles and fixation of joints 尸检 太平间 可用于推断死亡时间
死亡证明 death certificate 证明自然人死亡事实及其原因的法定文书 A legal document certifying the fact and cause of death 死亡证明 医务处 一式多联，须加盖医疗机构印章
死亡方式 manner of death 死亡发生的性质分类，分为自然死亡与非正常死亡 The classification of how death occurred, natural or unnatural 死亡证明 医务处 与死亡原因不同，死亡方式说明死亡性质
自然死亡 natural death 因疾病或年老导致的、无外力介入的死亡 Death caused by disease or ageing without external causes 死亡证明 医务处 须排除外伤与中毒后才能认定
非正常死亡 unnatural death 因事故、暴力、中毒或自杀等外因导致的死亡 Death caused by external factors such as accident, violence, poisoning, or suicide 死亡证明 医务处 须报公安并配合调查，不得直接开证明
死亡信息报告 death information reporting 医疗机构按规定向卫生行政部门报送死亡个案信息 Hospitals reporting individual death information to the health authority as required 死亡证明 医务处 与死亡登记报送对象不同
死因监测 cause-of-death surveillance 对人群死亡原因进行系统收集与分析的工作 Systematic collection and analysis of causes of death in a population 死亡证明 医务处 用于公共卫生决策，需保证填写质量
死亡证明补办 reissuance of death certificate 原证明遗失或损毁后依申请重新出具的程序 The procedure to issue a new certificate after loss or damage 死亡证明 医务处 须核验申请人身份与亲属关系
死亡证明存根 death certificate stub 医疗机构留存备查的死亡证明副本部分 The copy of the death certificate retained by the hospital for records 死亡证明 医务处 保存期限按病历管理规定执行
遗体 remains 死亡后的人体，需按规定保存、转运与处置 The body of a deceased person, to be preserved, transported, and handled as required 遗体处理 太平间 处置须尊重民族与宗教习俗
遗体料理 body preparation 对遗体进行清洁、整理与初步处置的护理操作 Nursing care that cleans, positions, and prepares the body after death 遗体处理 太平间 应维护逝者尊严并尊重习俗
遗体防腐 embalming 注入防腐药液以延缓遗体腐败的处理 Injecting preservative fluids to slow decomposition 遗体处理 太平间 跨境转运前通常必须完成
遗体整容 body restoration 对遗体面部与创口进行修复整形以恢复仪容 Repairing the face and wounds of a deceased person to restore appearance 遗体处理 太平间 创伤死亡常需先修复再告别
遗体告别 viewing of the deceased 家属在火化或安葬前瞻仰遗容的仪式 A ceremony in which the family views the deceased before cremation or burial 遗体处理 太平间 须安排独立空间并限时
殡仪馆 funeral home 承接遗体接运、整容、告别与火化服务的机构 A facility providing collection, restoration, viewing, and cremation services 遗体处理 太平间 接运须家属确认委托
火化 cremation 将遗体焚化为骨灰的殡葬处理方式 Disposal of remains by incineration into ashes 遗体处理 太平间 须凭死亡证明办理
土葬 burial 将遗体安葬入土的传统殡葬处理方式 Traditional disposal of remains by interment 遗体处理 太平间 须符合当地殡葬管理规定
遗体认领 identification of remains 由近亲属确认遗体身份并办理接收手续的过程 The process by which close relatives confirm identity and take custody 遗体处理 太平间 须核验身份与亲属关系证明
遗物 belongings 死者随身携带的手机、证件、现金与饰品等物品 Items the deceased carried, such as phone, documents, cash, and jewellery 遗体处理 太平间 清点须双人在场并签字
丧葬费 funeral expenses 处理遗体与办理丧葬事宜实际支出的费用 Actual costs of handling the body and conducting the funeral 遗体处理 医务处 属赔偿项目之一，按实际支出计算
遗体运输 transport of the body 在院内外或城际之间转移遗体的过程 Moving a body within or between facilities or cities 遗体处理 太平间 跨省须办理相关手续
遗体跨境转运 cross-border transport of remains 将遗体从一国运往另一国所需的申报、检疫与运输全过程 The declaration, quarantine, and transport needed to move a body between countries 遗体跨境转运 医务处 须同时满足出境国与入境国要求
卫生检疫 health quarantine 对遗体及随附物品实施的传染病防控检查 Infectious disease control checks on the body and accompanying items 遗体跨境转运 医务处 检疫不合格不得转运
出境许可证 exit permit 主管部门签发的允许遗体或骨灰出境的许可文件 A document issued by the competent authority permitting remains or ashes to leave 遗体跨境转运 医务处 须与死亡证明、检疫证明一并提交
死亡证明领事认证 consular authentication of death certificate 由目的国驻华使领馆对死亡证明真实性予以确认 Confirmation of the death certificate's authenticity by the destination country's mission 遗体跨境转运 医务处 部分国家还要求双认证
棺椁 coffin 装载遗体用于运输或安葬的箱形容器 A box-like container used to hold a body for transport or burial 遗体跨境转运 太平间 国际运输多要求密封且材质达标
防腐证明 embalming certificate 证明遗体已完成防腐处理的书面文件 A document certifying that the body has been embalmed 遗体跨境转运 医务处 多数国家入境必备
航空运单 air waybill 航空货物运输中记载托运人与货物的运输单据 The transport document recording the shipper and cargo in air freight 遗体跨境转运 医务处 遗体运输须单独申报
入境国检疫要求 entry quarantine requirements 目的国对遗体入境规定的检疫与文件条件 The quarantine and documentation conditions the destination country requires 遗体跨境转运 医务处 各国差异大，须逐案核实
随附文件 accompanying documents 遗体转运时须随行提交的证明与许可文件 Certificates and permits that must travel with the body 遗体跨境转运 医务处 缺一不可，须列清单核对
骨灰 ashes 遗体火化后剩余的骨灰，可跨境携带 Remains after cremation, which may be carried across borders 遗体跨境转运 太平间 携带出境须有火化证明
熏蒸消毒 fumigation and disinfection 用化学气体对遗体包装与运输工具进行消毒 Disinfecting packaging and vehicles with chemical gas 遗体跨境转运 太平间 按检疫要求实施并记录
遗体转运许可 permit for transport of remains 允许遗体在特定范围内转运的行政许可证件 An administrative permit allowing remains to be transported within a defined scope 遗体跨境转运 医务处 跨省与跨境许可不同
领事保护 consular protection 国家依法维护海外公民与机构合法权益的领事职务行为 Consular action taken to protect the lawful rights of citizens and institutions abroad 领事保护与协助 领事馆 有法定边界，不能干预当地司法
领事协助 consular assistance 领事官员为遇到困难的海外公民提供的帮助 Help given by consular officers to citizens in difficulty abroad 领事保护与协助 领事馆 与领事保护并列，侧重具体救助
领事官员 consular officer 在领事馆或使馆中承办领事职务的人员 A person handling consular duties at a consulate or embassy 领事保护与协助 领事馆 探视与通知均由其执行
领事辖区 consular district 领事馆负责办理领事业务的特定区域范围 The specific area in which a consulate handles consular business 领事保护与协助 领事馆 案件归属按辖区确定
保护对象 persons entitled to protection 依法可获得本国领事保护与协助的人员范围 The persons who may lawfully receive consular protection and assistance 领事保护与协助 领事馆 一般为本国公民，含特定情形
协助范围 scope of assistance 领事保护与协助条例规定的可提供与不可提供事项的界限 The boundary of what may and may not be provided under consular rules 领事保护与协助 领事馆 不得代为承担医疗或法律责任
法律协助 legal assistance 为海外公民推荐律师、提供法律信息与程序指引 Recommending lawyers and providing legal information and procedural guidance 领事保护与协助 领事馆 领事馆不代写诉状、不出庭
领事探视 consular visit 领事官员对本国住院或被拘留公民的探视 A consular officer visiting a national who is hospitalized or detained 领事保护与协助 病房 须医院配合安排时间
通报机制 notification mechanism 医院与使领馆之间就涉外案件互通信息的安排 Arrangements for sharing information on foreign-related cases between hospital and mission 领事保护与协助 领事馆 重大涉外案件应主动通报
领事保护热线 consular protection hotline 为海外公民提供二十四小时紧急求助的电话 A round-the-clock telephone line for citizens abroad in emergencies 领事保护与协助 领事馆 主要处理人身安全与紧急救助
12308热线 12308 hotline 外交部设立的海外中国公民领事保护与服务应急热线 The emergency consular hotline for citizens abroad set up by the foreign ministry 领事保护与协助 领事馆 号码固定，须写全称
领事通知 consular notification 将涉及外国公民的事件告知其国家使领馆的程序 The procedure of informing a foreign citizen's mission of an incident 领事通知与探视 领事馆 拘禁与死亡情形通常必须通知
通知义务 notification obligation 东道国就特定事项通知派遣国领事馆的法律义务 The host state's legal duty to notify a sending state's consulate of defined matters 领事通知与探视 领事馆 属国际法义务，不可自行省略
探视权 right to visit 领事官员依法会见本国公民的权利 A consular officer's right to meet a national 领事通知与探视 病房 可被依法限制但须说明理由
会见安排 visit arrangement 为使领馆探视确定时间、地点与方式的安排 Arrangements for the time, place, and manner of a consular visit 领事通知与探视 病房 须兼顾治疗与安全
通讯权 right to communicate 被限制人身自由者与外界联系的权利 The right of a person whose liberty is restricted to contact the outside world 领事通知与探视 病房 可协助联系家属与律师
语言协助 language assistance 为使领馆沟通提供的翻译与语言支持 Interpreting and language support for communication with a mission 领事通知与探视 病房 与医院口译服务可衔接
家属通知 family notification 将患者病情与情况告知其家属的程序 Informing the patient's family of the situation 领事通知与探视 医务处 须记录通知对象与时间
拘留通知 detention notification 对被拘留外国公民通知其使领馆的程序 Notifying a detained foreign national's mission 领事通知与探视 医务处 时限由国际公约与国内法规定
拒绝探视 refusal of visit 医院基于医疗或安全理由不接受探视的决定 A hospital decision not to accept a visit on medical or safety grounds 领事通知与探视 医务处 须书面说明并报外事部门
探视申请 application for visit 使领馆或家属向医院提出的探视请求 A request for a visit made by a mission or family to the hospital 领事通知与探视 领事馆 须提前提交并附身份材料
护照遗失 lost passport 外国旅客护照丢失需补办证件的状况 The situation in which a foreign traveller's passport is lost 护照与旅行证件 分诊台 须先报警取得报案证明
护照补发 passport reissuance 原护照失效后由使领馆重新签发护照的程序 The procedure for a mission to issue a new passport after the original is invalid 护照与旅行证件 领事馆 需照片、申请表与身份材料
旅行证 travel document 代替护照使用的临时出入境旅行证件 A temporary travel document used in place of a passport 护照与旅行证件 领事馆 多用于紧急回国或护照遗失
出入境通行证 exit-entry permit 在特定区域内往来的出入境通行证件 A permit for exit and entry within a defined area 护照与旅行证件 分诊台 适用范围有限，不能代替护照
护照复印件 passport copy 护照信息页的复制件，用于登记与备案 A copy of the passport data page used for registration and records 护照与旅行证件 分诊台 须与原件核对并注明用途
身份证明 identity document 证明个人身份的官方证件，如护照或身份证 An official document proving identity, such as a passport or ID card 护照与旅行证件 分诊台 无证件急诊先救治后补登记
签证 visa 允许外国人入境、停留或过境的许可 A permit allowing a foreigner to enter, stay, or transit 护照与旅行证件 领事馆 医疗停留延期需医院证明
停留期限 duration of stay 签证或入境许可允许停留的时间长度 The length of time a visa or entry permit allows a person to stay 护照与旅行证件 领事馆 住院超期须及时申请延期
逾期停留 overstay 在许可期限届满后仍未离境的状态 Remaining after the permitted period has expired 护照与旅行证件 领事馆 影响后续入境与签证申请
出境限制 exit restriction 依法限制特定人员离开国境的情形 Circumstances in which a person is lawfully restricted from leaving 护照与旅行证件 领事馆 须有法律文书依据
临时身份证明 temporary identity certificate 证件缺失时由公安机关出具的临时身份凭证 A temporary identity credential issued by police when documents are missing 护照与旅行证件 分诊台 可用于挂号与住院登记
中国国籍 Chinese nationality 依中国国籍法取得的中华人民共和国国籍身份 Nationality of the People's Republic of China under its nationality law 国籍与无国籍 领事馆 不承认双重国籍
双重国籍 dual nationality 同一人同时具有两个国家国籍的状态 The status of holding nationality of two states at once 国籍与无国籍 领事馆 中国不承认双重国籍
国籍冲突 nationality conflict 因各国国籍法差异导致同一人国籍状态不确定 Uncertain nationality status arising from differences between nationality laws 国籍与无国籍 领事馆 常需两国使领馆共同确认
无国籍 statelessness 不被任何国家依法认定为其国民的状态 The condition of not being recognized as a national by any state 国籍与无国籍 领事馆 影响身份登记与遣返
无国籍人 stateless person 不被任何国家依其法律承认为国民的人 A person whom no state recognizes as a national under its law 国籍与无国籍 领事馆 不得因身份拒绝救治
国籍认定 nationality determination 主管部门依国籍法确认个人国籍的程序 The procedure by which authorities confirm a person's nationality under nationality law 国籍与无国籍 领事馆 结果影响居留与领保
入籍 naturalization 外国人依法申请取得本国国籍的程序 The procedure by which a foreigner acquires nationality 国籍与无国籍 领事馆 须满足居住年限等条件
退籍 renunciation of nationality 本国公民依法放弃本国国籍的程序 The procedure by which a citizen gives up nationality 国籍与无国籍 领事馆 退籍后不再享有领保
国籍证明 nationality certificate 证明个人具有某国国籍的官方文件 An official document proving a person's nationality 国籍与无国籍 领事馆 办理签证与居留常用
永久居留 permanent residence 外国人在本国长期居留的合法资格 The status allowing a foreigner to reside long term 国籍与无国籍 领事馆 与国籍不同，不享有领保
永久居留身份证 permanent residence identity card 签发给永久居留外国人的身份证件 An identity card issued to foreigners with permanent residence 国籍与无国籍 领事馆 可用于就医实名登记
难民 refugee 因迫害或战乱被迫离开本国、需要国际保护的人 A person forced to flee their country because of persecution or war and in need of international protection 难民与遣返 领事馆 就医不得因身份拒绝救治
难民身份 refugee status 经甄别程序确认某人符合难民定义的法律地位 The legal status confirming that a person meets the refugee definition 难民与遣返 领事馆 影响居留、就业与医疗待遇
庇护 asylum 国家给予受迫害外国人保护并允许其居留的制度 The system by which a state protects and admits persecuted foreigners 难民与遣返 领事馆 与难民身份申请相关
不推回原则 principle of non-refoulement 禁止将难民送回可能遭受迫害国家的国际法原则 The international law principle barring return of refugees to persecution 难民与遣返 领事馆 遣返前必须评估

en: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees

驱逐出境 deportation 依法强制外国人离开国境的行政处理措施 A lawful measure compelling a foreign national to leave 难民与遣返 领事馆 与遣返性质不同，属强制措施

过境 transit 经第三国领土前往目的国的通行状态 Passing through a third country on the way to a destination 难民与遣返 领事馆 过境许可与医疗转运常同时办理
遣返前风险评估 pre-removal risk assessment 遣返前评估当事人回国是否面临迫害或酷刑风险的程序 Assessment before removal of the risk of persecution or torture on return 难民与遣返 领事馆 高风险者不得遣返

未成年人医疗决定 medical decision for minors 由监护人代为作出的未成年人诊疗决定 Treatment decisions made on behalf of a minor by the guardian 未成年人保护 谈话室 须以未成年人最佳利益为准
未成年人知情同意 consent for minors 由监护人代未成年人作出的知情同意 Informed consent given by a guardian on behalf of a minor 未成年人保护 谈话室 八周岁以上应听取本人意见
儿童福利机构 child welfare institution 由政府设立、收留照护困境儿童的机构 A government-established institution caring for children in difficulty 未成年人保护 医务处 可承担临时监护职责

亲子鉴定 paternity testing 通过遗传标记判断生物学亲子关系的鉴定 Testing genetic markers to determine biological parentage 未成年人保护 医务处 涉及身份与抚养，须自愿或依法
未成年人隐私 minor privacy 对未成年患者信息给予的特别保护 Special protection for the information of minor patients 未成年人保护 病房 披露须监护人同意
委托照护 entrusted care 监护人将部分照护职责委托他人的安排 Arrangement by which a guardian entrusts part of care to another 未成年人保护 医务处 受托人不能当然代为医疗决定
收养登记 adoption registration 收养关系依法成立并办理的登记手续 Registration completing a lawful adoption 未成年人保护 医务处 登记后收养关系成立
患者隐私 patient privacy 患者不愿公开的病情、身体与个人信息 A patient's condition, body, and personal information they do not want disclosed 隐私与数据保护 医务处 查体与讨论均须保护
个人信息 personal information 以电子或其他方式记录的、可识别特定自然人的信息 Information recorded electronically or otherwise that identifies a specific person 隐私与数据保护 医务处 处理须有合法性基础
敏感个人信息 sensitive personal information 一旦泄露易导致人格尊严或人身财产受危害的个人信息 Personal information whose disclosure may harm dignity, safety, or property 隐私与数据保护 医务处 医疗健康数据属敏感个人信息
个人信息处理告知 notice of personal information processing 向个人说明信息处理目的、方式与范围的程序 Telling individuals the purpose, method, and scope of processing 隐私与数据保护 医务处 告知须真实、准确、完整
去标识化 de-identification 去除可直接识别个人身份的信息、保留可用数据的处理 Removing directly identifying information while keeping data usable 隐私与数据保护 医务处 去标识化后仍可能被重新识别
数据泄露 data breach 患者信息被未经授权访问、披露或丢失的事件 An incident in which patient information is accessed, disclosed, or lost without authorization 隐私与数据保护 信息科 须立即上报并处置
跨境传输 cross-border transfer 将境内收集的个人信息提供给境外机构或系统 Providing domestically collected personal information to entities or systems abroad 隐私与数据保护 医务处 须完成安全评估或标准合同
最小必要原则 principle of minimal necessity 只收集与处理实现目的所必需的最少信息 Collecting and processing only the minimum information needed 隐私与数据保护 医务处 逐项说明用途

信息安全 information security 保护信息的保密性、完整性与可用性的措施 Measures protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information 隐私与数据保护 信息科 事件须分级响应

en: Regulations on Human Organ Donation and Transplantation
text: 人体器官捐献和移植条例 Regulations on Human Organ Donation and Transplantation 规范人体器官捐献与移植活动的行政法规 Administrative regulations governing human organ donation and transplantation. 器官捐献法律 医务处 2024 年 5 月 1 日起施行，原《人体器官移植条例》同时废止
自愿无偿原则 voluntary and unpaid principle 器官捐献必须出于自愿且不得获取任何报酬的原则 The principle that donation must be voluntary and unpaid 器官捐献法律 捐献谈话 任何补偿都违反原则
捐献同意 donation consent 捐献者本人或家属作出的同意捐献的意思表示 The expression of consent to donate by the donor or family 器官捐献法律 捐献谈话 须与诊疗同意分开签署
家属同意 family consent 由近亲属代表已故患者作出的捐献同意 Consent to donate given by close relatives of a deceased patient 器官捐献法律 捐献谈话 须全部近亲属签署意见
器官分配 organ allocation 按病情紧急度、配型与地域等规则分配可用器官的过程 Distributing available organs by urgency, matching, and geography 器官捐献法律 医务处 须通过国家分配系统完成
活体移植 living donor transplantation 从健康活体捐献者身上取出器官移植给受者的手术 Transplanting an organ from a healthy living donor to a recipient 器官捐献法律 医务处 限于配偶、直系血亲等法定关系
脑死亡 brain death 全脑功能不可逆丧失、需机械维持循环的死亡判定标准 Irreversible loss of all brain function with circulation maintained mechanically 器官捐献法律 ICU 判定有严格程序与确认试验
器官买卖 organ trafficking 以金钱或其他利益换取人体器官的违法行为 The illegal exchange of human organs for money or benefit 器官捐献法律 医务处 构成犯罪，发现即报
移植伦理委员会 transplant ethics committee 负责人体器官移植伦理审查的专门委员会 The committee reviewing the ethics of organ transplantation 器官捐献法律 医务处 活体移植与边缘供体须经审查
捐献者登记 donor registry 公民生前登记器官捐献意愿的官方记录 Official records of a citizen's wish to donate registered while alive 器官捐献法律 捐献谈话 登记可随时撤销
移植资质 transplant qualification 医疗机构开展器官移植须取得的法定资质 The statutory qualification a hospital needs to perform transplants 器官捐献法律 医务处 无资质不得开展
强制报告 mandatory reporting 法定主体发现特定情形必须向主管机关报告的制度 The system requiring specified parties to report defined situations to authorities 强制报告 医务处 不报告可能承担法律责任
报告义务 reporting duty 法律规定的向主管部门报告特定事件的责任 The legal responsibility to report defined events to authorities 强制报告 医务处 须明确报告主体与时限
疑似病例报告 suspected case reporting 对尚未确诊但符合疑似标准的病例上报的程序 Reporting cases that meet suspected criteria but are not yet confirmed 强制报告 医务处 疑似也须报告，不得等确诊
非正常死亡报告 unnatural death reporting 发现非正常死亡后向公安机关报告的程序 Reporting an unnatural death to the police 强制报告 医务处 须保护现场与证据
虐待报告 abuse reporting 发现疑似虐待行为后向主管部门报告的义务 The duty to report suspected abuse to authorities 强制报告 医务处 含老人、儿童与配偶虐待
未成年人受侵害报告 reporting of harm to minors 发现未成年人遭受侵害时强制报告的义务 The mandatory duty to report harm to minors 强制报告 医务处 医疗机构是法定报告主体
严重精神障碍报告 severe mental disorder reporting 对确诊严重精神障碍患者按规定登记报告的程序 Registering and reporting patients with severe mental disorders as required 强制报告 医务处 涉及随访管理与社区衔接
职业暴露报告 occupational exposure reporting 医务人员发生职业暴露后上报登记的程序 Reporting and registering occupational exposure of staff 强制报告 医务处 须当日上报并做基线检测
药品不良反应报告 adverse drug reaction reporting 发现药品不良反应后按规定上报监测系统的程序 Reporting adverse drug reactions to the surveillance system as required 强制报告 医务处 严重反应须立即报告

zh: 医疗质量安全事件报告
en: medical quality and safety event reporting
text: 医疗质量安全事件报告 medical quality and safety event reporting 发生医疗质量安全事件后按等级上报的程序 Reporting medical quality and safety events by severity level 强制报告 医务处 按事件等级确定报告时限
患者到院后先完成预检分诊，护士按分级结果引导其前往相应区域。 The patient was triaged on arrival, and the nurse directed him to the appropriate area according to the triage level.
麻烦您在分诊台稍等，我们按预检分诊的结果依次叫号。 Please wait at the triage desk; we will call patients in the order of their triage results.
分诊台完成信息登记后，患者信息会自动进入急诊系统。 After registration at the triage desk, the patient's information is entered into the emergency system automatically.
您先到分诊台登记一下，护士马上给您安排。 Please register at the triage desk first; the nurse will arrange everything for you right away.
分诊护士依据病情表现与分级标准决定患者的就诊顺序。 The triage nurse determines the order of care based on the patient's presentation and the triage criteria.
分诊护士马上过来看您，请先坐下休息。 The triage nurse will come to see you shortly; please sit down and rest.
医院每年更新一次分诊标准，并对护士进行培训。 The hospital updates its triage criteria once a year and trains the nursing staff accordingly.
按分诊标准，您这种情况属于需要尽快处理的级别。 Under our triage criteria, your condition is at a level that needs prompt attention.
分诊记录显示患者到院十分钟内即被送入抢救室。 The triage record shows the patient was sent to the resuscitation room within ten minutes of arrival.
请把分诊记录补全，写清楚到院时间和分级。 Please complete the triage record and note clearly the arrival time and acuity level.
批量伤员到院时启动快速分诊，三十秒内完成一人。 Rapid triage is activated when multiple casualties arrive, with one patient assessed every thirty seconds.
现在人多，我们做快速分诊，先看最危险的。 It is busy now, so we are doing rapid triage and will see the most seriously ill first.
车祸伤员送到后立即实施批量分诊，优先处理红色标识者。 Mass casualty triage was started as soon as the crash victims arrived, with red-tagged patients treated first.
外面送来一批伤员，马上启动批量分诊。 A group of casualties is coming in; start mass casualty triage immediately.
二次分诊发现患者病情加重，立即将分级上调。 Secondary triage revealed that the patient had deteriorated, so the acuity level was raised immediately.
到诊室后医生还会做一次二次分诊，请您配合。 The doctor will do a secondary triage once you are in the room, so please cooperate.
候诊患者每三十分钟接受一次再评估，并记录结果。 Waiting patients undergo periodic reassessment every thirty minutes, and the findings are documented.
我们再做一次再评估，您如果更难受请马上说。 Let us do one more periodic reassessment of your condition; tell me at once if you feel worse.
症状分诊表把发热、腹痛等症状分别对应到不同诊区。 The symptom-based triage chart maps symptoms such as fever and abdominal pain to different treatment areas.
请说一下您最难受的地方，我们按症状分诊安排。 Tell me what bothers you most; we will arrange your visit by symptom-based triage.
传染病预检发现患者有接触史，立即引导至隔离诊室。 Screening for infectious diseases found a relevant contact history, and the patient was taken to an isolation room.
我们正在做传染病预检，请先填表并说明有没有接触过发热病人。 We are doing screening for infectious diseases, so please fill in this form and tell me about any contact with fever patients.
发热预检点设在急诊门口，所有患者均需接受筛查。 A fever screening point is set up at the emergency entrance, and all patients must be screened.
请您到发热预检那边测一下温度，很快就好。 Please go to the fever screening point to have your temperature taken; it will be quick.
流行病学史筛查结果阴性，患者按普通流程就诊。 The epidemiological screening was negative, so the patient followed the routine pathway.
麻烦您如实回答流行病学史筛查的几个问题。 Please answer the questions in the epidemiological screening truthfully.
科室每月抽查分诊准确性，并将结果纳入质控报告。 The department audits triage accuracy every month and reports the results in its quality review.
我们复核分诊准确性，是为了让危重病人不被漏掉。 We review triage accuracy so that critically ill patients are not missed.
该例分诊不足导致患者等待超过一小时，已列入不良事件分析。 Undertriage in this case delayed care by more than an hour and was reviewed as an adverse event.
这个病人脸色这么差，别分诊不足了，赶紧叫医生。 This patient looks very unwell; do not undertriage him, call the doctor now.
过度分诊会挤占抢救资源，需要在质控中持续监测。 Overtriage consumes resuscitation resources and must be monitored continuously in quality control.
这不是过度分诊，他确实喘得厉害，必须优先看。 This is not overtriage; he really is short of breath and must be seen first.
急诊平均等待时间已缩短至二十五分钟。 The average emergency waiting time has been reduced to twenty-five minutes.
您这个分级等待时间会比较长，请耐心一些。 Your acuity level means a fairly long waiting time, so please be patient.
分诊等级分为五档，数字越小病情越重。 Triage levels run from one to five, and the lower the number, the more serious the condition.
您的分诊等级是三级，前面还有抢救病人。 Your triage level is three, and there are resuscitation patients ahead of you.
预检评估在患者踏入急诊的三十秒内完成。 The preliminary assessment is completed within thirty seconds of the patient entering the emergency department.
我先做个预检评估，您能听见我说话吗？ I will do a preliminary assessment first; can you hear me?
接诊台负责登记患者信息并指引其前往分诊区。 The reception desk registers patient information and directs them to the triage area.
您先去接诊台登记，然后到分诊台排队。 Please register at the reception desk first, then queue at the triage desk.
急诊入口设有明显标识，夜间保持照明。 The emergency entrance is clearly marked and stays lit at night.
您从急诊入口进来右转就是分诊台。 Come in through the emergency entrance and turn right to find the triage desk.
步行入院患者约占急诊总量的七成。 Walk-in patients account for about seventy percent of emergency visits.
我是步行入院自己走过来的，没叫救护车。 I came in as a walk-in; I walked here myself and did not call an ambulance.
目测评估发现患者面色苍白、大汗，立即提高分级。 Visual assessment revealed pallor and heavy sweating, so the acuity level was raised at once.
我先做个目测评估，看他能不能自己坐稳。 Let me do a visual assessment first to see whether he can sit upright by himself.
分诊访谈控制在两分钟内，只问最关键的问题。 The triage interview is kept under two minutes and covers only the most critical questions.
分诊访谈时请尽量说清楚哪里疼、疼了多久。 During the triage interview, please tell me clearly where it hurts and for how long.
分诊分区把急诊分成红区、黄区和绿区，救治能力随颜色递减。 The triage zone system divides the emergency department into red, yellow, and green areas with decreasing intensity.
您被分到黄区，这是按分诊分区安排的。 You have been assigned to the yellow zone under our triage zone arrangement.
分诊决策需在患者到院五分钟内作出。 The triage decision must be made within five minutes of the patient's arrival.
这个分诊决策我拿不准，请高年资护士复核。 I am not sure about this triage decision, so please ask the senior nurse to review it.
新版分诊指南强调对老年患者放宽分级阈值。 The new triage guideline stresses a lower threshold for assigning acuity to older patients.
我们按分诊指南执行，不是个人经验说了算。 We follow the triage guideline; it is not just a matter of personal experience.
分诊差错需在两小时内上报护理部。 Triage errors must be reported to the nursing department within two hours.
这次分诊差错我们会上报，也会重新培训。 We will report this triage error and provide retraining.
儿童分诊需结合年龄判断，不能照搬成人标准。 Pediatric triage must take age into account and cannot simply follow adult criteria.
孩子走儿童分诊通道，护士会先看。 Children go through pediatric triage, and the nurse will see them first.
电话分诊记录需注明来电时间与建议内容。 Telephone triage records must note the time of the call and the advice given.
电话分诊只能给建议，不能代替面诊。 Telephone triage can only offer advice and cannot replace an in-person assessment.
他的分诊分级是二级，需要在十分钟内接诊。 His acuity level is two, so he must be seen within ten minutes.
您的分诊分级比较靠后，前面还有两个危重病人。 Your acuity level is lower, and there are two critically ill patients ahead of you.
该院采用五级分级标准，与国际通行做法一致。 The hospital uses a five-level triage scale consistent with international practice.
分级标准写得很清楚，二级病人十分钟内必须看到。 The triage scale is clear: level two patients must be seen within ten minutes.
五级分诊体系由一级最重到五级最轻依次排列。 The five-level triage system runs from level one, the most urgent, to level five, the least.
我们用的是五级分诊，您目前是四级。 We use five-level triage, and you are currently level four.
病情分级结果决定患者进入哪个诊区。 The severity classification determines which treatment area the patient enters.
病情分级不是一成不变的，随时可能调整。 Severity classification is not fixed and may be adjusted at any time.
危急级别患者绕过候诊区直接进入抢救室。 Patients in the resuscitation category bypass the waiting area and go straight to the resuscitation room.
这个病人是危急级别，马上推抢救室。 This patient is in the resuscitation category; take him to the resuscitation room now.
危重患者由专人护送，途中不得中断监护。 Critically ill patients are escorted by a dedicated staff member with monitoring maintained throughout.
这位是危重患者，先安排床位。 This is a critically ill patient; arrange a bed first.
急症患者应在三十分钟内接诊。 Urgent patients should be seen within thirty minutes.
您是急症患者，不用排那么久。 You are an urgent patient, so you will not have to wait that long.
非紧急患者安排在绿区候诊，按叫号顺序就诊。 Non-urgent patients wait in the green zone and are seen in calling order.
您属于非紧急患者，可能要等一两个小时。 You are a non-urgent patient, so the wait may be one or two hours.
分级颜色与腕带颜色一致，便于各区快速识别。 The color code matches the wristband color so that each area can identify acuity at a glance.
腕带上的分级颜色变了，说明病情重新评估过。 The color code on the wristband has changed, which means the patient was reassessed.
红色分级患者到院后不得在候诊区停留。 Patients in the red category must not remain in the waiting area after arrival.
他是红色分级，直接进抢救室，不用排队。 He is in the red category and goes straight to the resuscitation room without queueing.
黄色分级患者应在三十分钟内完成接诊。 Patients in the yellow category should be assessed within thirty minutes.
您是黄色分级，先坐着等，我们会尽快叫您。 You are in the yellow category; please sit and wait, and we will call you as soon as we can.
绿色分级患者可在普通诊区按序就诊。 Patients in the green category can be seen in the general area in order.
您是绿色分级，可以去那边坐着等叫号。 You are in the green category, so you can sit over there and wait to be called.
复评发现病情变化，护士立即执行分级升级。 Repeat assessment showed a change, so the nurse immediately carried out an acuity upgrade.
他说胸口更闷了，赶紧做分级升级。 He says the chest tightness is worse, so do an acuity upgrade now.
症状缓解后经医生同意执行分级降级。 After symptoms eased, an acuity downgrade was carried out with the doctor's agreement.
您好多了，可以做个分级降级，但还要再观察。 You are much better, so we can do an acuity downgrade, but we still need to observe you.
分级复核由组长在十分钟内完成。 The level review is completed by the team leader within ten minutes.
这个病人我请组长做分级复核。 I will ask the team leader to do a level review for this patient.
发生分级争议时，应重新评估并说明判定依据。 When an acuity dispute arises, the patient should be reassessed and the rationale explained.
您对分级有疑问可以提，分级争议我们会重新评估。 You may question the grading; we will reassess this acuity dispute.
老年患者采用更宽松的分级阈值，以免延误救治。 A more generous acuity threshold is used for older patients to avoid delaying care.
这个指标够不够分级阈值，需要再看一遍。 Whether this indicator meets the acuity threshold needs another look.
分级判定以最危重的指标为准，不取平均值。 Acuity determination relies on the most severe indicator rather than an average.
这个分级判定有点勉强，我再看一眼病历。 This acuity determination seems a bit off; let me look at the chart again.
分级登记完成后系统会自动计算应诊时限。 Once acuity registration is complete, the system calculates the target time to be seen.
分级登记我这边做，您先去缴费。 I will handle the acuity registration; you go and pay first.
分级腕带须在患者到院后立即佩戴并核对信息。 The acuity wristband must be applied immediately on arrival and its details checked.
请把手伸出来，我给您戴上分级腕带。 Please hold out your wrist so I can put on your acuity wristband.
分级优先顺序以病情为准，与到院先后无关。 The priority order is based on the condition, not on who arrived first.
分级优先顺序不能因为熟人插队而改变。 The priority order must not be changed because someone knows a staff member.
分级一致性通过双人独立分诊来测量。 Triage reliability is measured by having two nurses triage the same patient independently.
我们查分级一致性，是为了发现培训盲点。 We check triage reliability to find gaps in training.
分级质控每月抽查一百份分诊记录。 Acuity quality control reviews one hundred triage records each month.
分级质控发现问题，会反馈给当班护士。 When acuity quality control finds a problem, it is fed back to the nurse on duty.
新入职护士须完成分级培训并考核合格。 Newly recruited nurses must complete triage training and pass the assessment.
下周有分级培训，您记得排班。 There is triage training next week, so please arrange your roster accordingly.
分级告知应在分诊完成后立即进行。 Acuity notification should take place right after triage is completed.
分级告知我已经说了，他还是不太理解。 I have done the acuity notification, but he still does not quite understand.
分级标识由护士在分诊时统一粘贴。 The acuity marker is applied by the nurse during triage.
床头分级标识掉了，麻烦补一张。 The acuity marker at the bedside has fallen off; please put up a new one.
分级信息系统与挂号系统实时对接。 The triage information system connects to the registration system in real time.
分级信息系统卡住了，先手工记录。 The triage information system is frozen, so record it by hand for now.
分级响应时限为二级十分钟、三级三十分钟。 The response time target is ten minutes for level two and thirty minutes for level three.
已经超过分级响应时限了，赶紧催一下医生。 The response time target has already been exceeded, so please urge the doctor.
急诊挂号需出示有效证件并说明主要不适。 Emergency registration requires a valid identity document and a brief statement of the main problem.
您先做完分诊，再去急诊挂号。 Please finish triage first, then go to emergency registration.
挂号处二十四小时开放，夜间由一人值班。 The registration desk is open around the clock, with one staff member on duty at night.
挂号处在哪边？我转了两圈没找到。 Where is the registration desk? I have walked around twice and cannot find it.
三号挂号窗口专门办理急诊业务。 Registration window three handles emergency cases only.
请到二号挂号窗口排队，这边暂停服务。 Please queue at registration window two; this one is closed for now.
挂号单请妥善保管，就诊和缴费都要用。 Please keep the registration slip safe; it is needed for the consultation and for payment.
挂号单丢了怎么办？还能补吗？ What if I lose the registration slip? Can it be replaced?
挂号费按医院等级与医师职称分别定价。 The registration fee is set according to hospital grade and physician rank.
挂号费是十五块，可以扫码付。 The registration fee is fifteen yuan and can be paid by scanning the code.
现场挂号在高峰时段需要排队半小时以上。 On-site registration can require more than half an hour of queueing at peak times.
我没在网上约，只能现场挂号。 I did not book online, so I can only do on-site registration.
自助挂号机旁有志愿者协助老年患者操作。 Volunteers help older patients use the self-service registration kiosks.
您可以在自助挂号机上操作，不用排长队。 You can use the self-service registration kiosk instead of waiting in a long queue.
补挂号需先结清欠费，再重新打印凭条。 Re-registration requires settling the outstanding balance and then printing a new slip.
系统里没您的号，得补挂号。 There is no record of your registration in the system, so you need re-registration.
退号须在未接诊前办理，逾期不予受理。 Registration cancellation must be done before the consultation; late requests are not accepted.
我不看了，可以办退号吗？ I have decided not to be seen; can I apply for registration cancellation?
建卡时需要录入姓名、证件号与联系方式。 Patient card creation requires the name, document number, and contact details.
第一次来要先建卡，很快的。 Your first visit requires patient card creation; it is quick.
就诊卡请随身携带，每次就诊都要刷卡。 Please carry your hospital card with you; it is swiped at every visit.
就诊卡消磁了，需要到窗口重新写卡。 The hospital card has lost its data, so it needs to be rewritten at the counter.
电子健康卡可在手机上调出，全国通用。 The electronic health card can be displayed on a phone and is accepted nationwide.
您有电子健康卡吗？没有的话我帮您申领。 Do you have an electronic health card? If not, I can help you apply for one.
急诊号按分级而非挂号先后叫号。 The emergency ticket is called by acuity rather than by registration order.
您的急诊号是四十七号，请留意屏幕。 Your emergency ticket number is forty-seven; please watch the screen.
加号需经接诊医生同意并在系统中登记。 An extra slot requires the agreement of the attending doctor and must be logged in the system.
今天号满了，我帮您问问能不能加号。 The slots are full today; let me ask whether an extra slot is possible.
挂号员核对证件后为患者打印凭条。 The registration clerk checks the identity document and then prints the slip for the patient.
挂号员说系统坏了，让我等一会儿。 The registration clerk said the system is down and asked me to wait.
急诊号源全天开放，不设预约限制。 Emergency appointment slots are open all day with no booking limit.
上午号源已经放完了，只能等下午。 There are no appointment slots left in the morning, so you will have to wait for the afternoon.
实名挂号可避免冒用他人医保卡就诊。 Real-name registration prevents people from using another person's insurance card.
现在都是实名挂号，请出示身份证。 Real-name registration is required now, so please show your identity card.
挂号信息有误会直接影响后续检查与取药。 Errors in registration information directly affect later tests and medication collection.
请核对一下挂号信息，姓名和年龄对不对？ Please check your registration information; are the name and age correct?
信息录入错误会导致报告无法关联到患者。 A data entry error can prevent reports from being linked to the patient.
信息录入我来做，您把证件放这儿就行。 I will do the data entry; just leave your document here.
发现录入错误应立即更正并留下修改痕迹。 An entry error should be corrected immediately with a record of the change.
年龄写成一百岁了，这是录入错误。 The age was entered as one hundred; that is an entry error.
代办挂号须同时提供患者与代办人的证件。 Proxy registration requires the documents of both the patient and the person acting for them.
老人来不了，我可以代办挂号吗？ The older patient cannot come; may I do proxy registration for him?
无卡挂号患者需在下次就诊时补录卡片信息。 Patients who complete registration without a card must have the card details added at their next visit.
卡没带也能无卡挂号，报身份证号就行。 You can still do registration without a card; just give your identity card number.
首诊登记需完整填写住址与联系电话。 First-visit registration requires a complete address and contact telephone number.
您是首诊登记，需要多填一张表。 This is your first-visit registration, so you need to fill in one more form.
复诊登记可直接调取上次的诊断与用药记录。 Return-visit registration can retrieve the previous diagnosis and medication records directly.
您是复诊登记，报一下上次的就诊号。 This is a return-visit registration; please give your previous visit number.
挂号类型选错会影响报销比例。 Choosing the wrong registration type affects the reimbursement rate.
挂号类型我给您选急诊，这样能优先看。 I will set the registration type to emergency so that you are seen sooner.
收费项目须在系统中与诊疗行为一一对应。 Each charge item must correspond to an actual service in the system.
这个收费项目我没做过，麻烦帮我核对。 I did not receive this charge item; please check it for me.
挂号凭条是退号与报销的必要凭证。 The registration receipt is required for cancellation and reimbursement.
挂号凭条请拿好，别弄丢了。 Please keep the registration receipt safe and do not lose it.
身份核验不通过时，需由两名工作人员共同确认。 When identity verification fails, two staff members must confirm the patient together.
请配合做身份核验，摘下口罩看一下。 Please cooperate with identity verification and take off your mask for a moment.
身份证信息将与挂号系统自动比对。 The identity card information is automatically matched against the registration system.
身份证带了吗？挂号要用。 Did you bring your identity card? It is needed for registration.
外籍患者须出示护照原件并留存复印件。 Foreign patients must present their original passport and a copy is kept on file.
我的护照在酒店，可以先看病吗？ My passport is at the hotel; can I be seen first?

en: Exit-Entry Permit for Travelling to and from Hong Kong and Macau
text: 港澳通行证上的姓名拼写须与挂号信息一致。 The name on the Exit-Entry Permit for Travelling to and from Hong Kong and Macau must match the registration information.

en: Exit-Entry Permit for Travelling to and from Hong Kong and Macau
text: 我用港澳通行证挂号，可以吗？ Can I register with my Exit-Entry Permit for Travelling to and from Hong Kong and Macau?
台胞证号码需完整录入挂号系统。 The Taiwan Compatriot Permit number must be entered in full into the registration system.
台胞证刷不出来，我手工输入号码。 The Taiwan Compatriot Permit does not scan, so I will type the number manually.
护照号码须逐位核对，避免字母与数字混淆。 The passport number must be checked digit by digit to avoid confusing letters with numbers.
请把护照号码写在这里，字迹清楚一点。 Please write the passport number here, and make it legible.
证件类型选错会导致实名核验失败。 Choosing the wrong document type causes real-name verification to fail.
证件类型这里选护照，不是身份证。 For document type, choose passport here, not identity card.
证件号码含字母时须区分大小写录入。 When the document number contains letters, case must be entered correctly.
证件号码最后一位是字母，请再念一遍。 The last character of the document number is a letter; please read it again.
姓名核对发现同音不同字，需按证件更正。 The name check found a homophone with a different character, so it was corrected to match the document.
我念一下您的名字，做个姓名核对。 Let me read out your name to do a name check.
姓名拼写与证件不一致时，须以证件为准修改。 When the name spelling differs from the document, it must be corrected to match the document.
请您把姓名拼写念一遍，我核对一下。 Please read out your name spelling so I can check it.
出生日期与证件不符会导致检查报告无法归档。 A date of birth that does not match the document prevents reports from being filed correctly.
请说一下出生日期，我核对一下年龄。 Please tell me your date of birth so I can check your age.
国籍一栏需与护照信息完全一致。 The nationality field must match the passport exactly.
请问您的国籍是哪里？我登记一下。 What is your nationality? I need to record it.
人证合一核验由挂号员与保安共同完成。 Identity matching is carried out jointly by the registration clerk and the security officer.
人证合一没通过，请到旁边再核对一次。 Identity matching did not pass, so please step aside for another check.
人脸识别失败时，可改用人工核对证件。 When facial recognition fails, staff can check the document manually instead.
请看着摄像头，做人脸识别。 Please look at the camera for facial recognition.
指纹核验用于无法提供有效证件时的辅助确认。 Fingerprint verification is used as a supplementary check when no valid document can be provided.
请您按一下指纹核验仪器。 Please place your finger on the fingerprint verification device.
无证件患者先按无名氏建档，后续补录身份信息。 A patient without identification is first filed under an unnamed record, with details added later.
我是无证件患者，证件被偷了，还能看吗？ I am a patient without identification because my documents were stolen; can I still be seen?
身份不明的伤员按危急级别先行抢救。 An unidentified person is resuscitated first under the critical category.
身份不明也要先救人，身份后面再查。 An unidentified person is still treated first; identity can be established later.
无名氏患者的腕带只写编号，不写姓名。 The wristband of an unnamed patient shows only a number, not a name.
系统里先登记为无名氏，等家属来了再改。 Register the patient as an unnamed patient in the system and change it when relatives arrive.
临时身份有效期为七十二小时，逾期须补正。 A temporary identity is valid for seventy-two hours and must be corrected afterwards.
先用临时身份给您建个档，别耽误检查。 We will create a temporary identity for you first so that tests are not delayed.
监护人确认后方可为未成年患者办理挂号。 Guardian confirmation is required before registration can be completed for a minor patient.
孩子看病需要监护人确认，请您出示一下证件。 A child's visit requires guardian confirmation, so please show your document.
代办人须出示本人证件与患者授权材料。 The authorized agent must present their own document and the patient's authorization.
您是代办人吗？请在这边签个字。 Are you the authorized agent? Please sign here.
就诊人信息与代办人不一致时需单独标注。 When the patient registrant differs from the agent, this must be noted separately.
请确认就诊人是您本人还是孩子。 Please confirm whether the patient registrant is you or your child.
关系证明可为户口簿、出生证明或公证书。 Proof of relationship may be a household register, birth certificate, or notarized document.
没有关系证明的话，代办手续会麻烦一些。 Without proof of relationship, proxy paperwork becomes more complicated.
签证有效期不足时，需提醒患者及时办理延期。 When the visa validity is running out, the patient should be reminded to apply for an extension.
我看一下您的签证有效期，登记要用。 Let me check your visa validity; it is needed for registration.
同名患者须用出生日期与证件号加以区分。 A same-name patient must be distinguished from others by date of birth and document number.
今天还有一个同名患者，别把报告贴错了。 There is another same-name patient today, so do not attach the reports to the wrong chart.
身份信息采集须遵循最小必要原则。 Identity data collection must follow the principle of minimal necessity.
身份信息采集很快，扫一下证件就行。 Identity data collection is quick; just scan your document.
医保结算窗口在急诊大厅东侧。 The medical insurance settlement window is on the east side of the emergency hall.
您这个能走医保结算，不用先全额付。 This can go through medical insurance settlement, so you do not have to pay in full first.
该药不在医保目录内，需患者自费。 This drug is not in the medical insurance formulary, so the patient must pay for it.
我帮您查一下这个药在不在医保目录。 Let me check whether this drug is in the medical insurance formulary.
异地医保需先办理备案才能直接结算。 Out-of-town medical insurance requires prior registration before direct settlement is possible.
我是异地医保，能不能直接刷？ I have out-of-town medical insurance; can I use it directly here?
缴费可通过窗口、自助机或手机完成。 Payment can be made at the counter, at a kiosk, or on a mobile phone.
请先去缴费，缴完再去做检查。 Please make the payment first, then go for the examination.
缴费窗口在夜间只保留一个。 Only one cashier window stays open at night.
缴费窗口排队太长，能用手机付吗？ The cashier window queue is too long; can I pay by phone?
移动支付支持微信、支付宝与银行卡。 Mobile payment supports WeChat, Alipay, and bank cards.
移动支付扫这个码就行，很方便。 For mobile payment, just scan this code; it is very convenient.
扫码支付成功后系统会自动打印凭条。 After QR code payment succeeds, the system prints a receipt automatically.
扫码支付可以吗？我没带现金。 Can I use QR code payment? I did not bring cash.
现金支付需当面点清并索取收据。 With cash payment, the amount should be counted on the spot and a receipt requested.
我只带了现金，现金支付行不行？ I only brought cash; is cash payment acceptable?
刷卡支付可支持银联与境外银行卡。 Card payment supports UnionPay and some foreign bank cards.
刷卡支付要输入密码，请在这里按。 For card payment you need to enter your PIN; please press here.
收据与发票不同，不能直接用于报销。 A receipt differs from an invoice and cannot be used directly for reimbursement.
收据请收好，丢了不好补。 Please keep the receipt; it is hard to replace if lost.
费用查询可在自助机或手机端完成。 Charge inquiry can be done at a kiosk or on a mobile phone.
我想做个费用查询，看看花了多少。 I would like to do a charge inquiry to see how much has been spent.
出现费用不足时，系统会暂停开立新的检查项目。 When there are insufficient funds, the system suspends new examination orders.
提示费用不足，还需要再交一点。 It shows insufficient funds, so a little more needs to be paid.
应急救助适用于身份明确但暂时无力缴费的急危患者。 Emergency assistance applies to critically ill patients who are identified but temporarily unable to pay.
您这种情况可以先走应急救助，救命要紧。 In your situation we can use emergency assistance first; saving your life comes first.
应急救助基金由卫生健康部门统一管理。 The emergency assistance fund is managed centrally by the health authority.
这笔费用可以申请应急救助基金。 This cost can be covered by an application to the emergency assistance fund.
退费须经科室确认后由财务办理。 A refund requires departmental confirmation and is then processed by the finance office.
这项检查没做，能退费吗？ This examination was not done; can I get a refund?
支付方式可在自助机上随时更改。 The payment method can be changed at any time on the self-service kiosk.
您选哪种支付方式？现金还是扫码？ Which payment method would you like, cash or QR code?
结算单需患者签字确认后存档。 The settlement statement is signed by the patient and then filed.
结算单给您一份，自己留好。 Here is a copy of the settlement statement for you to keep.
就诊流程张贴在急诊大厅的显眼位置。 The patient flow is displayed prominently in the emergency hall.
我第一次来，不太清楚就诊流程。 This is my first visit, so I am not familiar with the patient flow.
急诊接诊须在患者到院后立即启动。 Emergency reception must begin as soon as the patient arrives.
急诊接诊的医生马上过来，请稍等。 The doctor doing emergency reception will be here shortly; please wait.
医生接诊时间平均为十二分钟。 The average doctor consultation lasts twelve minutes.
医生接诊的时候请把以前的检查单带上。 Please bring your previous test results to the doctor consultation.
首诊医生需在病历中写明初步判断与处理计划。 The first consultation must include a written initial judgement and plan in the chart.
您是首诊吗？以前在我们医院看过这个病没有？ Is this your first consultation with us? Have you been treated here for this problem before?
就诊序号会显示在候诊区的屏幕上。 The visit number is shown on the screen in the waiting area.
请记一下您的就诊序号，叫到再进。 Please note your visit number; come in when it is called.
转科需由转入科室同意并完成交接。 An interdepartmental transfer requires the receiving department's agreement and a completed handover.
医生说需要转科，我去帮您办手续。 The doctor says an interdepartmental transfer is needed; I will help you with the paperwork.
会诊申请须写明目的与需要回答的问题。 A consultation request must state its purpose and the questions to be answered.
我们已经请外科来会诊了，请稍等。 We have asked the surgical team for a consultation; please wait a moment.
住院办理需先确认床位再缴纳预交金。 Admission processing requires confirming a bed before the deposit is paid.
医生开住院单了，我带您去办住院办理。 The doctor has written an admission order; I will take you to start admission processing.
入院手续包括身份核对、费用预交与物品登记。 The admission procedure includes identity checks, deposit payment, and belongings registration.
入院手续在一楼办理，电梯口右转。 The admission procedure is handled on the ground floor, right of the lifts.
出院办理需核对用药清单并预约复诊。 Discharge processing includes checking the medication list and booking a follow-up visit.
明天上午办出院办理，记得带押金条。 Discharge processing is tomorrow morning; remember to bring the deposit receipt.
检查预约可通过自助机或诊间完成。 Examination scheduling can be done at a kiosk or in the consulting room.
检查预约到下午三点，您先回去休息。 Examination scheduling has been set for three in the afternoon, so you can go and rest first.
危重患者检查陪同须由医护人员全程负责。 Examination escort for critically ill patients must be provided by clinical staff throughout.
需要检查陪同吗？我可以推轮椅带您去。 Do you need an examination escort? I can take you there in a wheelchair.
检查转运前须确认患者身份与随身管路。 Before examination transport, the patient's identity and attached lines must be confirmed.
检查转运的车在门口等，我们现在走。 The vehicle for examination transport is waiting at the door; let us go now.
门诊转急诊需由门诊医生开具转诊单。 An outpatient-to-emergency transfer requires a referral note from the outpatient doctor.
门诊说您得转急诊，我陪您过去。 The outpatient clinic says an outpatient-to-emergency transfer is needed; I will go with you.
急诊转住院需在系统中提交床位申请。 Emergency admission requires a bed request to be submitted in the system.
您这个情况要急诊转住院，先别回家。 Your condition requires emergency admission, so please do not go home yet.
每个就诊环节都需留下时间与操作人记录。 Each visit step must record the time and the staff member responsible.
下一个就诊环节是抽血，请到三楼。 The next visit step is blood sampling, so please go to the third floor.
就诊时长超过四小时的患者需说明原因。 Patients whose visit duration exceeds four hours must have the reason documented.
今天人少，就诊时长应该不会太久。 It is quiet today, so the visit duration should not be too long.
流程优化后高峰时段等候时间下降三成。 After process improvement, waiting time at peak hours fell by thirty percent.
我们正在做流程优化，以后会快一些。 We are working on process improvement, so it will be faster in future.
二次就诊需核对上次的诊断与用药。 A repeat visit requires checking the previous diagnosis and medication.
这是二次就诊，症状一直没好转。 This is a repeat visit; the symptoms have not improved at all.
就诊高峰期集中在晚间八点至十一点。 Peak hours are concentrated between eight and eleven in the evening.
现在正是就诊高峰期，请您多等一会儿。 It is peak hours right now, so please wait a little longer.
就诊状态更新为已接诊后才会进入检查队列。 Only after the visit status changes to seen does the patient enter the examination queue.
我查一下您的就诊状态，看排到哪了。 Let me check your visit status to see where you are in the queue.
就诊完成后系统会推送用药与复诊提醒。 After visit completion, the system sends medication and follow-up reminders.
您的就诊完成了，回去注意休息。 Your visit completion is confirmed; go home and rest.
就诊确认需在自助机或手机端完成。 Visit confirmation must be completed at a kiosk or on a mobile phone.
请在这里做就诊确认，签个名就行。 Please do the visit confirmation here; just sign your name.
就诊秩序由分诊护士与保安共同维护。 Department order is maintained jointly by triage nurses and security staff.
请大家保持就诊秩序，不要围在诊室门口。 Please maintain department order and do not crowd around the consulting room door.
流程公示牌列明了各环节的预计等候时间。 The process disclosure board lists the expected waiting time for each step.
流程公示在墙上，您可以先看一下。 The process disclosure is on the wall; you can read it first.
分诊后就诊按分级顺序进行，不按到院先后。 Consultation after triage follows the acuity order rather than arrival order.
分诊后就诊还要等一会儿，前面有重病人。 Consultation after triage will take a while; there are seriously ill patients ahead.
复诊预约可在离院前由医生直接完成。 A follow-up appointment can be arranged directly by the doctor before discharge.
复诊预约我帮您约在下周三上午。 I will book your follow-up appointment for next Wednesday morning.
候诊期间如症状加重请立即告知护士。 If symptoms worsen during waiting for consultation, tell the nurse immediately.
候诊的时候请不要离开太久，怕叫不到您。 Please do not leave for long while waiting for consultation, in case we call you.
候诊区设有座椅、饮水机与叫号屏幕。 The waiting area has seats, a water dispenser, and a calling screen.
候诊区在左手边，请那边坐。 The waiting area is on your left; please sit there.
三级患者的候诊时长应控制在一小时内。 The wait duration for level three patients should be kept under one hour.
候诊时长屏幕上会显示，您可以随时看。 The wait duration is shown on the screen, so you can check it at any time.
候诊叫号采用电子语音与屏幕同步提示。 Queue calling uses electronic voice and screen prompts at the same time.
候诊叫号声音有点小，您注意看屏幕。 The queue calling is a bit quiet, so please watch the screen.
叫号系统故障时改为人工呼叫。 When the queuing system fails, staff call patients manually.
叫号系统显示前面还有五个人。 The queuing system shows five people ahead of you.
排队时请保持一米间距。 Please keep one meter apart while queueing.
大家都在排队，请不要再往前挤。 Everyone is queueing, so please do not push forward.
插队会被劝阻，情节严重者移交保安处理。 Queue jumping is discouraged, and serious cases are referred to security.
有人插队，请护士过来维持一下。 Someone is queue jumping; please ask a nurse to come and keep order.
候诊序号与挂号序号一致，请勿混淆。 The queue number matches the registration number, so do not confuse them.
您的候诊序号是三十六，看着屏幕。 Your queue number is thirty-six; watch the screen.
候诊屏每十秒刷新一次叫号信息。 The display screen refreshes the calling information every ten seconds.
请看候诊屏，叫到您再进诊室。 Please watch the display screen and enter when you are called.
过号后需到分诊台重新激活排队顺序。 After a missed number, the patient must go to the triage desk to reactivate their place.
您刚才过号了，我帮您重新排。 You had a missed number just now; I will help you queue again.
重新排队需在系统内注明原因。 Requeueing requires the reason to be noted in the system.
过号要重新排队，前面还有三个人。 A missed number means you must requeue; there are three people ahead.
候诊巡视每二十分钟一次，重点看老年患者。 Waiting-area rounds take place every twenty minutes, focusing on older patients.
候诊巡视时发现他脸色不对，马上叫了医生。 During waiting-area rounds the nurse noticed he looked unwell and called a doctor at once.
候诊观察记录需写明观察时间与所见情况。 Waiting-area observation records must note the time and what was seen.
这个病人需要候诊观察，别让他离开视线。 This patient needs waiting-area observation, so do not let him out of sight.
候诊病情变化须立即重新分诊并调整分级。 Deterioration while waiting requires immediate re-triage and adjustment of the acuity level.
他候诊病情变化了，赶紧推到抢救室。 He shows deterioration while waiting; take him to the resuscitation room now.
候诊安全包括防跌倒、防走失与防交叉感染。 Waiting-area safety includes preventing falls, wandering, and cross-infection.
候诊安全提示贴在墙上，请留意。 The waiting-area safety notice is on the wall; please take note.
候诊秩序由叫号系统与现场引导共同维持。 Waiting order is maintained by the queuing system and on-site guidance together.
请保持候诊秩序，不要大声喧哗。 Please keep waiting order and do not make loud noise.
候诊患者每小时复测一次，异常者优先处理。 Waiting patients are rechecked hourly, and those with abnormal findings are seen first.
候诊患者请坐在座位上，不要堵在门口。 Waiting patients should stay seated and not block the doorway.
候诊告知应包含预计时长与病情变化时的求助方式。 Waiting information should cover the expected duration and how to get help if symptoms change.
候诊告知我再说一遍，您大概还要等四十分钟。 I will repeat the waiting information: you have about forty minutes to wait.
候诊宣教内容包括识别危险信号与正确拨打急救电话。 Waiting-area education covers recognizing warning signs and calling emergency services correctly.
候诊宣教的视频在循环播放，您可以看看。 The waiting-area education video is playing on a loop; you may watch it.
候诊环境每两小时巡查一次并记录。 The waiting environment is inspected and recorded every two hours.
候诊环境有点冷，我帮您调一下空调。 The waiting environment is a bit cold; I will adjust the air conditioning for you.
候诊拥挤时启动分流预案，开放备用诊区。 When overcrowding occurs, a diversion plan is activated and a backup area opened.
现在候诊拥挤，请家属到外面等。 There is overcrowding now, so please ask family members to wait outside.
候诊分流可把轻症患者引导至门诊诊区。 Waiting-area diversion can send mild cases to the outpatient area.
这边人太多，我们做候诊分流，请跟我走。 It is too crowded here, so we are doing waiting-area diversion; please come with me.
候诊优先级由分诊等级决定，与排队时间无关。 Waiting priority is set by triage level, not by time spent queueing.
他的候诊优先级高，先叫他。 His waiting priority is higher, so call him first.
候诊流程写在分诊台的提示牌上。 The waiting process is written on the notice board at the triage desk.
候诊流程您看一下，中间不要随意离开。 Please read the waiting process and do not leave at will in the meantime.
座位管理要求为老年与孕产妇预留前排位置。 Seat management requires reserving front-row seats for older people and pregnant women.
座位管理这边我来协调，请给老人让个座。 I will coordinate seat management here; please give up your seat to the older person.
广播叫号在三遍无人应答后转为人工寻找。 Loudspeaker calling switches to a manual search after three unanswered announcements.
广播叫号声音大，请注意听自己的号。 The loudspeaker calling is loud, so please listen for your number.
绿色通道开通后，患者可直接进入抢救室。 Once the fast-track pathway is opened, the patient can go straight to the resuscitation room.
您这个情况可以走绿色通道，不用排队。 Your condition qualifies for the fast-track pathway, so you do not need to queue.
先检查后付费适用于绿色通道患者的影像与化验项目。 Examination first, payment later applies to imaging and laboratory items for fast-track patients.
我们执行先检查后付费，您先去做检查，费用回头再结。 We use examination first, payment later, so go for the examination now and settle the cost afterwards.
批量伤员通道启用后，伤员按红黄绿分区集中处置。 Once the mass casualty pathway is opened, casualties are managed in red, yellow, and green areas.
伤员太多了，赶紧开批量伤员通道。 There are too many casualties, so open the mass casualty pathway now.
直达手术室需在患者到院前完成手术间准备。 Direct transfer to operating room requires the theatre to be prepared before the patient arrives.
这个病人走直达手术室，别送急诊病房。 This patient goes by direct transfer to operating room, not to the emergency ward.
危重孕产妇中心与产科、ICU 建立联动机制。 The maternal critical care center has a joint response mechanism with obstetrics and the ICU.
这位孕妇情况不好，马上联系危重孕产妇中心。 This pregnant woman is unstable; contact the maternal critical care center at once.
新生儿救治中心接到通知后五分钟内到位。 The neonatal care center team arrives within five minutes of being notified.
孩子要转新生儿救治中心，请家长签字。 The baby needs transfer to the neonatal care center; please sign as the parent.
先救治后付费适用于无家属陪伴的急危患者。 Treat first and pay later applies to critically ill patients without accompanying relatives.
这里实行先救治后付费，您先别担心钱。 We follow treat first and pay later here, so do not worry about money yet.
优先接诊对象包括危重患者与高龄老人。 Priority reception covers critically ill patients and the very old.
这位患者优先接诊，请安排到一号诊室。 This patient needs priority reception; please arrange room one.
优先检查需在申请单上标注绿色通道。 Priority examination requires the fast-track pathway to be marked on the request form.
他做了优先检查，结果半小时就出来了。 He had a priority examination, and the result came back within half an hour.
通道启动由急诊值班医生决定并记录时间。 Pathway activation is decided by the emergency doctor on duty and the time recorded.
通道已经启动了，检查单直接送过去。 Pathway activation is done, so send the request forms straight over.
通道时限不达标需在质控会上说明。 Failure to meet the pathway time target must be explained at the quality review meeting.
通道时限快到了，请催一下检查科室。 The pathway time target is nearly up, so please chase the examination department.
门球时间控制在九十分钟以内是胸痛中心的目标。 Keeping the door-to-balloon time under ninety minutes is the goal of the chest pain center.
门球时间每缩短十分钟，救回的人就更多。 Every ten minutes cut from the door-to-balloon time saves more lives.
门针时间超过六十分钟需逐例分析原因。 Cases with a door-to-needle time over sixty minutes are analysed individually.
门针时间是卒中救治的关键指标。 The door-to-needle time is a key indicator in stroke care.
通道标识采用统一绿色，夜间配有反光条。 Pathway signage uses a uniform green, with reflective strips at night.
沿着通道标识走，不要拐错方向。 Follow the pathway signage and do not turn the wrong way.
通道管理由急诊科与相关专科共同负责。 Pathway management is shared by the emergency department and the relevant specialties.
通道管理有问题，我们会定期开会解决。 When pathway management has problems, we meet regularly to solve them.
通道质控报告每季度向院级委员会提交。 The pathway quality control report is submitted to the hospital committee every quarter.
通道质控数据出来了，达标率比上季度高。 The pathway quality control data are out, and the compliance rate is higher than last quarter.
通道协调员负责通知导管室与转运人员。 The pathway coordinator notifies the catheterization laboratory and the transport staff.
有问题找通道协调员，她一直在急诊。 If there is a problem, find the pathway coordinator; she is always in the emergency department.
多学科团队在患者到院前已完成分工。 The multidisciplinary care team has already divided tasks before the patient arrives.
多学科团队马上到，各组准备好。 The multidisciplinary care team is arriving; all groups get ready.
一键启动后相关科室同时收到推送信息。 After one-call activation, all relevant departments receive the alert at once.
情况紧急，马上做一键启动。 It is urgent, so do the one-call activation now.
院前预警内容包括病情、预计到院时间与所需资源。 A prehospital alert covers the condition, estimated arrival time, and resources needed.
收到院前预警了，抢救室先准备床位。 The prehospital alert has come in, so prepare a bed in the resuscitation room first.
绕行急诊可再缩短十分钟的救治时间。 Emergency department bypass can shorten treatment time by another ten minutes.
这个病人走绕行急诊，直接去导管室。 This patient goes by emergency department bypass straight to the catheterization laboratory.

en: direct transfer to the catheterization laboratory
text: 直达导管室需提前通知介入团队待命。 Direct transfer to the catheterization laboratory requires the interventional team to be alerted in advance.

en: direct transfer to the catheterization laboratory
text: 走直达导管室，路上不要停。 Use direct transfer to the catheterization laboratory; do not stop on the way.
优先权仅限本次急诊诊疗期间有效。 Priority access applies only during the current emergency visit.
优先权不是特权，是为了抢时间。 Priority access is not a privilege; it is about saving time.
通道响应时间已纳入科室绩效考核。 Response time is now part of the department's performance assessment.
通道响应时间是十二分钟，达标了。 The response time was twelve minutes, which meets the target.
溶栓时间窗内到院的患者优先处理。 Patients arriving within the thrombolysis time window are treated first.
还在时间窗内，赶紧安排手术。 We are still within the time window, so arrange surgery at once.
应急通道禁止停放车辆与堆放物品。 Parking and storage are prohibited on the emergency access route.
请把车挪开，这是应急通道。 Please move your car; this is the emergency access route.
通道延误需记录原因并追踪整改。 A pathway delay must be recorded with its cause and followed up for correction.
这次通道延误是因为检查科室没接电话。 This pathway delay happened because the examination department did not answer the phone.
转诊前须与接收医院确认床位与接收条件。 Before referral, the bed and acceptance conditions must be confirmed with the receiving hospital.
我们这边治不了，需要转诊。 We cannot treat this here, so a referral is needed.
转诊单须由主管医生填写并签名。 The referral form must be completed and signed by the doctor in charge.
转诊单我给您装好了，别弄丢。 I have put the referral form in an envelope for you; do not lose it.
转诊申请需附上主要检查结果与初步诊断。 A referral request must include the main test results and the preliminary diagnosis.
转诊申请已经发出去了，等对方回复。 The referral request has been sent; we are waiting for their reply.
转诊指征包括本院不具备的诊疗能力。 Referral indications include services that this hospital cannot provide.
这个病人符合转诊指征，可以联系转院。 This patient meets the referral indication, so transfer can be arranged.
转诊评估须在转运前完成并记录结论。 Transfer assessment must be completed and its conclusion documented before transport.
转诊评估还没做，先别急着走。 The transfer assessment has not been done yet, so do not rush off.
转诊登记完成后系统会生成转诊编号。 After referral registration is complete, the system generates a referral number.
转诊登记我来录，您先联系救护车。 I will do the referral registration; you contact the ambulance first.
转诊审批一般在一小时内完成。 Transfer approval is usually completed within one hour.
转诊审批还没下来，先维持治疗。 Transfer approval has not come through yet, so continue treatment for now.
转诊接收须先确认床位与专科能力。 Referral acceptance requires first confirming the bed and specialist capacity.
对方回复转诊接收了，可以出发。 They have confirmed referral acceptance, so we can set off.
接收确认需记录答复人与时间。 Acceptance confirmation must record the person who replied and the time.
接收确认拿到了，我发到群里。 I have got the acceptance confirmation and will post it in the group.
接诊准备包括床位、设备与专科人员到位。 Reception preparation includes having the bed, equipment, and specialist staff ready.
接诊准备做好了，患者到了直接进抢救室。 Reception preparation is done, so the patient goes straight into the resuscitation room on arrival.
床位预留超过两小时未使用须释放。 A bed reservation not used within two hours must be released.
床位预留好了，到院就能直接住。 The bed reservation is done, so the patient can be admitted directly on arrival.
转诊反馈应在患者到院后二十四小时内发出。 Referral feedback should be sent within twenty-four hours of the patient's arrival.
转诊反馈收到了，那边说手术很顺利。 The referral feedback has arrived; they say the surgery went smoothly.
双向转诊可减少患者在大医院长期占用床位。 Two-way referral reduces the long-term occupation of beds in large hospitals.
我们和社区医院有双向转诊，恢复期可以转下去。 We have two-way referral with community hospitals, so recovery cases can be sent down.
上转患者需携带基层机构的诊疗记录。 Patients sent by upward referral must bring the records from the primary facility.
这里条件不够，得做上转。 The facilities here are not enough, so an upward referral is needed.
下转前需评估患者转运风险并做好交接。 Before downward referral, transport risk must be assessed and a proper handover made.
病情稳定了，可以考虑下转回社区。 The condition is stable now, so a downward referral back to the community can be considered.
跨院转诊须由双方医院确认接收安排。 Inter-hospital transfer requires both hospitals to confirm the receiving arrangements.
跨院转诊的手续我们来办，您签字就行。 We will handle the inter-hospital transfer paperwork; you just sign.
跨省转诊需提前联系对方医院并办理异地备案。 Interprovincial transfer requires contacting the other hospital in advance and filing out-of-town records.
跨省转诊路途远，家属要提前商量好。 An interprovincial transfer is a long trip, so the family should discuss it in advance.
国际转诊需协调签证、保险与航空医疗资源。 International referral requires coordinating visas, insurance, and air medical resources.
国际转诊手续复杂，家属要提前准备材料。 International referral involves complex paperwork, so the family should prepare the documents early.
转诊沟通应记录时间、对象与主要内容。 Referral communication should record the time, the person contacted, and the main points.
转诊沟通我来打电话，您把资料整理好。 I will handle the referral communication by phone; you get the documents in order.
转诊电话须使用科室登记的工作号码拨打。 A referral call must be made from the department's registered work number.
转诊电话打通了，对方同意接收。 The referral call went through and they agreed to accept the patient.
转诊风险须在转诊前向家属说明并记录。 Transfer risk must be explained to the family and documented before the transfer.
转诊风险不小，路上必须带监护设备。 The transfer risk is significant, so monitoring equipment must be taken on the journey.
转诊延误原因需在科室例会上分析。 The causes of referral delay are analysed at the department meeting.
这次转诊延误是因为对方没床位。 This referral delay happened because the other hospital had no bed.
转诊绿色通道可让患者到院后直接进入诊区。 The referral fast track lets patients go straight into the treatment area on arrival.
我们走转诊绿色通道，那边已经留好位置了。 We are using the referral fast track, and they have already kept a place for us.
对口医院之间可优先安排转诊床位。 Partner hospitals can arrange referral beds on a priority basis.
这是我们的对口医院，转过去比较快。 This is our partner hospital, so the transfer will be quicker.
医联体内可实现检查结果互认与双向转诊。 Within a medical consortium, test results are mutually recognized and two-way referral is possible.
我们医联体内转诊不用重复检查。 Within our medical consortium, referral does not require repeating the tests.
转诊标准由医院根据专科能力统一制定。 Referral criteria are set by the hospital according to its specialist capacity.
按转诊标准，这个病人应该转到上级医院。 Under the referral criteria, this patient should be sent to a higher-level hospital.
转诊档案随患者一并移交接收医院。 The referral file is handed over to the receiving hospital together with the patient.
转诊档案我复印一份留底。 I will photocopy the referral file and keep a copy.
急救呼叫接通后须在一分钟内完成地址确认。 After an emergency call is connected, the address must be confirmed within one minute.
急救呼叫电话请说清楚地点和病人情况。 For the emergency call, please state the location and the patient's condition clearly.
急救电话在本地为120，境外游客需提前了解。 The local emergency number is 120, and visitors from abroad should learn it in advance.
急救电话是多少？我马上打。 What is the emergency number? I will call right away.
呼叫受理包括地址、伤情与联系电话三项要素。 Call intake covers three elements: address, condition, and contact number.
呼叫受理完成了，车已经派出。 Call intake is complete and the ambulance has been dispatched.
调度员根据病情轻重安排出车顺序。 The dispatcher sets the dispatch order according to the severity of the condition.
调度员说最近的车十分钟到。 The dispatcher says the nearest ambulance will arrive in ten minutes.
出车时间以车辆驶离急救站为准。 Ambulance dispatch time is counted from when the vehicle leaves the station.
已经出车了，请保持电话畅通。 Ambulance dispatch has been done, so please keep your phone line free.
救护车调配以病情紧急程度与车辆位置为依据。 Ambulance deployment is based on the urgency of the condition and the position of vehicles.
救护车调配已经完成，最近的车在路上了。 Ambulance deployment is done, and the nearest vehicle is on its way.
出车时间要求控制在三分钟以内。 Dispatch time is required to be kept within three minutes.
出车时间两分半，符合要求。 Dispatch time was two and a half minutes, which meets the requirement.
到达时间由车载系统自动记录。 Arrival time is recorded automatically by the on-board system.
到达时间是九点十二分，请记一下。 The arrival time is nine twelve; please note it down.
急救现场评估包括环境安全、意识与出血情况。 On-scene assessment covers scene safety, consciousness, and bleeding.
急救现场评估还没做完，先别搬动伤员。 The on-scene assessment is not finished, so do not move the casualty yet.
派车单需与车载记录核对一致。 The dispatch order must be checked against the on-board record.
派车单打好了，司机签字就可以走。 The dispatch order is printed; the driver can leave after signing.
院前医疗急救记录须随患者移交急诊科。 The prehospital medical care record must be handed to the emergency department with the patient.
院前医疗急救已经做了初步处理，到院直接评估。 Prehospital medical care has already given initial treatment, so assess directly on arrival.
预到达通知应说明人数、伤情与预计到达时间。 Pre-arrival notification should state the number of patients, their condition, and the estimated arrival time.
预到达通知发过来了，准备两个抢救位。 The pre-arrival notification has come, so prepare two resuscitation bays.
呼叫优先级分为立即出车、优先出车与常规出车。 Call priority is divided into immediate dispatch, priority dispatch, and routine dispatch.
这个呼叫优先级高，先派车。 This call priority is high, so dispatch the ambulance first.
呼叫记录保存不少于两年。 Call records are kept for at least two years.
呼叫记录调出来听一下，确认地址没错。 Let us play back the call record to confirm the address was right.
电话指导可包括止血、体位与心肺复苏。 Telephone instruction may cover bleeding control, positioning, and CPR.
电话指导您先别搬动他，等我们到。 The telephone instruction is not to move him until we arrive.
急救站按区域布点，缩短到达时间。 Ambulance stations are located by district to shorten arrival times.
最近的急救站离这里三公里。 The nearest ambulance station is three kilometres from here.
急救网络覆盖城区与周边乡镇。 The emergency network covers the urban area and surrounding townships.
急救网络这边信号不好，定位会偏。 The emergency network signal is poor here, so the location may be off.
急救资源在高峰期需统一调配。 Emergency resources must be allocated centrally during peak periods.
现在急救资源紧张，请耐心等待。 Emergency resources are stretched right now, so please wait patiently.
城区急救半径一般不超过五公里。 The response radius in urban areas is usually no more than five kilometres.
超出急救半径的地方，到达时间会久一些。 Places beyond the response radius will have a longer arrival time.
急救调度中心可实时显示车辆位置。 The dispatch center shows vehicle locations in real time.
急救调度中心刚发来指令，让我们改去另一个现场。 The dispatch center has just sent an order for us to go to another scene.
急救指挥中心负责跨区域力量调配。 The emergency command center coordinates resources across districts.
现场由急救指挥统一安排，不要各自行动。 The scene is coordinated by emergency command, so do not act independently.
呼救者需留在现场并保持电话畅通。 The caller should stay at the scene and keep the phone line free.
呼救者说是老人突然倒地，没有呼吸。 The caller says an older person suddenly collapsed and is not breathing.
出诊记录须由出诊医生签字确认。 The house call record must be signed by the doctor who attended.
出诊记录写完了吗？到院要交接。 Is the house call record finished? It is needed for the handover on arrival.
急救车通道禁止社会车辆占用。 The ambulance bay must not be occupied by private vehicles.
急救车通道被堵了，请保安来疏导。 The ambulance bay is blocked; please send security to clear it.
直升机救援适用于交通中断的山区。 Helicopter rescue is used in mountain areas where roads are cut off.
病情太重，需要申请直升机救援。 The condition is too severe, so helicopter rescue needs to be requested.
无线通信中断时改用手机联络。 When radio communication fails, mobile phones are used instead.
无线通信信号不好，请重复一遍。 The radio communication signal is poor; please repeat that.
出车指令包含地点、伤情与注意事项。 The dispatch instruction includes the location, the condition, and points to note.
出车指令收到了，马上出发。 The dispatch instruction has been received; we are leaving now.
陪护须遵守病房作息与探视规定。 Accompanying care must follow ward routines and visiting rules.
需要陪护吗？一个人可能不方便。 Do you need accompanying care? It may be difficult on your own.
陪护证需每日到护士站更换。 The caregiver pass must be renewed at the nurses' station each day.
陪护证丢了，麻烦补办一张。 I have lost my caregiver pass; please issue a replacement.
陪护人员不得随意进入治疗室。 Caregivers must not enter the treatment room without permission.
每位患者只留一名陪护人员。 Only one caregiver is allowed per patient.
探视须在护士站登记并佩戴口罩。 Visiting requires registration at the nurses' station and a mask.
今天可以探视吗？我从外地赶过来的。 Is visiting allowed today? I have come from out of town.
探视时间为每日下午三点至五点。 Visiting hours are from three to five in the afternoon each day.
现在不是探视时间，请在楼下等。 It is not visiting hours now, so please wait downstairs.
探视规定包括限一人进入与禁止携带食物。 The visiting policy limits entry to one person and forbids bringing food.
探视规定贴在门口，请先看一下。 The visiting policy is posted at the door; please read it first.
探视证当日有效，离院时交回。 The visitor pass is valid for the day and must be returned on leaving.
请出示探视证，没有的话不能进。 Please show your visitor pass; without one you cannot enter.
陪护床需在早上七点前收起。 The caregiver bed must be folded away before seven in the morning.
陪护床还有吗？我想租一张。 Is there a caregiver bed available? I would like to rent one.
家属等候区设有信息屏与饮水设施。 The family waiting area has an information screen and drinking water.
家属等候区在走廊尽头，别堵在抢救室门口。 The family waiting area is at the end of the corridor, so do not block the resuscitation room door.
家属陪同可帮助患者完成缴费与取药。 Family accompaniment helps the patient complete payment and collect medication.
需要家属陪同吗？老人一个人不方便。 Is family accompaniment needed? It is not easy for the older person alone.
一人一陪在病区执行得比较严格。 One caregiver per patient is enforced fairly strictly in the wards.
现在是一人一陪，其他家属请回去。 It is one caregiver per patient now, so other relatives please go home.
陪护登记在入院时与患者信息一并完成。 Caregiver registration is completed together with the patient's details on admission.
陪护登记请到护士站办一下。 Please go to the nurses' station to complete caregiver registration.
探视登记需记录来访时间与体温结果。 Visitor registration must record the visiting time and the temperature result.
探视登记在门口办，两分钟就好。 Visitor registration is done at the door and takes two minutes.
探视限制适用于保护性隔离患者。 Visiting restrictions apply to patients under protective isolation.
现在有探视限制，一次只能进一个人。 There are visiting restrictions now, so only one person may enter at a time.
探视暂停期间家属可通过视频联系患者。 During the suspension of visiting, relatives can contact the patient by video.
病区临时探视暂停，请先回去等通知。 The suspension of visiting applies temporarily in the ward, so please go home and wait for notice.
儿童探视需由成人陪同并做好防护。 Child visiting requires an adult to accompany the child and protective measures.
儿童探视一般不建议，怕交叉感染。 Child visiting is generally not advised because of the risk of cross-infection.
远程探视由护士协助患者与家属连线。 Virtual visiting is set up by a nurse connecting the patient with relatives.
家属在外地，可以用远程探视。 The family is out of town, so virtual visiting can be used.
视频探视每日安排两次，每次十五分钟。 Video visits are arranged twice a day, fifteen minutes each.
视频探视的时间到了，我帮您接通。 It is time for your video visit; I will connect the call.
陪护管理纳入病区日常护理工作。 Caregiver management is part of daily ward nursing work.
陪护管理查得严，证件不齐进不去。 Caregiver management is strict, so you cannot enter without the full documents.
探视管理由护士与保安分工负责。 Visitor management is shared between nurses and security staff.
探视管理是为了患者休息，请理解。 Visitor management is for the patient's rest, so please understand.
夜间陪护需在护士站备案并领取折叠床。 An overnight caregiver must be registered at the nurses' station and collect a folding bed.
夜间陪护只能留一个人。 Only one overnight caregiver may stay.
陪护安全包括防跌倒与用电安全提示。 Caregiver safety includes advice on preventing falls and using electricity safely.
陪护安全要注意，走廊地面刚拖过。 Mind caregiver safety; the corridor floor was just mopped.
候诊家属请留一人在场，其余人在等候区。 Relatives in the waiting area should keep one person present and the rest there.
候诊家属不要在诊室门口围观。 Relatives in the waiting area should not crowd around the consulting room door.
