陪护须知在入院时随病历一并发放。 Caregiver guidelines are given out with the chart on admission.
陪护须知您看一下，有事按呼叫铃。 Please read the caregiver guidelines; if you need anything, press the call bell.
探视时段分为上午与下午两个单元。 Visiting sessions are divided into a morning and an afternoon slot.
您在第二个探视时段再来吧。 Please come back during the second visiting session.
语言初筛在挂号时完成，结果记入系统。 Language screening is completed at registration, and the result is recorded in the system.
语言初筛问一下，您平时说普通话还是方言？ For language screening, may I ask whether you usually speak Mandarin or a dialect?
语言需求评估后安排相应的翻译服务。 After language needs are assessed, the appropriate interpretation service is arranged.
您的语言需求我记下了，马上安排翻译。 I have noted your language needs and will arrange an interpreter at once.
存在语言障碍时须启用医疗翻译，不得让家属随意代译。 When a language barrier exists, a medical interpreter must be used rather than letting relatives translate.
我们有语言障碍，请找个会说英语的医生。 We have a language barrier, so please find a doctor who speaks English.
翻译服务可通过院内平台一键呼叫。 The interpretation service can be called with one click through the hospital platform.
翻译服务是免费的，您不用担心费用。 The interpretation service is free, so do not worry about the cost.
少数民族语言翻译资源需提前登记。 Minority language interpreting resources must be registered in advance.
患者说少数民族语言，请安排翻译。 The patient speaks a minority language; please arrange an interpreter.
英语沟通能力是涉外急诊岗位的基本要求。 English communication is a basic requirement for posts in international emergency care.
我英语沟通不太行，请帮我叫同事。 My English communication is not good, so please call a colleague for me.
文化初筛内容包括饮食、宗教与性别照护偏好。 Cultural screening covers diet, religion, and preferences regarding gender of carers.
文化初筛问几句就好，主要是避免冒犯。 Cultural screening takes only a few questions and mainly avoids offence.
文化背景会影响患者对治疗方案的接受度。 Cultural background affects how readily a patient accepts a treatment plan.
先了解一下患者的文化背景，沟通会顺一些。 Understanding the patient's cultural background first makes communication smoother.
健康素养偏低者需用图示反复说明。 Patients with low health literacy need repeated explanations with pictures.
他健康素养不高，别一次说太多。 His health literacy is not high, so do not explain too much at once.
识字水平不足时改用语音与图示告知。 When the literacy level is limited, voice and pictures are used instead.
先问一下识字水平，再决定怎么讲解。 Ask about literacy level first, then decide how to explain.
沟通辅助工具包括图示卡、翻译机与手写板。 Communication aids include picture cards, translation devices, and writing boards.
用沟通辅助卡指一下哪里疼。 Use the communication aid card to point to where it hurts.
翻译申请须注明语种与预计使用时长。 An interpreter request must state the language and the expected duration.
翻译申请我提交了，等二十分钟。 I have submitted the interpreter request; it will take about twenty minutes.
翻译设备需每日充电并测试语音质量。 Translation devices must be charged daily and their audio quality tested.
翻译设备没电了，换一台。 The translation device is out of power, so swap it for another.
多语种服务覆盖英语、日语、韩语与俄语。 Multilingual service covers English, Japanese, Korean, and Russian.
我们有多语种服务，您需要哪种语言？ We have multilingual service; which language do you need?
语言偏好应记录在病历首页。 Language preference should be recorded on the first page of the chart.
说一下您的语言偏好，我们好安排。 Tell us your language preference so we can arrange it.
语言标识覆盖挂号、缴费与检查区域。 Language signage covers registration, payment, and examination areas.
跟着语言标识走，就能找到抽血处。 Follow the language signage and you will find the blood sampling area.
翻译错误可能造成用药剂量理解偏差。 An interpretation error can lead to misunderstanding of drug doses.
刚才翻译错误了，我重新确认一遍。 There was an interpretation error just now, so let me confirm again.
特殊人群包括老年人、孕产妇、儿童与残疾人。 Special populations include older people, pregnant women, children, and people with disabilities.
特殊人群可以优先安排，请到这边。 Special populations can be given priority; please come this way.
优先就诊需在分诊时标注并在系统中体现。 Priority consultation must be marked at triage and shown in the system.
老人可以优先就诊，不用排这么久。 Older people can have priority consultation and do not need to wait so long.
优先安排需在系统中留下时间标记。 Priority arrangements must leave a time stamp in the system.
我们已经给您做了优先安排，请稍等。 We have made a priority arrangement for you; please wait a moment.
老年人优先在挂号与检查环节均有提示。 Priority for older adults is signposted at both registration and examination.
这里有老年人优先，您先坐这边。 We have priority for older adults here, so please sit here first.
孕妇优先可减少长时间站立带来的风险。 Priority for pregnant women reduces the risk of prolonged standing.
孕妇优先，请跟我到里面等。 Priority for pregnant women applies, so please come inside with me.
儿童优先与儿科分诊共同执行。 Priority for children is applied together with pediatric triage.
孩子发烧，可以儿童优先吗？ The child has a fever; can we use priority for children?
残疾人优先包括优先使用无障碍设施。 Priority for persons with disabilities includes priority use of accessible facilities.
残疾人优先，请走这边的通道。 Priority for persons with disabilities applies, so please use this route.
军人优先窗口设在挂号处一号。 The priority for military personnel window is at registration window one.
军人优先，请出示军官证。 Priority for military personnel applies, so please show your officer's card.
优抚对象凭有效证件可享受费用减免。 Preferential care recipients can receive fee reductions with valid documents.
您属于优抚对象吗？可以优先安排。 Are you a preferential care recipient? Priority can be arranged.
无障碍通道坡度不超过五度。 The accessible route has a slope of no more than five degrees.
推轮椅请走无障碍通道。 Take the wheelchair along the accessible route.
无障碍设施分布图张贴在导医台旁。 The accessibility facilities map is posted next to the information desk.
无障碍设施在电梯后面，我带您去。 The accessibility facilities are behind the lifts; I will take you there.
轮椅借用需登记姓名与联系方式。 Borrowing a wheelchair requires recording the name and contact details.
需要轮椅吗？我推您过去。 Do you need a wheelchair? I will push you there.
轮椅租借点设在急诊入口右侧。 The wheelchair loan point is on the right of the emergency entrance.
轮椅租借要押证件，用完归还。 Wheelchair loan requires a document as a deposit, returned after use.
听力障碍患者可申请手语或文字沟通。 Patients with hearing impairment can request sign language or written communication.
他有听力障碍，说话请慢一点、大声一点。 He has hearing impairment, so please speak slowly and loudly.
视力障碍患者需由工作人员引导就诊。 Patients with visual impairment must be guided through the visit by staff.
她有视力障碍，请扶着走。 She has visual impairment, so please hold her arm as she walks.
智力障碍患者须由监护人或家属陪同。 Patients with intellectual disability must be accompanied by a guardian or relative.
他有智力障碍，请跟家属确认治疗方案。 He has intellectual disability, so confirm the treatment plan with the family.
失能老人优先安排在靠近诊室的位置候诊。 Disabled older adults are seated closer to the consulting room while waiting.
这位是失能老人，需要人扶着走。 This is a disabled older adult who needs someone to support him while walking.
独居老人就诊后需评估是否需要社会支持。 An older adult living alone should be assessed for social support after the visit.
他是独居老人，回去没人照顾怎么办？ He is an older adult living alone; who will look after him at home?
特殊人群登记在挂号时同步完成。 Special population registration is completed at the same time as registration.
特殊人群登记我帮您勾上，后面会优先叫号。 I will tick special population registration for you, and you will be called earlier.
优先标识采用醒目的橙色底纹。 Priority signage uses a prominent orange background.
看到优先标识就可以直接过来。 When you see the priority signage, come straight over.
爱心窗口可同时办理挂号与缴费。 The priority service window handles both registration and payment.
爱心窗口那边人少，去那边办吧。 There are fewer people at the priority service window, so go there.
志愿服务在急诊高峰时段增加岗位。 Volunteer service adds posts during peak hours in the emergency department.
志愿服务台有志愿者，可以问路。 There are volunteers at the volunteer service desk who can give directions.
医务社工可协助申请医疗救助与临时照护。 A medical social worker can help apply for medical assistance and temporary care.
医务社工马上来，帮您联系社区。 The medical social worker will be here soon to contact the community for you.
无障碍沟通包括大字版材料与语音播报。 Accessible communication includes large-print materials and voice announcements.
我们做无障碍沟通，给您用大字版。 We use accessible communication, so here is a large-print version.
优先顺序由系统自动插入，不需人工干预。 The priority sequence is inserted automatically by the system without manual action.
您的优先顺序在第三位，很快到您。 Your position in the priority sequence is third, so it will be your turn soon.
爱心陪诊覆盖挂号、检查与取药全过程。 Accompanied assistance covers registration, examination, and medication collection.
需要爱心陪诊吗？我们有志愿者陪同。 Do you need accompanied assistance? We have volunteers to go with you.
导医服务覆盖急诊大厅各主要通道。 Guide service covers the main corridors of the emergency hall.
找不到地方就问导医。 If you cannot find the place, ask the guide service.
导医台备有轮椅、老花镜与充电设备。 The information desk keeps wheelchairs, reading glasses, and charging facilities.
导医台在正门进去左手边。 The information desk is on the left after the main entrance.
导诊人员熟悉各科室位置与检查流程。 Navigation assistance staff know the location of each department and the examination process.
需要导诊吗？我陪您走一趟。 Do you need navigation assistance? I will go with you.
问询高峰集中在上午九点至十一点。 Inquiry peaks between nine and eleven in the morning.
问询请到导医台，别在诊室门口问。 Please make your inquiry at the information desk, not at the consulting room door.
指引信息须与院内标识保持一致。 Direction information must match the hospital signs.
我给您指引一下，往前走第二个路口右转。 Let me give you directions: go straight and turn right at the second corner.
楼层指引牌在电梯厅内，随时可查。 The floor guide board is in the lift lobby and can be checked at any time.
楼层指引上写着三楼是检验科。 The floor guide says the laboratory is on the third floor.
科室指引按拼音排序，方便查找。 Department guides are sorted alphabetically for easy searching.
我查一下科室指引，外科在五楼。 Let me check the department guide; surgery is on the fifth floor.
路线指引需考虑无障碍与就近原则。 Route guidance must take accessibility and the shortest distance into account.
给您做条路线指引，这样不会走错。 Let me give you route guidance so you do not go the wrong way.
院内导航可在手机端实时显示位置。 In-hospital navigation shows the patient's position in real time on a mobile phone.
用院内导航扫这个码，跟着箭头走。 Use in-hospital navigation by scanning this code and follow the arrows.
指示牌高度须便于轮椅患者阅读。 Signposts must be placed at a height that wheelchair users can read.
跟着指示牌走就到急诊了。 Follow the signposts and you will reach the emergency department.
投诉受理须记录时间、事由与联系方式。 Complaint intake must record the time, the issue, and contact details.
投诉受理在门诊办公室，我带您去。 Complaint intake is at the outpatient office; I will take you there.
投诉登记后系统自动生成查询编号。 After complaint registration, the system generates a reference number automatically.
投诉登记好了，这是您的编号。 Complaint registration is done; here is your reference number.
投诉反馈须以书面或电话形式完成。 Complaint feedback must be given in writing or by telephone.
投诉反馈我们会打电话告诉您。 We will give you complaint feedback by telephone.
投诉电话在急诊大厅与官网均有公示。 The complaint hotline is published in the emergency hall and on the official website.
投诉电话是哪个？我想反映一下。 What is the complaint hotline? I would like to raise something.
意见箱每周开箱两次并登记。 The suggestion box is opened twice a week and the contents recorded.
有意见可以写下来投到意见箱。 If you have comments, write them down and put them in the suggestion box.
满意度按季度统计并向科室反馈。 Satisfaction is measured quarterly and reported back to departments.
您的满意度对我们很重要，请如实评价。 Your satisfaction matters to us, so please give an honest rating.
服务态度是投诉中最常见的项目。 Service attitude is the most common subject of complaints.
服务态度有问题我们可以反映。 If there is a problem with service attitude, we can report it.
便民服务项目在导医台公示。 Convenience service items are listed at the information desk.
便民服务有充电宝，您要借吗？ Convenience service includes power banks; would you like to borrow one?
失物招领处设在导医台，保留三十天。 Lost and found is at the information desk and items are kept for thirty days.
我的手机丢了，能去失物招领看看吗？ I have lost my phone; can I check lost and found?
首问负责要求不得以不知情为由推诿。 First-contact responsibility forbids brushing patients off by claiming ignorance.
首问负责，您问我我就帮您问到底。 Under first-contact responsibility, if you ask me I will follow it through.
服务窗口实行弹性排班应对高峰。 Service windows use flexible staffing to cope with peak periods.
服务窗口都开着，请分散排队。 All service windows are open, so please spread out when queueing.
服务改进方案由患者服务中心牵头制定。 Service improvement plans are drawn up by the patient service center.
您的意见会用于服务改进。 Your comments will be used for service improvement.
满意度评分低于四分的科室需说明原因。 Departments with a satisfaction score below four must explain why.
满意度评分一共五分，您给几分？ The satisfaction score is out of five; how many would you give?
病历主诉栏记录为胸痛两小时，与现病史一致。 The chief complaint was documented as chest pain for two hours.
请您用一句话说清主诉，就是最难受的地方。 Please give me your chief complaint in one sentence.
病程已有一周，期间症状逐步加重，需详细记录。 The duration of illness has been one week, with symptoms worsening gradually.
这个病程时间您记得准吗，大概从哪天开始。 Can you recall the duration of illness, roughly from which day?
起病时间记录为昨晚十点，距今约六小时。 The onset time was recorded as ten last night, about six hours ago.
起病时间越准确越好，麻烦想想当时在做什么。 The more exact the onset time, the better; think what you were doing.
起病方式对鉴别诊断很重要，请写明是骤起还是渐起。 The mode of onset matters for diagnosis; note whether it was abrupt or gradual.
您这个起病方式是突然一下，还是慢慢加重的。 Was the mode of onset sudden, or did it build up slowly?
突发起病伴大汗提示急性事件，需立即评估。 Sudden onset with heavy sweating suggests an acute event needing immediate assessment.
我这次是突发起病的，正吃饭时一下子就不行了。 This was of sudden onset; I went down while eating.
隐匿起病者常无法给出确切起点，需反复追问。 In insidious onset, patients often cannot give an exact starting point.
这种隐匿起病的情况，往往拖到很重才来医院。 With such an insidious onset, people come in only when very ill.
首发症状为乏力，三天后才出现发热，需写入现病史。 The initial symptom was fatigue, with fever appearing three days later.
您最早出现的首发症状是什么，发热之前有没有别的不舒服。 What was your initial symptom before the fever started?
主要症状是活动后气促，静息时减轻。 The chief symptom is breathlessness on exertion, easing at rest.
您现在哪个是主要症状，最影响生活的那个。 Which one is your chief symptom, the one affecting you most?
记录伴随症状有无恶心、出汗与心悸。 Record whether associated symptoms include nausea, sweating, or palpitations.
除了疼，您还有没有别的伴随症状，比如恶心或者出汗。 Apart from the pain, any associated symptoms such as nausea or sweating?
发病前有前驱症状，表现为乏力与食欲差。 There were prodromal symptoms of fatigue and poor appetite.
之前那几天有没有前驱症状，像感冒那样不舒服。 In the days before, any prodromal symptoms like a cold?
症状持续时间为十分钟左右，可自行缓解。 The symptom duration is about ten minutes, resolving on its own.
每次发作的症状持续时间大概多长，几分钟还是几小时。 How long is the symptom duration each time, minutes or hours?
仔细寻找诱发因素有助于预防复发。 Looking carefully for precipitating factors helps prevent recurrence.
您想想有没有诱发因素，比如一走路就发作。 Think if there is a precipitating factor, like attacks when walking.
记录缓解因素可提示病变部位与性质。 Recording relieving factors may point to the site and nature of the lesion.
什么情况下能好一点，您把缓解因素说给我听。 What makes it better? Tell me any relieving factors.
加重因素包括深呼吸与咳嗽，提示胸膜受累可能。 Aggravating factors include deep breathing and coughing, suggesting pleural involvement.
有没有加重因素，比如翻身或者深呼吸的时候更疼。 Any aggravating factors, like worse pain when turning or breathing deeply?
症状演变呈进行性加重，需记录每个时间节点。 The symptom evolution shows progressive worsening; record each time point.
这几天症状演变是怎样的，是越来越重还是时好时坏。 How has the symptom evolution gone, steadily worse or up and down?
该患者反复发作三次，每次持续数分钟。 This patient has had recurrent episodes three times, each lasting minutes.
您这个病反复发作过几次，一年能有几回。 How many recurrent episodes have you had, and how often per year?
间断发作性头痛，间期无任何不适。 Intermittent attacks of headache, with no symptoms between attacks.
我这个是间断发作，不疼的时候跟好人一样。 Mine is an intermittent attack pattern; I am fine in between.
胸痛持续不缓解超过二十分钟，按高危胸痛处理。 Chest pain with persistent symptoms beyond twenty minutes is treated as high risk.
疼了这么久一直持续不缓解，我实在受不了才来的。 It has been persistent symptoms so long that I could not bear it.
追问有无类似发作，既往两年内有三次相似情况。 Ask about similar episodes; there were three in the past two years.
以前有没有类似发作，上次也是这么疼吗。 Have you had a similar episode before, was it the same pain?
就诊原因为家属发现其意识不清，由救护车送入。 The reason for visit was confusion noticed by family, brought by ambulance.
您今天的就诊原因是什么，是什么让您决定来的。 What is your reason for visit today, what made you decide to come?
问诊应先行开放提问再针对细节追问。 A medical interview should start open-ended and then probe for details.
医生正在问诊，请您在外面稍等一会儿。 The doctor is doing a medical interview; please wait outside.
病史陈述条理清楚，时间顺序与用药情况交代明确。 The illness narrative was clear, with a proper timeline and medication details.
您的病史陈述很详细，我再确认几个时间点。 Your illness narrative is detailed; let me confirm a few time points.
发作前有先兆症状，表现为眼前闪光。 There were warning symptoms of flashing lights before the attack.
犯病之前有没有先兆症状，比如眼前发花。 Any warning symptoms before the attack, like blurred vision?
延迟就诊超过六小时，已错过早期干预时机。 Delayed presentation beyond six hours has missed the window for early intervention.
为什么延迟就诊，是没当回事还是路上耽误了。 Why the delayed presentation, did you ignore it or was the trip slow?
该患者反复就诊，一月内已来四次，需评估依从性。 The patient shows frequent attendance, four visits in a month; adherence needs review.
您最近反复就诊好几次了，是不是药没按时吃。 You have had frequent attendance lately; are you missing your medicine?
现病史需按时间顺序写清起病、演变与处理经过。 The history of present illness should follow onset, course, and treatment in order.
麻烦您把现病史讲一遍，从最开始不舒服说起。 Please tell me the history of present illness from when it first started.
发病过程记录完整，包括每次发作的时间与表现。 The course of illness was recorded fully, with timing and features of each episode.
您把发病过程慢慢说，我听清楚了再记。 Tell me the course of illness slowly; I will write it down after.
症状定位在右下腹，需结合查体进一步确认。 Symptom localization is the right lower abdomen, to be confirmed on examination.
您指一下最疼的地方，我们做症状定位。 Point to where it hurts most so we can do symptom localization.
疼痛放射至左肩及左臂内侧，需警惕心脏来源。 Pain radiation to the left shoulder and arm warrants concern about a cardiac cause.
这个疼会不会往别处跑，有没有疼痛放射。 Does the pain travel anywhere, any pain radiation?
症状昼夜变化明显，夜间加重影响睡眠。 Diurnal variation is marked, with worsening at night affecting sleep.
您这症状昼夜变化大吗，晚上是不是更厉害。 Does your condition show much diurnal variation, worse at night?
入院后病情加重，出现呼吸费力与意识改变。 There was deterioration after admission, with labored breathing and altered awareness.
这两天病情加重了，走两步就喘得厉害。 There has been deterioration these two days; I gasp after a few steps.
治疗后病情好转，可平卧休息。 Clinical improvement followed treatment, and the patient can lie flat.
用药以后病情好转，晚上能睡整觉了。 There is clinical improvement after the medicine; I sleep all night.
诊疗经过写明在外院输液一次，症状短暂缓解。 Prior treatment included one infusion elsewhere, with brief relief.
来之前有没有在别处看过，把诊疗经过说一下。 Did you seek care elsewhere? Tell me the prior treatment.
停药三天后症状复发，程度较前加重。 Symptom recurrence occurred three days after stopping the drug, worse than before.
好了没多久症状复发，是不是又把药停了。 Symptom recurrence came soon after improvement; did you stop the drug again?
阴性症状包括无发热、无呕吐、无意识丧失。 Negative symptoms include no fever, no vomiting, and no loss of consciousness.
我问问有没有这些情况，阴性症状也要记下来。 Let me ask about these; negative symptoms must be recorded too.
症状描述过于笼统，需引导患者具体化。 The symptom description was too vague and needs guiding toward specifics.
您的症状描述再具体点，是胀还是针扎一样。 Give a clearer symptom description: is it bloating or stabbing?
症状频率为每周两到三次，多在夜间发作。 Symptom frequency is two to three times weekly, mostly at night.
这症状频率高不高，一天大概几回。 Is the symptom frequency high, how many times a day?
症状强度用数字评分记录，最高达八分。 Symptom intensity was recorded by numeric score, reaching eight.
现在症状强度和刚来比，是轻了还是重了。 Compared with arrival, is the symptom intensity better or worse?
患者意识不清，病史由家属代诉获取。 The patient was confused, so the history came from collateral history given by family.
他说话说不清，麻烦您家属代诉一下经过。 He cannot speak clearly; please provide the collateral history.
病史可靠性一般，患者对用药名称记忆模糊。 Reliability of history is fair, as the patient recalls drug names poorly.
这份病史可靠性要打个问号，他记不太清。 The reliability of history is questionable; he does not remember well.
按时间轴整理发病以来的关键事件。 Put the key events since onset on a timeline of events.
我们照时间轴捋一遍，从昨天早上开始说。 Let us go through the timeline of events from yesterday morning.
症状波动较大，上下午评分相差三分。 Symptom fluctuation is considerable, with scores differing by three.
这病症状波动很大，好的时候跟没事一样。 The symptom fluctuation is large; when better I feel fine.
发病季节集中在冬季，与呼吸道感染高发期一致。 The season of onset clusters in winter, matching the respiratory infection peak.
您还记得发病季节吗，是冬天还是夏天。 Do you recall the season of onset, winter or summer?
伴随体征有结膜苍白与心率增快。 Associated signs include pale conjunctivae and a raised heart rate.
除了您说的不舒服，还有没有别的伴随体征。 Apart from your discomfort, were there other associated signs?
体位性加重明显，平卧时疼痛剧烈，需坐起缓解。 Postural aggravation is marked; pain is severe lying flat and eases sitting up.
躺下会不会更难受，有没有体位性加重。 Is it worse lying down, any postural aggravation?
夜间症状频繁，需询问是否被憋醒。 Nocturnal symptoms are frequent; ask whether the patient wakes up gasping.
晚上睡着以后有没有夜间症状，会被憋醒吗。 Any nocturnal symptoms after falling asleep, do you wake gasping?
先以开放式提问让患者自述，再逐项核实。 Begin with an open-ended question, then verify item by item.
我用开放式提问，您想到哪儿说到哪儿。 I will use an open-ended question; tell me whatever comes to mind.
封闭式提问适合核对时间、数量与既往史。 A closed-ended question suits checking time, quantity, and past history.
接下来我封闭式提问，您只答有或者没有。 Next I will use closed-ended questions; just answer yes or no.
对含糊之处逐一追问，明确发作诱因与缓解方式。 Use a follow-up question on each vague point to clarify triggers and relief.
我再追问一句，当时有没有出汗或者恶心。 One follow-up question: did you sweat or feel nauseated then?
恰当的共情回应可降低患者焦虑，提高病史准确性。 A proper empathic response reduces anxiety and improves the accuracy of history.
看他疼得厉害，我先共情回应一句再继续问。 He is in severe pain, so I offered an empathic response first.
既往史需写明慢性病、手术与输血情况。 Past medical history should cover chronic disease, surgery, and transfusions.
我问一下既往史，您以前得过什么病。 Let me ask your past medical history: what illnesses have you had?
慢性病史包括高血压十年，规律服药。 The chronic medical history includes ten years of hypertension on regular medicine.
有没有慢性病史，比如血压血糖方面的。 Any chronic medical history, such as blood pressure or sugar problems?
基础疾病多，耐受差，治疗方案需个体化。 With many underlying conditions and poor tolerance, treatment must be individualized.
您有哪些基础疾病，平时吃什么药控制。 What underlying conditions do you have, and what controls them?
合并症增加治疗风险，需在病历中列明。 Comorbidity raises treatment risk and must be listed in the record.
他有几种合并症，用药上要一起考虑。 He has several other conditions, so comorbidity affects every drug choice.
手术史记录阑尾切除术后十年，恢复良好。 The surgical history notes an appendectomy ten years ago with good recovery.
以前做过什么手术，手术史要问清楚。 What operations have you had? I need a clear surgical history.
外伤史阴性，本次无明确外力作用。 The injury history is negative, with no clear external force this time.
以前有过外伤史吗，比如骨折或者头部撞过。 Any injury history, such as fractures or a head blow?
住院史显示一年内因同样症状住院两次。 The hospitalization history shows two admissions in a year for the same symptoms.
之前住过院吗，住院史我记一下。 Have you been admitted before? I will note the hospitalization history.
输血史需注明有无输血反应。 The transfusion history should note whether there were reactions.
输过血吗，输血史对备血有帮助。 Have you had transfusions? A transfusion history helps with cross-matching.
传染病史阳性者需按院感要求安置。 A positive communicable disease history requires placement per infection control rules.
得过传染病没有，传染病史要问清楚。 Do you have any communicable disease history? I need it recorded clearly.
免疫接种史不完整，需补种并记录。 The immunization history is incomplete; catch-up doses should be given and recorded.
疫苗都打过了吗，免疫接种史我登记一下。 Are your vaccines up to date? Let me record the immunization history.
系统回顾未发现其他系统阳性症状。 The review of systems found no positive symptoms in other systems.
咱们做个系统回顾，从头到脚问一遍。 Let us do a review of systems, asking from head to toe.
麻醉史记录曾出现插管困难，需提前告知。 The anesthesia history notes a previous difficult intubation and should be flagged.
以前麻醉过吗，有没有不舒服，麻醉史要记。 Have you had anesthesia? Any problems? I must record the anesthesia history.
放疗史提示局部组织脆弱，操作需轻柔。 A radiotherapy history suggests fragile tissue, so handle it gently.
做过放疗吗，哪个部位，放疗史要写清楚。 Have you had radiotherapy, and where? I need a full radiotherapy history.
化疗史需注明近期白细胞情况。 The chemotherapy history should note recent white cell counts.
化疗史很重要，最近一次化疗是什么时候。 The chemotherapy history matters; when was the last cycle?
透析史患者用药剂量需按肾功能调整。 In patients with a dialysis history, doses must be adjusted for renal function.
是不是在做透析，透析史我得记下来。 Are you on dialysis? I need to record the dialysis history.
儿童期疾病史对判断免疫状态有参考价值。 A childhood illness history helps judge immune status.
小时候有什么儿童期疾病，比如高热抽过没有。 Any childhood illness, such as convulsions with high fever?
既往诊断不明确，需重新评估本次病情。 The previous diagnosis is unclear, so this episode must be reassessed.
外院给过什么既往诊断，您带资料了吗。 What previous diagnosis were you given elsewhere? Did you bring records?
长期卧床者需评估压疮与静脉血栓风险。 People on prolonged bed rest need pressure sore and clot risk assessment.
老人长期卧床，翻身都困难，这种情况多久了。 The elder has been on prolonged bed rest; how long has this lasted?
既往感染史提示可能存在相应抗体。 A previous infection suggests possible existing antibodies.
以前得过什么感染，既往感染史也要问。 What infections have you had? I also ask about previous infection.
家属存在疫苗犹豫，需耐心解释接种获益。 The family shows vaccine hesitancy and needs a patient explanation of benefits.
您是对疫苗有顾虑吗，这种疫苗犹豫很常见。 Are you worried about vaccines? Such vaccine hesitancy is common.
既往住院原因为肺部感染，与本次症状相关。 The reason for prior admission was a lung infection, relevant to these symptoms.
上次住院是因为什么，既往住院原因说一下。 What was the reason for prior admission last time?
疾病控制情况良好，近半年指标平稳。 Disease control status is good, with stable markers over six months.
您这病平时控制得怎么样，疾病控制情况如何。 How is your disease control status usually?
术后恢复情况良好，一周后出院。 The postoperative recovery was good, with discharge after a week.
上次手术的术后恢复情况怎么样，顺利吗。 How was the postoperative recovery last time, did it go smoothly?
药物维持治疗期间不可自行停药，否则易反跳。 Do not stop maintenance therapy on your own, or rebound is likely.
现在还在做药物维持治疗吗，药一直没停吧。 Are you still on maintenance therapy? You have not stopped the drugs?
复诊依从性差是本次病情反复的重要原因。 Poor follow-up adherence is a major cause of this relapse.
复诊依从性要提醒一下，别自己停药不来。 I must stress follow-up adherence: do not stop drugs or skip visits.
过敏史需在病历首页醒目标注。 The allergy history must be flagged prominently on the record.
先问过敏史，有没有对什么药过敏。 First, the allergy history: are you allergic to any medicine?
药物超敏反应记录为青霉素类，禁用同类药物。 Drug hypersensitivity is recorded for penicillins, so the class is avoided.
有没有药物超敏反应，吃药后起过疹子吗。 Any drug hypersensitivity? Did you get a rash after medicine?
海鲜过敏者进食后出现皮疹与口唇肿胀。 Seafood allergy causes rash and lip swelling after eating.
有没有海鲜过敏，吃了虾会不会痒。 Any seafood allergy? Does eating shrimp make you itch?
乳胶过敏者需使用无乳胶手套与耗材。 For latex allergy, use latex-free gloves and supplies.
您是乳胶过敏吗，那我们换无粉手套。 Do you have latex allergy? Then we will use powder-free gloves.
碘造影剂过敏者检查前需预处理并备抢救药。 With iodinated contrast allergy, premedicate and prepare resuscitation drugs.
以前做增强检查有没有碘造影剂过敏。 Did a previous scan cause iodinated contrast allergy?
头孢类过敏已标注，改用其他类抗菌药物。 Cephalosporin allergy is flagged, so another antibiotic class is used.
头孢类过敏吗，这个药不能用。 Do you have cephalosporin allergy? Then this drug cannot be used.
金属过敏者佩戴饰品后局部出现红斑与水疱。 Metal allergy causes local redness and blisters after wearing jewellery.
