到复苏终点了就收手，补多了反而不好。 Once the endpoint of resuscitation is reached stop, more fluid does harm.
每日液体平衡记录，连续三天为正平衡，需考虑利尿。 Daily fluid balance was positive for three days, so diuresis was considered.
液体平衡算一下，我怀疑他进得太多出得太少。 Work out the fluid balance, I suspect he takes in too much and puts out too little.
扩容后血压回升至 100 比 62 毫米汞柱。 After volume expansion the blood pressure recovered to 100 over 62 mmHg.
先扩容，血压稳了再看要不要升压药。 Expand the volume first and see whether a vasopressor is still needed.
动脉血气分析提示二氧化碳分压 68 毫米汞柱，考虑通气不足。 Arterial blood gas analysis showed a carbon dioxide pressure of 68 mmHg, suggesting hypoventilation.
先抽个动脉血气分析，看氧分压和酸碱。 Take an arterial blood gas analysis to look at the oxygen pressure and acid-base status.
氧疗指征明确，血氧 89 百分比，立即给氧。 The indication for oxygen therapy was clear with saturation at 89 percent, so oxygen was started at once.
他有氧疗指征，别等了先上氧。 He meets the indication for oxygen therapy, do not wait, give oxygen now.
十二导联心电图示下壁 ST 段抬高，启动导管室。 The twelve-lead ECG showed inferior ST elevation and the catheter laboratory was activated.
先做十二导联心电图，监护上那几条不够看。 Do a twelve-lead ECG first, the monitor leads are not enough.
低体温患者采用加温输液，液体温度维持 38 至 40 摄氏度。 Warmed intravenous fluid at 38 to 40 degrees Celsius was used in the hypothermic patient.
加温输液接上了吗，这么冷的天不能直接输。 Is the warmed intravenous fluid connected, we cannot infuse cold fluid in this weather.
目标导向液体治疗使补液更精准，减少术后并发症。 Goal-directed fluid therapy made fluid administration more precise and reduced postoperative complications.
我们现在按目标导向液体治疗来做，看每搏量。 We are using goal-directed fluid therapy now, watching the stroke volume.
入室即予心电监护，观察心律与 ST 段变化。 Electrocardiographic monitoring was started on arrival to watch rhythm and ST segments.
心电监护开着，别把导联扯掉。 Electrocardiographic monitoring is running, do not pull the leads off.
心电监护仪屏幕显示室性早搏，立即打印条图。 The cardiac monitor showed premature ventricular beats, so a rhythm strip was printed at once.
心电监护仪黑屏了，看看电源线。 The cardiac monitor has gone black, check the power cable.
心电波形出现明显基线漂移，重新粘贴电极。 The ECG waveform showed marked baseline drift, so the electrodes were reapplied.
心电波形太小了，把增益调一下。 The ECG waveform is too small, adjust the gain.
监护导联选择 II 导联，便于观察 P 波。 Monitoring lead II was chosen to make the P waves visible.
监护导联位置不对，P 波看不清。 The monitoring lead is in the wrong place and the P waves are unclear.
三导联监护用于常规观察，疑缺血时加做十二导联。 Three-lead monitoring was used for routine observation, with a twelve-lead ECG added when ischaemia was suspected.
先上三导联监护，等会儿再做十二导联。 Start three-lead monitoring first, the twelve-lead can wait.
心率 136 次每分，律齐，考虑窦性心动过速。 The heart rate was 136 per minute and regular, consistent with sinus tachycardia.
心率一百三十多，先看有没有发热。 His heart rate is over one hundred and thirty, check for fever first.
心律为心房颤动，心室率 110 次每分。 The cardiac rhythm was atrial fibrillation with a ventricular rate of 110.
心律看着不齐，打张条图给医生看。 The cardiac rhythm looks irregular, print a strip for the doctor.
心电图为窦性心律，心率 78 次每分。 The ECG showed sinus rhythm at 78 beats per minute.
心电图是窦性心律，不用担心。 It is sinus rhythm, nothing to worry about.
突发心动过速，心率 180 次每分，血压下降。 Sudden tachycardia at 180 per minute was accompanied by a fall in blood pressure.
他心动过速了，先看是宽还是窄。 He is tachycardic, first check whether the complexes are wide or narrow.
心动过缓至 38 次每分，伴头晕与黑蒙。 Bradycardia down to 38 per minute was accompanied by dizziness and visual greying.
他心动过缓，先把阿托品备好。 He is bradycardic, have atropine ready.
心律失常反复发作，需查电解质与甲状腺功能。 Recurrent arrhythmia prompted checks of electrolytes and thyroid function.
他有心律失常，搬动的时候小心点。 He has an arrhythmia, be careful when moving him.
频发室性期前收缩，每分钟超过五次，需复查电解质。 Frequent ventricular premature beats exceeding five per minute required electrolyte review.
监护上有个期前收缩，病人没感觉。 There is a premature beat on the monitor but the patient feels nothing.
心房颤动，心室率 138 次每分，予控制心率治疗。 Atrial fibrillation with a ventricular rate of 138 was treated with rate control.
心室率太快了，先降下来再谈复律。 The ventricular rate is too fast, slow it down before discussing cardioversion.
PR 间期延长至 0.26 秒，提示一度房室传导阻滞。 The PR interval was prolonged to 0.26 seconds, indicating first-degree atrioventricular block.
PR 间期有点长，数一下格子。 The PR interval looks long, count the small squares.
QRS 波群增宽至 0.14 秒，考虑室内传导阻滞。 The QRS complex widened to 0.14 seconds, suggesting intraventricular block.
QRS 波群宽，按室性心律处理。 The QRS complex is wide, treat it as a ventricular rhythm.
ST 段抬高 2 毫米，启动胸痛绿色通道。 ST segment elevation of 2 millimetres triggered the chest pain fast-track pathway.
ST 段压低了，叫医生过来看。 The ST segment is depressed, ask the doctor to look.
T 波高尖，结合血钾 6.9 毫摩尔每升考虑高钾。 Peaked T waves with a potassium of 6.9 millimoles per litre suggested hyperkalaemia.
T 波倒置了，之前那张是平的。 The T wave is now inverted, it was flat on the earlier tracing.
心电报警频繁触发，先检查电极接触再调整参数。 ECG alarms triggered often, so electrode contact was checked before adjusting settings.
心电报警一直响，是不是阈值设太窄。 The ECG alarm keeps sounding, maybe the threshold is set too tight.
导联脱落报警，重新粘贴电极后波形恢复。 A lead disconnection alarm was resolved by reapplying the electrode.
左边导联脱落了，怪不得波形没了。 The left lead has come off, that is why the waveform vanished.
心率变异性降低，提示交感张力持续升高。 Reduced heart rate variability suggested sustained sympathetic activation.
心率变异性这些指标看看就行，别过度解读。 Heart rate variability is worth a look but do not overinterpret it.
心率监测每小时一次，超过 120 次报告医生。 Heart rate monitoring was hourly, with rates above 120 reported to the doctor.
心率监测不能只看监护仪，要对着病人。 Heart rate monitoring is not just the monitor, look at the patient too.
目标心率控制在 60 至 80 次每分，逐步加量。 The target heart rate was 60 to 80 per minute, with gradual dose increases.
目标心率是八十以下，现在还没到。 The target heart rate is under eighty, we are not there yet.
电极片每二十四小时更换，出汗多时提前更换。 Electrode pads were changed every twenty-four hours, sooner if sweating heavily.
电极片不粘了，换新的再贴。 The electrode pad has lost adhesion, put a new one on.
监护报警设置按医嘱调整，避免关闭报警。 Alarm settings were adjusted according to orders, and alarms were never switched off.
监护报警设置别全关，静音可以但别屏蔽。 Do not switch all alarm settings off, silencing is fine but never disable them.
心律监测发现阵发性室上性心动过速，已记录发作时间。 Rhythm monitoring detected paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, and the onset time was recorded.
心律监测的重点是看有没有新出现的异常。 The point of rhythm monitoring is to catch anything new.
血钾 7.2 毫摩尔每升，属危急值，已电话通知医生。 A potassium of 7.2 millimoles per litre was a critical value and the doctor was notified by phone.
这个结果是危急值，必须马上报。 This result is a critical value, it must be reported immediately.
危急值报告需记录报告人、接听人与时间。 Critical value reporting must record the caller, the receiver and the time.
危急值报告流程贴在墙上，按步骤走。 The critical value reporting procedure is on the wall, follow the steps.
危急值登记本上补齐接听时间与处理措施。 The critical value log was completed with the receiving time and the action taken.
危急值登记别忘了签名，不然算漏项。 Do not forget to sign the critical value log, or it counts as missing.
危急值通知要求接听者复述结果，确认无误。 Critical value notification requires the receiver to read the result back for confirmation.
危急值通知到了吗，医生知道没有。 Has the critical value notification gone through, does the doctor know.
危急值预警弹出后三分钟内完成通知。 The critical value alert was followed by notification within three minutes.
危急值预警又响了，看看是哪个项目。 The critical value alert has gone off again, check which test it is.
危急值闭环管理要求每一步都留痕可查。 Closed-loop critical value management requires a traceable record at every step.
现在危急值闭环管理了，系统会自动催办。 With closed-loop critical value management the system chases you automatically.
不同医院危急值范围略有差异，以本院规定为准。 Critical value ranges vary slightly between hospitals, so local rules apply.
危急值范围在院内网上能查到。 The critical value range can be found on the hospital intranet.
危急值报告制度明确十小时内完成通知与记录。 The critical value reporting policy requires notification and documentation within the set time.
危急值报告制度是硬规定，不能口头说说就算。 The critical value reporting policy is mandatory, a verbal mention does not count.
报告时限为十五分钟，超时系统会标记。 The reporting time limit was fifteen minutes, and overruns were flagged by the system.
报告时限快到了，先打电话再补记录。 The reporting time limit is nearly up, phone first and document after.
血糖危急值 1.9 毫摩尔每升，立即静推葡萄糖。 A critical blood glucose of 1.9 millimoles per litre was treated with immediate intravenous glucose.
血糖危急值报过来了，先把葡萄糖抽好。 The critical blood glucose has been reported, draw up the glucose now.
血钾危急值 6.8 毫摩尔每升，立即做心电图并降钾。 A critical serum potassium of 6.8 millimoles per litre prompted an immediate ECG and potassium lowering.
血钾危急值，先看心电图有没有高尖 T 波。 Critical serum potassium, check the ECG for peaked T waves first.
血钠危急值 112 毫摩尔每升，纠正速度不超过每小时 8 毫摩尔。 A critical serum sodium of 112 millimoles per litre was corrected at no more than 8 millimoles per hour.
血钠危急值，补钠一定要慢。 Critical serum sodium, correct it slowly.
血红蛋白危急值 48 克每升，立即备血并通知医生。 A critical haemoglobin of 48 grams per litre prompted urgent crossmatch and doctor notification.
血红蛋白危急值，先看有没有在出血。 Critical haemoglobin, first check whether he is bleeding.
血小板危急值 12 乘十的九次方每升，避免肌注与深静脉穿刺。 A critical platelet count of 12 times ten to the ninth per litre contraindicated intramuscular injection and deep venous puncture.
血小板危急值，抽血后多压一会儿。 Critical platelet count, press longer after taking blood.
国际标准化比值 5.6，停用华法林并予维生素 K。 The international normalized ratio was 5.6, so warfarin was stopped and vitamin K given.
国际标准化比值超过五了，先别再用抗凝药。 The international normalized ratio is over five, hold the anticoagulant.
动脉氧分压 48 毫米汞柱，属危急值，立即给氧并准备插管。 An arterial oxygen partial pressure of 48 mmHg was critical, so oxygen was given and intubation prepared.
动脉氧分压这么低，血氧饱和度可能还正常。 The arterial oxygen partial pressure is this low even though saturation may look normal.

en: partial pressure of arterial carbon dioxide
text: 动脉二氧化碳分压 78 毫米汞柱，提示通气不足，需无创通气。 An arterial carbon dioxide partial pressure of 78 mmHg indicated hypoventilation requiring non-invasive ventilation.

en: partial pressure of arterial carbon dioxide
text: 动脉二氧化碳分压太高了，他二氧化碳在蓄积。 The arterial carbon dioxide partial pressure is too high, he is retaining carbon dioxide.
乳酸 7.4 毫摩尔每升，提示严重组织低灌注。 Lactate was 7.4 millimoles per litre, indicating severe tissue hypoperfusion.
乳酸抽了吗，两小时后再复查一次。 Have you sent the lactate, repeat it in two hours.
高乳酸血症持续不降，需重新评估容量与心功能。 Persistent hyperlactatemia required reassessment of volume status and cardiac function.
他有高乳酸血症，补液的同时要查肝功能。 He has hyperlactatemia, check liver function while giving fluids.
肌钙蛋白危急值 2.8 纳克每毫升，立即复查心电图。 A critical troponin level of 2.8 nanograms per millilitre prompted an immediate repeat ECG.
肌钙蛋白危急值，先让他绝对卧床。 Critical troponin, keep him strictly on bed rest first.
凝血危急值，凝血酶原时间 38 秒，暂停侵入操作。 The critical coagulation value with a prothrombin time of 38 seconds led to pausing invasive procedures.
凝血危急值，穿刺前先补血浆。 Critical coagulation, give plasma before puncturing.
血培养阳性报警，革兰染色为阳性球菌，立即通知医生。 A positive blood culture alert with Gram-positive cocci was reported to the doctor at once.
血培养阳性报警了，先把抗生素用上。 The blood culture alert is positive, start antibiotics now.
复测结果与原结果一致，按危急值上报。 Repeat testing matched the original result, so it was reported as a critical value.
先复测一下，可能是标本溶血。 Repeat the test first, the sample may be haemolysed.
危急值记录须包含结果、通知时间与处理措施。 Critical value documentation must include the result, notification time and action taken.
危急值记录补完整，别只写一句已处理。 Complete the critical value documentation, do not just write handled.
发现一例危急值漏报，已启动根因分析。 A missed critical value was identified and a root cause analysis was started.
这次危急值漏报要上报，不能内部消化。 This missed critical value must be reported, it cannot be settled internally.
予氧疗，目标血氧饱和度 94 至 98 百分比。 Oxygen therapy was started with a target saturation of 94 to 98 percent.
先上氧疗，别等到血氧掉下去。 Start oxygen therapy now, do not wait for the saturation to drop.
吸氧后呼吸困难减轻，血氧升至 96 百分比。 After oxygen inhalation the breathlessness eased and saturation rose to 96 percent.
先吸氧，流量开到每分钟三升。 Start oxygen inhalation at three litres per minute.
氧流量调至每分钟 5 升，十分钟后复测血氧。 The oxygen flow rate was set to 5 litres per minute with saturation rechecked after ten minutes.
氧流量别开太大，慢阻肺病人会二氧化碳蓄积。 Do not set the oxygen flow rate too high, COPD patients retain carbon dioxide.
吸氧浓度降至 40 百分比，血氧仍维持在 95。 The fraction of inspired oxygen was reduced to 40 percent while saturation stayed at 95.
吸氧浓度先给六十，稳定后往下调。 Start the fraction of inspired oxygen at sixty percent and wean down once stable.
鼻导管吸氧每分钟 2 升，患者耐受良好。 Nasal cannula oxygen at 2 litres per minute was well tolerated.
先鼻导管吸氧，不够再换面罩。 Start with nasal cannula oxygen and switch to a mask if it is not enough.
面罩吸氧每分钟 8 升，血氧升至 97 百分比。 Oxygen therapy via face mask at 8 litres per minute raised saturation to 97 percent.
改成面罩吸氧吧，鼻导管不够用。 Switch to oxygen therapy via face mask, the nasal cannula is not enough.
高流量鼻导管氧疗流量 50 升每分，氧浓度 60 百分比。 High-flow nasal cannula therapy was set at 50 litres per minute with 60 percent oxygen.
上高流量鼻导管氧疗，他呼吸做功太大了。 Start high-flow nasal cannula therapy, his work of breathing is too high.
起搏心律，每个 QRS 波前可见起搏信号。 The rhythm was paced, with a pacing spike before every QRS complex.
这是起搏心律，不是他自己的心跳。 This is a paced rhythm, not his own heartbeat.
有创机械通气后氧合改善，潮气量设为 6 毫升每公斤。 Oxygenation improved on invasive mechanical ventilation with tidal volume set at 6 millilitres per kilogram.
有创机械通气要镇静，不然人机对抗。 Invasive mechanical ventilation needs sedation, otherwise the patient fights the ventilator.
呼吸机参数按肺保护策略设定，平台压不超过 30 厘米水柱。 Ventilator settings followed a lung-protective strategy with plateau pressure below 30 centimetres of water.
呼吸机参数谁调的，先记下来再改。 Who changed the ventilator settings, record them before adjusting.
潮气量 6 毫升每公斤，平台压 26 厘米水柱。 Tidal volume was 6 millilitres per kilogram with a plateau pressure of 26 centimetres of water.
潮气量给太大容易伤肺，按体重算。 Too large a tidal volume injures the lungs, calculate it by body weight.
呼吸频率设置 14 次每分，患者有自主触发。 The set respiratory rate was 14 per minute with patient-triggered breaths.
呼吸频率设置调低一点，让他自己多呼吸。 Lower the set respiratory rate a little so he breathes more himself.
气道峰压升至 42 厘米水柱，检查是否有痰栓。 Peak airway pressure rose to 42 centimetres of water, so the airway was checked for a mucus plug.
气道峰压高了，先吸痰再看看。 Peak airway pressure is high, suction first and then reassess.
平台压 32 厘米水柱，需降低潮气量。 The plateau pressure was 32 centimetres of water, so tidal volume was reduced.
量一下平台压，这个比峰压更能说明问题。 Measure the plateau pressure, it tells you more than the peak.
呼气末正压调至 10 厘米水柱，氧合明显改善。 Positive end-expiratory pressure was raised to 10 centimetres of water with clear improvement in oxygenation.
呼气末正压太高会影响回心血量，注意血压。 Too much positive end-expiratory pressure reduces venous return, watch the blood pressure.
压力支持 12 厘米水柱，潮气量约 450 毫升。 Pressure support of 12 centimetres of water gave a tidal volume of about 450 millilitres.
压力支持往下调，看他能不能自己撑住。 Wean the pressure support down and see whether he can cope.
氧合目标为血氧饱和度 92 至 96 百分比，避免过度给氧。 The oxygenation target was 92 to 96 percent saturation to avoid hyperoxia.
氧合目标写在床头卡上，接班先看。 The oxygenation target is on the bed card, read it at handover.
氧输送不足是休克时乳酸升高的重要原因。 Inadequate oxygen delivery is an important cause of rising lactate in shock.
氧输送上不去，光调吸氧浓度没用。 If oxygen delivery does not improve, raising the inspired oxygen alone is useless.
气道阻力升高，考虑支气管痉挛，予解痉治疗。 Raised airway resistance suggested bronchospasm and bronchodilator treatment was given.
气道阻力这么高，是不是管路打折了。 Airway resistance is this high, is the circuit kinked.
肺顺应性下降至 25 毫升每厘米水柱，提示肺水肿。 Lung compliance fell to 25 millilitres per centimetre of water, suggesting pulmonary oedema.
肺顺应性差了，同样的压力进不去气。 Lung compliance has fallen, the same pressure no longer delivers the volume.
每搏量指数 32 毫升每平方米，低于正常范围。 The stroke volume index was 32 millilitres per square metre, below the normal range.
看每搏量指数，比单看血压能更早发现容量不足。 The stroke volume index picks up low volume earlier than blood pressure alone.
撤机参数达标，浅快呼吸指数 68，准备拔管。 Weaning parameters were met with a rapid shallow breathing index of 68, so extubation was planned.
撤机参数还差一点，再脱机训练一天。 The weaning parameters are not quite there, do another day of trials.
吸氧浓度持续 80 百分比超过二十四小时，警惕氧中毒。 An inspired oxygen of 80 percent for over twenty-four hours raised concern about oxygen toxicity.
氧中毒也是病，不是氧给得越多越好。 Oxygen toxicity is real, more oxygen is not always better.
呼吸支持升级为无创通气，仍不能维持氧合。 Respiratory support was escalated to non-invasive ventilation but oxygenation was still inadequate.
他现在需要呼吸支持，先别转普通病房。 He needs respiratory support now, do not move him to a general ward yet.

zh: 急性生理与慢性健康评分
en: Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation
text: 急性生理与慢性健康评分 28 分，预计病死率明显升高。 The Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation score was 28, predicting a clearly increased mortality.

zh: 急性生理与慢性健康评分
en: Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation
text: 算一下急性生理与慢性健康评分，家属谈话要用。 Work out the Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation score, we need it for the family talk.
序贯器官衰竭评分由 4 分升至 9 分，提示病情恶化。 The Sequential Organ Failure Assessment score rose from 4 to 9, indicating deterioration.
序贯器官衰竭评分每天算一次，看趋势比看单次重要。 The Sequential Organ Failure Assessment score is calculated daily, the trend matters more than one value.

zh: 快速序贯器官衰竭评分
text: 快速序贯器官衰竭评分 2 项阳性，按脓毒症流程处理。 Two criteria of the quick Sequential Organ Failure Assessment were positive, so the sepsis pathway was activated.

zh: 快速序贯器官衰竭评分
text: 快速序贯器官衰竭评分阳性，先抽血培养再上抗生素。 The quick Sequential Organ Failure Assessment is positive, take cultures then start antibiotics.
国家早期预警评分为 7 分，属高危，立即通知医生。 A National Early Warning Score of 7 was high risk, so the doctor was called at once.
国家早期预警评分超过五就要提高监护级别。 A National Early Warning Score above five means the monitoring level must increase.
改良早期预警评分 5 分，建议转入监护病房。 A Modified Early Warning Score of 5 suggested transfer to a monitored bed.
改良早期预警评分算出来多少，够不够叫快速反应团队。 What is the Modified Early Warning Score, is it enough to call the rapid response team.
早期预警评分每小时复评，评分上升立即上报。 The early warning score was recalculated hourly and any rise was reported immediately.
早期预警评分不是算完就完了，要触发行动。 An early warning score is not the end point, it must trigger action.
危重症评分越高，需要的监护资源越多。 The higher the critical illness score, the more monitoring resources are needed.
危重症评分只是参考，不能代替床旁判断。 A critical illness score is only a reference, it cannot replace bedside judgement.
简化急性生理评分 45 分，预计病死率约 35 百分比。 A Simplified Acute Physiology Score of 45 predicted a mortality of about 35 percent.
简化急性生理评分算完记得核对年龄分。 Remember to check the age points after calculating the Simplified Acute Physiology Score.
器官衰竭评分四项系统受累，病死率明显升高。 The organ failure score showed four systems involved, with markedly higher mortality.
器官衰竭评分每天都看，别只看入院那次。 Review the organ failure score daily, not just on admission.
出院时格拉斯哥预后评分 3 分，属重度残疾。 The Glasgow Outcome Scale score at discharge was 3, indicating severe disability.
格拉斯哥预后评分要等病情稳定后再评。 The Glasgow Outcome Scale should be scored once the condition is stable.
镇静评分目标为 -2 分，每小时评估一次。 The sedation score target was minus two, assessed hourly.
镇静评分太低他会躁动，调一下泵速。 A low sedation score will make him restless, adjust the pump rate.
镇静躁动评分 -3 分，呼唤有反应但不能保持清醒。 The Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale score was minus three, responding to voice but not staying awake.
镇静躁动评分目标负二到零，别镇静太深。 The Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale target is minus two to zero, do not sedate too deeply.
谵妄评估阳性，注意力和思维两方面均异常。 Delirium assessment was positive with abnormality in both attention and thinking.
谵妄评估每天做，镇静药停了再做一次。 Do the delirium assessment daily, and again after holding sedation.
肌力评分 36 分，提示明显肌力下降，需早期康复。 A muscle strength score of 36 indicated marked weakness requiring early rehabilitation.
肌力评分比上周低，赶紧安排康复。 The muscle strength score is lower than last week, arrange rehabilitation.
误吸风险评估为高危，床头抬高 30 度并暂缓经口进食。 Aspiration risk assessment was high, so the head of the bed was raised and oral intake withheld.
误吸风险评估做完再决定能不能喝水。 Finish the aspiration risk assessment before deciding whether he can drink.
营养风险筛查 4 分，需请营养科会诊。 The nutritional risk screening score was 4, so a dietitian consultation was requested.
营养风险筛查没做，别急着开肠内营养。 The nutritional risk screening is not done, do not start enteral feeding yet.
静脉血栓风险评估为高危，予低分子肝素预防。 Venous thromboembolism risk assessment was high, so low molecular weight heparin was started.
静脉血栓风险评估重新做一遍，他刚做完手术。 Redo the venous thromboembolism risk assessment, he has just had surgery.
死亡风险预测 62 百分比，已与家属沟通病情。 The predicted mortality risk was 62 percent and the family was informed.
死亡风险预测只是概率，不能对一个病人下定论。 A mortality risk prediction is only a probability, it does not decide one patient's fate.
预后评分结合病情与功能状态，不能只看单项。 Prognostic scores combine condition and function and should not be read in isolation.
预后评分低不代表没希望，康复还长着呢。 A poor prognostic score does not mean there is no hope, rehabilitation takes time.
评分量表使用前须核对条目与分值定义。 The scoring scale items and point definitions must be checked before use.
评分量表别自己改，标准是统一的。 Do not change the scoring scale yourself, the standard is fixed.
评分阈值设为 5 分，达到即通知医生。 A score threshold of five was set, with the doctor notified when reached.
评分阈值没到也不能掉以轻心，要看趋势。 Not reaching the score threshold is no reason for complacency, watch the trend.
重复评分每四小时一次，变化超过两分需报告。 Repeated scoring was done every four hours, with a change over two reported.
重复评分是为了看动态，不是走形式。 Repeated scoring is about the trend, not a formality.
危重程度分级为一级，直接进入抢救区。 Severity grading was grade one, so he went straight to the resuscitation area.
危重程度分级不一样，安排的床位也不一样。 Severity grading differs and so does the bed each patient gets.
急性生理评分主要看入室二十四小时内的最差值。 The acute physiology score uses the worst values within the first twenty-four hours.
急性生理评分这部分最费时间，慢慢核对。 The acute physiology score takes the longest, check it carefully.
慢性健康评分因长期透析计 5 分。 The chronic health evaluation scored five points for long-term dialysis.
慢性健康评分别漏了，他一直在用激素。 Do not miss the chronic health evaluation, he has been on steroids.
肺超声见双侧 B 线增多，提示肺水肿。 Lung ultrasound showed increased B lines bilaterally, suggesting pulmonary oedema.
做个肺超声，看看肺里水多不多。 Do a lung ultrasound to see how much water is in the lungs.
转运监护仪电量不足，转运前必须充满。 The transport monitor battery was low and had to be fully charged before transfer.
把转运监护仪挂到担架旁边，方便看。 Hang the transport monitor on the side of the stretcher so it is visible.
转运途中监测记录心率、血压与血氧各三次。 Monitoring during transport recorded heart rate, blood pressure and saturation three times each.
转运途中监测别只看监护仪，脸色也要看。 During transport monitoring do not only watch the monitor, look at his colour too.
转运前评估未通过，暂缓外出检查。 The pre-transport assessment was not passed, so the imaging trip was deferred.
转运前评估做一遍，缺什么补什么。 Do a pre-transport assessment and fix whatever is missing.
转运风险评估为高风险，需医生陪同。 The transport risk assessment was high, so a doctor accompanied the patient.
转运风险评估高的话，家属要签知情同意。 If the transport risk assessment is high the family must sign consent.
存在转运禁忌证，改为床旁超声检查。 There was a contraindication to transport, so bedside ultrasound was arranged instead.
这是转运禁忌证，不能推出去做 CT。 This is a contraindication to transport, he cannot go to CT.
便携式监护仪固定在担架支架上，防止跌落。 The portable monitor was fixed to the stretcher bracket to prevent it falling.
便携式监护仪屏幕小，报警声要开大。 The portable monitor screen is small, turn the alarm volume up.
尿渗透压 620 毫渗摩尔每千克，提示容量不足。 A urine osmolality of 620 milliosmoles per kilogram suggested volume depletion.
尿渗透压高，说明他身体在拼命保水。 The urine osmolality is high, his body is holding on to water.
转运氧气瓶压力不足，出发前更换满瓶。 The portable oxygen cylinder pressure was low, so a full one was fitted before departure.
转运氧气瓶能撑多久，算一下够不够来回。 How long will the portable oxygen cylinder last, work out whether it covers the round trip.
转运中生命体征平稳，到达后复测一次。 Vital signs during transport were stable and were rechecked on arrival.
转运中生命体征有变化就停下来处理。 If vital signs during transport change, stop and deal with it.
转运报警提示血氧下降，立即检查探头与管路。 The transport alarm indicated falling saturation, so the probe and circuit were checked.
转运报警一直响，先看病人再看机器。 The transport alarm keeps sounding, check the patient before the machine.
转运供氧改为面罩每分钟 10 升，估算可维持四十分钟。 Oxygen supply during transport was changed to a mask at 10 litres per minute, estimated to last forty minutes.
转运供氧别断，路上血氧掉得很快。 Do not interrupt oxygen supply during transport, saturation drops fast on the way.
转运监测参数包括心电、血氧与呼气末二氧化碳。 Monitored parameters during transport included ECG, saturation and end-tidal carbon dioxide.
转运监测参数不用全上，挑最关键的。 Do not use every monitored parameter during transport, pick the essential ones.
六小时血乳酸清除率 32 百分比，提示复苏有效。 A six-hour lactate clearance of 32 percent indicated effective resuscitation.
血乳酸清除率上来了，说明补液起作用了。 Lactate clearance has improved, so the fluids are working.
转运团队由一名医生、两名护士与一名工人组成。 The transport team consisted of one doctor, two nurses and one porter.
转运团队分工说清楚，谁管气道谁管泵。 Make the transport team roles clear, who manages the airway and who manages the pumps.
转运设备检查清单逐项打钩，缺项不得出发。 The equipment check before transport was ticked item by item and departure was blocked if anything was missing.
转运设备检查做完了吗，吸引器带没带。 Is the equipment check before transport done, is the suction unit packed.
发生转运不良事件，管路脱出，已现场重新固定。 A transport adverse event with tube dislodgement was managed by immediate re-fixation on scene.
转运不良事件都要上报，别自己压着。 Transport adverse events must be reported, do not keep them quiet.
转运记录写明出发与到达时间及途中的血压变化。 The transport record stated departure and arrival times and the blood pressure changes en route.
转运记录回来了补，别忘了签名。 Fill in the transport record when you are back, and do not forget to sign.
转运安全第一位，担架护栏必须拉起。 Transport safety comes first, the stretcher rails must be up.
转运安全不是口号，担架要固定好。 Transport safety is not a slogan, secure the stretcher.
转运后交接用统一表单，双方签名确认。 Post-transport handover used a standard form signed by both sides.
转运后交接别漏了泵速和过敏史。 Do not miss the pump rates and allergy history at post-transport handover.
转运中输液使用电池驱动的输液泵，防止速度失控。 Infusion during transport used a battery-powered pump to prevent rate errors.
转运中输液留意管路，转弯别拽掉了。 Watch the line during transport, do not pull it out on the corners.
转运中心率监测显示一过性心动过速，到达后恢复。 Heart rate monitoring during transport showed transient tachycardia that resolved on arrival.
转运中心率监测别只看数字，节律也要看。 In heart rate monitoring during transport watch the rhythm, not just the number.
转运中血氧监测下降至 88 百分比，途中调高了氧流量。 Oxygen saturation monitoring during transport fell to 88 percent, so the flow was raised en route.
转运中血氧监测要一直开着，进电梯最容易掉。 Keep oxygen saturation monitoring during transport running, it drops most in the lift.
转运中血压监测每五分钟一次，收缩压维持在 100 以上。 Blood pressure monitoring during transport was every five minutes, with systolic kept above 100.
转运中血压监测不方便，能摸脉就先摸脉。 Blood pressure monitoring during transport is awkward, feel the pulse if you cannot measure.
转运设备电池续航两小时，足够完成检查。 The battery for transport equipment lasted two hours, enough for the investigation.
转运设备电池还剩多少，别半路没电。 How much is left in the battery for transport equipment, do not run out halfway.
容量评估结合中心静脉压、下腔静脉与乳酸综合判断。 Volume assessment combined central venous pressure, inferior vena cava and lactate.
容量评估先做，别一上来就补液。 Do the volume assessment first, do not start fluids straight away.
容量状态评估为不足，皮肤弹性差、尿量少。 Volume status was assessed as depleted, with poor skin turgor and low urine output.
他的容量状态现在偏向过负荷，先利尿。 His volume status is now towards overload, give a diuretic.
容量负荷已明显增加，中心静脉压升至 14 厘米水柱。 The volume load had clearly increased with central venous pressure rising to 14 centimetres of water.
容量负荷够了，再补就进肺里了。 The volume load is enough, more fluid will just go into the lungs.
容量过负荷表现为体重三日增加 4 公斤、颈静脉充盈。 Fluid overload showed as a 4 kilogram weight gain over three days with raised jugular venous pressure.
容量过负荷了，先停补液再考虑超滤。 He is fluid overloaded, stop the fluids and consider ultrafiltration.
容量不足，眼窝凹陷、口唇干燥、尿比重升高。 Volume depletion was evident from sunken eyes, dry lips and a raised urine specific gravity.
他容量不足，先补晶体液。 He is volume depleted, give crystalloid first.
中心静脉压 4 厘米水柱，结合尿量判断容量不足。 Central venous pressure was 4 centimetres of water and, with the urine output, indicated volume depletion.
中心静脉压单看不准，要结合动态变化。 Central venous pressure alone is unreliable, use the trend.
中心静脉压监测每小时一次，同时记录补液量。 Central venous pressure monitoring was hourly with the fluid volume recorded alongside.
中心静脉压监测的零点要校准，不然没意义。 The zero point of central venous pressure monitoring must be calibrated or it means nothing.
每搏量变异度 16 百分比，提示补液可能有效。 Stroke volume variation was 16 percent, suggesting fluid would be effective.
每搏量变异度要在窦性心律和完全机械通气下才准。 Stroke volume variation is only reliable in sinus rhythm with full mechanical ventilation.
脉压变异度 18 百分比，支持下腔静脉塌陷之外的另一证据。 Pulse pressure variation was 18 percent, adding evidence alongside inferior vena cava collapse.
脉压变异度这么高，补点液看看。 Pulse pressure variation is this high, give some fluid and see.
下腔静脉变异度超过 50 百分比，提示容量不足。 Inferior vena cava variability above 50 percent suggested volume depletion.
下腔静脉变异度大，说明他还有补液空间。 Inferior vena cava variability is large, meaning there is room for more fluid.
下腔静脉直径 1.2 厘米，吸气塌陷明显。 The inferior vena cava diameter was 1.2 centimetres with clear inspiratory collapse.
量一下下腔静脉直径，看看容量够不够。 Measure the inferior vena cava diameter to see whether volume is adequate.
每搏输出量由 45 毫升升至 62 毫升，补液有效。 Stroke volume rose from 45 to 62 millilitres, confirming that fluid was effective.
每搏输出量上来了，说明补液没白补。 Stroke volume has risen, so the fluid was worth giving.
心输出量 3.2 升每分，低于正常，考虑心源性因素。 Cardiac output was 3.2 litres per minute, below normal, suggesting a cardiac cause.
心输出量测出来多少，够不够全身用。 What is the cardiac output, is it enough for the whole body.
心指数 2.0 升每分每平方米，提示低灌注状态。 The cardiac index was 2.0 litres per minute per square metre, indicating hypoperfusion.
心指数比心输出量更公平，按体表面积算的。 The cardiac index is fairer than cardiac output because it is indexed to body surface area.
床旁超声显示下腔静脉充盈、左室收缩良好。 Point-of-care ultrasound showed a plethoric inferior vena cava and good left ventricular contraction.
做个床旁超声，看看容量和心脏。 Do point-of-care ultrasound to look at volume and the heart.
液体潴留明显，双下肢凹陷性水肿至膝部。 Fluid retention was marked with pitting oedema of both legs up to the knees.
他有液体潴留，补液要算着来。 He has fluid retention, so fluids must be calculated carefully.
大量液体丢失至第三间隙，血压难以维持。 Large volumes were lost to the third space and blood pressure was hard to maintain.
第三间隙丢的液看不见，但确实缺。 Fluid lost to the third space is invisible, but the deficit is real.
组织水肿加重，眼睑与双手均肿胀。 Tissue oedema worsened, with swelling of the eyelids and both hands.
他组织水肿了，补液要收一收了。 He has tissue oedema, we should ease off the fluids.
出入量每班小结一次，二十四小时总结一次。 Intake and output were subtotalled each shift and totalled over twenty-four hours.
出入量记得准一点，引流液也要算。 Record intake and output accurately, include the drainage.
每日体重增加 1.5 公斤，提示液体潴留。 Daily weight increased by 1.5 kilograms, suggesting fluid retention.
每日体重同一时间称，衣服尽量一样。 Weigh for daily weight at the same time and with similar clothing.
容量管理目标是出入平衡并维持平均动脉压 65 以上。 The fluid management goal was even balance with a mean arterial pressure above 65.
容量管理这事要天天看，不能只看一天。 Fluid management needs daily review, not just a single day.
容量目标为每日负平衡 500 毫升。 The volume target was a negative balance of 500 millilitres per day.
容量目标定了吗，是正平衡还是负平衡。 Has the volume target been set, positive or negative balance.
利尿反应良好，四小时尿量 800 毫升。 The diuretic response was good with 800 millilitres of urine in four hours.
利尿反应差，考虑加量或换药。 The diuretic response is poor, consider a higher dose or a different drug.
毛细血管渗漏导致大量液体进入组织，血压难以维持。 Capillary leak shifted large volumes into the tissues and blood pressure was difficult to sustain.
毛细血管渗漏期补液容易水肿，要算着补。 During capillary leak, fluids easily cause oedema, so calculate carefully.
血管外肺水指数 14 毫升每公斤，提示肺水肿。 An extravascular lung water index of 14 millilitres per kilogram indicated pulmonary oedema.
血管外肺水高说明肺里进水了，补液要停。 High extravascular lung water means the lungs are wet, stop the fluids.
尿量每小时 20 毫升，偏少，需加快补液。 Urine output was 20 millilitres per hour, low, so fluids were increased.
尿量记一下，一小时多少毫升。 Record the urine output, how many millilitres per hour.
尿量监测每小时一次，连续两小时低于 0.5 立即报告。 Urine output monitoring was hourly, with two consecutive hours below 0.5 reported at once.
尿量监测别只看总量，要看每小时。 Urine output monitoring is not just the total, watch the hourly figure.
少尿持续六小时，肌酐上升，考虑急性肾损伤。 Oliguria lasting six hours with rising creatinine suggested acute kidney injury.
他少尿了，先补液再说要不要用利尿剂。 He is oliguric, give fluids first and then decide about diuretics.
无尿伴血钾 6.5，紧急联系血液净化。 Anuria with a potassium of 6.5 prompted urgent renal replacement therapy.
他无尿了，先冲一下尿管看通不通。 He is anuric, flush the catheter first to check patency.
多尿每日约 4000 毫升，查血糖与尿比重。 Polyuria of about 4000 millilitres daily prompted glucose and urine specific gravity testing.
他多尿，注意补液和电解质。 He is polyuric, watch fluids and electrolytes.
每小时尿量 35 毫升，较前两小时明显增多。 Hourly urine output was 35 millilitres, clearly more than the previous two hours.
每小时尿量都写在这里，接班对一下。 The hourly urine output is written here, check it at handover.
尿量记录与出入量单一致，无漏项。 The urine output record matched the fluid balance chart with no gaps.
尿量记录补上时间点，不然没法判断趋势。 Add the times to the urine output record, otherwise the trend cannot be judged.
导尿管留置第三天，评估是否可拔除。 On the third day of the indwelling urinary catheter, removal was assessed.
导尿管固定好，翻身别拽。 Secure the urinary catheter so it is not pulled when turning.
尿袋液面超过三分之二会影响计量，及时排空。 A urine collection bag more than two thirds full distorts measurement, so it was emptied promptly.
尿袋挂低一点，别让尿液倒流。 Hang the urine collection bag lower to prevent backflow.
尿比重 1.030，提示容量不足。 A urine specific gravity of 1.030 suggested volume depletion.
尿比重偏高，说明他缺水，先补点液。 The urine specific gravity is high, meaning he is short of fluid.
尿色深黄，考虑浓缩，嘱多饮水。 Urine colour was deep yellow, suggesting concentration, so more oral fluids were advised.
尿色像浓茶，得查一下胆红素。 The urine colour is like strong tea, check bilirubin.
尿量目标为每小时每公斤 0.5 毫升。 The target urine output was 0.5 millilitres per kilogram per hour.
尿量目标写清楚，护士才知道什么时候报。 Write the target urine output clearly so the nurse knows when to report.
少尿期持续五天，需限制入量并监测血钾。 The oliguric phase lasted five days, requiring fluid restriction and potassium monitoring.
少尿期补液要严格，多给一点就水肿。 Fluids must be strict in the oliguric phase, a little extra causes oedema.
多尿期每日尿量达 5000 毫升，注意补钾补液。 In the polyuric phase daily urine reached 5000 millilitres, so fluids and potassium were replaced.
进入多尿期了，别以为尿多就是好了。 He has entered the polyuric phase, do not assume lots of urine means recovery.
24 小时尿量 850 毫升，较前一日减少。 The 24-hour urine output was 850 millilitres, less than the previous day.
24 小时尿量从早上八点开始算，别漏了。 The 24-hour urine output is counted from eight in the morning, do not miss it.
尿量趋势连续三小时下降，提示灌注恶化。 The urine output trend fell over three consecutive hours, suggesting worsening perfusion.
看尿量趋势就知道补液够不够。 The urine output trend tells you whether the fluids are enough.
每公斤体重尿量 0.3 毫升每小时，低于目标值。 Urine output per kilogram was 0.3 millilitres per hour, below target.
按每公斤体重尿量算，不然胖瘦没法比。 Calculate urine output per kilogram, otherwise body size makes comparison impossible.
尿管堵塞，膀胱区膨隆，予冲洗后恢复引流。 Catheter blockage with a distended bladder resolved after irrigation.
尿管堵塞了，先看看是不是打折了。 The catheter is blocked, first check whether it is kinked.
尿管脱出，患者诉下腹胀痛，需重新置管。 Catheter dislodgement with lower abdominal pain required reinsertion.
尿管脱出了，先别硬塞回去。 The catheter has come out, do not force it back in.
尿液引流采用密闭系统，减少感染机会。 Urinary drainage used a closed system to reduce infection.
尿液引流袋要低于膀胱，防止倒流。 Keep the urinary drainage bag below the bladder to prevent backflow.
尿量计每小时读数一次，记录后复位。 The urine meter was read hourly and reset after recording.
尿量计读数看不清，换个新的。 The urine meter reading is unclear, change it for a new one.
补液后尿量恢复至每小时 60 毫升，灌注改善。 After fluids the urine output recovered to 60 millilitres per hour, showing better perfusion.
他尿量恢复了，说明补液方向对。 His urine output has recovered, so the fluid strategy was right.
尿量下降伴血压降低，首先考虑容量不足。 Declining urine output with falling blood pressure pointed first to volume depletion.
尿量下降了，先查尿管再查容量。 Urine output is declining, check the catheter then the volume status.
尿量异常持续两天，复查肾功能与电解质。 Abnormal urine output persisted for two days, so renal function and electrolytes were rechecked.
尿量异常要早报，别等到肌酐升上来。 Report abnormal urine output early, do not wait for the creatinine to rise.
尿量记录单每小时填写，交班时核对签名。 The urine output chart was completed hourly and countersigned at handover.
尿量记录单放床尾，谁量的谁填。 Keep the urine output chart at the foot of the bed and let whoever measures fill it in.
患者突发心搏骤停，抢救团队立即开始胸外按压。 He went into cardiac arrest, and the team started chest compressions at once.
他刚才心搏骤停了，快推抢救车过来！ He just had a cardiac arrest — get the crash cart here now!
本次分析纳入院外心搏骤停且接受旁观者复苏的病例。 This analysis included out-of-hospital cardiac arrest cases that received bystander resuscitation.
这例是院外心搏骤停，救护车到的时候已经有人在做按压了。 This is an out-of-hospital cardiac arrest; someone was already doing compressions when we arrived.
院内心搏骤停的抢救记录须在六小时内完成。 The record of an in-hospital cardiac arrest must be completed within six hours.
三楼病房院内心搏骤停，快叫急救小组！ In-hospital cardiac arrest on the third floor — call the resuscitation team now!
尸检未发现心源性猝死以外的其他死因。 Autopsy found no cause of death other than sudden cardiac death.
医生说是心源性猝死，家里人一点准备都没有。 The doctor said it was sudden cardiac death, and the family was completely unprepared.
心电监护显示心室颤动，即刻行电除颤。 The monitor showed ventricular fibrillation, so defibrillation was performed immediately.
现在是心室颤动，赶紧除颤，别耽误！ It is ventricular fibrillation now — defibrillate, do not waste a second!
患者心电图呈无脉性室速，立即按心搏骤停流程处置。 The electrocardiogram showed pulseless ventricular tachycardia, so the arrest protocol was started.
无脉性室速，马上电击，准备除颤器！ Pulseless ventricular tachycardia — shock now and get the defibrillator ready!
抢救记录记载无脉性电活动，予肾上腺素并查找可逆病因。 The record noted pulseless electrical activity, so epinephrine was given while reversible causes were sought.
监护上有波形但摸不到脉，这就是无脉性电活动。 There is a waveform but no pulse — that is pulseless electrical activity.
心电图提示心脏停搏，继续按压并给予肾上腺素。 The tracing showed asystole, so compressions continued and epinephrine was given.
心脏停搏了，接着按压，不要停！ It is asystole — keep compressing, do not stop!
患者仅有濒死呼吸，未触及颈动脉搏动，立即开始复苏。 The patient showed only agonal breathing with no carotid pulse, so resuscitation began at once.
他那种喘气是濒死呼吸，不是真的在呼吸，得马上按压。 That gasping is agonal breathing, not real breathing — start compressions now.
首次心律分析为可除颤心律，予单次电击后继续按压。 The first rhythm check showed a shockable rhythm, so one shock was given and compressions resumed.
是可除颤心律，除颤器充好电就放。 It is a shockable rhythm — shock as soon as the defibrillator is charged.
心律为不可除颤心律，未予电击，仅持续胸外按压。 It was a non-shockable rhythm, so no shock was given and chest compressions continued.
这个是不可除颤心律，别电了，继续按压给药。 This is a non-shockable rhythm — stop shocking and keep compressing while we give drugs.
缩短呼救到除颤的时间是改善生存链的关键。 Shortening the interval from the emergency call to defibrillation is key to strengthening the chain of survival.
生存链每一环都不能断，尤其别漏了早期除颤。 Every link in the chain of survival matters, especially early defibrillation.
抢救中同步排查可逆病因，并针对低氧予气道支持。 Reversible causes were checked during resuscitation, with airway support given for hypoxia.
先别放弃，找找可逆病因，说不定还能救回来。 Do not give up yet — look for a reversible cause, we may still get him back.
患者处于骤停前状态，已通知抢救团队床旁待命。 The patient was in a peri-arrest state, so the resuscitation team was called to the bedside.
这个病人是骤停前状态，咱们别离开床旁。 This patient is in a peri-arrest state, so nobody leaves the bedside.
记录停搏时间与自主循环恢复时间，用于评估预后。 Arrest downtime and the time of return of spontaneous circulation were recorded to estimate prognosis.
停搏时间太长，脑损伤的风险很高。 The arrest downtime was too long, so the risk of brain injury is high.
该患者复苏后出现骤停后综合征，转入重症监护室继续治疗。 The patient developed post-cardiac arrest syndrome and was transferred to intensive care.
醒过来不等于没事，骤停后综合征还要盯好几天。 Waking up is not the end of it — post-cardiac arrest syndrome needs days of watching.
心电图由终末期心律逐渐转为直线，家属已在场。 The tracing drifted from a terminal rhythm to a flat line, with the family present.
这个波形是终末期心律，大家都知道意味着什么。 That waveform is a terminal rhythm, and everyone knows what it means.
患者呼吸骤停，予球囊面罩通气并准备气管插管。 The patient was in respiratory arrest, so bag-mask ventilation was started and intubation prepared.
呼吸骤停，先给通气，别等到心跳也停了。 Respiratory arrest — ventilate first, before the heart stops too.
骤停事件记录须逐项填写并双人核对。 The cardiac arrest record must be completed item by item and checked by two staff.
你在旁边把骤停事件记录写好，时间都要准确。 Write up the cardiac arrest record beside me, and get every time right.
本院院内心搏骤停存活率较去年提高。 The hospital's in-hospital cardiac arrest survival rate improved compared with last year.
现在骤停存活率比以前高了，因为按压质量抓得紧。 The cardiac arrest survival rate is higher now because compression quality is tightly monitored.
所有院内骤停病例均纳入骤停登记。 All in-hospital arrest cases are entered into the cardiac arrest registry.
这个病例记得上报骤停登记，后面要复查数据。 Remember to report this case to the cardiac arrest registry — the data will be reviewed later.
按骤停风险评分评估，该患者需转入监护病房。 On the arrest risk score, this patient needs transfer to a monitored bed.
他的骤停风险评分很高，夜班多看着点。 His arrest risk score is high, so keep a close eye on him at night.
经团队评估后决定终止复苏，并向家属告知。 After team review, termination of resuscitation was decided and the family was informed.
按压三十分钟没有反应，按规范可以终止复苏了。 Thirty minutes with no response — under our protocol we can proceed to termination of resuscitation.
复苏十二分钟后出现自主循环恢复，转入进一步治疗。 Return of spontaneous circulation occurred after twelve minutes and further treatment followed.
摸到脉了，自主循环恢复，大家先别动导管。 I have a pulse — return of spontaneous circulation, so leave the lines alone for now.
病例随访记录骤停转归及出院时神经功能分级。 Follow-up recorded the arrest outcome and the neurological grade at discharge.
这个病人的骤停转归不太好，家属要有心理准备。 His arrest outcome is not looking good, so the family should be prepared.
立即启动心肺复苏，同时呼叫抢救团队。 Cardiopulmonary resuscitation was started immediately while the resuscitation team was called.
快做心肺复苏，按压别停！ Start cardiopulmonary resuscitation now — do not stop compressing!
胸外按压过程中尽量减少中断，保证按压质量。 Chest compressions were interrupted as little as possible to keep quality high.
胸外按压要快要有力，压下去让胸廓完全回弹。 Chest compressions must be fast and hard, and let the chest come all the way back up.
按压深度不足会显著降低复苏成功率。 Inadequate compression depth markedly lowers the success rate of resuscitation.
你的按压深度不够，再用力一点，压到五厘米。 Your compression depth is too shallow — push harder, down to five centimetres.
按压频率维持在每分钟一百至一百二十次。 The compression rate was kept at one hundred to one hundred twenty per minute.
按压频率太快了，跟着节拍器，一百一十下左右。 The compression rate is too fast — follow the metronome, about a hundred and ten a minute.
按压部位取胸骨下半部，避免压到剑突。 Compression position is the lower half of the sternum, avoiding the xiphoid process.
按压部位在胸骨下半段，你的手再往上挪一点。 Compression position is the lower sternum — move your hand up a little.
每轮按压都须保证胸廓回弹完全。 Every cycle of compressions must allow full chest recoil.
手别一直压着，让胸廓回弹，不然血回不来。 Do not lean on the chest — allow full chest recoil, otherwise blood cannot come back.
控制按压中断时间在十秒以内。 Compression interruption was kept under ten seconds.
按压中断别超过十秒，动作快点！ Keep the compression interruption under ten seconds — move faster!
培训重点是高质量心肺复苏的各项指标。 Training focuses on the measurable components of high-quality CPR.
咱们要做高质量心肺复苏，深度频率都得达标。 We need high-quality CPR here — depth and rate both have to hit target.
对目击成人心搏骤停可先行单纯胸外按压。 Compression-only CPR may be started first in a witnessed adult cardiac arrest.
你不会吹气就做单纯胸外按压，一直压就行。 If you cannot give breaths, just do compression-only CPR and keep pushing.
旁观者心肺复苏能显著缩短首次按压的延迟时间。 Bystander CPR substantially shortens the delay to the first chest compression.
幸好有人做了旁观者心肺复苏，不然等我们到就晚了。 Thankfully someone gave bystander CPR, or we would have arrived too late.
双人施救时按压者每两分钟轮换一次。 In two-rescuer CPR the compressor is changed every two minutes.
咱俩双人施救，你按压我通气，两分钟换一次。 Let us do two-rescuer CPR — you compress, I ventilate, and we swap every two minutes.
成人心肺复苏采用三十比二的按压通气比。 Adult CPR uses a compression-to-ventilation ratio of thirty to two.
按压通气比是三十比二，压三十下给两口气。 The compression-to-ventilation ratio is thirty to two — thirty pushes then two breaths.
清除口腔异物后给予人工呼吸。 Rescue breathing was given after clearing debris from the mouth.
来，配合我，我开始人工呼吸，你继续按压。 Work with me — I am starting rescue breathing while you keep compressing.
无防护设备时可实施口对口人工呼吸。 Mouth-to-mouth ventilation may be used when no barrier device is available.
有面罩就用面罩，没条件才做口对口人工呼吸。 Use a mask if we have one — only do mouth-to-mouth ventilation as a last resort.
所有急诊护士须每年通过基础生命支持考核。 All emergency nurses must pass a basic life support assessment each year.
先按基础生命支持做，按压加除颤，高级处理随后到。 Start with basic life support — compressions and defibrillation — and advanced care will follow.
高级生命支持阶段给予肾上腺素并建立高级气道。 During advanced life support, epinephrine was given and an advanced airway was placed.
等高级生命支持到了就给药、插管，现在就先把按压做好。 Once advanced life support arrives we will give drugs and intubate, but for now focus on compressions.
本流程依据最新复苏指南修订。 This protocol was revised according to the latest resuscitation guideline.
咱们按复苏指南来，别自己改顺序。 Follow the resuscitation guideline — do not change the sequence on your own.
本季度复苏成功率与按压质量培训同步改善。 The resuscitation success rate improved alongside compression quality training this quarter.
这个月复苏成功率上去了，说明流程改对了。 The resuscitation success rate went up this month, so the process change worked.
复苏记录须与医嘱、护理记录保持一致。 The resuscitation record must be consistent with the orders and nursing notes.
复苏记录你来写，每次给药时间都要写清楚。 You write the resuscitation record, and note the time of every drug dose clearly.
缩短复苏延迟是提高生存率的核心措施。 Reducing resuscitation delay is a core measure for improving survival.
复苏延迟一分钟，存活率就掉一大截。 Every minute of resuscitation delay drops the survival rate sharply.
转运途中使用心肺复苏机维持按压。 A mechanical CPR device maintained compressions during transport.
上心肺复苏机吧，人手不够，还得腾人出来。 Put the mechanical CPR device on — we are short of hands and need someone free.
复苏反馈装置显示按压深度合格率明显提升。 The CPR feedback device showed a clear rise in the proportion of adequate compression depth.
把复苏反馈装置贴上，看看你压得够不够深。 Stick the CPR feedback device on and see whether you are deep enough.
每两分钟安排一次按压者轮换并记录时间。 Compressor rotation was scheduled every two minutes with the time recorded.
两分钟了，按压者轮换，换人上！ Two minutes are up — compressor rotation, next person in!
出现复苏有效指征后继续按压并复评心律。 After signs of effective resuscitation appeared, compressions continued and the rhythm was rechecked.
看到复苏有效指征了，别停，接着压。 We are seeing signs of effective resuscitation — do not stop, keep compressing.
心前区叩击仅限目击骤停且监护在场时尝试。 A precordial thump is attempted only in witnessed arrest with the monitor attached.
别浪费时间做心前区叩击了，直接按压除颤。 Do not waste time on a precordial thump — go straight to compressions and defibrillation.
科室每半年组织一次复苏培训与考核。 The department runs CPR training and assessment every six months.
下周有复苏培训，新来的都要参加。 There is CPR training next week and all the new staff must attend.
确诊心室颤动后立即行电除颤。 Defibrillation was performed as soon as ventricular fibrillation was confirmed.
电除颤准备，所有人离开床！ Preparing for defibrillation — everybody off the bed!
大厅与候诊区均配置自动体外除颤器。 Automated external defibrillators are installed in the lobby and the waiting area.
快拿自动体外除颤器来，它自己会判断要不要电。 Get the automated external defibrillator — it decides by itself whether to shock.
抢救室配备手动除颤器与除颤电极片。 The resuscitation room is equipped with a manual defibrillator and defibrillation pads.
用手动除颤器，我来选能量，你们离床。 Use the manual defibrillator — I will pick the energy, you all step back.
除颤电极片贴于右锁骨下与左腋中线。 Defibrillation pads were placed below the right clavicle and at the left mid-axillary line.
除颤电极片贴好了吗？贴好我就充电。 Are the defibrillation pads on? If so I will charge.
使用除颤手柄时需涂导电糊并施加一定压力。 With defibrillator paddles, conductive gel must be applied and firm pressure used.
除颤手柄拿稳，涂点导电糊，别留空隙。 Hold the defibrillator paddles firmly, add gel and leave no gap.
双相波首次除颤能量选择一百二十至二百焦耳。 The first defibrillation energy for a biphasic device is one hundred twenty to two hundred joules.
除颤能量调到两百焦耳，快！ Set the defibrillation energy to two hundred joules, quickly!
老旧设备仍采用单相波除颤，能量选择三百六十焦耳。 Older devices still use monophasic defibrillation at three hundred sixty joules.
这台机器是单相波除颤，能量要往上调。 This machine does monophasic defibrillation, so the energy has to go up.
双相波除颤已取代单相波成为首选方式。 Biphasic defibrillation has replaced monophasic as the preferred approach.
现在都是双相波除颤，能量小一点效果一样。 We use biphasic defibrillation now, so lower energy works just as well.
房颤伴快速心室率时行同步电复律。 Synchronized cardioversion was performed for atrial fibrillation with a rapid ventricular rate.
这个不是室颤，要同步电复律，记得按同步键。 This is not ventricular fibrillation — we need synchronized cardioversion, so press the sync key.
心律分析确认除颤指征后方可放电。 A shock is delivered only after rhythm analysis confirms an indication for defibrillation.
先确认除颤指征，别看到乱就电。 Confirm the indication for defibrillation first — do not shock just because the trace looks messy.
一次电击后立即恢复胸外按压，不做即刻复查。 After a single shock, chest compressions resumed at once without an immediate recheck.
一次电击就够，电完马上按压，别站着看。 A single shock is enough — compress right after it, do not just stand and watch.
充电完成后再次确认无人接触患者。 After you charge the defibrillator, confirm again that nobody is touching the patient.
我在充电，大家手都拿开！ I need to charge now — everyone take your hands off!
放电前须确认心电图仍为可除颤心律。 Before shock delivery, confirm the tracing is still a shockable rhythm.
放电！大家都离开床了没有？ Shock delivery now! Is everyone clear of the bed?
心律分析时间不宜超过十秒。 Rhythm analysis should not take longer than ten seconds.
停一下做心律分析，看完马上接着压。 Pause for rhythm analysis, then get straight back on the chest.
除颤时机应尽可能提前至发现可除颤心律时。 Defibrillation timing should be as early as possible once a shockable rhythm is found.
除颤时机特别关键，每早一分钟都不一样。 Defibrillation timing is critical — every minute earlier makes a difference.
电极板位置须避开起搏器与敷料。 Paddle placement must avoid the pacemaker and any dressings.
电极板位置一个放右上胸一个放左腋下，别贴反。 Paddle placement is one on the upper right chest and one at the left axilla — do not mix them up.
转运前将患者接至除颤监护仪持续监护。 Before transport the patient was connected to a defibrillator monitor for continuous observation.
把除颤监护仪推到床旁，导联先贴上。 Bring the defibrillator monitor to the bedside and put the leads on first.
放电前口头清场并目视确认。 Before the shock, the team is verbally cleared and visually checked.
清场！氧气拿开，谁都别碰床！ Clear! Move the oxygen away and nobody touch the bed!
症状性心动过缓药物无效时改用经皮起搏。 Transcutaneous pacing is used when drugs fail in symptomatic bradycardia.
经皮起搏开起来，频率设七十，看看能不能夺获。 Start transcutaneous pacing at seventy a minute and see whether we get capture.
除颤阈值升高时需检查电极位置与接触。 When the defibrillation threshold rises, electrode position and contact should be checked.
除颤阈值高，可能电极没贴好。 The defibrillation threshold is high — the pads may not be making good contact.
两分钟后复查心律，仍为室颤者行再次除颤。 The rhythm was rechecked two minutes later and repeat defibrillation was given for persisting ventricular fibrillation.
还是室颤，准备再次除颤，能量不变。 Still ventricular fibrillation — prepare for repeat defibrillation at the same energy.
自动心律分析提示可电击，操作者确认后放电。 Automated rhythm analysis advised a shock, which the operator delivered after confirming.
等它自动心律分析完，听语音提示再按。 Wait for automated rhythm analysis to finish and follow the voice prompt before pressing.
记录除颤后心律并立即继续胸外按压。 The post-shock rhythm was recorded and chest compressions resumed at once.
看看除颤后心律转过来没有？转了就接着按压。 Check the post-shock rhythm — did it convert? If so, keep compressing.
电复律镇静首选短效静脉麻醉药并全程监护。 Sedation for cardioversion usually uses a short-acting intravenous agent with continuous monitoring.
做电复律镇静前先备好球囊面罩，镇静要浅。 Have bag-mask equipment ready before sedation for cardioversion, and keep it light.
除颤器检查记录须每班签字确认。 The defibrillator check record must be signed every shift.
交班前记得做除颤器检查，电池要满格。 Do the defibrillator check before handover and make sure the battery is full.
气道管理是抢救室交接班必须交代的内容。 Airway management is a mandatory item in resuscitation room handover.
这个病人气道管理要加强，随时可能堵。 This patient needs closer airway management — the airway could obstruct at any time.
先以手法开放气道，再评估通气效果。 A manual airway maneuver was performed first, then ventilation was assessed.
先做手法开放气道，看看能不能吹进去气。 Do a manual airway maneuver first and see whether air goes in.
无颈椎损伤疑虑时首选仰头抬颏法。 Head tilt-chin lift is preferred when cervical injury is not suspected.
仰头抬颏法，手放这儿，往上抬，气就通了。 Head tilt-chin lift — put your hand here and lift, and the airway opens.
怀疑颈椎损伤时改用推举下颌法开放气道。 A jaw thrust was used to open the airway when cervical injury was suspected.
别抬头，用推举下颌法，他脖子可能伤了。 Do not tilt the head — use a jaw thrust, his neck may be injured.
昏迷患者出现舌后坠时需放置口咽通气管。 When glossoptosis occurs in an unconscious patient, an oropharyngeal airway is inserted.
打呼噜那种声音是舌后坠，把头仰起来就好点。 That snoring sound is glossoptosis — tilting the head back helps.
置入口咽通气管后通气明显改善。 Ventilation improved noticeably after an oropharyngeal airway was inserted.
拿个口咽通气管来，三号的，给他放上。 Get an oropharyngeal airway, size three, and put it in.
牙关紧闭者可选用鼻咽通气管。 A nasopharyngeal airway may be chosen when the jaw is clenched.
鼻咽通气管涂点润滑剂再插，别硬顶。 Lubricate the nasopharyngeal airway before inserting — do not force it.
气道吸引前后应给予充分氧合。 Adequate oxygenation is given before and after airway suctioning.
先做气道吸引，把血吸干净再看声门。 Do airway suctioning first, clear the blood, then look for the glottis.
选择合适型号的吸痰管，避免损伤气道黏膜。 Choose an appropriately sized suction catheter to avoid injuring the airway mucosa.
吸痰管太粗了，换根细的，别伤着黏膜。 That suction catheter is too thick — use a finer one so we do not damage the mucosa.
负压吸引装置应处于备用状态并每日检查。 Negative pressure suction equipment must be ready for use and checked daily.
负压吸引开小一点，压力太大会伤气道。 Turn the negative pressure suction down — too much pressure injures the airway.
体位引流前应评估患者耐受性与氧合情况。 Tolerance and oxygenation are assessed before postural drainage.
给他摆个体位引流，痰在肺底那边。 Set him up for postural drainage — the secretions are at the lung bases.
开放气道的同时须做好颈椎保护。 Cervical spine protection is maintained while the airway is opened.
颈椎保护要做好，我固定头你开放气道。 Keep up cervical spine protection — I will hold the head while you open the airway.
插管前完成气道评估并记录困难气道征象。 Airway assessment was completed before intubation and difficult-airway signs were recorded.
先做气道评估，看他张嘴大不大。 Do an airway assessment first and see how wide he can open his mouth.
评估为困难气道者应准备备用方案与设备。 For a predicted difficult airway, backup plans and equipment must be prepared.
这个人是困难气道，把视频喉镜也推过来。 This one is a difficult airway — bring the video laryngoscope too.
马氏气道分级三级以上提示插管困难风险增高。 A Mallampati classification of three or above suggests a higher risk of difficult intubation.
马氏气道分级是三级，插管可能不好插。 The Mallampati classification is three, so intubation may be tricky.
张口度小于三厘米提示可能存在困难气道。 A mouth opening under three centimetres suggests a possible difficult airway.
张口度不够，喉镜放不进去。 The mouth opening is too small — the laryngoscope will not go in.
甲颏距小于六厘米时须备好困难气道方案。 If thyromental distance is under six centimetres, a difficult-airway plan is required.
量一下甲颏距，看着偏短。 Measure the thyromental distance — it looks short.
气道异物完全阻塞时患者无法发声与咳嗽。 With a complete airway foreign body obstruction the patient cannot speak or cough.
气道异物，快做海姆立克手法！ Airway foreign body — do the Heimlich maneuver now!
成人气道异物梗阻首选海姆立克手法。 A Heimlich maneuver is the first choice for an adult with an obstructed airway.
别拍背了，海姆立克手法，我来。 Stop the back slaps — I will do the Heimlich maneuver.
摆好嗅物位可明显改善声门视野。 A good sniffing position clearly improves the view of the glottis.
把头垫高一点，摆成嗅物位，好插。 Raise the head a little into a sniffing position — it will be easier to intubate.
头后仰配合抬颏可缓解轻度气道梗阻。 Head extension with chin lift relieves mild airway obstruction.
头后仰一点，气道就打开了。 Give it a bit of head extension and the airway opens.
深度镇静会抑制气道保护反射。 Deep sedation suppresses the airway protective reflex.
他还有气道保护反射，说明镇静没那么深。 His airway protective reflex is still there, so he is not that deeply sedated.
气道梗阻分为部分性与完全性两类。 Airway obstruction is classified as partial or complete.
听这声音是气道梗阻，快处理！ That sound means airway obstruction — deal with it now!
呕吐患者取侧卧位并清理口腔。 A vomiting patient is placed in the lateral position and the mouth is cleared.
把他翻成侧卧位，别让呕吐物呛进去。 Turn him into the lateral position so the vomit does not go down.
气道异物梗阻时先予背部拍击五次。 Five back blows are given first when the airway is obstructed.
先做背部拍击，拍五下看看能不能咳出来。 Start with back blows — five of them — and see whether he can cough it out.
患者血氧持续下降，决定行气管插管。 Oxygen saturation kept falling, so endotracheal intubation was decided.
准备气管插管，镇静药和喉镜都备好！ Get ready for endotracheal intubation — prepare sedation and the laryngoscope!
选择内径七点五毫米的气管导管经口置入。 An endotracheal tube with an internal diameter of seven point five millimetres was inserted orally.
气管导管型号合适吗？男的先用八号。 Is the endotracheal tube the right size? Start with a size eight for a man.
记录导管型号与置入深度。 Record the tube size and the insertion depth.
导管型号别选太大，容易伤声带。 Do not pick too large a tube size — it damages the vocal cords.
检查导管气囊是否漏气后再置入。 Check the tube cuff for leaks before insertion.
导管气囊充气后要测压力，别超过三十厘米水柱。 Measure the pressure after inflating the tube cuff, and keep it under thirty centimetres of water.
气囊充气后听诊确认无漏气。 After cuff inflation, auscultation confirmed there was no leak.
气囊充气了没有？没充会漏气。 Have you done cuff inflation? Without it the circuit will leak.
插管深度按门齿刻度记录为二十三厘米。 The insertion depth was recorded as twenty-three centimetres at the incisors.
插管深度太深了，往外拔一厘米。 The insertion depth is too deep — pull the tube back one centimetre.
喉镜光源不足会影响声门暴露。 A dim laryngoscope light impairs glottic exposure.
喉镜递给我，换个大号镜片看看。 Pass me the laryngoscope and change to a larger blade.
根据患者体型选择合适长度的喉镜片。 Choose a laryngoscope blade of suitable length for the patient's build.
喉镜片装上去了吗？装反了用不了。 Is the laryngoscope blade fitted? It will not work if it is the wrong way round.
成人气管插管多选用弯型镜片。 A curved blade is usually chosen for intubation in adults.
换弯型镜片，直的在成人不好用。 Switch to a curved blade — the straight one is awkward in adults.
儿童插管宜选用直型镜片。 A straight blade is preferred for intubation in children.
直型镜片给我，这孩子会厌软。 Give me a straight blade — this child has a floppy epiglottis.
采用快速诱导插管，给药后三十秒内完成置管。 Rapid sequence intubation was used, with the tube placed within thirty seconds of induction.
按快速诱导插管来，镇静肌松一起给。 Go with rapid sequence intubation — give sedation and the muscle relaxant together.
插管确认以持续二氧化碳波形最为可靠。 Tube confirmation is most reliable with a continuous carbon dioxide waveform.
插管确认了吗？先看二氧化碳波形。 Is tube confirmation done? Check the carbon dioxide waveform first.
呼气末二氧化碳骤升提示导管位置正确。 A sharp rise in end-tidal carbon dioxide indicates the tube is correctly placed.
呼气末二氧化碳有了，管子在气管里。 We have end-tidal carbon dioxide, so the tube is in the trachea.
全程二氧化碳图监测可早期发现导管移位。 Continuous capnography detects tube displacement early.
接上二氧化碳图，波形没了就是管子出来了。 Connect capnography — if the waveform disappears the tube has come out.
发生插管失败后立即改用声门上气道。 After a failed intubation, a supraglottic airway was used immediately.
两次都插不进去，这就是插管失败，换方案。 Two attempts and no tube — that is a failed intubation, change the plan.
按压环状软骨后声门暴露明显改善。 Glottic exposure improved markedly after cricoid pressure was applied.
声门暴露不好，帮我压一下环状软骨。 Glottic exposure is poor — help me press on the cricoid.
快速诱导时配合环状软骨压迫。 Cricoid pressure is applied during rapid sequence intubation.
环状软骨压迫轻一点，压太狠看不见声门。 Ease off the cricoid pressure — too much and I cannot see the glottis.
导管固定后复测深度并记录。 After tube securement the depth was rechecked and recorded.
导管固定牢一点，转运的时候别拽出来。 Make the tube securement firm so it is not pulled out during transfer.
翻身拍背后出现导管移位，立即检查并调整。 After turning the patient, tube displacement was found and corrected at once.
导管移位了，二氧化碳波形没了！ The capnography trace is gone — that means tube displacement!
未闻及双肺呼吸音时应警惕导管误入食管。 Absent breath sounds should raise suspicion of esophageal intubation.
没听到呼吸音，别是导管误入食管了！ No breath sounds — could it be esophageal intubation?
预计困难气道时首选视频喉镜。 A video laryngoscope is first choice in a difficult airway.
视频喉镜推过来，屏幕调亮一点。 Bring the video laryngoscope over and brighten the screen.
张口受限者可行纤支镜插管。 Fiberoptic intubation can be used when mouth opening is limited.
上纤支镜插管，这个病人脖子不能动。 Go for fiberoptic intubation — this patient's neck cannot be moved.
拔管前评估意识、咳嗽力量与氧合。 Before extubation, consciousness, cough strength and oxygenation were assessed.
准备拔管，吸痰、给氧、备好重新插管的东西。 Prepare for extubation — suction, oxygenate and have re-intubation equipment ready.
无法插管且无法通气时行环甲膜切开。 Cricothyrotomy is performed when the patient can be neither intubated nor ventilated.
不行就环甲膜切开，别犹豫！ If this fails, do a cricothyrotomy — do not hesitate!
外科气道是困难气道流程的最后一步。 A surgical airway is the final step in the difficult airway algorithm.
准备外科气道，把切开包打开。 Prepare for a surgical airway and open the cricothyrotomy kit.
环甲膜穿刺可临时改善氧合，为切开争取时间。 Needle cricothyrotomy can improve oxygenation briefly while preparing for incision.
先做环甲膜穿刺通气，撑到外科医生来。 Do a needle cricothyrotomy for now and hold on until the surgeon arrives.
插管次数超过三次应改用其他气道方案。 After three intubation attempts, another airway strategy should be used.
插管次数已经两次了，第三次让上级来。 That is two intubation attempts already — let the senior doctor do the third.
声门上气道可在不显露声门的情况下完成通气。 A supraglottic airway allows ventilation without exposing the glottis.
插不进去就先用声门上气道顶着。 If intubation fails, use a supraglottic airway to keep going.
置入喉罩后通气阻力明显下降。 After the laryngeal mask airway was inserted, ventilation resistance fell clearly.
拿个喉罩过来，要四号的。 Bring a laryngeal mask airway, size four.
喉罩置入后充气并确认胸廓起伏。 After laryngeal mask insertion, the cuff was inflated and chest movement confirmed.
喉罩置入要贴着上腭往下送，别卷边。 During laryngeal mask insertion keep it against the palate so the cuff does not fold.
按体重对照表选择喉罩型号。 Laryngeal mask size is chosen from the weight-based table.
喉罩型号选四号，他六十多公斤。 Take laryngeal mask size four — he is over sixty kilos.
喉罩拔除前须确认意识与吞咽反射恢复。 Before laryngeal mask removal, consciousness and swallowing must be confirmed.
等他能睁眼再做喉罩拔除，别太早。 Wait until he can open his eyes before laryngeal mask removal.
插管型喉罩用于预计插管困难的患者。 An intubating laryngeal mask is used when intubation is expected to be difficult.
用插管型喉罩，管子从里面穿过去。 Use an intubating laryngeal mask and pass the tube through it.
二代喉罩可经引流通道置入胃管。 A second-generation laryngeal mask allows a gastric tube through its drainage channel.
二代喉罩好，能下胃管还能测漏气压。 The second-generation laryngeal mask is better — it takes a gastric tube and lets us measure leak pressure.
食管气管联合导管可用于院前紧急通气。 The esophageal tracheal Combitube can be used for emergency prehospital ventilation.
车上只有食管气管联合导管，先插这个。 The ambulance only carries an esophageal tracheal Combitube, so use that first.
口咽漏气压低于二十厘米水柱提示密封不良。 An oropharyngeal leak pressure below twenty centimetres of water suggests a poor seal.
测一下口咽漏气压，太低就得换大一号。 Measure the oropharyngeal leak pressure — if it is low, go up a size.
听诊颈部有漏气声提示喉罩漏气。 A hissing sound over the neck suggests mask leak.
喉罩漏气，听着脖子那边嘶嘶响。 There is a mask leak — I can hear hissing at the neck.
盲探置入操作简便，适合院前使用。 Blind insertion is quick and suits prehospital use.
盲探置入就行，不用等喉镜。 Blind insertion is fine — no need to wait for a laryngoscope.
声门上气道失败应立即改为气管插管。 Supraglottic airway failure calls for immediate tracheal intubation.
这是声门上气道失败，别硬撑，改插管。 This is supraglottic airway failure — stop forcing it and intubate.
心肺复苏期间声门上气道指征明确。 During resuscitation the indication for supraglottic airway use is clear.
按声门上气道指征，这个病人可以先放喉罩。 On the indication for supraglottic airway, we can place a mask first in this patient.
饱胃属于声门上气道禁忌，应改为插管。 A full stomach is a contraindication to supraglottic airway use, so intubation is preferred.
张口只有一指，这是声门上气道禁忌。 He opens his mouth one finger wide — that is a contraindication to supraglottic airway use.
气道密封良好时通气压力保持稳定。 With a good airway seal the ventilation pressure stays stable.
气道密封不行，气都从嘴边跑了。 The airway seal is poor — gas is escaping around the mouth.
喉罩罩体应覆盖喉部入口。 The mask should sit over the laryngeal inlet.
罩体没对准喉部入口，位置偏了。 The mask is not over the laryngeal inlet — it is sitting off to one side.
抢救车应常备基本气道辅助装置。 The crash cart should stock basic airway adjuncts.
气道辅助装置带上，口咽鼻咽各两个。 Bring the airway adjuncts — two oral and two nasal.
喉罩通气期间监测漏气压与胸廓起伏。 During laryngeal mask ventilation, leak pressure and chest movement are monitored.
先喉罩通气，血氧上来再说。 Start laryngeal mask ventilation and wait for saturation to come up.
喉罩引导插管可作为困难气道的过渡方案。 Laryngeal mask guided intubation can serve as a bridge in the difficult airway.
做喉罩引导插管，导丝先放进去。 Do laryngeal mask guided intubation and pass the bougie first.
浅麻醉下拔管易诱发喉痉挛。 Extubation under light anaesthesia easily triggers laryngospasm.
喉痉挛了，正压通气，别硬拔管。 He has laryngospasm — give positive pressure and do not force the tube out.
多次尝试置管会加重气道损伤。 Repeated placement attempts worsen airway trauma.
动作轻点，别弄出气道损伤。 Be gentler — we do not want airway trauma.
声门上气道更换需在氧合稳定时进行。 Supraglottic airway exchange is done only when oxygenation is stable.
等血氧稳了再做声门上气道更换。 Wait until saturation is stable before supraglottic airway exchange.
漏气增加与通气阻力升高提示喉罩位置不良。 Rising leak and resistance suggest malposition of the laryngeal mask.
喉罩位置不良，往里再送一点。 That is malposition of the laryngeal mask — push it in a little further.
球囊面罩通气是建立高级气道前的标准通气手段。 Bag-mask ventilation is the standard method before an advanced airway is placed.
先球囊面罩通气，血氧撑住再说。 Start bag-mask ventilation and keep the saturation up first.
简易呼吸器应连接储氧袋使用。 The self-inflating bag should be used with an oxygen reservoir.
简易呼吸器拿来，接上氧气。 Bring the self-inflating bag and connect the oxygen.
面罩通气困难时应尽早建立高级气道。 When mask ventilation is difficult, an advanced airway should be placed early.
面罩通气效果不好，看看是不是漏气。 Mask ventilation is not working well — check whether it is leaking.
双手托颌可改善面罩密闭。 Two-handed jaw support improves the mask seal.
面罩密闭不好，气全从旁边漏了。 The mask seal is poor — all the gas is leaking out the side.
双人面罩通气可显著改善送气量。 Two-person mask ventilation clearly improves the delivered volume.
一个人按不住，改双人面罩通气。 One person cannot hold it — switch to two-person mask ventilation.
根据脸型选择合适的面罩型号。 Choose a face mask size that fits the shape of the face.
面罩型号不对，太大漏气，换小的。 The face mask size is wrong — too big and leaking, so use a smaller one.
氧气储袋充盈提示氧流量充足。 A filled oxygen reservoir bag indicates adequate oxygen flow.
氧气储袋瘪了，把流量开大点。 The oxygen reservoir bag has collapsed — turn the flow up.
单向阀粘连会导致通气阻力增大。 A stuck one-way valve increases ventilation resistance.
单向阀卡住了，这个球囊不能用。 The one-way valve is stuck, so this bag is unusable.
压力安全阀可减少气压伤风险。 The pressure relief valve reduces the risk of barotrauma.
压力安全阀没关，难怪气打不进去。 The pressure relief valve is open — no wonder the gas will not go in.
心肺复苏过程中应避免过度通气。 Hyperventilation should be avoided during resuscitation.
别挤那么快，过度通气会让二氧化碳掉太低。 Do not squeeze so fast — hyperventilation drops the carbon dioxide too low.
镇痛过深可引起通气不足。 Excessive analgesia can cause hypoventilation.
通气不足，二氧化碳都上来了。 There is hypoventilation — the carbon dioxide has climbed.
送气过快易造成胃胀气并增加反流风险。 Fast insufflation causes gastric insufflation and raises the risk of regurgitation.
压的时候慢一点，不然胃胀气更麻烦。 Squeeze more slowly, or gastric insufflation will cause trouble.
复苏时通气频率保持每分钟十次。 During resuscitation the ventilation rate is kept at ten per minute.
通气频率太快了，十次就够。 The ventilation rate is too fast — ten a minute is enough.
保留自主呼吸者可采用辅助通气。 Assisted ventilation can be used when spontaneous breathing is preserved.
先辅助通气看看，别急着完全控制。 Try assisted ventilation first — do not take over completely yet.
面罩通气困难者应及早准备插管。 Difficult mask ventilation should prompt early preparation for intubation.
这个人是面罩通气困难，快准备插管。 This is difficult mask ventilation — get ready to intubate.
转运期间保持手控通气并观察胸廓起伏。 Manual ventilation was maintained during transfer with chest movement observed.
先手控通气，我盯着血氧。 Go with manual ventilation for now and I will watch the saturation.
插管后连接呼吸机行机械通气。 After intubation the patient was connected for mechanical ventilation.
上机械通气，参数按公斤体重算。 Start mechanical ventilation and set the parameters by kilogram of body weight.
无创通气适用于清醒且能配合的患者。 Noninvasive ventilation suits patients who are alert and cooperative.
先试无创通气，人不清醒就不行。 Try noninvasive ventilation first — it will not work if he is not alert.
无创通气失败后改为有创通气。 After noninvasive support failed, invasive ventilation was started.
别再拖了，赶紧改有创通气吧。 Stop delaying and switch to invasive ventilation.
呼吸机使用前须完成自检。 The ventilator must pass its self-test before use.
呼吸机推到床旁，先自检。 Bring the ventilator to the bedside and run the self-test first.
根据病情与血气结果选择通气模式。 The ventilation mode is chosen according to the condition.
通气模式选哪个？先给个辅助控制。 Which ventilation mode? Start with assist-control.
气道压力突然升高需检查管路与气道。 A sudden rise in airway pressure calls for checking the circuit and the airway.
气道压力报警了，看看是不是痰堵了。 The airway pressure alarm is going — check whether secretions are blocking it.
人机对抗时需调整触发灵敏度或加深镇静。 Patient-ventilator asynchrony is managed by adjusting trigger sensitivity or deepening sedation.
他明显人机对抗，先加点镇静。 There is obvious patient-ventilator asynchrony — give a little more sedation.
脱机前评估自主呼吸试验结果。 The spontaneous breathing trial is reviewed before weaning from mechanical ventilation.
今天试着脱机，你看看他呼吸功。 We will try weaning from mechanical ventilation today — watch his work of breathing.
呼吸机报警须在三十秒内响应。 A ventilator alarm must be answered within thirty seconds.
呼吸机报警了，快去看看！ The ventilator alarm is sounding — go and check it now!
球囊挤压应持续一秒以上，避免气流过冲。 Each bag squeeze should last more than one second to avoid an abrupt surge.
球囊挤压慢一点，一秒送一口。 Slow the bag squeeze down — one second per breath.
低流量氧疗时首选鼻导管给氧。 A nasal cannula is first choice for low-flow oxygen therapy.
给他上个鼻导管，两升每分钟。 Put a nasal cannula on him at two litres a minute.
简易面罩给氧流量应不低于五升每分钟。 A simple face mask needs an oxygen flow of at least five litres per minute.
换简易面罩，流量开到八升。 Switch to a simple face mask and set the flow to eight litres.
危重低氧患者首选非重复呼吸面罩。 A non-rebreather mask is first choice for the critically hypoxaemic patient.
上非重复呼吸面罩，开十五升。 Put on a non-rebreather mask and run it at fifteen litres.
需控制氧浓度时选用文丘里面罩。 A Venturi mask is used when the oxygen concentration must be controlled precisely.
用文丘里面罩，浓度调到百分之二十八。 Use a Venturi mask and set the concentration to twenty-eight per cent.
高流量鼻导管可减少呼吸功。 A high-flow nasal cannula reduces the work of breathing.
上高流量鼻导管，流量四十升。 Start a high-flow nasal cannula at forty litres.
氧气瓶须固定放置并标注余量。 Oxygen cylinders must be secured and their remaining volume labelled.
氧气瓶还剩多少？够不够转运用。 How much is left in the oxygen cylinder? Is it enough for the transfer?
中心供氧故障时立即启用备用氧气瓶。 When the central oxygen supply fails, the backup cylinder is used at once.
中心供氧接口松了，插紧一点。 The central oxygen supply connector is loose — push it in firmly.
