肾功能不全者需行剂量调整。 Patients with renal impairment need dose adjustment.
剂量调整一下，他体重太轻。 Make a dose adjustment — he weighs very little.
配制后标注药物浓度与配制时间。 The drug concentration and preparation time are labelled after mixing.
药物浓度太高，得再稀释。 The drug concentration is too high — it needs further dilution.
药物稀释后缓慢静脉推注。 After drug dilution the solution was injected slowly into the vein.
药物稀释一下再推，刺激性太强。 Dilute the drug first — drug dilution reduces the irritation.
给药前须先查配伍禁忌表。 The drug incompatibility table is checked before drugs are given.
这两个药有配伍禁忌，别走同一路。 These two have a drug incompatibility — do not run them through the same line.
按给药间隔记录下次用药时间。 The next dose time was recorded according to the dosing interval.
给药间隔还没到，再等十分钟。 The dosing interval is not up yet — wait ten more minutes.
儿童用药须重新做剂量计算。 Dose calculation must be redone for paediatric patients.
剂量计算你再核一遍，别算错。 Redo the dose calculation — we cannot afford an error.
疑为药物不良反应须上报并记录。 A suspected adverse drug reaction must be reported and documented.
这是药物不良反应，先停药观察。 This is an adverse drug reaction — stop the drug and observe.
复苏团队在三分钟内到位。 The resuscitation team arrived within three minutes.
复苏团队到齐没有？人还不够。 Is the resuscitation team all here? We are still short of people.
抢救组长负责决策与任务分配。 The team leader is responsible for decisions and task allocation.
抢救组长说了算，别各自下命令。 The team leader decides — stop giving separate orders.
按压者每两分钟更换一次。 The compressor is changed every two minutes.
按压者准备好，我说开始就压。 Compressor ready — start pushing when I say.
球囊操作者与按压者保持三十比二的节律。 The bag-mask operator keeps to a thirty-to-two rhythm with the compressor.
球囊操作者就位，听按压的节拍给气。 Bag-mask operator in place — give a breath on the compression beat.
气道管理者由经验丰富的医师担任。 The airway manager is an experienced physician.
气道管理者来了，插管交给他。 The airway manager is here — hand over the intubation.
给药护士复述医嘱后方可推药。 The medication nurse repeats the order before giving the drug.
给药护士，肾上腺素一毫克准备。 Medication nurse, prepare epinephrine one milligram.
记录者须实时记录每次给药时间。 The recorder must log the time of every drug dose in real time.
记录者记一下，现在是十点零五分。 Recorder, note the time — it is ten oh five now.
计时员每两分钟提示按压轮换。 The timekeeper calls the compressor change every two minutes.
计时员报时，两分钟到了。 Timekeeper, call it — two minutes are up.
除颤操作者确认清场后放电。 The defibrillator operator confirms the team is clear before shocking.
除颤操作者准备，我说电就电。 Defibrillator operator standby — shock when I say.
抢救开始前完成角色分工并点名确认。 Role assignment was completed and confirmed by name before resuscitation started.
先做角色分工，谁按压谁给药说清楚。 Do the role assignment first — say who compresses and who gives drugs.
闭环沟通可减少抢救中的遗漏与重复。 Closed-loop communication reduces omissions and duplication during resuscitation.
用闭环沟通，我下指令你要重复一遍。 Use closed-loop communication — repeat every order I give.
复苏复盘在抢救结束后二十四小时内完成。 Resuscitation debriefing is completed within twenty-four hours of the event.
一会儿做个复苏复盘，把问题说清楚。 We will do a resuscitation debriefing shortly and go through the problems.
团队站位应保证按压与给药互不干扰。 Team positioning should let compressions and drug preparation proceed without interference.
团队站位挪一下，你挡着静脉通路了。 Adjust the team positioning — you are blocking the IV line.
发现骤停后立即呼叫支援。 A call for help is made as soon as the arrest is recognised.
快呼叫支援，两个人不够！ Make the call for help — two people are not enough!
给药前由两人交叉核对药名与剂量。 Two staff cross-check the drug name and dose before administration.
交叉核对一下，别拿错药。 Do a cross-check — we must not take the wrong drug.
高质量团队协作与复苏成功率正相关。 Good teamwork correlates with a higher resuscitation success rate.
团队协作要跟上，别各干各的。 Teamwork has to improve — stop working in your own corners.
院内急救小组接到呼叫后五分钟内到达。 The rapid response team arrived within five minutes of the call.
院内急救小组已经在路上了。 The rapid response team is already on its way.
口头医嘱须在抢救结束后补记。 Verbal orders must be written up after resuscitation ends.
口头医嘱我复述一遍，你确认。 I will repeat the verbal order back — confirm it.
高危药物给药前必须复述确认。 Read-back is mandatory before a high-alert drug is given.
复述确认一下药名和剂量。 Do a read-back of the drug name and dose.
科室开展团队资源管理培训。 The department runs team resource management training.
团队资源管理这块还得练，沟通太乱。 Team resource management needs work — communication is chaotic.
复苏团队启动后记录响应时间。 The response time is recorded after team activation.
复苏团队启动了吗？怎么还没人来。 Has team activation happened? Why is nobody here yet?
重症患者抢救常需多学科协作。 Resuscitation of critically ill patients often needs a multidisciplinary team.
多学科协作叫上心内科，一起定方案。 Call cardiology for the multidisciplinary team and set the plan together.
每季度组织一次复苏演练。 A resuscitation drill is held every quarter.
明天下午复苏演练，全员参加。 There is a resuscitation drill tomorrow afternoon — everyone attends.
上级医师到场后重新评估复苏方案。 After senior physician arrival the resuscitation plan was reassessed.
上级医师到场了，方案听他的。 Senior physician arrival confirmed — follow their plan now.
复苏后处理直接影响神经功能结局。 Post-resuscitation care directly affects the neurological outcome.
人救回来了，复苏后处理才刚开始。 We got him back, but post-resuscitation care has only just begun.
复苏后监护至少持续二十四小时。 Post-resuscitation monitoring continues for at least twenty-four hours.
复苏后监护别松，随时可能再停。 Do not relax post-resuscitation monitoring — the heart could stop again.
昏迷患者复苏后启动目标温度管理。 Targeted temperature management was started after resuscitation in the comatose patient.
目标温度管理上起来，体温别超三十六。 Start targeted temperature management and keep the temperature under thirty-six.
治疗性低温需连续监测核心体温。 Therapeutic hypothermia requires continuous core temperature monitoring.
治疗性低温要用冰毯，先铺上。 Therapeutic hypothermia needs the cooling blanket — put it on first.
复温速度控制在每小时零点二五度。 The rewarming rate was kept at zero point two five degrees per hour.
复温别太快，慢慢来就行。 Rewarming should not be too fast — take it slowly.
出现寒战需加深镇静或加用肌松药。 Shivering is managed by deepening sedation or adding a muscle relaxant.
他在寒战，体温压不下来。 He is shivering, so the temperature will not come down.
神经预后评估应在降温结束后至少七十二小时进行。 Neurological prognostication should wait at least seventy-two hours after cooling ends.
神经预后评估别太早做，容易误判。 Do not do neurological prognostication too early — it is easy to misjudge.
复苏后低血压首选液体与升压药处理。 Post-arrest hypotension is treated first with fluids and vasopressors.
复苏后低血压，先把血压撑到六十五以上。 Post-arrest hypotension — push the pressure above sixty-five first.
复苏后心电图提示急性心肌缺血。 The post-resuscitation electrocardiogram suggested acute myocardial ischaemia.
复苏后心电图做了吗？看看有没有缺血。 Has the post-resuscitation electrocardiogram been done? Check for ischaemia.
复苏后血糖控制目标为七点八至十毫摩尔。 The target for glucose control after resuscitation is seven point eight to ten millimoles.
复苏后血糖控制要盯，别让它飙。 Watch the glucose control after resuscitation — do not let it spike.
出现复苏后癫痫发作须立即止惊并监测脑电。 A post-arrest seizure requires immediate treatment and EEG monitoring.
他刚才抽了，是复苏后癫痫发作。 He seized a moment ago — that is a post-arrest seizure.
反复肌阵挛与不良神经结局相关。 Repeated myoclonus is associated with a poor neurological outcome.
他手脚老在跳，那是肌阵挛。 His limbs keep jerking — that is myoclonus.
脑电图可发现非惊厥性癫痫发作。 An electroencephalogram can reveal non-convulsive seizures.
脑电图约上了吗？要排除隐匿抽搐。 Is the electroencephalogram booked? We need to rule out hidden seizures.
双侧体感诱发电位消失提示预后极差。 Absent bilateral somatosensory evoked potentials suggest a very poor prognosis.
体感诱发电位做了再说，别急着下结论。 Wait for the somatosensory evoked potential results before drawing conclusions.
出院时评估神经功能结局并记录。 The neurological outcome was assessed and recorded at discharge.
神经功能结局好不好，一个月后才看得出来。 A good neurological outcome only becomes clear after about a month.
复苏后采用肺保护性通气策略。 Lung-protective ventilation was used after resuscitation.
肺保护性通气，潮气量按六毫升每公斤算。 Use lung-protective ventilation — six millilitres per kilogram.
复苏后镇静以能耐受治疗为度。 Post-arrest sedation is titrated to the level needed to tolerate treatment.
复苏后镇静浅一点，好评估意识。 Keep post-arrest sedation light so we can assess consciousness.
复苏后发热应积极降温并查找感染灶。 Post-arrest fever calls for active cooling and a search for infection.
复苏后发热到三十八度五了，赶紧处理。 Post-arrest fever has reached thirty-eight point five — treat it now.
复苏后护理记录须逐项落实。 Post-resuscitation nursing must be documented item by item.
复苏后护理交接清楚，别漏管路。 Hand over the post-resuscitation nursing clearly — do not miss any line.
复苏后随访在出院后一个月开始。 Post-arrest follow-up begins one month after discharge.
复苏后随访记得约，家属要带他来复查。 Book the post-arrest follow-up — the family must bring him back.
复苏后康复应在病情稳定后尽早介入。 Post-arrest rehabilitation should start as early as possible.
复苏后康复早点做，效果更好。 Start post-arrest rehabilitation early — the results are better.

en: quality of life after cardiac arrest
text: 复苏后生活质量采用量表评估。 Quality of life after cardiac arrest was assessed with a standard scale.

en: quality of life after cardiac arrest
text: 复苏后生活质量是他最关心的事。 Quality of life after cardiac arrest is what worries him most.
复苏后营养支持优先选择肠内途径。 Post-arrest nutrition support uses the enteral route first.
复苏后营养支持先上肠内，别急着静脉。 Start post-arrest nutrition support enterally — no rush for the intravenous route.
复苏后呼吸支持根据血气调整参数。 Post-arrest respiratory support parameters are adjusted by blood gas results.
复苏后呼吸支持参数调一下，二氧化碳偏高。 Adjust the post-arrest respiratory support — the carbon dioxide is high.
院前急救质量影响后续院内救治。 The quality of prehospital emergency care affects later in-hospital treatment.
院前急救做得好，到院就好办。 Good prehospital emergency care makes things much easier on arrival.
院前转运途中持续监测生命体征。 Vital signs are monitored continuously during prehospital transport.
院前转运半小时，路上一直盯着。 Prehospital transport took half an hour and we watched him the whole way.
救护车到达现场用时八分钟。 The ambulance reached the scene in eight minutes.
救护车到楼下了，准备接人。 The ambulance is downstairs — get ready to receive the patient.
急救员完成现场评估后立即转运。 The emergency medical technician completed the scene assessment and transported at once.
急救员说现场血压测不到。 The emergency medical technician says no blood pressure could be measured at the scene.
院前急救团队与院内提前通报病情。 The prehospital team notified the hospital of the condition in advance.
院前急救团队几个人？够不够搬抬。 How many are in the prehospital team? Enough to carry him?
急救调度根据分级派出相应车辆。 Emergency dispatch sends the appropriate vehicle according to the priority.
急救调度说十分钟到，先做按压。 Emergency dispatch says ten minutes — keep compressing until then.
现场评估包括环境安全与伤员数量。 The scene assessment covers environmental safety and the number of casualties.
先做现场评估，别贸然进去。 Do the scene assessment first — do not rush in.
现场安全未确认前不得展开救援。 Rescue does not begin until scene safety is confirmed.
现场安全吗？有漏气先撤。 How is scene safety? If there is a gas leak, pull back first.
担架转运时保持头部与躯干同轴。 During stretcher transport the head and trunk are kept in line.
担架转运，一二三一起抬。 Stretcher transport — lift together on three.
疑似脊柱损伤者使用铲式担架。 A scoop stretcher is used when spinal injury is suspected.
拿铲式担架来，别让他翻身。 Bring the scoop stretcher — we are not turning him.
转运监护设备须固定牢靠。 Transport monitoring equipment must be firmly secured.
转运监护接上，血氧掉了我好知道。 Connect transport monitoring so I know if the saturation drops.
转运前检查转运呼吸机电池与氧源。 Check the transport ventilator battery and oxygen supply before transfer.
转运呼吸机的氧气够不够用？ Is there enough oxygen for the transport ventilator?
院前通知须包含意识、气道与预计到院时间。 Prehospital notification must include consciousness, airway and estimated arrival time.
院前通知打了吗？让他们备好抢救室。 Has prehospital notification been made? Tell them to ready the resuscitation room.
院前交接采用结构化格式并双方签名。 Prehospital handover uses a structured format signed by both sides.
院前交接快点，重点说意识变化。 Keep the prehospital handover short — focus on the change in consciousness.
交接报告内容包括发病经过与用药。 The handover report covers the onset and the drugs given.
交接报告先说气道和循环。 In the handover report, start with airway and circulation.
转运前评估转运风险并记录。 Transport risk is assessed and documented before moving the patient.
转运风险不小，路上得多带个人。 There is real transport risk — take an extra person on the road.
途中病情变化须立即停车处置。 Deterioration during transport requires stopping the vehicle and treating at once.
途中病情变化了，先靠边停。 We have deterioration during transport — pull over first.
转运时间超过三十分钟需重新评估风险。 If transport time exceeds thirty minutes, the risk must be reassessed.
转运时间别太长，尽量就近。 Keep transport time short — go to the nearest place.
缩短院前延迟可提高救治效果。 Shortening prehospital delay improves the outcome of emergency treatment.
院前延迟太久，路上就耽误了二十分钟。 The prehospital delay was too long — twenty minutes lost on the road.
直升机转运适用于偏远地区重症患者。 Helicopter transport suits critically ill patients in remote areas.
直升机转运快，但得看天气。 Helicopter transport is fast, but it depends on the weather.
转运决策由现场负责人作出。 The transport decision is made by the person in charge at the scene.
转运决策定了吗？送哪家医院。 Is the transport decision made? Which hospital are we going to?
按就近送医原则选择接收医院。 The receiving hospital is chosen on the principle of transport to nearest hospital.
先就近送医，别绕远去大医院。 Do transport to nearest hospital first — do not bypass to a big centre.
转院前须完成病情告知与交接准备。 Before interhospital transfer, the condition must be explained and handover prepared.
这家医院做不了，得转院。 This hospital cannot do it — we need an interhospital transfer.
接收医院须提前确认床位与专科能力。 The receiving hospital must confirm bed availability and specialist capacity in advance.
接收医院联系好了吗？别到了不收。 Has the receiving hospital been contacted? We cannot arrive and be refused.
院前记录随患者一并移交接收医院。 The prehospital record is handed over to the receiving hospital with the patient.
院前记录给我一份，留档要用。 Give me a copy of the prehospital record for the file.
创伤患者到院后立即开始初级评估，先查气道和呼吸。 The primary survey starts immediately on arrival, beginning with the airway and breathing.
我们现在做初级评估，您别动，我先看看气道通不通。 We are doing the primary survey now; please keep still while I check your airway.
患者情况不稳，已按创伤团队启动流程呼叫上级医师。 The patient became unstable, so the trauma team activation process was triggered to call the senior doctors.
这个伤情够重，马上创伤团队启动，让麻醉和外科都下来。 The injury is severe enough, so activate the trauma team and get anesthesia and surgery down here now.
根据创伤机制判断，该患者可能合并颈椎损伤。 Based on the mechanism of injury, this patient may also have a cervical spine injury.
创伤机制是什么？是车祸还是从高处摔下来的？ What was the mechanism of injury, a car crash or a fall from height?
高能量损伤患者应按多发伤流程完成全身评估。 Patients with high-energy injury should receive a full-body workup following the polytrauma pathway.
他这是高能量损伤，别只看腿，肚子和头也得查。 This is a high-energy injury, so do not just look at the leg; check the abdomen and head as well.
多发伤患者优先处理致命性损伤，再处理肢体骨折。 In polytrauma, life-threatening injuries are treated first and limb fractures later.
这是多发伤，先救命，骨折的事等稳定了再说。 This is polytrauma, so save his life first and deal with the fractures once he is stable.
损伤严重度评分为三十四分，属于严重创伤。 The injury severity score was thirty-four, indicating severe trauma.
损伤严重度评分这么高，得直接进抢救室。 The injury severity score is so high that he needs to go straight to the resuscitation room.
入院创伤评分偏低，提示需要立即复苏。 The admission trauma score was low, indicating the need for immediate resuscitation.
先算个创伤评分，看看要不要送创伤中心。 Let us calculate a trauma score first to see whether he needs a trauma center.
把握黄金一小时，患者到院后三十分钟内完成止血。 We aim to use the golden hour and achieve hemorrhage control within thirty minutes of arrival.
黄金一小时别耽误，直接推手术室。 Do not waste the golden hour, take him straight to the operating room.
患者已出现致命三联征，需立即启动损伤控制复苏。 The patient has developed the lethal triad, so damage control resuscitation must start at once.
注意致命三联征，保温、纠酸、输血一起上。 Watch for the lethal triad and start warming, correcting acidosis and transfusing together.
按损伤控制复苏原则，先输血浆和红细胞，少给晶体液。 Following damage control resuscitation, plasma and red cells are given first and crystalloid is limited.
别猛灌盐水，走损伤控制复苏，血制品先上。 Do not pour in saline; use damage control resuscitation and start blood products first.
患者凝血功能差，决定行损伤控制手术，暂时关腹。 Because coagulation was poor, damage control surgery was chosen and the abdomen was left temporarily closed.
这台按损伤控制手术做，先止血，关腹的事以后再说。 Do this as damage control surgery, stop the bleeding first and close the abdomen later.
该患者符合转送创伤中心的标准，已联系急救车。 The patient meets the criteria for transfer to a trauma center, and the ambulance has been arranged.
我们这儿做不了，得送创伤中心。 We cannot manage this here; he needs a trauma center.
院前创伤评估记录显示患者意识清楚、右大腿畸形。 The prehospital trauma assessment noted a conscious patient with a deformed right thigh.
院前创伤评估说摸不到脉搏，准备输血。 The prehospital trauma assessment reported no palpable pulse, so get blood ready.
气道通畅性评估发现口咽部有血凝块，立即清除。 The airway patency assessment found a blood clot in the oropharynx, which was cleared at once.
先做气道通畅性评估，能说话说明气道还通。 Start with an airway patency assessment; if he can speak, the airway is still open.
接到创伤预警后，抢救室提前备好输血与手术人员。 After the trauma alert, blood products and surgical staff were prepared in the resuscitation room.
创伤预警已经发了，人五分钟到。 The trauma alert has gone out and the patient arrives in five minutes.
严格按创伤救治流程执行，避免遗漏致命性损伤。 Follow the trauma protocol strictly so that life-threatening injuries are not missed.
咱们按创伤救治流程走，一步一步来。 Let us follow the trauma protocol and take it step by step.
骨盆骨折评估提示骨盆环不稳定，需先行固定。 The pelvic fracture assessment suggested an unstable pelvic ring that needed stabilization first.
骨盆骨折评估先做，别急着让人站起来。 Do the pelvic fracture assessment first; do not let him stand up yet.
暴露与保温同时进行，避免患者出现低体温。 Exposure and warming were carried out together to prevent hypothermia.
先把衣服剪开做暴露与保温，别让他在风里冻着。 Cut the clothes off for exposure and warming; do not let him freeze in the wind.
出血源控制比单纯输血更能改善预后。 Source control of bleeding improves outcome more than transfusion alone.
出血源控制没做好，输再多血也白搭。 If source control of bleeding is not achieved, transfusing more blood is useless.

en: focused assessment with sonography for trauma
text: 创伤超声评估未见心包积液，腹腔也未见游离液体。 The focused assessment with sonography for trauma showed no pericardial or abdominal free fluid.

en: focused assessment with sonography for trauma
text: 先做个创伤超声评估，两分钟就知道肚子里有没有血。 Do a focused assessment with sonography for trauma first; in two minutes we will know if there is blood in the belly.
骨盆挤压试验阳性，禁止重复检查以免加重出血。 The pelvic compression test was positive, and repeat testing was avoided to prevent further bleeding.
别反复做骨盆挤压试验，查一次阳性就够了。 Do not repeat the pelvic compression test; one positive result is enough.
快速评估在九十秒内完成，重点看气道、呼吸和出血。 The rapid assessment was completed in ninety seconds, focusing on airway, breathing and bleeding.
先做个快速评估，别的检查等稳定了再说。 Do a rapid assessment first and leave other tests until he is stable.
现场安全评估未通过，救援人员暂不进入坍塌区域。 The scene safety assessment was not passed, so rescuers stayed out of the collapsed area.
先做现场安全评估，别为了救人把自己搭进去。 Do the scene safety assessment first; do not get yourself hurt trying to rescue others.
病例讨论认为这是一例可预防性死亡，需改进院前止血。 The case review concluded this was a preventable death and that prehospital bleeding control must improve.
很多可预防性死亡的病例，问题都出在止血太晚。 In many preventable death cases the problem is that bleeding control came too late.
完善创伤救治体系后，严重创伤的死亡率明显下降。 After the trauma system was improved, mortality from severe trauma fell markedly.
创伤救治体系建好了，病人才能救得及时。 Once the trauma system is in place, patients can be treated in time.
初步稳定后开始次级评估，逐项检查全身各部位。 Once stabilized, the secondary survey began with each body region examined in turn.
他稳住了，我们现在做次级评估，从头查到脚。 He is stable now, so we are doing the secondary survey from head to toe.
接诊医师完成从头到脚查体并记录阳性发现。 The receiving doctor completed a head-to-toe examination and recorded the positive findings.
麻烦您配合一下，我们做个从头到脚查体。 Please cooperate while we do a head-to-toe examination.
创伤病史采集重点询问受伤时间、外力方向和现场情况。 The trauma history focused on the time of injury, the direction of force and the scene.
我先问几句创伤病史，您以前有什么病、吃什么药？ Let me take a brief trauma history: what illnesses do you have and what medicines do you take?
受伤时间距入院约两小时，仍在清创时限内。 The time of injury was about two hours before arrival, still within the debridement window.
受伤时间大概是几点？这对后面处理很重要。 About what time were you injured? It matters for the treatment later.
受伤部位为右前胸，局部可见淤斑。 The injury site was the right anterior chest, where bruising was visible.
您指一下受伤部位，是这儿疼吗？ Point to the injury site; is this where it hurts?
伤口检查见右小腿外侧三厘米裂口，边缘整齐。 Wound inspection showed a three-centimetre laceration on the outer right calf with clean edges.
先做个伤口检查，看看里面有没有异物。 Let us inspect the wound first to see whether anything is inside.
骨盆稳定性检查阴性，暂不考虑骨盆环断裂。 The pelvic stability examination was negative, so a pelvic ring fracture was thought unlikely.
别反复做骨盆稳定性检查，怀疑骨折就先上固定带。 Do not repeat the pelvic stability examination; if fracture is suspected, apply the binder first.
神经血管检查提示右足背动脉搏动减弱。 The neurovascular examination showed a weakened right dorsalis pedis pulse.
打石膏前后都要做神经血管检查，脚趾能动吗？ We check neurovascular status before and after plastering; can you move your toes?
伤口有活动性出血，先行加压包扎并准备清创。 There was active bleeding from the wound, so a pressure dressing was applied and debridement prepared.
这里有活动性出血，快拿纱布压住。 There is active bleeding here; grab some gauze and press on it now.
腹部钝性伤后出现隐性出血，血红蛋白进行性下降。 Occult bleeding developed after blunt abdominal trauma, with a falling hemoglobin level.
外面看不出血，可人是隐性出血，肚子越来越胀。 No blood is visible outside, but there is occult bleeding and the abdomen is distending.
骨盆骨折合并腹膜后出血，需紧急输血。 Pelvic fracture with retroperitoneal hemorrhage required urgent transfusion.
骨盆骨折最容易伴腹膜后出血，别只盯着片子。 Pelvic fracture is often accompanied by retroperitoneal hemorrhage, so do not just stare at the films.
诊断性腹腔灌洗回抽液呈血性，提示腹腔积血。 The diagnostic peritoneal lavage returned bloody fluid, suggesting hemoperitoneum.
超声看不清，就做诊断性腹腔灌洗。 If ultrasound is unclear, go ahead with diagnostic peritoneal lavage.
创伤系列X线未见明显气胸与骨盆骨折。 The trauma radiograph series showed no obvious pneumothorax or pelvic fracture.
先拍个创伤系列X线，胸片和骨盆一起。 Take the trauma radiograph series first, chest and pelvis together.
全身CT扫描发现脾周积液与右侧肋骨骨折。 Whole-body computed tomography found perisplenic fluid and right rib fractures.
人还算稳，直接推去做全身CT扫描。 He is reasonably stable, so take him straight for whole-body computed tomography.
每小时重复评估一次，记录意识与出血情况。 Reassessment was repeated every hour, recording consciousness and bleeding.
转运前再重复评估一遍，别把人送走了才发现不对。 Do another reassessment before transfer; do not discover a problem after he has left.
复查发现漏诊的右踝骨折，已补行固定。 Follow-up revealed a missed injury of the right ankle, which was then immobilized.
多发伤最怕漏诊，查完一遍还要回头再看。 Missed injury is the big fear in polytrauma, so go back and check again after the first pass.
患者出现创伤性凝血病，需补充血浆和血小板。 The patient developed trauma-induced coagulopathy and needed plasma and platelets.
血一直止不住，怕是创伤性凝血病，快查凝血。 The bleeding will not stop; I suspect trauma-induced coagulopathy, so check coagulation now.
出血量估计约一千五百毫升，已启动大量输血方案。 Estimated blood loss was about one and a half liters, and the massive transfusion protocol was started.
出血量估计不准，宁可按重的算。 If the estimated blood loss is uncertain, err on the higher side.
双侧长骨骨折需临时固定后再搬运。 Bilateral long bone fractures needed temporary splinting before moving the patient.
长骨骨折出血多，一根股骨就能丢一升血。 Long bone fractures bleed a lot; one femur can lose a liter of blood.
开放性创伤需尽早清创并预防破伤风。 Open trauma requires early debridement and tetanus prophylaxis.
这是开放性创伤，先冲再缝，别直接盖上。 This is open trauma, so irrigate before suturing and do not just cover it.
闭合性创伤外表看不出伤，仍需排查内脏损伤。 Closed trauma may look minor but still requires screening for internal organ injury.
闭合性创伤也可能大出血，别被皮肤骗了。 Closed trauma can bleed heavily too, so do not be fooled by intact skin.
左胸穿透伤，需排除心脏与大血管损伤。 A penetrating trauma to the left chest required exclusion of cardiac and great vessel injury.
这是穿透伤，伤口小但里面可能很深。 This is penetrating trauma; the wound is small but may be deep inside.
双下肢挤压伤，需监测尿量与肌酸激酶。 With crush injury to both legs, urine output and creatine kinase were monitored.
他被墙压了半小时，挤压伤，先补液。 He was pinned by a wall for half an hour with crush injury, so start fluids first.
头皮撕脱伤需保留撕脱组织，随患者一同送手术室。 With an avulsion injury of the scalp, the avulsed tissue was kept and sent to operating room with the patient.
这块皮撕脱伤了，得连皮一起带到手术室。 This skin has an avulsion injury, so bring the tissue with us to the operating room.
现场止血以直接压迫为主，无效时改用止血带。 Field hemostasis relied mainly on direct pressure, with a tourniquet if that failed.
先止血，其他事等血止住再说。 Control the bleeding first; hemostasis comes before everything else.
对伤口行直接压迫十分钟后出血明显减少。 After ten minutes of direct pressure the bleeding from the wound decreased markedly.
别松手，直接压迫至少十分钟。 Do not let go; keep direct pressure on for at least ten minutes.
前臂出血先行指压止血，再改用加压包扎。 Digital pressure hemostasis was used for the forearm bleeding before a pressure dressing was applied.
手边没绷带，先用指压止血顶着。 No bandage at hand, so use digital pressure hemostasis for now.
四肢大出血经压迫无效时，应在伤口近端使用止血带。 When pressure fails in major limb bleeding, a tourniquet is applied proximal to the wound.
把止血带拿出来，绑在大腿根上。 Get the tourniquet out and put it high on the thigh.
止血带时间已超过一小时，转运途中需标记清楚。 The tourniquet time had passed one hour and was clearly marked during transfer.
止血带时间要写在他额头上，不然后面忘了。 Write the tourniquet time on his forehead so nobody forgets later.
到手术室后再行止血带松解，现场不得随意放松。 Tourniquet release was deferred until the operating room, and was not done in the field.
止血带松解要等外科到场，别自己松。 Tourniquet release waits for the surgeon, so do not loosen it yourself.
腹股沟伤口行填塞止血，纱布末端留于体表计数。 The groin wound was managed with wound packing, with the gauze ends left outside and counted.
这个伤口深，先填塞止血，纱布别忘拿出来。 This wound is deep, so pack it to stop the bleeding and remember to take the gauze out.
使用止血敷料后加压五分钟，出血基本停止。 After a hemostatic dressing and five minutes of pressure, the bleeding had almost stopped.
包里有止血敷料，赶紧拆开用上。 There is a hemostatic dressing in the bag, so open it and use it now.
术中细小出血点以电凝止血处理，无需缝扎。 Small bleeding points during surgery were managed with electrocautery rather than sutures.
这里渗血，电凝止血一下就好。 It is oozing here; a touch of electrocautery will do.
脾动脉活动性出血，行血管结扎后出血停止。 Active bleeding from the splenic artery stopped after vessel ligation.
这条血管结扎掉，不然一会儿又出血。 Ligate this vessel or it will bleed again shortly.
仔细寻找出血点，避免盲目钳夹造成神经损伤。 Look carefully for the bleeding point and avoid blind clamping that could injure a nerve.
出血点在这儿，你压准一点。 The bleeding point is here, so press exactly on it.
伤口见喷射性出血，考虑肱动脉损伤，立即加压。 Spurting bleeding from the wound suggested brachial artery injury, and pressure was applied at once.
血是喷出来的，喷射性出血，肯定是动脉。 The blood is spurting; that is spurting bleeding, so it must be arterial.
创面持续渗血，给予明胶海绵压迫。 The wound kept oozing, so a gelatin sponge and pressure were applied.
不严重，就是渗血，压一会儿就好。 It is not serious, just oozing; a few minutes of pressure will settle it.
颈部静脉出血，需警惕空气栓塞。 Venous bleeding in the neck raised concern about air embolism.
血色发暗，是静脉出血，还是得压住。 The blood is dark, so it is venous bleeding, but it still needs pressure.
股动脉出血量大，立即加压并通知外科。 Arterial bleeding from the femoral artery was heavy, so pressure was applied and surgery alerted.
动脉出血，按不住就上止血带。 For arterial bleeding, use a tourniquet if pressure will not hold.
创面毛细血管出血，局部压迫后已停止。 Capillary bleeding from the wound stopped after local pressure.
毛细血管出血不用紧张，纱布压一下就好。 Do not worry about capillary bleeding; a little gauze pressure will do.
右大腿血肿进行性增大，需排除活动性出血。 The right thigh hematoma was enlarging and active bleeding had to be excluded.
这里鼓了个血肿，摸着有点硬。 A hematoma has formed here and feels a little hard.
骨盆骨折合并大出血，立即启动大量输血方案。 Pelvic fracture with major hemorrhage triggered the massive transfusion protocol immediately.
这是大出血，别慢慢来，快叫人帮忙。 This is major hemorrhage, so do not go slowly; call for help now.
以止血钳夹住出血点，准备结扎。 The bleeding point was grasped with hemostatic forceps and prepared for ligation.
把止血钳递给我，先夹住再说。 Pass me the hemostatic forceps and clamp it first.
骨创面渗血处放置止血海绵后压迫。 A hemostatic sponge was placed on the oozing bone surface and pressed.
这个位置放块止血海绵，压一压。 Put a hemostatic sponge here and press it.
明胶海绵填塞后创面无明显继续渗血。 After gelatin sponge packing the wound showed no further significant oozing.
用明胶海绵压一下，比干纱布管用。 Press with a gelatin sponge; it works better than dry gauze.
创伤后三小时内给予氨甲环酸，可降低出血死亡风险。 Tranexamic acid given within three hours of trauma reduces the risk of death from bleeding.
氨甲环酸给了没有？伤后一小时最有效。 Has tranexamic acid been given? It works best within an hour of injury.
外院止血失败，转入时伤口仍在渗血。 Hemostasis failure at the referring hospital meant the wound was still oozing on arrival.
这边止血失败，赶紧叫外科上台。 Hemostasis has failed here, so call the surgeons in now.
术后六小时出现再出血，再次送手术室探查。 Rebleeding six hours after surgery led to another trip to the operating room.
血压一上来容易再出血，盯紧引流管。 Rebleeding is likely once pressure rises, so watch the drain closely.
创伤性出血是院前可预防死亡的首要原因。 Traumatic hemorrhage is the leading cause of preventable prehospital death.
创伤性出血止不住，人很快就没了，抓紧。 Traumatic hemorrhage that will not stop kills quickly, so move fast.
伤口加压包扎后出血停止，远端循环良好。 After the pressure dressing the bleeding stopped and distal circulation was good.
先加压包扎，包紧一点，但别把手指勒紫。 Apply a pressure dressing, firm but not so tight that the fingers turn blue.
伤口包扎完毕，敷料干燥无渗血。 Bandaging was completed and the dressing was dry with no oozing.
包扎好了，回家记得别沾水。 The bandaging is done; keep it dry when you get home.
以弹性绷带自远心端向近心端缠绕。 An elastic bandage was wrapped from distal to proximal.
再拿一卷绷带，这个不够长。 Bring another bandage; this one is not long enough.
踝关节扭伤后以弹性绷带加压包扎。 An elastic bandage was applied for compression after the ankle sprain.
用弹性绷带缠上，别缠太紧。 Wrap it with an elastic bandage, but not too tightly.
术后以加压绷带包扎，观察足趾颜色。 A compression bandage was applied after surgery and the toe color monitored.
加压绷带缠两层，松紧能塞进一根手指。 Wrap two layers of compression bandage, loose enough to slip one finger under.
以无菌纱布覆盖创面，外覆棉垫。 Sterile gauze was placed over the wound and covered with cotton padding.
给我几块纱布，这里还在渗。 Give me some gauze; it is still oozing here.
深部伤口以纱布卷填塞，末端留于体表计数。 The deep wound was packed with a gauze roll whose end was left outside and counted.
拿纱布卷来，这个洞得塞满。 Bring a gauze roll; this hole needs packing full.
清创后以无菌敷料覆盖，明日换药。 After debridement a sterile dressing was applied and a dressing change planned for tomorrow.
用无菌敷料盖，别拿纸巾碰伤口。 Use a sterile dressing; do not touch the wound with tissue paper.
胸部吸吮性伤口以封闭敷料覆盖三面固定。 The sucking chest wound was covered with an occlusive dressing taped on three sides.
这个伤口要用封闭敷料，普通纱布不行。 This wound needs an occlusive dressing; ordinary gauze will not do.
渗液较多的创面选用吸收敷料，每日更换。 An absorbent dressing was chosen for the heavily exuding wound and changed daily.
这个伤口水多，换吸收敷料吧。 This wound is very wet, so switch to an absorbent dressing.
术后第二天行敷料更换，创面干燥。 A dressing change was done on the second day after surgery and the wound was dry.
今天敷料更换，可能有点凉，忍一下。 It is time for the dressing change; it may feel cold for a moment.
敷料固定牢靠，边缘无卷起。 The dressing fixation was secure with no rolled edges.
敷料固定好一点，别一翻身就掉。 Fix the dressing properly so it does not fall off when he turns.
敷料浸透需立即更换并评估出血量。 A soaked dressing must be changed at once and blood loss assessed.
敷料浸透了，快看看是不是又出血。 The dressing is soaked, so check whether it is bleeding again.
腕部伤口以环形包扎固定敷料。 A circular bandage secured the dressing on the wrist wound.
先环形包扎两圈固定，再往上缠。 Start with two turns of circular bandage to anchor it, then wrap upwards.
前臂伤口采用螺旋包扎，松紧适宜。 A spiral bandage was used on the forearm wound with appropriate tension.
这种长伤口用螺旋包扎，一圈圈往上走。 For a long wound like this use a spiral bandage, working upward turn by turn.
踝部损伤以八字包扎固定，限制内翻。 A figure-of-eight bandage stabilized the ankle injury and limited inversion.
关节这里打八字包扎，活动能小一点。 Use a figure-of-eight bandage at the joint to limit movement.
以三角巾折叠成宽带包扎头部伤口。 A triangular bandage folded into a broad strip was used on the scalp wound.
把三角巾折一下，托住他的胳膊。 Fold the triangular bandage and support his arm with it.
锁骨骨折以三角巾悬吊患肢，减少活动。 A triangular sling supported the arm in the clavicle fracture and limited movement.
胳膊用三角巾悬吊起来，别乱动。 Put the arm in a triangular sling and keep it still.
指尖小裂口以创可贴保护即可。 A small fingertip laceration was simply covered with an adhesive bandage.
这点小口子贴个创可贴就行。 A small cut like this just needs an adhesive bandage.
以医用胶带将敷料边缘固定于皮肤。 The edges of the dressing were secured to the skin with medical tape.
用医用胶带贴一下，别让敷料滑下来。 Put some medical tape on so the dressing does not slip.
腹部术后使用腹带，咳嗽时用手按压伤口。 An abdominal binder was used after surgery, with hand pressure on the wound when coughing.
咳嗽的时候用腹带兜着，会舒服点。 Wearing the abdominal binder when you cough should make it more comfortable.
伤口渗液量少、色淡黄，无明显异味。 The wound exudate was scanty and pale yellow with no offensive odor.
伤口渗液有点多，敷料一天就湿了。 There is a fair amount of wound exudate; the dressing is soaked within a day.
伤口覆盖前需确认创面无活动性出血。 Before wound coverage, active bleeding must be excluded.
伤口覆盖先别做，等医生看完再说。 Hold off on wound coverage until the doctor has looked at it.
伤口敷料干燥，没有渗血也没有渗液。 The dressing was dry with no oozing or exudate.
敷料脏了就换，别一直贴着。 Change the dressing once it is dirty; do not leave it on.
骨折固定前先评估远端血运与感觉。 Distal perfusion and sensation were assessed before fracture immobilization.
先做骨折固定，别让骨头来回晃。 Do the fracture immobilization first; do not let the bone move about.
以夹板固定小腿，长度需超过骨折上下关节。 The lower leg was held with a splint long enough to cross the joints above and below the fracture.
找块夹板来，先把他小腿固定住。 Find a splint and immobilize his lower leg first.
石膏固定后六小时内有肿胀加重风险。 There is a risk of increasing swelling in the six hours after a cast is applied.
石膏刚打上，先别用这条腿踩地。 The cast has just been applied, so do not put weight on it.
桡骨远端骨折行石膏固定，患肢抬高。 The distal radius fracture had plaster immobilization and the limb was elevated.
这个位置石膏固定四周，下周来复查。 This needs plaster immobilization for four weeks, so come back next week for review.
腕部以石膏托固定，绷带松松缠绕。 A plaster splint was applied to the wrist and wrapped loosely with a bandage.
先用石膏托，肿消了再换正式的。 Use a plaster splint for now and change to a proper cast when the swelling settles.
股骨骨折行皮牵引，重量五公斤。 Skin traction was applied for the femoral fracture with a five-kilogram weight.
给上牵引，把腿拉直一点。 Put traction on and straighten the leg a little.
胫骨结节骨牵引后疼痛明显缓解。 Pain eased markedly after skeletal traction through the tibial tuberosity.
骨牵引要打钢针，先跟家属说清楚。 Skeletal traction needs a metal pin, so explain it to the family first.
皮肤牵引不超过两周，需检查皮肤有无水疱。 Skin traction is limited to two weeks and the skin must be checked for blisters.
皮肤牵引舒服些，但拉不了太重。 Skin traction is more comfortable but cannot pull much weight.
骨盆固定带置于大转子水平，勿压在腹部。 The pelvic binder was placed at the level of the greater trochanters, not over the abdomen.
骨盆固定带绑上，位置到大转子。 Put the pelvic binder on, down to the greater trochanters.
前臂吊带固定后手指活动良好。 With the arm sling in place, finger movement was normal.
胳膊挂前臂吊带，别拎东西。 Keep the arm in an arm sling and do not carry anything.
托马斯夹板固定后患肢疼痛减轻。 Pain in the injured limb lessened after application of the Thomas splint.
上托马斯夹板，把大腿拉直。 Apply the Thomas splint and straighten the thigh.
真空夹板适用于多发伤患者的快速固定。 The vacuum splint is useful for rapid immobilization in polytrauma.
真空夹板抽一下气就硬了，很快。 The vacuum splint hardens as soon as the air is drawn out, which is quick.
充气夹板压力不宜过高，以免影响血运。 Air splint pressure should not be too high, or perfusion may be impaired.

浸润麻醉沿伤口边缘分层注射。 Infiltration anesthesia was injected in layers along the wound edges.
浸润麻醉打一圈，伤口就不疼了。 Infiltrate all around with infiltration anesthesia and the wound will stop hurting.
伤口感染需拆开部分缝线引流并抗感染。 Wound infection required opening part of the suture line for drainage and antibiotics.
伤口感染了，得把线拆开一点引流。 The wound infection means opening the stitches a little to drain it.
伤口裂开需重新清创并延期缝合。 Wound dehiscence requires repeat debridement and delayed closure.
伤口裂开了，先别急着重缝。 The wound dehiscence means do not rush to close it again.
伤口愈合不良需排查感染与营养状况。 Poor wound healing requires checking for infection and nutrition.
伤口愈合要忌口吗？正常吃饭就行。 Does wound healing need dietary restrictions? Eating normally is fine.
一期缝合适用于污染轻、伤后时间短的伤口。 Primary closure suits wounds with little contamination and a short delay.
这个伤口干净，可以做一期缝合。 This wound is clean, so primary closure can be done.
污染重的伤口行延期缝合更安全。 Delayed primary closure is safer for heavily contaminated wounds.
先敞开引流，过几天再做延期缝合。 Leave it open to drain and do a delayed primary closure in a few days.
伤口引流条放置二十四到四十八小时。 The wound drainage strip is left in place for twenty-four to forty-eight hours.
伤口引流放一根，明天看情况拔。 Put in a wound drain and decide about removal tomorrow.
引流条需记录数量，拔除时核对完整。 Drainage strips are counted and checked intact on removal.
引流条别塞太紧，不然引流不畅。 Do not pack the drainage strip too tightly or it will not drain.
污染伤口需彻底清创并延期缝合。 A contaminated wound needs thorough debridement and delayed closure.
这是污染伤口，不能马上缝。 This is a contaminated wound and cannot be closed immediately.
撕裂伤需修整皮缘后缝合。 A laceration is closed after the skin edges are trimmed.
撕裂伤边缘不齐，得修剪一下再缝。 The laceration edges are irregular and need trimming before suturing.
缝线粗细根据部位与张力选择。 Suture size is chosen according to site and tension.
缝线打结要牢固，别让它松开。 Tie the suture securely so it does not loosen.
缝合针持针时需与持针器垂直。 The suture needle is held at right angles in the needle holder.
缝合针别乱放，容易扎到人。 Do not leave the suture needle lying about; it can prick someone.
持针器夹住缝合针中后三分之一处。 The needle holder grips the suture needle at its middle to posterior third.
把持针器给我，我来缝这一针。 Pass me the needle holder and I will place this stitch.
破伤风可表现为牙关紧闭与角弓反张。 Tetanus may present with trismus and opisthotonos.
伤口脏就要想到破伤风，疫苗打了没有？ A dirty wound raises the question of tetanus; has he been vaccinated?
破伤风梭菌芽孢可在土壤中存活多年。 Spores of Clostridium tetani can survive in soil for years.
破伤风梭菌在缺氧的深伤口里容易繁殖。 Clostridium tetani multiplies readily in deep oxygen-poor wounds.
破伤风抗毒素注射前需做皮试。 A skin test is required before tetanus antitoxin is given.
破伤风抗毒素要先皮试，别直接打。 Tetanus antitoxin needs a skin test first; do not give it directly.
伤口污染重者优选破伤风免疫球蛋白。 Tetanus immunoglobulin is preferred for heavily contaminated wounds.
破伤风免疫球蛋白不用皮试，直接打。 Tetanus immunoglobulin needs no skin test and is given directly.
破伤风类毒素是百白破疫苗的组成成分。 Tetanus toxoid is a component of the DTP vaccine.
小时候打的针里有破伤风类毒素，能管很多年。 The shots you had as a child contained tetanus toxoid and protect for years.
破伤风疫苗接种后局部可有红肿疼痛。 Tetanus vaccine may cause local redness and pain after injection.
破伤风疫苗十年加强一次。 Tetanus vaccine is boosted every ten years.
破伤风预防需结合伤口类型与接种史。 Tetanus prophylaxis depends on wound type and vaccination history.
破伤风预防不是每个伤口都要打针，看情况。 Tetanus prophylaxis is not needed for every wound; it depends on the case.
主动免疫保护时间长，需数周才起效。 Active immunization gives long-lasting protection but takes weeks to work.
打疫苗属于主动免疫，管得久。 Vaccination is active immunization and protects for a long time.
被动免疫起效快，但保护只维持数周。 Passive immunization acts quickly but lasts only a few weeks.
打免疫球蛋白是被动免疫，马上有用。 Immunoglobulin gives passive immunization that works immediately.
儿童期完成基础免疫，成年后定期加强。 Primary immunization is completed in childhood with periodic boosters later.
基础免疫没打全，受伤后要补。 If primary immunization was incomplete, it must be completed after injury.
破伤风每十年加强免疫一次。 Booster immunization for tetanus is given every ten years.
加强免疫这一针别忘了，十年一次。 Do not forget the booster immunization, once every ten years.
疫苗接种史不详者按未完成接种处理。 When the vaccination history is unknown, the patient is treated as incompletely vaccinated.
您记得疫苗接种史吗？小时候打过几针？ Do you remember your vaccination history, how many shots as a child?
免疫接种记录需与患者自述核对。 The immunization record is checked against what the patient reports.
免疫接种记录带来没有？手机里也行。 Do you have the immunization record? A phone copy is fine.
伤口污染程度重者需延期缝合并加强抗感染。 Heavily contaminated wounds need delayed closure and stronger antibiotic cover.
先看伤口污染程度，再决定缝不缝。 Assess the wound contamination level first, then decide about closure.
清洁伤口可立即缝合，无需预防性抗生素。 A clean wound can be sutured at once without prophylactic antibiotics.
这是清洁伤口，缝完就能回家。 This is a clean wound, so you can go home after suturing.
破伤风皮试观察二十分钟看有无红肿。 The tetanus skin test is read after twenty minutes for redness and swelling.
破伤风皮试阴性才能打全量。 Only after a negative tetanus skin test can the full dose be given.
牙关紧闭是破伤风最常见的早期表现。 Trismus is the most common early sign of tetanus.
他牙关紧闭，嘴都张不开。 He has trismus and cannot open his mouth.
角弓反张提示破伤风已进入发作期。 Opisthotonos indicates that tetanus has entered the spasmodic phase.
看到角弓反张，基本就是破伤风了。 Opisthotonos like this is almost certainly tetanus.
苦笑面容与牙关紧闭常同时出现。 Risus sardonicus often accompanies trismus.
他脸上那个苦笑面容，是破伤风的典型表现。 That risus sardonicus is typical of tetanus.
肌肉强直从咀嚼肌开始逐渐波及全身。 Muscle rigidity starts in the jaw muscles and spreads over the body.
全身肌肉强直，碰一下就抽。 There is whole-body muscle rigidity and any touch triggers spasms.
轻微刺激即可诱发肌痉挛，需安静避光。 Even slight stimuli can trigger muscle spasm, so a quiet dark room is needed.
别大声说话，会诱发肌痉挛。 Do not speak loudly; it may trigger muscle spasm.
接种禁忌证排除后再补种疫苗。 Vaccination is given once contraindications to vaccination are excluded.
有接种禁忌证就先不打，等好了再说。 If there is a contraindication to vaccination, wait until it resolves.
免疫状态评估后决定是否需补种疫苗。 Immune status assessment determines whether extra vaccine doses are needed.
先做免疫状态评估，别盲目加打。 Do an immune status assessment first; do not just add shots.
破伤风发作后需进监护室并保持环境安静。 After tetanus onset the patient needs intensive care in a quiet environment.
破伤风发作起来很痛苦，得镇静。 Tetanus onset is very distressing, so sedation is needed.
破伤风抗体水平低者需加强接种。 Those with low tetanus antibody levels need a booster.
查一下破伤风抗体，看看还要不要打。 Check the tetanus antibody to see whether another dose is needed.
手术知情同意需由患者本人签署。 Informed consent for surgery should be signed by the patient in person.
手术知情同意我给您讲清楚，您再决定签不签。 I will explain the informed consent for surgery, then you decide whether to sign.
手术同意书需写明术式与主要并发症。 The surgical consent form states the procedure and main complications.
手术同意书您先看一遍，有不懂的问我。 Read the surgical consent form and ask me about anything unclear.
术前谈话记录需双方签字归档。 The preoperative discussion is recorded and signed by both parties.
术前谈话大概二十分钟，家属最好都来。 The preoperative discussion takes about twenty minutes; it is best if the family all come.
手术风险告知需包括出血、感染与麻醉风险。 Disclosure of surgical risks covers bleeding, infection and anesthesia risks.
手术风险告知不是吓您，是让您有准备。 Disclosure of surgical risks is not meant to frighten you but to prepare you.
该患者有明确的手术指征，应尽早安排。 The patient has a clear surgical indication and should be scheduled early.
手术指征明确，拖下去只会更危险。 The surgical indication is clear and delay only adds risk.
手术禁忌证排除后方可安排择期手术。 Elective surgery is arranged only after contraindications to surgery are excluded.
有手术禁忌证就先保守治疗。 If there is a contraindication to surgery, treat conservatively first.
手术方案经全科讨论后确定。 The surgical plan was settled after a departmental discussion.
手术方案有两套，先讲第一套。 There are two surgical plans; I will explain the first.
术式选择需兼顾根治效果与功能保留。 The choice of surgical procedure balances cure and preservation of function.
术式选择我们倾向创伤小的那种。 For the choice of surgical procedure we favor the less invasive option.
麻醉方式由麻醉医师评估后决定。 The anesthesia type is decided by the anesthesiologist after assessment.
麻醉方式有两种，全麻或半麻，都可以。 There are two anesthesia types, general or regional, and both are possible.
全身麻醉需术前禁食并评估气道。 General anesthesia requires preoperative fasting and airway assessment.
全身麻醉就是睡一觉，醒来手术就做完了。 General anesthesia is like sleeping; you wake up when the operation is over.
区域麻醉患者保持清醒，但手术部位无痛。 With regional anesthesia the patient stays awake but feels no pain in the operative area.
区域麻醉下半身没感觉，人是清醒的。 With regional anesthesia the lower body is numb but you stay awake.
麻醉风险需在术前访视时充分告知。 Anesthesia risk is fully explained during the preoperative visit.
麻醉风险不大，但签字是必经流程。 The anesthesia risk is low, but signing is a required step.
术前禁食一般要求固体八小时、清饮两小时。 Preoperative fasting usually means eight hours for solids and two hours for clear fluids.
术前禁食别忘了，偷吃东西手术要推迟。 Do not forget preoperative fasting; eating would delay the operation.
术前准备包括备血与抗生素皮试。 Preoperative preparation includes blood crossmatching and antibiotic skin testing.
术前准备都做完了，就等手术台。 Preoperative preparation is complete; we are just waiting for the operating room.
术后护理需观察伤口渗血与引流液性状。 Postoperative care involves watching the wound for bleeding and checking drain fluid.
术后护理家属也要学，回家才知道怎么做。 The family should learn postoperative care to manage at home.
术后并发症以出血与感染最常见。 The most common postoperative complications are bleeding and infection.
术后并发症发现了要早处理，别等严重。 Postoperative complications must be treated early, not when severe.
手术并发症包括神经损伤与切口裂开。 Surgical complications include nerve injury and wound dehiscence.
手术并发症概率不高，但发生了我们会处理。 Surgical complications are uncommon, but we will manage them if they occur.
二次手术风险高于首次，需重新评估。 Reoperation carries higher risk than the first operation and needs reassessment.
如果出血止不住，可能要做二次手术。 If the bleeding cannot be stopped, a reoperation may be needed.
急诊手术需在最短时间内完成术前准备。 Emergency surgery requires preoperative preparation in the shortest possible time.
这是急诊手术，签字后马上进手术室。 This is emergency surgery, so sign and go to the operating room at once.
择期手术前需完善检查并控制基础病。 Elective surgery requires completed tests and control of underlying disease.
择期手术不急，先把血压血糖调好。 Elective surgery is not urgent; control the blood pressure and glucose first.
替代治疗方案包括保守观察与介入治疗。 Alternative treatment options include conservative observation and interventional treatment.
替代治疗方案我也讲了，您可以比较后再定。 I have also explained the alternative treatment options, so compare them before deciding.
手术获益与风险需权衡后决定。 Surgical benefit must be weighed against risk before deciding.
手术获益明显大于风险，我们建议做。 The surgical benefit clearly outweighs the risk, so we recommend it.
该手术成功率约百分之九十。 The surgical success rate for this operation is about ninety percent.
手术成功率不是保证，个体情况还有差别。 The surgical success rate is not a guarantee; individual cases differ.
术前评估提示患者可耐受全身麻醉。 The preoperative assessment indicated the patient could tolerate general anesthesia.
术前评估要两三天，结果出来才能定手术。 Preoperative assessment takes two or three days and the operation is scheduled after the results.
术前核查由手术、麻醉与护理三方共同完成。 The surgical safety checklist is completed jointly by surgery, anesthesia and nursing.
术前核查走一遍，确认是哪条腿。 Run through the surgical safety checklist and confirm which leg it is.
患者主诉胸痛两小时，伴大汗和恶心，立即送入抢救室。 The patient reports chest pain for two hours with sweating and nausea and was moved to the resuscitation room.
您这个胸痛是什么时候开始的，是一直疼还是一阵一阵地疼？ When did your chest pain start, and is it constant or does it come and go?
他一爬楼梯就心绞痛发作，含服硝酸甘油两分钟就缓解了。 His angina pectoris is triggered by climbing stairs and eases within two minutes of sublingual nitroglycerin.
医生追问他心绞痛一般持续几分钟，会不会放射到左肩。 The doctor asked how long each angina pectoris episode lasts and whether it radiates to the left shoulder.
心电图和肌钙蛋白都支持急性心肌梗死，马上启动导管室。 Both the ECG and troponin support acute myocardial infarction, so the catheterization lab was activated at once.
家属担心急性心肌梗死要不要马上开刀，医生先解释了介入方案。 The family worried whether acute myocardial infarction needs immediate surgery, so the doctor explained the interventional option first.
心电图提示ST段抬高型心肌梗死，十分钟内完成溶栓知情谈话。 The ECG showed ST-elevation myocardial infarction, and the thrombolysis consent talk was finished within ten minutes.
确诊ST段抬高型心肌梗死以后，我们直接送您去做冠脉造影。 Once ST-elevation myocardial infarction is confirmed, we will take you straight to coronary angiography.
肌钙蛋白升高而心电图不抬高，考虑非ST段抬高型心肌梗死，先收观察室。 With raised troponin and no ST elevation, non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction was considered, and the patient was kept in the observation unit.
护士提醒非ST段抬高型心肌梗死也要按急性冠脉综合征流程处理。 The nurse reminded the team that non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction is also managed along the acute coronary syndrome pathway.
凡疑诊急性冠脉综合征，到院十分钟内必须完成首份心电图。 For any suspected acute coronary syndrome, a first ECG must be completed within ten minutes of arrival.
医生跟他解释，急性冠脉综合征要抽血看肌钙蛋白才能分清类型。 The doctor explained that acute coronary syndrome needs blood tests for troponin before the type can be identified.
胸痛患者到院第一件事就是做心电图，不能先排队挂号。 The first thing a chest pain patient needs on arrival is an ECG, before any registration queue.
您别紧张，心电图不疼，几分钟就做完，结果马上给医生看。 Do not worry, the ECG is painless and takes a few minutes, and the result goes straight to the doctor.
抽血查肌钙蛋白需要一小时出结果，期间患者不能离院。 The troponin blood test takes an hour, and the patient must not leave the department meanwhile.
医生说他肌钙蛋白阴性也不能马上回家，要复查一次。 The doctor said a negative troponin does not mean he can go home at once and that it must be repeated.
冠状动脉造影安排在明天上午，术前需要空腹并停用部分药物。 Coronary angiography is scheduled for tomorrow morning, and the patient must fast and hold some medications beforehand.
家属问冠状动脉造影风险大不大，医生说明了穿刺出血和造影剂过敏的可能。 The family asked how risky coronary angiography is, and the doctor described bleeding at the puncture site and possible contrast allergy.

zh: 经皮冠状动脉介入治疗
text: 经皮冠状动脉介入治疗在发病两小时内完成，患者胸痛明显缓解。 Percutaneous coronary intervention was completed within two hours of onset, and the chest pain eased markedly.

zh: 经皮冠状动脉介入治疗
text: 医生建议先做经皮冠状动脉介入治疗，比单纯吃药开通血管更彻底。 The doctor recommended percutaneous coronary intervention first, which opens the vessel more reliably than drugs alone.
当地医院没有介入条件，先给溶栓治疗再转院。 The local hospital had no catheterization service, so thrombolytic therapy was given before transfer.
医生交代溶栓治疗最大的风险是出血，出现头痛要立刻报告。 The doctor warned that the main risk of thrombolytic therapy is bleeding and that headache must be reported at once.
疑诊心梗先嚼服阿司匹林三百毫克，除非有过敏或活动性出血。 Chewable aspirin three hundred milligrams is given first in suspected myocardial infarction unless allergy or active bleeding exists.
护士问他对阿司匹林有没有过敏，以前吃过后有没有胃出血。 The nurse asked whether he is allergic to aspirin and whether it ever caused stomach bleeding.
血压允许的话先舌下含服硝酸甘油，五分钟不缓解再含一片。 If blood pressure allows, give sublingual nitroglycerin and repeat once after five minutes without relief.
含硝酸甘油后他头晕得厉害，护士马上量了血压并让他平卧。 He felt very dizzy after nitroglycerin, so the nurse checked his blood pressure and laid him flat.
突发撕裂样胸背痛要警惕主动脉夹层，先做增强CT。 Sudden tearing chest and back pain should raise suspicion of aortic dissection, so contrast CT came first.
确诊主动脉夹层后不能再用抗凝药，要马上联系血管外科。 Once aortic dissection is confirmed, anticoagulants must be stopped and vascular surgery called immediately.
术后长期卧床的患者突发呼吸困难，要想到肺栓塞。 Sudden dyspnea in a patient bedridden after surgery should prompt suspicion of pulmonary embolism.
CT肺动脉造影确诊肺栓塞后，立即开始抗凝治疗。 After CT pulmonary angiography confirmed pulmonary embolism, anticoagulation was started at once.
这小伙子胸痛在平卧时加重、坐起来前倾就减轻，很像心包炎。 This young man's chest pain worsens when lying flat and eases when he sits forward, which fits pericarditis.
心包炎复查心脏超声是为了看有没有心包积液。 Echocardiography is repeated in pericarditis to look for pericardial effusion.
超声发现中量心包积液，患者暂无心包填塞表现。 Ultrasound found a moderate pericardial effusion without signs of tamponade for now.
复查超声看心包积液有没有增多。 Repeat the ultrasound to see whether the pericardial effusion has increased.
急性胸痛患者一律优先做心电图。 Every patient with acute chest pain gets an ECG first.
您这种急性胸痛不能自己走回家，要留观。 With acute chest pain like this you cannot walk home alone and need observation.
他说的放射痛一直到左手臂内侧和小指。 He described radiating pain that reached the inner left arm and little finger.
有没有放射痛、放射到哪里，对判断胸痛原因很关键。 Whether there is radiating pain and where it travels is key to judging the cause of chest pain.
他说是压榨性胸痛，像有块石头压在胸口，喘不上气。 He described crushing chest pain, like a stone on his chest that made it hard to breathe.
典型压榨性胸痛超过二十分钟不缓解，要按心梗处理。 Typical crushing chest pain lasting over twenty minutes without relief should be managed as myocardial infarction.
动态心电图抓到一次心肌缺血，正好和他胸痛的时间对得上。 Ambulatory ECG captured one episode of myocardial ischemia that matched the timing of his chest pain.
心肌缺血不一定疼，糖尿病患者可能只表现为气短乏力。 Myocardial ischemia is not always painful, and diabetic patients may only report breathlessness and fatigue.
他常在后半夜出现冠状动脉痉挛，白天造影却是正常的。 His coronary artery spasm usually occurs after midnight, while daytime angiography looks normal.
医生加了钙通道阻滞剂来预防冠状动脉痉挛再发作。 The doctor added a calcium channel blocker to prevent another coronary artery spasm.
大面积心梗后出现心源性休克，需要升压药和紧急再灌注。 Cardiogenic shock after a large myocardial infarction requires vasopressors and urgent reperfusion.
护士发现他四肢湿冷、尿量减少，提醒医生警惕心源性休克。 The nurse found his limbs cold and urine output low and warned the doctor to watch for cardiogenic shock.
他这两天休息时也犯病，属于不稳定型心绞痛，不能回家。 His pain now comes at rest, which is unstable angina, so he cannot go home.
不稳定型心绞痛要按急性冠脉综合征处理，抽血查肌钙蛋白。 Unstable angina is managed as acute coronary syndrome with blood tests for troponin.
老人说不清疼，只说心前区不适，我们照样给他做了心电图。 The elderly man could not describe pain and only reported precordial discomfort, so we did an ECG anyway.
心前区不适伴出冷汗，即使不疼也要当心梗筛查。 Precordial discomfort with cold sweats still warrants myocardial infarction screening even without pain.
急诊胸痛先做危险分层，低危的才能进观察室随访。 Chest pain in the emergency department is first risk stratified, and only low-risk patients go to observation.
危险分层为高危的患者，我们不建议离院观察。 For patients whose risk stratification is high, we do not advise observation at home.
支架植入后要规范双联抗血小板治疗，不能自己停药。 After stent placement, dual antiplatelet therapy must be taken as prescribed and never stopped on one's own.
医生交代双联抗血小板治疗期间出现黑便要马上回来。 The doctor warned that black stools during dual antiplatelet therapy require an immediate return visit.

zh: 房室结折返性心动过速
text: 房室结折返性心动过速突发突止，心率可达一百八。 Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia starts and stops abruptly and the rate can reach one hundred eighty.

zh: 房室结折返性心动过速
text: 她反复房室结折返性心动过速，建议做射频消融。 She has recurrent atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia, so ablation was advised.
心电图是心房颤动，心室率一百四十次，先控制心率。 The ECG showed atrial fibrillation with a ventricular rate of one hundred forty, so rate control came first.
心房颤动最大的危险是脑卒中，需要评估要不要长期抗凝。 The main danger of atrial fibrillation is stroke, so it must be assessed for long-term anticoagulation.
心房扑动的心电图有典型锯齿波，心室率常是成比例的。 Atrial flutter shows classic sawtooth waves, and the ventricular rate is often a fixed proportion.
医生用药物控制心房扑动没成功，改成电复律。 Drugs failed to control the atrial flutter, so electrical cardioversion was used instead.
监护提示室性心动过速，患者意识还在，准备同步电复律。 The monitor showed ventricular tachycardia with the patient still conscious, so synchronized cardioversion was prepared.
无脉性室性心动过速按心脏骤停处理，立即开始按压。 Pulseless ventricular tachycardia is managed as cardiac arrest with immediate chest compressions.
心电监护见尖端扭转型室速，立即静脉补镁。 The monitor showed torsades de pointes, so intravenous magnesium was given at once.
低钾会诱发尖端扭转型室速，先把钾补上来。 Low potassium can trigger torsades de pointes, so potassium was corrected first.
她突发室上性心动过速，心率一百八，先试迷走神经刺激。 She had sudden supraventricular tachycardia at a rate of one hundred eighty, so vagal maneuvers were tried first.
室上性心动过速多数血流动力学稳定，可以先用药物转复。 Most supraventricular tachycardia is hemodynamically stable and can be converted with drugs first.
他是窦性心动过缓，心率四十八次，但没有头晕就暂时观察。 He has sinus bradycardia at forty eight beats per minute, but without dizziness it is simply observed.
运动员的窦性心动过缓多半是生理性的，不用紧张。 Sinus bradycardia in athletes is mostly physiological and no cause for alarm.
窦性心动过速只是表现，要找发热、疼痛还是失血的原因。 Sinus tachycardia is only a sign, so look for fever, pain, or blood loss as the cause.
补液后他的窦性心动过速慢慢降下来了。 His sinus tachycardia gradually settled after fluid replacement.
动态心电图报告偶发室性期前收缩，一天不到一百次。 The ambulatory ECG reported infrequent premature ventricular contractions, fewer than one hundred a day.
频发室性期前收缩要查电解质和心脏结构。 Frequent premature ventricular contractions warrant checks of electrolytes and cardiac structure.
她说心慌像漏跳一下，心电图是房性期前收缩。 She described her palpitations as a skipped beat, and the ECG showed premature atrial contractions.
少喝浓茶和咖啡，房性期前收缩往往就少了。 Cutting back on strong tea and coffee usually reduces premature atrial contractions.
他是二度房室传导阻滞，心率掉到四十次时眼前发黑。 He has second-degree atrioventricular block and blacked out when the rate dropped to forty.
三度房室传导阻滞要尽快装临时起搏器。 Third-degree atrioventricular block needs a temporary pacemaker as soon as possible.
病态窦房结综合征的患者反复晕倒，最终装了永久起搏器。 The patient with sick sinus syndrome kept fainting and eventually received a permanent pacemaker.
动态心电图发现五秒长间歇，支持病态窦房结综合征。 Ambulatory ECG found a five-second pause, supporting sick sinus syndrome.
心电图看到预激波，诊断预激综合征，建议做射频消融。 A delta wave on the ECG led to a diagnosis of pre-excitation syndrome and a recommendation for radiofrequency ablation.
预激综合征合并房颤时不能用某些房室结药物。 Some atrioventricular node blockers must be avoided when pre-excitation syndrome coexists with atrial fibrillation.
房颤持续时间不长，今天安排电复律，术前要镇静。 The atrial fibrillation is recent, so electrical cardioversion is scheduled today with sedation.
电复律后要连续监护几小时，看心律会不会再变。 After electrical cardioversion the rhythm is monitored for several hours in case it changes again.
医生选了静脉抗心律失常药物，同时监测血压和心电图。 The doctor chose an intravenous antiarrhythmic drug while monitoring blood pressure and ECG.
抗心律失常药物本身也可能致心律失常，用药后要复查心电图。 Antiarhythmic drugs can themselves trigger arrhythmia, so the ECG is repeated after dosing.
动态心电图要背一天，洗澡时取下来，不舒服随时记录时间。 Holter monitoring lasts a full day; take it off for showers and note the time of any symptoms.
普通心电图正常但症状反复，最好做一次动态心电图。 If the resting ECG is normal but symptoms recur, Holter monitoring is the better test.
他的室上速反复发作，做了射频消融后半年没再犯。 After repeated supraventricular tachycardia he underwent radiofrequency ablation and has had no attacks for six months.
射频消融前要做电生理检查，把病灶位置定下来。 An electrophysiological study is done before radiofrequency ablation to localize the target.
心率只有三十几次，医生建议装人工心脏起搏器。 With a rate of only about thirty, the doctor advised implanting a pacemaker.
装上人工心脏起搏器后，过安检门要提前告诉工作人员。 After a pacemaker is fitted, tell security staff before walking through metal detectors.

zh: 植入式心律转复除颤器
text: 他有家族猝死史，医生建议植入式心律转复除颤器预防猝死。 With a family history of sudden death, the doctor advised an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator.

zh: 植入式心律转复除颤器
text: 植入式心律转复除颤器放电时患者会觉得胸口被重重一击。 When an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator fires, the patient feels a heavy blow to the chest.
QT间期五百二十毫秒，要注意药物影响。 The QT interval was five hundred twenty milliseconds, so drug effects were reviewed.
用这类药要监测QT间期，别和别的延长药一起用。 Monitor the QT interval with these drugs and avoid combining them with other prolonging agents.
心电图呈左束支传导阻滞，要结合症状判断是不是新发的。 The ECG showed left bundle branch block, and symptoms help decide whether it is new.
新发左束支传导阻滞伴胸痛，按急性心梗处理。 New left bundle branch block with chest pain is managed as acute myocardial infarction.
他主诉心悸伴出汗，先做心电图排除快速心律失常。 He reported palpitations with sweating, so an ECG was done first to exclude a rapid arrhythmia.
心悸不一定是心脏病，甲亢和贫血也会引起。 Palpitations do not always mean heart disease, since hyperthyroidism and anemia can cause them too.
年轻女孩反复晕倒，心电图提示长QT综合征。 A young girl kept fainting, and the ECG suggested long QT syndrome.
长QT综合征患者要避免用延长QT间期的药物。 Patients with long QT syndrome must avoid drugs that prolong the QT interval.
他晕倒时面色苍白、几秒钟就醒了，符合阿斯综合征。 He went pale and woke within seconds after fainting, which fits Adams-Stokes syndrome.
阿斯综合征一确诊就要评估起搏器指征。 Once Adams-Stokes syndrome is diagnosed, pacing indications must be assessed.
心衰合并左束支阻滞，评估心脏再同步治疗指征。 Heart failure with left bundle branch block prompted assessment for cardiac resynchronization therapy.
装了心脏再同步治疗以后，他走路没那么喘了。 After cardiac resynchronization therapy he was less breathless when walking.
先教他做迷走神经刺激，屏气用力像解大便那样。 First teach him a vagal maneuver: hold the breath and strain as if passing stool.
迷走神经刺激无效，改用静脉药物转复心律。 The vagal maneuver failed, so intravenous drugs were used to restore the rhythm.
急性缺血时容易出现室性心律失常，要持续监护。 Ventricular arrhythmia is common during acute ischemia and requires continuous monitoring.
这类室性心律失常要考虑装除颤器，光吃药不够。 This kind of ventricular arrhythmia calls for a defibrillator, and drugs alone are not enough.
怀疑脑卒中要在到院十分钟内完成评估并启动卒中流程。 Suspected stroke must be assessed within ten minutes of arrival and the stroke pathway activated.
家属说他早上还好好的，突然就脑卒中了，说话也不清楚。 His family said he was fine in the morning and then suddenly had a stroke and could not speak clearly.
八成脑卒中属于缺血性脑卒中，时间窗内可以溶栓。 About eighty percent of strokes are ischemic stroke, which can be thrombolysed within the time window.
缺血性脑卒中患者到院要先做头颅CT排除出血。 Patients with ischemic stroke need a head CT first to exclude hemorrhage.
头颅CT看到高密度影，诊断出血性脑卒中，不能溶栓。 The head CT showed a hyperdense lesion, so hemorrhagic stroke was diagnosed and thrombolysis withheld.
出血性脑卒中首要处理是控制血压和降低颅内压。 Managing hemorrhagic stroke starts with blood pressure control and lowering intracranial pressure.
症状一小时就完全恢复了，医生说是短暂性脑缺血发作，仍要住院查原因。 The symptoms resolved within an hour, and although the doctor called it a transient ischemic attack, admission for workup was still advised.
短暂性脑缺血发作是脑卒中的警报，不能因为好了就回家。 A transient ischemic attack is a warning of stroke and must not be dismissed just because symptoms resolved.
基底节区脑出血三十毫升，神经外科会诊考虑是否手术。 There was a thirty-milliliter intracerebral hemorrhage in the basal ganglia, and neurosurgery was consulted about surgery.
脑出血患者躁动明显，先镇静并控制血压。 The patient with intracerebral hemorrhage was very agitated, so sedation and blood pressure control came first.
产后头痛伴视物模糊，MRV确诊脑静脉窦血栓形成。 Postpartum headache with blurred vision was diagnosed as cerebral venous sinus thrombosis on MRV.
脑静脉窦血栓形成要尽早抗凝，即使有少量出血。 Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis is anticoagulated early even when there is minor hemorrhage.
CT上左侧颞叶见低密度灶，符合脑梗死。 CT showed a low-density lesion in the left temporal lobe consistent with cerebral infarction.
脑梗死的范围越大，脑水肿和脑疝的风险越高。 The larger the cerebral infarction, the higher the risk of cerebral edema and herniation.
他还在溶栓时间窗内，马上抽血并联系家属签字。 He is still within the thrombolytic time window, so bloods were drawn and the family called for consent.
超过溶栓时间窗就只能评估取栓或保守治疗。 Beyond the thrombolytic time window, only thrombectomy or conservative care can be considered.
静脉溶栓前必须排除近期手术、出血和血压过高。 Before intravenous thrombolysis, recent surgery, bleeding, and very high blood pressure must be excluded.
静脉溶栓后每十五分钟评估一次神经功能。 After intravenous thrombolysis, neurological status is assessed every fifteen minutes.
大血管闭塞的患者做了机械取栓，术后肌力从零级恢复到三级。 The patient with large-vessel occlusion underwent mechanical thrombectomy and improved from grade zero to grade three power.
机械取栓的时间窗比静脉溶栓宽，但越早越好。 The window for mechanical thrombectomy is wider than for thrombolysis, but earlier is still better.
房颤患者突发偏瘫，考虑脑栓塞。 Sudden hemiplegia in a patient with atrial fibrillation suggested cerebral embolism.
脑栓塞的梗死灶常多发，与栓子来源一致。 Infarcts in cerebral embolism are often multiple and fit the embolic source.
住进卒中单元以后，康复师第二天就来评估吞咽和肢体功能。 After admission to the stroke unit, the therapist assessed swallowing and limb function the next day.
卒中单元里护士会定时翻身并教家属做早期康复。 In the stroke unit nurses reposition patients regularly and teach families early rehabilitation.
他右半边脸面瘫，眼睛闭不紧，要给眼罩保护角膜。 He has right facial palsy and cannot close the eye, so an eye patch protects the cornea.
脑卒中引起的面瘫常伴同侧肢体无力。 Facial palsy from stroke usually comes with weakness of the same-side limbs.
他左侧偏瘫，左上肢抬不起来，走路要人扶。 He has left hemiplegia, cannot lift the left arm, and needs help to walk.
偏瘫患者入院就要评估压疮和误吸风险。 Patients with hemiplegia need pressure sore and aspiration risk assessed on admission.
他听懂了但不说话，是运动性失语症，家属别以为他装聋。 He understands but does not speak, which is motor aphasia, so the family should not think he is pretending.
失语症患者要用简单手势配合沟通，不要大声催。 Communicate with aphasia patients using simple gestures and without rushing them.
他说话含糊是构音障碍，让他重复一句话就更明显。 His slurred speech is dysarthria and is even clearer when he repeats a sentence.
构音障碍和失语症不同，前者是说不清，后者是找不到词。 Dysarthria differs from aphasia: the first is unclear speech, the second is difficulty finding words.
卒中后吞咽困难要先禁食，等床旁吞咽评估通过再喝水。 Dysphagia after stroke means fasting until a bedside swallow assessment is passed.
吞咽困难的患者喝水最容易呛，要用增稠剂。 Patients with dysphagia choke most on water and need thickeners.
他形容雷击样头痛，一秒钟就疼到极点，马上安排头颅CT。 He described a thunderclap headache that peaked within a second, so an urgent head CT was arranged.
没有雷击样头痛的特点，可以先观察再决定要不要腰穿。 Without the thunderclap headache pattern, observation can come before deciding on lumbar puncture.
影像显示大片缺血半暗带，取栓后肌力明显恢复。 Imaging showed a large ischemic penumbra, and power improved clearly after thrombectomy.
缺血半暗带越小，溶栓获益越少。 The smaller the ischemic penumbra, the less there is to gain from thrombolysis.
超声发现重度颈动脉狭窄，与他这次卒中有关。 Ultrasound found severe carotid stenosis, which accounted for this stroke.
有症状的颈动脉狭窄要评估内膜剥脱手术。 Symptomatic carotid stenosis warrants assessment for endarterectomy.
卒中后癫痫发作要观察频率并决定是否用药。 In post-stroke epilepsy the seizure frequency is observed before deciding on treatment.
他卒中后癫痫第一次发作在病后第三天。 His first post-stroke epilepsy seizure came on the third day after the stroke.
体重算好剂量后，阿替普酶十分钟内静脉推注一部分。 After calculating the dose by weight, part of the alteplase was given as a bolus within ten minutes.
用阿替普酶后血压不能超过一百八，护士每十五分钟量一次。 After alteplase, blood pressure must stay below one hundred eighty, so the nurse measured it every fifteen minutes.
溶栓后头痛加重，复查CT发现出血转化，立即停用抗栓药。 Headache worsened after thrombolysis and repeat CT showed hemorrhagic transformation, so antithrombotic drugs were stopped.
出血转化高危的患者，溶栓前要反复核对影像。 Patients at high risk of hemorrhagic transformation need imaging reviewed carefully before thrombolysis.
血管内治疗对发病六到二十四小时的大血管闭塞仍可能有效。 Endovascular therapy can still help large-vessel occlusion presenting six to twenty four hours after onset.
家属同意做血管内治疗，签字后直接送导管室。 The family agreed to endovascular therapy and, after signing, the patient went straight to the catheterization lab.
缺血性卒中急性期要尽早启动抗血小板治疗。 Antiplatelet therapy should start early in the acute phase of ischemic stroke.
抗血小板治疗期间要注意牙龈出血和黑便。 During antiplatelet therapy watch for bleeding gums and black stools.
维持脑血流灌注是卒中急性期处理的核心目标之一。 Maintaining cerebral perfusion is a central goal in acute stroke care.
血压降得太快反而会减少脑血流灌注，加重缺血。 Lowering blood pressure too fast can reduce cerebral perfusion and worsen ischemia.
出院前用改良Rankin量表评了一次，评了两分。 Before discharge a modified Rankin Scale score was recorded and came to two.
改良Rankin量表评分超过二分，说明生活还需要别人帮忙。 A modified Rankin Scale score above two means the patient still needs help in daily life.
患者主诉呼吸困难，说话只能两个字一顿，立即给氧。 The patient reported dyspnea and could speak only two words at a time, so oxygen was started at once.
您这个呼吸困难是突然出现的还是这几天慢慢加重的？ Did your dyspnea come on suddenly, or has it built up over the past few days?
支气管哮喘患者接触花粉后发作，双肺满布哮鸣音。 The patient with bronchial asthma developed an attack after pollen exposure, with wheezing all over both lungs.
她有支气管哮喘史，每次感冒都会诱发喘息。 She has a history of bronchial asthma, and every cold triggers wheezing.
哮喘急性发作时先连续雾化沙丁胺醇，再评估要不要加激素。 In an acute asthma attack, nebulized salbutamol is given repeatedly before deciding on steroids.
孩子哮喘急性发作说不出完整句子，家长吓得一直哭。 The child in an acute asthma attack could not speak in full sentences, and the parents were in tears.
听诊双肺喘息明显，呼气相延长，先给支气管扩张剂。 Wheezing was obvious on auscultation with prolonged expiration, so a bronchodilator was given first.
老人家一活动就喘息，躺下更厉害，要查心功能。 The old man wheezes on any exertion and worse when lying down, so cardiac function needs checking.
他有端坐呼吸，躺平两分钟就憋得坐起来。 He has orthopnea and within two minutes of lying flat he sits bolt upright gasping.
出现端坐呼吸说明淤血已经很重，要马上利尿。 Orthopnea means congestion is already severe and diuretics are needed urgently.
他反复夜间阵发性呼吸困难，常常睡到半夜憋醒要开窗。 He has recurrent paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea and often wakes at midnight gasping and opens the window.
夜间阵发性呼吸困难伴双下肢水肿，基本可以考虑心衰。 Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea with leg edema makes heart failure the likely diagnosis.
他有慢性阻塞性肺疾病，这次痰变黄变多，是急性加重。 He has chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and this time the sputum turned yellow and increased, indicating an exacerbation.
慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者不能吸高浓度氧，会加重二氧化碳潴留。 Patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease should not receive high-flow oxygen because it worsens carbon dioxide retention.

zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重
text: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重期要给雾化扩张剂和无创通气。 Acute exacerbation of COPD is treated with nebulized bronchodilators and non-invasive ventilation.

zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重
text: 这次慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重和天气变冷、痰多有关。 This acute exacerbation of COPD was linked to colder weather and increased sputum.
血气提示呼吸衰竭，氧分压五十，赶紧准备无创通气。 Blood gases showed respiratory failure with an oxygen partial pressure of fifty, so non-invasive ventilation was prepared quickly.
呼吸衰竭分一型和二型，处理方式不一样。 Respiratory failure is classified as type one or type two, and the management differs.
重症肺炎后出现急性呼吸窘迫综合征，氧合指数只有一百。 Acute respiratory distress syndrome developed after severe pneumonia, with an oxygenation index of only one hundred.
急性呼吸窘迫综合征要小潮气量通气，不能按常规潮气量给。 Acute respiratory distress syndrome requires low tidal volume ventilation rather than usual tidal volumes.
指脉氧只有八十五，低氧血症明显，先面罩吸氧。 The pulse oximeter read only eighty five, clear hypoxemia, so a face mask delivered oxygen first.
低氧血症纠正后他的烦躁明显好转。 His agitation eased noticeably once the hypoxemia was corrected.
血气二氧化碳分压八十，高碳酸血症已经很明显。 The blood gas carbon dioxide was eighty, so hypercapnia was already marked.
慢阻肺患者出现高碳酸血症时不能给太高浓度的氧。 In COPD patients with hypercapnia, oxygen must not be given at too high a concentration.
先雾化吸入支气管扩张剂，二十分钟后复评喘息。 Nebulized bronchodilators were given first and wheezing reassessed after twenty minutes.
他喷支气管扩张剂越来越频繁，说明哮喘控制不好。 He needs his bronchodilator more and more often, which means his asthma is poorly controlled.
沙丁胺醇雾化二十分钟一次，连做三次看效果。 Salbutamol nebulization was given every twenty minutes for three doses to assess response.
他自己在家喷沙丁胺醇不缓解才来的急诊。 He came to the emergency department because salbutamol at home brought no relief.
重症哮喘加静脉糖皮质激素，观察四小时再决定要不要住院。 Intravenous glucocorticoid was added for severe asthma, with reassessment after four hours to decide on admission.
长期吃糖皮质激素的患者突然停药会出现肾上腺危象。 Suddenly stopping long-term glucocorticoids can precipitate an adrenal crisis.
哮喘控制不佳时加吸入性糖皮质激素，规律用才有效。 In poor asthma control an inhaled corticosteroid is added and works only if used regularly.
吸入性糖皮质激素用完要漱口，防止口腔真菌感染。 Rinse the mouth after an inhaled corticosteroid to prevent oral fungal infection.
峰流速比平时下降三成，说明这次发作不轻。 Peak expiratory flow was thirty percent below his usual value, indicating a significant attack.
教患者每天早晚各测一次峰流速并记在本子上。 Teach patients to measure peak expiratory flow twice daily and record it in a diary.
抽血气分析要扎桡动脉，会比普通抽血疼一点。 Arterial blood gas sampling goes into the radial artery and hurts a little more than a routine blood draw.
血气分析结果回来，二氧化碳分压明显升高。 The arterial blood gas result came back with a clearly raised carbon dioxide partial pressure.
慢阻肺患者吸氧浓度过高会引起二氧化碳潴留。 Too high an oxygen concentration can cause carbon dioxide retention in COPD patients.
二氧化碳潴留加重时患者会嗜睡、胡言乱语。 Worsening carbon dioxide retention makes patients drowsy and confused.
孩子吸气时三凹征明显，哭声都变弱了，准备气道支持。 The child showed clear suprasternal retraction on inspiration and a weaker cry, so airway support was prepared.
出现三凹征说明呼吸费力已经很重，不能只看血氧。 Suprasternal retraction means breathing effort is already severe, and pulse oximetry alone is not enough.
急性肺水肿患者咳粉红色泡沫痰，坐位给氧并静推利尿剂。 The patient with acute pulmonary edema coughed pink frothy sputum, so oxygen was given sitting up with intravenous diuretics.
肺水肿好转后肺部湿啰音明显减少。 After the pulmonary edema improved, the lung crackles decreased markedly.
慢阻肺患者嗜睡、手扑翼样颤动，考虑肺性脑病。 Drowsiness with flapping tremor in the COPD patient suggested pulmonary encephalopathy.
肺性脑病改善通气后意识能明显好转。 Pulmonary encephalopathy improves markedly once ventilation is improved.
哮喘持续发作出现呼吸肌疲劳，是插管指征。 Respiratory muscle fatigue during a prolonged asthma attack is an indication for intubation.
呼吸肌疲劳的患者呼吸浅快、说话断句。 Patients with respiratory muscle fatigue breathe rapidly and shallowly and speak in broken phrases.
婴儿呼吸窘迫伴鼻翼扇动，需要马上评估。 The infant in respiratory distress with nasal flaring needed urgent assessment.
呼吸窘迫的患者说不出整句话，要优先处理。 Patients in respiratory distress cannot speak full sentences and must be prioritized.
支气管舒张试验阳性，支持哮喘诊断。 A positive bronchodilator reversibility test supports the diagnosis of asthma.
支气管舒张试验前要停用短效扩张剂六小时。 Short-acting bronchodilators are stopped six hours before a bronchodilator reversibility test.
患者说咯血两口，鲜红色带泡沫，先拍胸片。 The patient reported coughing up two mouthfuls of hemoptysis, bright red and frothy, so a chest film came first.
咯血和呕血要问清是咳出来还是吐出来的。 For hemoptysis versus hematemesis, ask whether the blood was coughed up or vomited.
老慢支患者长期吃茶碱，这次心慌要查血药浓度。 The patient with chronic bronchitis had taken theophylline long term, so a drug level was checked for his palpitations.
茶碱治疗窗窄，加量一定要慢。 Theophylline has a narrow therapeutic window, so any dose increase must be gradual.
患者腹痛六小时，先在右下腹，现在全腹都疼。 The patient had abdominal pain for six hours, starting in the right lower quadrant and now all over.
您这个腹痛是绞痛、胀痛还是烧灼样的疼？ Is your abdominal pain cramping, bloating, or burning?
急腹症患者先禁食、建立静脉通路，同时联系外科。 For acute abdomen, keep the patient fasting, secure intravenous access, and call surgery.
这例急腹症血压不稳，考虑腹腔内出血。 This case of acute abdomen had unstable blood pressure, suggesting intra-abdominal bleeding.
疼痛从脐周转到右下腹，超声考虑急性阑尾炎。 The pain migrated from the umbilicus to the right lower quadrant, and ultrasound suggested acute appendicitis.
急性阑尾炎伴发热和白细胞升高，准备急诊手术。 Acute appendicitis with fever and raised white cells prompted emergency surgery.
暴饮暴食后上腹剧痛，血淀粉酶升高，诊断急性胰腺炎。 Severe epigastric pain after a heavy meal with raised amylase led to a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.
急性胰腺炎要禁食、补液并监测尿量。 Acute pancreatitis requires fasting, fluid replacement, and urine output monitoring.
右上腹痛伴发热，墨菲征阳性，考虑急性胆囊炎。 Right upper quadrant pain with fever and a positive Murphy sign suggested acute cholecystitis.
急性胆囊炎先抗感染和禁食，再请外科评估。 Acute cholecystitis was treated with antibiotics and fasting before surgical review.
体检发现胆石症多年，这次吃油腻后右上腹绞痛。 Cholelithiasis had been known for years, and this time fatty food brought right upper quadrant colic.
胆石症患者反复发作胆绞痛，建议择期手术。 Recurrent biliary colic in cholelithiasis usually leads to elective surgery.
腹部平片见多个液气平面，诊断肠梗阻，先禁食减压。 Abdominal films showed multiple air-fluid levels, so intestinal obstruction was diagnosed and fasting with decompression started.
肠梗阻患者呕吐后腹胀稍缓解，但仍需留置胃管。 After vomiting the distension eased slightly in this intestinal obstruction, but a nasogastric tube was still needed.
立位腹平片见膈下游离气体，考虑胃肠穿孔。 Free air under the diaphragm on an erect abdominal film pointed to gastrointestinal perforation.
胃肠穿孔需要急诊手术修补，先禁食并抗感染。 Gastrointestinal perforation requires emergency repair, with fasting and antibiotics first.
左下腹痛伴发热，CT诊断结肠憩室炎。 Left lower quadrant pain with fever was diagnosed as acute diverticulitis on CT.
结肠憩室炎多数抗感染即可，脓肿才需引流。 Most acute diverticulitis responds to antibiotics and only abscesses need drainage.
老人房颤病史，突发剧烈腹痛而腹部软，要想到肠系膜缺血。 In an elderly patient with atrial fibrillation and severe pain but a soft abdomen, mesenteric ischemia must be considered.
肠系膜缺血确诊后要尽快手术，坏死肠管必须切除。 Once mesenteric ischemia is confirmed, surgery should follow quickly and necrotic bowel must be resected.
他疼得满地打滚，是典型肾绞痛，先给解痉止痛。 He was writhing in pain with classic renal colic, so antispasmodic analgesia came first.
肾绞痛患者尿常规常见红细胞。 Urinalysis in renal colic commonly shows red blood cells.
CT看到输尿管结石六毫米，先止痛再考虑排石。 CT showed a six-millimeter ureteral calculus, so analgesia came before measures to pass the stone.
输尿管结石合并感染发热要紧急引流。 A ureteral calculus with infection and fever needs emergency drainage.
消化性溃疡患者空腹时上腹痛明显，进食后减轻。 In peptic ulcer the epigastric pain is worse when hungry and eases after eating.
消化性溃疡要查幽门螺杆菌并按疗程用药。 Peptic ulcer requires testing for Helicobacter pylori and a full course of treatment.
他烧心反酸多年，胃食管反流病一直没规范治。 He had heartburn and acid regurgitation for years without proper treatment of gastroesophageal reflux disease.
胃食管反流病引起的胸痛做心电图是正常的。 Chest pain from gastroesophageal reflux disease comes with a normal ECG.
超声提示中量腹腔积液，腹部膨隆明显。 Ultrasound showed moderate ascites with obvious abdominal distension.
腹腔积液患者抽液后呼吸困难缓解。 After fluid was drained the patient's breathing eased despite the ascites.
急诊先做腹部超声，看胆囊、胰腺和有无积液。 Abdominal ultrasonography came first in the emergency department to assess the gallbladder, pancreas, and any fluid.
腹部超声没看到结石，但不能完全排除。 Abdominal ultrasonography showed no stone, but that does not fully exclude one.
消化道出血患者先静脉抑酸治疗，等胃镜。 Patients with gastrointestinal bleeding receive intravenous acid suppression while awaiting endoscopy.
抑酸治疗要足量足疗程，不能疼了才吃。 Acid suppression must be given at full dose for the full course, not only when pain occurs.
术后频繁呕吐、上腹膨隆，考虑急性胃扩张。 Repeated vomiting and epigastric distension after surgery suggested acute gastric dilatation.
急性胃扩张要先禁食并留置胃管减压。 Acute gastric dilatation is treated by fasting and nasogastric decompression.
急性胰腺炎泵入生长抑素，同时严密观察腹痛。 Somatostatin was infused for acute pancreatitis while abdominal pain was closely watched.
食管静脉出血用生长抑素可以降低门脉压力。 Somatostatin lowers portal pressure in variceal bleeding.
质子泵抑制剂静脉给药，八小时一次。 The proton pump inhibitor was given intravenously every eight hours.
出院后继续口服质子泵抑制剂八周。 After discharge the proton pump inhibitor is continued by mouth for eight weeks.
腹痛、发热加黄疸，考虑急性胆管炎，要尽快引流。 Pain, fever, and jaundice pointed to acute cholangitis, so drainage was needed promptly.
胆管炎患者血压下降提示病情危重。 Falling blood pressure in cholangitis signals a critical condition.
急性胰腺炎六周后CT发现胰腺假性囊肿。 Six weeks after acute pancreatitis, CT found a pancreatic pseudocyst.
胰腺假性囊肿合并感染时需要引流。 An infected pancreatic pseudocyst requires drainage.
查了一圈没有器质性问题，诊断功能性消化不良。 After extensive testing showed no organic disease, functional dyspepsia was diagnosed.
功能性消化不良与情绪和进食习惯关系很大。 Functional dyspepsia is closely related to mood and eating habits.
他慢性腹痛两年，反复做检查都没找到原因。 He had chronic abdominal pain for two years, and repeated tests found no cause.
慢性腹痛患者要有耐心，不能每次疼都做CT。 Patients with chronic abdominal pain need patience, and not every episode warrants a CT.
重症监护患者出现急性胃黏膜病变，胃管引出咖啡样液体。 The intensive care patient developed acute gastric mucosal lesion with coffee-ground fluid from the gastric tube.
急性胃黏膜病变要停用损伤药物并抑酸。 In acute gastric mucosal lesion, offending drugs are stopped and acid suppression started.
呼气试验阳性，说明有幽门螺杆菌感染。 A positive breath test confirmed Helicobacter pylori infection.
根除幽门螺杆菌要联合用药十四天。 Eradicating Helicobacter pylori requires combination therapy for fourteen days.
术后第三天腹胀明显、没有排气，是麻痹性肠梗阻。 Marked distension and no flatus on the third postoperative day indicated paralytic ileus.
麻痹性肠梗阻以纠正电解质和胃肠减压为主，多数不用手术。 Paralytic ileus is mainly managed by correcting electrolytes and decompression, and usually needs no surgery.
患者消化道出血量大，先建立两条静脉通路。 With heavy gastrointestinal bleeding, two intravenous lines were secured first.
消化道出血要先判断是上消化道还是下消化道。 In gastrointestinal bleeding, first decide whether it is upper or lower tract.
上消化道出血最常见的原因是消化性溃疡。 The most common cause of upper gastrointestinal bleeding is peptic ulcer.
上消化道出血患者呕血两次，血压开始往下走。 The patient with upper gastrointestinal bleeding vomited blood twice and blood pressure began to fall.
下消化道出血以鲜血便为主，要查结肠镜。 Lower gastrointestinal bleeding mostly causes bright red stool and calls for colonoscopy.
老年人下消化道出血要排除血管畸形和肿瘤。 In elderly patients lower gastrointestinal bleeding warrants exclusion of angiodysplasia and tumor.
患者呕血约三百毫升，呈暗红色。 The patient had hematemesis of about three hundred milliliters, dark red in color.
呕血时要侧卧位，防止误吸。 During hematemesis, position the patient on the side to prevent aspiration.
他说这两天解黑便，像柏油一样黑。 He reported melena for two days, black like tar.
黑便通常提示出血量在五十毫升以上。 Melena usually means the blood loss exceeded fifty milliliters.
便血三次，颜色鲜红，考虑下消化道出血。 Three episodes of hematochezia, bright red, suggested lower gastrointestinal bleeding.
便血患者要先看血压和血红蛋白，别只看颜色。 In hematochezia check blood pressure and hemoglobin rather than only the color.
体检做隐血试验阳性，后来胃镜发现溃疡。 The fecal occult blood test was positive, and endoscopy later found an ulcer.
隐血试验前一天不能吃动物血和铁剂。 Avoid animal blood and iron tablets the day before a fecal occult blood test.
胃镜看到重度食管胃底静脉曲张，有红色征。 Endoscopy showed severe esophageal varices with red color signs.
食管胃底静脉曲张患者不能吃粗糙坚硬的食物。 Patients with esophageal varices must avoid coarse and hard food.
胃镜证实消化性溃疡出血，用钛夹夹闭了血管。 Endoscopy confirmed bleeding peptic ulcer and the vessel was clipped.
消化性溃疡出血停止后仍要根除幽门螺杆菌。 After a bleeding peptic ulcer stops, Helicobacter pylori eradication is still needed.

zh: 食管静脉曲张破裂出血
text: 肝硬化患者突发食管静脉曲张破裂出血，先给生长抑素。 The cirrhotic patient had sudden variceal bleeding, so somatostatin was started first.

zh: 食管静脉曲张破裂出血
text: 食管静脉曲张破裂出血止血后要预防再出血。 After variceal bleeding is controlled, prevention of further bleeding is essential.
内镜检查前要禁食六小时以上。 Patients must fast for more than six hours before endoscopy.
内镜检查同时可以取活检或止血。 Endoscopy allows biopsy or hemostasis in the same session.
急诊内镜在入院六小时内完成，找到了出血点。 Emergency endoscopy was completed within six hours of admission and located the bleeding point.
