急诊内镜前要先稳定循环，不能边休克边做。 Circulation must be stabilized before emergency endoscopy rather than scoping during shock.
内镜下止血成功后，患者血压逐渐稳定。 After endoscopic hemostasis succeeded, blood pressure gradually stabilized.
内镜下止血后再出血率约一成，需要观察。 Rebleeding after endoscopic hemostasis occurs in about ten percent and needs observation.
血红蛋白降到六十，医生决定输血两个单位。 With hemoglobin down to sixty, the doctor decided on a transfusion of two units.
输血前要双人核对姓名和血型。 Two staff must check the name and blood group before transfusion.
急性出血早期贫血可以不明显，补液后数值才下降。 Anemia may be absent early in acute bleeding and only appears after fluids are given.
长期贫血患者要查铁、叶酸和维生素B12。 In chronic anemia, check iron, folate, and vitamin B12.
超声提示门静脉高压，脾大且门静脉增宽。 Ultrasound indicated portal hypertension with splenomegaly and a dilated portal vein.
门静脉高压患者要避免用力排便和剧烈咳嗽。 Patients with portal hypertension should avoid straining at stool and violent coughing.
肝硬化失代偿期出现腹水和黄疸。 Decompensated liver cirrhosis brought ascites and jaundice.
肝硬化患者要限制钠盐并监测体重。 Patients with liver cirrhosis need salt restriction and weight monitoring.
胃镜见门脉高压性胃病，黏膜呈蛇皮样改变。 Endoscopy showed portal hypertensive gastropathy with a snake-skin mucosal pattern.
门脉高压性胃病引起的出血一般比较缓慢。 Bleeding from portal hypertensive gastropathy is usually slow.
奥曲肽静脉泵入三天，观察有无再出血。 Octreotide was infused for three days while watching for rebleeding.
奥曲肽比血管加压素副作用少，更常用。 Octreotide has fewer side effects than vasopressin and is used more often.
内镜下了三个套扎环，套扎治疗过程顺利。 Three bands were placed and the band ligation proceeded smoothly.
套扎治疗后要吃软食，避免摩擦结扎部位。 After band ligation eat soft food to avoid rubbing the banded areas.
注射硬化治疗时患者感到胸骨后不适，属常见反应。 During sclerotherapy the patient felt retrosternal discomfort, a common reaction.
硬化治疗后有发热和胸痛要警惕并发症。 Fever and chest pain after sclerotherapy warrant concern for complications.
药物和内镜都止不住，只好下三腔二囊管压迫。 When drugs and endoscopy failed, a Sengstaken-Blakemore tube was placed for tamponade.
三腔二囊管最多留置二十四小时，要防止误吸。 A Sengstaken-Blakemore tube is kept no longer than twenty four hours and aspiration must be prevented.
长期黑便导致缺铁性贫血，血红蛋白只有七十。 Chronic melena led to iron deficiency anemia with hemoglobin of only seventy.
缺铁性贫血要查原因，不能只补铁。 Iron deficiency anemia requires a search for the cause and not iron alone.
结肠镜发现肠道血管畸形，用氩气刀凝固了病灶。 Colonoscopy found angiodysplasia and the lesion was coagulated with argon plasma.
还有一处肠道血管畸形在小肠，胃镜和结肠镜都看不见。 There was another patch of angiodysplasia in the small bowel that neither gastroscopy nor colonoscopy could reach.
下消化道出血稳定后做了结肠镜，发现息肉出血。 Once the lower gastrointestinal bleeding settled, colonoscopy found a bleeding polyp.
结肠镜前要清洁肠道，急诊时可只做灌肠。 Bowel preparation is needed before colonoscopy, though emergency cases may only need an enema.
除了内镜，还给了止血药物作为辅助。 Besides endoscopy, a hemostatic agent was given as supportive treatment.
止血药物不能代替内镜止血，只能辅助。 Hemostatic agents cannot replace endoscopic hemostasis and are only supportive.
胃管引出咖啡样呕吐物，提示上消化道出血。 The gastric tube drained coffee-ground vomitus, indicating upper gastrointestinal bleeding.
出现咖啡样呕吐物要记录量和次数。 Record the volume and number of episodes when coffee-ground vomitus appears.
乳酸升高、血压偏低，考虑脓毒症，一小时内给抗生素。 With raised lactate and low blood pressure, sepsis was suspected and antibiotics were given within an hour.
脓毒症的关键是早识别、早抗感染和液体复苏。 The key to sepsis is early recognition, early antibiotics, and fluid resuscitation.
脓毒性休克患者补液后血压仍低，加了去甲肾上腺素。 Blood pressure stayed low after fluids in septic shock, so norepinephrine was added.
脓毒性休克每延迟一小时用药，病死率就上升。 Every hour of delay in antibiotics in septic shock raises mortality.
血培养报菌血症，要根据药敏调整抗生素。 Blood cultures reported bacteremia, so antibiotics were adjusted to susceptibility results.
留置导管相关菌血症要尽快拔管。 Catheter-related bacteremia requires early removal of the line.
按全身炎症反应综合征标准，他满足三条。 He met three criteria for systemic inflammatory response syndrome.
全身炎症反应综合征不等于感染，胰腺炎也会出现。 Systemic inflammatory response syndrome does not equal infection, since pancreatitis can cause it too.

zh: 多器官功能障碍综合征
text: 脓毒症进展为多器官功能障碍综合征，转入ICU。 Sepsis progressed to multiple organ dysfunction syndrome and the patient was transferred to the ICU.

zh: 多器官功能障碍综合征
text: 多器官功能障碍综合征的病死率随衰竭器官数增加。 Mortality in multiple organ dysfunction syndrome rises with the number of failing organs.
社区获得性肺炎先经验性用抗生素，再看培养结果。 Community-acquired pneumonia was treated with empiric antibiotics pending culture results.
抗生素不能治病毒感染，感冒不需要常规用。 Antibiotics do not treat viral infections and are not routine for colds.
脓毒症要在留取培养后一小时内开始经验性抗生素治疗。 In sepsis, empiric antibiotic therapy starts within one hour of taking cultures.
经验性抗生素治疗覆盖常见病原，之后按药敏调整。 Empiric antibiotic therapy covers common pathogens and is later adjusted by susceptibility.
发热寒战时抽血培养，两只胳膊各采一套。 Blood cultures were drawn during fever and chills, one set from each arm.
血培养结果要三到五天，不能等结果再用药。 Blood culture results take three to five days, so treatment cannot wait for them.
降钙素原明显升高，支持细菌感染。 Procalcitonin was clearly raised, supporting bacterial infection.
降钙素原降到正常可以考虑停抗生素。 Antibiotics can be considered for stopping once procalcitonin returns to normal.
C反应蛋白一百二，提示炎症明显但不能定位。 C-reactive protein was one hundred twenty, indicating marked inflammation without localizing it.
C反应蛋白下降说明治疗有效。 A falling C-reactive protein suggests the treatment is working.
确诊脓毒症后立即启动脓毒症集束化治疗。 Once sepsis was diagnosed the sepsis bundle was started immediately.
脓毒症集束化治疗要求一小时内抽培养和用药。 The sepsis bundle requires cultures and antibiotics within one hour.
社区获得性肺炎患者氧分压低，需要住院。 The patient with community-acquired pneumonia had a low oxygen partial pressure and needed admission.
社区获得性肺炎多由肺炎链球菌引起。 Community-acquired pneumonia is most often caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae.
机械通气五天后出现医院获得性肺炎，痰培养有耐药菌。 Hospital-acquired pneumonia appeared after five days of ventilation, with resistant organisms on sputum culture.
医院获得性肺炎要按本院耐药谱选抗生素。 Hospital-acquired pneumonia requires antibiotics chosen by local resistance patterns.
卒中后吞咽困难的患者进食呛咳，随后出现吸入性肺炎。 The patient with post-stroke dysphagia choked while eating and later developed aspiration pneumonia.
预防吸入性肺炎要抬高床头并做吞咽评估。 Preventing aspiration pneumonia means raising the head of the bed and assessing swallowing.
老年患者泌尿系统感染可以只表现为意识模糊。 Urinary tract infection in the elderly may present only as confusion.
泌尿系统感染要留尿培养再用药。 Urine culture should be taken before treating a urinary tract infection.
高热、腰痛伴尿频，诊断急性肾盂肾炎，需要静脉抗生素。 High fever, flank pain, and frequency led to a diagnosis of acute pyelonephritis needing intravenous antibiotics.
妊娠期急性肾盂肾炎容易早产，要收住院。 Acute pyelonephritis in pregnancy risks preterm labor and requires admission.
胆道感染伴黄疸，要尽快做胆道引流。 Biliary tract infection with jaundice called for early biliary drainage.
胆道感染容易进展为脓毒性休克。 Biliary tract infection can readily progress to septic shock.
脓肿不引流，抗生素再好也没用，必须做感染源控制。 No antibiotic works well without draining an abscess, so source control is essential.
感染源控制包括拔除感染的导管和切开引流。 Source control includes removing infected catheters and incising for drainage.
发热头痛伴颈抵抗，怀疑化脓性脑膜炎，立即腰穿。 Fever, headache, and neck stiffness raised concern for purulent meningitis, so lumbar puncture was done at once.
化脓性脑膜炎要在地塞米松后尽早用抗生素。 In purulent meningitis antibiotics should follow dexamethasone as early as possible.
皮肤软组织感染范围扩大，要静脉用抗生素。 The skin and soft tissue infection was spreading, so intravenous antibiotics were started.
皮肤软组织感染要判断有没有脓肿需要切开。 In skin and soft tissue infection, decide whether an abscess needs incision.
腿部红肿剧痛伴水泡，考虑坏死性筋膜炎，立即请外科。 Leg swelling, severe pain, and blisters suggested necrotizing fasciitis, so surgery was called immediately.
坏死性筋膜炎进展极快，几小时就可能坏死扩大。 Necrotizing fasciitis progresses very fast and can spread within hours.
分诊时先做脓毒症筛查，阳性就通知医生。 Sepsis screening is done at triage, and a positive result triggers a doctor's review.
脓毒症筛查包括体温、心率、呼吸和意识状态。 Sepsis screening covers temperature, heart rate, respiration, and mental status.
发热伴穿刺点红肿，考虑导管相关血流感染。 Fever with redness at the insertion site suggested catheter-related bloodstream infection.
导管相关血流感染要拔管并做导管尖端培养。 Catheter-related bloodstream infection requires line removal and culture of the catheter tip.
培养结果出来后做抗菌药物降阶梯，减少耐药风险。 Once cultures returned, de-escalation of antibiotics reduced the risk of resistance.
抗菌药物降阶梯要等患者病情稳定再执行。 De-escalation of antibiotics waits until the patient is stable.
痰培养检出多重耐药菌，需要单间隔离。 Sputum culture grew a multidrug-resistant organism, so single-room isolation was required.
多重耐药菌感染可选药物少，要请感染科会诊。 Few drugs remain for multidrug-resistant organism infection, so infectious disease consultation is needed.
发热伴新出现的心脏杂音，要考虑感染性心内膜炎。 Fever with a new heart murmur should raise suspicion of infective endocarditis.
感染性心内膜炎要连抽三次血培养再开始抗生素。 In infective endocarditis, three sets of blood cultures are taken before antibiotics start.
脓毒症心肌病患者补液后血压仍低，加用了强心药。 The patient with sepsis-induced cardiomyopathy stayed hypotensive after fluids and needed inotropes.
脓毒症心肌病多数随感染控制逐渐恢复。 Sepsis-induced cardiomyopathy usually recovers as the infection is controlled.
血糖二十八、尿酮强阳性，诊断糖尿病酮症酸中毒，开始补液。 With glucose twenty eight and strongly positive urine ketones, diabetic ketoacidosis was diagnosed and fluids started.
糖尿病酮症酸中毒要小剂量胰岛素泵入，每小时测血糖。 Diabetic ketoacidosis is treated with low-dose insulin infusion and hourly glucose checks.
老年患者血糖六十、意识模糊而尿酮阴性，考虑高渗高血糖状态。 An elderly patient with glucose sixty and confusion but negative urine ketones was thought to have hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state.
高渗高血糖状态补液要慢，防止渗透压下降过快。 Fluids in hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state are given slowly to avoid too rapid a fall in osmolality.
糖尿病患者出汗心慌，测血糖二点八，是低血糖。 The diabetic patient was sweating and trembling with a glucose of two point eight, which is hypoglycemia.
低血糖先口服糖水，不能口服就静脉推葡萄糖。 Treat hypoglycemia with oral sugar first, or intravenous glucose if the patient cannot swallow.
老人被家人发现叫不醒，血糖一点九，按低血糖昏迷处理。 The elderly man was found unresponsive with a glucose of one point nine and was treated as hypoglycemic coma.
低血糖昏迷补糖后几分钟就醒了，别忘了让他进食。 Patients in hypoglycemic coma wake within minutes of glucose, but a meal must follow.
甲亢患者肺部感染后高热四十度、心率一百六，考虑甲状腺危象。 After a chest infection the hyperthyroid patient had a fever of forty and a rate of one hundred sixty, suggesting thyroid storm.
甲状腺危象要同时用抗甲状腺药、碘剂和β受体阻滞剂。 Thyroid storm is treated with antithyroid drugs, iodine, and beta blockers together.
老人低体温、反应迟钝、皮肤干厚，考虑黏液性水肿昏迷。 Low temperature, slow responses, and dry thick skin in an elderly patient suggested myxedema coma.
黏液性水肿昏迷要静脉补甲状腺激素并保温。 Myxedema coma requires intravenous thyroid hormone and active warming.
长期吃激素的患者自行停药后呕吐、血压下降，是肾上腺危象。 Vomiting and falling blood pressure after stopping steroids on his own indicated an adrenal crisis.
肾上腺危象立即静脉给氢化可的松并补液。 Adrenal crisis is treated at once with intravenous hydrocortisone and fluids.
血钙三点八伴嗜睡和多尿，考虑高钙危象，马上补液。 Calcium of three point eight with drowsiness and polyuria suggested hypercalcemic crisis, so fluids were started at once.
高钙危象要大量补液并给降钙药物。 Hypercalcemic crisis is managed with vigorous fluids and calcium-lowering drugs.
他有糖尿病十年，一直口服降糖药。 He has had diabetes mellitus for ten years and takes oral glucose-lowering drugs.
糖尿病患者的感染往往更重，血糖也更高。 Infections in diabetes mellitus tend to be more severe and push glucose higher.
胰岛素要放冰箱冷藏，不能冷冻。 Insulin must be kept in the refrigerator and never frozen.
护士核对胰岛素剂量后再皮下注射。 The nurse checked the insulin dose before giving the subcutaneous injection.
入院后改成胰岛素治疗，血糖慢慢稳住了。 Insulin therapy was started after admission and the glucose gradually stabilized.
胰岛素治疗期间要防低血糖，教会患者识别心慌出汗。 During insulin therapy prevent hypoglycemia and teach patients to recognize palpitations and sweating.
糖尿病足患者脚上溃疡发黑，需要清创和抗感染。 The diabetic foot ulcer was blackened and needed debridement and antibiotics.
糖尿病足每天都要检查脚趾缝有没有破皮。 In diabetic foot, check between the toes daily for breaks in the skin.
他一天尿七八升，禁水后尿比重仍很低，符合尿崩症。 He passed seven to eight liters a day and urine remained dilute after water deprivation, consistent with diabetes insipidus.
尿崩症要记录出入量并补足水分。 Diabetes insipidus requires intake and output records and adequate water replacement.

zh: 抗利尿激素分泌不当综合征
text: 肺部感染后出现稀释性低钠，考虑抗利尿激素分泌不当综合征。 Dilutional hyponatremia after a lung infection suggested syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone.

zh: 抗利尿激素分泌不当综合征
text: 抗利尿激素分泌不当综合征要限制水入量。 The syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone is managed by restricting fluid intake.
满月脸、水牛背加紫纹，要查库欣综合征。 Moon face, buffalo hump, and purple striae warrant testing for Cushing syndrome.
外源性激素也会引起库欣综合征，先问用药史。 Exogenous steroids can also cause Cushing syndrome, so ask about drug history first.
他阵发头痛、心悸、大汗伴血压飙到二百二，怀疑嗜铬细胞瘤。 Paroxysmal headache, palpitations, sweating, and blood pressure of two hundred twenty raised suspicion of pheochromocytoma.
怀疑嗜铬细胞瘤要先做激素检查再考虑手术。 Suspected pheochromocytoma is confirmed by hormone tests before surgery.
她心慌消瘦、怕热多汗，查甲状腺功能亢进。 Palpitations, weight loss, heat intolerance, and sweating led to a diagnosis of hyperthyroidism.
甲状腺功能亢进没控制好就手术，容易诱发甲状腺危象。 Surgery with uncontrolled hyperthyroidism can precipitate thyroid storm.
她怕冷、便秘、下肢水肿，查甲状腺功能减退。 Cold intolerance, constipation, and leg swelling led to a diagnosis of hypothyroidism.
甲状腺功能减退患者对镇静药特别敏感。 Patients with hypothyroidism are unusually sensitive to sedatives.
尿酮体三个加号，提示脂肪分解明显。 Urine ketone bodies were three plus, indicating marked fat breakdown.
饥饿和剧烈运动也会让酮体轻度升高。 Starvation and strenuous exercise can also raise ketone bodies slightly.
她糖化血红蛋白九点二，说明这几个月血糖一直没控制好。 Her glycated hemoglobin was nine point two, showing poor control over recent months.
糖化血红蛋白不受当天吃饭影响。 Glycated hemoglobin is not affected by what the patient ate that day.
糖尿病肾病早期只有微量蛋白尿，要定期查。 Early diabetic nephropathy shows only microalbuminuria, so regular testing is needed.
糖尿病肾病患者用药要按肾功能调整剂量。 In diabetic nephropathy drug doses must be adjusted to renal function.
产后大出血史的患者出现低血糖和低血压，考虑垂体危象。 A patient with a history of postpartum hemorrhage developed hypoglycemia and hypotension, suggesting pituitary crisis.
垂体危象要补糖、补激素并纠正电解质。 Pituitary crisis needs glucose, steroid replacement, and electrolyte correction.
低血糖昏迷立即推百分之五十葡萄糖注射液四十毫升。 Forty milliliters of fifty percent dextrose injection was given at once for hypoglycemic coma.
葡萄糖注射液外渗会引起局部组织坏死。 Extravasation of dextrose injection can cause local tissue necrosis.
糖尿病酮症酸中毒用静脉胰岛素泵，每小时降三到五。 Diabetic ketoacidosis was managed with continuous insulin infusion, aiming to lower glucose by three to five per hour.
静脉胰岛素泵期间每半小时测一次血糖。 Glucose is checked every half hour during continuous insulin infusion.

zh: 原发性肾上腺皮质功能减退
text: 皮肤变黑、乏力、低血压，查原发性肾上腺皮质功能减退。 Skin darkening, fatigue, and low blood pressure pointed to primary adrenal insufficiency.

zh: 原发性肾上腺皮质功能减退
text: 原发性肾上腺皮质功能减退患者感染时要加量激素。 Patients with primary adrenal insufficiency need extra steroid during infection.
腹型肥胖的人常有胰岛素抵抗，血糖却可能还正常。 People with central obesity often have insulin resistance even while glucose remains normal.
改善胰岛素抵抗要靠减重和运动。 Improving insulin resistance depends on weight loss and exercise.
内分泌急症起病隐匿，容易在感染后爆发。 Endocrine emergencies start insidiously and often erupt after an infection.
值班医生要熟悉常见内分泌急症的识别。 Doctors on call should be able to recognize common endocrine emergencies.
急性中毒患者到院先评估气道、呼吸和循环。 In acute poisoning, airway, breathing, and circulation are assessed first.
问清急性中毒的毒物种类和时间，比盲目洗胃更重要。 Knowing the poison and timing in acute poisoning matters more than reflexive gastric lavage.
她吃了二十片安眠药，是药物过量，先洗胃再给活性炭。 She took twenty sleeping tablets, a drug overdose, so gastric lavage was followed by activated charcoal.
药物过量要保留药瓶，方便医生判断成分。 In drug overdose, keep the bottle so the doctor can identify the drug.
喷洒农药后大汗、流涎、瞳孔缩小，是有机磷农药中毒。 Sweating, salivation, and pinpoint pupils after spraying pesticide indicated organophosphate poisoning.
有机磷农药中毒要反复用阿托品直到阿托品化。 Organophosphate poisoning requires repeated atropine until atropinization is reached.
冬天煤炉取暖后一家人头晕恶心，是一氧化碳中毒。 Dizziness and nausea in a family using a coal stove in winter pointed to carbon monoxide poisoning.
一氧化碳中毒要尽快高压氧治疗。 Carbon monoxide poisoning should be treated with hyperbaric oxygen as soon as possible.
百草枯中毒没有特效解毒剂，早期血液灌流很重要。 There is no specific antidote for paraquat poisoning, so early hemoperfusion matters.
家属反复问百草枯中毒能不能救，我们只能如实说很难。 The family kept asking whether paraquat poisoning could be treated, and we had to say the outlook is very poor.
家里用敌敌畏灭蚊后孩子呕吐抽搐，是敌敌畏中毒。 After dichlorvos was used indoors for mosquitoes, the child vomited and convulsed, indicating dichlorvos poisoning.
敌敌畏中毒也要按有机磷中毒用阿托品和解磷定。 Dichlorvos poisoning is treated like other organophosphate poisoning with atropine and pralidoxime.
镇静催眠药中毒患者呼吸浅慢，要准备气道支持。 Patients with sedative-hypnotic poisoning breathe slowly and shallowly, so airway support is prepared.
镇静催眠药中毒多数补液观察即可，不必常规透析。 Most sedative-hypnotic poisoning needs fluids and observation rather than routine dialysis.
针尖样瞳孔加呼吸抑制，典型阿片类中毒，立即给纳洛酮。 Pinpoint pupils with respiratory depression is classic opioid poisoning, so naloxone was given at once.
阿片类中毒纳洛酮起效快但半衰期短，要观察再抑制。 Naloxone acts fast but wears off sooner than most opioids in opioid poisoning, so watch for recurrence.
他喝了一斤白酒，呼之不应，是急性酒精中毒。 He drank heavily and became unresponsive, which is acute alcohol intoxication.
酒精中毒要查血糖，低血糖也会昏迷。 Check glucose in alcohol intoxication, since hypoglycemia can also cause coma.
喝了假酒视力模糊，警惕甲醇中毒，查血气看酸中毒。 Blurred vision after drinking bootleg liquor raised concern for methanol poisoning, so blood gases were checked for acidosis.
甲醇中毒早期用乙醇或甲吡唑竞争代谢。 Early methanol poisoning is treated with ethanol or fomepizole to compete for metabolism.
密闭空间燃烧后昏迷、皮肤樱桃红，考虑氰化物中毒。 Coma with cherry-red skin after a fire in an enclosed space suggested cyanide poisoning.
氰化物中毒要立即用羟钴胺或亚硝酸盐解毒。 Cyanide poisoning is treated at once with hydroxocobalamin or nitrites.
长期用偏方后腹痛贫血，查血铅诊断重金属中毒。 Abdominal pain and anemia after long-term use of a folk remedy led to a blood lead test and a diagnosis of heavy metal poisoning.
重金属中毒多用络合剂促排。 Heavy metal poisoning is usually treated with chelating agents to enhance excretion.
一家人吃完野蘑菇后呕吐腹泻，是毒蕈中毒。 Vomiting and diarrhea in a family after eating wild mushrooms indicated mushroom poisoning.
毒蕈中毒要留蘑菇样本，并监测肝肾功能。 In mushroom poisoning keep a sample of the mushroom and monitor liver and kidney function.
吃河豚后口唇发麻、说话不清，是河豚中毒。 Numb lips and slurred speech after eating pufferfish indicated pufferfish poisoning.
河豚中毒没有特效解毒药，只能支持呼吸。 There is no specific antidote for pufferfish poisoning, only respiratory support.
服药两周后转氨酶升高，考虑中毒性肝损伤。 Raised transaminases two weeks after starting the drug suggested toxic liver injury.
中毒性肝损伤要停用可疑毒物并监测凝血。 In toxic liver injury stop the suspected agent and monitor coagulation.
有机磷中毒的解毒剂是阿托品和解磷定。 The antidotes for organophosphate poisoning are atropine and pralidoxime.
不是每种中毒都有解毒剂，支持治疗同样重要。 Not every poisoning has an antidote, and supportive care matters just as much.
苯二氮卓类过量昏迷可试用氟马西尼。 Flumazenil can be tried in coma from benzodiazepine overdose.
氟马西尼可能诱发癫痫，长期服药者慎用。 Flumazenil can provoke seizures and is used cautiously in long-term users.
服药一小时内给活性炭，超过两小时效果差。 Activated charcoal was given within an hour of ingestion and is less effective after two hours.
活性炭不能用于昏迷或腐蚀性中毒的患者。 Activated charcoal must not be given to comatose patients or after corrosive ingestion.
服毒两小时内可以洗胃，超过六小时意义不大。 Gastric lavage is reasonable within two hours of ingestion and of little value after six.
洗胃前要确认没有腐蚀性物质中毒。 Before gastric lavage, confirm that no corrosive substance was ingested.
百草枯中毒早期做血液灌流，越早越好。 Early hemoperfusion is used in paraquat poisoning, and earlier is better.
血液灌流对脂溶性毒物清除效果较好。 Hemoperfusion removes lipid-soluble poisons relatively well.
甲醇中毒合并严重酸中毒要血液透析。 Methanol poisoning with severe acidosis requires hemodialysis.
血液透析对蛋白结合率高的毒物清除差。 Hemodialysis clears poisons with high protein binding poorly.
胆碱酯酶活性只有正常的三成，支持有机磷中毒。 Cholinesterase activity was only thirty percent of normal, supporting organophosphate poisoning.
胆碱酯酶恢复比症状慢，不能只看这个指标。 Cholinesterase recovers more slowly than symptoms, so it cannot be the only guide.
有机磷中毒要阿托品和解磷定一起用。 Organophosphate poisoning is treated with atropine together with pralidoxime.
解磷定要早期足量，晚了酶已老化就没用。 Pralidoxime must be given early and in adequate dose, since it fails once the enzyme has aged.
不明原因昏迷要送毒物筛查。 Unexplained coma should prompt toxicology screening.
毒物筛查结果出来前不能停止支持治疗。 Supportive care must not stop while awaiting toxicology screening results.
吃了腌菜后口唇青紫而血氧不低，考虑亚硝酸盐中毒。 Blue lips with normal oxygen readings after eating pickled vegetables suggested nitrite poisoning.
亚硝酸盐中毒用亚甲蓝解毒。 Nitrite poisoning is treated with methylene blue.
一氧化碳中毒后出现中毒性脑病，认不出家人。 Toxic encephalopathy developed after carbon monoxide poisoning and he could not recognize his family.
中毒性脑病要边解毒边保护脑功能。 In toxic encephalopathy, antidotes and brain protection proceed together.
一氧化碳中毒清醒两周后记忆力下降，是迟发性脑病。 Memory decline two weeks after waking from carbon monoxide poisoning indicated delayed encephalopathy.
迟发性脑病要做高压氧和康复治疗。 Delayed encephalopathy is treated with hyperbaric oxygen and rehabilitation.
高温车间工人头晕乏力，考虑中暑，先搬到阴凉处。 A worker in a hot workshop with dizziness and weakness was thought to have heat illness and moved to shade.
中暑分轻中重，重的会昏迷。 Heat illness is graded mild to severe, and the severe form can cause coma.
热射病患者体温四十一度、昏迷抽搐，立即降温。 The patient with heat stroke had a temperature of forty one, coma, and convulsions, so cooling started at once.
热射病降温要快，半小时内降到三十九度以下。 Heat stroke cooling must be fast, bringing the temperature below thirty nine within half an hour.
他小腿抽筋疼得直叫，是热痉挛，补点盐水就好。 He cried out with calf cramps, which is heat cramps, and salty fluids relieved it.
热痉挛关键是补盐，光喝白开水会加重。 The key to heat cramps is salt replacement, and plain water alone can worsen it.
老人热衰竭后浑身湿冷、心率快，先平卧补液。 The elderly patient with heat exhaustion was cold and clammy with a fast pulse, so he was laid flat and given fluids.
热衰竭处理及时多能恢复，但可能进展为热射病。 Heat exhaustion usually recovers with prompt care but can progress to heat stroke.
中午在地里干活后头痛呕吐，是日射病。 Headache and vomiting after working in the fields at noon indicated sunstroke.
日射病要移到阴凉处并头部冷敷。 In sunstroke move the patient to shade and apply cold to the head.
热射病降温治疗优先于转运，不能耽误。 Cooling therapy for heat stroke takes priority over transport and must not be delayed.
降温治疗目标是半小时内把核心体温降到三十九度以下。 Cooling therapy aims to bring core temperature below thirty nine within half an hour.
长跑选手比赛中倒地抽搐，诊断劳力型热射病。 A runner collapsed and convulsed during a race, and exertional heat stroke was diagnosed.
劳力型热射病进展快，现场就要开始降温。 Exertional heat stroke progresses fast, so cooling must start on site.
热射病时体温调节中枢功能衰竭，出汗停止。 In heat stroke the thermoregulatory center fails and sweating stops.
脑卒中累及体温调节中枢时会出现中枢性高热。 Stroke involving the thermoregulatory center causes central hyperthermia.
热射病后肌酸激酶上万，出现横纹肌溶解，尿色像酱油。 After heat stroke the creatine kinase exceeded ten thousand with rhabdomyolysis and cola-colored urine.
横纹肌溶解要大量补液并碱化尿液。 Rhabdomyolysis is treated with vigorous fluids and urine alkalinization.
横纹肌溶解后出现急性肾损伤，尿量越来越少。 Acute kidney injury followed rhabdomyolysis and urine output kept falling.
急性肾损伤要停用肾毒性药物并评估透析指征。 In acute kidney injury stop nephrotoxic drugs and assess the need for dialysis.
他的手指冻伤发白发硬，不能用力搓。 His frostbitten fingers were white and hard, and must not be rubbed.
冻伤要用温水复温，不能用雪搓或火烤。 Frostbite is rewarmed in warm water and never rubbed with snow or held to fire.
山中被发现时他已冻僵，核心体温二十八度。 He was found in the mountains with severe hypothermia and a core temperature of twenty eight.
冻僵患者要缓慢复温，搬动要轻。 Patients with severe hypothermia are rewarmed slowly and handled gently.
醉酒后倒在雪地一夜，长时间冷暴露导致低体温。 Found in the snow after a night of drinking, he had hypothermia from prolonged cold exposure.
冷暴露前要换干衣服，湿衣服散热快得多。 Change into dry clothes before cold exposure, since wet clothing loses heat far faster.
复温过快出现复温休克，血压掉到七十。 Too rapid rewarming produced rewarming shock with blood pressure falling to seventy.
复温休克要减慢复温速度并补液。 Rewarming shock calls for slowing the rewarming rate and giving fluids.
她手指关节处红肿发痒，一到冬天就犯，是冻疮。 Her finger joints were red, swollen, and itchy every winter, which is chilblain.
冻疮要注意保暖，不要用热水烫。 Chilblain is managed with warmth and never with scalding water.
新工人要先做热适应再上岗，能明显减少中暑。 New workers should complete heat acclimatization before starting, which clearly reduces heat illness.
热适应一般需要一到两周。 Heat acclimatization usually takes one to two weeks.
现场先蒸发降温，用喷壶喷水再用电扇吹。 Evaporative cooling was started on site with a spray bottle and a fan.
蒸发降温在干燥环境效果最好。 Evaporative cooling works best in a dry environment.
热射病首选冷水浸泡，比冰袋快得多。 Cold water immersion is preferred for heat stroke and works much faster than ice packs.
冷水浸泡时要有人扶住头部防止溺水。 During cold water immersion someone must support the head to prevent drowning.
大量出汗后要电解质补充，光喝白水会抽筋。 After heavy sweating, electrolyte replacement is needed, and plain water alone causes cramps.
电解质补充要根据血检结果调整。 Electrolyte replacement is adjusted according to blood test results.
冻伤分级要到复温后才能判断准确。 Frostbite staging is only accurate after rewarming.
按冻伤分级，他属于三度，可能保不住指尖。 By frostbite staging he was third degree and might lose the fingertips.
低体温患者心电图见奥斯本波。 The ECG of the hypothermic patient showed an Osborn wave.
复温后奥斯本波会逐渐消失。 The Osborn wave disappears gradually after rewarming.
连续热暴露超过四小时，中暑风险明显上升。 Heat exposure lasting more than four hours clearly raises the risk of heat illness.
评估热暴露时间和湿度比只看温度更有意义。 Assessing the duration of heat exposure and humidity is more useful than temperature alone.
独居老人不开空调，室内高温导致经典型热射病。 An elderly man living alone without air conditioning developed classic heat stroke indoors.
经典型热射病起病隐匿，常被家属当成中暑。 Classic heat stroke starts insidiously and families often mistake it for simple heat illness.
大血管处放冰袋，颈侧、腋下和腹股沟。 Ice packs go over large vessels at the neck, axillae, and groins.
冰袋外面要包毛巾，防止冻伤皮肤。 Wrap an ice pack in a towel to prevent skin frostbite.
温水复温要持续到皮肤变软变红。 Warm water immersion continues until the skin becomes soft and pink.
温水复温会很疼，要提前给止痛药。 Warm water immersion is very painful, so give analgesia beforehand.
长时间站岗后双脚麻木发白，是非冻结性冷伤。 Numb white feet after long hours on guard duty indicated non-freezing cold injury.
非冻结性冷伤复温要慢，不能按摩。 Non-freezing cold injury is rewarmed slowly and must not be massaged.
今天热指数四十二，户外作业要限时。 The heat index is forty two today, so outdoor work must be time limited.
热指数比气温更能反映中暑风险。 The heat index reflects heat illness risk better than air temperature alone.
她吃虾后全身起疹，是过敏反应。 She broke out in a rash all over after eating shrimp, which is an allergic reaction.
轻度过敏反应先口服抗组胺药观察。 Mild allergic reaction is observed after oral antihistamine.
打青霉素后血压骤降、喉头水肿，是过敏性休克。 Blood pressure collapsed with laryngeal edema after penicillin, indicating anaphylactic shock.
过敏性休克首选肾上腺素肌注，不是激素。 Anaphylactic shock is treated first with intramuscular epinephrine, not steroids.
诊断严重过敏反应要立即肌注肾上腺素零点五毫克。 For anaphylaxis, epinephrine zero point five milligrams is given intramuscularly at once.
严重过敏反应可累及呼吸和循环两个系统。 Anaphylaxis may involve both the respiratory and circulatory systems.
身上起了一片荨麻疹，越抓越多。 A crop of urticaria appeared and spread the more he scratched.
荨麻疹累及喉头会憋气，要马上就医。 Urticaria involving the larynx causes breathlessness and needs immediate care.
他嘴唇和眼睑突然肿起来，是血管性水肿。 His lips and eyelids swelled suddenly, which is angioedema.
血管性水肿若在舌根会迅速堵住气道。 Angioedema at the base of the tongue can rapidly obstruct the airway.
严重过敏反应导致气道水肿，声音变哑要立即处理。 Anaphylaxis caused airway edema, and a hoarse voice required immediate treatment.
气道水肿进展很快，床边要备好插管设备。 Airway edema progresses quickly, so intubation equipment must be ready at the bedside.
严重过敏反应后查类胰蛋白酶升高，支持诊断。 Raised tryptase after the event supported the diagnosis of anaphylaxis.
类胰蛋白酶要在反应后几小时内抽。 Tryptase must be sampled within hours of the reaction.
荨麻疹吃抗组胺药后痒得好多了。 The itching eased considerably after an antihistamine for urticaria.
抗组胺药有嗜睡作用，开车要小心。 Antihistamines cause drowsiness, so be careful when driving.
查出过敏原是尘螨，家里要勤晒被褥。 The allergen turned out to be dust mite, so bedding must be aired often.
明确过敏原后要教会患者主动回避。 Once the allergen is identified, patients must be taught to avoid it.
过敏原检测要停抗组胺药三天再做。 Antihistamines must be stopped for three days before allergy testing.
过敏原检测阴性也不能完全排除食物过敏。 Negative allergy testing does not fully exclude food allergy.
皮肤点刺试验十五分钟就能看结果。 The skin prick test gives results in about fifteen minutes.
皮肤点刺试验前不能大面积抓挠皮肤。 Do not scratch the skin widely before a skin prick test.
牛奶特异性IgE升高，提示牛奶蛋白过敏。 Raised specific IgE to milk suggested cow's milk protein allergy.
特异性IgE高只说明致敏，不等于一定过敏。 High specific IgE shows sensitization and does not always mean clinical allergy.
过敏性休克时组胺大量释放，血管迅速扩张。 In anaphylactic shock large amounts of histamine are released and vessels dilate rapidly.
抗组胺药只是阻断组胺，不能替代肾上腺素。 Antihistamines only block histamine and cannot replace epinephrine.
总免疫球蛋白E明显升高，提示过敏体质。 Total immunoglobulin E was clearly raised, suggesting an atopic constitution.
免疫球蛋白E升高不等于对某种东西过敏。 Raised immunoglobulin E does not mean allergy to a particular substance.
用药后躯干出现红色皮疹，先停可疑药物。 A red rash appeared on the trunk after the drug, so the suspected drug was stopped first.
皮疹伴呼吸困难要按严重过敏反应处理。 Rash with breathlessness must be managed as anaphylaxis.
他全身瘙痒难忍，抓得到处是血痕。 He had unbearable pruritus and had scratched himself bloody.
瘙痒明显时先冷敷，再口服抗组胺药。 For marked pruritus apply cool compresses first and then give an oral antihistamine.
孩子吃鸡蛋后嘴唇肿，诊断食物过敏。 The child's lips swelled after eating egg, and food allergy was diagnosed.
食物过敏要看清配料表，避免交叉污染。 In food allergy read ingredient labels and avoid cross contamination.
尘螨过敏重点是过敏原回避，勤晒被褥。 For dust mite allergy the priority is allergen avoidance with regular airing of bedding.
过敏原回避做得好的孩子发作明显减少。 Children with good allergen avoidance have far fewer attacks.
病历标注青霉素过敏，改用其他类抗生素。 The chart recorded penicillin allergy, so another antibiotic class was used.
他说青霉素过敏，我们追问是起疹还是休克过。 He reported penicillin allergy, and we asked whether it had caused a rash or shock.
有轻度反应史的患者做增强CT前做碘对比剂预处理。 Patients with mild previous reactions receive contrast premedication before contrast CT.
碘对比剂预处理不能完全防止严重反应。 Contrast premedication does not completely prevent severe reactions.
被马蜂这类昆虫蜇伤后全身起疹、声音嘶哑，立即处理。 After an insect sting by a hornet he had a rash and hoarse voice, so treatment started at once.
昆虫蜇伤后留观半小时，防止迟发过敏。 After an insect sting observe for half an hour to catch delayed allergy.
肾上腺素起效后别急着走，双相反应可能几小时后再来。 Do not rush home once epinephrine works, since a biphasic reaction may return hours later.
双相反应多见于症状重、需要多次肾上腺素的患者。 Biphasic reaction is more common in patients with severe symptoms needing repeated epinephrine.
结核菌素试验就是典型的迟发型过敏反应。 The tuberculin test is a classic delayed hypersensitivity reaction.
迟发型过敏反应和速发型机制完全不同。 Delayed hypersensitivity works by a completely different mechanism from immediate reactions.
肥大细胞脱颗粒释放组胺，几分钟内就出现症状。 Mast cells degranulate and release histamine, with symptoms appearing within minutes.
检测类胰蛋白酶可间接反映肥大细胞激活。 Measuring tryptase indirectly reflects mast cell activation.
严重过敏患者要随身带肾上腺素自动注射器。 Patients with severe allergy should carry an epinephrine auto-injector at all times.
教家属用肾上腺素自动注射器，大腿外侧垂直按下。 Teach the family to use the epinephrine auto-injector straight into the outer thigh.
花粉症可以做脱敏治疗，坚持两三年才见效。 Hay fever can be treated with desensitization, which takes two to three years to work.
脱敏治疗期间仍要随身备肾上腺素。 Epinephrine must still be carried during desensitization.
用抗蛇毒血清一周后发热起疹、关节痛，是血清病。 Fever, rash, and joint pain a week after antivenom indicated serum sickness.
血清病多为自限性，重者用糖皮质激素。 Serum sickness is usually self-limiting, and severe cases need glucocorticoids.
急诊患者出现电解质紊乱要先查血钾和血钠。 In emergency patients with electrolyte imbalance, check potassium and sodium first.
电解质紊乱纠正太快也会出问题，要慢。 Correcting an electrolyte imbalance too fast also causes problems, so go slowly.
血钠一百二十五，低钠血症明显，要限制水并慢慢补钠。 Sodium one hundred twenty five showed clear hyponatremia, so fluids were restricted and sodium corrected slowly.
低钠血症补钠不能太快，否则会损伤脑桥。 Hyponatremia must not be corrected too fast or the pons can be damaged.
高钠血症患者口渴明显、意识淡漠，先补自由水。 The patient with hypernatremia was thirsty and apathetic, so free water was given first.
高钠血症要算自由水缺失量，分次补。 In hypernatremia the free water deficit is calculated and replaced in stages.
低钾血症患者腹胀、乏力，心电图见U波。 The patient with hypokalemia had distension and weakness, and the ECG showed U waves.
低钾血症补钾不能静脉推注，必须稀释后滴。 Potassium for hypokalemia is never pushed but given diluted by infusion.
血钾六点八，心电图T波高尖，是高钾血症，立即处理。 Potassium of six point eight with peaked T waves indicated hyperkalemia, so treatment started at once.
高钾血症先静脉补钙保护心肌，再促钾转移。 In hyperkalemia give intravenous calcium to protect the heart first, then shift potassium.
她手指抽成爪形、口周发麻，查低钙血症。 Her fingers cramped into a claw shape and her mouth tingled, and tests showed hypocalcemia.
低钙血症要静脉补钙并查镁。 Hypocalcemia requires intravenous calcium and a check of magnesium.
高钙血症患者多尿、便秘又嗜睡，容易漏诊。 Hypercalcemia causes polyuria, constipation, and drowsiness and is easily missed.
高钙血症要查甲状旁腺激素和肿瘤。 Hypercalcemia requires measurement of parathyroid hormone and a search for tumor.
顽固低钾血症查血镁，发现低镁血症。 In refractory hypokalemia magnesium was checked and hypomagnesemia found.
低镁血症不纠正，低钾也很难补上来。 Unless hypomagnesemia is corrected, potassium is hard to raise.
乳酸升高伴血pH下降，是代谢性酸中毒。 Raised lactate with a falling pH indicated metabolic acidosis.
代谢性酸中毒要看阴离子间隙找原因。 In metabolic acidosis the anion gap helps identify the cause.
反复呕吐后血气提示代谢性碱中毒。 Blood gases after repeated vomiting showed metabolic alkalosis.
代谢性碱中毒补生理盐水多数能纠正。 Metabolic alkalosis usually corrects with normal saline.
慢阻肺急性加重出现呼吸性酸中毒，需要无创通气。 Respiratory acidosis in a COPD exacerbation required non-invasive ventilation.
呼吸性酸中毒关键是改善通气，不是补碱。 The key to respiratory acidosis is better ventilation, not alkali.
他吵架后大口喘气、手脚发麻，是呼吸性碱中毒。 After an argument he gasped and his hands tingled, which is respiratory alkalosis.
呼吸性碱中毒要先安抚情绪，减慢呼吸。 Respiratory alkalosis is first managed by calming the patient and slowing breathing.
阴离子间隙二十，提示有机酸堆积。 An anion gap of twenty indicated accumulation of organic acids.
阴离子间隙正常也不能完全排除酸中毒。 A normal anion gap does not completely exclude acidosis.
补钾治疗期间要复查血钾并监测尿量。 During potassium replacement, repeat potassium and monitor urine output.
补钾治疗前要先看肾功能和尿量。 Before potassium replacement check renal function and urine output.
高钾血症先静脉补钙稳定心肌细胞膜。 In hyperkalemia intravenous calcium stabilizes the myocardial membrane first.
静脉补钙速度要慢，外渗会造成组织坏死。 Intravenous calcium is given slowly, and extravasation causes tissue necrosis.
口服氯化钾对胃肠刺激大，要饭后吃。 Oral potassium chloride irritates the gut and should be taken after meals.
氯化钾静脉滴注浓度不能超过千分之三。 Intravenous potassium chloride must not exceed a concentration of three per thousand.
血糖极高时血浆渗透压明显升高。 With extremely high glucose the plasma osmolality rises markedly.
渗透压算出来可以判断高渗状态。 Calculated osmolality helps identify a hyperosmolar state.
术后每天记录出入量，维持水电解质平衡。 Daily intake and output are recorded after surgery to maintain fluid and electrolyte balance.
维护水电解质平衡比单纯补液更复杂。 Maintaining fluid and electrolyte balance is more complex than simply giving fluids.
长期呕吐后血氯偏低，出现低氯血症。 Prolonged vomiting lowered chloride and produced hypochloremia.
低氯血症常与代谢性碱中毒同时存在。 Hypochloremia often coexists with metabolic alkalosis.
长期禁食后出现低磷血症，患者四肢无力。 Hypophosphatemia appeared after prolonged fasting and the patient had weak limbs.
低磷血症严重时要静脉补磷。 Severe hypophosphatemia requires intravenous phosphate.
尿毒症患者高磷血症明显，要限磷饮食。 Hyperphosphatemia was marked in the uremic patient, so a phosphate-restricted diet was started.
高磷血症会加重继发性甲状旁腺功能亢进。 Hyperphosphatemia worsens secondary hyperparathyroidism.
重症患者要每天评估酸碱平衡。 Acid-base balance is assessed daily in critically ill patients.
酸碱平衡紊乱分呼吸性和代谢性两类。 Acid-base balance disturbances are classified as respiratory or metabolic.
小伙子半夜突然四肢不能动，查低钾性周期性麻痹。 The young man suddenly could not move his limbs at night, and hypokalemic periodic paralysis was found.
低钾性周期性麻痹补钾后肌力很快恢复。 Muscle power recovers quickly in hypokalemic periodic paralysis after potassium replacement.
碱剩余负值明显，提示代谢性酸中毒。 A markedly negative base excess indicated metabolic acidosis.
碱剩余比单纯看pH更能反映代谢因素。 Base excess reflects the metabolic component better than pH alone.
血钠一百一十伴抽搐，诊断低钠性脑病。 Sodium of one hundred ten with seizures led to a diagnosis of hyponatremic encephalopathy.
低钠性脑病补钠要快一点，但不能过矫。 Sodium is corrected a little faster in hyponatremic encephalopathy but must not be overcorrected.
肾衰患者用了含镁泻药后出现高镁血症，反射减弱。 After a magnesium-containing laxative the renal failure patient developed hypermagnesemia with reduced reflexes.
高镁血症严重时可用钙剂拮抗。 Severe hypermagnesemia can be countered with calcium.
高血糖引起渗透性利尿，患者尿多又脱水。 Hyperglycemia causes osmotic diuresis, with heavy urine output and dehydration.
渗透性利尿会带走大量钾和钠。 Osmotic diuresis carries away large amounts of potassium and sodium.
患者晕厥一次，几十秒就醒了，先做心电图。 The patient had one syncope episode and woke within seconds, so an ECG came first.
晕厥和昏迷不一样，晕厥能自己醒。 Syncope differs from coma because the patient wakes up on their own.
他站着排队时眼前发黑晕倒，是血管迷走性晕厥。 He blacked out while standing in a queue, which is vasovagal syncope.
血管迷走性晕厥多半有诱因，如闷热、久站。 Vasovagal syncope usually has triggers such as heat or prolonged standing.

zh: 直立性心动过速综合征
text: 她站立后心率涨了四十次，诊断直立性心动过速综合征。 Her heart rate rose by forty on standing, and postural tachycardia syndrome was diagnosed.

zh: 直立性心动过速综合征
text: 直立性心动过速综合征要增加水和盐的摄入。 Postural tachycardia syndrome is managed with more water and salt intake.
运动中晕厥伴心悸，要警惕心源性晕厥。 Syncope during exercise with palpitations warrants concern for cardiac syncope.
心源性晕厥猝死风险最高，必须查心脏。 Cardiac syncope carries the highest risk of sudden death and needs full cardiac workup.
他每次咳得厉害就晕一下，属于情境性晕厥。 He fainted whenever he coughed hard, which is situational syncope.
情境性晕厥多为良性，但要排除心脏问题。 Situational syncope is usually benign but cardiac causes must be excluded.
系紧领带或转头就晕，要考虑颈动脉窦综合征。 Fainting with a tight collar or head turning suggests carotid sinus syndrome.
颈动脉窦综合征多见于老年男性。 Carotid sinus syndrome is most common in older men.
他说有晕厥前兆，眼前发黑、耳朵嗡嗡响。 He described presyncope with dim vision and ringing in the ears.
有晕厥前兆要立即坐下或蹲下，防止摔伤。 With presyncope sit or squat at once to prevent a fall injury.
直立倾斜试验阳性，支持血管迷走性晕厥。 A positive tilt table test supported vasovagal syncope.
直立倾斜试验前要空腹四小时。 Patients fast for four hours before a tilt table test.
反射性晕厥占晕厥的大多数，预后较好。 Reflex syncope accounts for most syncope and has a good prognosis.
反射性晕厥要和心源性晕厥区分开。 Reflex syncope must be distinguished from cardiac syncope.
她直立不耐受明显，站十分钟就心慌。 Her orthostatic intolerance was marked, with palpitations after ten minutes standing.
直立不耐受要增加水和盐的摄入。 Orthostatic intolerance is managed with more water and salt intake.
短暂意识丧失要先区分是晕厥、癫痫还是低血糖。 Transient loss of consciousness is first classified as syncope, seizure, or hypoglycemia.
短暂意识丧失的患者摔伤头部要一并评估。 Head injury during transient loss of consciousness must be assessed too.
晕厥时抽了几下，别急着诊断癫痫，可能是惊厥性晕厥。 A few jerks during fainting should not be labelled epilepsy at once, since convulsive syncope is possible.
惊厥性晕厥抽搐时间短，很快恢复。 Convulsive syncope causes only brief jerking and rapid recovery.
反复晕厥查不出原因，做了心内电生理检查。 With repeated unexplained syncope an electrophysiological study was performed.
心内电生理检查可以诱发并定位心律失常。 An electrophysiological study can induce and localize an arrhythmia.
晕厥反复发作，安排动态心电监测一周。 For recurrent syncope, ambulatory ECG monitoring was arranged for a week.
动态心电监测期间要记录症状发生的时间。 Note the time of symptoms during ambulatory ECG monitoring.
晕厥发作时抓到室速，诊断心律失常性晕厥，需装除颤器。 Ventricular tachycardia was captured during the syncope, so arrhythmogenic syncope was diagnosed and a defibrillator advised.
心律失常性晕厥复发风险高，不能只观察。 Arrhythmogenic syncope has a high recurrence risk and cannot simply be observed.
结构性心脏病患者出现晕厥要尽快做超声。 Syncope in a patient with structural heart disease calls for urgent echocardiography.
结构性心脏病是心源性晕厥的重要基础。 Structural heart disease is an important substrate for cardiac syncope.
复发性晕厥患者要留观并做心脏评估。 Patients with recurrent syncope need observation and cardiac assessment.
复发性晕厥对生活影响大，容易摔伤。 Recurrent syncope greatly affects daily life and risks injury.
晕厥评估第一步是问清楚有没有前驱症状。 The first step in syncope assessment is asking about prodromal symptoms.
晕厥评估高危的患者要留观而不是回家。 High-risk patients on syncope assessment need observation rather than discharge.
呕血后血容量不足，患者心率快、皮肤湿冷。 After hematemesis hypovolemia caused a fast pulse and clammy skin.
血容量不足先补晶体液，必要时输血。 Hypovolemia is treated with crystalloids first and blood products if needed.
他一连串咳嗽后晕倒，是咳嗽性晕厥。 He fainted after a bout of coughing, which is cough syncope.
咳嗽性晕厥要查慢阻肺和肺动脉高压。 Cough syncope warrants checking for COPD and pulmonary hypertension.
他半夜起来小便时晕倒，是排尿性晕厥。 He fainted while getting up to urinate at night, which is micturition syncope.
排尿性晕厥多见于饮酒后或憋尿过久的男性。 Micturition syncope is more common in men after alcohol or prolonged bladder distension.

第二产程延长，考虑胎头下降停滞。 The second stage of labor was prolonged, suggesting arrest of fetal head descent.
第二产程了，宫缩时用力。 You are in the second stage of labor; push with each contraction.
第三产程常规使用缩宫素预防出血。 Oxytocin is given routinely in the third stage of labor to prevent bleeding.
第三产程别催，等胎盘自己下来。 Do not rush the third stage of labor; wait for the placenta to deliver.
产程延长伴产妇发热，考虑绒毛膜羊膜炎。 Prolonged labor with maternal fever raised concern for chorioamnionitis.
产程延长了，得看看是不是头盆不称。 Labor is prolonged; let us check for cephalopelvic disproportion.
活跃期停滞，行人工破膜并加用缩宫素。 With arrest of the active phase, artificial rupture of membranes and oxytocin augmentation were performed.
活跃期停滞了，跟家属谈剖宫产。 The active phase has arrested, so discuss cesarean delivery with the family.
孕三十七周胎膜早破，予抗生素并引产。 At 37 weeks with premature rupture of membranes, antibiotics were given and labor was induced.
胎膜早破了，先别下床走动。 Your membranes have ruptured early, so stay in bed for now.
脐带脱垂，立即抬高臀部并送手术室。 Umbilical cord prolapse occurred, so the hips were elevated and she was rushed to the operating room.
脐带脱垂，用手先托住胎头。 Umbilical cord prolapse; support the fetal head with your hand first.
羊水栓塞起病急骤，需多学科同时抢救。 Amniotic fluid embolism has a sudden onset and requires simultaneous multidisciplinary resuscitation.
怀疑羊水栓塞，叫麻醉和ICU。 I suspect amniotic fluid embolism; call anesthesia and the ICU.
发生肩难产，记录胎头娩出至胎儿娩出时间。 Shoulder dystocia occurred, and the head-to-body delivery interval was recorded.
肩难产，快屈大腿压耻骨。 Shoulder dystocia; flex the hips and apply suprapubic pressure now.
臀位足先露，择期剖宫产。 With a footling breech presentation, elective cesarean delivery was planned.
她是臀位，别等破水。 She has a breech presentation, so do not wait for her membranes to rupture.
横位临产须立即剖宫产，防子宫破裂。 Transverse lie in labor requires immediate cesarean delivery to prevent uterine rupture.
横位，赶紧推手术室。 It is a transverse lie; get her to the operating room right away.
超声提示胎位不正，讨论分娩方式。 Ultrasound showed malpresentation, so the mode of delivery was discussed.
胎位不正，先别急着生。 There is malpresentation, so do not rush the delivery.
评估后建议尝试阴道分娩。 After assessment, a trial of vaginal delivery was recommended.
条件好，可以阴道分娩。 The conditions are favorable, so vaginal delivery is possible.
过期妊娠予引产，放置宫颈球囊。 For post-term pregnancy, labor was induced with a cervical balloon.
明天给您引产，今晚先放药。 We will induce labor tomorrow; tonight we will place the medication.
分娩镇痛后疼痛评分由八分降至两分。 After labor analgesia the pain score fell from eight to two.
想打分娩镇痛随时说，宫口开三指就能打。 Tell us whenever you want labor analgesia; we can start at three centimeters.
行会阴侧切娩出胎儿，产后逐层缝合。 An episiotomy was performed to deliver the baby, and the incision was closed in layers.
会阴侧切一下，孩子快出来了。 I will do a quick episiotomy; the baby is coming.
第二产程延长，行胎头吸引助产。 For prolonged second stage, vacuum extraction was used.
胎头吸引准备，宫缩时一起用力。 Prepare for vacuum extraction and push with the contraction.
产钳助产后检查有无头皮血肿。 After forceps delivery the newborn was checked for scalp hematoma.
产钳助产，儿科医生到场。 Forceps delivery; have the pediatrician present.
胎心音一百四十次每分，节律整齐。 Fetal heart tones were 140 beats per minute with a regular rhythm.
听到胎心音了，很稳。 We can hear the fetal heart tones, and they are steady.
宫底高度小于孕周，需超声核实。 Fundal height was smaller than expected for gestational age, so ultrasound was arranged.
量一下宫底高度，看看长得够不够。 Let us measure fundal height to see if the baby is growing well.
院前分娩新生儿入院时体温偏低。 The newborn from the prehospital delivery arrived with low body temperature.
院前分娩的母子到了，先保暖。 The mother and baby from the prehospital delivery are here; keep them warm first.
产程图显示宫口扩张曲线变平，考虑停滞。 The partograph showed a flattening dilation curve, suggesting arrest.
产程图画勤一点，两小时一记。 Update the partograph regularly, every two hours.
异位妊娠破裂，急诊行腹腔镜手术。 The ectopic pregnancy had ruptured, so emergency laparoscopy was performed.
怀疑异位妊娠，先查血HCG和超声。 I suspect an ectopic pregnancy; check the blood hCG and do an ultrasound first.
输卵管妊娠未破裂，予甲氨蝶呤保守治疗。 The unruptured tubal pregnancy was treated conservatively with methotrexate.
是输卵管妊娠，还没破。 It is a tubal pregnancy, and it has not ruptured yet.
妊娠试验阳性，结合腹痛需排除异位妊娠。 The pregnancy test was positive, and with abdominal pain ectopic pregnancy had to be excluded.
先做个妊娠试验，很快出结果。 We will do a pregnancy test first; the result comes back quickly.
卵巢扭转可能，急诊腹腔镜探查。 Ovarian torsion was suspected, so emergency laparoscopy was performed.
突然一侧剧痛，怕是卵巢扭转。 Sudden severe one-sided pain; I am afraid it is ovarian torsion.
黄体破裂伴腹腔积液，行保守观察。 Ruptured corpus luteum with pelvic fluid was managed with observation.
黄体破裂，出血不多可以先观察。 It is a ruptured corpus luteum; with little bleeding we can observe first.
盆腔炎性疾病予广谱抗生素静脉治疗。 Pelvic inflammatory disease was treated with intravenous broad-spectrum antibiotics.
盆腔炎性疾病要足疗程，别好点就停。 Pelvic inflammatory disease needs a full course; do not stop when you feel better.
异常子宫出血查因，先排除妊娠与内膜病变。 For abnormal uterine bleeding, pregnancy and endometrial pathology were excluded first.
异常子宫出血得做个超声看看内膜。 With abnormal uterine bleeding we need an ultrasound of the lining.
多发子宫肌瘤，最大直径六厘米。 Multiple uterine fibroids were present, the largest measuring 6 cm.
子宫肌瘤是良性的，先定期复查。 The uterine fibroid is benign, so we will follow it with regular checks.
子宫内膜异位症致严重痛经，考虑手术。 Endometriosis caused severe dysmenorrhea, and surgery was considered.
子宫内膜异位症容易复发，术后要随访。 Endometriosis tends to recur, so follow-up is needed after surgery.
卵巢过度刺激综合征伴腹水，收住院补液。 Ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome with ascites was admitted for fluid therapy.
是卵巢过度刺激综合征，肚子胀得厉害。 It is ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome, and her abdomen is very distended.
自然流产两次，建议查染色体。 After two spontaneous abortions, chromosome testing was recommended.
这次是自然流产，好好休息。 This was a spontaneous abortion, so rest well.
不全流产伴大出血，行急诊清宫。 Incomplete abortion with heavy bleeding required emergency curettage.
不全流产，得清一下宫。 It is an incomplete abortion, so the uterus needs to be cleared.
稽留流产两周，建议药物或手术处理。 The missed abortion had been present for two weeks, and medical or surgical management was advised.
是稽留流产，胚胎已经没心跳了。 It is a missed abortion; there is no fetal heartbeat anymore.
难免流产伴宫颈口扩张，行清宫术。 With an inevitable abortion and a dilated cervix, curettage was performed.
已经是难免流产了，这胎保不住。 It is already an inevitable abortion; this pregnancy cannot be saved.
先兆流产予卧床休息与黄体酮支持。 For threatened abortion, bed rest and progesterone support were advised.
这是先兆流产，先保胎看看。 This is a threatened abortion; we will try to preserve the pregnancy.
患者要求人工流产，已完成术前评估。 The patient requested an induced abortion, and preoperative assessment was completed.
人工流产要签知情同意。 An induced abortion requires signed informed consent.
药物流产适用于孕七周以内。 Medical abortion is suitable within seven weeks of gestation.
药物流产会腹痛流血，属正常反应。 Medical abortion causes cramps and bleeding, which is a normal response.
超声呈落雪状，诊断葡萄胎。 Ultrasound showed a snowstorm pattern, confirming a hydatidiform mole.
是葡萄胎，清宫后要定期查HCG。 It is a hydatidiform mole; hCG must be checked regularly after evacuation.
绒毛膜癌对化疗敏感，行多药联合方案。 Choriocarcinoma is chemosensitive, and a multidrug regimen was started.
病理报告是绒毛膜癌，得转肿瘤科。 The pathology report shows choriocarcinoma, so transfer to oncology.
急性盆腔痛患者先做妊娠试验与超声。 In acute pelvic pain, a pregnancy test and ultrasound were done first.
急性盆腔痛多久了，一侧还是中间。 How long have you had acute pelvic pain, and is it on one side or in the middle.
性传播感染需同时治疗性伴侣。 Sexually transmitted infection requires treating the partner as well.
性传播感染要查梅毒、淋病和衣原体。 For sexually transmitted infection we test for syphilis, gonorrhea, and chlamydia.
淋病予头孢曲松单次肌内注射。 Gonorrhea was treated with a single intramuscular dose of ceftriaxone.
淋病要取宫颈分泌物送检。 For gonorrhea, cervical discharge is collected for testing.
衣原体感染予阿奇霉素口服。 Chlamydial infection was treated with oral azithromycin.
衣原体感染没症状，也要治。 Chlamydial infection often has no symptoms, but it still needs treatment.
细菌性阴道病予甲硝唑治疗。 Bacterial vaginosis was treated with metronidazole.
细菌性阴道病有鱼腥味，不属性传播。 Bacterial vaginosis causes a fishy odor and is not sexually transmitted.

zh: 外阴阴道假丝酵母菌病
text: 外阴阴道假丝酵母菌病予克霉唑阴道片。 Vulvovaginal candidiasis was treated with a clotrimazole vaginal tablet.

zh: 外阴阴道假丝酵母菌病
text: 外阴阴道假丝酵母菌病容易反复。 Vulvovaginal candidiasis tends to recur.
七十二小时内可服紧急避孕药。 Emergency contraception can be taken within seventy-two hours.
紧急避孕越早吃越有效。 Emergency contraception works better the sooner it is taken.
清宫术中疑子宫穿孔，停止操作并观察。 Uterine perforation was suspected during curettage, so the procedure was stopped and the patient observed.
子宫穿孔了，先别动，叫上级。 There is a uterine perforation; stop and call the senior doctor.
入抢救室先看儿科评估三角，外观明显异常。 On arrival in the resuscitation room, the pediatric assessment triangle showed an abnormal appearance.
先看儿科评估三角，这孩子外观不对。 Look at the pediatric assessment triangle first; this child does not look right.
儿童早期预警评分升至五分，通知医生。 The pediatric early warning score rose to five, and the doctor was notified.
儿童早期预警评分高了，快叫医生。 The pediatric early warning score is high; call the doctor.
昏迷患儿用儿童体重估算确定给药剂量。 In the unconscious child, weight estimation was used to set drug doses.
先做儿童体重估算，按公斤给药。 Do a weight estimation first and dose by kilogram.
体检时做生长发育评估，语言发育稍落后。 Growth and development assessment at the checkup showed slightly delayed language.
每半年做一次生长发育评估。 Growth and development assessment is done every six months.
头围测量连续三个月增长过快，需排查脑积水。 Head circumference measurement showed rapid growth for three months, so hydrocephalus was excluded.
给孩子做个头围测量，看看长的速度。 Let us do a head circumference measurement to check the growth rate.
前囟平坦，大小约两厘米。 The anterior fontanelle was flat and about two centimeters wide.
摸摸前囟，看有没有鼓起来。 Feel the anterior fontanelle to see whether it is bulging.
患儿囟门膨隆伴呕吐，警惕颅内感染。 The child had a bulging fontanelle with vomiting, raising concern for intracranial infection.
囟门膨隆，得赶紧降颅压。 The fontanelle is bulging; we need to lower the intracranial pressure now.
婴儿肌张力偏低，四肢松软。 Infant muscle tone was reduced, with floppy limbs.
婴儿肌张力怎么样，抱起来软不软。 How is the infant muscle tone; does the baby feel floppy when you lift them.
儿童疼痛评估用表情量表，孩子说疼得厉害。 Pediatric pain assessment used a faces scale, and the child reported severe pain.
先做儿童疼痛评估，再决定用不用镇痛。 Do a pediatric pain assessment first, then decide about analgesia.
疼痛面部表情量表评分四分，属中度疼痛。 The Wong-Baker FACES pain scale score was four, indicating moderate pain.
让孩子指一下疼痛面部表情量表。 Ask the child to point to the Wong-Baker FACES pain scale.
家长陈述孩子昨晚开始拒食。 The parental report was that the child had refused food since last night.
家长陈述很重要，请仔细说过程。 The parental report matters; please describe what happened in detail.
儿童体格检查从观察开始，最后查咽部。 The pediatric physical examination began with observation and ended with the throat.
做儿童体格检查时先别碰孩子。 During the pediatric physical examination, do not touch the child at first.
营养状况评估提示轻度贫血与蛋白质不足。 Nutritional status assessment suggested mild anemia and low protein intake.
先做营养状况评估，再定喂养方案。 Do a nutritional status assessment first, then plan feeding.
年龄别体重低于第三百分位。 Weight-for-age was below the third percentile.
年龄别体重要对照生长曲线看。 Weight-for-age must be read against the growth chart.
身高别体重提示中度急性营养不良。 Weight-for-height indicated moderate acute malnutrition.
身高别体重比年龄别体重更能看急性营养。 Weight-for-height shows acute nutrition better than weight-for-age.
反应性评估仅对疼痛有反应，属昏睡。 Responsiveness assessment showed reaction only to pain, consistent with stupor.
先做反应性评估，看叫不叫得醒。 Do a responsiveness assessment first to see whether the child wakes.
患儿微弱哭声伴呻吟，需立即评估。 The infant had a weak cry with grunting and needed immediate assessment.
孩子微弱哭声，跟平时不一样。 The baby has a weak cry, different from usual.
喂养史显示近两天只喝少量水。 The feeding history showed only small amounts of water for two days.
问一下喂养史，吃奶好不好。 Ask about the feeding history; is the baby feeding well.
儿童疫苗接种史不全，麻疹疫苗未种。 The pediatric immunization history was incomplete, with no measles vaccine recorded.
查一下儿童疫苗接种史，本子上有吗。 Check the pediatric immunization history; is it in the booklet.
出生史提示早产并窒息，需随访发育。 The birth history showed prematurity with asphyxia, so developmental follow-up was arranged.
出生史很重要，孩子是顺产吗。 The birth history matters; was the baby born vaginally.
早产儿出院后需定期评估生长与眼底。 A preterm infant needs regular growth and retinal checks after discharge.
他是早产儿，纠正月龄再评估。 He is a preterm infant, so assess using corrected age.
低出生体重儿转入新生儿病房观察。 The low birth weight infant was admitted to the newborn ward for observation.
低出生体重儿要勤喂，注意保暖。 Low birth weight infants need frequent feeds and warmth.
巨大儿娩出后查血糖，警惕低血糖。 After delivery of a macrosomia, blood glucose was checked for hypoglycemia.
是巨大儿，肩难产风险高。 This is a macrosomia, so the risk of shoulder dystocia is high.
儿童转运前先建立静脉通路并固定气道。 Before pediatric transport, intravenous access was secured and the airway stabilized.
儿童转运要带好抢救箱和氧气。 For pediatric transport, bring the emergency kit and oxygen.
家长陪同可减轻患儿恐惧，但需说明配合要求。 Parental presence reduces a child's fear, but the caregiver must be told how to help.
可以家长陪同，请站在孩子头侧。 Parental presence is allowed; please stand by the child's head.
儿童生长发育曲线显示体重增长变慢。 The growth chart showed slowing weight gain.
把儿童生长发育曲线调出来对照。 Bring up the growth chart for comparison.
体格生长指标均低于同龄儿童中位数。 All anthropometric measurements were below the median for age.
先量体格生长指标，再判断营养。 Measure the anthropometric indices first, then judge nutrition.
儿童发热先看精神反应，再决定是否就诊。 In pediatric fever, check the child's general condition before deciding on a visit.
孩子儿童发热两天了，退了又烧。 The child has had pediatric fever for two days, settling and rising again.
儿童高热到三十九度五，孩子精神萎靡。 With a pediatric high fever of 39.5 degrees, the child was listless.
出现儿童高热先看精神反应，再决定是否用退热药。 With pediatric high fever, check the child's condition before deciding on an antipyretic.
小儿超高热伴意识改变，需立即降温。 Pediatric hyperpyrexia with altered consciousness requires immediate cooling.
小儿超高热了，冰毯和补液一起上。 The child has pediatric hyperpyrexia; start the cooling blanket and fluids.
热峰逐日下降，说明治疗有效。 The peak temperature fell day by day, showing that treatment was working.
这几天的热峰多少度。 What has the peak temperature been over the past few days.
热性惊厥发作约一分钟自行停止。 The febrile seizure stopped on its own after about one minute.
热性惊厥时让孩子侧卧，别往嘴里塞东西。 During a febrile seizure, turn the child on the side and do not put anything in the mouth.
复杂性热性惊厥需做脑电图评估。 Complex febrile seizure required an electroencephalogram for assessment.
这次是复杂性热性惊厥，得住院查。 This one is a complex febrile seizure, so admission for tests is needed.
热性惊厥持续状态按癫痫持续状态处理，首选苯二氮卓类。 Febrile status epilepticus is managed as status epilepticus, starting with a benzodiazepine.
热性惊厥持续状态，快推地西泮。 This is febrile status epilepticus; give diazepam now.
退热药间隔至少四小时，二十四小时不超过四次。 Antipyretics are given at least four hours apart and no more than four times a day.
退热药先别急着吃，看孩子精神。 Do not rush the antipyretic; watch how the child behaves.
布洛芬六至八小时一次，饭后服。 Ibuprofen is given every six to eight hours with food.
布洛芬六小时一次，脱水时慎用。 Ibuprofen every six hours, and use it cautiously when the child is dehydrated.
儿童物理降温用温水擦浴，禁用酒精擦浴。 Pediatric physical cooling uses tepid sponging; alcohol rubs are forbidden.
先做儿童物理降温，把衣服解开。 Start pediatric physical cooling and loosen the child's clothes.
退热处理后两小时复测体温。 Temperature was rechecked two hours after antipyretic treatment.
退热处理了还不退，就回来复诊。 If the fever persists after antipyretic treatment, come back for review.
发热护理记录每四小时一次体温。 Fever care included a temperature record every four hours.
发热护理记住补水、测温和看精神。 Fever care means fluids, temperature checks, and watching the child's behavior.
发热伴皮疹第三天出疹，从耳后开始。 Fever with rash appeared on the third day, starting behind the ears.
发热伴皮疹先别上学，可能传染。 With fever with rash, keep the child home from school; it may be contagious.
幼儿急疹热退后躯干出现红色斑丘疹。 In roseola infantum, a red maculopapular rash appeared on the trunk after the fever resolved.
这是幼儿急疹，出了疹子就好了。 This is roseola infantum; once the rash appears the child recovers.
麻疹患儿需呼吸道隔离并补充维生素A。 Children with measles need respiratory isolation and vitamin A supplementation.
麻疹传染性强，家里人查疫苗记录。 Measles is highly contagious, so check the family's vaccination records.
疱疹性咽峡炎患儿因咽痛拒食。 A child with herpangina refuses food because of sore throat.
疱疹性咽峡炎传染，别跟小朋友玩。 Herpangina is contagious, so keep the child away from other children.
猩红热予青霉素治疗十天。 Scarlet fever was treated with penicillin for ten days.
猩红热要隔离到退热后两天。 With scarlet fever, isolate until two days after the fever settles.
川崎病发热超过五天伴草莓舌，需查心脏超声。 Kawasaki disease with fever over five days and strawberry tongue required echocardiography.
川崎病要尽早用丙种球蛋白。 Kawasaki disease should be treated with intravenous immunoglobulin early.
疫苗接种后发热一般不超过三十八度五。 Post-vaccination fever usually stays below 38.5 degrees.
疫苗接种后发热不用慌，多喝水。 Do not worry about post-vaccination fever; give plenty of fluids.
出牙期发热多为低热，精神好。 Teething fever is usually mild and the infant remains active.
出牙期发热一般不用吃药。 Teething fever usually does not need medication.
发热患儿观察期间出现抽搐立即处理。 During observation of a febrile child, any seizure was treated immediately.
发热患儿观察两小时，精神好可以回家。 Observe the febrile child for two hours; if active, the child may go home.
小儿感染性发热需寻找感染灶。 Pediatric infectious fever requires a search for the source.
小儿感染性发热先查血常规和C反应蛋白。 For pediatric infectious fever, check the blood count and C-reactive protein first.
小儿非感染性发热要考虑川崎病。 Pediatric non-infectious fever raises consideration of Kawasaki disease.
抗生素用了还烧，可能是小儿非感染性发热。 Still febrile on antibiotics; it may be pediatric non-infectious fever.
婴儿体温测量首选腋温，安全易行。 Axillary measurement is the preferred method for infant temperature measurement.
婴儿体温测量别用口表，孩子会咬。 For infant temperature measurement, do not use an oral thermometer; the baby may bite it.
发热家庭护理要点已向家长书面交代。 The key points of home fever care were explained to the parents in writing.
发热家庭护理记住三条：喝水、退烧、看精神。 Home fever care has three rules: fluids, antipyretics, and watching the child.
婴幼儿脱水时眼窝凹陷、皮肤弹性差。 Infant dehydration presents with sunken eyes and poor skin turgor.
孩子是婴幼儿脱水，先补液。 The child has infant dehydration; start fluids first.
轻度脱水可口服补液盐纠正。 Mild dehydration can be corrected with oral rehydration salts.
轻度脱水，回家喝口服补液盐。 It is mild dehydration; go home and drink oral rehydration salts.
中度脱水患儿需静脉或鼻胃管补液。 A child with moderate dehydration needs intravenous or nasogastric fluids.
中度脱水了，得留观补液。 This is moderate dehydration, so stay for fluids.
重度脱水表现为脉弱、四肢凉与意识改变。 Severe dehydration presents with a weak pulse, cold limbs, and altered consciousness.
重度脱水，马上开两条静脉通路。 Severe dehydration; get two intravenous lines going now.
脱水程度评估为中度，按计划补液。 Dehydration assessment indicated moderate loss, and fluids were given accordingly.
先做脱水程度评估，再定补多少。 Do a dehydration assessment first, then decide the fluid volume.
等渗性脱水最常见，血钠一百三十五毫摩尔。 Isotonic dehydration is the most common type, with a sodium of 135 mmol per liter.
等渗性脱水用等张液补。 Use isotonic fluid for isotonic dehydration.
低渗性脱水易出现抽搐与脑水肿。 Hypotonic dehydration predisposes to seizures and cerebral edema.
低渗性脱水补钠要慢。 Correct sodium slowly in hypotonic dehydration.
高渗性脱水补液过快可致惊厥。 Correcting hypernatremic dehydration too fast can cause seizures.
高渗性脱水降钠不能太快。 Do not lower sodium too fast in hypernatremic dehydration.
口服补液盐每袋冲二百五十毫升温水。 Each sachet of oral rehydration salts is dissolved in 250 mL of warm water.
口服补液盐按说明配，别加糖。 Mix oral rehydration salts as instructed and do not add sugar.
口服补液治疗成功率达九成以上。 Oral rehydration therapy succeeds in more than ninety percent of cases.
口服补液少量多次喂。 Give oral rehydration therapy in small amounts often.
静脉补液先补累积损失量再补维持量。 Intravenous rehydration replaces the deficit first and then maintenance needs.
静脉补液开上了，注意速度。 Intravenous rehydration has started; watch the rate.
小儿补液速度过快可致心力衰竭。 An excessive pediatric fluid infusion rate can cause heart failure.
小儿补液速度调慢点，孩子尿多了。 Slow the pediatric fluid infusion rate; the child is passing more urine.
累积损失量按体重下降百分之八估算。 The fluid deficit was estimated from an eight percent weight loss.
累积损失量先补一半。 Replace half of the fluid deficit first.
继续损失量按等量液体补充。 Ongoing losses are replaced with equal volumes of fluid.
继续损失量要记呕吐和腹泻的量。 For ongoing losses, record the volume of vomit and stool.
生理需要量按体重第一个十公斤每小时四毫升计算。 Maintenance fluid requirement is 4 mL per kg per hour for the first 10 kg.
生理需要量别忘了算进去。 Do not forget to include the maintenance fluid requirement.
前囟凹陷伴皮肤弹性差，提示中度脱水。 A sunken fontanelle with poor skin turgor suggests moderate dehydration.
前囟凹陷了，孩子脱水不轻。 The fontanelle is sunken; the child is significantly dehydrated.
皮肤弹性评估差提示细胞外液明显减少。 A poor skin turgor assessment indicates a marked reduction in extracellular fluid.
皮肤弹性评估一下，捏起来回不去就是差。 Do a skin turgor assessment; if the skin stays up, it is poor.
眼窝凹陷与黏膜干燥同时出现。 Sunken eyes appeared together with dry mucous membranes.
眼窝凹陷，说明脱水了。 The eyes are sunken, which means dehydration.
口腔黏膜干燥是脱水的早期体征。 Dry mucous membranes are an early sign of dehydration.
黏膜干燥，先让孩子喝点水。 The mucous membranes are dry; let the child drink some water.
哭时无泪伴尿量减少，符合重度脱水。 Absent tears with reduced urine output met the criteria for severe dehydration.
哭时无泪，赶紧补液。 No tears when crying; start fluids right away.
尿量减少至每公斤每小时零点五毫升以下。 Decreased urine output fell below 0.5 mL per kg per hour.
尿量减少，注意补液够不够。 Urine output is reduced; check whether fluids are adequate.
补液方案分快速扩容与维持两阶段。 The rehydration plan had a rapid expansion phase and a maintenance phase.
按补液方案走，每小时核一次量。 Follow the rehydration plan and check the volume hourly.
快速扩容用等张液二十毫升每公斤。 Rapid volume expansion used 20 mL per kg of isotonic fluid.
先快速扩容二百毫升，再重新评估。 Start rapid volume expansion with 200 mL, then reassess.
鼻胃管补液适用于拒绝口服的患儿。 Nasogastric rehydration is used for children who refuse to drink.
不肯喝就上鼻胃管补液。 If the child will not drink, start nasogastric rehydration.
口服补液失败需改为静脉补液。 Oral rehydration failure requires a change to intravenous fluids.
口服补液失败，别再喂了，改输液。 Oral rehydration has failed; stop feeding and switch to intravenous fluids.
补液后评估显示眼窝恢复、尿量增加。 Post-rehydration assessment showed the eyes had refilled and urine output increased.
补液后评估一下，精神好多了。 Do a post-rehydration assessment; the child is much more alert.
维持补液用低张含糖液缓慢静滴。 Maintenance fluid therapy used a hypotonic glucose-containing solution given slowly.
快速补完改维持补液。 After rapid rehydration, switch to maintenance fluid therapy.
新生儿复苏团队提前到场待命。 The neonatal resuscitation team was present and ready before delivery.
新生儿复苏准备，辐射台预热。 Prepare for neonatal resuscitation and warm the radiant warmer.
新生儿窒息复苏后转入新生儿重症监护。 After resuscitation for neonatal asphyxia the baby was admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit.
新生儿窒息，羊水三度污染。 Neonatal asphyxia with grade three meconium staining.
一分钟Apgar评分五分，五分钟八分。 The Apgar score was five at one minute and eight at five minutes.
Apgar评分多少，需要复苏吗。 What is the Apgar score; does the baby need resuscitation.
胎粪吸入患儿出现呼吸窘迫，予无创通气。 The infant with meconium aspiration developed respiratory distress and was supported with noninvasive ventilation.
胎粪吸入，先吸引再给氧。 Meconium aspiration; suction first, then give oxygen.
羊水胎粪污染三度，儿科医生到场。 With grade three meconium-stained amniotic fluid, the pediatrician attended the delivery.
羊水胎粪污染，破水时注意颜色。 There is meconium-stained amniotic fluid; watch the color when the membranes rupture.

zh: 新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征
text: 早产儿新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征予肺表面活性物质。 A preterm infant with neonatal respiratory distress syndrome received surfactant.

zh: 新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征
text: 新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征，先上无创通气。 Neonatal respiratory distress syndrome; start noninvasive ventilation first.
新生儿呼吸暂停发作，予触觉刺激后恢复。 The neonatal apnea episode resolved after tactile stimulation.
新生儿呼吸暂停，快刺激一下。 The baby has neonatal apnea; stimulate him quickly.
正压通气三十秒后心率回升。 Heart rate improved after thirty seconds of positive pressure ventilation.
正压通气先给三十秒，看心率。 Give positive pressure ventilation for thirty seconds, then check the heart rate.
儿童面罩通气时注意密闭与胸廓起伏。 During pediatric mask ventilation, check the seal and chest rise.
儿童面罩通气做不好就插管。 If pediatric mask ventilation is inadequate, intubate.
新生儿低体温增加死亡风险，需立即复温。 Neonatal hypothermia increases mortality and requires immediate rewarming.
新生儿低体温，先包上塑料膜。 The baby has neonatal hypothermia; wrap him in plastic first.
新生儿体温管理从产房开始。 Neonatal thermal management begins in the delivery room.
新生儿体温管理别大意，容易掉温。 Do not neglect neonatal thermal management; babies lose heat easily.
辐射保暖台预热至三十六度待用。 The radiant warmer was preheated to 36 degrees before use.
把孩子放辐射保暖台上。 Put the baby on the radiant warmer.
延迟脐带结扎可增加新生儿铁储备。 Delayed cord clamping increases neonatal iron stores.
延迟脐带结扎，等一分钟。 Delayed cord clamping; wait one minute.
脐带结扎后检查残端有无渗血。 After cord clamping the stump was checked for bleeding.
脐带结扎好了，包上脐带夹。 Cord clamping is done; put on the cord clamp.
新生儿黄疸达光疗标准，予蓝光照射。 Neonatal jaundice reached phototherapy criteria, and blue light treatment was started.
新生儿黄疸高，得照蓝光。 The neonatal jaundice is high; the baby needs phototherapy.
新生儿溶血病查胆红素与血型抗体。 In hemolytic disease of the newborn, bilirubin and blood group antibodies were checked.
新生儿溶血病，可能要换血。 Hemolytic disease of the newborn; exchange transfusion may be needed.
新生儿败血症表现为反应差与体温不稳。 Neonatal sepsis presented with poor responsiveness and unstable temperature.
新生儿败血症，先抽血培养再上抗生素。 Neonatal sepsis; take blood cultures then start antibiotics.
新生儿肺炎予抗生素与氧疗。 Neonatal pneumonia was treated with antibiotics and oxygen.
新生儿肺炎，呼吸快还有呻吟。 Neonatal pneumonia with fast breathing and grunting.
新生儿低血糖予喂养或静脉葡萄糖。 Neonatal hypoglycemia was treated with feeding or intravenous glucose.
新生儿低血糖，先喂糖水。 Neonatal hypoglycemia; give glucose water first.
新生儿惊厥表现为眨眼与口角抽动。 Neonatal seizure presented with eye blinking and mouth twitching.
新生儿惊厥不典型，得做脑电。 Neonatal seizures are atypical, so an electroencephalogram is needed.
缺氧缺血性脑病中重度需亚低温治疗。 Moderate to severe hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy requires therapeutic hypothermia.
缺氧缺血性脑病，赶紧联系亚低温。 Hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy; contact the cooling team now.
亚低温治疗须在生后六小时内开始。 Neonatal therapeutic hypothermia must start within six hours of birth.
亚低温治疗越早越好。 Neonatal therapeutic hypothermia works best when started early.
新生儿转运前稳定呼吸与血糖。 Before neonatal transport, breathing and glucose were stabilized.
新生儿转运车到了，保温箱预热。 The neonatal transport team has arrived; warm the incubator.
按新生儿复苏流程逐步执行并记录时间。 Follow the neonatal resuscitation algorithm step by step and record the times.
别乱，按新生儿复苏流程走。 Do not panic; follow the neonatal resuscitation algorithm.
新生儿评估在出生后一分钟内完成。 Newborn assessment was completed within one minute of birth.
先做新生儿评估，看肌张力。 Do a newborn assessment first and check the tone.
新生儿重症监护病房床位已满。 The neonatal intensive care unit was full.
转新生儿重症监护，家属去办手续。 Transfer to neonatal intensive care; the family should complete the paperwork.
新生儿原始反射对称存在。 Primitive reflexes were present and symmetric.
查一下新生儿原始反射，看有没有不对称。 Check the primitive reflexes for asymmetry.
儿童气道口径小，水肿一毫米即明显狭窄。 The pediatric airway is small, so one millimeter of edema causes marked narrowing.
儿童气道不好插管，管径要选小一号。 The pediatric airway is harder to intubate; choose one size smaller tube.
儿童气道评估发现吸气性凹陷与喘鸣。 Pediatric airway assessment revealed inspiratory retractions and stridor.
先做儿童气道评估，听有没有喘鸣。 Do a pediatric airway assessment first and listen for stridor.
儿童气道梗阻时出现三凹征与发绀。 Pediatric airway obstruction presents with retractions and cyanosis.
儿童气道梗阻了，先开放气道。 The child has pediatric airway obstruction; open the airway first.
儿童气道异物位于右主支气管，行支气管镜取出。 The pediatric airway foreign body was in the right main bronchus and was removed by bronchoscopy.
儿童气道异物，孩子吃花生呛到了。 Pediatric airway foreign body; the child choked on a peanut.
完全性气道梗阻需立即行海姆立克急救。 Complete airway obstruction requires the Heimlich maneuver at once.
完全性气道梗阻，赶紧腹部冲击。 Complete airway obstruction; give abdominal thrusts now.
不完全性气道梗阻时鼓励用力咳嗽。 With partial airway obstruction the patient is encouraged to cough forcefully.
不完全性气道梗阻，别乱掏，让他咳。 It is partial airway obstruction; do not dig around, let him cough.
儿童海姆立克急救法用于一岁以上异物梗阻。 The pediatric Heimlich maneuver is used for foreign body obstruction in children over one year.
儿童海姆立克急救法，站到孩子背后。 Pediatric Heimlich maneuver; stand behind the child.
儿童背部拍击五次，再翻过来按压。 Give five pediatric back blows, then turn the child over and do chest thrusts.
婴儿气道异物先做儿童背部拍击。 For an infant with a foreign body, start with pediatric back blows.
背部拍击无效改行胸部冲击。 When back blows failed, chest thrusts were performed.
胸部冲击五下，动作要快。 Five chest thrusts, and be quick.
小儿喉痉挛时托下颌并给正压通气。 In pediatric laryngospasm, lift the jaw and give positive pressure ventilation.
小儿喉痉挛了，快托下颌。 Pediatric laryngospasm; lift the jaw quickly.
小儿喉水肿进展迅速，准备气管插管。 Pediatric laryngeal edema progressed rapidly, so intubation was prepared.
小儿喉水肿，声音都变了。 Pediatric laryngeal edema; the voice has changed.
急性会厌炎患儿端坐流涎，禁止压舌检查。 A child with acute epiglottitis sat upright and drooled, so tongue blade examination was avoided.
急性会厌炎别压舌头，会窒息。 With acute epiglottitis do not press the tongue; it can cause obstruction.
哮吼患儿予雾化肾上腺素与激素。 A child with croup received nebulized epinephrine and steroids.
哮吼的咳嗽像狗叫。 The cough of croup sounds like a dog barking.
小儿支气管痉挛予雾化支气管扩张剂。 Pediatric bronchospasm was treated with nebulized bronchodilators.
小儿支气管痉挛，雾化先上。 Pediatric bronchospasm; start nebulizers first.
儿童气管插管一次成功，导管深度合适。 Pediatric endotracheal intubation succeeded on the first attempt at the correct depth.
准备儿童气管插管，叫麻醉。 Prepare for pediatric endotracheal intubation and call anesthesia.
新生儿气管插管后接呼吸机。 After neonatal intubation the baby was connected to the ventilator.
新生儿气管插管，管径三点五。 Neonatal intubation with a 3.5 tube.
儿童气管导管固定于门齿二十二厘米。 The pediatric endotracheal tube was secured at 22 cm at the incisors.
儿童气管导管固定好，别脱出。 Secure the pediatric endotracheal tube so it does not come out.
儿童声门上气道可作为困难气道的过渡。 A pediatric supraglottic airway can serve as a bridge in a difficult airway.
先放儿童声门上气道，再想办法插管。 Place a pediatric supraglottic airway first, then plan intubation.
儿童喉罩置入后通气良好。 Ventilation was adequate after insertion of the pediatric laryngeal mask airway.
儿童喉罩选二号，先润滑。 Choose a size two pediatric laryngeal mask airway and lubricate it first.
儿童球囊面罩通气时观察胸廓起伏。 During pediatric bag-mask ventilation, chest rise was observed.
儿童球囊面罩通气，捏两下看胸廓。 Pediatric bag-mask ventilation; squeeze twice and check the chest.
气管内吸引前后给予纯氧。 Oxygen was given before and after endotracheal suctioning.
气管内吸引别超过十秒。 Endotracheal suctioning should not last more than ten seconds.
儿童困难气道预案包括喉罩与外科气道。 The pediatric difficult airway plan included a supraglottic airway and surgical airway.
儿童困难气道，叫上级来插。 Pediatric difficult airway; call the senior doctor to intubate.
吸气性喘鸣提示上气道梗阻。 Inspiratory stridor suggests upper airway obstruction.
孩子有喘鸣，安静时也听得见。 The child has stridor, audible even at rest.
患儿呻吟伴鼻翼扇动，提示呼吸窘迫。 Grunting with nasal flaring indicated respiratory distress.
孩子一直呻吟，情况不好。 The child keeps grunting, which is a bad sign.
鼻翼扇动与三凹征提示呼吸费力。 Nasal flaring with retractions indicated increased work of breathing.
有鼻翼扇动，呼吸肯定费力。 There is nasal flaring, so breathing is clearly labored.
儿童气道管理强调早期识别与阶梯处理。 Pediatric airway management emphasizes early recognition and a stepwise approach.
儿童气道管理先保通畅再谈插管。 In pediatric airway management, secure patency before thinking about intubation.
气管软化患儿出现呼气性喘鸣。 The child with tracheomalacia had expiratory stridor.
气管软化，哭的时候更明显。 Tracheomalacia is more obvious when the baby cries.
自杀风险评为高危，需专人陪护。 Suicide risk was assessed as high, requiring one-to-one supervision.
自杀风险很高，今晚不能回家。 Suicide risk is high, so you cannot go home tonight.
患者前臂有多处自伤瘢痕。 The patient had multiple self-harm scars on the forearms.
自伤是为了缓解情绪吗。 Is the self-harm a way to relieve emotions.
自杀意图强烈者需立即住院。 Strong suicidal intent requires immediate admission.
自杀意图有多强，是真心想死吗。 How strong is the suicidal intent; did you really want to die.
绝望感评分高，提示自杀风险增加。 A high hopelessness score indicated increased suicide risk.
您是不是觉得绝望感很重。 Do you feel a heavy sense of hopelessness.
患者诉强烈无价值感，需评估抑郁。 The patient reported intense worthlessness, so depression was assessed.
无价值感常和抑郁一起出现。 Worthlessness often appears together with depression.
情绪低落两周以上需筛查抑郁障碍。 Depressed mood lasting over two weeks warrants screening for depressive disorder.
情绪低落多久了，睡得好吗。 How long have you had depressed mood, and how is your sleep.
既往自杀未遂是最重要的自杀危险因素。 Previous attempted suicide is the most important suicide risk factor.
自杀危险因素有哪些，喝酒算吗。 What are the suicide risk factors; does drinking count.
致命性评估显示手段致死性高。 Lethality assessment showed that the method was highly lethal.
致命性评估怎么样，方法危险吗。 How is the lethality assessment; is the method dangerous.
手段限制是有效的自杀预防措施。 Means restriction is an effective suicide prevention measure.
手段限制先从收走药物开始。 Means restriction starts with taking away the medications.
符合强制住院条件，已通知家属。 The criteria for involuntary admission were met, and the family was informed.
这种情况得强制住院，法律允许。 This situation requires involuntary admission, which the law permits.
观察期二十四小时内每两小时巡视一次。 During the observation period, checks were made every two hours for twenty-four hours.
观察期不能带手机和皮带。 During the observation period, no phone or belt is allowed.
心理评估提示中度抑郁伴焦虑。 Psychological assessment indicated moderate depression with anxiety.
先做心理评估，再定治疗方案。 Do a psychological assessment first, then plan treatment.
急诊对所有患者做自杀筛查。 The emergency department performs suicide screening for all patients.
自杀筛查阳性就进一步评估。 If suicide screening is positive, assess further.
精神科急症包括激越、木僵与自杀风险。 Psychiatric emergencies include agitation, stupor, and suicide risk.
这是精神科急症，叫精神科。 This is a psychiatric emergency; call psychiatry.
急性精神病性障碍需排除器质性病因。 Acute psychotic disorder requires exclusion of organic causes.
急性精神病性障碍，先排除脑病。 Acute psychotic disorder; rule out brain disease first.
躁狂发作期言语增多、行为冲动。 During the manic episode there was pressured speech and impulsive behavior.
躁狂发作了，一夜不睡还很有劲。 A manic episode; no sleep all night and still full of energy.
紧张性木僵需排除器质性病因。 Catatonic stupor requires exclusion of organic causes.
他紧张性木僵，先查血糖和电解质。 He is in catatonic stupor; check glucose and electrolytes first.
紧张症对苯二氮卓类反应良好。 Catatonia responds well to benzodiazepines.
紧张症，试用小剂量地西泮。 Catatonia; try a small dose of diazepam.
惊恐发作时心电图与心肌酶均正常。 During the panic attack the ECG and cardiac enzymes were normal.
刚才惊恐发作，现在好多了。 I had a panic attack just now, and I feel better.
惊恐障碍需与心脏病相鉴别。 Panic disorder must be distinguished from heart disease.
惊恐障碍会反复，得规律治疗。 Panic disorder recurs, so regular treatment is needed.
广泛性焦虑障碍需评估共病抑郁。 Generalized anxiety disorder requires assessment for comorbid depression.
广泛性焦虑障碍，先做心理治疗。 For generalized anxiety disorder, start with psychotherapy.
精神科评估包括自杀风险与自知力。 Psychiatric assessment covers suicide risk and insight.
精神科评估做完再收住院。 Complete the psychiatric assessment before admission.
精神状态检查记录外观、言语与思维内容。 The mental status examination documented appearance, speech, and thought content.
先做精神状态检查，看有没有幻觉。 Do a mental status examination first and look for hallucinations.
拒食三天，需评估营养与补液。 After three days of food refusal, nutrition and fluids were assessed.
拒食了，先补液别硬灌。 He refuses food; give fluids and do not force-feed.
逃跑风险高者安排在靠近护士站的床位。 Patients at high elopement risk were placed near the nurses' station.
逃跑风险高，家属要陪住。 Elopement risk is high, so a family member must stay.
