病情告知前先确认患者希望知道到什么程度。 Before disclosure of condition, confirm how much the patient wants to know.
诊断告知宜先询问患者已知多少。 Diagnosis disclosure should start by asking what the patient already knows.
诊断告知用了十几分钟，家属在外间等着。 The diagnosis disclosure took over ten minutes, with the family waiting outside.
预后告知避免给绝对时间承诺。 Prognosis disclosure should avoid absolute time promises.
预后告知要讲清不确定性，不能给死期限。 Prognosis disclosure must acknowledge uncertainty rather than set a hard deadline.
病危通知须记录时间、告知人与家属签名。 The critical condition notice must record the time, the person informing, and the family signature.
我们已经下了病危通知，请您尽快到抢救室门口。 We have issued a critical condition notice; please come to the resuscitation room entrance as soon as possible.
病情恶化须及时告知并记录。 Deterioration must be promptly communicated and documented.
昨晚病情恶化，血压掉得很厉害，已经加了升压药。 The condition deteriorated last night with a sharp drop in blood pressure, so vasopressors were started.
病理提示恶性肿瘤，须与家属商量下一步治疗。 The pathology indicates a malignant tumor, and the next step must be discussed with the family.
病理提示是恶性肿瘤，我们需要商量下一步治疗。 The pathology shows a malignant tumor, and we need to discuss the next step.
癌症诊断告知应留出情绪反应时间。 When giving a cancer diagnosis, allow time for an emotional response.
拿到癌症诊断那天，患者一句话都没说。 On the day of the cancer diagnosis, the patient said nothing at all.
晚期肿瘤沟通重点转向生活质量。 With advanced cancer, the focus shifts to quality of life.
晚期肿瘤的治疗目标以控制症状为主。 In advanced cancer, the goal of treatment is mainly symptom control.
终末期判定需两位以上医师确认。 End-stage status should be confirmed by at least two physicians.
进入终末期后，我们更关注舒适而不是延长。 In end-stage disease, comfort matters more than prolonging life.
临终关怀不等于不治疗。 Hospice care is not the same as no treatment.
家属问临终关怀是不是放弃，我解释了很久。 The family asked whether hospice care meant giving up, so I explained at length.
姑息治疗可与抗肿瘤治疗同时进行。 Palliative care can run alongside anticancer treatment.
姑息治疗团队今天来处理疼痛，不影响原来的化疗。 The palliative care team will manage the pain today, with no change to chemotherapy.
心理支持不等于心理治疗。 Psychological support is not psychotherapy.
告知之后我们安排了心理支持，患者愿意聊了。 After the disclosure we arranged psychological support, and the patient began to talk.
家属沟通要避免多人多口径。 Family communication must avoid conflicting messages.
家属沟通由主管医生统一口径，其他人不要随便许诺。 Family communication is led by the attending; others should not make promises.
知情权与保护性医疗需平衡。 The right to know must be balanced with protective medical practice.
患者知情权受法律保护，不能以怕影响情绪为由全瞒。 The right to know is protected by law and cannot be set aside simply for fear of distress.
情绪反应需要时间，不要急于纠正。 Emotional responses need time; do not rush to correct them.
患者情绪反应很强烈，我们先陪着，不急着讲方案。 The emotional response was strong, so we stayed with the patient rather than pushing the plan.
家属谈话须明确主持人与记录人。 A family meeting needs a designated facilitator and recorder.
家属谈话定在今晚七点，请主要决策的家属都来。 The family meeting is at seven tonight; please have the key decision-makers attend.
舒适照护需与家属明确目标。 Comfort care requires agreeing on goals with the family.
转到舒适照护后，我们停掉了没必要的抽血。 After switching to comfort care, we stopped unnecessary blood draws.
不抢救医嘱签署前必须确认患者本人意愿。 The patient's own wishes must be confirmed before a do-not-resuscitate order is signed.
家属要求不抢救医嘱，我们还要再和患者本人确认。 The family requested a DNR order, but we still need to confirm the patient's own wishes.
限制治疗不等于放弃，基础照护继续。 Limitation of treatment is not abandonment; basic care continues.
限制治疗的范围要写清楚，比如不做插管但继续止痛。 The scope of limitation of treatment must be explicit, such as no intubation but continued analgesia.
撤除治疗须经伦理与家属沟通程序。 Withdrawal of treatment requires ethics review and family discussion.
撤除治疗前，我们开了家庭会议并记录了共识。 Before withdrawal of treatment, we held a family meeting and documented the consensus.
维持生命治疗是否继续需定期评估获益。 Whether to continue life-sustaining treatment needs regular reassessment of benefit.
维持生命治疗已经一周，需要评估还有没有获益。 Life-sustaining treatment has run for a week and its benefit needs reassessment.
脑死亡告知须两位医师共同完成。 Brain death notification should be delivered by two physicians together.
脑死亡告知那天，家属反复问还有没有希望。 During the brain death notification, the family kept asking whether there was still hope.
预后不良不等于立即死亡。 Poor prognosis does not mean imminent death.
预后不良这句话说出来很难，但不能含糊。 Saying the prognosis is poor is hard, but it must not be vague.
告知策略要记录患者希望知情程度。 The disclosure strategy should record how much the patient wants to know.
告知策略先问患者想不想知道，再决定讲多深。 The disclosure strategy starts by asking whether the patient wants to know, then decides how much to tell.
病情交代要突出变化与风险点。 A condition briefing should highlight changes and risks.
交班时病情交代清楚，尤其是夜里加的药。 The condition briefing at handover was clear, especially about the drugs added overnight.
自费项目须事先告知并征得同意。 Self-pay items must be disclosed and agreed in advance.
这个药是自费，一天大约三百块。 This drug is self-pay, about three hundred a day.
境外患者常需先自费，回国后再申请医疗保险理赔。 Overseas patients often pay first and claim after returning home.
您有医疗保险吗，国内的还是国外的。 Do you have medical insurance, domestic or overseas?
商业保险直付需提前确认合作医院。 Direct billing by commercial insurance requires confirming the hospital is in network.

报销所需材料应一次性告知。 All documents needed for reimbursement should be listed at once.
回国报销要发票原件和费用明细。 Reimbursement back home needs the original invoice and an itemized bill.
起付线按医院等级与地区不同。 The deductible varies by hospital level and region.
这次还没到起付线，所以全部要自己付。 This visit has not reached the deductible, so you pay it all yourself.
超出封顶线的部分需自费或由商保承担。 Anything above the reimbursement cap is self-pay or covered by commercial insurance.
费用已经接近封顶线，后面部分要自费。 Costs are near the reimbursement cap, so the rest is self-pay.
不同级别医院的自付比例不一样，先按三级算。 The co-payment ratio differs by hospital level, so calculate it as tertiary first.
自付比例是百分之二十，其余医保出。 The co-payment ratio is twenty percent and insurance covers the rest.
押金不足会影响检查和用药。 Insufficient deposit may delay tests and medication.
先交两千押金，出院时多退少补。 Please pay a two thousand deposit; we will settle the balance at discharge.
费用清单须与医嘱和护理记录一致。 The itemized bill must match the orders and nursing records.
费用清单上这项材料我们没有用过，请核对。 We never used this material on the itemized bill; please check it.
收费处二十四小时可办理急诊缴费。 The cashier handles emergency payments around the clock.
您先去收费处交费，再回来做检查。 Please pay at the cashier first, then come back for the test.
发票遗失补办需提供身份证明。 A replacement invoice requires identity documents.
发票请收好，回国理赔要用。 Keep the invoice; you will need it for reimbursement back home.
异地医保卡需先备案才能直接结算。 Out-of-town insurance cards need prior registration for direct settlement.
请把医保卡给我，我先登记。 Please give me your insurance card so I can register it.
境外保险多需先自费再回国理赔。 Overseas insurance usually requires self-payment first and a claim later.
您的境外保险能直付吗，还是先自费。 Can your overseas insurance pay directly, or do you pay first?
旅行保险常含紧急救援与转运责任。 Travel insurance often covers emergency assistance and evacuation.
旅行保险的保单号能提供一下吗。 Could you provide the policy number of your travel insurance?
保险直付须提前获得保险公司担保函。 Direct billing requires a letter of guarantee from the insurer in advance.
我们和这家保险公司有保险直付协议。 We have a direct billing agreement with this insurer.
保险公司联系方式应记入病历。 The insurer's contact details should be recorded in the chart.
保险公司说需要医院先出诊断证明。 The insurer says the hospital must issue a diagnosis certificate first.
保单上的免责条款决定能否理赔。 The exclusions in the policy decide whether a claim is payable.
请把保单的责任页拍照给我们。 Please photograph the coverage page of your insurance policy for us.
理赔材料不齐会反复退件。 Incomplete claim documents cause repeated rejections.
理赔大概要四到六周，材料越全越快。 A claim usually takes four to six weeks; complete documents speed it up.
理赔材料清单应一次性交给患者。 The list of claim documents should be given to the patient in one go.
理赔材料包括诊断证明、发票和费用清单。 Claim documents include the diagnosis certificate, invoice, and itemized bill.
费用预估算不得作为最终收费承诺。 A cost estimate is not a final billing commitment.
费用预估大概三万，实际以结算为准。 The cost estimate is about thirty thousand, subject to the final bill.
欠费可能影响后续取药与出院手续。 An outstanding balance may block later prescriptions and discharge.
目前欠费一千二，结清后才能办出院。 The outstanding balance is twelve hundred; discharge can proceed after payment.
催缴通知须送达并有签收记录。 A payment reminder must be delivered with a signed receipt.
催缴通知已经发到家属手机上了。 The payment reminder has been sent to the family's phone.
费用减免须经审核并留档。 A fee waiver requires review and must be documented.
他家确实困难，费用减免的材料我帮着准备。 His family is really struggling, so I will help prepare the fee waiver paperwork.
医疗救助需民政与医保部门联合认定。 Medical assistance requires joint determination by civil affairs and insurance authorities.
这种情况可以申请医疗救助，我带您去社工部。 You may apply for medical assistance; let me take you to the social work office.
慈善援助不得附加商业推广条件。 Charitable assistance must not carry commercial promotion conditions.
慈善援助批下来了，能覆盖一部分药费。 The charitable assistance was approved and covers part of the drug cost.
费用告知应与知情同意同步完成。 Cost disclosure should be completed together with informed consent.
费用告知做在前面，后面就少有争议。 When cost disclosure comes first, there are far fewer disputes later.
价格公示应包含耗材与床位费。 Price transparency should cover consumables and bed charges.
大厅屏幕上有价格公示，您可以自己查。 There is price transparency on the lobby screen; you can check it yourself.
紧急情况可拨打领事馆值班电话。 In an emergency, call the consulate duty phone.
领事馆在市中心，开车大概半小时。 The consulate is downtown, about half an hour by car.
大使馆负责全国范围的外交与领事事务。 The embassy handles diplomatic and consular affairs nationwide.
大使馆让我们先把护照复印件传过去。 The embassy asked us to send a copy of the passport first.
通知家属须记录时间、对象与方式。 Notifying family must record the time, the person reached, and the method.
通知家属了，他爱人正在从外地赶过来。 The family has been notified; his wife is on her way from out of town.
紧急联系人电话应每次核对。 The emergency contact number should be verified each visit.
请留一个紧急联系人，能随时接电话的。 Please leave an emergency contact who can answer at any time.
外交部通过使领馆系统提供领保服务。 The ministry provides consular services through its embassies and consulates.
外交部热线可以协助协调跨境转运。 The ministry hotline can help coordinate cross-border transfer.
涉外病例应报外事部门备案。 Cases involving foreign nationals should be filed with the foreign affairs office.
外事部门已经介入，帮我们对接了领事馆。 The foreign affairs office has stepped in and connected us with the consulate.
外籍患者需核验护照与保险信息。 Foreign patients need passport and insurance details verified.
外籍患者挂号要用护照，不能用身份证。 Foreign patients must register with a passport, not an identity card.
监护人通知须核实监护关系。 Guardian notification requires verifying the guardianship relationship.
监护人通知已经打了三次电话，还没接通。 We have called the guardian three times for notification, with no answer.
学校通知须取得患者同意。 School notification requires the patient's consent.
学生同意后我们做了学校通知，辅导员马上到。 With the student's consent we notified the school, and the counselor is on the way.
旅行团领队可协助翻译与联络。 A tour leader can help with interpreting and contact.
他是旅行团的，领队正在联系保险公司。 He is with a tour group, and the leader is contacting the insurer.
陪同人员不能当然代替法定代理人。 An accompanying person is not automatically a legal representative.
陪同人员请在外面等，医生要单独问诊。 Please wait outside; the doctor needs to see the patient alone.
联络官负责与领事馆和警方对接。 The liaison officer is the contact for the consulate and the police.
联络官十分钟后到，先把资料准备好。 The liaison officer arrives in ten minutes, so have the documents ready.
报案回执是后续理赔与补证的关键。 The police report receipt is key for claims and replacement documents.
护照被偷了要马上去报案。 If the passport was stolen, report to the police right away.
非正常死亡须及时警方通报。 Unnatural deaths require prompt police notification.
这例属于非正常死亡，警方通报已经做了。 This is an unnatural death, and the police notification has been made.
家属联络人应固定，避免信息混乱。 The family liaison should be fixed to avoid conflicting information.
家属联络由我来负责，有事打我电话。 I am handling family liaison, so call me if anything comes up.
华侨就医可使用中国身份证或护照。 Overseas Chinese can use a Chinese identity card or passport for care.
这位华侨只有护照，没有国内医保。 This overseas Chinese patient has only a passport and no local insurance.
联络渠道应写进交接班记录。 Contact channels should be written into the handover record.
联络渠道留了三个，夜里打值班手机。 We recorded three contact channels; at night call the duty mobile.
死亡判定由两位医生共同确认，时间记到分钟。 Two doctors confirmed the determination of death, recorded to the minute.
死亡判定需要两位医生一起签字。 Determination of death needs two doctors to sign together.
临床死亡不等于没救，先按压再评估。 Clinical death does not mean it is over; start compressions and reassess.
临床死亡阶段抢救要争分夺秒。 In clinical death, resuscitation must be immediate.
已经进入生物学死亡，我们准备告知家属。 Biological death has occurred, so we are preparing to inform the family.
到了生物学死亡，继续按压已经没有意义。 At biological death, continued compressions serve no purpose.
心死亡时间记录为下午四点零七分。 The time of cardiac death was recorded as 4:07 p.m.
心死亡按心跳停止来记时间。 Cardiac death is timed by the cessation of heartbeat.
遗体保存温度是四度，登记本上有记录。 The remains are preserved at four degrees, as recorded in the log.
遗体保存要等殡仪馆的车来，先放冷藏。 For preservation of remains, keep them refrigerated until the funeral home arrives.
遗体转运要等检疫证明出来才能走。 Transport of remains must wait for the quarantine certificate.
遗体转运的手续领事馆那边能帮忙吗。 Can the consulate help with the transport of remains paperwork?
尸斑集中在下背部，与卧位相符。 Livor mortis is concentrated on the lower back, consistent with the position.
尸斑颜色偏暗，可能要记录一下。 The livor mortis looks dark and may need documenting.
天气太热，尸体腐败较快，要尽快冷藏。 The weather is hot, so decomposition is fast and refrigeration is urgent.
尸体腐败明显，建议尽快安排转运。 Decomposition is obvious, so transport should be arranged soon.
家属认领时情绪失控，我们安排了单独房间。 The family broke down during identification, so we arranged a private room.
家属认领遗体需要带身份证和关系证明。 Family identification requires an ID and proof of relationship.
死亡病例讨论定在周四，全科参加。 The mortality review is on Thursday with the whole department.
死亡病例讨论要写清经验和改进点。 The mortality review should record lessons and improvements.
法医鉴定要等尸检报告，大概两周。 The forensic examination awaits the autopsy report, about two weeks.
法医鉴定结果出来前，遗体不能火化。 The remains cannot be cremated before the forensic examination result.
到院死亡的患者，我们按流程做了三十分钟抢救。 For the patient dead on arrival, we followed protocol and resuscitated for thirty minutes.
到院死亡的，家属可能不接受，要慢慢说。 With a dead-on-arrival case, the family may not accept it, so explain gently.
患者进入濒死期，家属可以进来陪着。 The patient has entered the agonal stage, and the family may stay.
濒死期的患者不要频繁抽血了，以舒适为主。 In the agonal stage, avoid frequent blood draws and focus on comfort.
户籍注销要在派出所办，带死亡证明和户口本。 Household registration cancellation is done at the police station with the death certificate and household book.
户籍注销办完后，把回执给我们一份。 After the household registration cancellation, please give us a copy of the receipt.
器官移植的等待时间通常按病情排序。 Waiting time for organ transplantation is usually ranked by urgency.
器官移植是唯一能根治的办法，但要有合适供体。 Organ transplantation is the only cure, but a suitable donor is needed.
患者生前登记过捐献意愿，系统里能查到。 The patient registered donation intent while alive, and it is in the system.
捐献意愿是患者自己说的，家属也确认了。 The donation intent came from the patient and the family confirmed it.
这位是潜在捐献者，先做脑死亡评估。 This patient is a potential donor, so start the brain death assessment.
潜在捐献者还要过感染筛查这一关。 A potential donor still has to pass infection screening.
脑死亡捐献的流程已经启动，协调员在联系家属。 The donation after brain death process has started and the coordinator is contacting the family.
脑死亡捐献要等两次判定都完成。 Donation after brain death waits until both determinations are complete.
循环死亡捐献要控制撤除治疗后的热缺血时间。 In donation after circulatory death, warm ischemia time after withdrawal must be controlled.
循环死亡捐献的热缺血时间不能超过半小时。 In donation after circulatory death, warm ischemia must stay under half an hour.

活体捐献对供者也有风险，必须单独告知。 Living donation carries risks for the donor and must be disclosed separately.
捐献同意书签好后，协调员会全程陪同。 Once the donation consent form is signed, a coordinator will stay throughout.
捐献同意书只签一份，其余用复印件。 Only one donation consent form is signed; copies are used elsewhere.
他已经进入等待名单，排位还在更新。 He is on the waiting list, and his ranking is still being updated.
等待名单上排多久说不准，要看有没有合适器官。 Time on the waiting list is uncertain and depends on a suitable organ.
组织配型结果明天出，先做交叉配血。 Tissue typing comes back tomorrow; do the crossmatch first.
组织配型要抽两管血，不疼的。 Tissue typing needs two tubes of blood and is not painful.
移植后要长期吃抗排斥药，否则容易出现排斥反应。 After transplantation, anti-rejection drugs are lifelong or rejection becomes likely.
出现发热和尿少要警惕排斥反应。 Fever and low urine output should raise concern for rejection.
捐献协调员明天上午来和家属谈。 The donation coordinator will meet the family tomorrow morning.
捐献协调员不参与治疗决策，只负责流程。 The donation coordinator does not decide treatment, only the process.
捐献伦理讨论先讲清自愿和无偿两个前提。 The donation ethics discussion starts with voluntariness and non-payment.
捐献伦理上不能给家属任何经济暗示。 Donation ethics forbid any financial hint to the family.
捐献必须是无偿捐献，任何补偿都不能接受。 Donation must be unpaid; no compensation can be accepted.
无偿捐献的原则我们会写在同意书上。 The principle of unpaid donation will be written into the consent form.
家属捐献拒绝后，我们立即停止相关沟通。 After the donation refusal, we stop all related discussion at once.
捐献拒绝是家属的权利，不要反复劝。 Donation refusal is the family's right; do not press further.
角膜捐献的时间窗很短，要尽快联系眼库。 The window for corneal donation is short, so contact the eye bank quickly.
角膜捐献不影响遗容，家属可以放心。 Corneal donation does not affect appearance, so the family need not worry.
遗体捐献要跟医学院校对接，流程比较长。 Body donation requires coordination with the medical school and takes time.
遗体捐献后，骨灰会在数年后归还家属。 After body donation, ashes are returned to the family years later.
器官保存液已经备好，等获取后立即灌注。 The preservation solution is ready for perfusion right after procurement.
器官保存的冷缺血时间要严格记录。 Cold ischemia time for organ preservation must be recorded precisely.
器官获取手术安排在三号手术间，家属不必到场。 Procurement surgery is scheduled in room three; the family need not attend.
器官获取手术和遗体修复是同一台做。 Procurement surgery and body restoration are done in the same session.
移植中心那边已经确认接收，我们准备转运。 The transplant center has confirmed acceptance, so we prepare transfer.
移植中心的医生明天过来评估。 Doctors from the transplant center will come to assess tomorrow.
受者的基本信息不能透露给家属。 The recipient's basic information must not be disclosed to the family.
受者那边手术顺利，这是最好的消息。 The recipient's surgery went well, which is the best news.
供者和受者双方都不知道对方身份。 Neither the donor nor the recipient knows the other's identity.
供者的感染筛查必须全部阴性。 All infection screening for the donor must be negative.
免疫抑制方案开始后，感染风险会明显上升。 Once immunosuppression starts, infection risk rises markedly.
免疫抑制药不能自己停，否则会排斥。 Immunosuppressive drugs must not be stopped at will or rejection follows.
器官获取组织今天派人来对接评估。 The organ procurement organization is sending someone to coordinate the assessment.
器官获取组织的资质文件要存档。 The accreditation documents of the organ procurement organization must be archived.
移植评估要两周，先把所有检查做完。 Transplant assessment takes two weeks, so complete all the tests first.
移植评估没过的话，暂时不能进等待名单。 Without passing transplant assessment, one cannot join the waiting list.
父亲生前做过捐献登记，我们尊重他的选择。 Father had registered as a donor, so we respect his choice.
捐献登记是自愿的，随时可以撤销。 Donation registration is voluntary and can be revoked at any time.
宗教信仰不同，饮食和陪护安排都要调整。 Religious beliefs differ, so diet and visiting arrangements must be adjusted.
患者宗教信仰是伊斯兰教，安排女护士操作。 The patient's religious belief is Islam, so arrange a female nurse.
宗教禁忌要先问清楚，不能想当然。 Ask about religious taboos first rather than assuming.
这条宗教禁忌涉及饮食，通知营养科。 This religious taboo concerns diet, so inform the nutrition department.
饮食禁忌写进食医嘱，食堂配餐要避开。 Dietary restrictions go into the order so the kitchen avoids those foods.
他有饮食禁忌，猪肉和酒精都不能碰。 He has dietary restrictions and cannot take pork or alcohol.
清真饮食请食堂单独配送，餐具分开。 Please have the halal diet delivered separately with its own utensils.
患者要清真饮食，先看食堂能不能供。 The patient needs a halal diet, so check whether the kitchen can provide it.
素食患者营养方案要另算蛋白量。 For a vegetarian diet, protein intake must be calculated separately.
他是素食，鸡蛋牛奶可以，肉不行。 He is vegetarian: eggs and milk are fine, meat is not.
斋月期间白天不能进食，口服药时间要调整。 During Ramadan, daytime eating is not allowed, so oral medication timing must change.
斋月里他晚上才吃东西，输液可以照常。 During Ramadan he eats only at night, but intravenous fluids can continue.
斋戒前要评估能不能停一顿药。 Before fasting, assess whether a dose can be skipped.
他坚持斋戒，我们调整了给药时间并监测血糖。 He insisted on fasting, so we adjusted dosing times and monitored glucose.
礼拜时间我们把治疗往后推半小时。 We delayed treatment by half an hour because of prayer time.
患者要做礼拜，先帮他找块干净地方。 The patient wants to pray, so help him find a clean space.
病房里没有标识，我们用手机帮他找朝觐方向。 There is no marker in the room, so we used a phone to find the qibla direction.
朝觐方向朝东南，床可以稍微挪一下。 The qibla direction is southeast, so the bed can be shifted slightly.
安息日他不想做非紧急检查，我们改到明天。 He does not want non-urgent tests on the Sabbath, so we moved them to tomorrow.
安息日家属不来探视，沟通改电话。 The family does not visit on the Sabbath, so communicate by phone.
查体记录要写明是否已行割礼。 Document whether circumcision has been performed.
他做过割礼，插管时选细一点的导尿管。 He has been circumcised, so choose a smaller catheter.
输血拒绝的患者，抢救预案要提前做。 For a patient who refuses transfusion, prepare the rescue plan in advance.
他因信仰输血拒绝，我们改用扩容和止血药。 He refuses transfusion on religious grounds, so we use volume expanders and hemostatics.
耶和华见证人患者术前必须谈输血替代方案。 For Jehovah's Witness patients, alternatives to transfusion must be discussed before surgery.
他是耶和华见证人，输血同意书签不了。 He is a Jehovah's Witness, so the transfusion consent cannot be signed.
伊斯兰教患者尽量安排同性医护做隐私操作。 For Muslim patients, arrange same-sex staff for intimate procedures where possible.
他是伊斯兰教信徒，查体时请女护士在场。 He is a Muslim, so have a female nurse present during examination.
基督教患者希望牧师来，我们联系了院牧。 The Christian patient asked for a pastor, so we contacted hospital chaplaincy.
基督教家庭不忌讳谈死亡，沟通可以直白些。 Christian families are less averse to discussing death, so be direct.
印度教患者去世后，家属希望尽快安排恒河仪式。 After a Hindu patient dies, the family wants the Ganges rites arranged promptly.
印度教患者不吃牛肉，配餐要避开。 Hindu patients do not eat beef, so avoid it in meals.
天主教患者病危，尽快联系神父行临终仪式。 For a dying Catholic patient, contact a priest promptly for the last rites.
天主教家属要求在病房点蜡烛，消防不允许。 The Catholic family wants candles in the room, which fire safety forbids.
佛教患者需要助念，我们安排单间并减少打扰。 The Buddhist patient needs chanting, so we arranged a single room and reduced disturbance.
佛教徒往生后八小时内尽量不搬动遗体。 In Buddhist practice, avoid moving the body for eight hours after death.
临终仪式需要在场，我们把抢救设备挪开。 The last rites need space, so we moved the resuscitation equipment aside.
家属要给患者做临终仪式，我们先停一下操作。 The family wants to perform the last rites, so we pause our procedures.
神职人员来访要登记，并遵守探视时间。 Clergy visits must be registered and follow visiting hours.
神职人员到了，我们给他一件隔离衣。 The clergy has arrived, so give him an isolation gown.
阿訇来了以后，家属的情绪稳定很多。 After the imam arrived, the family calmed down considerably.
请阿訇在床旁念经，我们尽量不打扰。 The imam will recite at the bedside, so we keep disturbances minimal.
僧侣来给患者诵经，我们把监护仪声音调低。 The monk came to chant, so we lowered the monitor volume.
僧侣不能进负压病房，改在门外诵经。 The monk cannot enter the negative pressure room, so he chants outside.
文化差异导致家属不让告诉患者，我们要慢慢沟通。 Because of cultural differences, the family wants to hide the diagnosis, so we discuss it gradually.
文化差异不是借口，核心是尊重患者本人。 Cultural difference is no excuse; respecting the patient comes first.
跨文化沟通最怕想当然，先确认对方听懂了。 In cross-cultural communication, never assume; confirm that the other side understood.
跨文化沟通时语速放慢，多用短句。 In cross-cultural communication, slow down and use short sentences.
谈遗体处理时要文化敏感，先问家属的习俗。 Be culturally sensitive about handling remains and ask about the family's customs first.
文化敏感不是客套，是避免二次伤害。 Cultural sensitivity is not politeness; it prevents further harm.
家属参与决策很常见，但患者本人的意愿优先。 Family involvement in decision making is common, but the patient's own wishes prevail.
家属参与决策可以，但最终要患者点头。 Family involvement is fine, but the patient must agree in the end.
他用传统医学的药，入院时要写进用药史。 He uses traditional medicine, so record it in the medication history.
传统医学可以配合，但不能替代急救。 Traditional medicine can complement care but cannot replace emergency treatment.
家属先用了民俗疗法，送来时已经耽误两天。 The family tried a folk remedy first and delayed presentation by two days.
民俗疗法不做评判，但要问清用了什么。 Do not judge the folk remedy, but ask exactly what was used.
宗教节日那天家属多，探视时间适当放宽。 On the religious holiday more family come, so visiting hours are relaxed.
宗教节日期间他想出院回家，需要评估风险。 He wants to go home for the religious holiday, so assess the risk.
洗手应持续至少四十秒。 Handwashing should last at least forty seconds.
进门先洗手，再去碰患者。 Wash your hands before touching the patient.
速干手消毒剂应放在每个床单元。 Alcohol-based hand rub should be available at every bed space.
手上没有明显污物就用速干手消毒剂。 Use alcohol-based hand rub when hands are not visibly soiled.
N95口罩佩戴前须做密合性检查。 A fit check is required before wearing an N95 respirator.
进结核病房必须戴N95口罩。 An N95 respirator is mandatory in the tuberculosis ward.
医用手套不得代替手卫生。 Medical gloves are not a substitute for hand hygiene.
医用手套一患一换，不能戴着走。 Change medical gloves between patients; do not walk around wearing them.
清洁区与污染区须明确分隔。 Clean areas and contaminated areas must be clearly separated.
从污染区回清洁区要先脱防护装备。 Remove protective equipment before returning from a contaminated area to a clean area.
污染区须设警示标识与专用通道。 Contaminated areas require warning signs and dedicated routes.
污染区的垃圾分类要更严。 Waste segregation is stricter in the contaminated area.
知情同意记录须与同意书对应。 The consent record must correspond to the consent form.
知情同意记录里要写患者问过什么。 The consent record should note what the patient asked.
告知记录须写明在场人员与告知方式。 The disclosure record must state who was present and how disclosure was made.
告知记录要有家属签字，否则说不清。 The disclosure record needs a family signature or it proves little.
诊断证明须与病历诊断一致。 The diagnosis certificate must match the diagnosis in the record.
诊断证明只能开一份，复印件盖章。 Only one diagnosis certificate is issued; copies are stamped.
住院号须与腕带和检验条码一致。 The admission number must match the wristband and test barcodes.
住院号报一下，我查他的检验结果。 Give me the admission number so I can check his test results.
病历编号用于归档与调阅检索。 The record number is used for archiving and retrieval.
病历编号抄错了，难怪找不到片子。 The record number was copied wrong, which is why the images were not found.
医师签名须与执业注册姓名一致。 The physician signature must match the registered name.
医师签名缺了三处，先补全。 Three physician signatures are missing; complete them first.
影像报告须区分所见与结论。 The imaging report must separate findings from conclusions.
影像报告还没出，先看片子口头讨论。 The imaging report is not out yet, so review the images and discuss verbally.
医疗口译须准确传达，不得擅自增删。 Medical interpreting must be accurate with no unauthorized additions or omissions.
医疗口译请的是专业译员，不是家属。 We use a professional for medical interpreting, not a family member.
口译员应熟悉医学术语与伦理规范。 An interpreter should know medical terminology and ethical standards.
口译员到了，我们开始谈知情同意。 The interpreter has arrived, so we can start the consent discussion.
笔译文件须由译者与审核人双签。 Translated documents require both translator and reviewer signatures.
这份出院小结要笔译成英文给患者。 This discharge summary needs translation into English for the patient.
同声传译设备需提前调试。 Simultaneous interpreting equipment must be tested in advance.
多国专家会议用同声传译，效率高。 The multinational expert meeting uses simultaneous interpreting for efficiency.
交替传译适合床旁沟通。 Consecutive interpreting suits bedside communication.
床旁谈话用交替传译，一句一句来。 We use consecutive interpreting at the bedside, sentence by sentence.
远程口译须保证网络与音质。 Remote interpreting requires reliable network and audio quality.
小语种可以约远程口译，半小时能上线。 For rare languages we can arrange remote interpreting within half an hour.
电话口译适合简短沟通与急诊。 Telephone interpreting suits brief communication and emergencies.
电话口译接通了，请把手机给患者。 Telephone interpreting is connected, so hand the phone to the patient.
视频口译对设备和带宽要求较高。 Video remote interpreting demands better equipment and bandwidth.
视频口译能看到口型，沟通更准确。 Video remote interpreting shows lip movement, making communication more accurate.
手语翻译须由持证译员承担。 Sign language interpreting must be done by certified interpreters.
手语翻译明天上午到，先安排单间。 The sign language interpreter comes tomorrow morning, so arrange a private room.
医疗翻译须由具备医学背景的译者完成。 Medical translation should be done by translators with a medical background.
医疗翻译件要盖章，否则国外不认。 Medical translations must be stamped or they are not accepted abroad.
机器翻译结果须经人工译后编辑。 Machine translation output must be post-edited by a human.
机器翻译先出初稿，译后编辑再改。 Machine translation produces the draft, then post-editing refines it.
译后编辑须核对术语与数字。 Post-editing must check terminology and numbers.
译后编辑不能只看通顺，还要看术语对不对。 Post-editing must check terminology, not just fluency.
术语库须随科室更新。 The termbase must be updated with the department.
术语库里有这个词，按库里译名来。 The termbase has this term, so use the approved rendering.
翻译记忆能保证同类文书前后一致。 Translation memory keeps similar documents consistent.
翻译记忆里已有这段，改动一下就行。 This passage is already in translation memory, so just adjust it.
语言服务应纳入医院服务体系。 Language services should be part of the hospital service system.
语言服务台在门诊一楼，可以约口译。 The language services desk is on the first floor and can book interpreters.
本项目语种以中英为主，逐步扩展东盟语种。 This project focuses on the Chinese-English language pair and will expand to ASEAN languages.
您需要的语种是中文和缅甸语，我们联系译员。 The language pair you need is Chinese and Burmese, so we will contact an interpreter.
沟通应尽量使用患者母语。 Communication should use the patient's mother tongue where possible.
他的母语是泰语，英语只能简单交流。 His mother tongue is Thai, and his English is limited.
方言差异大时应请同乡协助确认。 When dialects differ greatly, ask someone from the same region to confirm.
老人只会说方言，普通口译听不懂。 The elderly patient speaks only a dialect, which the standard interpreter cannot follow.
第三方口译可避免家属转述失真。 A third-party interpreter prevents distortion from family relay.
这种情况要用第三方口译，家属不能兼。 This situation needs a third-party interpreter; a family member cannot serve.
家属口译不得用于知情同意与坏消息告知。 Family interpreting must not be used for consent or breaking bad news.
家属口译容易漏掉关键风险，尽量别用。 Family interpreting tends to drop key risks, so avoid it when possible.
儿童翻译不得用于任何医疗决策沟通。 Child interpreting must never be used for medical decisions.
让小孩翻译不合适，我们马上安排专业译员。 Using a child to interpret is inappropriate; we will arrange a professional at once.
口译质量可通过回译与双人评估。 Interpreting quality can be checked by back-translation and paired assessment.
口译质量我们会录音抽查。 We sample recordings to check interpreting quality.
误译可能直接导致诊疗错误。 Mistranslation can directly lead to treatment error.
这句误译了，患者以为要禁食。 This is a mistranslation; the patient thought fasting was required.
漏译风险告知内容可能构成告知不足。 Omitting risk disclosure may amount to inadequate disclosure.
漏译了一句关键风险，必须补上。 A key risk was omitted and must be added.
文化中介可协助解释习俗与禁忌。 A cultural broker can explain customs and taboos.
文化中介帮忙解释了家属为什么坚持出院。 The cultural broker explained why the family insisted on discharge.
语言无障碍是服务公平的基本要求。 Language access is a basic requirement of service equity.
语言无障碍做不好，外籍患者就不敢来。 Without language access, foreign patients will not come.
翻译请求须注明语种与时限。 An interpretation request must state the language and deadline.
翻译请求已经提交，两小时内到人。 The interpretation request is submitted, and someone arrives within two hours.
双语材料须由专业译者定稿。 Bilingual materials must be finalized by professional translators.
双语材料放在护士站，患者可以自取。 Bilingual materials are at the nurses station for patients to take.
医疗免责不能免除法定注意义务。 A medical disclaimer cannot waive the legal duty of care.
医疗免责不是万能挡箭牌，说话还是要谨慎。 A medical disclaimer is no universal shield; still choose words carefully.
免责条款不得违反法律强制性规定。 A disclaimer clause must not violate mandatory legal rules.
免责条款范围太宽，法务要求删改。 The disclaimer clause is too broad, so legal affairs asked for revision.
投诉应在规定时限内答复。 Complaints must be answered within the set time limit.
患者提了投诉，我们先记录下来。 The patient filed a complaint, so let us record it first.
投诉渠道应在门诊与病房公示。 Complaint channels should be posted in clinics and wards.
投诉渠道贴在每层电梯口，患者能看到。 Complaint channels are posted by the elevators on every floor.
投诉处理须闭环并回访。 Complaint handling must close the loop and include follow-up.
投诉处理结果三天内给患者答复。 The complaint handling result will be given to the patient within three days.
医患沟通不足是纠纷的主要诱因。 Poor doctor-patient communication is a leading cause of disputes.
医患沟通做在前面，后面少很多麻烦。 Good doctor-patient communication upfront prevents much trouble later.
医患关系需要长期维护。 The doctor-patient relationship needs sustained effort.
医患关系紧张时，第三方在场更好。 When the doctor-patient relationship is tense, a third party should be present.
患者满意度受沟通质量影响很大。 Patient satisfaction is strongly affected by communication quality.
患者满意度这季度下降了，主要是等候时间。 Patient satisfaction dropped this quarter, mainly due to waiting time.
满意度调查应覆盖出院患者。 Satisfaction surveys should cover discharged patients.
满意度调查是匿名的，您放心填。 The satisfaction survey is anonymous, so please answer freely.
道歉不等于承认过错。 An apology does not equal admitting fault.
该道歉就道歉，但不要随口承诺赔偿。 Apologize when appropriate, but do not promise compensation casually.
解释说明应使用通俗语言。 An explanation should use plain language.
家属情绪激动，先把解释说明做足。 The family is upset, so make the explanation thorough first.
赔偿须经协商、调解或判决确定。 Compensation must be set through negotiation, mediation, or judgment.
赔偿金额不是医生能定的，要走流程。 The doctor cannot set compensation; it must follow procedures.
调解协议可申请司法确认。 A mediation agreement can be judicially confirmed.
双方同意调解，下周一到医调委。 Both sides agreed to mediation, scheduled at the mediation committee next Monday.
诉讼周期长且需完整证据链。 Litigation takes time and requires a complete evidence chain.
家属说要诉讼，我们把病历封存好。 The family says they will go to litigation, so seal the records properly.
病历调取须经审批并登记。 Record retrieval requires approval and registration.
病历调取申请今天交，明天能拿到。 Submit the record retrieval request today and it will be ready tomorrow.
医疗鉴定结论是处理纠纷的关键证据。 The medical appraisal conclusion is key evidence in disputes.
医疗鉴定要等两个月，家属要有心理准备。 Medical appraisal takes about two months, so the family should be prepared.
患者权利应在院内公示。 Patient rights should be posted in the hospital.
患者权利告知书入院时发一份。 Give a patient rights statement at admission.
患者义务与权利应同时告知。 Patient responsibilities should be explained along with rights.
患者义务包括如实说用药史，这点常被忽略。 Patient responsibilities include reporting medication history, which is often overlooked.
申诉须在规定期限内提出。 An appeal must be filed within the set period.
患者对答复不满，可以走申诉程序。 If the patient is unhappy with the reply, they may use the appeal process.
回访记录应纳入满意度管理。 Follow-up records should feed into satisfaction management.
回访发现患者伤口红肿，让他马上回来。 The follow-up call found wound redness, so we asked the patient to return at once.
服务承诺须可考核、可追责。 Service commitments must be measurable and accountable.
服务承诺写了候诊不超过三十分钟，就要做到。 The service commitment says waiting under thirty minutes, so we must meet it.
隐私保护贯穿诊疗全过程。 Privacy protection runs through the whole care process.
这里人多，我们换个地方谈，保护您的隐私。 It is crowded here, so let us talk somewhere private to protect your privacy.
数据保护需技术与制度双管齐下。 Data protection needs both technical and policy measures.
数据保护检查下周来，先把台账整理好。 The data protection inspection is next week, so organize the records first.
医疗保密有法定例外情形。 Medical confidentiality has statutory exceptions.
医疗保密不等于对家属一概不说，要看患者意愿。 Medical confidentiality does not mean saying nothing to family; it follows the patient's wishes.
信息泄露须按规定上报并处置。 Information leakage must be reported and handled per regulations.
发生信息泄露，先封账号再上报。 When information leakage occurs, freeze the account first, then report.
匿名化后的数据不再属于个人信息。 Anonymized data is no longer personal information.
匿名化处理过的统计结果可以对外发布。 Anonymized statistical results may be published.
数据脱敏须保留必要的业务可读性。 Data masking must keep enough readability for the business.
演示环境的数据要脱敏，手机号只留后四位。 Data in the demo environment must be masked, keeping only the last four digits.
目的限制禁止超范围使用数据。 Purpose limitation forbids using data beyond the disclosed scope.
目的限制写清楚，就不能拿去二次营销。 Once purpose limitation is stated, the data cannot be reused for marketing.
部分国家的医疗数据要求本地化存储。 Some countries require local storage of medical data.
数据本地化要求意味着东盟节点要单独部署。 Data localization means a separate ASEAN node is needed.
授权访问须按岗位最小权限配置。 Authorized access should follow least privilege by role.
授权访问有记录，谁看过一查就知道。 Authorized access is logged, so any viewing can be traced.
访问日志至少保存六个月。 Access logs must be kept for at least six months.
访问日志显示有人半夜查了病历，要核实。 The access log shows a record viewed at midnight, which needs checking.
权限管理须定期复核。 Access control must be reviewed periodically.
权限管理收回要及时，调岗当天就改。 Access control must be revoked promptly, changed the day of transfer.
网络安全等级保护须定期测评。 Cybersecurity classified protection requires periodic assessment.
网络安全演练发现钓鱼邮件很容易中招。 The cybersecurity drill showed phishing emails are easily clicked.
敏感数据传输与存储须加密。 Sensitive data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
这份资料要加密发送，不要用普通邮件。 Send this file encrypted, not by ordinary email.
数据备份须异地存放并定期恢复演练。 Data backups must be stored offsite and restore-tested regularly.
数据备份每天凌晨跑，别在那个时候维护。 Data backup runs every early morning, so avoid maintenance then.
患者授权须写明使用范围与期限。 Patient authorization must state the scope and duration of use.
患者授权只签了宣传用途，不能拿去做研究。 The patient authorization covers publicity only, not research.
信息披露豁免包括传染病报告与司法调取。 Disclosure exemptions include infectious disease reporting and judicial requests.
这个属于信息披露豁免，不用再要患者同意。 This falls under a disclosure exemption, so patient consent is not required.
法定报告须在规定时限内完成。 Statutory reporting must be completed within the set time limit.
法定报告二十四小时内报，晚了要说明。 Statutory reporting is due within twenty-four hours; delays need explanation.
影像资料使用须取得单独同意。 Use of images requires separate consent.
影像资料使用要打码，眼睛也不能露。 Use of images requires masking, including the eyes.
录音录像须告知并取得同意。 Audio-video recording requires disclosure and consent.
诊疗区录音录像是为了安全，不是监视患者。 Audio-video recording in care areas is for safety, not surveillance.
预检分诊台设体温筛查岗，对所有到院患者先测额温。 A temperature screening post is set at triage, and every arriving patient has a forehead temperature taken first.
请您先到这边做体温筛查，稍等一下就好。 Please come here for temperature screening first; it only takes a moment.
症状筛查表包括发热、咳嗽、皮疹和腹泻四项必问内容。 The symptom screening form covers four mandatory items: fever, cough, rash and diarrhoea.
我先给您做症状筛查，最近有没有发烧咳嗽？ Let me run a symptom screening first. Have you had any fever or cough recently?
产科分诊将孕三十二周合并阴道出血者直接判为一级。 Obstetric triage assigns a woman at 32 weeks with vaginal bleeding directly to level one.
您先去产科分诊台，护士会根据孕周和出血情况给您分级。 Please go to obstetric triage; the nurse will grade you by gestational age and bleeding.
创伤分诊提示高处坠落患者，立即启动创伤团队。 Trauma triage flagged the fall-from-height patient and activated the trauma team immediately.
这个病人按创伤分诊要马上进抢救室，你们先准备。 Trauma triage puts this patient straight into the resuscitation room; please get ready.
患者生命体征平稳，予急诊留观六小时后复查心肌酶。 Vital signs were stable, so the patient was kept for emergency observation and troponin was repeated after six hours.
您今天先不用住院，在急诊留观观察一晚上，明早复查。 You do not need admission today; we will keep you under emergency observation overnight and repeat the tests in the morning.
留观区现有十二张床位，其中两张为隔离观察位。 The observation area has twelve beds, two of which are for isolation observation.
留观区在走廊尽头右转，家属可以在外面等候。 The observation area is at the end of the corridor on the right; family members may wait outside.
输液区护士每小时巡视一次，记录滴速与穿刺点情况。 Infusion area nurses round hourly, recording drip rate and the puncture site.
您到输液区找个座位，输液过程中不舒服马上叫我们。 Please find a seat in the infusion area and call us at once if you feel unwell during the infusion.
夜间挂号时段调整为二十二时至次日六时，每小时放号四十个。 The night registration slot now runs from 22:00 to 06:00 with forty slots per hour.
您预约的挂号时段是九点半，提前十分钟来就行。 Your registration slot is 9:30; please come ten minutes earlier.
护照翻译件须加盖翻译机构公章并与原件一并归档。 The translated passport must carry the agency's seal and be filed together with the original.
麻烦您提供护照翻译件，我们要核对姓名拼写。 Please provide the translated passport so we can check the spelling of your name.
该院已开通国际保险直付，合作保险公司名单在收费处公示。 The hospital offers international direct billing, and the list of partner insurers is posted at the cashier.
您的保险支持国际保险直付吗？支持的话我们直接和保险公司结算。 Does your policy cover international direct billing? If so, we will settle directly with the insurer.
挂号时须选择医保类型，选择错误将影响后续结算。 The insurance type must be selected at registration; a wrong choice affects later settlement.
请问您的医保类型是职工医保还是居民医保？ Is your insurance type employee or resident coverage?
导医台提供中英双语就医指引，含楼层索引与检查须知。 The information desk provides bilingual medical guidance, including a floor index and test instructions.
我给您一份就医指引，照着上面的顺序走就不会漏项。 Here is your medical guidance; follow the order and nothing will be missed.
门诊大厅设多语种导诊屏，支持中英越泰四种语言切换。 The lobby has multilingual wayfinding screens supporting Chinese, English, Vietnamese and Thai.
您用英文也可以，我们有提供多语种导诊的同事。 English is fine; we have colleagues who provide multilingual wayfinding.
导诊单上注明先抽血再拍片，两项都在二楼完成。 The guidance slip states blood draw first, then imaging, both on the second floor.
这张导诊单您拿好，按上面的顺序一项项做。 Keep this guidance slip and follow the order listed.
满意度回访由服务台在患者离院三日内完成，记录不满意项。 Satisfaction follow-up is completed within three days of discharge, recording any dissatisfaction.
我们稍后会对您做一次满意度回访，麻烦您接一下电话。 We will do a satisfaction follow-up call later; please take the call.
陪护告知记录须写明已交代跌倒预防与用药注意事项。 The caregiver briefing record must state that fall prevention and medication precautions were explained.
我给您做一下陪护告知，晚上要注意他起来会不会摔倒。 Let me give you a caregiver briefing; watch out that he does not fall when getting up at night.
重症病房实行探视预约，每次不超过两人、不超过三十分钟。 The intensive care ward uses visiting appointments, with no more than two people for thirty minutes.
探视需要提前预约，您扫这个码选个时间段。 Visits require an appointment; scan this code and choose a time slot.
转诊对接由医务处指定专人负责，三十分钟内回复是否接收。 A designated officer handles referral liaison and replies within thirty minutes on acceptance.
转诊对接已经联系好了，那边留了一张床给你们。 The referral liaison is done; they have reserved a bed for you.
城区急救响应时间中位数为十一分钟，超过十五分钟须说明原因。 The median urban emergency response time is eleven minutes; any delay beyond fifteen must be explained.
我们承诺急救响应时间在十五分钟以内，请您保持电话畅通。 We aim for an emergency response time under fifteen minutes; please keep your phone available.
患者恢复自主呼吸后取复苏体位，持续监测血氧。 Once spontaneous breathing returned, the patient was placed in the recovery position with continuous oxygen saturation monitoring.
他有呼吸了，先摆成复苏体位，别让他仰面躺着吐。 He is breathing now; put him in the recovery position so he does not choke lying on his back.
本次复苏按压分数为百分之八十二，高于质控要求的百分之八十。 The chest compression fraction was 82 percent, above the 80 percent quality threshold.
按压分数还不够，换人动作要快，尽量别停。 Our chest compression fraction is still low; switch compressors fast and keep interruptions minimal.
每班交接须核对抢救车封条与药品效期。 Each shift handover checks the crash cart seal and drug expiry dates.
抢救车推到床边，把肾上腺素和插管包都拿出来。 Bring the crash cart to the bedside and get out epinephrine and the intubation kit.

zh: 急救优先分级调度系统
text: 调度员依据急救优先分级调度系统判定为最高优先级并立即派车。 Using the medical priority dispatch system, the dispatcher assigned the highest priority and dispatched at once.

zh: 急救优先分级调度系统
text: 系统按急救优先分级调度系统判定您这属于紧急情况，车已经派出。 Under the medical priority dispatch system this is an emergency, and the ambulance is on its way.
社区急救志愿者在救护车到达前完成初步止血与安抚。 Community emergency volunteers controlled bleeding and reassured the patient before the ambulance arrived.
现场有急救志愿者在帮忙，你们到了直接接手就行。 Emergency volunteers are helping at the scene; you can take over when you arrive.
第一响应者在四分钟内到达并开始胸外按压。 The first responder arrived within four minutes and began chest compressions.
第一响应者已经到场了，正在做按压，我们马上接手。 The first responder is on scene doing compressions; we will take over shortly.
创伤患者在院前镇痛后疼痛评分由九分降至四分。 After prehospital analgesia the trauma patient's pain score fell from nine to four.
他疼得厉害，我们在路上给了院前镇痛。 He was in severe pain, so we gave prehospital analgesia en route.
收到费用担保函后，收费处按直付流程登记，不再向患者预收押金。 On receipt of the letter of guarantee, the cashier registers direct billing and stops collecting a deposit.
请您让保险公司发一份费用担保函，我们收到后就不用您先垫钱。 Please ask your insurer to send a letter of guarantee; once we receive it you will not need to pay up front.
口译伦理要求译员不替患者作答，也不对诊疗方案发表意见。 Interpreting ethics require the interpreter not to answer for the patient or comment on treatment.
按口译伦理，我只能如实转述，不能替医生解释病情。 Under interpreting ethics I can only relay faithfully and cannot explain the condition for the doctor.
医院在患者权利告知书中写明语言权与获取口译服务的途径。 The patient rights statement sets out language rights and how to obtain interpreting services.
您有语言权，可以要求我们提供口译，这不额外收费。 You have language rights and may request an interpreter at no extra charge.
科室每年开展文化能力培训，覆盖宗教饮食与丧葬习俗。 The department runs annual cultural competence training covering religious diet and burial customs.
我们尽量按您的文化习惯安排，这也是文化能力的一部分。 We will accommodate your cultural practices as far as we can; that is part of cultural competence.
预立照护计划应在患者病情稳定时启动，并记录讨论内容。 Advance care planning should start when the patient is stable, with the discussion documented.
趁您现在状态好，我们可以做一次预立照护计划，把以后的想法说清楚。 While you are stable, we could do advance care planning and record what you would want later.
不良事件上报后由医务处组织根因分析，七日内反馈整改意见。 After adverse event reporting, the medical affairs office conducts root cause analysis and gives feedback within seven days.
这件事我们要走不良事件上报，不是追究谁，是为了改流程。 We need to file an adverse event report; it is not about blame, but about fixing the process.
产后抑郁筛查在出院前完成，评分十三分以上转心理科。 Postpartum depression screening is completed before discharge, with scores above thirteen referred to psychiatry.
我们给您做一次产后抑郁筛查，就是几个问题，别紧张。 We will do a postpartum depression screening; it is just a few questions, please do not worry.
急救包内止血敷料每季度检查一次，过期立即更换。 Dressings in the first aid kit are checked quarterly and replaced as soon as they expire.
急救包在后备箱，先拿止血带和纱布出来。 The first aid kit is in the boot; get out the tourniquet and gauze first.
口译预约须至少提前四小时提交，急诊可即时呼叫。 Interpreting requests must be submitted at least four hours ahead, with immediate call-out for emergencies.
您需要哪种语言？我帮您提交口译预约。 Which language do you need? I will submit an interpreting request for you.
患者携带输液港，穿刺时须使用专用无损伤针。 The patient has an implantable venous access port, which requires a dedicated non-coring needle.
他胸口有个输液港，别在普通位置扎针。 He has an implantable venous access port on his chest, so do not use an ordinary site.
直升机停机坪夜间启用需提前打开边界灯并清空安全区。 Using the helipad at night requires switching on perimeter lights and clearing the safety zone.
救护车先送直升机停机坪，直升机那边已经准备好了。 Take the patient to the helipad first; the helicopter crew is ready.
长期机械通气患者于入院第十二天行气管切开。 Tracheostomy was performed on day twelve of admission for the patient on prolonged ventilation.
这个病人上气道长期不通，后面可能要做气管切开。 This patient cannot maintain the upper airway long term; a tracheostomy may be needed later.
一氧化碳中毒昏迷患者接受高压氧治疗两次后意识转清。 The comatose carbon monoxide poisoning patient regained consciousness after two sessions of hyperbaric oxygen therapy.
建议做高压氧治疗，对缺氧和中毒恢复都有帮助。 Hyperbaric oxygen therapy is recommended; it helps recovery from hypoxia and poisoning.
处方开具片剂两盒，嘱患者按说明书服用。 Two boxes of tablets were prescribed, and the patient was told to follow the package insert.
这个片剂一天三次，饭后吃。 Take this tablet three times a day after meals.
胶囊剂应整粒吞服，不要打开胶囊壳。 Capsules should be swallowed whole; do not open the capsule shell.
这个胶囊剂有点大，可以掰开吃吗？ This capsule is quite large; can I open it and take the contents?
缓释片必须整片吞服，掰开会导致剂量突释。 Extended-release tablets must be swallowed whole; splitting them causes dose dumping.
缓释片早上吃一次就行，晚上不用再吃。 You only need the extended-release tablet once in the morning, not again at night.
控释片的外壳可能随粪便排出，属于正常现象。 The shell of a controlled-release tablet may appear in the stool, which is normal.
控释片不能掰，掰了就不控释了。 Do not split a controlled-release tablet; splitting it destroys the controlled release.
肠溶片应空腹整片吞服，避免与抑酸药同服。 Enteric-coated tablets should be swallowed whole on an empty stomach and not taken with acid suppressants.
肠溶片别掰开，掰开就在胃里化了。 Do not crush the enteric-coated tablet; it will dissolve in the stomach instead.
分散片可投入温水中分散后口服，也可直接吞服。 A dispersible tablet can be dispersed in warm water or swallowed directly.
老人吞咽困难，给他开分散片吧。 The older patient has trouble swallowing, so prescribe a dispersible tablet.
口崩片置于舌面待其崩解，不要整片吞咽。 Place the orally disintegrating tablet on the tongue and let it disintegrate; do not swallow it whole.
口崩片不用水，放在舌头上就化了。 You do not need water for an orally disintegrating tablet; it dissolves on the tongue.
颗粒剂用温水冲服，水温不宜超过六十度。 Dissolve the granules in warm water not hotter than sixty degrees.
这个颗粒剂冲开有点苦，可以加点糖吗？ These granules taste bitter when dissolved; can I add some sugar?
口服溶液用专用量具量取，避免用汤匙估量。 Measure the oral solution with the supplied measuring device rather than a spoon.
口服溶液摇匀再倒，别直接对瓶喝。 Shake the oral solution before pouring, and do not drink straight from the bottle.
混悬液使用前充分摇匀，以保证每次剂量准确。 Shake the suspension well before use so that each dose is accurate.
混悬液放久了会沉底，喝之前摇一摇。 The suspension settles on standing, so shake it before drinking.
注射剂使用前应检查药液是否澄清、有无异物。 Before use, check that the injection is clear and free of particles.
这个注射剂要避光，配好马上用。 This injection must be kept away from light and used immediately after preparation.
粉针剂需用生理盐水溶解后静脉滴注。 The powder for injection must be dissolved in normal saline before intravenous infusion.
粉针剂先化开，别直接推。 Dissolve the powder for injection first; do not push it directly.
雾化液按医嘱加入雾化器，避免与其他药液混合。 Add the nebulizer solution to the nebulizer as prescribed and avoid mixing it with other solutions.
雾化液一次一支，用不完就扔。 Use one vial of nebulizer solution at a time and discard any leftover.
栓剂应冷藏保存，使用前去除外包装。 A suppository should be kept refrigerated and the wrapper removed before use.
栓剂塞进去以后尽量躺一会儿，别马上去厕所。 After inserting the suppository, lie down for a while and do not go to the toilet straight away.
贴剂应贴在清洁干燥无毛的皮肤上，并每日更换部位。 Apply the transdermal patch to clean, dry, hairless skin and change the site daily.
贴剂撕下来以后对折粘好再扔，别让小孩碰到。 Fold the used transdermal patch sticky side together before disposal to keep children away from it.
滴眼液开封后四周内使用，过期须丢弃。 Use eye drops within four weeks of opening and discard them after expiry.
滴眼液点完请按住内眼角，防止流入鼻腔。 After instilling eye drops, press the inner corner of the eye to stop the drops draining into the nose.
软膏剂薄涂于患处，避免覆盖过厚影响散热。 Apply a thin layer of ointment to the affected area and avoid thick covering that traps heat.
软膏剂涂完不用包，晾着就行。 You do not need to cover the ointment after applying it; just leave it open.
处方须写明药品规格，避免发错剂量。 The prescription must state the drug strength to avoid dispensing the wrong dose.
这个药有十毫克和二十毫克两种药品规格，别拿错。 This drug comes in two drug strengths, ten and twenty milligrams, so do not pick the wrong one.
复方制剂含多种成分，须核对是否与其他药物重复。 A fixed-dose combination contains several ingredients, so check for duplication with other drugs.
这是复方制剂，别再另加退烧药。 This is a fixed-dose combination, so do not add another antipyretic on top.
剂量根据体重与肾功能计算，不得随意加倍。 The dose is calculated from body weight and renal function and must not be doubled at will.
这个剂量是一次两片，别一次吃四片。 The dose is two tablets at a time, not four.
每日一次，早餐后服用，整片吞服。 Once daily, after breakfast, swallowed whole.
每日一次是每天同一时间吃，不是想起来才吃。 Once daily means the same time every day, not whenever you remember.
每日两次，早八点与晚八点各服一次。 Twice daily, at eight in the morning and eight in the evening.
每日两次就是早晚各一次，间隔差不多十二小时。 Twice daily means one in the morning and one in the evening, about twelve hours apart.
每日三次，餐后半小时服用。 Three times daily, half an hour after meals.
每日三次不要挤在一起吃，尽量隔开。 Do not take three times daily all at once; space the doses out.
每八小时一次，夜间也要按时给药。 Give it every 8 hours, including through the night.
每八小时一次是看钟点，不是跟着三餐吃。 Every 8 hours follows the clock, not mealtimes.
必要时口服一片，二十四小时内不超过三次。 Take one tablet as needed, no more than three times in twenty-four hours.
必要时就是难受才吃，不难受不吃。 As needed means take it only when you feel unwell, and skip it when you do not.
立即一次给予地塞米松十毫克静脉注射。 Give a stat dose of dexamethasone ten milligrams intravenously.
这个是立即一次，现在就去推。 This is a stat dose, so give it now.
睡前一次口服，服后不要再起床活动。 Take one dose at bedtime and do not get up and move around afterwards.
睡前一次，吃完就躺着，注意防跌倒。 Take it once at bedtime, lie down afterwards, and be careful about falls.
日剂量分两次给予，避免一次负荷过重。 The daily dose is divided into two administrations to avoid an excessive single load.
日剂量是全天总量，不是每次的量。 The daily dose is the total for the whole day, not the amount per dose.
处方须注明剂量单位，避免毫克与微克混淆。 The prescription must state the dosage unit to avoid confusing milligrams with micrograms.
剂量单位看仔细，微克和毫克差一千倍。 Check the dosage unit carefully; micrograms and milligrams differ a thousandfold.
该药单次剂量为五十微克，不得按毫克给药。 The single dose of this drug is fifty micrograms and must not be given in milligrams.
这里是微克，不是毫克，看清楚再推。 This is in micrograms, not milligrams, so check carefully before giving it.
胰岛素按国际单位计量，须使用专用注射器。 Insulin is measured in international units, so a dedicated syringe must be used.
这个国际单位不是毫克，换算要查说明书。 This is in international units, not milligrams, so check the label for conversion.
皮内注射后观察十五分钟判断皮试结果。 After intradermal injection, observe for fifteen minutes to read the skin test.
这个是皮内注射，会起个小包，别抓。 This is an intradermal injection; a small wheal will appear, so do not scratch it.
外用局部给药后不要立即覆盖敷料。 Do not cover the area immediately after topical administration.
这个是外用局部给药，别吃下去。 This is for topical administration; do not swallow it.
鼻饲给药前后各用二十毫升温水冲管。 Flush the tube with twenty millilitres of warm water before and after nasogastric administration.
鼻饲给药要把药碾碎化开，别整片推。 For nasogastric administration crush and dissolve the tablet; do not push it whole.
经皮给药可避免首过效应，但起效较慢。 Transdermal administration avoids first-pass metabolism but has a slower onset.
经皮给药贴在前胸或后背，别贴伤口上。 Apply the transdermal administration patch to the chest or back, not on a wound.
用药前须核对用法用量，尤其是儿童剂量。 Check the dosage and administration before use, especially for children.
用法用量写在盒子上，照着做别自己改。 The dosage and administration are printed on the box; follow them and do not change them yourself.
餐前服用可提高吸收，避免与食物同服影响。 Before meals improves absorption and avoids interference from food.
餐前服用是饭前三十分钟，不是端起碗才吃。 Before meals means thirty minutes before eating, not just as you sit down to eat.
餐后服用可减轻胃肠道刺激。 After meals reduces gastrointestinal irritation.
这个药餐后服用，空腹吃会胃疼。 Take this after meals; it causes stomach pain on an empty stomach.
空腹服用吸收更完全，但可能引起胃部不适。 On an empty stomach gives fuller absorption but may cause stomach discomfort.
空腹服用就是早上起来先吃药再吃早饭。 On an empty stomach means take it in the morning before breakfast.
随餐服用可增加脂溶性药物的吸收。 With meals improves absorption of fat-soluble drugs.
随餐服用就是吃饭时一起吃，别忘了。 With meals means take it together with your meal, so do not forget.
晨服可减少夜间排尿，避免影响睡眠。 Take it in the morning to reduce night-time urination and sleep disturbance.
晨服就是早上吃，别拖到中午。 In the morning means take it in the morning, not at noon.
缓释与肠溶制剂须整片吞服。 You should swallow the tablet whole when it is extended-release or enteric-coated.
这个药整片吞服，别掰成两半。 Please swallow the tablet whole; do not break it in half.
抗酸药嚼服后效果更快，须嚼碎再咽。 Chewed antacids act faster; chew thoroughly before swallowing.
这个是嚼服，嚼碎了再喝水。 This one is to be chewed; chew it and then drink some water.
医嘱写明顿服，即一日总量一次服完。 The order reads take all at once, meaning the entire daily amount in one dose.
顿服就是一天的药一次吃完，不是分三次。 The label says take all at once, so take the whole day's amount in one go.
日剂量较大时建议分服，减轻胃肠反应。 When the daily dose is large, divided doses are advised to reduce gastrointestinal effects.
这个药要分服，早中晚各一次。 This drug is given in divided doses: morning, noon, and evening.
颗粒剂冲服时水温不宜过高，以免破坏药效。 Granules should be dissolved in warm water, not hot, or the drug may be destroyed.
这个冲服，用温水化开再喝。 For this one, dissolve it in water and drink it; do not swallow the powder dry.
抗菌药物疗程一般为五至七天，不得随意延长。 The usual course of treatment for antibacterials is five to seven days and should not be extended at will.
这个疗程七天，吃完要回来复查。 The course of treatment is seven days; come back for review when it is finished.
出现不良反应须及时上报并记录在病历中。 Any adverse drug reaction must be reported promptly and documented in the chart.
吃了这个药有不良反应，身上起疹子。 I had an adverse drug reaction to this medicine; a rash appeared.
该药常见副作用为嗜睡，服药后避免驾车。 A common side effect of this drug is drowsiness, so avoid driving after taking it.
这个药的副作用是犯困，白天别开车。 The side effect of this drug is drowsiness, so do not drive during the day.
长期大剂量使用可致毒性反应，须监测血药浓度。 Long-term high-dose use can cause a toxic reaction, so drug levels must be monitored.
剂量太大出毒性反应了，赶紧停药。 The dose was too high and caused a toxic reaction, so stop the drug now.
药疹多出现在用药后三至七天，须立即停药。 A drug rash usually appears three to seven days after starting the drug; stop it immediately.
身上这个药疹是吃药引起的，先停。 This drug rash is caused by the medicine, so stop it first.
胃肠道反应明显者改为餐后服药。 For marked gastrointestinal reactions, switch to taking the drug after meals.
这个药胃肠道反应大，饭后吃能好点。 This drug causes strong gastrointestinal reactions, so taking it after meals helps.
用药期间出现肝损伤须停药并复查肝功能。 If liver injury occurs during treatment, stop the drug and recheck liver function.
这个药可能引起肝损伤，要定期抽血。 This drug may cause liver injury, so blood tests are needed regularly.
化疗后出现骨髓抑制，须监测白细胞与血小板。 Bone marrow suppression after chemotherapy requires monitoring of white cells and platelets.
这药会骨髓抑制，发烧要马上来。 This drug causes bone marrow suppression, so come in at once if you develop a fever.
联合用药时须警惕 QT间期延长，必要时复查心电图。 Watch for QT prolongation when drugs are combined and repeat the ECG if needed.
这个药会 QT间期延长，心电图先做一个。 This drug can cause QT prolongation, so do an ECG first.
注射部位反应多在数日内消退，可局部冷敷。 Injection site reactions usually resolve within days and can be treated with a cold compress.
打针的地方有点肿，是注射部位反应。 The injection site is a bit swollen; that is an injection site reaction.
使用头孢类抗菌药物期间饮酒可致双硫仑样反应。 Drinking alcohol during cephalosporin treatment can cause a disulfiram-like reaction.
这个药期间不能喝酒，会双硫仑样反应。 You must not drink alcohol while on this drug, or you may have a disulfiram-like reaction.
长期使用糖皮质激素须逐渐减量，避免撤药反应。 After long-term steroids, taper the dose gradually to avoid a withdrawal reaction.
这个药不能突然停，会有撤药反应。 You cannot stop this drug suddenly or you will have a withdrawal reaction.
说明书明确列出禁忌证，用药前须逐项核对。 The label lists the contraindications, which must be checked before prescribing.
他有禁忌证，这药不能用。 He has a contraindication, so this drug cannot be used.
肝功能不全者慎用，须减量并监测转氨酶。 Use with caution in hepatic impairment, with a reduced dose and transaminase monitoring.
这个药慎用，不是不能用，但要多观察。 Use with caution does not mean forbidden; it means the patient needs closer observation.
对本品过敏者禁用，标注须醒目。 Do not use in patients allergic to this product, and the warning must be prominent.
孕妇禁用，这个药不能开。 It is do not use in pregnancy, so this drug cannot be prescribed.
绝对禁忌须在病历首页醒目标注，避免再次误用。 An absolute contraindication must be flagged prominently on the front of the chart to prevent repeat use.
这个药是绝对禁忌，不能用，没有任何例外。 This drug is an absolute contraindication; it cannot be used under any circumstances.
相对禁忌不是绝对不能用，须记录权衡过程。 A relative contraindication does not mean the drug is forbidden; the weighing process must be documented.
这是相对禁忌，风险大但救命时还可以用。 This is a relative contraindication: the risk is high, but it may still be used to save life.
说明书标注孕妇禁用，育龄女性须先排除妊娠。 The label marks it contraindicated in pregnancy, so women of childbearing age must first have pregnancy excluded.
这个药孕妇禁用，你先把月经情况说清楚。 This drug is contraindicated in pregnancy, so tell me first about your periods.
该药儿童禁用，不得按成人剂量减半使用。 This drug is contraindicated in children and must not be halved from an adult dose.
这个药儿童禁用，孩子不能吃。 This drug is contraindicated in children, so the child cannot take it.
哺乳期禁用药物须改为暂停哺乳或更换品种。 For a drug contraindicated during breastfeeding, either suspend breastfeeding or change the drug.
这个药哺乳期禁用，吃了就先别喂奶。 This drug is contraindicated during breastfeeding, so do not feed the baby while taking it.

en: caution in hepatic and renal impairment
text: 该药肝肾功能不全慎用，须复查转氨酶与肌酐。 Use with caution in hepatic and renal impairment, and recheck transaminases and creatinine.

en: caution in hepatic and renal impairment
text: 他肝肾功能不全慎用这个药，剂量减半。 In his case, caution in hepatic and renal impairment means half the dose.
青霉素过敏禁用，用药前须核对过敏史。 Contraindicated in case of allergy to penicillin, so check the allergy history before use.
他对这个药过敏禁用，换一种。 He is allergic, so it is contraindicated in case of allergy; choose another drug.
黑框警告提示严重风险，须向患者明确说明。 A boxed warning flags a serious risk that must be explained clearly to the patient.
这个药有黑框警告，用之前要签字知情。 This drug carries a boxed warning, so the patient must sign consent before use.
镇静药与酒精产生协同作用，可致呼吸抑制。 Sedatives and alcohol have a synergistic effect that can cause respiratory depression.
这两个药有协同作用，剂量都要减。 These two drugs have a synergistic effect, so both doses should be reduced.
抗菌药物与某些药物存在拮抗作用，不宜同用。 Some antibacterials have an antagonistic effect with certain drugs and should not be combined.
这两个药是拮抗作用，一起吃白吃。 These two drugs have an antagonistic effect, so taking them together wastes the treatment.
利福平酶诱导明显，可使多种药物血药浓度下降。 Rifampicin causes marked enzyme induction and can lower the levels of many drugs.
这个药有酶诱导，会让他吃的其他药失效。 This drug causes enzyme induction and may make his other medicines ineffective.
大环内酯类酶抑制可致他汀类蓄积与肌病。 Enzyme inhibition by macrolides can cause statin accumulation and myopathy.
这个药酶抑制强，合用要减量。 This drug causes strong enzyme inhibition, so the other drug needs a lower dose.
该药经肝药酶代谢，合用抑制剂须减量。 This drug is metabolised by hepatic drug-metabolizing enzymes, so reduce the dose with inhibitors.
肝药酶慢的人，药容易蓄积。 People with slow hepatic drug-metabolizing enzymes accumulate drugs more easily.
高蛋白结合率药物合用时可发生置换性相互作用。 Drugs with a high protein binding rate can interact by displacing each other.
这个药蛋白结合率高，低蛋白病人要小心。 This drug has a high protein binding rate, so be careful in patients with low protein.
万古霉素须做血药浓度监测，防止肾毒性。 Vancomycin requires therapeutic drug monitoring to prevent nephrotoxicity.
这个药要做血药浓度监测，明天抽血。 This drug needs therapeutic drug monitoring, so blood will be taken tomorrow.
西柚汁与部分药物存在食物相互作用，须避免同服。 Grapefruit juice has a food-drug interaction with some medicines and should not be taken together.
这个药有食物相互作用，别跟牛奶一起吃。 This drug has a food-drug interaction, so do not take it with milk.
头孢类与酒精相互作用可致双硫仑样反应。 The alcohol-drug interaction with cephalosporins can cause a disulfiram-like reaction.
这个药有酒精相互作用，停药一周内别喝。 This drug has an alcohol-drug interaction, so do not drink for a week after stopping it.
中西药相互作用常被忽略，问诊须问草药。 Herb-drug interaction is often overlooked, so ask about herbal medicines during the consultation.
他在喝中药，注意中西药相互作用。 He is taking herbal medicine, so watch for a herb-drug interaction.
钙剂与左甲状腺素须间隔服药，至少四小时。 Calcium and levothyroxine require separate dosing at least four hours apart.
这两个药间隔服药，一个早上一个晚上。 These two drugs need separate dosing: one in the morning and one in the evening.
开方前须完成相互作用查询并记录结果。 Complete an interaction check and record the result before writing the prescription.
我先做个相互作用查询，稍等。 Let me run an interaction check first; please wait.
合并用药越多，相互作用风险越高。 The more concomitant medication a patient takes, the higher the interaction risk.
把合并用药都写下来，我看看有没有冲突。 Write down all your concomitant medication so I can check for conflicts.
孕妇用药须选择证据充分、风险较低的品种。 Medication in pregnancy should use agents with good evidence and lower risk.
你这是孕妇用药，我得查一下安全性。 This is medication in pregnancy, so I need to check the safety data.
哺乳期用药应选择乳汁分泌量低的药物。 Medication during breastfeeding should use drugs that pass into milk in low amounts.
哺乳期用药要谨慎，吃完四小时再喂。 Medication during breastfeeding needs care, so wait four hours after a dose before feeding.
儿童用药须按体重计算，不可直接减半成人量。 Pediatric medication is dosed by weight and must not simply halve an adult dose.
儿童用药有专用剂型，别掰大人的药。 There are specific dosage forms for pediatric medication, so do not split adult tablets.
老年用药应从小剂量开始，缓慢加量。 Geriatric medication should start at a low dose and be increased slowly.
老年用药要简化，一天一次最好。 Geriatric medication should be simplified, ideally once a day.
肝功能不全者须避免经肝代谢且肝毒性大的药物。 In hepatic impairment, avoid drugs that are hepatically metabolised and hepatotoxic.
他肝功能不全，这个药要减量。 He has hepatic impairment, so this drug must be reduced.
肾功能不全须按肌酐清除率调整剂量。 In renal impairment, adjust the dose according to creatinine clearance.
她肾功能不全，用药间隔要拉长。 She has renal impairment, so the dosing interval must be lengthened.
处方前须核对妊娠安全性分级，选风险最低者。 Check the pregnancy safety category before prescribing and choose the lowest-risk option.
这个药妊娠安全性分级偏低，能换就换。 This drug has a low pregnancy safety category, so change it if possible.
哺乳风险分级低的药物优先用于哺乳期。 Drugs with a low lactation risk category are preferred during breastfeeding.
查一下哺乳风险分级，再决定能不能喂。 Check the lactation risk category before deciding whether feeding is safe.
儿童剂量按每公斤体重计算，不得超过成人量。 The pediatric dose is calculated per kilogram and must not exceed the adult dose.
儿童剂量是每公斤十毫克，别按成人算。 The pediatric dose is ten milligrams per kilogram, not the adult amount.
老年剂量调整通常从成人量的二分之一开始。 Dose adjustment in older adults usually starts at half the adult dose.
老年剂量调整要慢，先吃半片。 Dose adjustment in older adults is gradual, so start with half a tablet.
透析患者用药须注意药物是否被透析清除。 Medication in dialysis patients requires checking whether the drug is removed by dialysis.
他是透析患者用药，这个药透析后补。 For medication in dialysis patients, this drug is given after dialysis.
新生儿用药须按日龄与体重精确计算。 Neonatal medication must be calculated precisely from postnatal age and weight.
新生儿用药剂量很小，要用专用注射器。 Neonatal medication doses are tiny and need a dedicated syringe.
体重剂量按实际体重计算，肥胖者须校正。 Weight-based dosing uses actual body weight, with correction for obesity.
这个药是体重剂量，先称一下体重。 This drug uses weight-based dosing, so weigh the patient first.
化疗药物按体表面积剂量给药，须精确测量身高体重。 Chemotherapy is given by body surface area dosing, so height and weight must be measured accurately.
这个药是体表面积剂量，不能按体重算。 This drug uses body surface area dosing, not weight-based dosing.
储存条件不符合会降低药效，须每日记录温湿度。 Failure to meet storage conditions reduces potency, so record temperature and humidity daily.
这个药储存条件要求高，得放冰箱。 This drug has strict storage conditions and must go in the fridge.
避光保存的药物须用棕色瓶或避光袋。 Protect from light any drug that is light-sensitive, using amber bottles or bags.
这个要避光保存，别放在窗台上。 Please protect from light and keep it off the windowsill.
冷藏保存的药品不得贴近冰箱内壁，以免冻结。 Drugs requiring refrigerated storage must not touch the freezer wall or they may freeze.
这个药冷藏保存，放冰箱中间那层。 This drug needs refrigerated storage, so put it on the middle shelf.
冷冻保存的样本须避免反复冻融。 Samples kept in frozen storage must avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
这个要冷冻保存，不能放冷藏层。 This one needs frozen storage; do not just refrigerate it.
室温保存的药品应远离暖气与直射阳光。 Store at room temperature and keep the drug away from radiators and direct sunlight.
这个室温保存就行，不用放冰箱。 You can store at room temperature; no fridge is needed.
发放前须核对有效期，过期药品一律不得使用。 Check the expiry date before dispensing; expired drugs must never be used.
看一下有效期，别给过期的。 Check the expiry date and do not give out expired stock.
出现不良反应时须记录批号并上报。 When an adverse reaction occurs, record the batch number and report it.
把批号抄下来，这批药要召回。 Write down the batch number; this batch is being recalled.
滴眼液开封后有效期仅四周，须标注开瓶日期。 Eye drops have an in-use shelf life of only four weeks, so mark the opening date.
开封后有效期到了就别用了。 Once the in-use shelf life is over, stop using it.
疫苗与胰岛素须全程冷链，断链后不得使用。 Vaccines and insulin need an unbroken cold chain; do not use them after a break.
这个药走冷链，路上不能断冰。 This drug travels in the cold chain, so the ice must not run out on the way.
配好的药液药物稳定性有限，须在规定时间内输完。 A prepared solution has limited drug stability, so it must be infused within the stated time.
这个药药物稳定性差，配好马上用。 This drug has poor drug stability, so use it immediately after preparation.
用药交代须包括剂量、时间、不良反应与储存。 Medication counseling must cover dose, timing, adverse effects, and storage.
我给您做个用药交代，有不懂的随时问。 I will do your medication counseling now; ask me anything you do not understand.
服药时间应相对固定，避免血药浓度波动。 The dosing time should be kept fairly regular to avoid fluctuations in drug levels.
服药时间最好写下来，贴在冰箱上。 Write the dosing time down and stick it on the fridge.
漏服处理原则是想起即补，接近下次则跳过。 Missed dose management is to take it when remembered, or skip it if the next dose is near.
漏服处理我教您一遍，别再自己加量。 I will explain missed dose management once, and do not take extra doses yourself.
停药告知须写明不可骤停的药物与减量方案。 Discontinuation advice must state which drugs cannot be stopped abruptly and how to taper.
这个是停药告知，吃完就该停，别自己续。 This is the discontinuation advice: stop when the course ends and do not continue on your own.
不良反应告知可提高患者警觉，减少严重事件。 Adverse effect counseling raises patient awareness and reduces serious events.
不良反应告知我讲一下，出疹子要马上回来。 Let me give the adverse effect counseling; come back at once if a rash appears.
用药教育应使用图示与白话，避免专业术语堆砌。 Patient education on medication should use pictures and plain words rather than jargon.
用药教育资料带回去，家里人也看看。 Take the patient education on medication leaflet home so your family can read it too.
分药盒可减少漏服，但须避光防潮。 A pill organizer reduces missed doses but must be kept away from light and moisture.
用分药盒把一周的药分好，不容易忘。 Use a pill organizer to sort a week of medicines so you do not forget.
喂药时应抱起取半卧位，不可捏鼻强灌。 For administering medicine to a child, hold the child upright and never pinch the nose to force it.
喂药的时候别硬灌，容易呛到。 When administering medicine to a child, do not force it, or the child may choke.
鼻饲服药前后须冲管，不同药物分开给。 For administering via feeding tube, flush before and after and give drugs separately.
鼻饲服药要一片一片化开，别混在一起。 When administering via feeding tube, dissolve one tablet at a time and do not mix them.
首次用药应观察过敏反应，尤其注射剂。 Observe for allergic reactions after the first dose, especially with injections.
首次用药先坐半小时再走。 After the first dose, sit for half an hour before leaving.
用药确认须核对姓名、药名、剂量与途径。 Medication confirmation must check the name, drug, dose, and route.
给药前做用药确认，别叫错人。 Do the medication confirmation before giving it, so the wrong patient is not called.
用药指导单须与处方一致，字迹清楚。 The medication instruction sheet must match the prescription and be clearly written.
这张用药指导单您收好，照着吃。 Keep this medication instruction sheet and follow it when taking your medicine.
依从性差会导致疗效不足与耐药。 Poor adherence leads to inadequate efficacy and resistance.
他的依从性不错，每天都按时吃。 His adherence is good; he takes the medicine on time every day.
不依从常见于多重用药与老年患者。 Non-adherence is common with polypharmacy and in older patients.
他是不依从，自己把药减半了。 He is showing non-adherence and halved the dose himself.
自行停药可致病情反跳或撤药反应。 Self-discontinuation can cause rebound of the illness or a withdrawal reaction.
别自行停药，有副作用先打电话问。 Do not practice self-discontinuation; call first if you have side effects.
服药提醒可设手机闹钟或由家属协助。 A medication reminder can be a phone alarm or help from a family member.
设个服药提醒，到点就响。 Set a medication reminder so it rings at the right time.
依从性评估可通过问询与药片计数完成。 Adherence assessment can be done by questioning and tablet counts.
做个依从性评估，看看这几个月吃得怎么样。 Let us do an adherence assessment to see how the last few months went.
多重用药增加相互作用与跌倒风险。 Polypharmacy increases the risk of interactions and falls.
他多重用药，得做一次全面梳理。 He has polypharmacy, so a full medication review is needed.
用药错误须上报并分析原因，避免再犯。 A medication error must be reported, analysed, and prevented from recurring.
这次用药错误是剂量看错了。 This medication error happened because the dose was misread.
入院二十四小时内须完成药物重整。 Medication reconciliation must be completed within twenty-four hours of admission.
转科前先做药物重整，别漏药。 Do medication reconciliation before the transfer so no drug is missed.
抗菌药物须按分级管理原则开具。 Antibacterial agents must be prescribed according to the tiered management rules.
抗菌药物不能随便吃，要有指征。 Antibacterial agents should not be taken casually; there must be an indication.
非限制使用级抗菌药物由主治以下医师开具即可。 Non-restricted category antibacterials can be prescribed by doctors below attending level.
这个属于非限制使用级，普通医生能开。 This is in the non-restricted category, so any doctor can prescribe it.
限制使用级抗菌药物须经主治医师查房同意。 Restricted category antibacterials require the attending physician's agreement on rounds.
这是限制使用级，得请上级医生签字。 This is in the restricted category, so a senior doctor must sign.
特殊使用级抗菌药物须经会诊与审批后方可使用。 Special-use category antibacterials require consultation and approval before use.
这个是特殊使用级，得开专家会诊。 This one is special-use category, so an expert consultation is needed.
经验性用药须结合本地耐药谱，不能凭感觉。 Empirical therapy must follow local resistance patterns, not guesswork.
现在是经验性用药，等培养结果再调整。 For now this is empirical therapy; adjust it when the culture results come back.
培养结果回报后改为目标性用药，减少广谱使用。 After culture results return, switch to targeted therapy to reduce broad-spectrum use.
药敏出来了，改成目标性用药。 The susceptibility results are back, so switch to targeted therapy.
降阶梯治疗可减少耐药与二重感染。 De-escalation therapy reduces resistance and superinfection.
体温正常两天了，可以考虑降阶梯治疗。 The temperature has been normal for two days, so de-escalation therapy can be considered.
滥用抗菌药物会加速耐药，须严格掌握指征。 Misuse of antibacterials accelerates drug resistance, so indications must be strict.
这个细菌已经耐药，普通抗生素没用。 This bacterium already shows drug resistance, so ordinary antibiotics will not work.
使用青霉素前须做皮试，阴性方可给药。 A skin test is required before penicillin, and the drug may be given only if it is negative.
皮试打了要等二十分钟看结果。 After the skin test you must wait twenty minutes for the result.
围手术期预防用药一般在切皮前半小时给予。 Perioperative prophylaxis is usually given half an hour before the incision.
这个是围手术期预防用药，术后不超过二十四小时。 This is perioperative prophylaxis and should not continue beyond twenty-four hours after surgery.
抗菌药物分级管理须在信息系统中设置权限。 Tiered management of antibacterials requires permissions to be set in the information system.
按抗菌药物分级管理，这个药要上级医生开。 Under tiered management of antibacterials, this drug needs a senior doctor to prescribe.
联合用药须有明确指征，避免无谓叠加。 Combination therapy needs a clear indication to avoid unnecessary stacking of drugs.
这两种药是联合用药，要一起吃才有效。 These two drugs are combination therapy and must be taken together to work.
滴速每分钟四十滴，须定时巡视。 The drip rate is forty drops per minute, and the line must be checked regularly.
滴速太快了，请调慢一点。 The drip rate is too fast, so slow it down.
溶媒选择错误会导致药物沉淀或失效。 Choosing the wrong solvent causes precipitation or loss of drug potency.
这个药只能用葡萄糖做溶媒。 This drug can only use glucose as the solvent.
冲管须使用与药物相容的溶媒，避免配伍反应。 Flush the line with a compatible solvent to avoid an incompatibility reaction.
两种药之间要冲管，别让它们在管里混。 Flush the line between the two drugs so they do not mix in the tubing.
配液须在净化台上完成并注明时间。 Admixture preparation must be done on a clean bench and the time noted.
配液好了，两小时内输完。 Admixture preparation is done; infuse it within two hours.
发现渗漏须立即拔针并抬高患肢。 If infiltration is found, remove the needle immediately and raise the limb.
手背肿起来了，可能是渗漏。 The back of the hand is swollen; it may be infiltration.
高警示药品须专区存放并加标识。 High-alert medication must be stored in a dedicated area with a label.
这是高警示药品，必须双人核对。 This is a high-alert medication and must be double-checked.
听似看似药品须分开放置并加警示标识。 Look-alike sound-alike medicines must be stored apart and marked with a warning label.
这两个药听似看似，拿药时要多看一眼。 These two are look-alike sound-alike drugs, so look carefully when picking them up.
胰岛素输注前须完成独立双核对。 Independent double check must be completed before insulin infusion.
独立双核对就是各看各的，别念出来。 Independent double check means each looks separately; do not read it aloud.
肝素过量可致出血，须监测凝血功能。 Heparin overdose can cause bleeding, so clotting must be monitored.
肝素是抗凝药，打针后按压久一点。 Heparin is an anticoagulant, so press longer after the injection.
高浓度电解质须稀释后缓慢静脉滴注。 Concentrated electrolyte must be diluted and infused slowly.
这个高浓度电解质不能直接推。 This concentrated electrolyte cannot be pushed directly.
细胞毒药物配制须在生物安全柜内完成。 Cytotoxic drug preparation must be done in a biological safety cabinet.
细胞毒药物外溅要按流程处理。 If a cytotoxic drug spills, follow the spill procedure.
麻醉药品须双人双锁管理并逐支登记。 Narcotic drugs require double locks with two people and a record for every ampoule.
麻醉药品开处方要用专用处方。 A narcotic drug requires a special prescription form.
精神药品分第一类与第二类管理。 Psychotropic drugs are managed as class one and class two.
这个精神药品要登记，别随便放。 This psychotropic drug must be registered, so do not leave it lying around.
高危药品标识须为红底白字，便于识别。 The high-alert label should be white on red for easy recognition.
看到高危药品标识就要多核对一遍。 When you see the high-alert label, check again.
给药错误须立即上报并评估患者影响。 An administration error must be reported at once and the patient assessed.
刚才给药错误了，赶紧告诉医生。 There was an administration error just now; tell the doctor immediately.
对乙酰氨基酚中毒须尽早给予乙酰半胱氨酸。 Acetylcysteine should be given early in paracetamol poisoning.
乙酰半胱氨酸味道难闻，可以稀释后喝。 Acetylcysteine smells unpleasant and can be diluted before drinking.
亚甲蓝用于治疗高铁血红蛋白血症。 Methylene blue is used to treat methaemoglobinaemia.
亚甲蓝会让人尿变蓝，别紧张。 Methylene blue turns the urine blue, so do not worry.
重金属中毒须使用螯合剂，并监测肾功能。 Heavy metal poisoning requires a chelating agent and monitoring of renal function.
螯合剂要按疗程打，不能一直用。 The chelating agent is given in courses; it cannot be used continuously.
过量处理包括稳定生命体征、清除毒物与解毒。 Overdose management includes stabilising vital signs, removing the drug, and giving antidotes.
过量处理先看呼吸和循环。 In overdose management, check breathing and circulation first.
解毒治疗须与清除毒物同时进行。 Antidotal treatment should proceed together with removal of the poison.
解毒治疗越早越好，别等结果。 Antidotal treatment should start as early as possible; do not wait for results.
呋塞米静脉推注后须记录尿量与电解质。 After intravenous furosemide, record urine output and electrolytes.
呋塞米推了，注意他会不会低钾。 Furosemide has been given, so watch for low potassium.
高钾血症可静脉注射葡萄糖酸钙保护心肌。 In hyperkalaemia, intravenous calcium gluconate protects the myocardium.
葡萄糖酸钙推慢点，别漏到血管外。 Push calcium gluconate slowly and avoid extravasation.
空腹采血前请确认患者已禁食八小时。 Confirm the patient has fasted eight hours before fasting blood sampling.
抽血要空腹采血，早上没吃东西吧。 This is fasting blood sampling, so you have not eaten this morning?
血常规用抗凝管，不能与生化管混用。 Use an anticoagulant tube for the blood count, not the biochemistry tube.
这个是抗凝管，抽完要马上颠倒混匀。 This is an anticoagulant tube; invert it gently right after collection.
采血管按颜色区分添加剂，请按顺序使用。 Blood collection tubes are colour-coded by additive; use them in order.
采血管顺序别弄错，不然结果会受影响。 Do not mix up the blood collection tube order, or the results will be affected.
真空采血减少溶血，是目前门诊的主要方式。 Vacuum blood collection reduces haemolysis and is the main outpatient method.
我们用真空采血，一下就好，不用紧张。 We use vacuum blood collection; it is quick, so do not worry.
血培养必须严格无菌采集，否则易报假阳性。 Blood cultures require strict aseptic specimen collection to avoid false positives.
无菌采集要注意，手别碰针头。 Mind the aseptic specimen collection; do not touch the needle.
皮肤消毒待干后再进针，避免消毒液混入标本。 Let skin disinfection dry before puncture to avoid contaminating the sample.
皮肤消毒有点凉，忍一下就好。 The skin disinfection feels cold; bear with it for a moment.
血培养采集应在抗菌药物使用前完成。 Blood culture collection should be completed before antibiotics are given.
先做血培养采集，再上抗生素。 Do the blood culture collection first, then start the antibiotic.
清洁后留取中段尿送培养，减少污染。 After cleansing, collect midstream urine for culture to reduce contamination.
留中段尿，先尿一点再接杯子。 Collect midstream urine: urinate a little first, then use the cup.
标本溶血会使血钾假性升高，需重新采集。 Hemolysis of specimen falsely raises potassium, so a new sample is needed.
这个标本溶血了，麻烦重新抽一次。 This sample shows hemolysis of specimen; please draw another one.
标本拒收要登记原因并通知临床重采。 Specimen rejection must be documented with a reason and the ward informed.
标本量不够，按标本拒收处理了。 The volume was short, so the specimen rejection rule was applied.
采血后先贴标本条码，再送检。 Apply the specimen barcode after collection, then send it to the laboratory.
条码贴歪了，麻烦贴好，标本条码要扫得上。 The label is crooked; stick it straight so the specimen barcode scans.
采血顺序错误可致钾、钙结果失真。 A wrong order of draw can distort potassium and calcium results.
按采血顺序来，先培养瓶再凝血管。 Follow the order of draw: culture bottles first, then the coagulation tube.
动脉采血后需按压五分钟并立即送检。 After arterial puncture, press for five minutes and send the sample at once.
动脉采血有点疼，忍一下，按好不能揉。 Arterial puncture stings; hold the pressure afterwards and do not rub.
急诊入院常规查血常规，半小时出结果。 A complete blood count is routine on admission, with results in thirty minutes.
先抽个血常规，看看白细胞高不高。 We will run a complete blood count to see if the white cells are up.
白细胞计数明显升高，提示细菌感染可能。 A raised white blood cell count suggests a bacterial infection.
白细胞计数二十，先按感染处理。 The white blood cell count is twenty, so treat as infection first.
红细胞计数降低伴血红蛋白下降，提示贫血。 A low red blood cell count with low haemoglobin points to anaemia.
红细胞计数偏低，得查一下有没有出血。 The red blood cell count is low, so check for bleeding.
血红蛋白六十，属于重度贫血，需备血。 A low red cell count with low hemoglobin points to anaemia.
血红蛋白太低了，先输不输血要评估。 The hemoglobin is very low; whether to transfuse needs assessment.
