血小板计数低于二十，出血风险很高。 A platelet count below twenty carries a high bleeding risk.
血小板计数低，穿刺后要多按一会儿。 The platelet count is low, so press longer after puncture.
红细胞压积与血红蛋白同步下降，支持失血判断。 A falling hematocrit together with haemoglobin supports blood loss.
红细胞压积掉得快，提示还在出血。 The hematocrit is dropping fast, suggesting ongoing bleeding.
平均红细胞体积偏小，提示缺铁可能。 A low mean corpuscular volume suggests possible iron deficiency.
平均红细胞体积低，先查铁蛋白。 The mean corpuscular volume is low; check ferritin first.
中性粒细胞比例升高，符合细菌感染表现。 A raised neutrophil proportion fits a bacterial infection.
中性粒细胞高，多半是细菌感染。 The neutrophils are high, which usually means bacterial infection.
淋巴细胞比例升高，常见于病毒感染。 A raised lymphocyte proportion is common in viral infection.
淋巴细胞高，考虑病毒性的。 The lymphocytes are high, so a viral cause is likely.
白细胞分类提示中性粒细胞为主，需复查。 The differential count is neutrophil-predominant and needs repeating.
白细胞分类我看一下，中性高不高。 Let me see the differential count: are the neutrophils high?
红细胞分布宽度增大，提示混合性贫血。 A raised red cell distribution width suggests a mixed anaemia.
红细胞分布宽度高，说明红细胞大小不一。 The red cell distribution width is high, so cell sizes vary.
网织红细胞升高提示骨髓代偿活跃。 A raised reticulocyte count means the marrow is compensating.
网织红细胞上来了，说明骨髓在造血。 The reticulocytes are rising, so the marrow is producing cells.
嗜酸性粒细胞增多，需追问过敏与寄生虫接触。 Eosinophilia calls for asking about allergy and parasite exposure.
嗜酸性粒细胞偏高，最近有没有过敏。 The eosinophils are raised; any recent allergy?
血小板压积随血小板计数同步变化。 Plateletcrit changes in step with the platelet count.
血小板压积也低，和血小板计数一致。 The plateletcrit is low too, matching the platelet count.
入院查肝功能，转氨酶明显升高。 Liver function tests on admission show markedly raised transaminases.
查个肝功能，看看转氨酶高不高。 Let us run liver function tests to check the transaminases.
肾功能异常时用药剂量需按肌酐调整。 When renal function is impaired, doses must be adjusted to creatinine.
肾功能不好，这个药得减量。 The renal function test is abnormal, so this drug needs a lower dose.
丙氨酸氨基转移酶升高三倍，需查病因。 Alanine aminotransferase is three times normal; the cause must be sought.
丙氨酸氨基转移酶很高，别再用伤肝的药。 The alanine aminotransferase is very high, so avoid hepatotoxic drugs.
天冬氨酸氨基转移酶与丙氨酸氨基转移酶同时升高。 Aspartate aminotransferase rises together with alanine aminotransferase.
天冬氨酸氨基转移酶也高，心肌和肝都要考虑。 The aspartate aminotransferase is also high, so consider heart and liver.
总胆红素升高伴巩膜黄染，提示黄疸。 A raised total bilirubin with scleral icterus indicates jaundice.
总胆红素高，眼睛也有点黄。 The total bilirubin is high and the eyes look yellow.
白蛋白偏低，提示营养差或慢性炎症。 A low albumin suggests poor nutrition or chronic inflammation.
白蛋白低，输液和营养都得调。 The albumin is low, so fluids and nutrition need adjusting.
血肌酐两天内翻倍，符合急性肾损伤。 Serum creatinine doubled in two days, consistent with acute kidney injury.
血肌酐涨得快，赶紧查尿量和用药。 The serum creatinine is rising fast; check urine output and drugs.
血尿素氮升高但肌酐正常，考虑脱水。 A raised blood urea nitrogen with normal creatinine suggests dehydration.
血尿素氮高，可能水不够，先补液。 The blood urea nitrogen is high, possibly from dehydration; give fluids.
估算肾小球滤过率低于三十，用药需调整。 An estimated glomerular filtration rate below thirty requires dose adjustment.
估算肾小球滤过率才三十，药得改。 The estimated glomerular filtration rate is only thirty, so change the drug.
急诊查电解质，血钾五点八需处理。 Electrolytes on arrival show potassium 5.8, which needs treatment.
先查电解质，钾高不高很关键。 Check the electrolytes; whether potassium is high matters.
血钾六点二，需要立即心电监护。 Serum potassium of 6.2 requires immediate cardiac monitoring.
血钾太高了，先降钾再谈别的。 The serum potassium is too high; lower it before anything else.
急诊先测血糖，低血糖要立刻纠正。 Check blood glucose first; hypoglycaemia must be corrected at once.
血糖三点一，先给糖再查原因。 The blood glucose is 3.1; give glucose first, then look for the cause.
乳酸脱氢酶明显升高，结合溶血指标判断。 Lactate dehydrogenase is markedly raised; interpret with haemolysis markers.
乳酸脱氢酶高，可能有组织破坏。 The lactate dehydrogenase is high, suggesting tissue breakdown.
术前常规查凝血功能，排除出血风险。 A coagulation profile is routine before surgery to exclude bleeding risk.
先查凝血功能，再决定能不能做操作。 Check the coagulation profile before deciding whether the procedure is safe.
凝血酶原时间延长，提示华法林作用或肝病。 A prolonged prothrombin time suggests warfarin effect or liver disease.
凝血酶原时间延长了，华法林吃了多少。 The prothrombin time is prolonged; how much warfarin have you taken?

zh: 活化部分凝血活酶时间
text: 活化部分凝血活酶时间明显延长，需查肝素用量。 A markedly prolonged activated partial thromboplastin time calls for checking heparin.

zh: 活化部分凝血活酶时间
text: 活化部分凝血活酶时间太长，肝素要减。 The activated partial thromboplastin time is too long; reduce the heparin.
纤维蛋白原降低见于消耗性凝血病。 A low fibrinogen is seen in consumptive coagulopathy.
纤维蛋白原低，得补冷沉淀。 The fibrinogen is low, so cryoprecipitate is needed.
急诊查D二聚体，阴性可辅助排除肺栓塞。 A negative D-dimer helps exclude pulmonary embolism in the emergency setting.
D二聚体高，不能只看这一项就下结论。 A high D-dimer alone is not enough to make the diagnosis.
凝血酶时间延长提示纤维蛋白原异常或肝素残留。 A prolonged thrombin time suggests abnormal fibrinogen or residual heparin.
凝血酶时间也延长，可能还有肝素。 The thrombin time is prolonged too, so heparin may still be present.
纤维蛋白降解产物升高，提示纤溶亢进。 Raised fibrin degradation products indicate enhanced fibrinolysis.
纤维蛋白降解产物高，符合弥散性血管内凝血。 The fibrin degradation product is high, consistent with disseminated coagulation.
抗凝血酶降低时肝素效果会变差。 When antithrombin is low, heparin works less well.
抗凝血酶低，肝素效果不好，要加量或换药。 The antithrombin is low, so heparin works poorly; increase or switch.
血小板聚集试验异常，提示血小板功能缺陷。 An abnormal platelet aggregation test suggests a platelet function defect.
血小板聚集试验不好，拔牙前要评估。 The platelet aggregation test is abnormal, so assess before extraction.
出血时间延长而血小板计数正常，考虑功能障碍。 A prolonged bleeding time with a normal count suggests a function disorder.
出血时间有点长，先别做有创操作。 The bleeding time is a little long, so avoid invasive procedures for now.
凝血因子缺乏需补充相应制品。 Deficient coagulation factors must be replaced with the matching product.
凝血因子缺，得输血浆补。 A coagulation factor is missing, so plasma is needed.
血栓弹力图指导大出血时的成分输血。 Thromboelastography guides component therapy in major haemorrhage.
做个血栓弹力图，按结果补血制品。 Run a thromboelastography and replace blood products by the result.
抗凝治疗监测需定期查国际标准化比值。 Anticoagulation monitoring requires regular international normalized ratio checks.
抗凝治疗监测不能停，一周复查一次。 Anticoagulation monitoring must continue, with weekly checks.
动脉血氧分压五十，需立即给氧。 An arterial partial pressure of oxygen of fifty requires immediate oxygen.
动脉血氧分压低，氧流量调大。 The arterial partial pressure of oxygen is low; increase the oxygen flow.

en: arterial partial pressure of carbon dioxide
text: 动脉血二氧化碳分压升高提示通气不足。 A raised arterial partial pressure of carbon dioxide indicates hypoventilation.

en: arterial partial pressure of carbon dioxide
text: 动脉血二氧化碳分压高，得考虑上无创通气。 The arterial partial pressure of carbon dioxide is high; consider non-invasive ventilation.
酸碱度七点二，属于失代偿性酸血症。 A pH of 7.2 indicates uncompensated acidaemia.
酸碱度偏酸，先找原因再补碱。 The pH is acidotic; find the cause before giving bicarbonate.
碳酸氢根降低提示代谢性酸中毒。 A low bicarbonate indicates metabolic acidosis.
碳酸氢根低，是代谢性的酸中毒。 The bicarbonate is low, so this is metabolic acidosis.
胸痛患者先抽心肌标志物，再做心电图。 For chest pain, draw cardiac markers first, then do the ECG.
先查心肌标志物，别漏了心梗。 Check the cardiac markers so we do not miss a heart attack.
高敏肌钙蛋白阴性可辅助快速排除心梗。 A negative high-sensitivity troponin helps rule out infarction quickly.
高敏肌钙蛋白两次都阴性，先观察。 Both high-sensitivity troponin results are negative; observe for now.
肌酸激酶明显升高，需排查横纹肌溶解。 A markedly raised creatine kinase calls for excluding rhabdomyolysis.
肌酸激酶这么高，查一下肌红蛋白和肾功。 The creatine kinase is high; check myoglobin and renal function.
肌酸激酶同工酶升高支持心肌损伤。 A raised creatine kinase MB supports myocardial injury.
肌酸激酶同工酶高，结合肌钙蛋白看。 The creatine kinase MB is up; interpret it with troponin.
肌红蛋白升高早但特异性差，需结合肌钙蛋白。 Myoglobin rises early but is non-specific, so interpret with troponin.
肌红蛋白高得早，但还得看肌钙蛋白。 The myoglobin rises early, but troponin still matters.
B型钠尿肽升高，提示心功能不全可能。 A raised B-type natriuretic peptide suggests cardiac dysfunction.
B型钠尿肽高，考虑心衰，先利尿。 The B-type natriuretic peptide is high; consider heart failure and give a diuretic.
N末端前脑钠肽显著升高，支持急性心衰诊断。 A markedly raised N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide supports acute heart failure.
N末端前脑钠肽很高，心衰跑不了。 The N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide is very high, so heart failure is likely.
心型脂肪酸结合蛋白可更早提示心肌损伤。 Heart-type fatty acid-binding protein signals myocardial injury earlier.
心型脂肪酸结合蛋白高得早，先按心梗观察。 The heart-type fatty acid-binding protein rises early; observe as infarction.
心肌损伤不等于心梗，需结合临床与心电图。 Myocardial injury is not the same as infarction; interpret with clinical data.
有心肌损伤，但不一定是心梗。 There is myocardial injury, but it is not necessarily infarction.
肌钙蛋白有诊断窗口期，太早抽血可能阴性。 Troponin has a diagnostic window, so an early sample may be negative.
过了诊断窗口期才抽，结果要看准。 This sample is past the diagnostic window, so interpret the result carefully.
肌钙蛋白动态变化符合急性心梗的演变。 The troponin kinetics fit the evolution of acute myocardial infarction.
盯着肌钙蛋白动态变化，两小时后再抽一次。 Watch the troponin kinetics and repeat the sample in two hours.
心肌酶谱轻度升高，需结合肌钙蛋白判断。 The myocardial enzyme panel is mildly raised and must be read with troponin.
心肌酶谱一起查，别只看一项。 Run the myocardial enzyme panel together, not just one test.
快速肌钙蛋白检测阴性，仍需按流程复查。 A negative rapid troponin assay still needs repeat testing per protocol.
先做快速肌钙蛋白检测，别等中心实验室。 Do the rapid troponin assay first rather than waiting for the central laboratory.
感染标志物升高，需结合培养结果判断。 Raised infection markers must be interpreted with culture results.
感染标志物都高，先上经验性抗生素。 The infection markers are all high, so start empirical antibiotics.
超敏C反应蛋白轻度升高，提示慢性炎症状态。 A mildly raised high-sensitivity C-reactive protein suggests chronic inflammation.
超敏C反应蛋白高一点，先别急着用抗生素。 The high-sensitivity C-reactive protein is slightly up; do not rush to antibiotics.
红细胞沉降率增快，见于感染与风湿活动。 A raised erythrocyte sedimentation rate occurs in infection and active rheumatism.
红细胞沉降率快，查查有没有慢性炎症。 The erythrocyte sedimentation rate is fast; look for chronic inflammation.
白细胞介素6显著升高，提示炎症反应强烈。 A markedly raised interleukin-6 indicates a strong inflammatory response.
白细胞介素6这么高，病情不轻。 The interleukin-6 is so high that the illness is not mild.
血清淀粉样蛋白A升高而C反应蛋白不高，提示病毒可能。 A raised serum amyloid A with a low C-reactive protein suggests a viral cause.
血清淀粉样蛋白A高，可能是病毒。 The serum amyloid A is high, so a virus is possible.
内毒素升高，需警惕革兰阴性菌败血症。 Raised endotoxin calls for vigilance for Gram-negative sepsis.
内毒素高，革兰阴性菌感染要考虑。 The endotoxin is high, so Gram-negative infection must be considered.
G试验阳性提示侵袭性真菌感染可能。 A positive 1,3-beta-D-glucan test suggests possible invasive fungal infection.
G试验阳性，真菌感染要查到底。 The 1,3-beta-D-glucan test is positive, so work up a fungal infection.
半乳甘露聚糖试验阳性，支持侵袭性曲霉病。 A positive galactomannan test supports invasive aspergillosis.
半乳甘露聚糖试验阳性，赶紧请感染科。 The galactomannan test is positive; call infectious diseases now.
病毒载量下降说明抗病毒治疗有效。 A falling viral load shows the antiviral treatment is working.
病毒载量降下来了，药继续吃。 The viral load has fallen, so keep taking the medicine.
抗体滴度四倍升高有诊断意义。 A fourfold rise in antibody titer is diagnostically significant.
抗体滴度查两次，看有没有升高。 Check the antibody titer twice to see whether it rises.
血培养阳性，需按药敏调整抗生素。 Blood culture positive means adjusting antibiotics to the susceptibility result.
培养阳性了，看看药敏再换药。 The culture is positive, so check susceptibility before switching drugs.
炎症指标回落，说明治疗有效。 The inflammatory markers are falling, which means treatment is working.
炎症指标还高，疗程没到。 The inflammatory markers are still high, so the course is not finished.
急诊查尿常规，白细胞明显增多。 Urinalysis in the emergency department shows many white cells.
先留个尿常规，看看有没有感染。 Leave a urine sample for urinalysis to check for infection.
尿蛋白两个加号，需查二十四小时定量。 Urine protein is two plus, so a twenty-four hour quantification is needed.
尿蛋白有加号，肾要查一下。 There is urine protein, so the kidneys need checking.
尿潜血阳性而镜检无红细胞，需复查。 Occult blood in urine without red cells on microscopy should be repeated.
尿潜血阳性，先排除月经污染。 Occult blood in urine is positive; first exclude menstrual contamination.
尿沉渣见大量白细胞管型，提示肾盂肾炎。 Urine sediment shows many white cell casts, suggesting pyelonephritis.
尿沉渣有管型，提示肾脏受累。 The urine sediment has casts, so the kidney is involved.
尿酮体三个加号，需警惕糖尿病酮症。 Urine ketone is three plus, so diabetic ketosis must be excluded.
尿酮体强阳性，赶紧查血糖血气。 The urine ketone is strongly positive; check glucose and blood gas quickly.
尿培养出大肠埃希菌，按药敏换药。 Urine culture grew Escherichia coli, so switch drugs by susceptibility.
尿培养结果出来了，看看对什么药敏感。 The urine culture is back; check which drugs it is sensitive to.
粪便隐血阳性，需进一步查消化道。 A positive fecal occult blood test requires gastrointestinal work-up.
粪便隐血阳性，别只当痔疮。 The fecal occult blood test is positive; do not dismiss it as haemorrhoids.
粪便常规见大量白细胞，提示肠道感染。 Stool routine shows many white cells, suggesting intestinal infection.
留个粪便常规，看看有没有感染。 Send a stool routine to check for infection.
粪便培养出沙门菌，需报传染病卡。 Stool culture grew Salmonella, so a notifiable disease report is required.
粪便培养阳性，按传染病流程处理。 The stool culture is positive, so follow the infectious disease pathway.
白细胞酯酶阳性，支持尿路感染。 A positive leukocyte esterase supports urinary tract infection.
白细胞酯酶阳性，先按尿路感染处理。 The leukocyte esterase is positive, so treat as urinary infection first.
亚硝酸盐阳性提示大肠埃希菌等感染。 A positive nitrite suggests infection with organisms such as Escherichia coli.
亚硝酸盐阳性，尿路感染可能性大。 The nitrite is positive, so urinary infection is likely.
24小时尿蛋白两克，达到肾病范围。 A 24-hour urine protein of two grams is in the nephrotic range.
留24小时尿蛋白要记好时间。 For the 24-hour urine protein, record the collection times carefully.
伤口分泌物细菌培养阳性，需清创。 Bacterial culture of the wound discharge is positive, so debridement is needed.
先做细菌培养，再决定用哪种抗生素。 Do a bacterial culture before choosing the antibiotic.
药敏试验提示对万古霉素敏感。 The antimicrobial susceptibility test shows sensitivity to vancomycin.
等药敏试验出来再换窄谱的。 Wait for the antimicrobial susceptibility test before narrowing coverage.
革兰染色见革兰阳性球菌成簇排列。 Gram stain shows clusters of Gram-positive cocci.
先看革兰染色，初步判断用什么药。 Look at the Gram stain first to guide the initial drug choice.
革兰阳性菌感染常选用青霉素类。 Gram-positive bacterium infections are often treated with penicillins.
革兰阳性菌，先按球菌覆盖。 It is a Gram-positive bacterium, so cover cocci first.
革兰阴性菌败血症进展快，需尽早用药。 Gram-negative bacterium sepsis progresses fast and needs early antibiotics.
革兰阴性菌，用药要覆盖肠道菌。 It is a Gram-negative bacterium, so cover enteric organisms.
真菌培养阳性，需评估免疫状态。 A positive fungal culture requires assessment of immune status.
真菌培养阳性，看看有没有免疫低下。 The fungal culture is positive; check for immunosuppression.
深部脓肿需同时送需氧与厌氧培养。 Deep abscess samples need both aerobic and anaerobic culture.
这个标本要加厌氧培养，别只做普通培养。 Add anaerobic culture for this sample, not just the routine one.
尿培养菌落计数超过十万，有诊断意义。 A colony count above one hundred thousand in urine culture is significant.
菌落计数够高，说明不是污染。 The colony count is high enough, so it is not contamination.
最低抑菌浓度越低，药物越有效。 The lower the minimum inhibitory concentration, the more effective the drug.
看最低抑菌浓度，别只看敏感还是耐药。 Check the minimum inhibitory concentration, not just sensitive or resistant.
检出多重耐药菌株需单间隔离。 Detection of a multidrug-resistant strain requires single-room isolation.
有多重耐药菌株，先隔离再谈治疗。 There is a multidrug-resistant strain, so isolate the patient first.

zh: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌
text: 痰培养检出耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌，需接触隔离。 Sputum culture grew methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus, so contact isolation is needed.

zh: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌
text: 检出耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌，按接触隔离办。 Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus was found; apply contact isolation.
痰培养出铜绿假单胞菌，按药敏调整。 Sputum culture grew Pseudomonas aeruginosa, so adjust by susceptibility.
痰培养要送合格的痰，口水不行。 For sputum culture send proper sputum, not saliva.
痰中检出定植菌时不必使用抗生素。 Antibiotics are unnecessary when sputum grows only a colonizer.
这是定植菌，不用为它上抗生素。 This is a colonizer, so no antibiotic is needed for it.
免疫学检查阳性，需结合临床判断。 The immunological test is positive and must be read with the clinical picture.
先做免疫学检查，看抗体有没有。 Run an immunological test to look for antibodies.
乙肝表面抗原阳性，需查病毒载量与肝功能。 A positive hepatitis B surface antigen requires viral load and liver tests.
乙肝表面抗原阳性，操作要按血源性防护。 Hepatitis B surface antigen is positive, so follow blood-borne precautions.
丙肝抗体阳性，需做核酸检测确认。 A positive hepatitis C antibody needs nucleic acid confirmation.
丙肝抗体阳性，先别下诊断，要查核酸。 A positive hepatitis C antibody is not a diagnosis until nucleic acid is checked.

zh: 人类免疫缺陷病毒抗体
text: 人类免疫缺陷病毒抗体初筛阳性，需送确证试验。 A reactive human immunodeficiency virus antibody screen requires confirmatory testing.

zh: 人类免疫缺陷病毒抗体
text: 人类免疫缺陷病毒抗体要送确证，别直接告诉患者结果。 The human immunodeficiency virus antibody needs confirmation; do not tell the patient yet.
梅毒螺旋体抗体阳性，需结合非特异性试验判断。 A positive Treponema pallidum antibody must be read with a non-treponemal test.
梅毒螺旋体抗体阳性，再查滴度。 The Treponema pallidum antibody is positive; check the titre too.
类风湿因子阳性不等于类风湿关节炎。 A positive rheumatoid factor does not equal rheumatoid arthritis.
类风湿因子高，还要看关节症状。 The rheumatoid factor is high, but joint symptoms still count.
抗链球菌溶血素O升高，提示近期链球菌感染。 A raised antistreptolysin O suggests recent streptococcal infection.
抗链球菌溶血素O高，问问他前阵子有没有咽痛。 The antistreptolysin O is high; ask about a recent sore throat.
补体C3降低，需考虑免疫复合物疾病。 A low complement C3 suggests immune complex disease.
补体C3低了，查查有没有活动性狼疮。 The complement C3 is low; look for active lupus.
交叉配血相合后才能发血。 Blood is issued only after crossmatching shows compatibility.
交叉配血过了，可以输血。 The crossmatching has passed, so transfusion can start.
血型鉴定为 A 型 Rh 阳性。 Blood typing shows group A, Rh positive.
先做血型鉴定，再谈输血。 Do the blood typing before discussing transfusion.
自身抗体谱阳性，需结合临床表现诊断。 A positive autoantibody panel needs clinical correlation before diagnosis.
自身抗体阳性，别急着下结论。 The autoantibody is positive; do not jump to a diagnosis.
不同实验室参考区间不同，需看本报告单。 Reference intervals differ between laboratories, so use the one printed on the report.
参考区间在每个报告单上，别记错。 The reference interval is printed on each report, so do not memorise it.
肌钙蛋白的医学决定水平通常取第九十九百分位。 The medical decision level for troponin is usually the ninety-ninth percentile.
超过医学决定水平就要处理，别只看正常值。 Above the medical decision level, act; do not rely on the normal range alone.
低于检测限的结果不能报告为零。 A result below the detection limit cannot be reported as zero.
低于检测限，写小于检测限，不要写零。 Below the detection limit, write less than the limit, not zero.
超出线性范围的结果需稀释后复测。 A result outside the linear range must be diluted and retested.
超线性范围了，稀释后重做。 It is outside the linear range; dilute and repeat.
室内质控失控时当批结果不能发出。 When internal quality control fails, that batch of results cannot be released.
室内质控没过，这批结果先别发。 Internal quality control failed, so hold this batch of results.
室间质评成绩合格才能开展该项目。 The laboratory must pass external quality assessment to run the test.
室间质评合格，这个项目才算靠谱。 External quality assessment is passed, which makes the test reliable.
结果异常时需先复核再通知临床。 An abnormal result should be verified before informing the clinician.
结果异常先复核一遍，别急着报。 For an abnormal result, verify it first before reporting.
标本污染可造成假阳性，需重复检测。 Specimen contamination can cause a false positive, so repeat the test.
这可能是假阳性，重新抽血复查。 This may be a false positive; redraw and repeat.
采样过早可导致假阴性，需复查。 Sampling too early can cause a false negative, so retest.
别被假阴性骗了，两小时后再抽。 Do not be misled by a false negative; repeat in two hours.
检验结果互认可减少重复抽血。 Mutual recognition of test results reduces repeat blood draws.
同级医院的检验结果互认，别重复抽。 Mutual recognition of test results applies here, so do not redraw.
参考方法用于校准常规检测系统。 A reference method is used to calibrate routine testing systems.
这个项目用参考方法做的，结果可信。 This test used the reference method, so the result is reliable.
检验报告需双人审核后发放。 The laboratory report is released after review by two staff.
检验报告出来了，我给您解释一下。 The laboratory report is back; let me explain it.
流感抗原阴性，不能完全排除流感。 A negative influenza antigen test does not fully exclude influenza.
结果是阴性，先放心一半。 The result is negative, so that is partly reassuring.
血培养阳性，需立即通知临床。 A positive blood culture must be reported to the clinician at once.
阳性了，得马上告诉医生。 It is positive, so tell the doctor immediately.
弱阳性结果建议两周后复查。 A weakly positive result should be repeated in two weeks.
弱阳性先别慌，过两周复查。 A weakly positive result is not alarming; repeat in two weeks.
胸片未见异常，但不能排除早期病变。 No abnormality detected on the chest film, but early disease is not excluded.
报告写未见异常，先按这个处理。 The report says no abnormality detected, so manage accordingly.
报告写待排肺栓塞，需马上做CT血管成像。 The report says pulmonary embolism to be excluded, so CT angiography is urgent.
写的是待排，不是确诊，别吓着患者。 It says to be excluded, not confirmed, so do not frighten the patient.
发热待查需完善感染与免疫筛查。 Fever pending investigation requires infection and immune screening.
写待查就是还没查清楚，别自己猜。 Pending investigation means it is not settled, so do not guess.
急诊检验报告时限为六十分钟。 The laboratory turnaround time for emergency reports is sixty minutes.
检验报告时限一小时，别催了。 The laboratory turnaround time is one hour, so no need to chase it.
报告审核通过后才能发放给临床。 The report is released to the clinician only after report verification.
报告审核还没过，先等通知。 Report verification has not passed yet, so wait for the notice.
解释性备注提示该结果需结合临床症状判断。 The interpretive comment notes that the result needs clinical correlation.
看解释性备注，别只看数字。 Read the interpretive comment, not just the numbers.
结果复核发现报告序号与标本不符。 Result review found the report number did not match the specimen.
结果复核过一遍，确认没问题再发。 Do a result review and release it once confirmed.
检验结论提示缺铁性贫血可能。 The laboratory impression suggests possible iron deficiency anaemia.
检验结论写得很清楚，按它处理。 The laboratory impression is clear, so act on it.
报告用语应避免绝对化表述，如确诊、排除。 Reporting wording should avoid absolutes such as confirmed or excluded.
报告用语规范点，别写得太绝对。 Keep the reporting wording standard and avoid absolutes.
电子报告与纸质报告具有同等效力。 The electronic report carries the same weight as the paper one.
电子报告在系统里能查，不用等纸的。 The electronic report is in the system, so no need to wait for paper.
X线摄影示右下肢骨折。 Radiography shows a fracture of the right lower limb.
先拍个X线摄影，看看骨头。 Do a radiography first to check the bone.
急诊头颅计算机断层扫描未见出血。 Emergency computed tomography of the head shows no haemorrhage.
马上推去做计算机断层扫描，怀疑出血。 Take him for computed tomography now; bleeding is suspected.
先做平扫排除出血，再考虑增强。 Do a non-contrast scan first to exclude bleeding, then consider contrast.
先平扫，别急着打造影剂。 Do the non-contrast scan first; do not rush the contrast.
增强扫描示肝右叶不均匀强化。 The contrast-enhanced scan shows heterogeneous enhancement in the right liver lobe.
增强扫描要签同意书，先问过敏史。 The contrast-enhanced scan needs consent, so ask about allergy first.
肺窗见双下肺渗出影。 The lung window shows infiltrates in both lower lungs.
调到肺窗，看清肺里的情况。 Switch to the lung window to see the lungs clearly.
纵隔窗见气管旁淋巴结增大。 The mediastinal window shows enlarged paratracheal nodes.
纵隔窗再看一遍，淋巴结大不大。 Look again on the mediastinal window: are the nodes enlarged?
骨窗见颅骨线样透亮影，提示骨折。 The bone window shows a linear lucency in the skull, suggesting fracture.
切到骨窗，看有没有骨折线。 Switch to the bone window to look for a fracture line.
薄层厚扫描可发现更小的病灶。 Thinner slice thickness allows smaller lesions to be detected.
层厚调薄一点，小结节才看得见。 Reduce the slice thickness so small nodules are visible.
图像重建后矢状面显示更清楚。 After image reconstruction the sagittal view is clearer.
图像重建完再看冠状面。 Finish the image reconstruction, then review the coronal view.
腹部平片见多个液气平面，提示肠梗阻。 The abdominal radiograph shows multiple air-fluid levels, suggesting obstruction.
腹部平片看有没有气腹。 Check the abdominal radiograph for free air.
儿童检查应尽量降低辐射剂量。 Radiation dose should be kept as low as possible in children.
这个检查辐射剂量不低，能替代就替代。 This examination carries a real radiation dose, so substitute if possible.
三维重建清晰显示骨折块移位方向。 Three-dimensional reconstruction clearly shows the direction of fracture displacement.
做个三维重建，手术前看清楚。 Do a three-dimensional reconstruction to see it clearly before surgery.
磁共振成像示腰椎间盘突出。 Magnetic resonance imaging shows a lumbar disc herniation.
磁共振成像要预约，还不能带金属。 Magnetic resonance imaging needs booking and no metal is allowed.
T1加权成像示出血呈高信号。 T1-weighted imaging shows the haemorrhage as high signal.
看T1加权成像，脂肪是亮的。 On T1-weighted imaging, fat appears bright.
T2加权成像示脑白质高信号灶。 T2-weighted imaging shows high-signal foci in the white matter.
T2加权成像上水肿看得清楚。 Oedema is clearly seen on T2-weighted imaging.
弥散加权成像高信号提示急性脑梗死。 High signal on diffusion-weighted imaging suggests acute infarction.
弥散加权成像亮，考虑急性梗死。 It is bright on diffusion-weighted imaging, so consider acute infarction.

zh: 液体衰减反转恢复序列
text: 液体衰减反转恢复序列示脑室旁高信号。 The fluid-attenuated inversion recovery sequence shows periventricular high signal.

zh: 液体衰减反转恢复序列
text: 看液体衰减反转恢复序列，病灶更明显。 Look at the fluid-attenuated inversion recovery sequence; the lesion stands out.
磁共振血管成像示右侧大脑中动脉狭窄。 Magnetic resonance angiography shows stenosis of the right middle cerebral artery.
先做磁共振血管成像，看血管通不通。 Do magnetic resonance angiography first to check vessel patency.
超声检查示胆囊壁增厚。 Ultrasonography shows thickening of the gallbladder wall.
做个超声检查，看胆囊。 Do an ultrasonography to look at the gallbladder.
彩色多普勒超声示下肢静脉血栓形成。 Color Doppler ultrasonography shows deep vein thrombosis of the leg.
彩色多普勒超声看血流，血栓一目了然。 Color Doppler ultrasonography shows the flow, so the clot is obvious.
超声心动图示左室射血分数下降。 Echocardiography shows a reduced left ventricular ejection fraction.
做个超声心动图，看心功能。 Do an echocardiography to assess cardiac function.
弹性成像提示结节质地偏硬。 Elastography suggests the nodule is relatively stiff.
加做弹性成像，看硬不硬。 Add elastography to see how stiff it is.
超声造影示病灶动脉期快速强化。 Contrast-enhanced ultrasound shows rapid arterial enhancement of the lesion.
超声造影能看血供，比普通超声清楚。 Contrast-enhanced ultrasound shows the blood supply more clearly.
体内有心脏起搏器属于磁共振禁忌证。 A cardiac pacemaker is a contraindication to MRI.
先问有没有磁共振禁忌证，起搏器不能进。 Ask about any contraindication to MRI; a pacemaker cannot go in.
造影检查示右肾动脉狭窄。 Contrast examination shows stenosis of the right renal artery.
造影检查前要签知情同意。 Consent is required before a contrast examination.
对比剂经静脉注入后即刻扫描。 The contrast medium is injected intravenously and scanning follows at once.
对比剂打进去会有点发热，正常。 The contrast medium may feel warm; that is normal.
碘对比剂使用前需评估肾功能。 Renal function must be checked before iodinated contrast medium is given.
碘对比剂对肾有影响，先查肌酐。 Iodinated contrast medium affects the kidney, so check creatinine first.
钆对比剂在严重肾功能不全时需慎用。 Gadolinium-based contrast agent should be used cautiously in severe renal impairment.
钆对比剂对肾要求高，先看肾功能。 The gadolinium-based contrast agent needs good renal function, so check it.
有对比剂过敏史者检查前需预处理。 Those with contrast medium allergy need premedication before scanning.
有对比剂过敏就别直接做，要先预处理。 With contrast medium allergy, premedicate rather than scan directly.
碘对比剂可引起过敏样反应，需备抢救药。 Iodinated contrast can cause an anaphylactoid reaction, so keep resuscitation drugs ready.
出现过敏样反应，先停药给氧。 If an anaphylactoid reaction occurs, stop the agent and give oxygen.
造影前准备包括问过敏史与查肌酐。 Pre-contrast preparation includes allergy history and creatinine testing.
造影前准备做完了吗，过敏史问了吗。 Is pre-contrast preparation complete? Was the allergy history taken?
高危患者造影前后需水化。 High-risk patients need hydration before and after contrast.
记得给水化，不然容易伤肾。 Remember hydration, or the kidney may be damaged.
造影后观察三十分钟，无不适方可离院。 After thirty minutes of post-contrast observation the patient may leave if well.
造影后观察半小时再走。 Stay for half an hour of post-contrast observation.
对比剂肾病多在三天内肌酐升高。 In contrast-induced nephropathy creatinine rises within three days.
小心对比剂肾病，术后复查肌酐。 Watch for contrast-induced nephropathy and recheck creatinine.
血管造影示冠状动脉前降支闭塞。 Angiography shows occlusion of the left anterior descending artery.
血管造影能看清堵在哪儿。 Angiography shows exactly where the blockage is.
数字减影血管造影示动脉瘤形态。 Digital subtraction angiography shows the aneurysm morphology.
要做数字减影血管造影，得进导管室。 Digital subtraction angiography is needed, so go to the catheter laboratory.
注射速率过快可致血管外渗。 An excessive injection rate can cause extravasation.
注射速率调低一点，血管细。 Lower the injection rate; the vein is small.
影像诊断考虑右侧肺炎。 The imaging diagnosis is right-sided pneumonia.
影像诊断只是参考，还要看临床。 The imaging diagnosis is only a reference and must be read with the clinical picture.
影像表现描述病灶大小、位置与密度。 The imaging finding describes the size, site, and density of the lesion.
影像表现写得很细，按这个判断。 The imaging finding is detailed, so judge from it.
出现典型的影像征象，支持肠梗阻。 The typical imaging sign supports bowel obstruction.
这个影像征象很典型，基本能定。 This imaging sign is typical, so the diagnosis is fairly secure.
右肺上叶见占位性病变，需进一步评估。 A space-occupying lesion is seen in the right upper lobe and needs further assessment.
报告写占位性病变，先别告诉患者是癌。 The report says space-occupying lesion, so do not tell the patient it is cancer.
头颅CT见高密度影，考虑出血。 Head CT shows a hyperdense shadow, suggesting haemorrhage.
这儿有高密度影，可能是血。 There is a hyperdense shadow here, possibly blood.
左额叶见片状低密度影，提示水肿。 A patchy hypodense shadow in the left frontal lobe suggests oedema.
低密度影这块是水肿还是梗死，要复查。 Is this hypodense shadow oedema or infarction? Repeat the scan.
强化程度不均，提示坏死可能。 The degree of enhancement is uneven, suggesting possible necrosis.
强化程度低，血供不丰富。 The degree of enhancement is low, so blood supply is poor.
肿块边界清楚，良性可能性大。 The mass is well-defined, so a benign lesion is more likely.
报告说边界清楚，先别太担心。 The report says well-defined, so do not worry too much.
小结节建议三个月后随访复查。 For the small nodule, follow-up imaging in three months is advised.
这个要随访复查，别一年后才来。 This needs follow-up imaging, so do not wait a year.
报告建议进一步检查，除外肿瘤。 The report recommends further imaging to exclude a mass.
报告写建议进一步检查，我们加做增强。 The report says recommend further imaging, so add a contrast study.
影像与临床不符时需重新评估或复查。 When there is an imaging-clinical discrepancy, reassess or repeat the scan.
影像与临床不符，别只信片子。 There is an imaging-clinical discrepancy, so do not trust the film alone.
疑难病例安排会诊读片后再出报告。 Difficult cases go to imaging consultation before the report is issued.
这个片子安排会诊读片，别急着发报告。 Arrange an imaging consultation for this study; do not issue the report yet.
影像结论为急性阑尾炎可能。 The imaging conclusion is possible acute appendicitis.
影像结论我看懂了，就是阑尾炎可能。 I understand the imaging conclusion: probable appendicitis.
门诊病历须由接诊医师书写并签名。 The outpatient medical record must be written and signed by the treating physician.
把门诊病历给医生看，别只带化验单。 Show the doctor the outpatient medical record, not just the lab slips.
急诊病历须准确记录到院时间与离院时间。 The emergency department medical record must accurately record arrival and departure times.
急诊病历我们自己写，家属不要代签。 We write the emergency department medical record ourselves, so family members should not sign for it.
留观病历每日记录一次，病情变化随时记录。 The observation unit record is written once daily, and at any time the condition changes.
他还在留观，留观病历先别归档。 He is still under observation, so do not archive the observation unit record yet.
入院记录应在患者入院后二十四小时内完成。 The admission note should be completed within twenty-four hours of admission.
入院记录写好了吗，护士站等着收。 Is the admission note ready, the nursing station is waiting for it.
住院病历包括入院记录、病程记录与出院小结。 The inpatient medical record includes the admission note, progress notes and discharge summary.
住院病历不能带走，只能按规定复印。 The inpatient medical record cannot be taken away, only copied according to the rules.
病案在出院后三个工作日内归档。 The medical record is archived within three working days after discharge.
这份病案已经归档，调阅要走流程。 This medical record has already been archived, so retrieval must follow the procedure.
病案首页的诊断应按主要诊断选择原则填写。 Diagnoses on the medical record front sheet should follow the principal diagnosis rules.
病案首页这里填错了，主要诊断和手术要对上。 The medical record front sheet is filled in wrongly here, the principal diagnosis must match the operation.
系统按就诊记录自动生成费用清单。 The system generates the billing list automatically from the visit record.
这次就诊记录里没写过敏史，补一下。 This visit record does not mention allergies, please add it.
复诊记录须写明上次治疗后症状变化。 The follow-up visit record must state how symptoms changed after the previous treatment.
复诊记录接着上次写，别重开一份。 Continue the follow-up visit record from last time, do not start a new one.
门诊日志每日核对一次，不得漏登。 The outpatient register is checked daily and no entry may be omitted.
门诊日志上这个人没登记，先补上。 This patient is not in the outpatient register, add the entry first.
住院登记完成后才能生成住院号。 The inpatient number is generated only after inpatient registration is complete.
住院登记还没做，先办手续再上病房。 Inpatient registration is not done yet, finish the paperwork before going to the ward.
纸质病历与电子病历内容不一致时以原件为准。 When the paper medical record and the electronic record differ, the original prevails.
纸质病历还在架子上，扫描完再归档。 The paper medical record is still on the shelf, scan it before archiving.
病历摘要包括诊断、主要检查与治疗经过。 The medical record summary covers diagnoses, key investigations and the treatment course.
给他出一份病历摘要，转诊要用。 Issue a medical record summary for him, it is needed for the referral.
就诊前处理：自服硝酸甘油一片，症状未缓解。 Pre-visit management: one glyceryl trinitrate tablet self-administered without relief.
就诊前处理问清楚，吃过什么药、谁给的。 Clarify the pre-visit management, what was taken and who gave it.
疫区接触史：发病前两周到过登革热流行区。 Epidemic area contact history: visited a dengue-endemic area two weeks before onset.
疫区接触史要问，发热病人别漏了。 Ask the epidemic area contact history, do not miss it in febrile patients.
旅居史：近一月曾赴东南亚三国。 Travel and residence history: travelled to three Southeast Asian countries in the past month.
旅居史问细一点，去了哪些国家。 Ask the travel and residence history in detail, which countries did he visit.
浅表淋巴结未触及肿大。 Superficial lymph nodes were not enlarged on palpation.
浅表淋巴结摸一下，颈部有没有肿大。 Palpate the superficial lymph nodes, is there enlargement in the neck.
肺部听诊：右下肺可闻及湿啰音。 Pulmonary auscultation: crackles audible over the right lower lung.
肺部听诊两边对比着听。 On pulmonary auscultation, compare both sides.
脊柱四肢：脊柱无畸形，四肢活动自如。 Spine and limbs: no spinal deformity and free limb movement.
脊柱四肢都要看，别漏了脚上的伤。 Check the spine and limbs, do not miss the injury on the foot.
专科检查：右膝浮髌试验阳性。 Specialized examination: positive ballottement test of the right knee.
专科检查请骨科来补，我们写的太简单。 Ask orthopaedics to add the specialized examination, ours is too brief.
初步诊断：急性冠脉综合征待排。 Preliminary diagnosis: acute coronary syndrome to be excluded.
初步诊断先写上，等结果出来再改。 Write the preliminary diagnosis first and revise it when results come back.
入院诊断：社区获得性肺炎。 Admission diagnosis: community-acquired pneumonia.
入院诊断和门诊不一样，要在病程里说明理由。 The admission diagnosis differs from the outpatient one, so the reason must be explained in the progress note.
出院诊断：急性阑尾炎，术后恢复良好。 Discharge diagnosis: acute appendicitis with good postoperative recovery.
出院诊断按主要诊断排第一，别把顺序写乱。 The discharge diagnosis lists the principal diagnosis first, do not mix the order.
修正诊断：由肺炎修正为肺结核。 Revised diagnosis: changed from pneumonia to pulmonary tuberculosis.
修正诊断要写清依据，不能只改结论。 The revised diagnosis must state the basis, not just change the conclusion.
补充诊断：二型糖尿病。 Supplementary diagnosis: type 2 diabetes mellitus.
补充诊断别忘了首页也要同步。 Do not forget the supplementary diagnosis must be synced to the front sheet too.
鉴别诊断应考虑主动脉夹层与肺栓塞。 The differential diagnosis should include aortic dissection and pulmonary embolism.
鉴别诊断要写出为什么排、怎么排。 The differential diagnosis must state why and how each condition is excluded.
疑似诊断：急性胰腺炎。 Suspected diagnosis: acute pancreatitis.
疑似诊断要跟家属讲清楚，别当成确诊。 Explain the suspected diagnosis clearly to the family and do not present it as confirmed.
确诊需病理结果支持。 The confirmed diagnosis requires pathological support.
确诊了再跟病人谈，先别下结论。 Wait until the diagnosis is confirmed before talking to the patient, do not conclude early.
临床诊断与病理诊断不一致时须讨论。 A discrepancy between the clinical diagnosis and the pathological diagnosis must be discussed.
这个只是临床诊断，最后还要等病理。 This is only the clinical diagnosis, we still await pathology.
病理诊断：浸润性导管癌。 Pathological diagnosis: invasive ductal carcinoma.
病理诊断出来了，赶紧告诉主管医生。 The pathological diagnosis is back, tell the doctor in charge quickly.
术后并发症为肺部感染。 The postoperative complication was pulmonary infection.
并发症要写进出院小结，不能省。 The complication must be written in the discharge summary, it cannot be omitted.
误诊原因分析已写入死亡病例讨论记录。 The analysis of the misdiagnosis was entered in the death case discussion record.
不能轻易写误诊，要有依据。 Do not write misdiagnosis lightly, it needs evidence.
医嘱须由具备处方权的医师下达。 Medical orders must be issued by a physician with prescribing rights.
医嘱改一下，把输液速度降下来。 Change the medical order and lower the infusion rate.
长期医嘱包括低盐饮食与每日测血压。 Standing orders included a low-salt diet and daily blood pressure measurement.
长期医嘱开好没有，护理要照着执行。 Are the standing orders written, nursing will follow them.
临时医嘱：地西泮十毫克，睡前一次。 Temporary order: diazepam ten milligrams once at bedtime.
临时医嘱别忘了开，今晚就要做。 Do not forget the temporary order, it is needed tonight.
备用医嘱：体温超过三十八度五予退热药。 As-needed order: antipyretic if temperature exceeds 38.5 degrees.
备用医嘱要看条件，不是每天都给。 The as-needed order depends on the condition, it is not given every day.
停止医嘱后护士须及时在系统内确认。 After a discontinue order the nurse must confirm it in the system promptly.
这个药停止医嘱开了吗，别再输了。 Has the discontinue order been written for this drug, do not infuse it again.
医嘱执行后须记录执行时间与执行人。 After order implementation, the time and the person must be recorded.
医嘱执行了没有，签字才算完成。 Has the order been implemented? It counts only after signing.
医嘱核对由两名护士完成。 Order verification is completed by two nurses.
医嘱核对别走过场，剂量要看清楚。 Do not treat order verification as a formality, check the dose carefully.
医嘱转抄后须与原医嘱逐项核对。 After order transcription every item must be checked against the original order.
医嘱转抄容易错，转完再对一遍。 Order transcription is error-prone, check it again after copying.
出院医嘱须写明复诊时间与联系电话。 The discharge order must state the follow-up time and contact number.
出院医嘱给病人讲一遍，别只塞张纸。 Explain the discharge order to the patient, do not just hand over a sheet.
医嘱变更须注明原因与时间。 Order modification must state the reason and the time.
医嘱变更了要通知护士，不然还按老的开。 When an order modification is made, tell the nurse or the old one will still be followed.
医嘱审核由临床药师完成，发现问题退回医师。 Order review is done by a clinical pharmacist, who returns problems to the physician.
这个医嘱审核没过，剂量超了，先别发药。 This order review failed because the dose is too high, do not dispense yet.
医嘱补录须注明实际下达时间与补录原因。 Late order entry must state the actual order time and the reason for the delay.
医嘱补录不要写成现在时间，要写实际时间。 For late order entry do not write the current time, write the actual time.
电子医嘱须由下达医师本人完成医嘱签名。 Electronic orders must be signed by the ordering physician personally.
医嘱签名是你自己的工号，不能代签。 The order signature must be your own staff number, no signing on behalf of others.
病程记录须反映病情变化与上级医师意见。 The progress note must reflect changes in condition and the senior physician's opinion.
病程记录今天还没写，查完房补上。 The progress note is not written today, complete it after rounds.
首次病程记录须在入院后八小时内完成。 The initial progress note must be completed within eight hours of admission.
首次病程记录写了吗，八小时内要完成。 Is the initial progress note done, it is due within eight hours.
日常病程记录一般每日一次，危重患者随时记录。 A daily progress note is usual, with entries at any time for critically ill patients.
日常病程记录别只写病情平稳四个字。 Do not write only stable condition in the daily progress note.
上级医师查房记录须有上级医师签名。 The senior physician rounds note must be signed by that physician.
上级医师查房记录还没签，催一下。 The senior physician rounds note is unsigned, please chase it up.
主治医师查房记录应体现诊断依据与治疗调整。 The attending physician rounds note should show the diagnostic basis and treatment changes.
主治医师查房记录写在日常病程后面。 The attending physician rounds note goes after the daily progress entry.
主任医师查房记录须在一周内完成首次。 The first chief physician rounds note must be completed within one week.
主任医师查房记录要把下一步方案写清楚。 The chief physician rounds note must state the next plan clearly.
疑难病例讨论记录须写明参加人员与结论。 The difficult case discussion record must list participants and conclusions.
这个病人要不要提交疑难病例讨论记录。 Should this patient go to a difficult case discussion record.
术前小结由经治医师书写，上级医师审签。 The preoperative summary is written by the treating physician and reviewed by a senior.
术前小结写完整，麻醉科要看。 Complete the preoperative summary, anaesthesia will review it.
术后首次病程记录须在术后即刻完成。 The first postoperative progress note must be completed immediately after surgery.
术后首次病程记录别拖，回病房就写。 Do not delay the first postoperative progress note, write it back on the ward.
住院满一个月须写阶段小结。 An interval summary is required after one month of admission.
阶段小结这个月该写了，别等出院。 The interval summary is due this month, do not wait until discharge.
交接班记录须写明危重患者与待处理事项。 The handover record must list critically ill patients and pending tasks.
交接班记录写清楚，别口头说说就完了。 Write the handover record properly, do not just say it verbally.
病情变化记录须写明时间、表现与处理。 The record of condition change must state the time, findings and management.
病人刚抽搐了，病情变化记录马上写。 The patient just had a seizure, write the record of condition change at once.
诊疗计划须与诊断和病情相符。 The treatment plan must match the diagnosis and the condition.
诊疗计划写具体点，别写继续治疗。 Make the treatment plan specific, do not write continue treatment.
护理记录与病程记录须相互对应。 The nursing record and the progress note must correspond to each other.
护理记录里生命体征那栏空着，补上。 The vital signs column in the nursing record is blank, fill it in.
科内会诊由科室主任组织。 Intradepartmental consultation is organised by the department head.
科内会诊定在下午，大家把片子带上。 Intradepartmental consultation is this afternoon, bring the images.
科间会诊须在二十四小时内完成。 Interdepartmental consultation must be completed within twenty-four hours.
科间会诊单开了没，心内科到现在没来。 Has the interdepartmental consultation been requested, cardiology has not come yet.
院外会诊须经医务部门审批备案。 Outside consultation requires approval and filing by the medical affairs office.
院外会诊的手续先走，别先请人来了。 Complete the outside consultation formalities first, do not bring the expert in yet.
急会诊须在十分钟内到位。 Urgent consultation must be attended within ten minutes.
叫急会诊，病人血压掉了。 Call an urgent consultation, the blood pressure has dropped.
会诊申请须写明会诊目的与主要问题。 The consultation request must state the purpose and main questions.
会诊申请写清楚要解决什么问题。 Make the consultation request clear about what needs solving.
会诊意见已记录在病程中，请主管医师落实。 The consultation opinion has been recorded in the progress note, the treating physician should act on it.
会诊意见和我们的方案不一样，先讨论再改。 The consultation opinion differs from our plan, discuss before changing it.
会诊记录由会诊医师书写并签名。 The consultation record is written and signed by the consulting physician.
会诊记录别只写同意目前治疗。 Do not write only agree with current treatment in the consultation record.
多学科会诊每周三下午固定进行。 Multidisciplinary consultation is held every Wednesday afternoon.
这个肿瘤病人走多学科会诊更合适。 This cancer patient is better handled through multidisciplinary consultation.
转科记录由转出科室书写，转入科室接收。 The transfer note is written by the departing department and received by the incoming one.
转科记录写好了吗，那边等着接收。 Is the transfer note ready, they are waiting to receive.
转院手续须经科主任与医务部门同意。 The hospital transfer procedure requires the department head and medical affairs approval.
转院手续先办，救护车我来联系。 Complete the hospital transfer procedure first, I will arrange the ambulance.
接收科室须在转科记录上签字确认。 The receiving department must sign the transfer note to confirm.
接收科室说没床，先别推病人过去。 The receiving department says there is no bed, do not move the patient yet.
转科交接须双方护士与医师共同完成。 Transfer handover must be completed jointly by nurses and physicians of both sides.
转科交接要当面做，别只发个消息。 Transfer handover must be done face to face, not just by message.
手术记录须在术后二十四小时内完成。 The operative note must be completed within twenty-four hours after surgery.
手术记录写完给我看，别只写手术顺利。 Show me the operative note when done, do not just write surgery went well.
手术通知单须注明手术名称、部位与麻醉方式。 The surgery notification must state the procedure, site and anaesthetic method.
手术通知单今天下午三点前送到手术室。 Send the surgery notification to the theatre before three this afternoon.
手术部位标识须由术者在患者清醒时完成。 Surgical site marking must be done by the surgeon while the patient is awake.
手术部位标识做了吗，左膝还是右膝。 Has the surgical site marking been done, left or right knee.
手术分级与术者资质必须匹配。 The surgery classification must match the surgeon's credentials.
这台是四级手术，主刀要有相应资质。 This is a level-four operation under surgery classification, the surgeon needs the matching credentials.
麻醉记录须包含麻醉方式、用药与出入量。 The anesthesia record must include the technique, drugs and fluid balance.
麻醉记录单贴到病历里，别丢了。 File the anesthesia record in the chart, do not lose it.
麻醉术前访视记录须写明明细与 ASA 分级。 The pre-anesthetic visit record must state the findings and ASA class.
麻醉术前访视记录做了没，明天第一台。 Has the pre-anesthetic visit record been done, first case tomorrow.
麻醉复苏记录须记录离室评分与时间。 The post-anesthesia recovery record must note the discharge score and time.
麻醉复苏记录写完了再送回病房。 Finish the post-anesthesia recovery record before sending the patient back.
术后随访记录须在术后二十四小时内完成。 The postoperative follow-up record must be completed within twenty-four hours.
术后随访记录别忘写镇痛评分。 Do not forget the analgesia score in the postoperative follow-up record.
植入物登记须记录产品名称与批号。 Implant registration must record the product name and batch number.
植入物登记标签贴在病历上，不然后续没法追溯。 Stick the implant registration label in the chart, otherwise traceability fails.
手术清点记录须由巡回与器械护士共同签名。 The surgical count record must be signed by the circulating and scrub nurses.
手术清点记录对不上，先别关腹。 The surgical count record does not match, do not close yet.
手术风险评估包括心肺功能与营养状态。 Surgical risk assessment covers cardiorespiratory function and nutrition.
手术风险评估是高危，术前要跟家属谈清楚。 Surgical risk assessment is high risk, discuss it clearly with the family preoperatively.
麻醉分级为三级，属高风险患者。 The ASA physical status classification was three, a high-risk patient.
麻醉分级写几级，术前访视单上要填。 What is the ASA class, fill it in on the pre-anesthetic form.
抢救记录须在抢救结束后六小时内补记完成。 The rescue record must be completed within six hours after resuscitation ends.
抢救记录现在补，六小时内必须写完。 Complete the rescue record now, it must be done within six hours.
抢救起止时间须精确到分钟并双人核对。 The rescue start and end time must be to the minute and checked by two staff.
抢救起止时间记准，家属会问几点开始的。 Record the rescue start and end time accurately, the family will ask when it began.
抢救经过须按时间顺序写明各项措施与反应。 The course of rescue must state each measure and response in chronological order.
抢救经过写得细一点，几点给药几点除颤。 Write the course of rescue in detail, when drugs were given and when defibrillation was done.
抢救措施包括气管插管、静脉通路与升压药。 Rescue measures included intubation, intravenous access and vasopressors.
抢救措施逐条写，别合并成一句。 List the rescue measures one by one, do not merge them into one sentence.
抢救人员名单须与排班记录一致。 The list of rescue personnel must match the duty roster.
抢救人员都记上，进修医生也要写。 Record all rescue personnel, including the trainee doctors.
抢救用药须记录药名、剂量、给药途径与时间。 Resuscitative medication must be recorded with name, dose, route and time.
抢救用药别只写肾上腺素，剂量也要写。 Do not write only adrenaline for resuscitative medication, include the dose.
抢救记录补记须注明补记时间与原因。 Supplementary rescue documentation must state when and why it was written.
抢救记录补记要写明是事后补的，不能装作当时写的。 The supplementary rescue documentation must state it was written afterwards, not pretend it was contemporaneous.
病危通知书须由家属签收并注明时间。 The critical condition notice must be signed by the family with the time noted.
病危通知书先让家属签，抢救同时进行。 Have the family sign the critical condition notice while resuscitation continues.
抢救室登记本与病历信息须保持一致。 The resuscitation room register must be consistent with the medical record.
抢救室登记本补一下，刚才那个病人没写转归。 Update the resuscitation room register, the outcome for that patient is missing.
复苏后评估须记录意识、瞳孔与血氧。 The post-resuscitation assessment must record consciousness, pupils and oxygen saturation.
复苏后评估做了吗，瞳孔和血糖都要查。 Has the post-resuscitation assessment been done, check pupils and glucose too.
院前抢救记录须随患者一并移交。 The prehospital emergency care record must be handed over with the patient.
院前抢救记录给我看一下，路上用了什么药。 Show me the prehospital emergency care record; what drugs were given en route?
抢救记录审核由科主任或质控医师完成。 Rescue record review is done by the department head or quality control physician.
抢救记录审核没通过，时间点前后矛盾。 The rescue record review failed, the times contradict each other.
抢救记录签名须由参加抢救的人员本人完成。 The rescue record signature must be made personally by those who took part.
抢救记录签名别漏了，参加的人都要签。 Do not miss any rescue record signature, everyone involved must sign.
死亡记录须在患者死亡后二十四小时内完成。 The death record must be completed within twenty-four hours after death.
死亡记录写完了吗，家属等着办手续。 Is the death record finished, the family is waiting for the paperwork.
死亡时间以心电图直线并记录的时间为准。 The time of death is the time when asystole is documented on the ECG.
死亡时间记准，死亡证明上要用。 Record the time of death accurately, it goes on the death certificate.
死亡原因须与死亡证明书一致。 The cause of death must match the death certificate.
死亡原因先别下定论，等讨论后统一。 Do not settle the cause of death yet, agree it after discussion.
直接死亡原因填写为呼吸循环衰竭。 The immediate cause of death was recorded as cardiorespiratory failure.
直接死亡原因和根本原因要分开填。 Fill in the immediate cause of death separately from the underlying cause.
根本死亡原因须依据病史与病理判断。 The underlying cause of death is judged from the history and pathology.
根本死亡原因写错了，统计口径就不对。 If the underlying cause of death is wrong, the statistics are wrong.
死亡诊断应与住院期间的检查结果相符。 The death diagnosis should match the investigations during admission.
死亡诊断和出院诊断口径要一致。 The death diagnosis must be consistent with the discharge diagnosis.
死亡病例讨论记录须在一周内完成。 The death case discussion record must be completed within one week.
死亡病例讨论记录别写成走过场，问题要写出来。 Do not make the death case discussion record a formality, write the problems out.
死亡证明书须由执业医师填写并加盖专用章。 The death certificate must be completed by a licensed physician and stamped.
死亡证明书一共几联，家属别弄丢了。 How many copies does the death certificate have, the family must not lose them.
死亡通知须由两名医护人员共同完成。 Death notification must be carried out by two clinicians together.
死亡通知别让实习生单独去说。 Do not let a trainee deliver the death notification alone.
尸检须经家属同意并签署知情同意书。 Autopsy requires family consent and a signed consent form.
要不要建议尸检，得看家属能不能接受。 Should we suggest an autopsy, it depends whether the family can accept it.
尸检同意书须写明检查范围与用途。 The autopsy consent must state the scope and purpose of the examination.
尸检同意书签了才能做，别先动遗体。 The autopsy consent must be signed first, do not touch the body before that.
遗体交接记录须写明时间、双方人员与遗体状况。 The remains handover record must state the time, both parties and the condition of the body.
遗体交接记录签一下，太平间要留底。 Sign the remains handover record, the mortuary needs a copy.
死亡登记须在死亡后二十四小时内完成。 Death registration must be completed within twenty-four hours after death.
死亡登记漏了一个，赶紧补，报表要报。 One death registration is missing, add it now, the report is due.
脑死亡判定须由两名以上医师按规范程序完成。 Brain death determination must be performed by at least two physicians following the protocol.
脑死亡判定结果要跟家属反复解释。 The brain death determination result must be explained to the family repeatedly.
出院小结须包括入院情况、诊疗经过与出院医嘱。 The discharge summary must cover the admission, treatment course and discharge orders.
出院小结今天必须出，医保要结算。 The discharge summary must be issued today, insurance needs it for settlement.
入院日期与出院日期须与住院登记一致。 The admission date and discharge date must match the inpatient registration.
入院日期再核对一下，别和急诊日期混了。 Check the admission date again, do not confuse it with the emergency visit date.
出院日期以医嘱下达时间为准。 The discharge date is set by the time the discharge order is written.
出院日期还没定，等主任查房再说。 The discharge date is not set yet, wait for the chief's rounds.
住院天数按出院日期减入院日期计算。 Length of stay is calculated by subtracting the admission date from the discharge date.
住院天数算错了，医保会退回来。 The length of stay is miscalculated, insurance will reject it.
出院带药须与出院医嘱一致。 Discharge medication must match the discharge order.
出院带药只开一周，剩下的让他来门诊续。 Give only one week of discharge medication, the rest can be renewed at the clinic.
出院指导须口头讲解并有书面材料。 Discharge instructions must be explained verbally and provided in writing.
出院指导别只给一张纸，要问病人听懂没有。 Do not just hand over a sheet for discharge instructions, ask whether the patient understood.
随访计划须写明复查时间与负责科室。 The follow-up plan must state the review date and the responsible department.
随访计划留个电话，病人有问题能打。 Put a phone number in the follow-up plan so the patient can call with problems.
出院评估包括生命体征、伤口与活动能力。 Discharge assessment covers vital signs, wounds and mobility.
出院评估没做就别办出院，路上出事谁负责。 Do not discharge without a discharge assessment, who is responsible if something happens on the way.
达到出院标准后方可办理出院手续。 Discharge formalities may be completed only once the discharge criteria are met.
他还没达到出院标准，血象还没降下来。 He does not meet the discharge criteria yet, the blood count has not come down.
非计划再入院须在病历质控中分析原因。 Unplanned readmission must be analysed in medical record quality control.
这个非计划再入院要复盘，是不是出院太早。 This unplanned readmission needs review, was the discharge too early.
转归栏须填写治愈、好转、未愈或死亡。 The outcome field must record cured, improved, not cured or died.
转归写好转还是治愈，要看复查结果。 Whether the outcome is improved or cured depends on the review results.
出院转归为治愈，复查指标均正常。 The outcome at discharge was cured, with all review indices normal.
写治愈要有依据，别凭感觉写。 Writing cured needs evidence, not a feeling.
转归为好转，嘱两周后门诊复查。 The outcome was improved, with a clinic review in two weeks.
他算好转，回家还得继续吃药。 He counts as improved, but must keep taking medicine at home.
自动出院须签署知情同意与风险告知书。 Discharge against medical advice requires a signed acknowledgement of risk.
家属坚持要自动出院，把风险讲清楚再签字。 The family insists on discharge against medical advice, explain the risks before they sign.
诊断证明书须经医师签名并加盖专用章。 The medical certificate of diagnosis must be signed and officially stamped.
开诊断证明书要挂号，不能当场随便写。 A medical certificate of diagnosis requires a clinic visit, it cannot be written on the spot.
病假条须写明休息起止日期与建议天数。 The sick leave certificate must state the start and end dates and the recommended days.
病假条只能开一周，长了要复诊。 The sick leave certificate can cover only one week, longer needs a review.
病假天数应与病情严重程度相符。 The days of sick leave should match the severity of the condition.
病假天数别一次开太多，按规定来。 Do not issue too many days of sick leave at once, follow the rules.
休息建议包括避免负重与卧床时间。 The rest recommendation includes avoiding weight-bearing and the period of bed rest.
休息建议写具体点，别只写注意休息。 Make the rest recommendation specific, do not just write take a rest.
复工证明须结合复查结果开具。 The fitness-for-work certificate must be issued together with review results.
他要复工证明，先看复查报告再开。 He wants a fitness-for-work certificate, check the review report before issuing it.
出生医学证明须核对父母身份信息后签发。 The birth certificate is issued after checking the parents' identity details.
出生医学证明名字写错了，改起来很麻烦。 If the name on the birth certificate is wrong, correcting it is very troublesome.
诊断证明专用章由医务部门统一管理。 The official seal for medical certificates is controlled by the medical affairs office.
诊断证明专用章不能借给别的科室用。 The official seal for medical certificates cannot be lent to another department.
诊断意见须与病历记录一致。 The diagnostic opinion must be consistent with the medical record.
诊断意见和病历对不上，家属会质疑。 If the diagnostic opinion does not match the record, the family will question it.
住院证明须载明入院与出院日期。 The hospitalisation certificate must state the admission and discharge dates.
单位要住院证明，出院时一起开。 The employer wants a hospitalisation certificate, issue it at discharge.
伤情证明须客观描述创口大小与位置。 The injury certificate must describe the size and site of the wound objectively.
伤情证明别写推测，只写你看到的。 Do not write speculation in the injury certificate, write only what you observed.
误工证明须与病假条时间衔接。 The lost-work certificate must match the period on the sick leave certificate.
误工证明开的时候要写清休息多少天。 When issuing the lost-work certificate, state clearly how many days of rest.
保险理赔医学证明须如实填写诊疗项目。 The insurance medical certificate must accurately list the treatment provided.
保险理赔医学证明不能按病人要求改诊断。 The insurance medical certificate cannot have the diagnosis changed at the patient's request.
诊断证明书存根须保存两年以上。 The counterfoil of medical certificates must be kept for at least two years.
诊断证明书存根翻出来对一下，笔迹不对。 Check the counterfoil of the medical certificate, the handwriting does not match.
转诊理由须写明本院不具备的条件。 The reason for referral must state what this hospital cannot provide.
转诊理由要写实话，不能只写患者要求。 The reason for referral must be honest, not just patient request.
转诊回执须留存归档备查。 The referral receipt must be kept on file for verification.
转诊回执要回来，不然算没交接完。 The referral receipt must come back, otherwise the handover is incomplete.
检查申请单须写明检查部位与临床诊断。 The examination request form must state the site and the clinical diagnosis.
检查申请单别只写查一下，部位要填。 Do not just write check it on the examination request form, fill in the site.
检验申请单须注明标本类型与检验项目。 The laboratory request form must state the specimen type and the tests requested.
检验申请单开错了，重开一张。 The laboratory request form is wrong, issue a new one.
影像检查申请单须写明检查目的与既往结果。 The imaging request form must state the purpose and previous results.
影像检查申请单上写怀孕了吗，这很重要。 Does the imaging request form mention pregnancy, that matters a lot.
输血申请单须由主治及以上医师审核。 The blood transfusion request form must be reviewed by an attending physician or above.
输血申请单和血样一起送血库，别分开。 Send the blood transfusion request form with the sample to the blood bank, not separately.
病理申请单须写明标本来源与固定方式。 The pathology request form must state the specimen source and fixative.
病理申请单临床诊断那栏空着不行。 The clinical diagnosis field on the pathology request form cannot be left blank.
申请医师须签署姓名与工号。 The requesting physician must sign with name and staff number.
申请医师是谁，出了问题先找他。 Who is the requesting physician, if there is a problem we go to him first.
申请科室与执行科室须在系统中对应。 The requesting department and the performing department must correspond in the system.
申请科室填错了，检验科不认。 The requesting department is wrong, the laboratory will not accept it.
病历管理由病案管理部门统一负责。 Medical record management is the responsibility of the medical record department.
病历管理这块检查很严，别随便外借。 Medical record management is inspected strictly, do not lend records casually.
病历归档须在出院后规定时限内完成。 Medical record archiving must be completed within the set time after discharge.
病历归档慢了会被扣分，催一下。 Slow medical record archiving loses points, chase it up.
病历借阅须登记用途与归还时间。 Medical record access must record the purpose and the return time.
病历借阅只能在本室看，不能带走。 Medical record access is only allowed inside this room, records cannot be taken away.
病历复印须核验申请人身份与授权材料。 Medical record copying requires verification of identity and authorisation.
病历复印要带身份证，家属代办还要委托书。 Medical record copying needs an ID, and a family proxy also needs an authorisation letter.
病历封存须医患双方共同在场并签字。 Medical record sealing requires both parties present and signing.
病历封存要当着家属的面封，别自己封。 Medical record sealing must be done in front of the family, not alone.
病历启封须记录时间、地点与在场人员。 Unsealing of medical records must record the time, place and those present.
病历启封不能单方面进行，必须双方在场。 Unsealing of medical records cannot be unilateral, both sides must be present.
病历保存期限门诊不少于十五年。 The retention period of outpatient medical records is at least fifteen years.
病历保存期限没到不能销毁，这是硬规定。 Records cannot be destroyed before the retention period ends, that is a hard rule.
病历质控每月抽取一定比例病历。 Medical record quality control samples a set proportion of records each month.
病历质控抽查到我们科了，赶紧自查。 Medical record quality control has sampled our department, self-check quickly.
病历缺陷分为一般缺陷与重大缺陷。 Medical record defects are graded as minor and major.
这个病历缺陷是缺上级医师签名，补签没用。 This medical record defect is a missing senior signature, back-signing will not help.
病历修改须保留原记录并注明修改时间。 Medical record amendment must preserve the original entry and note the time.
病历修改不能涂掉原字，要划双线再改。 Medical record amendment must not erase the original, draw a double line and correct it.
病历真实性是医疗损害责任认定的关键。 The authenticity of medical records is central to determining liability.
病历真实性出了问题，后面怎么解释都没用。 Once the authenticity of medical records is questioned, no explanation helps.
病历完整性检查包括入院记录与知情同意书。 Completeness of medical records covers the admission note and consent forms.
病历完整性不够，缺了手术同意书。 Completeness of medical records is poor, the surgical consent form is missing.
病历查阅权限按岗位分级设置。 Access rights to medical records are set by role level.
病历查阅权限别乱开，护士看不到全部。 Do not grant access rights to medical records casually, nurses cannot see everything.
病案室须具备防火防潮与防盗条件。 The medical record room must be protected against fire, damp and theft.
病案室几点下班，我要调一份旧病历。 When does the medical record room close, I need an old record.
电子病历须符合统一的接口与数据标准。 Electronic medical records must follow common interface and data standards.
电子病历系统卡住了，先手写再补录。 The electronic medical record system is frozen, write by hand and enter it later.
电子签名与手写签名具有同等效力。 An electronic signature has the same effect as a handwritten one.
电子签名只能用你自己的账号，不要共用。 Electronic signatures must use your own account, never share it.
电子签名认证须由具备资质的机构提供。 Electronic signature authentication must be provided by a qualified authority.
电子签名认证过期了，登录不上系统。 The electronic signature authentication has expired, I cannot log in.
时间戳由系统自动生成，不得人为修改。 The timestamp is generated by the system and must not be altered.
时间戳显示凌晨三点，那会儿谁在改病历。 The timestamp shows three in the morning, who was editing the record then.
电子病历系统须具备权限管理与操作留痕功能。 The electronic medical record system must support access control and audit trails.
电子病历系统今晚升级，大家提前下班前保存。 The electronic medical record system is upgraded tonight, save everything before leaving.
结构化病历便于质控与科研数据提取。 A structured medical record makes quality control and research extraction easier.
结构化病历点选太多，写不清具体情况。 Structured medical records have too many tick boxes and cannot describe specifics.
病历模板须经科室审核后统一使用。 Medical record templates must be approved by the department before use.
病历模板套得太顺，容易漏掉个体差异。 Following the medical record template too smoothly makes it easy to miss individual differences.
修改痕迹不得删除或覆盖。 The audit trail must not be deleted or overwritten.
修改痕迹一查就知道谁改的，别想蒙。 The audit trail shows exactly who changed it, do not try to hide it.
操作日志至少保存六个月。 Operation logs are retained for at least six months.
操作日志显示他半夜查过这个病人。 The operation log shows he looked at this patient in the middle of the night.
电子病历归档后不得再修改。 An electronic record cannot be modified after archiving.
电子病历归档前把未签名的都签掉。 Sign all unsigned entries before electronic record archiving.
电子病历共享须取得患者授权。 Medical record sharing requires patient authorisation.
电子病历共享范围要写清楚，别全院都能看。 The scope of medical record sharing must be defined, not visible to the whole hospital.
病历数据安全实行分级保护与定期审计。 Medical record data security uses tiered protection and regular audits.
病历数据安全出了问题，全院都要通报。 If medical record data security fails, the whole hospital gets notified.
电子病历分级评价共分八个等级。 Electronic medical record grading has eight levels.
电子病历分级评价要升到五级，今年得改系统。 To reach level five in electronic medical record grading, the system must change this year.
数据接口须符合国家医疗数据交换标准。 Data interfaces must follow national health data exchange standards.
数据接口对不上，检验结果传不过来。 The data interface does not match, so lab results cannot be transferred.
拟行阑尾切除术，术中根据探查情况决定是否放置引流。 An appendectomy is planned, with a drain placed only if the findings indicate it.
你这个阑尾切除术，一般是打三个小孔，肚子上会留几个疤。 Your appendectomy is usually done through three small holes, so you will have a few small scars.
同意行腹腔镜阑尾切除术，如术中粘连严重则中转开腹。 Consent is given for laparoscopic appendectomy, converting to open surgery if dense adhesions are found.
腹腔镜阑尾切除术恢复快，两三天就能下床活动。 With a laparoscopic appendectomy you recover quickly and can walk in two or three days.
因胎儿窘迫拟行剖宫产术，已向孕妇及家属说明母婴风险。 A cesarean section is planned for fetal distress, and the maternal and fetal risks have been explained.
医生说要做剖宫产术，我有点怕，能不能再等等看。 The doctor says I need a cesarean section; I am nervous and wonder whether we can wait.
急诊行清创缝合术，术后需观察伤口有无感染及破伤风预防。 Emergency debridement and suture were performed, with the wound watched for infection and tetanus cover given.
这个口子得做清创缝合术，打点麻药，缝几针。 This cut needs debridement and suture; we will numb it and put in a few stitches.
拟行左胫骨骨折内固定术，术后需限制负重并定期复查X线。 Internal fixation of the left tibial fracture is planned, with limited weight bearing and repeat radiographs afterwards.
骨折内固定术以后钢板要不要取，得看位置和恢复情况。 Whether the plates come out after internal fixation depends on where they are and how the bone heals.
诊断不明时先行腹腔镜探查术，必要时中转开腹。 Laparoscopic exploration is performed first when the diagnosis is unclear, converting to laparotomy if needed.
先做腹腔镜探查术，创伤小，有事再转开腹。 We start with laparoscopic exploration because it is less invasive, and convert if we find a problem.
择期行胆囊切除术，术前禁食八小时并停用抗凝药。 Elective cholecystectomy is scheduled after an eight-hour fast and stopping anticoagulants.
胆囊切除术现在多是打孔做，第二天就能喝粥。 A cholecystectomy is usually done through keyholes now, and you can take fluids the next day.
拟行腹股沟疝修补术，可使用补片，术后避免重体力劳动三个月。 Inguinal hernia repair with mesh is planned, with no heavy lifting for three months.
腹股沟疝修补术做完当天就能下地，别使劲咳嗽。 After inguinal hernia repair you can walk the same day, but avoid hard coughing.
因胃窦部肿瘤行胃大部切除术，术后需少量多餐。 Subtotal gastrectomy was performed for an antral tumour, with small frequent meals afterwards.
胃大部切除术后得少吃多餐，一次吃多了会难受。 After a subtotal gastrectomy you eat small amounts often; a big meal will make you uncomfortable.
肠坏死行肠切除吻合术，术中注意吻合口血供。 Bowel resection with anastomosis was performed for ischaemic bowel, with attention to anastomotic blood supply.
肠切除吻合术后要等排气才能吃东西，别急着喂。 After bowel resection with anastomosis we wait for flatus before eating, so do not feed yet.
气胸行胸腔闭式引流术，术后观察水柱波动与漏气情况。 Closed chest drainage was placed for pneumothorax, with the water column and air leak monitored.
胸腔闭式引流术放根管子，咳嗽的时候瓶子会冒泡，别怕。 Closed chest drainage means a tube is left in; bubbling when you cough is expected, do not be alarmed.
糖尿病足坏疽行小腿截肢术，术前已评估残端血供与假肢条件。 Below-knee amputation was planned for diabetic gangrene after assessing stump perfusion and prosthetic suitability.
截肢术是最后的选择，我们先把能保的都保住了再谈。 Amputation is the last option; we try everything to save the limb first.
股骨颈骨折行全髋关节置换术，术后第一天开始床旁康复。 Total hip arthroplasty was performed for a femoral neck fracture, with bedside rehabilitation on day one.
全髋关节置换术后不能跷二郎腿，小心假体脱位。 After total hip arthroplasty do not cross your legs, or the prosthesis may dislocate.
三支病变行冠状动脉旁路移植术，术前停用抗血小板药并备血。 Coronary artery bypass grafting was planned for triple-vessel disease, with antiplatelets stopped and blood reserved.
冠状动脉旁路移植术要开胸，恢复期比放支架长得多。 Coronary artery bypass grafting means opening the chest, and recovery takes much longer than a stent.
局麻下行体表肿物切除术，标本送病理，七天出结果。 Excision of the superficial mass was done under local anaesthesia and the specimen sent for pathology, results in seven days.
体表肿物切除术门诊就能做，切下来的东西要化验。 Excision of the superficial mass can be done in the clinic, and the tissue will be tested.
肛周脓肿行切开引流术，术后每日换药至创面愈合。 Incision and drainage of the perianal abscess was performed, with daily dressing changes until healing.
脓肿切开引流术不用缝，敞开换药好得快。 Incision and drainage leaves the wound open, and dressing changes help it heal faster.
气管插管全身麻醉下完成手术，术毕待自主呼吸恢复后拔管。 Surgery was completed under endotracheal general anesthesia and the tube removed once spontaneous breathing returned.
气管插管全身麻醉醒了嗓子会疼，那是管子蹭的。 After endotracheal general anesthesia your throat will be sore from the tube.
全凭静脉麻醉用于术中神经电生理监测，避免吸入药干扰。 Total intravenous anesthesia was used to avoid interference with intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring.
全凭静脉麻醉不用面罩吸药，睡得更平稳，醒来也快。 With total intravenous anesthesia there is no mask agent, so you sleep smoothly and wake quickly.
小儿短小手术可选吸入全身麻醉，苏醒较快。 Inhalational general anesthesia may be chosen for short paediatric procedures because recovery is quick.
吸入全身麻醉是戴个面罩吸药，几口就睡着了。 Inhalational general anesthesia means breathing the agent through a mask and falling asleep in a few breaths.
椎管内麻醉适用于下腹部及下肢手术，术前需评估凝血与穿刺部位。 Neuraxial anesthesia suits lower abdominal and limb surgery, after checking coagulation and the puncture site.
椎管内麻醉人是清醒的，下半身没感觉，听到器械声别紧张。 With neuraxial anesthesia you stay awake but feel nothing below the waist; do not be alarmed by the sounds.
蛛网膜下腔阻滞下完成剖宫产，术中注意防治低血压。 Cesarean delivery was performed under spinal anesthesia, with prevention and treatment of hypotension.
蛛网膜下腔阻滞打完腿会发热发麻，那是正常起效。 After spinal anesthesia your legs feel warm and numb as it takes effect, which is normal.
硬膜外阻滞用于分娩镇痛，置管后按需追加药量。 Epidural anesthesia was used for labour analgesia, with top-ups given through the catheter as needed.
硬膜外阻滞那根管子留在背上，疼的时候能加药。 We keep the epidural anesthesia going through a catheter in your back.
腰硬联合麻醉用于下肢骨折手术，起效快且可延长阻滞时间。 Combined spinal-epidural anesthesia was used for lower limb fracture surgery, giving rapid onset and extendable block.
腰硬联合麻醉起效快，时间长了还能从管子里加药。 Combined spinal-epidural anesthesia works fast and can be topped up through the catheter if it runs long.
局部浸润麻醉逐层注射，注意单次总量不超过安全上限。 Local infiltration anesthesia was injected layer by layer, keeping the total dose below the safe limit.
局部浸润麻醉打的时候有点胀，忍一下就好。 Local infiltration anesthesia stings a little as it goes in, so bear with it.
超声引导下神经阻滞可减少局麻药用量并提高成功率。 Ultrasound-guided nerve block reduces the local anesthetic dose and improves success.
神经阻滞打完那条腿会麻几个小时，别下地走。 After the nerve block that leg stays numb for hours, so do not try to walk.
臂丛神经阻滞下行桡骨远端骨折复位，注意观察气胸与局麻药中毒。 Brachial plexus block was used for distal radius fracture reduction, watching for pneumothorax and toxicity.
臂丛神经阻滞打完手抬不起来是正常的，药效过了就好。 After a brachial plexus block the arm will not lift, which is normal until it wears off.
表面麻醉下行胃镜检查，嘱患者含住麻药五分钟后咽下。 Topical anesthesia was used for gastroscopy, asking the patient to hold the agent for five minutes before swallowing.
表面麻醉就是喉咙喷麻药，有点苦，别咽太快。 Topical anesthesia means spraying the throat numb; it tastes bitter, so do not swallow too fast.
监护麻醉下完成拔牙与内镜操作，术中持续监测血氧与血压。 Monitored anesthesia care was used for dental extraction and endoscopy, with continuous oxygen and pressure monitoring.
监护麻醉是半睡半醒，叫你能应，但不会觉得疼。 With monitored anesthesia care you are drowsy but can respond, and you will not feel pain.
术前给予轻度镇静，保持患者能配合指令并维持气道通畅。 Light sedation was given before the procedure, keeping the patient able to follow commands and protect the airway.
给你一点镇静，人放松点，不舒服就说话。 We will give you some sedation to relax you; tell us if you are uncomfortable.
清醒镇静用于关节复位，术中保持语言交流并监测呼吸。 Conscious sedation was used for joint reduction, maintaining verbal contact and monitoring breathing.
清醒镇静就是迷糊但能说话，疼了可以加药。 Conscious sedation means you are drowsy but can talk, and we can add more if it hurts.
麻醉诱导前再次核对禁食时间与过敏史，给药后立即准备通气。 Fasting time and allergies were rechecked before induction of anesthesia, with ventilation ready immediately after dosing.
麻醉诱导就是开始推药那几分钟，几秒钟就睡着了。 Induction of anesthesia is the few minutes when we start the drugs; you are asleep in seconds.
麻醉维持期间根据血压与心率调整吸入浓度，避免术中知晓。 During maintenance of anesthesia the inhaled concentration is adjusted to blood pressure and heart rate to prevent awareness.
麻醉维持这一段最平稳，你什么都不用管，我们在盯着。 Maintenance of anesthesia is the stable part; you do not need to do anything, we are watching.
术前访视记录麻醉方案、气道评估结果与患者疑问。 The preoperative visit note records the anesthetic plan, airway findings and the patient's questions.
麻醉医生晚上会来术前访视，把想问的都问清楚。 The anesthesiologist will come for the preoperative visit tonight, so ask everything you want to know.
麻醉前评估重点看气道条件、心肺储备与近期用药。 Preanesthetic assessment focuses on airway features, cardiopulmonary reserve and recent medications.
麻醉前评估发现他最近在吃抗凝药，得先停药。 Preanesthetic assessment found he is on an anticoagulant, so it must be stopped first.
术前检查包括血常规、凝血功能、肝肾功能与胸片。 The preoperative workup includes a blood count, coagulation profile, liver and kidney function and a chest radiograph.
术前检查有几项没出，手术可能要往后推一天。 Some preoperative workup results are back yet, so surgery may slip by a day.
心肺功能评估结合心电图、胸片与六分钟步行试验判断手术耐受性。 Cardiopulmonary assessment combines electrocardiography, chest imaging and a six-minute walk test to judge fitness.
心肺功能评估不太好，麻醉方式得改一改。 The cardiopulmonary assessment is not favourable, so the anesthetic plan needs adjusting.
术前心电图提示频发室早，请心内科会诊后再定手术。 The preoperative electrocardiogram showed frequent ventricular ectopy, so cardiology review was requested before scheduling.
术前心电图有点问题，得让心内科先看看。 There is an abnormality on the preoperative electrocardiogram, so cardiology should see him first.
肝肾功能不全者需减少经肾排泄的肌松药剂量并延长监测时间。 In liver or kidney impairment, renally cleared muscle relaxants are reduced and monitoring is prolonged.
肝肾功能不太好，麻药得减量，醒了也多观察一会儿。 With poor liver and kidney function we reduce the anesthetic dose and watch you longer after waking.
电解质检查提示低钾，术前需补钾并复查后再麻醉。 The electrolyte panel showed hypokalaemia, so potassium was replaced and rechecked before anesthesia.
电解质检查钾低，先补钾，不然麻醉有风险。 The electrolyte panel shows low potassium; we replace it first, as anesthesia would be risky otherwise.
抗凝药停用时间依药物而定，华法林需提前五天并监测凝血。 Anticoagulant discontinuation depends on the drug; warfarin is stopped five days ahead with coagulation monitoring.
抗凝药停用这几天要小心，刷牙都别太用力。 While the anticoagulant is stopped, be careful even when brushing your teeth.
术前戒烟四周以上可明显降低术后肺部感染与伤口愈合不良。 Preoperative smoking cessation of four weeks or more clearly reduces chest infection and poor wound healing.
术前戒烟越早越好，哪怕提前两周也有好处。 Preoperative smoking cessation helps the earlier the better, even two weeks makes a difference.
营养评估提示重度营养不良，术前给予肠内营养一周再手术。 Nutritional assessment showed severe malnutrition, so enteral nutrition was given for a week before surgery.
营养评估不过关，先吃一周营养餐再上手术台。 The nutritional assessment is poor, so you need a week of supplements before surgery.
功能状态良好者耐受手术能力较强，可减少不必要的术前检查。 Good functional capacity predicts better tolerance of surgery and reduces unnecessary preoperative testing.
他功能状态不错，每天能走五公里，手术风险小很多。 His functional capacity is good, walking five kilometres a day, so surgical risk is much lower.
术前讨论记录术式、麻醉方式、备用方案与抢救预案。 The preoperative case discussion records the procedure, anesthetic plan, backup plan and resuscitation plan.
明天早上术前讨论，你把影像和化验都准备好。 Preoperative case discussion is tomorrow morning, so have the imaging and results ready.
颈部活动度受限者插管宜采用视频喉镜并避免强行后仰。 With limited neck mobility, intubation should use a video laryngoscope and avoid forced extension.
颈部活动度差，不能后仰，插管的时候别硬掰。 His neck will not extend, so do not force it during intubation; use the video laryngoscope.
牙齿情况记录松动牙与烤瓷冠，插管前用牙垫保护。 Dentition notes loose teeth and crowns, with a bite block used to protect them during intubation.
牙齿情况我记一下，你有颗牙松，插管时别碰掉。 One of your teeth is loose and could be knocked during intubation; we will note it first.
全麻前取下活动义齿并记录，交家属保管。 The removable denture was taken out and documented before general anesthesia, then given to the family.
进手术室前把活动义齿摘了，交给你家里人。 Take out the removable denture before going to theatre and give it to your family.
插管困难者应限制尝试次数，三次失败即改用声门上气道。 In difficult intubation, attempts are limited and a supraglottic airway is used after three failures.
插管困难，最多试三次，不行就换方案。 This is difficult intubation; we try at most three times, then change the plan.
声门暴露分级三级以上需调整头位或改用视频喉镜。 A Cormack-Lehane grade of III or worse calls for repositioning or a video laryngoscope.
声门暴露分级不好，垫个肩垫再试。 The Cormack-Lehane grade is poor, so put a shoulder roll under and try again.
阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停患者术后需加强气道监测，慎用镇静药。 Patients with obstructive sleep apnea need closer postoperative airway monitoring and careful sedation.
他有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停，术后别给太多镇静药。 He has obstructive sleep apnea, so do not give much sedation after surgery.
颏下间隙小于三指提示舌根空间不足，插管可能困难。 A submandibular space under three fingers suggests limited tongue space and possible intubation difficulty.
颏下间隙不到三指，插管可能不好插。 The submandibular space is under three fingers, so intubation may be difficult.
预给氧三分钟或四次深呼吸后开始诱导，提高缺氧耐受。 Preoxygenation for three minutes or four deep breaths precedes induction to improve hypoxia tolerance.
先预给氧几分钟，再推药，这样憋气时间能长一点。 We preoxygenate for a few minutes before induction so you can hold your breath longer.
饱胃患者采用快速序贯诱导，不给面罩正压通气。 Rapid sequence induction was used for a full stomach, avoiding positive pressure mask ventilation.
饱胃就用快速序贯诱导，别捏球囊，直接插。 With a full stomach we use rapid sequence induction, no bagging, straight to the tube.
困难气道处理流程要求每次尝试后重新评估氧合与方案。 The difficult airway algorithm requires reassessing oxygenation and the plan after each attempt.
按困难气道处理流程走，别一直试插，先保氧合。 Follow the difficult airway algorithm: do not keep trying, keep oxygenation first.
ASA 一级患者麻醉风险低，可按常规方案实施。 ASA class I patients carry low anesthetic risk and follow the routine plan.
ASA 一级就是身体挺好，除了这个手术没别的毛病。 ASA class I means you are basically healthy apart from the condition we are operating on.
高血压控制良好的 ASA 二级患者可安全接受择期手术。 An ASA class II patient with well-controlled hypertension can safely undergo elective surgery.
ASA 二级，就是血压有点高但吃药控制得住。 ASA class II means slightly high blood pressure that tablets keep under control.
ASA 三级患者术前需优化合并症，麻醉后加强监护。 ASA class III patients need comorbidities optimised before surgery and closer monitoring afterwards.
ASA 三级，麻醉风险明显升高，术后要进监护室观察。 ASA class III means clearly higher anesthetic risk, so you will be monitored closely after surgery.
ASA 四级患者仅在救命手术时实施麻醉，需多学科共同决策。 ASA class IV patients are anesthetised only for life-saving surgery, with multidisciplinary decisions.
ASA 四级，做手术是为了保命，风险要家属充分理解。 ASA class IV means surgery is to save life, and the family must fully understand the risk.
ASA 五级患者手术风险极高，术前须完成家属沟通并记录。 ASA class V carries extremely high risk, so family discussion is completed and documented before surgery.
ASA 五级，人已经在生死边上，做不做手术都得说清楚。 ASA class V means the patient is at the edge of life, so the decision must be discussed openly.
ASA 六级仅用于脑死亡器官捐献，需符合器官移植相关规定。 ASA class VI applies only to brain-dead organ donors and follows organ transplant regulations.
ASA 六级是脑死亡捐献的情况，和普通手术不是一回事。 ASA class VI is the brain-dead donor situation, not the same as ordinary surgery.
记录为 ASA 三级 E，提示急诊手术需按加急流程准备。 Recorded as ASA class III with the emergency modifier, indicating emergency surgery.
他是 ASA 三级 E，那个 E 就是急诊手术的意思。 He is ASA class III with the emergency modifier; the E means emergency surgery.
麻醉风险分级为高危者，术前谈话须由高年资医师完成。 For high anesthesia risk classification, the preoperative discussion is led by a senior physician.
麻醉风险分级是高危，谈话得让主任来签字确认。 The anesthesia risk classification is high, so the consultant must lead the consent discussion.
围术期风险与 ASA 分级、手术分级和患者功能状态相关。 Perioperative risk depends on the ASA class, the surgical grade and functional capacity.
医生把围术期风险算了一遍，说这次手术风险中等。 The doctor worked out the perioperative risk and said it is moderate for this operation.
评估手术耐受力后确定术式与麻醉方式，耐受差者选择微创方案。 Surgical tolerance guides the choice of procedure and anesthesia, with minimally invasive options for frail patients.
他这个手术耐受力差，咱们选小一点的手术方式。 His surgical tolerance is poor, so we choose a smaller operation.
按术前禁饮两小时执行，可减少口渴与脱水又不增加误吸风险。 A two-hour clear fluid fast reduces thirst and dehydration without raising aspiration risk.
术前禁饮是两小时，白开水、糖水都算，牛奶不算清饮料。 The clear fluid fast is two hours; water and sugar water count, but milk does not.
记录禁食时间时须写明食物种类，油炸食物需延长至八小时以上。 When recording fasting duration, note the food type; fatty meals require more than eight hours.
禁食时间够不够，得看最后一次吃的是什么。 Whether the fasting duration is long enough depends on what was last eaten.
术前两小时内可少量饮用清饮料，不得饮用牛奶或含渣食物。 Clear fluids may be taken up to two hours before anesthesia; milk and solids are not allowed.
清饮料就是白开水、糖水这类，能看见底的才行。 Clear fluids mean water or sugar water you can see through, nothing cloudy.
糖尿病胃轻瘫与肠梗阻患者存在胃排空延迟，应按饱胃处理。 Diabetic gastroparesis and bowel obstruction cause delayed gastric emptying and are managed as a full stomach.
他胃排空延迟，虽然禁食了八小时，还是按饱胃处理。 He has delayed gastric emptying, so even after eight hours we treat him as a full stomach.
结直肠手术前需完成胃肠道准备，口服泻药并禁食。 Bowel preparation for colorectal surgery uses oral laxatives plus fasting.
胃肠道准备今天下午开始喝泻药，晚上会跑几趟厕所。 Bowel preparation starts this afternoon with laxatives; expect several trips to the toilet tonight.
皮肤准备使用抗菌皂清洁，避免用力搓擦损伤皮肤。 Skin preparation uses an antiseptic wash without vigorous scrubbing that damages the skin.
皮肤准备今晚洗个澡，用我们给的抗菌皂。 For skin preparation, shower tonight with the antiseptic soap we gave you.
手术区备皮宜用剪刀或推剪，避免剃刀造成皮肤破损。 Surgical site hair removal should use clippers rather than a razor, which can nick the skin.
手术区备皮用推子，不用剃刀，免得刮破皮感染。 We use clippers for surgical site hair removal, not a razor, to avoid cuts and infection.
术前用药记录药名、剂量与给药时间，避免与麻醉药叠加抑制呼吸。 Premedication is recorded with drug, dose and time to avoid additive respiratory depression.
术前用药已经给了，病人有点困，别再给镇静药。 Premedication has been given and the patient is drowsy, so no more sedatives.
术前镇静选用短效药物，给药后须监测血氧与呼吸。 Preoperative sedation uses a short-acting agent, with oxygen saturation and breathing monitored afterwards.
老人术前镇静要减量，容易呼吸抑制。 For elderly patients, preoperative sedation must be reduced because of respiratory depression risk.
预防性抗生素应在切皮前三十至六十分钟内给药，超过时间需追加。 Prophylactic antibiotics are given thirty to sixty minutes before incision and repeated if surgery runs long.
预防性抗生素已经推了，记一下时间。 The prophylactic antibiotic has gone in, so note the time.
