血栓高风险者停华法林期间给予抗凝桥接，术前再停短效药。 Patients at high thrombotic risk receive anticoagulation bridging while warfarin is stopped, holding the short-acting drug before surgery.
他在做抗凝桥接，停药时间得按表来，不能自己停。 He is on anticoagulation bridging, so the stop dates follow the schedule, not his own choice.
围术期血糖管理目标为七点八至十毫摩尔每升，术中每小时监测。 Perioperative glucose management targets seven point eight to ten millimoles per litre, checked hourly in theatre.
围术期血糖管理要盯紧，高血糖伤口长不好。 Perioperative glucose management matters: high glucose slows wound healing.
饱胃、肠梗阻与胃排空延迟者误吸风险高，需快速序贯诱导。 A full stomach, obstruction or delayed emptying raises aspiration risk, so rapid sequence induction is used.
麻醉前一定问清最后进食时间，误吸会要命。 Always ask when they last ate; aspiration can be fatal.
苏醒延迟需排查低血糖、低体温、电解质紊乱与残余肌松。 Delayed emergence prompts a search for hypoglycaemia, hypothermia, electrolyte disturbance and residual paralysis.
手术做完一个小时还没醒，这是苏醒延迟，得查原因。 An hour after surgery and still not awake, that is delayed emergence; find the cause.
恶性高热一旦发生立即停用诱发药、给予丹曲林并全身降温。 Malignant hyperthermia is managed by stopping the trigger, giving dantrolene and cooling the body.
恶性高热虽然罕见，但抢救车必须常备丹曲林。 Malignant hyperthermia is rare, but dantrolene must always be on the emergency trolley.
局麻药中毒早期表现为耳鸣、口周麻木，严重时抽搐与心搏骤停。 Local anesthetic toxicity starts with tinnitus and perioral numbness, progressing to seizures and cardiac arrest.
打完局麻他说耳朵响、嘴发麻，这是局麻药中毒，快处理。 After the local he reports ringing ears and numb lips, which is local anesthetic toxicity; act now.
全脊麻表现为迅速出现的低血压、呼吸困难与意识丧失，须立即气道支持。 Total spinal anesthesia brings rapid hypotension, breathing difficulty and loss of consciousness, requiring immediate airway support.
硬膜外打进去十分钟血压掉到六十，考虑全脊麻。 Ten minutes after the epidural the pressure is down to sixty, so consider total spinal anesthesia.
穿刺后头痛在坐起时加重、平卧缓解，多数经补液与卧床数日好转。 Post-dural puncture headache worsens on sitting and eases lying flat, usually settling with fluids and rest.
她站起来就头痛，躺下就好，是典型的穿刺后头痛。 Her head aches on standing and eases lying down, typical post-dural puncture headache.
麻醉后神经损伤多表现为局部麻木无力，需记录范围并随访。 Nerve injury after anesthesia usually shows as localized numbness or weakness and must be mapped and followed up.
麻醉后手腕抬不起来，可能是麻醉后神经损伤，请会诊。 The wrist will not lift after anesthesia, possibly nerve injury after anesthesia; request a consult.
支气管痉挛时气道压骤升、通气困难，需加深麻醉并给予支气管扩张药。 Bronchospasm brings a sudden rise in airway pressure, managed by deepening anesthesia and giving bronchodilators.
气道压一下子高了，听诊有哮鸣音，是支气管痉挛。 Airway pressure has shot up with wheeze on auscultation; that is bronchospasm.
术中知晓高风险手术需监测麻醉深度并避免单纯肌松。 Surgery at high risk of intraoperative awareness requires depth monitoring and avoiding muscle relaxants alone.
病人说手术中听见有人说话，要评估是不是术中知晓。 The patient says she heard talking during surgery, so assess for intraoperative awareness.
术后恶心呕吐高危者预防性给予止吐药，并避免使用一氧化二氮。 Patients at high risk of postoperative nausea and vomiting receive prophylactic antiemetics and avoid nitrous oxide.
她术后恶心呕吐得厉害，先给止吐药再喝水。 She has severe postoperative nausea and vomiting, so give an antiemetic before any water.
有麻醉药物过敏史者须更换药物类别，并在术前预防用药。 A history of anesthetic allergy requires switching drug classes and preoperative prophylaxis.
他说上次麻醉后全身起疹子，可能是麻醉药物过敏。 He says he broke out in a rash after the last anesthetic, possibly anesthetic allergy.
麻醉期间低血压持续超过十分钟与术后器官损伤相关，须及时处理。 Intraoperative hypotension lasting over ten minutes is linked to organ injury and must be corrected promptly.
麻醉期间低血压了，先减浅麻醉、加快补液。 We have intraoperative hypotension; lighten the anesthesia and give fluids faster.
麻醉后呼吸抑制需持续监测血氧与呼气末二氧化碳，必要时拮抗。 Respiratory depression after anesthesia requires monitoring of saturation and end-tidal carbon dioxide, with reversal if needed.
老人回病房后麻醉后呼吸抑制，血氧一直往下掉。 Back on the ward the elderly patient has respiratory depression after anesthesia, with falling saturation.
阻滞失败需评估原因并改行全身麻醉，不可反复追加至中毒剂量。 Block failure is assessed and converted to general anesthesia rather than repeated dosing to toxic levels.
阻滞失败，切皮还疼，别再加药了，改全麻。 The block failed and the incision still hurts, so stop topping up and convert to general anesthesia.
麻醉并发症按系统分类记录，严重者需上报并做根因分析。 Anesthesia complications are recorded by system, and serious ones are reported and analysed for root cause.
这份病历把麻醉并发症写清楚了，包括低血压和苏醒延迟。 This record documents the anesthesia complication fully, including hypotension and delayed emergence.
苏醒期躁动常见于疼痛、缺氧与膀胱充盈，须先排查诱因再约束。 Emergence agitation often reflects pain, hypoxia or a full bladder, so causes are excluded before restraint.
他在苏醒期躁动，先看看是不是疼或者憋尿。 He has emergence agitation; check whether it is pain or a full bladder first.
手术风险须逐项告知并写入知情同意书，包括出血、感染与血栓。 Surgical risk is explained item by item in the consent form, including bleeding, infection and thrombosis.
手术风险主要是出血、感染和血栓，我会一条条讲。 The surgical risk is mainly bleeding, infection and clots, and I will go through each one.
术中出血量大时需及时输血并记录出入量。 Heavy intraoperative bleeding requires prompt transfusion and fluid balance recording.
术中出血比预计多，已经备了四个单位红细胞。 Intraoperative bleeding was more than expected, and four units of red cells are ready.
术后出血表现为引流量增多、血压下降与切口渗血，须立即评估。 Postoperative bleeding shows as rising drain output, falling pressure and wound oozing, requiring urgent review.
引流管里血突然多了，怕是术后出血，快叫医生。 Blood in the drain has suddenly increased, likely postoperative bleeding; call the doctor.
手术部位感染表现为切口红肿热痛与脓性分泌物，需取标本培养。 Surgical site infection shows redness, heat, pain and purulent discharge, and a specimen is sent for culture.
切口有点红还有脓，考虑手术部位感染。 The wound is red with pus, so consider surgical site infection.
深静脉血栓预防包括早期活动、弹力袜与药物抗凝。 Deep vein thrombosis prevention includes early mobilisation, compression stockings and pharmacological anticoagulation.
术后第二天腿肿了，要排查深静脉血栓。 The leg is swollen on day two after surgery, so screen for deep vein thrombosis.
血管损伤可导致大出血或肢体缺血，需血管外科同期处理。 Vascular injury may cause major bleeding or limb ischaemia and requires vascular surgical repair.
手术中血管损伤了，请血管外科上台。 There is vascular injury during the operation; call vascular surgery to the table.
脏器损伤是腹腔手术的重要风险，二次手术率随之升高。 Organ injury is a major risk in abdominal surgery and raises the reoperation rate.
腹腔手术有脏器损伤的风险，我们会仔细分离。 Abdominal surgery carries a risk of organ injury; we dissect carefully to avoid it.
术后粘连可引起慢性腹痛与粘连性肠梗阻，需再次手术松解。 Postoperative adhesion can cause chronic pain and adhesive obstruction requiring surgical division.
他以前做过手术，这次肠梗阻很可能是术后粘连。 He has had surgery before, so this obstruction is likely postoperative adhesion.
愈合不良与糖尿病、营养不良和局部血供差相关。 Poor wound healing is linked to diabetes, malnutrition and poor local blood supply.
血糖控制不好，伤口愈合不良，拆线得往后拖。 With poor glucose control the wound heals badly, so suture removal must be delayed.
围术期死亡是最严重的风险，须在知情同意中明确告知。 Perioperative death is the most serious risk and must be stated clearly in the consent discussion.
围术期死亡虽然概率低，但同意书里必须写明。 Perioperative death is unlikely, but it must be written in the consent form.
术中大出血需启动大量输血方案并通知血库备血。 Massive intraoperative hemorrhage triggers the massive transfusion protocol and a blood bank call.
术中大出血，启动大量输血方案，快通知血库！ Massive intraoperative hemorrhage: activate the massive transfusion protocol and call the blood bank.
手术失败可能需二次手术或改行其他治疗方式。 Surgical failure may require a second operation or a different treatment approach.
手术失败不是谁故意的，但得跟家属说清楚是否二次手术。 Surgical failure is not intentional, but the family must be told whether a second operation is needed.
疾病复发与切除范围、病理类型相关，术后需定期随访。 Recurrence of disease depends on resection margins and pathology, so regular follow-up is required.
肿瘤切干净了，但还有疾病复发的可能，要按时复查。 The tumour was removed completely, but recurrence of disease is possible, so keep the follow-up appointments.
器官功能衰竭是术后严重并发症，常需转入重症监护治疗。 Organ failure is a serious postoperative complication, often requiring intensive care.
术后出现器官功能衰竭，得转重症监护室。 Organ failure has developed after surgery, so transfer to intensive care is needed.
住院时间延长会增加费用与院内感染风险，需评估原因。 Prolonged hospital stay raises costs and infection risk, so the cause must be reviewed.
伤口感染导致住院时间延长，费用也会增加。 The wound infection caused a prolonged hospital stay and higher costs.
知情同意须说明替代方案及其利弊，不能只讲手术。 Informed consent must describe alternative treatment options and their pros and cons, not just surgery.
除了手术，替代方案还有保守治疗和介入，你可以选。 Besides surgery, the alternative treatment options are conservative care and intervention; you can choose.
实施手术须取得患者知情同意，并签署书面文件。 Informed consent must be obtained and documented in writing before surgery.
知情同意不是签个字，我得把风险和替代方案都讲明白。 Informed consent is not just a signature; I must explain the risks and alternatives.
手术知情同意书须由患者本人签署，无行为能力时由法定代理人签署。 The surgical informed consent form is signed by the patient, or by the legal representative if the patient lacks capacity.
手术知情同意书你看一遍，有不明白的现在问。 Read the surgical informed consent form and ask about anything unclear now.
麻醉知情同意书须写明麻醉方式与可能出现的并发症。 The anesthesia informed consent form must state the technique and possible complications.
麻醉知情同意书和手术那张是分开的，两张都要签。 The anesthesia informed consent form is separate from the surgical one; both must be signed.
保守治疗适用于病情稳定、无急诊手术指征的患者。 Conservative treatment suits stable patients without an emergency surgical indication.
先保守治疗观察两天，不行再手术。 Let us try conservative treatment for two days and operate if it fails.
药物治疗可作为手术的替代方案，但需说明失败后仍需手术。 Medical therapy may replace surgery, but patients must know surgery may still be needed if it fails.
药物治疗先试一个疗程，没用再考虑手术。 Try medical therapy for one course first; if it does not work, consider surgery.
介入治疗可作为手术替代方案，但存在穿刺并发症与复发可能。 Interventional therapy may replace surgery but carries puncture complications and recurrence risk.
这个病可以介入治疗，不用开刀，但可能要再做一次。 This can be treated by interventional therapy without opening you up, but it may need repeating.
内镜治疗适用于部分早期病变，出血或穿孔时需中转手术。 Endoscopic therapy suits some early lesions, converting to surgery if bleeding or perforation occurs.
能内镜治疗就先内镜治，不行再开刀。 If endoscopic therapy is possible we try it first and operate if it fails.
患者有权要求第二诊疗意见，不应因此延误急诊处置。 Patients may seek a second opinion, which should not delay emergency care.
你想听第二诊疗意见可以，我们不会拦着。 You may seek a second opinion; we will not stand in the way.
拒绝手术须记录告知内容、患者状态与签字，并说明随访安排。 Refusal of surgery is documented with what was explained, the patient's capacity and a signature, plus follow-up.
他拒绝手术，我们得把风险讲清楚并让他签字。 He is refusing surgery, so we must explain the risks clearly and have him sign.
撤回同意须在切皮前确认并记录，已备血与用药需相应调整。 Withdrawal of consent is confirmed and documented before incision, with blood reservation and premedication adjusted.
病人进手术室前撤回同意，手术停了。 The patient withdrew consent before entering theatre, so the operation was cancelled.
授权委托书须写明受托人、授权范围与有效期，并随病历保存。 The authorization letter states the proxy, the scope and the validity period and is kept with the record.
这份授权委托书要写清楚谁替你做决定，签好交给我们。 The authorization letter must name who decides for you; sign it and give it to us.

en: person without capacity for civil conduct
text: 无民事行为能力人手术由法定代理人签署知情同意书。 For a person without capacity for civil conduct, the legal representative signs the consent form.

en: person without capacity for civil conduct
text: 他是无民事行为能力人，同意书得由监护人签。 He is a person without capacity for civil conduct, so the guardian signs the consent.
医疗损害责任以过错为要件，知情同意缺陷常成为争议焦点。 Medical damage liability requires fault, and deficient informed consent is often the focus of disputes.
同意书签得不规范，医疗损害责任风险会明显上升。 Poorly documented consent clearly raises the risk of medical damage liability.
风险告知应具体到本术式的主要并发症，不能只写套话。 Risk disclosure should name the main complications of this operation, not use generic wording.
风险告知我按这张单子逐条讲，你听完再签。 I will go through the risk disclosure item by item from this sheet, then you sign.
大手术常规备血两个单位，术中出血多时再追加。 Two units are routinely reserved for major surgery, with more requested if bleeding is heavy.
手术备血已经备好了，需要的时候直接取。 Blood reservation for surgery is done, so units can be collected when needed.
输血知情同意书须包括输血传播感染与输血反应等风险。 The transfusion informed consent form covers risks such as transfusion-transmitted infection and reactions.
输血知情同意书单独一张，跟手术同意书不是一回事。 The transfusion informed consent form is separate; it is not the same as the surgical consent.
自体输血可减少异体输血需求与免疫反应，但需提前评估采集条件。 Autologous transfusion reduces donor exposure and immune reactions but requires prior assessment.
她选择自体输血，术前两周先存了兩个单位血。 She chose autologous transfusion and banked two units two weeks before surgery.
术中血液回收禁用于恶性肿瘤与污染手术野。 Intraoperative cell salvage is not used in malignancy or a contaminated operative field.
这台用术中血液回收，出血能直接还回去。 We use intraoperative cell salvage here so the shed blood can be returned.
成分输血优于全血，可按缺乏成分精准补充。 Component transfusion is preferred over whole blood because the missing component is replaced precisely.
现在都是成分输血，缺什么补什么，不输全血。 We do component transfusion now: replace what is missing, not whole blood.
新鲜冰冻血浆用于凝血因子缺乏或大量输血后的凝血病。 Fresh frozen plasma is used for clotting factor deficiency or coagulopathy after massive transfusion.
凝血功能差，先输新鲜冰冻血浆，不是输红细胞。 The coagulation is poor, so give fresh frozen plasma first, not red cells.
红细胞悬液输注前须核对血型，一单位约提升血红蛋白五克每升。 Packed red blood cells are checked against the blood group; one unit raises haemoglobin by about five grams per litre.
血红蛋白七十，输两个单位红细胞悬液。 Haemoglobin is seventy, so transfuse two units of packed red blood cells.
血小板输注用于血小板低于二十且伴出血风险者。 Platelet transfusion is used when the count is below twenty with a bleeding risk.
血小板太低，先约血小板输注，别等到出血。 The platelets are very low, so book a platelet transfusion before bleeding starts.
出现输血反应立即停止输血、保留血袋并报告输血科。 For a transfusion reaction, stop the transfusion, keep the bag and notify the blood bank.
他输血十分钟就发冷发热，是输血反应，先停。 He had chills and fever ten minutes into the transfusion, a transfusion reaction; stop it.
输血传播感染包括乙肝、丙肝、艾滋与梅毒，输血前须筛查。 Transfusion-transmitted infection includes hepatitis B and C, HIV and syphilis, so screening precedes transfusion.
输血前都查过输血传播感染指标，结果正常。 Screening for transfusion-transmitted infection was done and the results are normal.
大量输血需按比例输注红细胞、血浆与血小板并监测凝血。 Massive transfusion gives red cells, plasma and platelets in fixed ratios with coagulation monitoring.
出血止不住，启动大量输血，红细胞血浆一比一。 The bleeding will not stop, so start massive transfusion with red cells and plasma one to one.
输血指征包括血红蛋白低于七十或血流动力学不稳定。 Transfusion indications include haemoglobin below seventy or haemodynamic instability.
输血指征够了，血红蛋白六十五还心慌气短。 The transfusion indication is met: haemoglobin sixty-five with palpitations and breathlessness.
限制性输血阈值多为血红蛋白七十，可减少输血相关并发症。 Restrictive transfusion usually uses a threshold of seventy and reduces transfusion-related complications.
我们按限制性输血来，血红蛋白不到七十先不输。 We follow restrictive transfusion: no transfusion until haemoglobin falls below seventy.
术后镇痛方案按手术类型与患者情况个体化制定。 Postoperative analgesia is tailored to the operation and the individual patient.
术后镇痛要跟上，疼得睡不着影响恢复。 Postoperative analgesia must be adequate; pain that stops sleep delays recovery.
术后疼痛评估每小时一次，评分大于四分需调整镇痛方案。 Postoperative pain assessment is hourly, and a score above four prompts a change in the analgesia plan.
术后疼痛评估做了吗？他说有八分疼。 Has the postoperative pain assessment been done? He rates it eight out of ten.
镇痛方案采用多模式联合，减少单一阿片类药物用量。 The analgesia plan combines several modalities to reduce reliance on a single opioid.
镇痛方案写进医嘱了，按需给药也要记录。 The analgesia plan is in the orders; record every as-needed dose too.
多模式镇痛联合对乙酰氨基酚、非甾体抗炎药与局部阻滞。 Multimodal analgesia combines paracetamol, an NSAID and a local block.
用多模式镇痛，几种药一起上，阿片类就能少用。 Use multimodal analgesia: several drugs together means less opioid.
患者自控镇痛须设置单次剂量与锁定时间，并向患者讲解使用方法。 Patient-controlled analgesia requires set bolus doses and lockout intervals, with instruction for the patient.
给你接患者自控镇痛泵，疼的时候按一下，别连着按。 I will connect the patient-controlled analgesia pump; press it when it hurts, not repeatedly.
硬膜外镇痛效果确切，但需监测血压、感觉平面与导管位置。 Epidural analgesia works well but requires monitoring of blood pressure, sensory level and catheter position.
硬膜外镇痛泵在背上，翻身的时候别压到管子。 The epidural analgesia catheter is in your back, so do not lie on the tubing.
连续神经阻滞用于下肢大手术，需观察肢体感觉与运动恢复。 Continuous nerve block is used for major lower limb surgery, watching sensory and motor recovery.
做了连续神经阻滞，这条腿会麻一阵子，别自己下地。 With a continuous nerve block the leg stays numb for a while, so do not get up alone.
阿片类药物须监测呼吸频率与镇静程度，警惕呼吸抑制。 Opioids require monitoring of respiratory rate and sedation level for respiratory depression.
阿片类药物别一次给太多，老人容易呼吸抑制。 Do not give too much opioid at once; elderly patients easily get respiratory depression.
非甾体抗炎药用于术后镇痛，但肾功能不全与消化道溃疡者慎用。 Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs help postoperative pain but are used cautiously in renal impairment or ulcer disease.
非甾体抗炎药能减少阿片用量，但他肾功能不好，慎用。 The nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug spares opioid, but his kidneys are poor, so use it cautiously.
对乙酰氨基酚每日总量不超过三克，肝功能不全者减量。 Paracetamol is limited to three grams a day, with dose reduction in hepatic impairment.
先给对乙酰氨基酚，不够再加别的镇痛药。 Start with paracetamol and add another analgesic if it is not enough.
镇痛不足会导致活动延迟与肺部并发症，应及时调整方案。 Inadequate analgesia delays mobilisation and causes pulmonary complications, so the plan is adjusted promptly.
他镇痛不足，一动就疼，方案得改。 He has inadequate analgesia and it hurts to move, so the plan needs changing.
出现过度镇静应立即停用阿片类药物、给氧并监测血氧。 Oversedation calls for stopping the opioid, giving oxygen and monitoring saturation.
他过度镇静了，叫不太醒，先停阿片给药。 He is oversedated and hard to rouse, so hold the opioid.
镇痛泵报警时检查管路、电池与药液余量。 When the analgesia pump alarms, check the tubing, battery and remaining drug.
镇痛泵报警了，看看是不是管子打折。 The analgesia pump is alarming; check whether the tubing is kinked.
麻醉恢复室接收术后患者，监测血氧、血压与意识直至离室标准达标。 The postanesthesia care unit monitors saturation, blood pressure and consciousness until discharge criteria are met.
手术做完送麻醉恢复室，醒了、指标稳了才回病房。 After surgery you go to the postanesthesia care unit and return to the ward once awake and stable.
麻醉苏醒期重点观察气道、呼吸与循环，防止误吸与坠床。 During emergence from anesthesia the focus is airway, breathing and circulation, preventing aspiration and falls.
麻醉苏醒的时候他会有点躁，把床栏拉起来。 He will be restless during emergence from anesthesia, so put the bed rails up.
术后监护按手术级别设定频次，大手术后每小时记录一次。 Postoperative monitoring frequency follows the surgical grade, hourly after major operations.
术后监护不能松，前两个小时最关键。 Postoperative monitoring must not slip; the first two hours matter most.
术后拔管须满足自主呼吸恢复、呛咳有力与氧合达标。 Postoperative extubation requires spontaneous breathing, a strong cough and adequate oxygenation.
术后拔管前先吸痰，确认他自己能喘再拔。 Suction before postoperative extubation and confirm he breathes on his own first.
术后低体温需主动加温、监测核心体温并警惕寒战。 Postoperative hypothermia is managed with active warming, core temperature monitoring and attention to shivering.
体温三十五度五，术后低体温，赶紧用加温毯。 Temperature is thirty-five point five, so there is postoperative hypothermia; use the warming blanket.
术后寒战增加心肌耗氧，需保暖并排除低体温与感染。 Postoperative shivering raises myocardial oxygen demand, so warm the patient and exclude hypothermia or infection.
他术后寒战得厉害，先盖加温毯，再查体温。 He has severe postoperative shivering; use the warming blanket first, then check his temperature.
尿潴留常见于椎管内麻醉后，可先诱导排尿再考虑导尿。 Urinary retention is common after neuraxial anesthesia and is managed with voiding measures before catheterisation.
术后六小时没排尿，膀胱胀，是尿潴留。 No urine six hours after surgery and the bladder is distended, so it is urinary retention.
术后谵妄表现为波动性意识混乱，需排查疼痛、缺氧与药物因素。 Postoperative delirium shows fluctuating confusion, so pain, hypoxia and drugs are reviewed.
老人晚上突然不认识人，可能是术后谵妄。 The elderly patient suddenly did not recognise anyone at night, possibly postoperative delirium.
早期活动应在镇痛充分与血流动力学稳定前提下进行。 Early mobilisation proceeds once analgesia is adequate and haemodynamics are stable.
镇痛给够就早期活动，今天先在床边坐十分钟。 With adequate analgesia we start early mobilisation, sitting at the bedside for ten minutes today.
腹部手术后待排气再逐步恢复术后进食，从流质开始。 After abdominal surgery, resumption of oral intake waits for flatus and starts with fluids.
排气了，可以开始术后进食，先喝点米汤。 He has passed flatus, so resumption of oral intake can start with rice water.
引流管管理记录引流量、颜色与性状，异常时及时报告。 Drain management records volume, colour and character, reporting abnormalities promptly.
引流管管理要注意，量突然多了要报告。 Mind the drain management; report it if the output suddenly increases.
术后随访包括拆线、病理结果解读与功能评估。 Postoperative follow-up covers suture removal, pathology results and functional assessment.
术后随访约在两周后，来之前先拍张伤口照片。 Postoperative follow-up is in two weeks; take a photo of the wound beforehand.
日间手术要求患者一般状况好、有家属陪护与可靠联系方式。 Ambulatory surgery requires good general condition, a family escort and reliable contact details.
这个手术可以做日间手术，早上来晚上回家。 This can be done as ambulatory surgery: come in the morning and go home at night.
日间手术病房在术前完成核查、宣教与出院评估。 The day surgery unit completes checking, education and discharge assessment preoperatively.
日间手术病房在二楼，办完手续直接上去。 The day surgery unit is on the second floor; go straight up after registration.
门诊手术适用于体表肿物切除、小面积清创等。 Outpatient surgery suits superficial mass excision and small wound debridement.
这个门诊手术半小时就完，做完回家。 This outpatient surgery takes half an hour and you go home afterwards.
当日出院须满足生命体征稳定、能进食排尿与疼痛可控。 Same-day discharge requires stable vital signs, ability to eat and void, and controlled pain.
当日出院前再评估一次，别到家就出血。 Assess again before same-day discharge; we do not want bleeding at home.
限期手术如恶性肿瘤根治术，应在诊断后数周内完成。 Urgent surgery such as cancer resection should be completed within weeks of diagnosis.
这是限期手术，尽量两周内做，不能拖太久。 This is urgent surgery; aim for within two weeks, not months.
急诊手术可先实施后补办手术审批，但须当日完成。 Emergency surgery may proceed first with surgical approval completed the same day.
手术审批还没签，先别排台，让主任补签。 Surgical approval is not signed yet, so hold the slot and have the director sign.
紧急救治须经医疗机构负责人或授权负责人批准并记录。 Emergency rescue requires approval from the institution's head or an authorised person, and is documented.
病人昏迷、家属联系不上，按紧急救治先做手术。 The patient is unconscious and the family unreachable, so proceed under emergency rescue.
术前等待时间过长会增加并发症，急诊手术应尽量缩短。 A long time to surgery raises complications, so it is shortened for emergency cases.
术前等待时间已经四个小时了，催一下手术室。 The time to surgery is already four hours, so chase the theatre.
手术取消须记录原因并重新评估安排，避免延误治疗。 Cancellation of surgery is documented with the reason and reassessed, so treatment is not delayed.
他早上发烧，手术取消，等体温正常再排。 He spiked a fever this morning, so cancellation of surgery; reschedule once afebrile.
急诊加台需协调麻醉、护理与血库资源并评估对择期手术的影响。 An emergency add-on case needs coordination of anesthesia, nursing and blood bank, plus review of elective impact.
急诊加台，把第三间的手术往后挪。 Emergency add-on case: move the list in theatre three back.
手术排程优先安排急诊与限期手术，择期手术按顺序排入。 Operating room scheduling prioritises emergency and urgent cases, with elective surgery slotted in order.
手术排程今天满了，只能加在最后一台。 Operating room scheduling is full today, so it can only go last.
严重腹腔感染常计划二次手术，在四十八小时后再次探查。 Severe abdominal sepsis often needs a planned reoperation, returning after forty-eight hours.
医生说了是计划二次手术，不是出问题才开的。 The doctor said this is a planned reoperation, not because something went wrong.
二次探查术用于判断肠管活力或清除残余感染。 Second-look laparotomy assesses bowel viability or clears residual infection.
明天做二次探查术，看看肠子活了没有。 Second-look laparotomy is tomorrow to see whether the bowel has recovered.
中转开腹不是手术失败，须向家属说明原因并记录。 Conversion to laparotomy is not a failure; the reason is explained and documented.
粘连太重，中转开腹，跟家属说一声。 Adhesions are too dense, so conversion to laparotomy; tell the family.
中转全身麻醉需重新评估气道并追加知情同意记录。 Conversion to general anesthesia requires airway reassessment and an added consent note.
麻醉效果不够，中转全身麻醉，家属同意了。 The block is inadequate, so conversion to general anesthesia, and the family has agreed.
非计划再次手术是手术质量监测指标，须上报并讨论原因。 Unplanned reoperation is a quality indicator and must be reported and reviewed.
吻合口瘘了，非计划再次手术，今晚就得进手术室。 The anastomosis has leaked, so unplanned reoperation; theatre tonight.
再手术指征包括持续出血、腹膜炎加重与引流液异常。 Indications for reoperation include ongoing bleeding, worsening peritonitis and abnormal drain output.
再手术指征明确了，别再等，安排手术。 The indication for reoperation is clear, so stop waiting and schedule it.
再次入院率是评价手术质量与出院准备充分性的指标。 Readmission rate reflects surgical quality and the adequacy of discharge preparation.
出院一周又回来了，这次是伤口感染，算再次入院。 He returned a week after discharge with a wound infection, which counts as readmission.
中转率用于评价病例选择与手术难度，应定期回顾分析。 Conversion rate reflects case selection and difficulty and is reviewed regularly.
这个月中转率有点高，得看看是不是选病例太激进。 The conversion rate is high this month, so check whether case selection is too aggressive.
中转决策由主刀与麻醉医师共同作出，并在记录中说明理由。 The conversion decision is made jointly by the surgeon and anesthesiologist and the reason recorded.
中转决策不能一个人拍板，叫上级一起看。 The conversion decision is not one person's call; bring the senior in.
再手术风险随手术次数与粘连程度增加，须充分告知。 Reoperation risk rises with the number of previous operations and adhesions, so full disclosure is needed.
再手术风险比第一次高，这些我都要写进同意书。 Reoperation risk is higher than the first time, and I will put all of it in the consent.
法定传染病须在规定时限内完成报告。 Notifiable infectious diseases must be reported within the prescribed time limit.
这个病是法定传染病，我们要按规定上报。 This is a notifiable infectious disease, so we must report it as required.
甲类传染病病人须就地隔离治疗。 Patients with a Class A infectious disease must be isolated and treated on site.
甲类传染病不能转院，先就地隔离。 A Class A infectious disease cannot be transferred; isolate on site first.
乙类传染病按有关规定报告并管理。 Class B infectious diseases are reported and managed according to the relevant rules.
肺结核是乙类传染病，报告别漏。 Tuberculosis is a Class B infectious disease, so do not miss the report.
丙类传染病按监测方案登记报告。 Class C infectious diseases are registered and reported under the surveillance plan.
流感算丙类传染病，报卡要填全。 Influenza is a Class C infectious disease, so complete the reporting card fully.

en: Law on Prevention and Treatment of Infectious Diseases
text: 传染病防治法规定医疗机构负有报告义务。 The Law on Prevention and Treatment of Infectious Diseases obliges hospitals to report cases.

en: Law on Prevention and Treatment of Infectious Diseases
text: 按传染病防治法，这事必须报。 Under the Law on Prevention and Treatment of Infectious Diseases, this must be reported.

en: managed as a Class A disease
text: 该病按甲类管理，须两小时内报告。 This disease is managed as a Class A disease and must be reported within two hours.

en: managed as a Class A disease
text: 这个病按甲类管理，防护要升级。 This disease is managed as a Class A disease, so upgrade protection.

en: Class B disease under Class B measures
text: 调整为乙类乙管后，防控措施相应调整。 After the change to Class B disease under Class B measures, control measures were adjusted.

en: Class B disease under Class B measures
text: 现在是乙类乙管，不用按甲类那么严。 It is now managed as a Class B disease, so Class A measures are not required.
检疫传染病包括鼠疫、霍乱与黄热病。 Quarantinable infectious diseases include plague, cholera and yellow fever.
这是检疫传染病，入境要隔离。 This is a quarantinable infectious disease, so quarantine is required on entry.
监测传染病需填写健康申明并随访。 Infectious diseases under surveillance require a health declaration and follow-up.
这个属于监测传染病，登记一下就行。 This is an infectious disease under surveillance, so registration is enough.
新发传染病早期识别依赖症候群监测。 Early identification of emerging infectious diseases relies on syndromic surveillance.
新发传染病最怕漏诊，问清旅行史。 The main risk with an emerging infectious disease is missing it, so ask about travel.
再发传染病提示免疫屏障出现缺口。 Re-emerging infectious diseases signal a gap in the immune barrier.
麻疹又多了，再发传染病不能松。 Measles is rising again; re-emerging infectious diseases need attention.
输入性传染病需核实航班与入境口岸。 For an imported infectious disease, check the flight and port of entry.
这是输入性传染病，先问从哪回来。 This is an imported infectious disease, so first ask where the patient came from.
出现本土病例后启动应急响应。 An emergency response was launched after a locally acquired case appeared.
这例是本土病例，流调要扩大范围。 This is a locally acquired case, so expand the investigation.
该病区出现聚集性疫情，立即上报。 A cluster of cases appeared in the ward and was reported immediately.
一个班好几个发烧，是聚集性疫情。 Several children in one class have fever, which is a cluster of cases.
传染病暴发需启动现场调查与处置。 An infectious disease outbreak requires field investigation and response.
确诊多了就是传染病暴发，得报。 Many confirmed cases mean an infectious disease outbreak, which must be reported.
大流行期间口岸检疫措施全面升级。 During a pandemic, port quarantine measures were fully upgraded.
大流行那几年，发热门诊压力最大。 During the pandemic years the fever clinic was under the most pressure.
传染病报告须在规定时限内完成。 Infectious disease reporting must be completed within the prescribed time limit.
这个要传染病报告，快点卡别拖。 This needs infectious disease reporting, so submit the card without delay.
两小时报告适用于鼠疫、霍乱等疾病。 Two-hour reporting applies to diseases such as plague and cholera.
这个必须两小时报告，别等到交班。 This requires two-hour reporting, so do not wait for handover.
乙类传染病行二十四小时报告。 Class B infectious diseases require twenty-four-hour reporting.
肺结核走二十四小时报告，今天报完就行。 Tuberculosis uses twenty-four-hour reporting, so report it today.
网络直报后系统自动生成报告卡号。 After direct online reporting the system generates a report number automatically.
网络直报我来做，你把信息给我。 I will do the direct online reporting; give me the details.
传染病报告卡须填写证件号与联系方式。 The infectious disease reporting card must include the ID number and contact details.
传染病报告卡填完再下班。 Finish the infectious disease reporting card before you leave.
首诊负责制要求不得推诿传染病患者。 The first-visit responsibility system forbids refusing patients with infectious diseases.
首诊负责制，病人到你手上就得管。 Under the first-visit responsibility system, the patient is yours once seen.
疫情报告须经科室审核后提交。 Epidemic reporting must be reviewed by the department before submission.
疫情报告走完流程才能收治。 Admission can proceed only after epidemic reporting is complete.
节假日仍执行零报告制度。 The zero-report system still applies on public holidays.
今天没病例也要零报告制度报一下。 Even with no cases today, make a zero-report submission.
迟报将被通报并追究责任。 Late reporting is notified and accountability is pursued.
这份是迟报，系统会标红。 This one is late reporting, so the system will flag it in red.
自查发现漏报三例肺结核。 Self-inspection found three cases of under-reported tuberculosis.
别漏报，漏了要倒查。 Do not under-report; missed cases are traced back.
瞒报疫情将依法追究责任。 Concealment of cases is pursued according to law.
瞒报比迟报严重得多。 Concealment of cases is far more serious than late reporting.
谎报疫情扰乱防控秩序。 False reporting of an epidemic disrupts control work.
谎报是要担责的，数据必须真实。 False reporting carries liability, so the data must be accurate.

zh: 突发公共卫生事件报告
text: 突发公共卫生事件报告须在两小时内完成。 Public health emergency reporting must be completed within two hours.

zh: 突发公共卫生事件报告
text: 突发公共卫生事件报告赶紧走，别压着。 Send the public health emergency report now; do not hold it back.
报告责任人须每日核对直报数据。 The person responsible for reporting checks the online data daily.
报告责任人是谁？这个卡找他签。 Who is the person responsible for reporting? Find him to sign this card.
疾病预防控制机构接到报告后开展流调。 The disease prevention and control institution starts the investigation after the report.
疾病预防控制机构马上到，先留好资料。 The disease prevention and control institution is arriving; keep the records ready.
流行病学调查须在二十四小时内启动。 The epidemiological investigation must start within twenty-four hours.
流行病学调查会问得很细，您慢慢想。 The epidemiological investigation asks many details; take your time.
现场流调同步采集环境样本。 The field epidemiological investigation collected environmental samples at the same time.
现场流调队到了，带他们去病区。 The field epidemiological investigation team has arrived; take them to the ward.
流行病学史提示有境外旅行史。 The epidemiological history suggests recent overseas travel.
流行病学史再问一遍，有没有聚餐？ Ask about the epidemiological history again: was there a group meal?
活动轨迹已推送至协查平台。 The movement history was sent to the cross-regional tracing platform.
把活动轨迹写清楚，几点到几点在哪。 Write the movement history clearly: where and at what times.
开展病例搜索并扩大检测范围。 Case finding was carried out and testing was expanded.
病例搜索做起来，同类症状都要查。 Start case finding and test anyone with similar symptoms.
对陪护人员开展主动筛查。 Active screening was carried out for carers.
主动筛查一轮，先把隐匿病例找出来。 Run one round of active screening to find hidden cases.
核酸采样须双人核对身份。 Nucleic acid sampling requires two staff to verify identity.
核酸采样有点恶心，忍一下就好。 Nucleic acid sampling is a bit uncomfortable, so bear with it.
核酸检测结果四小时内回报。 The nucleic acid amplification test result is reported within four hours.
核酸检测阴性也不能马上排除。 A negative nucleic acid amplification test does not rule it out immediately.
流行病学调查表须病例本人或家属确认。 The epidemiological investigation form must be confirmed by the patient or family.
流行病学调查表这几项我帮您填。 I will help you fill in these items on the epidemiological investigation form.
该病潜伏期多为三至七天。 The incubation period of this disease is usually three to seven days.
潜伏期还没过，先医学观察。 The incubation period has not passed, so keep under medical observation.
传染期内须严格隔离。 Strict isolation is required during the infectious period.
传染期没过，不能解除隔离。 The infectious period is not over, so isolation cannot end.
追查传染源是流调的核心任务。 Tracing the source of infection is the core task of the investigation.
传染源没找到，防控就难做。 Without finding the source of infection, control is difficult.
传播途径以飞沫和接触为主。 The main routes of transmission are droplets and contact.
传播途径不同，防护级别也不一样。 Different routes of transmission need different levels of protection.
易感人群应优先接种疫苗。 The susceptible population should be vaccinated first.
老人和孩子是易感人群，要重点保护。 Older people and children are the susceptible population and need protection.
该病毒基本再生数约为三。 The basic reproduction number of the virus is about three.
基本再生数大于一，疫情就会扩散。 If the basic reproduction number is above one, the outbreak will spread.
密切接触者须集中隔离并每日测体温。 Close contacts must be centrally quarantined with daily temperature checks.
您是密切接触者，得先隔离观察。 You are a close contact, so you must be isolated for observation first.
密接判定由疾控机构统一完成。 Close contact identification is completed by the disease control agency.
密接判定还没出，先别放人走。 Close contact identification is not done yet, so do not let anyone leave.
次密切接触者参照密接管理。 Secondary close contacts are managed like close contacts.
他是次密切接触者，也要做核酸。 He is a secondary close contact and also needs a nucleic acid test.
一般接触者实施健康监测。 General contacts undergo health monitoring.
您算一般接触者，注意监测体温。 You are a general contact, so monitor your temperature.
接触者追踪在二十四小时内完成。 Contact tracing is completed within twenty-four hours.
接触者追踪要快，晚一天就扩散。 Contact tracing must be fast; one day late means spread.
接触者管理实行属地负责。 Contact management is the responsibility of the local authority.
接触者管理按名单一个一个落实。 Contact management is carried out one by one from the list.
接触时间超过十五分钟计为密接。 Contact longer than fifteen minutes counts as close contact.
接触时间多久？几分钟和半小时不一样。 How long was the exposure time? A few minutes differs from half an hour.
接触方式包括同餐、同住与同乘。 Modes of contact include shared meals, shared housing and shared transport.
接触方式说清楚，是同桌吃饭吗？ Describe the mode of contact: did you share a table?
接触者登记信息须注意隐私保护。 Contact registration data must be kept private.
接触者登记填手机号，方便通知。 Put a mobile number in the contact registration so we can notify you.
已向邻市发出协查通报。 A cross-regional tracing notification was sent to the neighbouring city.
协查通报发出去，等人回话。 The cross-regional tracing notification is out; wait for their reply.
时空伴随者纳入健康监测范围。 Space-time overlap contacts are included in health monitoring.
手机提示您是时空伴随者，先做核酸。 Your phone says you are a space-time overlap contact, so take a test first.
风险人员名单由流调组汇总。 The list of persons at risk is compiled by the investigation team.
风险人员都通知到了吗？ Has every person at risk been notified?
重点人群每周开展一次核酸检测。 Priority populations receive a nucleic acid test once a week.
重点人群先打加强针。 Priority populations receive booster doses first.
接触者采样须在隔离点完成。 Contact sampling must be done at the quarantine site.
接触者采样今天下午统一做。 Contact sampling will be done for everyone this afternoon.
健康监测期间不得外出聚餐。 No outings or group meals are allowed during health monitoring.
健康监测十四天，每天报体温。 Health monitoring lasts fourteen days with daily temperature reports.
接触者告知须注意保护病例隐私。 Contact notification must protect the privacy of the case.
接触者告知我来打电话，别透露是谁。 I will do the contact notification by phone; do not reveal who it was.
确诊患者须立即隔离治疗。 Confirmed patients must be isolated and treated immediately.
这个要隔离，不能住普通病房。 This needs isolation, not a general ward.
医学观察期为十四天。 The medical observation period is fourteen days.
医学观察期间不能上班，每天报体温。 During medical observation you cannot work and must report temperature daily.
居家隔离须单人单间并分餐。 Home isolation requires a separate room and separate meals.
居家隔离期间别出门，家人都要戴口罩。 Do not go out during home isolation, and the family should wear masks.
密切接触者实施集中隔离。 Close contacts undergo centralized quarantine.
集中隔离有车来接，带好换洗衣服。 A vehicle will collect you for centralized quarantine, so bring clothes.
患者转入隔离病房继续治疗。 The patient was transferred to the isolation ward for further treatment.
送隔离病房，走专用通道。 Take him to the isolation ward through the dedicated route.
负压病房收治空气传播疾病患者。 The negative-pressure room admits patients with airborne diseases.
负压病房门要关严，别同时开两扇。 Keep the negative-pressure room doors shut; do not open two at once.
疑似病例先单间隔离待检。 A suspected case is placed in single-room isolation pending testing.
先单间隔离，结果出来再定。 Keep him in single-room isolation and decide when the result comes.
连续两次核酸阴性方可解除隔离。 Release from isolation requires two consecutive negative tests.
解除隔离要等疾控通知。 Release from isolation waits for notice from disease control.
隔离期为十四天，期满复查。 The isolation period is fourteen days, with a review at the end.
隔离期没满，不能提前走。 The isolation period is not over, so you cannot leave early.
甲类传染病患者须隔离治疗。 Patients with Class A infectious diseases must receive isolation treatment.
先隔离治疗，别急着转院。 Start isolation treatment first; do not rush to transfer.
拒绝隔离治疗的可由公安机关协助强制隔离治疗。 Those refusing isolation treatment may face compulsory isolation and treatment assisted by police.
他跑了就得走强制隔离治疗程序。 If he runs away, compulsory isolation and treatment procedures apply.
医学观察期内出现症状立即转运。 Transfer immediately if symptoms appear during the medical observation period.
医学观察期还有五天，别松劲。 There are five days left in the medical observation period, so stay alert.
居家健康监测期间每日报告体温。 Report your temperature daily during home health monitoring.
居家健康监测，别去人多的地方。 During home health monitoring, avoid crowded places.
集中隔离点须分区设置并配备医护。 A centralized quarantine facility needs separate zones and medical staff.
集中隔离点在体育馆那边。 The centralized quarantine facility is over by the stadium.
确诊病例闭环转运至定点医院。 The confirmed case was transferred to the designated hospital by closed-loop transfer.
闭环转运，司机和医护都不下车。 For closed-loop transfer, neither the driver nor staff get out.
期满且核酸阴性者解除医学观察。 Those with a negative test at the end of the period are released from medical observation.
今天解除医学观察，可以回家了。 You are released from medical observation today and can go home.
进入隔离病区须规范穿戴个人防护装备。 Personal protective equipment must be worn correctly before entering the isolation ward.
个人防护装备穿好再进去，别漏了护目镜。 Put on the personal protective equipment first, and do not forget the goggles.
预检分诊岗位执行一级防护。 Staff at triage work under level one protection.
你在分诊台，一级防护就够了。 You are at the triage desk, so level one protection is enough.
进入发热门诊须二级防护。 Level two protection is required to enter the fever clinic.
发热门诊走二级防护，帽子口罩都要戴。 The fever clinic uses level two protection, so wear cap and mask.
气管插管按三级防护执行。 Intubation is performed under level three protection.
插管是三级防护，正压头套别忘了。 Intubation needs level three protection, so do not forget the powered air hood.
全程佩戴医用外科口罩。 Wear a surgical mask throughout.
医用外科口罩戴好，遮住鼻子。 Put the surgical mask on properly and cover your nose.
接触疑似肺结核患者须戴医用防护口罩。 A medical protective respirator is required when seeing suspected tuberculosis.
医用防护口罩要做密合性检查。 Do a seal check on the medical protective respirator.
脱防护服时避免污染内层衣物。 Avoid contaminating inner clothing when removing the protective suit.
防护服穿反了不行，接缝朝外。 The protective suit cannot be worn inside out; seams must face outward.
采样时须佩戴护目镜或面屏。 Wear protective goggles or a face shield during sampling.
护目镜起雾了，擦一下再操作。 The protective goggles fogged up; wipe them before continuing.
吸痰操作加戴防护面屏。 Add a face shield when performing suctioning.
防护面屏戴上，别用手摸脸。 Put on the face shield and do not touch your face.
接触患者前后更换乳胶手套。 Change latex gloves before and after contact with a patient.
乳胶手套一人一换，别戴着乱走。 Change latex gloves for each patient; do not walk around wearing them.
手卫生依从性纳入科室考核。 Hand hygiene compliance is included in departmental assessment.
手卫生做到位，比多戴一层手套管用。 Good hand hygiene helps more than an extra pair of gloves.

en: donning and doffing of protective clothing
text: 穿脱防护服须双人监督。 Donning and doffing of protective clothing requires a buddy to supervise.

en: donning and doffing of protective clothing
text: 穿脱防护服有顺序，脱的时候更要慢。 Donning and doffing of protective clothing follows a sequence; slow down when removing.
脱卸区分清洁区与污染区。 The doffing area is divided into clean and contaminated zones.
到脱卸区再脱，别在走廊里脱。 Remove equipment in the doffing area, not in the corridor.
戴医用防护口罩后行密合性检查。 Perform a mask seal check after putting on the respirator.
密合性检查做一下，呼气看有没有漏。 Do a mask seal check and breathe out to see if air leaks.
候诊区张贴呼吸道礼仪提示。 Respiratory hygiene notices are posted in the waiting area.
咳嗽注意呼吸道礼仪，用纸巾捂住。 Mind your respiratory hygiene when coughing and cover with a tissue.
接触耐药菌患者须穿隔离衣。 An isolation gown is required when caring for patients with resistant bacteria.
隔离衣系紧后领，出来前脱掉。 Tie the isolation gown at the back of the neck and remove it before leaving.
患者转出后对床单位进行消毒。 The bed unit is disinfected after the patient is transferred out.
这个床要消毒，先别收新病人。 This bed needs disinfection, so do not admit a new patient yet.
手术器械须经高压蒸汽灭菌。 Surgical instruments must undergo autoclave sterilization.
这些器械要灭菌，不能只消毒。 These instruments need sterilization, not just disinfection.
患者死亡后行终末消毒。 Terminal disinfection was performed after the patient died.
人走了做终末消毒，房间封两小时。 Do terminal disinfection after the patient leaves and seal the room for two hours.
病室实行随时消毒并记录。 The room undergoes concurrent disinfection and it is documented.
随时消毒跟上，别等出院才做。 Keep up concurrent disinfection; do not wait until discharge.
门诊每日开展预防性消毒。 Preventive disinfection is carried out daily in the outpatient department.
预防性消毒每天两次，别省。 Preventive disinfection is done twice a day; do not skip it.
用含氯消毒剂擦拭地面与床栏。 Floors and bed rails were wiped with a chlorine-based disinfectant.
含氯消毒剂现配现用，放久了失效。 Chlorine-based disinfectant must be freshly prepared; it loses potency.
乙醇消毒剂用于体温计擦拭。 Ethanol disinfectant is used to wipe thermometers.
乙醇消毒剂别喷空气，只擦表面。 Do not spray ethanol disinfectant into the air; wipe surfaces only.
无人时开启紫外线消毒三十分钟。 Ultraviolet disinfection runs for thirty minutes when the room is empty.
紫外线消毒时人不能在里面。 Nobody can stay inside during ultraviolet disinfection.
耐高温器械首选高压蒸汽灭菌。 Autoclave sterilization is preferred for heat-resistant instruments.
高压蒸汽灭菌要贴指示胶带。 Put indicator tape on items for autoclave sterilization.
按说明书配置消毒剂浓度。 Prepare the disinfectant concentration according to the instructions.
消毒剂浓度不够，等于白擦。 If the disinfectant concentration is too low, wiping is useless.
消毒作用时间不少于三十分钟。 The contact time must be at least thirty minutes.
喷完要等够消毒作用时间再擦。 After spraying, wait the full contact time before wiping.
每日两次物体表面消毒。 Surface disinfection is done twice daily.
物体表面消毒重点擦门把手。 For surface disinfection, focus on door handles.
病室每日通风并进行空气消毒。 The room is ventilated and air disinfection is performed daily.
空气消毒加开窗通风，双管齐下。 Combine air disinfection with open-window ventilation.
医疗废物按类别分袋收集。 Medical waste is collected in bags by category.
医疗废物别混进生活垃圾。 Do not mix medical waste with household rubbish.
感染性废物使用黄色专用袋。 Infectious waste goes into yellow dedicated bags.
感染性废物扎紧袋口再称重。 Tie the infectious waste bag tightly before weighing.
每季度开展消毒效果监测。 Disinfection efficacy monitoring is carried out quarterly.
消毒效果监测不合格就重做。 If disinfection efficacy monitoring fails, redo the disinfection.
疫苗接种须核对姓名与疫苗批号。 Vaccination requires checking the name and vaccine batch number.
疫苗接种前先问有没有过敏史。 Before vaccination, ask about any history of allergy.
该疫苗已纳入国家免疫规划。 This vaccine is included in the national immunization programme.
免疫规划内的疫苗免费。 Vaccines in the immunization programme are free.
按接种程序完成全程接种。 Complete the full course according to the vaccination schedule.
接种程序是零一二六个月，别记错。 The vaccination schedule is zero, one, two and six months; do not mix it up.
灭活疫苗需多剂次完成基础免疫。 Inactivated vaccines need several doses to complete primary immunization.
灭活疫苗打两针，间隔三周。 The inactivated vaccine is given in two doses three weeks apart.
免疫缺陷者禁用减毒活疫苗。 Live attenuated vaccines are contraindicated in immunodeficient patients.
减毒活疫苗孕妇不能打。 Pregnant women cannot receive live attenuated vaccines.
重组蛋白疫苗需低温保存。 Recombinant protein vaccines require cold storage.
重组蛋白疫苗三针，间隔一个月。 The recombinant protein vaccine is three doses one month apart.
信使核糖核酸疫苗须超低温储运。 Messenger RNA vaccines require ultra-low temperature storage and transport.
信使核糖核酸疫苗打完后胳膊会酸。 The arm aches after a messenger RNA vaccine.
病毒载体疫苗接种一剂即可起效。 A single dose of viral vector vaccine is effective.
病毒载体疫苗只打一针。 The viral vector vaccine is just one dose.
严格按接种剂量抽取疫苗。 Draw the vaccine strictly according to the vaccination dose.
接种剂量别抽多，零点五毫升就够。 Do not draw more than the vaccination dose; half a millilitre is enough.
发热者暂缓接种并另行预约。 Those with fever have temporary deferral of vaccination and a new appointment.
今天发烧就暂缓接种，好了再来。 With fever today you need temporary deferral of vaccination; come back when well.
完成基础免疫六个月后接种加强针。 A booster dose is given six months after completing primary immunization.
加强针到时间了，记得来打。 The booster dose is due; remember to come.
接种率达到一定水平可形成群体免疫。 Herd immunity forms when coverage reaches a certain level.
群体免疫要靠大家都去打疫苗。 Herd immunity depends on everyone getting vaccinated.
该疫苗效力约为百分之九十。 The vaccine efficacy is about ninety percent.
疫苗效力再高也不能百分百防住。 Even high vaccine efficacy does not guarantee full protection.
提高老年人疫苗覆盖率。 Increase vaccination coverage among older people.
疫苗覆盖率上不去，疫情就难控。 If vaccination coverage stays low, the outbreak is hard to control.
入托入学须查验预防接种证。 The immunization record booklet is checked at kindergarten and school entry.
预防接种证带来，我登记一下。 Bring the immunization record booklet and I will register it.
划定区域开展应急接种。 Emergency vaccination was carried out in the designated area.
应急接种今天开始，先打重点人群。 Emergency vaccination starts today, beginning with key groups.
疫苗不良反应须在系统内报告。 Adverse vaccine reactions must be reported in the system.
打完后不舒服，可能是疫苗不良反应。 Feeling unwell afterwards may be an adverse vaccine reaction.

zh: 疑似预防接种异常反应
text: 疑似预防接种异常反应须在四十八小时内报告。 An adverse event following immunization must be reported within forty-eight hours.

zh: 疑似预防接种异常反应
text: 这个算疑似预防接种异常反应，先上报。 This counts as an adverse event following immunization, so report it first.
一般反应无需特殊处理。 A common adverse reaction needs no specific treatment.
一般反应就是胳膊酸、有点低烧。 A common adverse reaction is a sore arm and slight fever.
异常反应需组织专家调查诊断。 An abnormal vaccination reaction requires expert investigation and diagnosis.
这种情况要按异常反应上报。 This case must be reported as an abnormal vaccination reaction.
接种部位红肿直径约三厘米。 The injection-site redness and swelling measured about three centimetres.
接种部位红肿别揉，冷敷就行。 Do not rub the injection-site redness and swelling; cold compress is enough.
全身反应多在两天内缓解。 A systemic reaction usually resolves within two days.
有全身反应就多喝水、多休息。 With a systemic reaction, drink more water and rest.
接种点须配备疫苗相关过敏性休克抢救药品。 Vaccination sites must stock drugs for vaccine-associated anaphylaxis.
疫苗相关过敏性休克要马上打肾上腺素。 For vaccine-associated anaphylaxis give adrenaline immediately.
晕针者平卧并观察生命体征。 A patient with needle syncope lies flat and vital signs are watched.
他是晕针，不是过敏，先躺下。 He has needle syncope, not allergy, so lie him down first.
局部反应一般三到五天消退。 A local reaction usually fades in three to five days.
局部反应不用吃药，观察就行。 A local reaction needs no medicine, just observation.
不良反应监测覆盖所有接种单位。 Adverse reaction monitoring covers all vaccination units.
不良反应监测数据每周汇总。 Adverse reaction monitoring data are summarised weekly.
因果关联评估由专家组完成。 Causality assessment is completed by an expert panel.
因果关联评估没出来，先别下结论。 Causality assessment is not out yet, so do not conclude.
异常反应补偿按省级办法执行。 Compensation for abnormal reaction follows provincial rules.
异常反应补偿要走鉴定程序。 Compensation for abnormal reaction requires the appraisal procedure.
不良反应报告须填写发生时间与处理经过。 Adverse reaction reporting records the time of onset and treatment given.
不良反应报告今天必须录完。 Adverse reaction reporting must be entered today.
接种后留观三十分钟方可离开。 Stay for post-vaccination observation for thirty minutes before leaving.
接种后留观半小时，不舒服马上说。 Stay for post-vaccination observation for half an hour and speak up if unwell.
接种点制定异常反应处置流程。 Vaccination sites set out a management of adverse reactions pathway.
异常反应处置演练每半年一次。 Management of adverse reactions is drilled every six months.
异常反应鉴定由市级医学会组织。 The appraisal of abnormal vaccination reaction is organised by the city medical association.
异常反应鉴定结果出来再说赔偿。 Wait for the appraisal of abnormal vaccination reaction before discussing compensation.
口岸检疫发现一例发热旅客。 Port health quarantine identified one febrile traveller.
口岸检疫会测体温，别紧张。 Port health quarantine will check your temperature, so do not worry.
健康申报内容包括症状与接触史。 The health declaration covers symptoms and contact history.
健康申报在手机上填，别漏项。 Fill in the health declaration on your phone and do not skip items.
入境检疫须查验核酸检测证明。 Entry quarantine checks the nucleic acid test certificate.
入境检疫排队先准备好护照。 Have your passport ready while queueing for entry quarantine.
出境检疫发现疑似病例移交医疗机构。 Exit quarantine referred a suspected case to a medical institution.
出境检疫也要填健康申报。 Exit quarantine also requires a health declaration.
染疫嫌疑人送留验场所观察。 The person suspected of infection was sent to a quarantine site for observation.
他是染疫嫌疑人，先留验。 He is a person suspected of infection, so keep him under quarantine observation.
留验期限按该病潜伏期确定。 The quarantine observation period is set by the incubation period of the disease.
留验期间不能离开指定场所。 You cannot leave the designated site during quarantine observation.
对就地诊验人员发放就诊方便卡。 Those under on-site medical examination receive a medical convenience card.
就地诊验要去指定医院，别乱跑。 On-site medical examination must be at the designated hospital, so do not wander off.
医学排查发现体温三十八度以上旅客。 Medical screening at port found a traveller with a temperature above thirty-eight degrees.
医学排查就是问症状、测体温。 Medical screening at port means asking about symptoms and checking temperature.
健康申明卡须本人签字。 The health declaration form must be signed by the traveller.
健康申明卡填错要重填。 If the health declaration form is filled in wrongly, do it again.
登机前须出示核酸检测证明。 A nucleic acid test certificate must be shown before boarding.
核酸检测证明过期了，得重做。 The nucleic acid test certificate has expired, so a new test is needed.
入境须查验疫苗接种证明。 Vaccination certificates are checked on entry.
疫苗接种证明在手机里能查。 The vaccination certificate can be shown on your phone.
染疫人由指定机构隔离治疗。 The infected person receives isolation treatment at a designated facility.
染疫人要闭环转运，不能自行离开。 The infected person needs closed-loop transfer and cannot leave alone.
对行李实施卫生处理后方可放行。 Luggage is released only after sanitary measures are applied.
卫生处理完才能提货。 Goods can be collected only after sanitary measures are completed.
交通工具检疫须查验旅客名单。 Conveyance quarantine requires checking the passenger list.
交通工具检疫没放行，人不能下机。 Until conveyance quarantine clears, passengers cannot disembark.

zh: 口岸突发公共卫生事件
en: public health emergency at a port of entry
text: 口岸突发公共卫生事件两小时内上报。 A public health emergency at a port of entry is reported within two hours.

zh: 口岸突发公共卫生事件
en: public health emergency at a port of entry
text: 口岸突发公共卫生事件要马上启动预案。 Activate the plan at once for a public health emergency at a port of entry.
疫情发布须经授权后统一进行。 Epidemic information release is carried out uniformly after authorisation.
疫情发布今天下午三点，别提前透消息。 Epidemic information release is at three this afternoon; do not leak it early.
风险沟通要说明已知与未知，避免过度承诺。 Risk communication should state what is known and unknown and avoid overpromising.
风险沟通别只讲数字，要告诉公众怎么做。 In risk communication do not just give numbers; tell the public what to do.
已向相邻省份发出疫情通报。 An epidemic notification has been sent to neighbouring provinces.
疫情通报发出后，各地开始排查。 After the epidemic notification went out, local areas began screening.
新闻发布会通报了新增病例与防控措施。 The press conference reported new cases and control measures.
新闻发布会别抢答，统一由发言人回应。 At the press conference do not answer out of turn; the spokesperson responds.
该区调整为中风险等级。 The district was adjusted to a medium risk level.
风险等级变了，防控措施也要跟着调。 When the risk level changes, control measures must change too.
发布旅行风险提示，建议暂缓前往。 A travel risk alert advised postponing trips.
门口贴了风险提示，就诊前先看。 A risk alert is posted at the entrance; read it before coming in.
公众防护指南明确发热就诊流程。 The public protection guidance sets out the pathway for fever clinic visits.
公众防护指南发到社区，人手一份。 Distribute the public protection guidance to the community, one per person.
谣言称喝某药可预防，已紧急澄清。 A rumour claimed a certain drug prevents infection and was promptly clarified.
群里传的谣言别转，等官方消息。 Do not forward rumours in group chats; wait for official information.
当天辟谣三条不实信息。 Three pieces of misinformation were refuted the same day.
谣言出来要及时辟谣，别拖着。 Refute misinformation promptly when it appears; do not delay.
风险感知偏低导致防护措施执行不到位。 Low risk perception led to poor adherence to protective measures.
风险感知因人而异，沟通要分层。 Risk perception varies, so communication must be tailored.
启动应急响应，各工作组到位。 Emergency response was activated and all working groups assembled.
应急响应一启动，全员取消休假。 Once emergency response starts, all leave is cancelled.
应急响应级别由三级提升为二级。 The emergency response level was raised from three to two.
应急响应级别没降，防控不能松。 The emergency response level has not been lowered, so control stays strict.
舆情监测发现公众对隔离政策疑问较多。 Public opinion monitoring found many questions about isolation policy.
舆情监测每天出一期简报。 Public opinion monitoring produces a daily briefing.
术后出现医院感染，上报院感科。 A healthcare-associated infection appeared after surgery and was reported to infection control.
这个算医院感染，别当成社区感染。 This counts as a healthcare-associated infection, not a community one.
院感防控纳入医院年度考核。 Infection prevention and control is part of the annual hospital assessment.
院感防控做不好，一次暴发全科停摆。 Poor infection prevention and control means one outbreak shuts the unit.
手卫生依从性从六成提升到九成。 Hand hygiene compliance rose from sixty to ninety percent.
手卫生依从性上不去，先查洗手液够不够。 If hand hygiene compliance is low, first check the supply of hand rub.
所有患者均执行标准预防。 Standard precautions apply to all patients.
标准预防是底线，不分有没有确诊。 Standard precautions are the baseline, whatever the diagnosis.
耐药菌患者实施接触隔离。 Patients with resistant bacteria are managed under contact precautions.
接触隔离要挂牌，进出都穿隔离衣。 Contact precautions need a door sign and a gown on entry.
流感患者执行飞沫隔离。 Influenza patients are managed under droplet precautions.
飞沫隔离要求单间或床间距一米。 Droplet precautions require a single room or one metre between beds.
肺结核活动期需空气隔离。 Active pulmonary tuberculosis requires airborne precautions.
空气隔离必须进负压病房。 Airborne precautions require a negative-pressure room.
隔离标识贴在门外醒目位置。 The isolation sign is posted prominently outside the door.
隔离标识掉了要马上补。 Replace the isolation sign at once if it falls off.
医院感染监测每月汇总分析。 Healthcare-associated infection surveillance is summarised monthly.
医院感染监测发现某病区感染率上升。 Healthcare-associated infection surveillance found a rising infection rate in one ward.
启动暴发调查，采集环境样本。 An outbreak investigation was launched and environmental samples collected.
暴发调查期间暂停收新病人。 Suspend new admissions during the outbreak investigation.
换药须严格遵守无菌操作。 Dressing changes must strictly follow aseptic technique.
无菌操作不过关，伤口就容易感染。 Poor aseptic technique leads to wound infection.
医疗废物分类错误会被通报。 Wrong medical waste classification is reported as a breach.
医疗废物分类按颜色分，别混。 Medical waste classification follows bag colour; do not mix them.
病区出现院感暴发，立即封控。 A healthcare-associated outbreak in the ward triggered immediate closure.
院感暴发要两小时内报院感科。 A healthcare-associated outbreak is reported to infection control within two hours.
血源性病原体暴露需评估源患者。 Bloodborne pathogen exposure requires assessment of the source patient.
血源性病原体里最怕的是乙肝。 Among bloodborne pathogens, hepatitis B is the biggest concern.
锐器伤后立即挤出血液并消毒。 After a needlestick injury, squeeze out blood and disinfect at once.
锐器伤先冲洗，别用力挤。 For a needlestick injury irrigate first; do not squeeze hard.
暴露源乙肝表面抗原阳性。 The exposure source was positive for hepatitis B surface antigen.
暴露源查清楚，才知道要不要用药。 Identify the exposure source to decide whether drugs are needed.
暴露评估为低风险，观察即可。 The exposure assessment was low risk, so observation suffices.
暴露评估没做完，先别停药。 Do not stop drugs until the exposure assessment is complete.
暴露登记须在二十四小时内完成。 Exposure registry entries must be completed within twenty-four hours.
暴露登记填全，随访才找得到人。 Complete the exposure registry so follow-up can reach you.
未接种者需注射乙肝免疫球蛋白。 Those not vaccinated need hepatitis B immunoglobulin.
乙肝免疫球蛋白越早打越好。 Hepatitis B immunoglobulin should be given as early as possible.
基线检测今天抽血送检。 Baseline testing bloods were sent today.
基线检测结果留底，后面要对比。 Keep the baseline testing results for later comparison.
随访检测安排在六周、三个月与六个月。 Follow-up testing is scheduled at six weeks, three months and six months.
随访检测别漏，最后一次最容易被忘。 Do not miss follow-up testing; the last one is easily forgotten.
上报流程贴在治疗室墙上。 The reporting procedure is posted on the treatment room wall.
上报流程走完，才算正式备案。 Only after the reporting procedure is complete is it formally recorded.
暴露后随访由感染科负责。 Post-exposure follow-up is managed by the infectious diseases department.
暴露后随访半年，期间可正常上班。 Post-exposure follow-up lasts six months, and normal work continues.
暴露档案保存不少于十年。 Exposure records are kept for at least ten years.
暴露档案在院感科，调阅要登记。 The exposure record is held by infection control; access is logged.
锐器盒装到四分之三就要更换。 The sharps container must be replaced when three-quarters full.
锐器盒别用手掏，直接换新的。 Do not reach into the sharps container; replace it.
安全注射要求一人一针一管。 Safe injection requires a new needle and syringe for each patient.
安全注射做到位，锐器伤少一半。 Good safe injection halves needlestick injuries.
痰涂片阳性肺结核需空气隔离。 Smear-positive pulmonary tuberculosis requires airborne precautions.
肺结核要查痰，别只看胸片。 Pulmonary tuberculosis needs sputum tests, not just a chest film.
耐多药结核病疗程长达十八个月。 Multidrug-resistant tuberculosis treatment lasts up to eighteen months.
耐多药结核病要送药敏试验。 Multidrug-resistant tuberculosis needs drug susceptibility testing.
人类免疫缺陷病毒抗体初筛阳性需确证。 A reactive human immunodeficiency virus antibody screen needs confirmation.
人类免疫缺陷病毒检测要本人知情同意。 Human immunodeficiency virus testing requires the patient's informed consent.
艾滋病患者机会性感染风险高。 Patients with acquired immunodeficiency syndrome are at high risk of opportunistic infection.
艾滋病不是绝症，规范治疗能长期生存。 Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome is not a death sentence with proper treatment.
病毒性肝炎分型靠血清学检测。 Viral hepatitis typing relies on serological tests.
病毒性肝炎要注意休息和复查肝功能。 With viral hepatitis, rest and repeat liver function tests.
乙型肝炎表面抗原阳性者需定期随访。 Those positive for hepatitis B surface antigen need regular follow-up.
乙型肝炎疫苗三针打完才有保护。 Hepatitis B protection requires all three vaccine doses.
流行性感冒与普通感冒不同，需抗病毒治疗。 Influenza differs from the common cold and needs antiviral treatment.
流行性感冒高发季节，发热病人要分流。 In influenza season, febrile patients need separate routing.
新型冠状病毒感染按乙类传染病管理。 Coronavirus disease 2019 is managed as a Class B infectious disease.
新型冠状病毒感染抗原阳性先居家监测。 A positive antigen test for coronavirus disease 2019 first means home monitoring.
霍乱疑似病例须就地隔离并上报。 Suspected cholera requires on-site isolation and reporting.
霍乱补液是关键，别等培养结果。 Fluid replacement is key in cholera; do not wait for culture.
手足口病患儿需隔离至疱疹结痂。 Children with hand, foot and mouth disease are isolated until the vesicles crust.
手足口病看手心脚心和口腔。 For hand, foot and mouth disease check palms, soles and mouth.
丙型肝炎可经抗病毒治疗治愈。 Hepatitis C can be cured with antiviral treatment.
丙型肝炎查抗体阳性还要查核酸。 For hepatitis C, a positive antibody test needs nucleic acid testing too.
诺如病毒感染易在病区引起暴发。 Norovirus infection easily causes outbreaks in wards.
诺如病毒感染要处理呕吐物，别干扫。 For norovirus infection clean vomit properly; do not dry sweep.
病历记录精神障碍诊断须由精神科执业医师作出 Diagnoses of mental disorder must be made by a licensed psychiatrist and recorded accordingly.
家属问精神障碍是不是就是精神病，医生说明范围更宽 The family asked whether mental disorder means insanity, and the doctor explained the term is broader.
严重精神障碍患者纳入社区随访管理 Patients with severe mental disorder are included in community follow-up programmes.
他这个严重精神障碍已经十年，一直规律服药 He has had severe mental disorder for ten years and has taken medication regularly throughout.
精神分裂症患者自知力多不完整，需长期抗精神病药维持 Patients with schizophrenia usually have limited insight and need long-term antipsychotic maintenance.
他确诊精神分裂症八年，一停药就复发 He was diagnosed with schizophrenia eight years ago and relapses whenever he stops the medication.
抑郁障碍的诊断需同时满足症状标准和病程标准 Diagnosing depressive disorder requires both symptom criteria and duration criteria.
她说抑郁障碍不是想不开，是病，得治 She says depressive disorder is an illness rather than a bad attitude, and it needs treatment.
双相障碍误用抗抑郁药可能诱发躁狂发作 Antidepressants used in bipolar disorder may trigger a manic episode.
家里人说双相障碍情绪一会儿高一会儿低，很难照顾 The family says bipolar disorder makes his mood swing between high and low, which is hard to manage.
焦虑障碍需与甲状腺功能亢进、心律失常等躯体疾病鉴别 Anxiety disorder must be distinguished from physical conditions such as hyperthyroidism and arrhythmia.
他焦虑障碍发作时心慌手抖，以为是心脏病 When his anxiety disorder flares he has palpitations and tremors and thinks it is a heart problem.
老年谵妄常被误认为痴呆或情绪问题 Delirium in older patients is often mistaken for dementia or an emotional problem.
老爷子晚上突然谵妄，认不出人，还说看见虫子 The old man suddenly became delirious at night, did not recognise people, and said he saw insects.
器质性精神障碍需先查头颅CT与代谢指标 Organic mental disorder requires brain imaging and metabolic tests first.
医生说要先排除器质性精神障碍，才考虑功能性的病 The doctor said organic mental disorder must be excluded before considering a functional illness.
物质所致精神障碍须记录物质种类与末次使用时间 For substance-induced mental disorder, record the substance and the time of last use.
他这次幻觉是物质所致精神障碍，戒断后就清醒了 This episode of hallucinations was substance-induced mental disorder, and he cleared once he withdrew.
强迫障碍患者明知不必要却无法控制反复检查的行为 Patients with obsessive-compulsive disorder know the repeated checking is unnecessary but cannot stop.
他强迫障碍，出门要反复回去看门锁 His obsessive-compulsive disorder makes him go back again and again to check the door lock.
创伤后应激障碍多在创伤事件后数周至数月出现 Post-traumatic stress disorder usually emerges weeks to months after the traumatic event.
车祸后他一直做噩梦，是创伤后应激障碍 He has had nightmares since the car crash, which is post-traumatic stress disorder.
人格障碍的诊断需追溯至青少年期并排除其他精神障碍 Diagnosing personality disorder requires tracing onset to adolescence and excluding other disorders.
家属说他人格障碍，跟谁都处不来，也不觉得自己有问题 The family says his personality disorder makes him fall out with everyone, and he sees no problem in himself.
进食障碍患者常伴电解质紊乱与心律失常，需监测血钾 Patients with eating disorder often have electrolyte disturbance and arrhythmia, so potassium must be monitored.
女孩进食障碍，瘦得厉害还说自己胖 The girl has an eating disorder and is dangerously thin yet still calls herself fat.
睡眠障碍需先排除睡眠呼吸暂停等躯体原因 Sleep disorder requires exclusion of physical causes such as sleep apnoea first.
他睡眠障碍两年，一晚上醒四五次 He has had a sleep disorder for two years and wakes four or five times a night.
躯体形式障碍患者常多次就诊于多个科室 Patients with somatic symptom disorder often attend several departments repeatedly.
她躯体形式障碍，查了半年都没查出毛病，人还是难受 She has somatic symptom disorder, and after six months of tests nothing was found yet she still feels unwell.
孤独症谱系障碍应尽早开展行为干预与语言训练 Autism spectrum disorder should prompt early behavioural intervention and language training.
孩子两岁还不会叫爸爸妈妈，查了是孤独症谱系障碍 The child could not say mummy or daddy at two, and testing showed autism spectrum disorder.
幻觉需记录种类、内容和出现时间 For hallucinations, record the type, content, and time of occurrence.
他说晚上有人站床边说话，其实是幻觉 He says someone stands by his bed talking at night, which is a hallucination.
患者诉听幻觉为命令性内容，需立即评估自伤风险 When auditory hallucinations are commanding in content, self-harm risk must be assessed at once.
他听幻觉里一直有人骂他，让他别信医生 In his auditory hallucinations someone keeps insulting him and telling him not to trust the doctor.
妄想内容应原话记录，不要只写"有妄想" Record delusional content in the patient's own words rather than writing only that delusions are present.
他坚信邻居要害他，这是妄想，怎么解释都不信 He is convinced the neighbour means to harm him, which is a delusion, and no explanation changes it.
被害妄想患者可能因恐惧而先发制人，需注意环境安全 Patients with persecutory delusion may act first out of fear, so the environment must be kept safe.
他说饭菜被下毒，是典型被害妄想，不肯吃饭 He says the food is poisoned, a classic persecutory delusion, and refuses to eat.
关系妄想常表现为认为电视和广播在暗示自己 Delusion of reference often appears as a belief that television and radio broadcasts hint at oneself.
他关系妄想，觉得路人咳嗽都是冲他来的 He has delusions of reference and thinks strangers cough because of him.
思维散漫使病史采集困难，需记录原话示例 Loosening of associations makes history taking difficult, so verbatim examples should be recorded.
跟他聊病情，他思维散漫，说三句就跑题 Talking about his illness shows loosening of associations, as he drifts off topic every few sentences.
思维奔逸伴言语增多和睡眠减少，支持躁狂发作 Flight of ideas with increased speech and reduced sleep supports a diagnosis of mania.
他思维奔逸，一晚上写了几十页计划 His thoughts are racing so fast that he wrote dozens of pages of plans in one night.
思维贫乏属精神分裂症阴性症状，需与抑郁鉴别 Poverty of thought is a negative symptom of schizophrenia and must be distinguished from depression.
问一句答一句，思维贫乏很明显 He answers only what is asked, and the poverty of thought is obvious.
情感淡漠影响康复训练参与度，需家属协助督促 Apathy reduces participation in rehabilitation, so families need to help with encouragement.
他情感淡漠，家里出事也没什么反应 He shows apathy and barely reacts even when something happens at home.
情感高涨伴夸大观念时需评估冲动消费与出走风险 Elation with grandiose ideas requires assessment of impulsive spending and absconding risk.
他这几天情感高涨，觉得自己什么都能干 He has been elated for days and believes he can do anything.
谈亲人去世时发笑属情感倒错，应如实记录 Laughing while discussing a relative's death is inappropriate affect and should be recorded as such.
说到父亲去世他还笑，情感倒错很明显 He laughed while talking about his father's death, which is clearly inappropriate affect.
自知力缺乏者多拒绝服药，需与家属共同商定方案 Those lacking insight often refuse medication, so a plan must be agreed with the family.
他自知力很差，坚持说自己没病，不肯吃药 His insight is very poor, he insists he is not ill and refuses medication.
蜡样屈曲是紧张症典型体征，须记录持续时间 Waxy flexibility is a typical catatonic sign and its duration should be recorded.
抬起他胳膊，他就保持那个姿势，是蜡样屈曲 When his arm is lifted it stays in that position, which is waxy flexibility.
缄默患者需先排除失语与喉部病变 In mutism, aphasia and laryngeal disease must be excluded first.
她一天不说一句话，缄默已经三天了 She has not said a word all day, and the mutism has lasted three days.
入院风险评估须在规定时限内完成并记录 Admission risk assessment must be completed and documented within the required time.
先做风险评估，看他有没有伤人风险再安排床位 Do the risk assessment first, then decide bed placement based on the risk of harming others.
自杀风险评估阳性者需专人看护并清除危险物品 Patients screening positive on suicide risk assessment need one-to-one observation and removal of dangerous items.
自杀风险评估还没做，别让他一个人待着 The suicide risk assessment is not done yet, so do not leave him alone.
暴力风险评估提示高风险时，应提前呼叫安保支援 When violence risk assessment indicates high risk, security support should be called in advance.
暴力风险评估做完了，这人暂时不能单独问诊 The violence risk assessment is done, and this patient cannot be seen alone for now.
危险性评估达三级以上需加密随访 Follow-up must intensify once the dangerousness assessment reaches grade three or above.
社区医生每季度做一次危险性评估 The community doctor carries out a dangerousness assessment every quarter.
既往未遂史是最重要的危险因素之一 A history of previous attempts is one of the most important risk factors.
问清危险因素，比如最近有没有失业、离婚这些事 Ask about risk factors such as recent job loss or divorce.
保护性因素包括家庭支持和规律随访 Protective factors include family support and regular follow-up.
他有保护性因素，家里一直有人陪着 He has protective factors because someone in the family is always with him.
既往自杀未遂史须在入院记录中单列 A history of suicide attempt must be recorded as a separate item in the admission note.
问他既往自杀未遂史，他承认三年前割过腕 Asked about his history of suicide attempt, he admitted cutting his wrist three years ago.
自杀意念频繁出现者应转入观察区并制定安全计划 Frequent suicidal ideation warrants transfer to the observation area and a safety plan.
他说有自杀意念，但还没想好怎么做 He says he has suicidal ideation but has not decided how he would do it.
有明确自杀计划者属高危，不宜居家观察 A clear suicide plan places the patient at high risk and rules out home observation.
他连自杀计划都写好了，必须留观 He has even written out a suicide plan, so observation is mandatory.
冲动控制差的患者应减少环境刺激并加强观察 Patients with poor impulse control need reduced environmental stimulation and closer observation.
他冲动控制不行，一急就砸东西 His impulse control is poor and he smashes things when he gets agitated.
激越加重时应先排除疼痛、缺氧和药物不良反应 When agitation worsens, exclude pain, hypoxia, and adverse drug reactions first.
病人越来越激越，先查血糖和血氧再考虑加药 The patient is increasingly agitated, so check glucose and oxygen before adding medication.
敌意明显者问诊时应保持出口通畅 When hostility is marked, keep a clear exit during the interview.
他一进来就敌意很重，说谁也别碰他 He came in full of hostility and said nobody should touch him.
评估量表结果须结合临床判断，不能只看分数 Rating scale results must be interpreted with clinical judgement and not by score alone.
这个评估量表十分钟能做完，先测一遍 This rating scale takes ten minutes, so let us run it first.

zh: 哥伦比亚自杀严重程度评定量表
text: 用哥伦比亚自杀严重程度评定量表筛查后记录分级 Screen with the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale and record the grade.

zh: 哥伦比亚自杀严重程度评定量表
text: 按哥伦比亚自杀严重程度评定量表问，他属于四级 On the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale he scores grade four.
攻击行为发生后应记录诱因、经过与处置 After aggressive behaviour, record the trigger, course, and management.
昨晚有攻击行为，把输液架推倒了 There was aggressive behaviour last night and he pushed over the drip stand.
评估自杀手段可及性后应联系家属清理家中危险品 After assessing access to lethal means, contact the family to remove dangerous items at home.
家里有农药，自杀手段太容易拿到，得让家属收走 There is pesticide at home and lethal means are too easy to reach, so the family must lock it away.
自杀干预记录须包括风险等级与随访安排 Suicide intervention records must include the risk level and follow-up arrangements.
自杀干预先保证人不离开视线，再谈治疗方案 Suicide intervention starts with keeping the patient in sight, then moves to treatment planning.
自杀未遂患者离院前须完成风险评估与安全计划 Patients after a suicide attempt must have risk assessment and a safety plan before leaving.
这次自杀未遂是服药，洗胃后情绪还很差 This suicide attempt was by overdose, and he was still low in mood after gastric lavage.
自杀既遂后应按规定报告并做好家属安抚 After a completed suicide, report as required and support the family.
